text:
It's all about tender chicken - and Timing

My wife and I were recently traveling through Nashville and needed to get some lunch. Having eaten at Hattie B's in Memphis, I knew how good the chicken can be; I truly enjoyed the Large Dark on my first visit in Memphis. 

This time, however, we didn't have time to stop. We each got the 3 Jumbo Tenders which are easier to eat in the car; they are equally as good as the Large Dark I normally eat. Unfortunately, they were a bit too spicy for my wife, but I thought it was great. The chicken was moist, juicy and had a great crunch. Oh, and the Blue Cheese dipping sauce helped calm the heat for her as well as enhance the taste.

To sum it up, you've heard about Hattie B's for awhile, right - now go get some and see for yourself what everyone is talking about. 

Oh, the timing I mentioned? I was fortunate enough to have only 2 people ahead of me when I came in. Shortly after, the line grew to more than a dozen. Bottom line - the wait is worth it.

text:
My party of 4 came here for appetizers and dinner at 5:30 on a Monday night and we had excellent service and excellent food. I have never been to a Yard House so this was my first experience.

Our server Andrew got our drink order and let us know we could order off the happy hour menu until 6- half off appetizers and $$ off drinks. We quickly ordered fried Mac and cheese, chicken strips, pepperoni pizza, and cheese curds to share. All for half off. Nothing like a nice discount to make it a little easier on the pocket book.

We were happy with everything. The chicken tenders were nice and crunchy and came with Dijon mustard and ranch. Not spectacular ranch but I forgive that. The pepperoni pizza was thin and crunchy, slightly spicy sauce and a good amount of cheese- surprisingly yummy. The breading on the cheese curds were not as dark as I've seen other places but they were still crunchy, salty and delicious. Oddly, the came with honey and some sort of horseradish dip which was odd. The star of the show: macaroni and cheese bites with tomato bisque for dipping. Just trust me on this- please order these if you like delicious food!

We enjoyed our meal and service was great- thanks again Andrew!

text:
I have been eye balling the Faceless Samurai for quite some time now. I love sushi but they also have a few Japanese dishes I wanted to try. 

The restaurant is a small establishment that is tucked away on Tampa road in the same strip mall as Queens Pizza and a Shell station. 

Atmosphere:
When you walk in you feel like you are walking into a humble Japanese restaurant. Along the right wall are booths that allow you to sit on pillows and a low table. Down the center is a long banquet table that can hold a large party or several small parties. A great community table. The left side has typical chair and tables. Towards the back is a well lit and modest sushi bar. 

The owner, Duke, is personable and is honest about his portions. He had the opportunity to sell me more food than I needed but said that the dish I ordered should be filling for one person. 

The food and people that work there are well liked. I was the only one that wasn't a repeat customer. Duke and the waitress (didn't catch her name, she too was know and liked) knew their customers' names and food preferences. By the end of my dinning experience they were calling me by my name. 

Their customer service is so exceptional that Duke made a mistake on a to go order and told the customer that if it should ever happen again call and he will bring the correct order to her. WHAT!!! Amazing!

Food: I ordered gyoza and okonomiyaki. 

The gyoza was delicious. The meat stuffing was well seasoned and balanced in flavor. It was moist and not chewy. The wrappers were delicate in texture but didn't easily fall apart. They were cooked perfectly, steamed and pan fried so that you get the juxtaposition of soft wrapper next to crunchy wrapper. 

The okonomiyaki was huge! The pancakes/ crepe like wonder was packed full of flavor. The edges were crispy while the center was soft. They included cabbage and seafood. It was topped with eel sauces, mayo, seaweed, sesame seeds and bonito flakes. I tried to finish it but I could only eat half (next time I'll dine with a friend). I highly recommend this as an appetizer for a group of 2 to 4 people.

I look forward to trying more dishes!

Cost: 
Gyoza $ 6.5
Okonomiyaki $ 10 or 12 (can't remember)


I will definitely be back!
name: Amber

text:
It's an insane bias I have built into my DNA that I automatically think less of and expect less of a restaurant when it is located in a mini mall or strip center as an attached tenant build out and NOT a stand alone building. I am delighted to report that Gino's has gone a long way in disproving my own stereotype.
Honestly if I could give 6 stars Gino's might be the first recipient of such an "honor" which is saying something coming from a person who has a visceral reaction to suck cliches as "I'm giving it 110% effort".
Keeping it very simple, this place was awesome in my opinion. Not only was the food fantastic but the service was absolutely spot on. 
There was only 2 of us that night but when our food was ever so delayed in coming out, the owner came over to our table to apologise....Now I am a believer that dinner is NOT just a meal but if done right, it is an experience. And trust me please, we had a delightful experience. In fact, according to us the food came out in perfect order, just when we were ready for it.
My colleague had the lamb shank and I had the special flat iron steak, cooked to a perfect rare temperature.....
Our waiter was great. The hostess was welcoming. The bus staff quiet and quick and the owners visit was a treat in and of itself.
I plan on going back and have saved it as a Meridian favorite.....mic drop.
name: Scott

text: I've heard a lot about Bardea so my boyfriend and I were super excited to eat there. We were greeted by the host who was super friendly and the ambience was amazing, unfortunately that's where the good things ended. After ordering our wine, we ordered the cheese and meat board. For $24, I expected alittle more than deli meat and crackers. The nuts that accompanied it was stale and the cheeses were nothing out of the ordinary- I probably could've found better cheeses at Walmart. My boyfriend ordered the spicy honey pizza which came out alittle burnt and the flavor was very average. I ordered the Spaghettino(?) and the pasta came out horribly underdone. I asked our server Emily if they could recook it since the pasta was crunchy and the kitchen just sent out the same pasta with more sauce that was nuked in the microwave. Being a server and working in the restaurant industry, I have never had a kitchen fix a meal that was undercooked by reheating in the microwave. For the prices and reviews, I really don't see what the big deal was. I could've gotten better pasta that would've been cooked right at Olive Garden than I did at Bardea. Our server Emily was very mediocre and seemed unconcerned about our satisfaction despite me not touching the food. Very average, wouldn't recommend.
name: Mia

text: Glad they are back. We ate here almost weekly until the fire. It took a while for remodeling, but the new place looks great on the inside. They have the same fantastic menu, with the falafel sandwich added back in. The service is polite and efficient . They also have outdoor seating.
name: Dotar

text:
I dashed off to Lonnie's after checking Yelp for Lunch places nearby. I was excited to discover a place I hadn't heard of, wondering if this could be another hidden gem.
But alas I was not feelin Lonni's
At first glance I was skeptical as this sandwich stop was completely dead while the surrounding locations were buzzing with hungry lunchers
I headed inside anyway to finish my mission 
I ordered the Sunny Bird sandwich as the special of the day and when it arrived the name on receipt should have read Lonnie's Bread now with a little sandwich 
Sometimes....bigger is not better 
While I attempted to pry my mouth wide enough to take a bite of this sandwich all flavors were masked with a dry flavorless sandwich bread almost 2 inches thick on both sides 
This might not have been bad if it was a delicious bakery bread that was magnificent all it's own but sadly this was not 
Once I was able to get through the bread the combined flavors of Turkey, sunflower seeds, sprouts and some type of sauce actually went very well together and the flavor was very good. Although it actually reminded me of the tasty turkey from Einstein's Bagel minus the delicious soft Bagel.
Lonni's tries with the flavors but falls short in this Foodies opinion
I think if they stepped it up a notch and rather than your Mamas sandwich from Texas changed the focus to a more upscale gourmet fare they might do ok with the surrounding competition
name: Jennifer

text: The staff seemed tired but still polite. The music was louder than it needed to be. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasnt expecting at all. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Pretty happy w it overall. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: I ordered from Fratelli's for the first time ever tonight and was horribly disappointed. Not only is the food only subpar, but I ordered a chicken parmigiana sandwich and instead received a meatball sub. I tried to call to have my order amended but the manager said there was nothing he can do. Don't waste your time or money with this place.
name: Ella

text: Absolutely love this place. Great food, incredibly nice owners and a massive beer selection.
name: Riain

text:
Took a stroll here on a Sunday in a hung-over stupor. Walked past a few places and saw the glorious prospect of a gyro omelette on their menu. Bliss. 

The owner and staff are probably the nicest and friendliest staff I've met in a long time. They even let me sit in a booth alone as I'm sure they could tell the bar seating would result in catastrophe in my hung over state. 

The gyro omelette changed my life. Headache a mere afterthought. Tzaziki sauce was on point, especially since  I chose the tomatoes as my side. Bacon was cooked to perfection. 

I will make it a point to stop here any time I come back into town! Sober, drunk, or anywhere in between! Thanks Gloria!
name: Pat

text: This is another great lunch spot on the Westbank. The service is very friendly, and the options are dizzying. I ordered the pho ga and fried egg rolls. The pho was more like ramen, salty and buttery with a taste like bullion. I couldn't detect the usual flavors of fish sauce, and the broth was very yellow. It still tasted good, and I'm not going to begrudge the chef some bullion. I also bought a taro bubble tea before I left. While I've absolutely had better,  the prices were low and service was fast.
name: Jessica

text: Had a great time and the crab cake Benedict was great. Erica was an excellent server too. Check it out!
name: SaLvatoré

text: Food was pretty good but the prices are definitely high.  Service was average and food takes a long time to come out.  I didnt find it to be amazing like other reviewers have said.
name: Xiao

text: If you need something quick this is your place.  If you want high quality...keep driving.  I have been here numerous times for a 30 minute lunch.  You can get in and out quickly.  The staff have always been nice but the food is just not that great.  If you know what you are getting into this can be a good stop but don't go here looking for top shelf Mexican food.  It's right off of Briley parkway next to the 40 freeway so it's convenient to the airport.  They have plenty of parking.  Friday's they do $5 fajitas which isn't bad.  If you work over in the area or are catching a flight it may be worth a stop but if not don't spend the time making the drive across town for this place.  Ground beef tacos vs shredded to me is a dead giveaway that says generic vs authentic.
name: Aaron

text: The food at Boca is awesome. There is a variety of salsas to choose from with a wide range of heat levels. Their guac is very well seasoned as well. There is a great balance of flavor all around. But one of my favorite things was to watch Cheif Maria, who is obviously very talented in the kitchen come out and not only serve the food sometimes but also bus a table or just wipe off a table for a customer. AMAZING leadership! Well done all around!!
name: Melissa

text: Service was great, burger was amazing, menu had lots of appealing choices for adults and kids. Would absolutely eat here again.
name: Emily

text: Great cheesesteaks.  Arguably one of the best in Philly.  Off the beaten path from the others always noted in south philly.  And definitely better than the pop cheesesteak spots in Passyunk.
name: Mike

text:
Terrible coffee. Stale burnt no good 
I don't know why yelp makes me write more words than "bad coffee" to rate a coffee shop, but so be it.
name: George

text:
Where: First Watch
What: Breakfast. Brunch. Lunch. 
Description: Skillet, Avocado Toast  , Million Dollar  Bacon  !! This place is a must come! Thank you for treating us so well. Their bacon is delicious btw ! I am very very impressed! If you haven't been in and you're in the south jersey area, come now! Excellent service! Get here early on the weekends to avoid the wait and use yelp to place your spot on the waitlist!  

Instagram: @CollegeFoodAddicts
name: Chris

text: My go to place when I'm craving for some good pho. Coming from Dallas I have a very high standard and I find this to be fairly close to my expectations
name: Nghi

text: The food here is wonderful and the setting on the water very enjoyable. Definitely a good place to eat!
name: Jack

text:
Amazing food and quick happy service 
Great variety for breakfast with large portions
name: Ron

text: Parking was annoying and I was already in a bad mood by the time I got inside. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text:
Very simple menu. Various hummus dips with pita or other Isralei dips.
Good spot for a quick snack but I couldn't use this as a full meal
name: Vishal

text: Looking for an inexpensive lunch near the airport and we were lucky to find this place. The food was really food, especially all the soups. Everything we ate was very authentic and tasty. The service was awesome as well.
name: BeerMe

text: I had spent a whole day traveling and wanted a good meal but this place wasn't open when they said they were. Oh well.
name: Megan

text: Matoi is my new go to sushi place in south Tampa! I love their specialty sushi, specially the dynamite and the Mount Fuji rolls. Delicious! Their crab rangoons are also very good, and they have lots of non sushi options as well. The service is good and quick. They have a cool system where each table has a button you can press if you need a server. Highly recommend!
name: Nara

text: These people that work here were nothing but nice to me. Thank you for the great panini and kind gestures.
name: Stac

text: Excellent price ! Food is tasty. The barbecue is perfect! Not a huge buffet but enough variety. I'm in love with the calabresa sausage. Wishing they could sell them; even ship them for me. Definitely worth 1:40h drive .
name: Fernanda

text: The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: In Nashville for the weekend and found this little spot - my sister and I both lived in Asia (Taiwan and Singapore) for years, and found this a very acceptable walk down memory lane! Xiao long bao (small steamed buns) were good,  and Taiwanese Salted Crispy Chicken took me back to the streets of Kaohsiung. Service was solicitous and friendly; they were busy, but got our food quickly and hot. Prices are average ($8.95 for steamed buns, $11/plate for entrees) but portion sizes are generous. Rice was the only disappointment, a surprise at a Chinese restaurant, but we had so much food we didn't miss it. Orange slices for dessert were a treat!
name: Katherine

text: A little taste of France in the heart of Philly. I came here around 9am on a Wednesday morning, so it wasn't too crowded. I ordered a breakfast ham, egg, and cheese crêpe and got to watch them make the crêpe right in front of me. It was affordable ($5.55 excluding tax+tip), filling, and delicious, albeit slightly heavier than what you'd get on the streets of Paris. I definitely want to come back to try some of the sweet crêpes!
name: Yunica

text: The food came out fast, which was good because we were starving. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again. It looked better online than it did in person. Food was fresh and service was quick.
name: User

text:
This was definitely our favorite meal in New Orleans. We made a reservation for a Saturday early dinner, but showed up about 30 mins early and were seated right away. The restaurant has a sort of pub atmosphere but a creative and extensive menu. It's right in the middle of French Quarter.

We ordered the crab cakes for an appetizer and wow! I'm from Rhode Island and have had crab cakes in Baltimore, but this was the best crab cake I've ever had. There was plenty of crab meat, and the sauce on top was full of flavor and complemented it perfectly. 

For my entree, I ordered the Cajun jambalaya pasta and it was also delicious! There was plenty of shrimp and gator, the pasta was cooked perfectly, and the flavor of the sauce was very unique. 5/5 would recommend. 

Finally, for dessert we ordered the bread pudding with a side of vanilla ice cream. I wish it had fewer raisins but it was still very warm and moist. 3 days later and I still think about this bread pudding! 

Our server (Brad?) was excellent and made great recommendations. The prices of everything was very fair for the quality and portion size you get. Overall, we had a great experience and will likely return.
name: Sakoun

text:
Came here on a light rainy day. We order the Jambalaya and gumbo. They were both delicious! We chit chatted with our server as well and found out he was from the west coast who moved out to NOLA recently. 

We really enjoyed the vibe here. From other reviews it looked like others had to wait a bit before getting seated, I think we just got lucky that day.
name: Corie

text: They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Food was good and came out fast. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text: Awesome! Consistent service and fast seating. They cater military events also and the food is great
name: Shelby

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Kind of landed in the middle for me. Not bad for a quick meal. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text: Not saying it's perfect, but some reviews make it sound way worse than it is. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Maybe expectations are just off for some people. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: We came here for a family brunch on a Sunday. I haven't been to Hartefeld in years, and it's changed a lot. There was a good selection of breakfast and lunch items. Everyone else ordered a salad; I got french toast. The toast was good! It also came with a generous serving of hash browns. My coffee was mediocre--it was pretty watery and warm but not hot. The salads were a good size and looked great, but those who got salads remarked that they were still hungry after lunch. Perhaps more protein or a side of bread would be helpful to make the salad a more complete meal--the shrimp salad only had a few shrimp.  In all, though, we had a good time. The service was great.
name: Leah

text: Price felt a touch high for what it was. Food was fresh and service was quick. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. You can tell they care about customer experience here. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. A very pleasant experience. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable.
name: User

text: Not sure why this place has such split reviews, but my experience was mostly fine. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The staff seemed tired but still polite. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. I'd maybe go back, but I'd order differently next time. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text: Great place, if you want both "dogs n frys" it can be a little pricey. But that's okay because they're BIG loaded dogs and BIG loaded fries. Awesome menu, music is too loud most the time though. It's a gem in Florissant
name: Aisy

text: For the price I expected a little more care. So yeah, the whole meal felt kind of uneven. Idk, i've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. maybe I just came on an off day. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text: The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. It just never really recovered once things started off weird. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Food was good and came out fast.
name: User

text: I've been waiting to try this spot for a while and finally I went! I had the combo of jerk chicken and oaxtail. It came with rice, cabbage and plantains. It's so good! Full of flavor! I want to go back and taste more of their dish. The spot has a super cool vibe plus It also has a bar! I'll be returning soon and will be recommending this to everyone I know :)
name: Heydi

text: What a great place.  Service was excellent.  Ordered the wings as an appetizer and boy they were delicious!  Then ordered the Grouper dinner and blackened grouper wrap.  Both were delicious!  They have happy hour $1.50 draft beer and $3 well drinks, .65 wings or peel and eat shrimp.  Everything was delicious !
name: Cathy

text: It's was all really good but seemed expensive for the price and a little bit small portions
name: Trevor

text: Honestly I think I ordered the wrong thing. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again. Would probably stop in again if nearby. For the price I expected more than this.
name: User

text: Nice little spot, decent portions too. Would probably stop in again if nearby. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text: I would give 3.5 stars out of 5 if I could... Their dishes looks wonderful! But the taste is kinda normal. We ordered a Tonnkoto ramen and Key's chicken (fried chicken). The ramen tastes alright, but the smell of pork doesn't go away... Fried chicken was good. But to my standard, the flavor was little bit too light... I probably will revisit, but definitely not because of the ramen...
name: Violet

text:
It's Cinco De Mayo so what better place to enjoy tacos, right? Unfortunately not.
They were pretty crowded, not surprised. Never worried about that. Having a packed house is always great. However it isn't so great when your family is seated in a back corner table and forgot about. 
We sat patiently for 20 minutes waiting for someone to order our drinks and food. The worst part is, we watched people get sat after us and have their orders taken and drinks delivered. We even tried to wave our waiter down! How embarrassing. We got fed up and just left. I let a man in charge at the cashier know and he didn't apologize or even try to help the situation. 
Like I said, busy day. I get it. But make sure you have enough people on the floor to serve your paying customers. 
Won't be returning as of right now, sometimes all it takes is one bad experience.
name: Tolini

text: You need to come here and eat the portions are huge and the food is delicious. The atmosphere, the music and the service is impeccable.
name: Tahtianna

text:
I almost felt like I was back in S. Asia when dining here.  The food was authentic, and certainly delicious.

I'd recommend to any friend, and I look forward to bringing my extended family back to this restaurant.

Prepare to loosen the belt.  You're going to be stuffed full when walking out of the place because the food is so good.
name: Brady

text: I have been to my fair share of nice restaurants around Indy so I have become quite picky when it comes to what is 5 star.  Service 100% met those standards.  Our waiter was knowledgeable and always prompt without being overbearing.  He did a great job helping with wine selections and recommending dishes.  Food however I would rate as a 3 star.  Not because it wasn't good, but because it wasn't as good as I was expecting for the price.  Obviously you are expecting to pay a premium but I also expect a premium product.  I felt my carbonara lacked flavor and I was not super impressed with the tonno appetizer.  Everything was beautifully plated though and my boyfriend did really enjoy the lobster tortellini which the server raved about. Overall its a beautiful space and great staff, I just wasn't sold on the value of the food for the money.
name: Taylor

text: The food was okay nothing out of this world. Similar to Vallarta's foods. But the waitress was very nice.
name: Ruben

text: Breakfast bowl looked like it came from a gas station. Would not try again, was very disappointed
name: Laura

text:
This place was recommended by my brother and his wife when we went into the city together to get lunch and drinks. It was fantastic. We arrived as they opened at noon on a Monday. We had the bar closer to the entrance to ourselves. The bartender was prompt with greeting us and she engaged us in conversation throughout our lunch and drinks. She was very fun to chat with and made our visit extra memorable. 

The food was excellent. I had the club and we all split the fried cheese curds. I highly recommend trying the cheese curds, they were extremely tasty. My brother and his wife each had the fried chicken sandwich, which I hear is excellent. Of course they made me privy to the information after placing my order . Nonetheless, my sandwich hit the spot. I am sad I accidentally left my leftovers behind, I was really looking forward to them later in the day. I also tried a mango ale here which was perfect. I wish I could remember the name. If they have it when you visit, give it a try, as you must stop on in if you are in the area.
name: Matthew

text: I went here for Wednesday trivia last night and had a great time. Don't order the steak, not good. The shrimp tacos and mac and cheese were reeeeally good. It will be hard to try other things next time. The mozzarella sticks were good as well. The nachos were nothing special. The tito's moscow mule was just ok.
name: Mandy

text: This place is AMAZING. Great flavors and beautiful service. They are just getting started but with this food, there's no doubt they will stick around! We came in on a Saturday for lunch. We ordered a Jibarito sandwich, mofongo with carne frita, and some rice. DELICIOUS! If you're in the mood for some great food, come here!
name: Kem

text: Casual dining at the mall. You already know what you're getting into. But these guys take it to a whole different level of neglect. Host says 20 minutes to be sat. Waited nearly an hour. No apologies- couldn't care less. Finally get sat. No server/table greet for nearly 15 minutes. How does corporate let these places slide so poorly? And you wonder why casual dining chains are dropping like flies.
name: Michael

text: Find another one if possible. Food was terrible and overcooked. Service was unorganized and awful. Bathrooms dirty! Management sat in the corner and didn't help keep things flowing at all. Just terrible.
name: Aaron

text: Good food, absolutely terrible service. I waited until our fourth visit to write this review, thinking perhaps the poor service was a fluke. It's a shame, because the food is pretty good--not awesome, but good. We've had the spring rolls, various soups, and a couple variations of the vermicelli bowls (bun). All decent. But my god, the service. It borders on hostile. It's not just surly, it is aggressively neglectful. Each time we visited, it was in the late afternoon, when business was sparse. Each time, the servers were aloof, disinterested, dropped food off without checking for accuracy or to see if we needed anything, did not refill drinks or waters, and sat at the bar playing on their cell phones while we roamed the restaurant collecting the things we needed to consume our food. I've had poor service, scattered service, but this goes beyond that. They just do not give a single shit. Maybe get take out, if you choose to eat here.
name: Chrissie

text:
This bar is so fun!
I was here the weekend before July 4th with my friend. 

Drinks were made well: not too strong & not too sweet. They were playing hip hop music most of the night and almost everyone in the whole bar was dancing. They had a few beach balls being bounced around the dance floor. For part of the night they even had someone going around offering people free shots. How could I turn that down?

I'm not sure if they always do this or it was just for the holiday weekend because I'm not from the area. But next time I'm back in Santa Barbara, I'll definitely be back.
name: Clarissa

text: Awesome spicy tuna rolls.  Fantastic service.  This is a favorite of ours and visit regularly.
name: Mark

text:
Visiting Santa Barbara dropped in for dinner at Finney's... wait was 30 minutes but was offered a community table.. no wait! Was fabulous... got service immediately.. the food was yummy and the service was fabulous.. we had a blast! 
I highly recommend visiting Finneys... good food.. fun... friendly staff
name: Lorrie

text: Good beer. Bad soft pretzels. I could've made a better pizza at my house. No sauce. Really cool bocce area and bar area
name: Lyle

text: Awful pizza. Cold, nasty sauce, cheese hard & overcooked.  St. Louis lets down again. Nothing much more to say, order a chain instead of this crap.  Cinnamos - hard as leather. Raviolis - disgusting filling can't even describe what it was, brown puréed something, vomit.
name: Royce

text: Food is AH-mazing!!  We had a reservation and even though they were busy they still got us seated in a reasonable time. We frequent this location all the time and will continue to come back!
name: Brittany

text: The Causeway Cafe is quaint, cute & has great outdoor patio seating. The ice cream is homemade, delicious & very special. The pizza is very tasty, cheesy & fresh. The "Greek" salad leaves much to be desired. It is mostly iceberg lettuce. No oregano or Greek spices & no onions at all. 3 small strips of green pepper, 4 small pieces of underripe tomato, 4 small chunks of feta & 6 Cubs if boiled potato (!?!?!?) The dressing for as vinaigrette, but should have  been a Greek dressing. Although I ate it, it was just a plain salad. I am hopeful that my comments will be helpful toward improving this salad & adding to the already great Cafe! Let us know forward to giving 5 stars.
name: Linda

text: The food is okay, suffers from the chain resturant blah. Sonny's is better and cheaper. Bouggt a pobd of brisket to go for part of a party tray got home 12 ozs including the container. nit worth making the complicated U turn off of Ulmerton to get in their driveway
name: Walt

text: We checked it out tonight and we were impressed. Place is nicely done, a whole new place, very clean and great and friendly service, not to mention about the food. It all looks great and quality. Nice sound system for the background music,  not really my type of genre but at least it's pleasant, I'm against screaming guitar when I'm eating. Looking forward to try their All you can eat menu . Highly recommend it. Nice to have a quality restaurant nearby and not downtown St. Pete. I think Tsunami has a big competition. Josh was our server and was very friendly and attentive.
name: Lito

text: I wanted to like this more than I actually did. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Maybe better dine-in than delivery, hard to tell.
name: User

text: We were in the area fir a graduation and decided to try Happy Hour.  Yes, the casino is smokey; however,  the restaurant is tucked upstairs and the smell was tolerable.  They have a fantastic Happy Hour!  Plates are large, cocktails tasty and sizable pours with wine.  Probably will go back tonite!
name: Kim

text: Overall a good experience. Here on day #2 and they're doing fine. Had the lobster sandwich. Tasty. Would have preferred a bun instead of sliced bread. The chowder was excellent. Fries were covered with cheese, bacon and chowder. Not what I expected but still good. The shrimp required more work than worth the effort. The corn was delicious. Overall a good experience. We will be back to further explore the menu.
name: Harry

text: Had my birthday dinner with family here and the food was very, very good. Everyone was pleased with their choices. My medium rare filet mignon was closer to rare, but that was okay as I took part home and reheating was better this way! Even at the table it was still very tender and yummy. I got the shrimp cocktail and it was amazing! Dessert was the Blueberry Cobbler and I loved it. Our server was clearly less experienced than he needed to be to work in such a busy restaurant-the place was packed! He did his best but there were a few rookie errors and odd events. All in all they did not detract from a great evening and he was very nice. I will return-the Brick finally looks great and serves great food!
name: Linda

text: Cute place serving burgers, shakes, and fries with ingredients from local farms. The moo cheeseburger was really flavorful and cooked perfectly. I could have eaten more than one! Fries hit the spot. We loved the paper straw with the milkshake, and the glass water bottles. We'll be back sometime when we're in the area again. :)
name: J

text:
We ordered a large pizza and boneless wings meal deal from here last night using UberEats and were super disappointed with the caliber of food we received. I legit would rather have ordered from Domino's or any other chain pizza restaurant than here. 

The pizza was SALTY. Raise my blood pressure in one fell swoop salty. Salty enough that we had to throw it out, as it was inedible. The toppings were also randomly scattered in a way that meant that only parts of the pizza were covered. We also swear the boneless wings were a package of Tyson's chicken that were smothered in gross barbecue sauce. We ate that since we were hungry, but were extremely disappointed. 

Sadly UberEats does not give refunds but I will certainly be taking it up with this restaurant.
name: Erika

text: It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Food was fresh and service was quick. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Would absolutely visit again. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text: First off, this little restaurant does not use MSG, which is a plus. The ingredients they use seem fresh. My mom and I ordered the Pho Tai, shrimp with broccoli, and the lemongrass tofu (can't remember the actual name of the dish). The lemongrass tofu had such a unique taste to it. We liked everything that we ordered. If you don't like rare beef in your pho, you can request it "well done" without issue. Dine in wait time seemed reasonable. Definitely on my top 3 chinese restaurants in the Tucson area so far.
name: Demi

text: Love this place, coffee is great , sandwiches are made fresh. The atmosphere is very relaxing!
name: Nancy

text: I get the appeal, I just don't totally share it. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Anyway, delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Also, my friend liked their dish more than i liked mine.. Also, our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. not sure I'd order the same thing again. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text:
Prep & Pastry never disappoints. The line can be really long, but everyone I know says it's worth the wait! I always take visitors here and many of them continue to say it was their favorite meal in Tucson. 

Don't go here if you want traditional breakfast dishes. It's a great testament to Tucson's UNESCO City of Gastronomy designation. Enjoy!
name: Daniel

text: Out of town on business. Was a little surprised how we were debating if we should eat here or not and the next two people that came out told us that we need to try it. Goodness. This was fantastic and worth every penny
name: Tony

text: Excellent!  Bacon /cheese fries where so good.  Fish tacos too.  Waitress was the best.
name: Kathleen

text:
Went for lunch with family including youngster. We did Hibachi grill for lunch. Service was good and prompt, but they are not the chatty types. Chef paid special attention to youngsters making it a fun time for them. Spring roll appetizer, steak Hibachi lunch were both very good.

I did not try sushi, but everything we saw looked very good. We will be back.
name: Nate

text: Fantastic experience, we thought that this was going to be another overpriced breakfast place however the service and excellent food need to made this a great experience. Shout out to Aaron for his hard work and attention to service
name: R

text:
We've been to Founding Farmers KOP twice now and have enjoyed our meals. The menu has so many choices sometimes it is hard to narrow down what you want to order. First, two words: bacon lollies. Trust me, you won't regret it!

The KOP seafood stew in 'memory making' sauce will clear your sinuses and make you dip all of the bread in there so you don't miss a drop. The fried chicken and donut is two HUGE pieces of chicken fried to perfection, with a glazed donut made fresh in the bakery downstairs. The short rib pasta is a-maz-ing, with handmade rigatoni and fall-apart beef with mushrooms. Can't wait to go back again to try something else, maybe brunch next time!
name: Karen

text: We tried a sampling of the jerk wings, beef fat fries, meat pie, and boudin. Everything was fantastic! The jerk wings weren't the typical. They had a little sweet taste and some kick. The meat pie was by far our most favorite of the sampling (if we had to choose one).  Was staying in the French Quarters but caught an uber over, just a short drive.
name: Pheadra

text: Delicious pho and fresh quality ingredients. They are not stingy with toppings even when we asked for vinegar onions. The pho came out piping hot! Broth was yummy. Took maybe 10-15 mins for the pho to arrive. They do take credit card. But has msg for sure because I was thirsty after.
name: Crystal

text:
Jessica was our server and she was amazing!!! She made our experience so enjoyable that we started off with happy hour and stayed for dinner.  

She recommended the short ribs, they were very tasty.  Also the hurricane is so good here, its fresh and full of passion fruit.  I loved it.
name: Danielle

text:
We popped in on a Saturday night. We got there about 7 pm. We were told it wasn't busy. We got seated right away. There was 4 of us in the group. I am happy we got there when we did by the time we left it was crazy busy and there was a wait. 

Our waitress was Cait. She was fantastic! She greeted us and told us about the drink specials. I opted for the Pink Lady Long Island Iced Tea. My friend opted for the Blue one. Mine was delish!!! It was gone in NO TIME! I know understand why they are busy.  $4 or $5.25 for Long Island Iced Teas, that are scrumptious. 

We ordered some appetizers! We got the garlic knots. Omgeeeee! They were so yummy. They were crunchy and doughy and garlicky. They came with 2 dipping sauces. You don't need them as they can stand alone. 

Cait suggested the bacon cheeseburger. Once again OMG!!! It was so good. There is bacon IN the burger! I wanted to keep eating but I got full!!! It was so tasty. My son opted for the Chicken Tenders and Fried Shrimp with the Cajun Fries. Cait had warned us that they had a kick to them, but my son was  unphased by kick. They actually had a very delicious flavor. My son finished his entire meal. He said he was full but he could t stop eating. I know exactly how he felt. 

I have to say that for an appetizer, 2 entrees, and my drink our bill was very reasonable. I enjoyed the atmosphere, our food, and the service.
name: Andrea

text: This is our absolute favorite Mexican gem! Friendly and fast staff who make whatever you want to yours specs. A must try!! You won't be sorry.
name: Mrs

text:
Ok this spot has a cool concept. Basically you order your food and can sit down in a play area for kids while enjoying your food, drinks and watching your kids play, all while you enjoy the beautiful beach side weather.

We had heard it gets really crowded and been told to make a reservation before coming. So we called a few days before but we were told to make a reservation online. So we did that, sent the message on the website but didn't hear back for a couple days. Then I sent a message on Yelp the day before and got a message back within 2 hours saying we had a reservation. Great!

So the next day we are en route, running a few mins late, as usual with 3 kids, so I wanted to call to notify them. There was no answer. Ugh. When we arrived, we found a line to order all the way back outside the door onto the sidewalk. Double ugh. So this place IS popular. Ok. We waited in line, finally got to the front and placed our order. We got our drinks (yes, they serve limited alcohol/beer, even though the drinks are kinda weak) and walked through the playground to find a table. We found a table with our name on it, even though we were a little behind the time slot written on the card. Some other people had sat down there and were eating but politely moved when we said it was reserved for us. No problem. After all, we were late. I think they gave us a buzzer to let us know when our food was ready. The food was not great. I felt like I was eating cafeteria food (I had a burger and fries) but the atmosphere was cool. It was laid back, relaxed and fun for the kids. It was the typical beach like atmosphere. I'd come back for sure but I'd definitely try to order something different.
name: Byron

text: I love this location.  Online orders are always fast and accurate.  Plus I love picking up my food and going inside to catch a song I love but haven't heard in ages.  I can count on them to inspire a playlist addition.
name: Shamara

text: Disappointing because heard it was good . Portugal style chicken no flavor and over priced . Forgot to bring mushroom dish orders by friends . Very noisy as I heard it was . Friends were not impressed with their steak frites .
name: Richard

text: 1st Time here! Great taste! Our food wasn't hot when it arrived. Will give them another try in the future!
name: Rachel

text: First time coming here. Down visiting from NY & the hubby wanted cornbeef hash. Unfortunately no other places have that except here. So we came for breakfast. The cornbeef has was homemade & my hubby enjoyed it. I also got the grits, unfortunately I didnt care for them, must be use to waffle house. Tho my eggs came out perfect, just the way I like them..
name: Mel

text:
We came for margaritas and dinner. 
We were a party of 5 and did not make a reservation on a Friday at 5pm. We sat at a high table because all tables had reservations. So I recommend making a reservation! 
Food was great and so were the flavored margaritas. 
We will definitely return.
name: Carla

text:
Seeeriously the best meal we had in NOLA. The hospitality was over the TOP. Harold you're amazing! To start there is complimentary Corn bread w/ garlic butter & parsley.  

We ordered: 
Gumbo: so tasty and full of meat
Alligator Cheesecake: more like a quiche super airy and so yummy! Must order
Drum meunière: such a huge pice of fish! Lightly battered and cooked to perfection.
Bbq shrimp: omg soo many shrimps! We were surprised, we thought maybe 5 large shrimp tops... but we were wrong! More like 10 or more pieces. Cooked just right! 

Everything was yummy! And we have already suggested it to many of our friends coming 
into town. You will not be disappointed.
name: S

text:
Use to be a very good place to nosh on Classic American favorites. 

Sadly, Eeekk, They are using dirty over used and not change in who knows how long GREESE ! Fishy Fries Are NOT on the menu not even on their secret menu but that's what my french fries smelled like , I
Returned it and settled with a orange Shake, that too was nothing special. 

This place has potential to be a great Diner.
name: Bea

text:
One of the best places to go to in Philly to reward yourself! There's always high quality beef and the carousel makes it super easy to always have food to eat. The staff have been super nice for the past few times I've been. Quynh was my waiter this time around and she's really nice and helpful :) 
Just warning - there's always gonna be a line no matter the time of day! 
Bonus- they have some great bops playing for background music.
name: Gloria

text: I had the chilaquiles verde and a side of biscuits. The biscuits were good, but the chilaquiles was not what I expected. It was more like pulled pork nachos with a dab of guacamole, cream, black beans, cheddar cheese and a sprinkle of chile verde sauce. It was ok. I rather go to an excellent Mexican restaurant to get a chilaquiles dish.
name: J

text:
It was lunchtime, I was at my company's Tampa office, and the talk of food began. Somehow this restaurant's name popped up and the rest is history.

Ended up ordering one of their lunch specials. It was $10 or so and it was so large that I had leftovers. Had the roast pork lunch special that included the aforementioned roast pork, as well as white rice, black beans, and fried plantains.

Now one of my coworkers knowing I come from Miami was hesitant about recommending this place to me. He kept going on about his time in Miami and how their pork is fabulous. Have to say that the pork from this restaurant is, too, and that surprises me. I had set the bar really low, but nope, I didn't have to pretend to like this pork. 

The pork was moist, juicy, and the type that I just wanted to repeatedly eat. The rice and beans were on par and the fried plantains had the perfect mix of crunch and sweetness. I was in heaven and all this in Tampa of all places. I am impressed and more impressed that I had two full meals. These people don't full around.

Probably the one reason I don't give this place five stars is because I need to try more of their cuisine. That and I'm confused as to whether this is a Cuban or Spanish restaurant. Or maybe both. I don't know.
name: Marilu

text: The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Definitely coming back. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text:
It's lucky I only VISIT Washington U. and friends in St. Louis because
if I lived there, Piccione Pastry would make me obese in a very 
short time.  They catered the event I attended (Student LIFE Reunion,
the campus newspaper) and I must say that everything I sampled
and took home was superb.  I am particularly fond of the macaroons
which are different from the Italian kind but so good in their way (and
fresh.......).  They had a variety of sugar cookies which were also
loaded with butter and tasted so fresh that.......
name: Ruth

text:
I really love this place. They get busy around meal times but you can typically get a table without a wait. The food and service is very good, and they're pastries are phenomenal! I highly recommend the lemon soup and the gyro platter is big enough for 2 to share.

There's free parking in a fenced parking lot around back (off Hope St.). Don't forget to ask your server for a ticket if they forget to offer, otherwise you will have to pay.
name: Joe

text: I will never come back here ever again. I made a reservation for my wedding anniversary months ago. I called the hotel to confirm my reservation the week before our stay to confirm. On the phone they said all is confirmed. We even had spa reservations. We show up today and they tell us our reservation was cancelled and they are fully booked and so they have nothing available. The front desk manager Morgan Melanson was incredibly rude and had absolutely no sympathy for our situation. I have never experienced worse customer service. I can't believe this is supposed to be a five star hotel.
name: Abhaya

text: Amazing is putting it lightly. I had the 5 course tasting menu and every bite was a burst of imaginative excellence. Pork belly with Dijon mustard aioli and Brussels-sprout slaw just an example. Yumm. Service excellent with a genuine interest in customer satisfaction.
name: Lois

text:
I feel like it's about time I write a review of this place considering I've been going to Terakawa at least once a month for the past couple of years. Now they opened up this location and it's even closer to me! Service is nice and fast, as to be expected.

Over the years I've tried just about everything here but my usual is the Kyushu Danji bowl. It's huge! I always eat half and take the rest home to have for dinner. The broth is honestly the best I've ever had - it's dark, almost black in color, and intensely savory and garlicky, though I still do add tons of the fried garlic that they leave on the tables. I came in a bit congested today and the flavor managed to transcend my clogged nostrils! The Kyushu Danji (spelling is probably wrong) bowl has 5 pieces of their delicious pork belly slices that are so good I get chills pretty much every time I eat them, along with a lot of veggies like cabbage that allow me to pretend I'm eating healthy. 

As much as I love terakawa, they can be hit or miss sometimes with things such as softness/tenderness of the pork, and the flavor of their traditional tonkatsu ramen broth can be a bit bland sometimes. As long as you know what to order, you'll never be disappointed and probably become a drooling regular like me. 

Add a mini curry rice bowl to your order as a starter, they're amazing!
name: Sandra

text: Love this place for breakfast. We have gone everyday and every time we are in NOLA. If you go early, they have an early bird breakfast which includes everything you could possibly want on one plate. Servers are really nice.
name: Brooke

text: Unfortunately, here is what I remember. Sticky floors, flies that harassed us, a chicken quesadilla with some kind of sauce that tasted like pizza sauce, an extremely salty carnitas lunch and 3 flat sodas. Must be all the tourists who come to see the arch with the good reviews.
name: John

text: 1st time here food blew my mind amazing food stuffed going back soon. Service was amazing. Food came out on time amazing across the board. Parking was free. Best of all tappers acarde was next door eat drink and go play next door like a big kid.
name: Eboni

text: Their pizza is just amazing. I drive one hour to eat their yummy pizza. I lived in Florida for 14 years and by far this is the best pizza.
name: Keysha

text: Loved this little French restaurant. Felt like we were right back in Paris. We ordered the cheese board, which had plenty of accoutrements. The bread basket was beautiful and had plenty of options. I had the burger and my husband had the ricotta ravioli. Both were excellent. The only downside is that is was a bit overpriced so be prepared to spend a pretty penny.
name: Christina

text: Food is awesome. Service is awesome. Love the coconut shrimp. Steaks are tender and cooked perfectly.
name: Nancy

text: Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. The wait felt longer than it should have. Wouldn't really choose this place again. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Not bad for a quick meal. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text:
Excellent fusion food and great service!

We were looking for places to eat at downtown New Orleans and were so happy to have found Maypop. This restaurant is located within a few minutes walk from the Hyatt hotel and reservation can be made online. 

As for the menu, the restaurant serves fusion food with Asian and creole flair. I ordered the fried oyster as appetizer and it was crunchy and light. For entree, I had the shrimp noodle at the first visit and the soft shell crab in the second visit. The stir fried shrimp noodle dish was great with homemade noodles, although the noodles tasted a bit more like pasta than Asian noodles. The soft shell crab entree was delicious, with whole fried soft shell crab on vegetables. 

As for prices, appetizers are around $15 and most entrees are $20-$32. The service was great and the ambiance was trendy and intimate. 

Highly recommend this fusion restaurant!
name: Ika

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. For a busy night they handled it okay. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text: I stopped by on my way to work for a quick lunch and to pick up for my later meal at work.  I ordered two grouper  and the Cali fries with steak.  I ate the Cali fries for lunch and saved my tacos for later.  I wish I had the opposite as the tacos were awesome but they would have been much better hot off the grill. The tortillas tasted so fresh and good.  The Cali Fries were not what I expected.  They weren't bad but they didn't knock my socks off either. You get you choice of protein on the fries,  I chose steak and I wish the portion of protein was more.  Cut down on the portion of fries and increase the steak and it will be much better. Taste wise the fries were meh... I will definitely stop by and try their other menu items. The girl was super with customer service and was very friendly. She brings out the food to you even though I wouldn't expect with this type of establishment.
name: Michael

text: For the price I expected more than this. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. A couple small things kept adding up. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. For the price I expected more than this. Food was good and came out fast. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: Maybe it was the time of day I was there, but it wasn't hopping and the food and drinks seemed a little pricey for the value. I love blues and share a birthday with BB King, who I never got to see live. Thought this would make up for it. It didn't.
name: Dennis

text: Food took forever but ended up being better than I expected. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up.
name: User

text: Overpriced and overrated for what you get.  I went here for an anniversary dinner and we were seated in a room by the bar which was very loud.  That in itself didn't turn me off but it didn't help either.  The staff was nice but nothing special.  We were told by the waiter to order the crab cakes as an appetizer because they were known for it.  They were over $20 so I was like...man...these are gonna be awesome.  So we get them and it's two little crab cakes on a plate.  I was like....hmmm ok.  I tried them and I'm not gonna lie...I wanted to like them sooo bad.  But they just weren't all that great.  Surely not $20 great.  The salad bar was the highlight in my opinion and it looked like there were really nice places to sit in other areas of the restaurant.  I got a steak that was good but not great.  I had a $100 gift card but still ended up dropping almost $100 and I didn't even drink.  Parking is easy as it's pretty much in a strip mall location.  I don't plan on going back unless someone else is buying.  There are plenty of great places in the Nashville area that are better and less expensive.
name: Aaron

text: One of the best biscuits I've ever had, and I'm from North Carolina! This place is to die for. Prices and service are wonderful. We love to bring out of towners here.
name: Bridget

text: The restaurant is nice.  Service was good. Food was okay. Definitely had better from other Latin restaurants.  The Mojitos were ok. The pictures make you want to go in, I doubt to go back unless it's for an event with friends(if they choose that location).
name: Aurey

text:
The meat is the star of Seoul Taco! From the beef to the tofu, the flavors are perfect.  They do a great job at balancing the sweet, salty and the tenderness.  All choices (chicken, beef, pork, or tofu) are delicious and go well inside the tacos, mixed in Gogi bowls or even top your nachos or place in a burrito.

My favorite is a tie between either the bowl or the tacos. If you want to try all the meats, choose the tacos each with a different selection. They include greens and a nice drizzle of spicy mayo. This is probably an excellent first timer option. The bowls are good too, but I have had others that have outdone theirs with good veggies and toppings. Seoul's are filled with rice, greens and topped with a generous heap of gochujang and a fried egg.  Pretty good! 

Seoul is definitely a great place for a quick meal, healthy options, and modern twist on Korean flavors!
name: Jessica

text: Amazing dishes! Service was great (Mack) we really enjoyed the atmosphere but best of all was the food! Well done!
name: Al

text:
I finally got the apple, walnut, cinnamon knodle and it was quite tasty! I stopped by a few different times because I have been wanting to try it. The first time I was told it'd take a half hour to make, another time the machine didn't work, another time the chef had to go to the bank, etc. I called it in and got there and waited for about five minutes for it to be ready. It was 4.80 for a Knodle which is almost a sticky dough pastry filled with hot apple compote. The inside was really delicious. It was dusted with cinnamon sugar. I liked it! My advice would be to call ahead and make sure they can make it before you go. Also if you check in on yelp you can get 15 percent cash back! 
The owner is nice and they have really good hot wine that tastes like cinnamon.
name: Lauren

text: After arriving to pick up a TO GO ORDER, one of their employees approached my coworker in the parking lot to tell him that the waitress was upset because he didn't leave a tip.  My question is, when did you start tipping on to go orders? And why is one of your employees harassing a customer in the parking lot for tips?  After all of that, the order was not correct.
name: Rohmell

text: I got a couple orders of pelmeni which I love! They were tasty! Definitely worth trying!
name: Kiel

text: Usually would stop here for drinks and the other night decided on food and it was fantastic! They have a really awesome selection of burgers - you have a selection of turkey chicken or beef patties and really can't go wrong with any of the burger selections .. there are many other items on the menu I'm lookin to try and definitely plan to return
name: Ryan

text: Portion size looked small at first but it was actually enough. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. For a busy night they handled it okay. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text:
This was the best meal we had in New Orleans. Mediterranean food! 

Such a delightful spot with a cute interior and excellent service. AND UNLIMITED PITA BREAD! We ordered 3 dips/"salatim": acorn squash, baba ganoush, and matbutcha. The latter two were definitely the standouts for us. Sooo yummy with the bread. We were recommended the fried chicken hummus, which was also great!! 

The falafels were delicious: perfectly crispy on the outside, flavorful, and paired perfectly with the cabbage slaw on the side.

I noted in the reservation that it was my friend's birthday, and they had a hand-written card ready for her! Very thoughtful. We had such a great experience at Shaya and I would definitely recommend adding it to your list of places to try when in NOLA.
name: Emily

text:
Stopped here with some friends on a Monday night while traveling through New Orleans. It was a no brainer when we saw they had 1/2 off pizzas, wine, and drafts during happy hour. 

Everything was great! We ordered garlic knots, cauliflower, a cheese pizza, and the prosciutto pizza. The garlic knots were my absolute favorite as they had a wonderful flavor and were served with a wiped provolone. The pizzas were good, but the sauce could have a bit more zest to them.  

There were a few tables when we arrived, but it got pretty busy throughout our hour stay. The service was great and they never missed a beat. 

I will certainly pop back in on my next visit to the city!
name: Qiana

text: This place isn't good at all. In comparison to it's competitors like Chipotle and Moes. The food was very unflavorful, rice is super over cooked, prices are too high and customer service was poor as well. All in all, terrible experience and will not be back.
name: Silly

text: I've been here twice now and can say I do enjoy their dishes and highly recommend the Roti Canai as an appetizer or appetizer(s)! This day I attempted to be adventurous and try out the mango chicken--if you're interested as well be aware there is a sweet/sour taste to it (it's mango of course) and I chose a side of rice to even out the flavor. The dish ended up being too sweet for me but I was still able to enjoy a portion of it as well as my mom's (I forgot what she got) noodle stir fry & my friend's  chicken curry. This place has a lot of options and recommend trying it out when visiting chinatown!
name: Paris

text: Stopped in for cocktails, stayed 3 hours, haha. Good vibe, great staff. Very friendly, personable. Will be back soon for dInner.
name: Maureen

text: It was our (me and my fiance) first time here and we loved it! There's a good variety on the menu (sides, tacos, burritos, etc) and the atmosphere/decor is very welcoming and aesthetic. We ordered one Asada taco and one Chipotle BBQ taco. We loved both! They were a tiny bit expensive at $3.60 each, but they were worth it. They came out lightning quick, and on cutting boards instead of plates (very innovative). BOTTOMLINE: we recommend and we will eat here again when we're in the area again.
name: Bella

text: Was here two days in a row. 1st day had the Bloody Mary & shrimp & grits. Excellent. Second day had the omelette with gator & crawfish. Lukewarm & disappointing. Hostess was rude. Great music though!
name: Stefan

text: Only place around open past 10. Ended up tasting pretty good too. However I asked for the house hot mustard and I got honey mustard instead.. that was not pleasant.
name: Hunny

text: The Tanzanian brew with HWC is worth the wait.  Not far from the train tracks but a great place for a caffeine jolt
name: Dave

text:
Kwok's Bistro, where the 'ole China Diner used to be. I've heard so much positive reviews about this place and now I've finally tried it for myself. And let me tell you, I can see what the rave was all about! 

Just by first glance, there was an area for outside seating, and when we stepped inside, it was totally revamped. The restaurant still felt cozy but it didn't feel packed. Kwok's menu has been simplified to just a handful of selections versus the over 100 items China Diner used to have. However, with the few selections Kwok's seemed to have, each and every one of them looked and sounded appetizing. They even had a Chef's Special menu. 

When it comes to the service, the waitress was friendly and the bussers were on it. I wasn't used to seeing so many workers in one cozy restaurant seeing how China Diner only had a handful of people working there. 

The food we ordered, man, I was so excited! I ordered the Roasted Pork with Fish Collar Claypot and my friend ordered the Roasted Duck Noodle Soup. The duck was tender and the broth was light. I'm not sure what exactly the type of noodles are called, but I call 'em skinny noodles and I love it. The Roasted Pork with Fish Collar Claypot was very savory. It also had chunks of tofu too. Everything was so tasty and filled with flavor with every bite! 

I know Kwok's Bistro is a completely different restaurant from China Diner, and I know I've been comparing the two a lot on this review. For me, I actually liked China Diner not just for the food but for the people who owned the restaurant and when they closed, it was a bittersweet moment. I appreciated China Diner for being that "hole in the wall fast food Chinese restaurant". I guess what I'm trying to say is, if there was any restaurant to replace China Diner, I'm very glad that it's Kwok's Bistro.
name: Cory

text: Should've taken pic B4 going in...but it couldn't help it. It looked so good and tasted even better. This is the mini parrillada w/perfectly seasoned grilled chicken, andouille sausage, pork chop and beef.
name: Sabrina

text: Very welcoming staff, espresso drinks done to perfection, nice tea selection, and interesting pastry selection. I love the big open space and high ceilings. Stay a while...read the paper, meet someone new, or just relax. This is a great neighborhood joint.
name: Stacie

text: There is zero service but all attitude! If you get any food you will be lucky! Don't bother with this location.
name: Lori

text: This place was louder than I expected and that sort of shaped the whole meal. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The staff seemed tired but still polite. The music was louder than it needed to be. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text: Nice little spot, decent portions too. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Not bad for a quick meal. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Food was good and came out fast. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. It looked better online than it did in person. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: I was craving a smoothie so decided to visit tropical smoothie cafe on Fowler ave. I asked the staff what's the best selling smoothie and they suggested the sunrise sunset smoothie. It had mangos and strawberries along with a number other ingredients. I would definitely suggest trying this smoothie. The small size was all I needed and definitely tasted delicious. Great summer drink.
name: Jacqueline

text: I stopped by Franks on a recent trip to Philly and enjoyed a pretty darn good lunch.  I ordered a plate of pierogies with homemade sour cream, mac-n-cheese and green beans for sides, and threw in a piece of banana cornbread for a sweet final addition.  All of it was really good.
name: Tony

text:
My cousin and I went for dinner on a Monday night and it was pretty busy! There was a small line but since there was 2 of us we got to be seated pretty quickly at the bar. Of course we had the oysters, specifically the chargrilled and Rockefeller one and we like the chargrilled better. The Rockefeller had spinach which I didn't care for too much but we're still pretty good. The bread pudding is delicious but definitely good for people with sweet tooth's! 

What really made our experience super awesome was the bartender Ryan. He was busy but still found a way to be attentive. He was so sweet and gave me water as napkins because I had gotten spices in my eye. Thank you Ryan!!
name: Kristen

text: Stopped by for a quick bite and few beers. Our waitress was friendly, prompt, and kept our glasses full. I had the classic upland wheat, an old favorite. I tried the hummus sandwich and it hit the spot! My friend had the nachos and it was a huge serving, definitely enough for a few people!
name: Kaleigh

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Overall, a strong experience.
name: User

text: Can't believe we lived in Summerland for over 2 years and had not been to Rincon Brewery. Truth be told, we're not big beer drinkers so we don't really think of going to a brewery to eat. Came to find out that the food is amazing! Best Chinese Chicken Salad and Lamb sliders! RB is now our go to spot for lunch. Love the food, service is attentive, and the energy is always upbeat & lively. And Alma at the bar is a delight! And even though I can't speak to it personally I'm sure the beers are top notch!
name: stuart

text: Stopped by after work because I was nearby and hungry. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. For a busy night they handled it okay. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Kind of landed in the middle for me. Not bad for a quick meal. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: Great beer and a cool atmosphere.  They also have a great menu which is sure to get your taste buds buzzing!
name: Matt

text: Had the cheesesteak sandwich right on the water was really good the homemade potato salad was out-of-this-world two of us had lunch for twenty bucks can't beat it great view of the river friendly service and good food
name: Kevin

text: Food was fresh and service was quick. You can tell they care about customer experience here. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Food was good and came out fast. For the price I expected more than this. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text: This is more like a 3.5 review. I've heard mixed things about this place, but when my friend picked this as the spot for her 30th birthday dinner I was still pretty excited to try it out. My husband and I got there before the rest of our party so we sat as the bar and I ordered the Mardi Gras margarita. I guess I'm so use to going to typical Mexican restaurants that I was expecting this $11 drink to come out in a big regular margarita glass. I wasn't too surprised when that wasn't the case though. The drink tasted good, it was just tiny. When more people arrived we were seated and the salsa with chips and plantains were brought out. Delicious. I loved those. When the birthday girl arrived, our server came around to take just drink orders even though most people had a drink. He wouldn't even let someone order guacamole. He struck us as a bit odd and service was extremely slow. We ended up here for 2 and a half hours. Once the drinks came out, my friend was able to order the guacamole which never came out until he asked about it again. I do have to say that when it did come out it was really yummy. My husband and I split the pork burrito which came out already split for us and was very good. We also ordered a side of street corn which was pretty good as well. Overall, I enjoyed the food but the weird service and high prices made the experience less than stellar. I have noticed though that they seem to have great happy hour specials on margaritas and tacos, and I would like to come back for that.
name: Brittany

text:
After being stuck in traffic for five hours, the last thing I wanted to do was drive to get dinner. Consequently I succumbed and did something out of character. I got on UberEats and started to search for places that could deliver to the hotel I was staying at.

Because of the fact that I was more exhausted than hungry, but I knew I had to eat, I ended up ordering what I consider light - SUSHI! To be specific, I ordered a Mexican roll and a ginger salad. You know, pretty standard fare for this type of place.

My food arrived pretty quickly. No complaints on that. Presentation was fine. I just wish they hadn't been so stingy with sauces and napkins. At any rate, had the ginger salad and found the sauce strong. Same issue with the wasabi. There's an expression that says "se le paso la mano," which figuratively means they went overboard (literally means "they passed the hand") and that's exactly how I felt about the flavor of the sauces there.

I'm not sure if maybe I ordered the wrong thing or what, but know I ate it, got ready for bed, and slept like a baby. Then, I completely forgot about this meal until now. It simply was unmemorable.
name: Marilu

text:
Good food. Slow service. 

The duck gumbo was  and the tater plate was 

If our waitress sees this - his name was Akil. He's been dating a girl for two weeks but it isn't serious
name: Josh

text: Another average burger joint but with soggy fries....decent beer selection with ok atmosphere.  Service is about what you would expect for a place like this.  Given there are dozens of this same type of restaurant in this area, I'll give it a year or so until it goes by the waste side.
name: T

text: Second time to grit and it did not disappoint! Started with the fried cauliflower and butternut squash. Really good flavors especially with the cashew yogurt sauce to dip in. We got the Nashville hot chicken (sweet and spicy, juicy and crispy), steak tacos and grit dip. All were outstanding with good sized portions. The side salad was also on par- m lots of chopped vegetables and candies pecans yum! We will be back
name: Monica

text: Four of us were at the training dinner.  Despite a great wait staff, it could not save the dinner; all four meals were bad.
