The steak ordered rare was grey and rubbery with a fake grill mark; the scallops with grits were inedible, grossly over-salted and bitter; the fish and chips was also highly oversalted --not just a little, but like the scallops, as if someone simply poured salt all over the dish.  The salmon had a metallic, weird taste.  Our very good waitress was at a disadvantage because the bar did not have our wine ready in a timely way (both the first and second bottles were very late, by the third it came on time.)  They have a lot of work to do, and first they need new kitchen staff.  I know it was just training for the real opening, but this there is more than one of these places and they should have their menu down by now.
name: Word

text: This place is amazing I took my wife here for our anniversary and she loved it and the piano bar was great
name: Richard

text: The BBQ shrimp and spinach dip are amazing. Great variety in the menu. Good and nice service from the staff. Everything that I've ordered from here has been great, along with the carry out and delivery orders.
name: Velour

text:
Delicious, pleasant atmosphere and reasonably priced. My family tried this out for dinner in the hopes of finding great Indian food.  We do not know Indian food very well so this was a bit experimental for us.

My husband had Chicken Vindaloo and asked it to be seasoned hot rather than mild or medium. It was flavorful and spicy. He doesn't like rice but loved it with the butter Naan.  I tried a bite. While it was a little too warm for me, it also had a fantastic smokiness to it.

My teenage daughter had the Chicken Biryani. She prefers something mild and enjoys seasoned rice. She got both. I tried it and liked it too, especially the seasoned chicken. 

I had the Chicken Tikka Masala seasoned mild. It was loaded with exotic flavor yet not too rich or overwhelming. I can't wait to have it again. 

Service is a bit slower than what I might expect at a the neighboring restaurants, but still good.  I look forward to coming back!
name: Lisa

text: The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. A couple small things kept adding up. Wouldn't really choose this place again. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Food was fresh and service was quick. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Food was good and came out fast. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: Not gonna lie, I was a little skeptical before coming here because I'm a New York pizza snob, but I really really liked the pizza here. A group of 7 of us ordered two 18" pies -- one was half cheese and half vegan, the other was half pesto and half vodka. At first we thought we wouldn't be able to finish everything, but we had NO problem eating all of the pizza. I didn't try a vegan slice, but the others were so good. They nailed the plain cheese, which I think is the sign of a good pizza place. But I think my favorite was the pesto pizza. I also got a nitro milk stout from the bar which turned out to be the perfect pairing. Would definitely recommend for anyone looking for east coast-style pizza in Nashville. Also shoutout to our waiter Stephen -- he was so friendly!
name: Marissa

text: Simply put...delicious!  Ordered the small bowl of Steak and Meatball Phó w/vegetables. The broth was so flavorful and everything was perfectly cooked, and for under $8 a bowl. The staff here are amazing, very helpful and knowledge. If you love a good Phó, you have to check out this restaurant. The only issue I had was they were out of bean sprouts and the only reason they missed a star.  After all bean sprouts are one of the best parts of Phó. Check this place out you won't be disappointed!
name: Dan

text: Amazing staff, coffee and food! I highly recommend a stop in. I've had iced lattes, smoothies, peach mozzarella balsamic toast, blueberry scopes, and chicken salad croissant...I've come in a few times and have not been disappointed. So glad you're here!
name: Luli

text: The soup was better than the sandwich, which I wasn't expecting. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. I left full, which at least counts for something.
name: User

text: We had not been here in years and, after last night's meal, we're regretting our absence mightily.  Perhaps it's because we came to dinner without specific expectations, but every item we ordered was a home run.  Any restaurant that aspires to high-end excellence needs to get the middle-of-the-fairway items perfect (e.g., food cooked EXACTLY as ordered/appropriate, capable and attentive service, ambience, etc.) and the Inn at Barley Sheaf Farm certainly did that.  A truly extraordinary meal, however, is one that exceeds those expectations and borders on the revelatory.  That happened for us several times during our meal last evening.  Couple that with extremely friendly hosts and servers and you have the ingredients for a tremendously enjoyable evening.  We will happily be including the Inn in our rota of outstanding local restaurants and returning soon.
name: Paul

text: We showed up 30 minutes early for our 7:30 res on Saturday night.  I've been wanting to try Oceano for a while and was looking forward to a nice dinner.  When we checked in, the hostess advised "it would be a few minutes."  She was not at all cheery and inviting, nor did she suggest "have a cocktail at our lovely bar while you wait" which would have been fine, and actually given us an indication that "a few minutes" might mean something more than 5-10 minutes.  After waiting for those 5-10 minutes we inquired as to how much longer, thinking perhaps a drink at the bar was advisable.  By now, the bartender had asked if we were being helped. The hostess then in a noticeably condescending tone, advised us we were early and it would be a while before we could be seated.  Upon which we walked out, went to 801 Fish with no reservation, sat in the bar and had a wonderful meal.  Maybe the hostess was having a bad day and eventually I'll let it forget about this and try Oceano again.
name: Dave

text:
All You Can Eat...if you only want one plate

I've been a frequent diner at Oyster Shucker prior to the new management, because of their 'All You Can Eat' special which was offered daily.  When they no longer offered that special, I was forced to look elsewhere so imagine my excitement when on a whim I called to find out they offered the 'All You Can Eat Crab' on Tuesdays!!  Stepping back into Oyster Shucker (now added Craft & Draft) the new design and decor looked amazing - they have upgraded to a more refined look and  provided more table top spaces.  The new Staff is welcoming, knowledgeable about their menu and extremely accommodating.  The menu choices has been revamped and will make the inner foodie in anyone do a little happy dance.   However, the 'All You Can Eat Crab'  night needs a lot of improvements or simply does not need to be offered.  All the positive things I listed about the remodel, Staff and menu was immediately overshadowed due to the confusion, lack of quality and inability to satisfy customers who want eat crabs until their belly burst.

The first round of crabs my group of four received were cold.  However, by the time we received food at the table I was so hungry a tear almost fell from my eye because I had waited almost 25 mins. for my food to only be sent back because it wasn't hot.  The Manger on Duty addressed our table and attempted to apologize and I am thankful for that, but apologies do not fill empty stomachs.  I was starving and spent the whole day dreaming about my reunion with Oyster Shucker's All -You Can Eat Crabs.  After my friends and I ate our first round of crabs, there was no refill!  From my past experience, there was a Staff member that was dedicated to passing out crab legs to those who had ordered AYCE.  We sat and waited for our waiter to ask if we were ready for more, but by this time it was too late - I was frustrated.  I shouldn't have to find a Staff member to request more food.  After the first round of crab were delivered to the table, the waiter should have taken an order for the second round.  I understand it is a busy night and there are several demanding customers, then you need to adjust and plan for a crowd. 

I hope to return to Oyster Shucker on another Tuesday after they have mastered their AYCE.
name: Cidney

text: We know better and usually dress for this restaurant but were feeling lazy and casual and took a chance. The host was gracious and allowed us into the bar lounge where we received excellent service.  While piano music entertained, we had some drinks,  wedge salad and a delicious blue cheese encrusted filet.  Same great experience just from a different angle. Enjoy!
name: Chris

text: We had a great breakfast here this morning. My husband and I built our own plates and had a mix of eggs, sausage, cheesy hash browns, and sourdough pancakes. My son loved the dipped French toast, which is cinnamon raisin bread dipped in sourdough batter. The service was quick and the staff were very welcoming.
name: Lisa

text:
Delicious! Generous Seafood Jalea plate (fish, mussels, yucca,calamari rings,lobster octupus , chifles and cancha).. Perfect for three people. IT IS HUGE!. Heavy on onions, which is great - I like onions.
We also had their ceviche de pescado.

Very clean restaurant, lovely servers. Specially señora Sophia 

Another note: This restaurant's checks already include the tip.
name: Paloma

text: Sat at the bar and enjoyed watching the drinks being made.  Had a HumaHuma and a Monsoon which are our favs.  Then we had our usual burger.  Cooked perfect and scrumptious.  Couldn't eat my potato but it made a great lunch the next day.
name: Penny

text:
Arrived on time for our Mother's Day celebration, the maitre d greeted us rudely by looking us up and down and proclaiming that there was a 30 minute wait. No hello, no smile, and no inquiry if we had a reservation. We informed him of our reservation for 5 and were told to wait. 

After a few minutes the maitre d took us to a table for 4, which we rejected. We were directed to leave the restaurant and wait outside again. 5-10 minutes later he called us in again and directed us to a table. 

My wife sat down but was creeped out by the obvious filth left behind by diners before us. I started to try to clean the seat I was about to sit in but decided that wouldn't fix the problems at the Oyster bar on this day. 

We walked out and enjoyed our dinner in another restaurant. Having dined at the Oyster bar on other occasions, it was a huge disappointment. 

We refuse to patronize establishments with rude, or indifferent, customer service employees or cleanliness failures. I doubt that we will try to spend our hard earned money there again.
name: Mark

text:
Still looking for a good Chinese restaurant in the middle of Tucson.

The buffet is VERY expensive compared to buffets from other states I have lived in, almost $19 per person on a Sunday.  VERY expensive and the food was just so so.  Crab legs were served, must they must have been on the Nutri-system before getting caught.  I couldn't find anything to crack the crab opened with either, the wait staff don't understand English at all.  I finally had to walk over, point to the crabs, and act like I was breaking them over.  The waiter brought me water instead!   ERRR.  Finally another waiter brought me a nutcracker. The shrimp was cold.  The fried rice was sticky.  The roast beef..............ha.  It was really tough.  How tough you ask?  So tough I couldn't even cut it with the specialty knife provided.  Took me a while, but I finally was able to saw through it, but I should have just left it.  It was so tough, that I couldn't even eat it.  My teeth could not chew it, it was like rubber.  Now I know what people mean when they say the meat was like shoe leather or rubber.  That's their roast beef.  My wife tried the ribs, those too were terrible.  Sigh.....Will not go back, that is for sure!!

Still looking for just a decent Chinese restaurant.
name: Rob

text: This is a very laid back, casual sushi restaurant. The dumplings we had for appetizers were delicious. The sushi was good too. There were a lot of families and kids. A nice restaurant for a casual weekend dinner
name: Lacy

text: A meal to remember. Stumbled upon this place when shopping on Magazine Street with my husband. We snagged two seats at the bar and had a few cocktails and some appetizers. The crab beignets!!! The cauliflower salad! The pickles! Simply perfect. Great service at the bar, we will be back!
name: Lena

text: Poor service, okay food. They are nice to you if they seem to know you, cold to you if they don't.
name: Gary

text: I absolutely love this place this place is a must if you are over by the beach which I know you will be just stop in and show your face and get some shrimp tacos they are the best trust me you will not be disappointed
name: Odessa

text:
Oh wow what a step back in time! Soda fountains, milkshake machines, swivel stools at the bar, tile decor, and welcoming atmosphere! And not to forget the ICE CREAM! my mouth is watering again just thinking about it. 

I came here with a girlfriend for the first time not too long ago (and it definitely won't be the last!) After having lots of trouble deciding between the amazing options - and getting some solid advice from the server, as well as a sample of the dark chocolate ice cream - I decided on the traditional banana split sundae (served vertically in a glass. Good thing I didn't have a large dinner because this filled me up: layers of 3 ice creams, hot fudge, strawberry syrup, caramelized banana, and whipped cream. You won't regret it!

Fantastic for a date night, girls night out, family dinner, or casual dessert run. This place is great for all - and I'd highly recommend it.
name: Danielle

text:
The portions were smaller than we had expected, but filling, and the flavors were excellent. My wife had a chicken sandwich and I had a steak sandwich. Awesome selection of beers that I'd come back to sample even if the food hadn't been as tasty as it was.

The only reason I can't give 5 stars is because the smell of grease in the air inside the restaurant was overwhelming.  The next day, we had to wash the jackets that we had worn inside because they smelled too strong to wear.  This was our first time at the restaurant, so perhaps it was an odd night.  If not, better ventilation would score an extra star from this guy...
name: Justin

text:
This place is poppin!! It was super busy and the line was almost out the door on a Sunday night. 

Our server was efficient and attentive. He suggested we ordered the soup dumplings right away since it takes a while to make. He said they steam it one table at a time. This means it's made fresh?

It did come out steaming hot but honestly the soup dumplings were just okay. The first dumpling I had was just unlucky, I think it bursted so I had no soup in it. Therefore, it was dry and not too exciting. The meat inside was great, I really enjoyed the crab and pork because it had a good seafood flavor. 

I tried another one and finally I taste the soup, but I was still disappointed. The dough was too thick which made the texture feel dry. Overall, not the best soup dumplings I've had.
name: Donna

text:
Food was okay. Expensive. But you're in the French quarter, so it's expected. 

Honestly the low rating is for the staff. 
Our waitress was rude and aggressive and when she messed up a coffee order she got defensive and immediately blamed us for not being more specific. Overcharging is for something as simple as coffee isn't a big deal but it's how abrasive and mean she was about it??? So rude. Like it's a cup of coffee. Relax. You don't have to roll your eyes and treat us like we are idiots because you didn't give us the simple coffee we asked for. 

To be honest, it left a really sour mood on the whole place. 

The staff should be just even the slightest bit kinder. 

I would chalk it up to a bad day but even just walking through the restaurant I'd have waitresses be annoyed if it was a crowded space and they couldn't get through. Using hand flicks and speaking with such venom at the customers. It was just not the most welcoming atmosphere.
name: Esther

text: This was our first time trying Smoke Daddy's at a recommendation of a friend and I'm sorry to say this is not BBQ, this is greasy food smothered with butter. I ordered the pulled pork sandwich  it was not shredded pork it was chunks chopped up pork  a lot of it was red I'm not sure if that was raw but it doesn't appear to me to be fully cooked.  My idea of barbecue is not greasy it should be well-cooked, shredded meats not chunks. It clearly appears that this is not good quality meat and that is why they chop it up like they do and bury it in butter and  I wouldn't even say they smoked it walking up to the place you really didn't even get a smell of smoked barbecue when you walk into a barbecue place you should be able to smell it. I may try again and in a couple of months and order something else but greasy, smothered in butter, food is not my idea of barbecue
name: Maria

text:
After an experience of a mishap during dinner, the manager, Kayla, went above and beyond to make things right.  Not only is she a total sweetheart but she's pretty cool too.  
I highly recommend the pink Cadillac margaritas (just get the pitcher, you won't be disappointed) 

Never in my life have I experienced such professionalism and top quality customer service than what Kayla provided.  This restaurant is very lucky to have her in a management position, and her impact should not go unnoticed.  

I will definitely be returning & recommending.  

 thanks El Vez
name: Zach

text: After standing in line for 45 min in the rain we were worried that it wouldn't be worth the wait. It completely was! The eggs lafitte were amazing! Shared an order of the banana nut french toast which was delightfully sweet and delicious. Also shared a side of the chipotle pepper house-made sausage. These little patties were nothing short of amazing! Oddly enough possibly my favorite bite was the ratatouille that came as a side with the eggs lafitte. It was amazing! Attentive service and delicious food. This is a must have meal when in the French Quarter!
name: Joe

text: I stopped by here this evening after anticipating a new opening of Indian food. The staff were super attentive.   Notably the server Cameron was very informative and is one of the best waiters I have ever had. The chef came out and explain the dishes. Really delicious and beautiful interior decor.
name: Anastasia

text: The service was phenomenal. For starters we tried the goat cheese and tomato jam on bruschetta and it was excellent. I had the seafood pasta made with a champagne creamy sauce and it was very good. It is a heavy dish that would be great on a cold rainy day or in the winter time. Overall I think I would visit the place again.
name: Lisa

text: Not a bad place to eat of you like pizza and Italian food in Apollo Beach area.  Great staff, food and affordable.  Must try if you're in the area.
name: CobraCol

text: Do you want ice with that drink? Because you can't have it. Yes, believe it or not. This place has had a hard time providing ice in drinks for it least two months now. This is in spite of my two formal complaints to corporate about what a schlocky operation it is that doesn't even have ice for drinks in 2019. Maybe this location is about to go under and they don't want to invest in a new ice machine. Whatever the reason, McDonald's has always been better than this. It's a small recurring thing in  a store like this, but it's is enough to make you change think whole chain must be struggling. UPDATE: I just stopped by there on July 26, 2019. "Sorry, we are out of ice." The long goodbye continues.
name: David

text: The music was louder than it needed to be. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Definitely coming back. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text: Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Glad we tried it. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish.
name: User

text:
Wow I've heard good things about this place, and finally got to try it!

This place is great, the chicken is more unique than other places.

Their batter is lighter than most fried chicken places, but still seasoned very well. All the sides I got to try were delicious!

Inside seating a little limited, but other than that, no complaints!

Everything's made to order it seems like, I had to wait for my takeout order
name: David

text: Phenomal deal for the sushi. 95% of the time it is fresh with some standard options, but it is a steal for the price. Sometimes they even have a shrimp tempura roll.
name: John

text:
What a good first meal for our first time here in NOLA. I give this place a solid 5 stars. From customer service to the food, everything was top notch. This place set off my first time to NOLA with a bang!

-

ATMOSPHERE
The place is huge, it's got lots of seating, and has a fancy feel to it.  It reminds me of a dining room on a cruise ship or something. Lots of tables, lots of people dining... It could use a little updating, but whatever. Not a big deal. 

CUSTOMER SERVICE
Our server was Chloe (sp?) and she was the BEST! She made suggestions on what we should order, and none of them were a disappointment. She was so attentive, funny, and sweet. She is definitely another great memory I will leave with on this trip! Thanks Chloe!

FOOD
Most restaurants start you off with bread, but this place starts you off with whole, boiled red potatoes that were boiled in cajun goodness. These things were amazing and will be something I definitely remember from my whole trip. Pro tip: if you order the BBQ Shrimp (which you absolutely should), dip the potatoes in the sauce. So
bomb!

We ordered the BBQ SHRIMP. It was my first time trying it and it is mind-blowing. There are so many layers of flavors in this dish and they all meld well together for the absolute perfect bite. The shrimp was cooked PERFECTLY and the sauce.... oh man... the sauce... is so buttery and good! I wanted more! Pro tip: don't forget to suck the shrimp head. That's where all the flavor's at.

We also ordered the BOIL PIZZA which is a pizza topped with crab, crawfish, and shrimp with white sauce and cheese. I didn't think this was gonna be as good as it was. It was buttery, cheesy, and seafood-y... All the flavors of this pizza marry so well together. It was the fave of the evening for us. We ate the whole pizza!

The last thing we ordered was the trio of GUMBO, ETOUFFEE, and their soup of the day, which was some CHICKEN TORTILLA type soup.  The gumbo and the etouffee were amazingly good, I would've been fine without the tortilla soup. It was okay, but it didn't match up with the other two. 

We ended the meal with their STRAWBERRY CHEESECAKE. It was so creamy and delicious. Not too sweet, and the crust was made JUST rig
- 

OVERALL
I will be back the next time I'm in NOLA - and hopefully, Chloe's my server again. Give the girl a raise!

--
Update: 09/16/19

Just a few days after our first visit and I'm extremely disappointed in the customer service and the food. We ordered the BARBECUE SHRIMP PASTA and it tasted like a frozen shrimp linguine meal that Stouffers makes. No real taste of "BBQ Shrimp" at all. 

We ordered the BOIL PIZZA again and it tasted completely different from the first time we were here. I feel like they forgot the white sauce or something and forgot to take it out of the oven, as it was slightly overcooked. 

Our server was super slow. We didn't even get greeted at our table until about 10 minutes after we sat down. The bus boy got us the starter potatoes. The server finally came, took our order, and then it took about 25-30 minutes JUST to get our food. 

Tonight's staff dropped the ball, and it was definitely a disappointment compared to our first visit.
name: Annalynn

text: Come here often and the food is always great!!  Can't say the same for other locations but this location always gets it right.  Love the fried philly roll!!
name: Karen

text: I use to love coming here, but then they hired the slowest, people with attitude, and THE LAZIEST workers and are ALWAYS out of food. Poor management and poor service I DO NOT recommend this location THEY ARE WORTHLESS!!!!!! Choose another location before coming here for convenience!
name: Angel

text: We came here for lunch on a Saturday for their lunch special since they're real close to our new house. We really enjoy everything. I ordered three rolls - shrimp cucumber, spicy tuna, and spicy crab. They were all delicious. My mom got teriyaki chicken, my dad got sushi, and my little sister got shrimp udon. We all finished our plates in no time. My little sister really love her shrimp tempura udon, I really like her dish too. I would def come back again, lunch is 100 percent worth it.
name: Lily

text: The Four Dogs is a lovely restaurant with a great atmosphere and nice staff. However, my recent experience was a little lacking in the food department. The Chicken BLT Pita is an interesting idea but impossible in execution. There was no easy way to eat chicken and vegetables piled on one piece of pita bread. It was under the sandwich section of the menu but you had to eat it with a knife and fork. It was delicious but so difficult to eat. The crème brûlée was good, but a little overdone with the burn. The crab nachos were the redeeming quality of the night because they were simple to eat and also delicious.
name: Rosemary

text: Service was nice, kitchen was just moving kind of slow. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. It was crowded but still moved along. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable.
name: User

text: We found this last minute on our road trip. Came first thing on a Monday morning. No lines. Staff was attentive and gave great recommendations. But the cooks THANK YOU we loved the food. It made our day. Looking forward to coming here next time we're in Santa Barbara.
name: Dominic

text:
Real unbiased review. Got carry out Sunday 5pm, August 18, 2019. Ordered boneless chicken "wings" and a 12 inch Pizza Classico: pepperoni, sausage, onions, mushrooms that I exchanged for black olives, and extra cheese. 

The Bad: Boneless Chicken Wings were terrible--like out of a box and buffalo wing sauce was like tasteless, mass-produced, flavorless, canned blah. The blue cheese dressing was warm and tasteless. 

The Good: Pizza. You're so close to a 100% slam dunk awesome pizza, but the sauce is bland. You're crust is perfect thickness and crunchy, cheese-perfect amt, toppings fresh and tasty; I ordered well-done and it was perfect. But the sauce is bland. Add some garlic please. Do a small focus group. This is so easy to fix. 

There's no good pizza aro MacDill and you could hit a grand slam. I'll definitely order from here again.
name: Matt

text: We figured it had to be good as it was in a neighborhood and outside most of the tourist areas.  We were wrong totally wrong it was amazing!!  Going again!!
name: Henry

text: One of the best restaurants and one of my favorite meals ever! And I am 60, so I've been to a few in my life. I love vegetables and it is apparent that these folks do too. Every bite of every dish was exquisite, including the wine and dessert. Splurge and enjoy this place fully. You are worth it and so are they!
name: Desiree

text: We visited Indy for one night last week & loved eating at this trendy restaurant. The food recommendations by our server were excellent as was the wine. Great atmosphere & food.
name: Rope

text: Wow! Exceptionally good gourmet Chinese. So good, we went there two days in a row! We had pork dumplings, rangoon, pork ribs and kung pao chicken. More ribs, plus kung pao pork and cashew chicken second day. Portions were large, entrees came with sticky white rice. All sauces were exceptionally flavorful. The interior is small but beautiful: bent dark-wood chairs and tables, dark lighting, open kitchen. A real gem!
name: Free

text: Stopped in here before attending Festival of Speed at Vinoy Park last weekend. We were in need of some coffee and a bathroom and Annex delivered on both fronts. We ordered the chocolate smoothie (I believe it was called the chocolate monkey) made with almond milk, banana, and some peanut butter. My boyfriend ordered a to-go cup of tea. I was a little shocked that the small smoothie cost about $6 but the small tea was $3 and most of the breakfast sandwiches on the menu were around $6-7 and granola/yogurt for a little bit more. They also had several different options for lunch. You are definitely paying for the location here. They have several tables outside to sit and enjoy a coffee and people watch. The view here honestly cannot be beat, you can see the ocean and the park and plenty of pretty people and cars walking to the other restaurants, shops, and galleries in the area. Annex also has a small shop where they sell cute gifts and other touristy odds and ends. They have a decent selection of wines to purchase for carry out. Service was a little slow but it was a busy Sunday morning in St Pete and the view was worth the wait.
name: Courtney

text:
PLEASE EXPAND TO MAGAZINE STREET!
Good Bird is everything we need in the 3000 or so blocks of Magazine: affordably priced, high quality rotisserie chicken based sandwiches and salads with surprisingly tasty but not overpowering sauces and dressings.

BIRD MAN JR.
Generously chopped chicken, Swiss cheese, and slaw in a Magic Johnson special sauce with pickles is pretty darn perfect - it even comes with a handful of their house made chips for just $11!
name: Charles

text: Slow inattentive service. Loud. Good food- not great food mind you.  Wanted to live it and make it a daily start as we are staying very near here.  But we have gone elsewhere to start our days after one visit to Ruby Slipper.
name: P

text: Excellent service and great atmosphere! We can have an occasional stooges outside as well.
name: Ray

text: Meh. Pretty average food. Brisket was dry and needed lots of sauce for taste. Slaw tasted generic, and the cornbread pancake was cold. Not the worst I have had, but not very memorable either.
name: Ray

text: Best food truck in St.Louis!  All the bread is freshly baked prior to service ....in the wood fired oven ....on the truck.  (yes you read that right)  FOOD & WINE named them one of the "Best Bites Of The Year" and they've won a bunch of local awards, so I'm not the only one addicted to their tasty food.  My current favorites are their cheese pide and tofu döner - so fresh and flavorful!  My friends can't get enough of their cevapi and chicken döner.  All of us can't wait till they get a brick and mortar so we can stop chasing their turquoise and red truck around town.  Highly recommended!
name: Aren

text: So yummy! Good food, atmosphere and music are great! Everything we tried on the menu is delicious. Fried buffalo chicken salad is phenomenal!
name: Ashley

text: Chef Jake is absolutely killing it at his kitchen attached to The Starboard Side Tavern in Fishtown. This goes beyond standard pub fare. The pierogies are creative and a sensation. Try the Yaki Halushki for an unexpected fusion of Polish and Asian. Even the standard pub grub is elevated. The burgers are perfect, and the chicken ranch sandwich is brilliant enough to deserve a less pedestrian name. Maybe the Amazeballs Chicken Deluxe. Even the fries go beyond the norm. Go! Now!
name: Gordon

text: Delicious, quality food, very well made and good french food this is the place to go for real french food.
name: Andre

text: Service was excellent, food was also great! I had the Chicken Lo Mein, wife had the Chicken Pad Thai. Both were delicious and the portions were just right. $22 with 2 drinks at lunch. Will definitely be going back!
name: Justin
