text: This is the best Pastrami Reuben I've had in Philly and possibly ever (although I have not yet been to Katz Deli). The flavorful meat is so tender and succulent with the spices really coming through. The Reuben was hearty and thick. I'll have to try their corned beef next !
name: Sam

text: Before they used Basa fish in their fish and chips and now it is Swai fish. What happened to Cod or Halibut"?
name: Charles

text: Fun atmosphere and delicious food. We were a party of 18 and our server was amazing! Her name was Alia (sorry-not sure how it's spelled), and she was incredible. Other than having help bringing our food out, which she somehow got out at the same time.. she took care of our large party by herself and we never waited for drink refills or anything for that matter.  Everything was yummy. We will definitely be back next time we are in town.
name: Melissa

text: service was nice, kitchen was just moving kind of slow. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. The music was louder than it needed to be. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Food took a while and didn't rlly feel worth the wait. Food was good and came out fast. Not bad for a quick meal. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed.
name: User

text: Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Price felt a touch high for what it was. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Worth checking out. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text: Not sure why this place has such split reviews, but my experience was mostly fine. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. It was crowded but still moved along. I left full, which at least counts for something. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: Fan-freaking-tastic food. But truly the greens were a game changer. Smoky, silky yumminess. The oysters had a good kick and not smothered in butter and breadcrumbs like many of the other restaurants in NO. The ribs, alligator and gumbo we wanted to freeze and take home. Everyone else will talk about the meat which is delicious but the sides and apps are nothing to sneeze at.
name: Launi

text: Great restaurant! Food is delicious and service is excellent. It looks small on the outside but very nice inside. There are a lot of options for both meat eaters and vegetarians. Awesome find!
name: Laura

text: Great food and staff. A must try.  I look forward to returning soon. Good drinks too.
name: Gibson

text: Been in 3 times first 2 times the ribs were outstanding full of flavor and plenty of meat. The last time on Thursday 5/13/19 the ribs were tough and over cooked look like somebody pulled half the meat off, the beans been sitting to long and was dry. Asked for coleslaw and received potato salad. If You want to eat here go early!! I wasted 25.00 on a meal that I was really looking forward to.
name: Terry

text:
Fantastic! Had the Mocajete. Fixed to perfection. Both food and drink were a little pricey. 15.00 for the entree and 15.00 for a medium Cadalac margarita. It's the new "hot place" so be ready to wait.
The decor is very festive. Very traditional in theme. You can tell they put some money into it. 
Service was fine. It's was busy so it might have lacked the pleasantries you might get elsewhere. It's definitely worth a second try.
name: Cathy

text: Came here for a last minute dinner out. We had a really great experience here. Our server was helpful and attentive, our food was great. I had a chicken salad and my husband had a burger (shocker ;)). I was really impressed with the kids menu! Most places that have a kids menu don't offer anything healthy. We were able to order grilled chicken & steamed broccoli for my daughter, and when she wouldn't eat the broccoli they brought her mandarin oranges which she loved, at no extra charge. Great Job Red Robin, keep up the good work!
name: Kristin

text: This was our first time in New Orleans for Mardi Gras and I love love this place! We had (of course) the famous beignet and it was fantastic! I paired it with cold chocolate milk (which came from a box carton but that's okay) and our friend had cappuccino! The atmosphere and the view was awesome. Definitely one of the highlights while we were in New Orleans. It's the BEST place to satisfy our drunk cravings lol can't wait to go back here!
name: Christine

text: Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Food was good and came out fast. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text: I love the shrimp and grits!!! The service there is good, they're always busy when I go so it's not very attentive but the food makes up for it!
name: Vanhsy

text:
Not your average donut shop. These donuts are handcrafted and not like your Long's or Jack's donuts. The main reason for stopping was their vegan donuts. I always appreciate a good dairy-free food item. The donuts were ok and I am glad I stopped in. Just nothing super special to make me come back. 

The shop is filled with plants and they have a wall where they project a movie onto. Lots of street parking in front of the shop.
name: Breanne

text: Brought 10 people in for a business lunch to celebrate the holidays.  Generally speaking I was very disappointed with everything.  The room was freezing to begin with and it took them way to long to adjust the temp.  Our server had zero personality...they had trouble getting everyone their food...basically mass confusion on who gets what salad.  Of the 8 stakes one had to go back and 3 others were very undercooked.  Is this not a steak house?  The restaurant was maybe a third full.  I won't be going back anytime soon.
name: Tim

text: Went back to Cartago tonight for a special celebration. Our server was so lovely. The playlist was awesome (80's classics). Had a wonderful cocktail (I think it was called hey my girl is on tv) and the best meatballs in the world. Thank you for the wonderful night.
name: Carrie

text: Nothing special. I ordered a sushi roll and it was very boring and small. I shared a poke bowl and for the price, I wasn't impressed. I can't say I wouldn't go again, but definitely wouldn't be my first choice for the high price.
name: Kristina

text: Good local place.  Hard to believe the really bad reviews.  Service is usually pretty quick. Fish and chips a great regular. The wee portion is plenty big.  Sandwiches have always been good for us, same with appetizers.
name: Tom

text:
This place is amazing they have everything a Vegan could possibly want! From tofu to
Seitan , vegan cheese , vegan wine! On top of it the customer service is great. It's nice and clean and the music and atmosphere is great! The large window brings all the natural light making it an even greater place to eat. I loved it and i will be back
name: Erika

text: The music was louder than it needed to be. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. Glad we tried it. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh.
name: User

text: Best Burger ever,I stumbled across the clover grill by and accident. My friend and i both wanted burger's that day and this place didn't disappoint. It's a small place with  a few tables to sit at with stools at the counter. It's like an old school burger joint. The decor is nothing fancy but you won't be worried about that once you taste the burger. We both ordered burgers  and onion rings. The burger is season to perfection i had the works. When i tell you that this was the juiciest burger I ever had. The staff was so friendly which alao gave that old school feel. We loved the burgers so much that we had them again for dinner. The awesome thing about this place is that its open 24 hours a day. So after a drunken night you can get a great burger at a great price.
name: Pam

text: You know a place is amazing when you're making plans to come back and invite other people while eating the bread basket!  This is my favorite place to eat in the city.  We go so often the severs know my little one by name SMH.  ITs a hidden treasure for sure.  I've tried several thing on the dinner and brunch menu and I've never been disappointed.  This place is absolute heaven.  My family and I love it!
name: Mr

text: This is a new restaurant with new restaurant problems. Food was wayyy to salty and cold! No wine menu and servers were completely confused.
name: Debbie

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. For a busy night they handled it okay. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up. Not bad for a quick meal. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Food was good and came out fast.
name: User

text:
This place is a hidden gem! Some friends recommended it but it only had a few reviews so I was hesitant to check it out. I am very glad I did! My coworkers and I all very much enjoyed our food. I had the Gyro and it was on point. They also had some Pho that looked amazing and a few customers I talked to said it was very good. The bread here is fantastic. Watch when they cut the bread, it cuts like butter and is perfect! 

If you haven't tried this place then you are missing out. It's a perfect spot to grab lunch. I highly recommend it!
name: Glenn

text: We have eaten at Anthonino's for years on a very frequent basis and we have loved the food and service. This used to be the best restaurant on The Hill, but we have definitely noticed the quality of the food declining the past two years. We decided to give Anthonino's one last try today for lunch and it was absolutely terrible!  They provided bread and olive oil that was beyond ordinary. Any loaf of grocery store bread is better. The Volpi Sausage Pasta was one of our favorites. Today it was almost inedible. The pasta sauce had been cooked down to a thick, dry paste and the sausage had the taste and texture that it had been reheated a couple times on a grill until it was burnt and so hard it was difficult to cut and nearly impossible to chew. The Creamy Pesto Pasta was too cheesy and almost flavorless. We managed to eat half before calling it quits. The Greek Pizza was also smothered in cheese that overwhelmed the other ingredients. Worst pizza we've had in years. Service was poor. Waitress talked over us when we tried to ask questions. Forgot our simple requests. Ignored us at times and the restaurant was nearly empty. It's a shame how much this restaurant has declined over a few short years. It was our favorite restaurant just a few years ago, but today we made the decision we will NEVER RETURN!  Try one of the other restaurants on The Hill. Almost any of them can do better than Anthonino's Taverna.
name: Len

text: Great place for families and friends.  Kids welcome.  Food was yummy, service was fantastic!
name: Pam

text: Definitely the best place I ate while in NOLA. It is a very small place, very few tables (I didn't know until later there were more upstairs). The place was packed, and the line was long. But was managed very well, it actually went pretty quick and efficiently. Prices were good, and the menu seemed endless! You should definitely visit this place if you get the chance. You
name: Michael

text: The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The food was good and the service was easygoing. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text: Ended up here pretty late, maybe around 9:30, because everything else nearby had a wait. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The food was good and the service was easygoing. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. A very pleasant experience.
name: User

text: The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. By the time the food came out I was already annoyed. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Wouldn't really choose this place again. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. For the price I expected more than this.
name: User

text: Quick and casual breakfast! This place is great if you want something casual to grab a bite or a yummy coffee. They had lots of options and good sizes for coffee which is not always the case at individually owned places. Yummy food and good prices!
name: Jessie

text: Moved to Nashville from Memphis. My husband and I were excited to see Corky's to get our Memphis BBQ fix. We were so disappointed in the food! They didn't have the rolls. Their bbq nachos barley had bbq sauce, a different cheese sauce (white queso), and had lettuce, tomatoes on top with salsa on the side. That is not Memphis style! We have realized Nashville lacks good BBQ.
name: Kailee

text:
First time here and we had a group of 8 on a Sunday. Staff was great and accommodating. Place looked deceivingly small, but had good seating indoor and outdoor. Staff was attentive and nice.

They served rolls & butter first and they were great. We ordered the meatloaf with creamed corn and green beans, and fried chicken with fried okra, mashed potatoes and cucumber/tomato salad. Fried chicken was good, chicken was moist and coating was different, but yummy and crunchy. The mashed potatoes were good, just a little salty. Fried okra was good and recommend their cucumber/tomato salad (great blend of acid and sweet). They came to our table after we ordered, and said they ran out of meatloaf, which was a bummer so got the roast beef. The beef was a little too fatty but had good flavor. Creamed corn and green beans were okay, but next time probably opt for a different side.

Their desserts looked great, but we were too stuffed to have one. Portions are a good size and prices were reasonable. The place itself was great. Seating outside, and kids can play in the front yard. Parking wasn't bad. All in all, a good experience and good staff. We'll probably revisit!
name: Mari

text: I love this place and it is super convenient to work. The food is ready super quick and is generally very tasty. I will say that consistency is an issue. Some days the dish is dry, overcooked and dark as cola, the next dish it is light and moist and perfect. Obviously, this is an issue with the place as they have a sign out front that says "Our Kitchen Our taste" so they're used to the issues. This is understandable but not something to post in such a manner.
name: John

text: i love haider. he is the best. everyone should try this place just because of him and the great mango lassi he makes. also the malai tikka is pretty good. try that too.
name: Srija

text: Rude hostess does not care if no one else is seated at the hibachi - she will seat you where she pleases no matter what you want. She does not care about your preferences. According to her where she picked was the only place she would seat me. I am a veteran and do not sit with my back to open doors. She looked surprised that I just walked out. Never looked back and shook the grease and dirt from their floor off my feet. Never went back and never will again.
name: David

text: 5 of us went last night to celebrate my mother's birthday.  We really couldn't have had a better seat or meal.  Amber our server was knowledgeable and friendly.  Loved the ambiance as well.  still enjoying leftovers.
name: Kelly

text:
The service was very attentive. I ordered a cooked entree and I was given a fork and knife just in case. I was with 4 others who were non-Asian so I don't think it was me but the choice of sea bass.

Entrees come with miso soup or salad. The entree does come with rice and vegetables even tho not stated on the menu.

The restaurant is BYOB.

My sea bass would have been better without skin. The fish was steamed so the skin wasn't crispy.

The waiter was very accommodating offering split or itemized receipts even tho we were good with splitting the check evenly 4 ways excluding the celebratory guest.
name: Hai Duong

text: Dylan Connor was our tour guide to St Louis Cemetery and super knowledgeable and great!!!  Had a wonderful visit and learned a lot about the history!  Fun fun fun!!!
name: john

text:
This is a fantastic place to stop for lunch. We stopped in after seeing the high rating on yelp and this place did not disappoint. My husband and I both got the treś tacos and they were fantastic. pork carnitas are very tender and the queso in the taco is yummy. My husband couldn't decide which was better, the chicken or the pork taco. 
Kids enjoyed some chicken and cheese quesadillas. The The quesadillas are BIG, one order is enough for two kiddos to share. 
If you're in Reno, this is worth the stop!
name: Michelle

text:
What makes their sandwiches unique is the crunch. I think it is buttered and toasted or something. O don't know how they do it, but it works. The crunch is really awesome. Good twist, really worth coming for this.

The pate and meats were half quantity and lower grade than what I am used to eating in west coast cities and Texas and Georgia... and Vietnam. I think I was most disappointed that the pate wasn't better. Flavor was weak and there wasn't much of it (though I ordered a pate sandwich). Peppers were a good kick. For something on the fattier side such as this toasted baguette, some cucumber could balance it more. 

Overall I felt more like I was eating a philly sandwich with Vietnamese flavor. I felt like my brother had stolen some meat when I wasn't looking. I would get this sandwich when I'm in the mood for more gluttonous comfort food rather than healthy lunchtime food.
name: G

text: I LOVE THIS BAKERY! They have the best little breakfast sandwiches. My favorite is the Tuscan on a croissant, delicious! Their chai is also one of my faves in the city. Please visit this cute little spot!
name: Alexis

text: Reading some of these complaints now feels a little overblown. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: Great pizza, great service.  Only used the take out counter this time, but the gent behind the counter was efficient, courteous and knew the products.  Able to answer questions quickly and efficiently.  Pizzas were really good.
name: Cathy

text: Came here to celebrate my gfs bday. Food was awesome-shareable (freebird, salads, fried green tomatoes, not your Mac and cheese and catfish we ordered a variety and these portions were perfect), staff very attentive and the ambiance was wonderful-it reminded us of restaurants at home in San Diego that we frequent. I highly recommend if you want a great place to enjoy an evening with friends and great food.
name: Annabelle

text:
Classy yet casual and surprisingly affordable, Roxy was a happy find for pre and post dinner drinks in a cosy, intimate setting.

I was lured by some excellent happy hour pricing that included an extensive martini list with many many choices from five to twelve dollars.

Service was not too fast which was a good thing as my wife and I had to work our way around the drink menu to find exactly what we wanted. A place that attempts to have something for everyone deserves some credit but of course that can lead to menu paralysis.

There was a piano player in the lounge and the lights are low. If you need a place to unwind from the hustle and bustle of downtown Reno, stop in for a drink or two!
name: Ian

text: The food here is pretty solid, but man, the people who with here are grumpy AF.  They make you feel as if you've ruined their day by stopping in to give them money.  A real bummer as I like this place.
name: Victoria

text: Hubby ordered ribeye and broccoli! Cooked to perfection. Wedge salad and French onion soup! Very yummy. Good value and waitress was very friendly and happy to help! Warm bread
name: Christie

text: Been waiting to try this place for a good while and I was disappointed. My friends enjoy eating here so I had high hopes coming here. The place was nice and roomy. There was a wide selection on the menu. You could choose from poke bowls, sushi, pho and more. My friends advised me to just get sushi. I ordered the Spicy Calamari as an appetizer. It came out room temperature, not even warm; indicating it wasn't freshly made. It tasted slighty salty and I didn't think it was worth almost $10. We were also given complimentary Noodle Salad. It tasted old and cheesy. We also ordered the Cajun Poboy Roll since it was recommended by our server and the Sushi Dinner. The Cajun Poboy Roll tasted okay. The shrimp tempura in the roll tasted like it was cooking earlier in the day. The taste of the roll wasn't the best to me. I would rate it a 6/10. The Sushi Dinner was also okay. It came with 7 assorted sushi, 1 cruchy roll and 1 hand roll. The sushi and roll tasted good. The hand roll was okay, but I also don't like hand rolls anyway. On the other hand, our server was nice. We paid $57 including tip. I don't think we would come back.
name: Jewel

text: Never had a problem here. The service has always been great and the food has always been consistent in quality
name: Andrew

text: I love this place! It doesn't get any better for Mexican in Reno.  Order there Original Margarita (used to be called the skinny margarita).  You wont regret it!
name: April

text:
Truly wowed. 
My partner and I are sushi feens, and this place shot straight to the top of my list. 
First, the food. We ordered gyoza, (4, solid and simple option), the salmon poke (5, surprisingly big, delicious sauces, plenty of salmon, and filled with goodies) and the sushi sashimi for two (5+, generous, quality portion for the price. Every pieces was explained, and beyond fresh. The chef special roll was also amazing and well constructed. I wish I knew if it was one from the menu). To round out the experience, all the food was beautifully presented. 
The bill came, we couldn't believe the total for what we received, in both quality and quantity - well worth it. The server, as I mentioned, explained the options and was the right amount of attentive. I also loved the style of the restaurant. It had traditional cultural elements, but managed to be modern and chic. 
I can't say enough good things!
name: Rachael

text: Great food always and a fantastic atmosphere. We have been numerous times and every visit was enjoyable !
name: N

text: It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The wait wasnt awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Food was good and came out fast. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Not bad for a quick meal. Food took a while and didnt really feel worth the wait. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: The service is good and the food is always fresh. One of my favorite local sushi places.
name: Joe

text:
Reasonably priced, not crowded on a Saturday at 11am, and tasty food! Pro tip: go before 7pm! Complimentary valet parking is provided! Just tip the nice guys!

Ambiance: This perfect brunch spot sits inside a unique boutique hotel on South Howard.  There are inside and outside seating areas, so if the weather is right, take your meal to the fresh air.  There are some cute photo op areas with modern art vibes.

Price: I expected the prices to be higher than expected given this restaurant was located in a hotel, but I was pleasantly surprised at the ratio of food to price.  Check the menu attached.

Food: I ordered a Kentucky Madame and my friends ordered the lemon pepper chicken salad and fried green tomato salad! Pictures all included!  If you love cheese, carbs, and staple breakfast items (bacon, eggs), the Kentucky Madame is a perfect elevated option! The mornay sauce (aka damn good cheese sauce) was heaven!  Out of the two salads I preferred the lemon pepper chicken salad! There was a larger portion and the shredded brussel sprouts were a great touch! The fried green tomato salad was pretty typical, but still tasty!

Service: Pretty standard. No complaints!


Hope to check out their evening menu soon!
name: Raymond

text: Best Thai on south side of Indy.  Freshest ingredients, crispy spring rolls, best crab Rangoon I have ever had, dumplings were fabulous.  Pad Thai was good, and the Orange Chicken was out of this world.  Clean dining area, nice atmosphere and pleasant staff.  The kind of place where you know every item has been handmade with the highest quality ingredients available.
name: Diana

text: I normally do not eat at chain restaurants, but we were doing a double date and they suggested this place. It was really busy for a Friday night at 9 PM. We could order off the happy hour menu, which is really good bang for your buck. I ordered the Red Vegetarian Curry while my husband went with the burger special. Our server was professional and prompt, and really good at coming back for drink orders and to refill our water. I have to say, I was very pleased with my curry. Lovely flavours, full of vegetables and it came with naan and rice. I really felt they nailed the spices in the curry. So yummy. My husband seemed to like his burger as well. I liked the diversity of the menu - ramen, curries, burgers, steaks, etc. This is a great place to go when you have very diverse culinary needs. I definitely will be back for Happy Hour. I want to try the ramen!
name: Jennie

text:
I am a pretty BB when it comes to coffee... I enjoy Dunkin Donuts dark roast or cold brew - 1 or 2 creams and a couple extra pumps of caramel. 
Well... this place is amazing!! Homemade caramel and I left feeling in love. 
Not a huge menu, but all sounds delicious. 
Friendly staff. 
Not too big but big enough to cater to the area (so far...). 
I can't wait to go back and try the hangover sandwich, along with another coffee.
name: Amanda

text: This place is kinda dirty. Look up and you'll see something that looks like mold and a bunch or mold, dust, and bugs in the air vent. Not very appetizing to see that when you eat but as for the food. The food is pretty good. I ordered rice with pork and egg. I would recommend this place to someone else but I recommend the store to do a really deep cleaning and change some dirty things out. Overall I would eat here again.
name: Anee

text: For the price I expected more than this. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. By the time the food came out I was already annoyed. Maybe other people have better luck here. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text:
Soon as you walk in the decor is very modern and has a homely feel to it. The seating area is quiet small so if you have a big party I would call ahead before stopping by. My husband and I ordered the Fresh Rolls with grilled chicken. The rolls came with cucumber, lettuce and the grilled chicken. Unfortunately it wasn't rolled tight enough so it kept breaking apart and there wasn't enough peanut sauce to accompany the big rolls :( 
My husband ordered the Pho Special, the broth was very flavorful and he enjoyed it. The only downside was that for some reason the noodles were very short and he had a hard time eating them. I optioned for the spicy wonton soup with egg noodles. I didn't find it spicy just kind of had coloring, the wontons are amazing though, not too much pepper like some places do. We also ordered the chicken fried rice and fish clay pot to bring home for lunch the next day. To my surprise the chicken weren't pieces of chicken breast thats been stirf-fried, it was actually the grilled chicken from earlier ! It was a welcomed change. The basa fish wasn't too spicy, had the perfect carmalization on it, and the fish wasn't overcooked that it would break. I was a little disappointed with the vietnamese iced coffee though as it tasted like powder and did not have that strong coffee aroma that is toned down with condensed milk, I just won't order it next time. I forgot to mention, please make sure to check the soup spoons as mine was dirty and had a dry crusted bean sprout on it :/
name: Leslie

text: We live just a block up from Gianfranco's and it remains our favorite pizza shop in Old City. They closed during the month of January as they moved into the shop next door, probably tripling in size and looking much more modern which will definitely attract more customers. We always order our pizza "extra crispy" and it comes out perfect every single time! My only complaint is that they close on Sundays (we always crave Gianfranco's on Sundays for some reason...) and that the staff aren't overly friendly. But the pizza makes it worth it.
name: Mary

text: I'm an In N Out guy, but honestly getting Habit every once in a while is the move. I will say their char burgers are pretty greasy, but it tastes fresher than In N Out. I'm not a huge fan of their fries, but overall the charburger is a solid munch if you're feeling burgers and not tryna make the mish to the superior establishment, In N Out
name: Sheck

text: Portion size looked small at first but it was actually enough. Anyway, the sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something i'm still thinking about two days later. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Idk, nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Idk, the leftovers held up okay the next day.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: Saint Anejo is a great brunch spot. There is almost always a wait, but it seems to move pretty quickly! Most recently, I ordered the Smokey+ the benedict with salmon and I definitely enjoyed it. Another person in my party ordered the breakfast burrito which was massive and so delicious! The drinks were good and even with the crowds, our server was great. I would definitely recommend for a fun and lively brunch spot on the weekend.
name: Lauren

text: Terrible hotspot. Kicked us out before the 2h limit. Free soup base was not free. Asked for enoki mushroom, server didn't understand. Only one ice cream flavour. Nothing better or special than any other hotspot place, in fact, other places have more variety.
name: Jerry

text:
came in around 8am on a Thursday morning with family as a party of 4. restaurant was maybe half full, so we were seated right away. waitress came by to greet us and take our drink order.

coffee comes out as a carafe, so that's nice. I ordered the breakfast tacos, my dad wanted "diner" style breakfast so he went with the traditional, brother got the farmhouse hash, and dads girlfriend went for the Belgian waffle. 

food came out and the waitress checked on us shortly after we had gotten the food. unfortunately, she didn't make many trips back to check on us after the initial food drop. we needed refills and my dad wanted to order another side item; we found ourselves looking around for someone to come over. seemed like the wait staffs MO was to tend to hang out in front of the kitchen with their backs to the dining room, so it was hard to get someone's attention. 

overall, food was just OK.. I don't anticipate the breakfast tacos being something I'd crave or go out of my way to have. other items on the menu seemed intriguing, so would def try something else next time.
name: Emilie

text: They charged me $3 for a single skimpy taco. The wait was 15mins long. The cashier mocked and teased me. She didn't even put everything I wanted on my taco. If I am going to pay $3 for a taco then at least load it up and get it right. I would rather go anywhere other than here. They also didn't even give me the drink I ordered. Do not come here.
name: Ashely

text: Food and servicing size was incredible. Some of the best Thai I've had in Indy. Didn't love the "salad" or soup compared to other Thai restaurant salads but the chicken pad Thai and pineapple fried rice were phenomenal. Definitely returning ASAP.
name: Claire

text:
November 17, 2018 Saturday - 12:45 PM for lunch
2 Adults

Atmosphere - 5 stars
Food - 5 stars
Service - 5 stars

Background - During our shopping trip to Sprout's my wife asked if I wanted to go to Blaze.  Umm was that really a question?

Atmosphere - Like many of the new pizza places in Reno it is build your pizza as you walk the line.  The line ends right at the ovens.  So the place has long narrow footprint.  

Food
  Drink - Nothing for me, was craving a beer, but none sold here.

  Lunch - My wife was in front of me in line and was able to read the signature pizzas before I could.  She already found my pizza, the Hot Link and hold the olives.  The pizza is or was spicy red sauce, jalapeños, sausage, (hold the black olives, not for me), red onions, banana peppers, mozzarella cheese with oregano sprinkled on top before it went to the oven.  The toppings could have been placed a little more evenly on the pizza.  The crust had a nice char to the bottom that I loved.

Service - Pretty much working with every employee in the place as you move down the line making your pizza.  After you pay you can find a spot to sit.  They call your name before they cut the pizza so you can get that pizza super hot.

Future - Yes, and I think my wife found her gluten free pizza option!
name: Paul

text: Very friendly. Consistently good food. Great lunch buffet is a nice way to try new dishes.
name: Lynn

text: They tried to kill me. I ordered a heath bar blizzard last night and saved it for today to eat it. I went to eat it and it turned out to be butterfinger. I am allergic to peanuts! Thank goodness I'm not a little kid who doesn't know any better. Peanut mistakes should never happen at restaurants!
name: Cindy

text: THE BEST donuts in all of Pa..probably in the whole world. I refuse to eat donuts from any other bakery, they could never beat the freshness, and fluffiness of yum yums donuts. The flavor of every donut is so enticing and addictive! The bagels are also very good. Every item here beats dunkin by x1000!
name: Theresa

text: Normally I wouldn't get to excited about a pizza shop but this was a very pleasant restaurant. Carol and I both just got a slice of meat lovers and I was a bad boy, I got a second slice, it was great. Crust was crisp but bread like texture. It was cooked perfectly. The meats were roasted and had great flavor and nice color. My sister joined us and had the tuna salad plate, the greens were crisp and very fresh with a nice crunch. The tuna looked good and it must have been, none was shared or left. She did take the remaining greens for another meal. She got dressing on the side but never used it. Did I mention she liked the tuna. Garlic knots came with her salad, they were outstanding. There were plenty to share, lucky for her! The waiter was pleasant and took excellent care of us. Great dining experience!
name: Paul

text: This place was delicious! We were having drinks next door at The Good Lion and decided to pop in around 9:30 for dinner. Service was very quick! We ordered the Chinese fried rice with sausage- SO good! The pork ribs were insane! And the salad with egg, beans and potato was so delicious with the peanut dressing. We also ordered the tofu with broccoli which was slightly spicy (in a good way) with lots of flavor/ garlic. Highly recommend!
name: Brooke

text: So the very first time I had ordered from here, safe to say I would rate this 10/10 my favorite place. I ordered the fettuccini Alfredo, Caesar salad with bread and oil. Everything. Is PERFECT. And the portion was HUGE. (Delivery was fast too). Next, I dined in, got the same thing..kind of, seemed like they changed the menu but still got the Alfredo and bread. The flavor, as well as portion, was way less than the first time. It was still good. But, not the same. Then this last time (delivery), ordered the same thing, and, portion was again even smaller and, the taste, was bland.... sadly. I'm unsure as to why the food is becoming inconsistent, but I hope it goes back to the original flavor. Hence the 3 stars.
name: Nina

text:
My girlfriend just ordered a pizza from Mellow off of the Waitr App. Pure disappointment. Ever since they got rid of the last manager Laura, the place has steadily gone downhill. They simply can't get an order right. We ordered a large pesto base pizza with green peppers, banana peppers, pepperoni, seasoned ricotta cheese, and a side of garlic butter sauce. 

The pizza was delivered without any pepperoni, nor the side of garlic butter. No packets of parmesan or red pepper at all either. The green and banana peppers they put on the pizza were huge chunks. Way too thick to be enjoyable. This is the third order they have messed up within a few month period. We're done with Mellow until they make changes.

Now I have to live with my upset girlfriend, because I was the one who suggested Mellow. Not to mention it was $27.53 for the pizza before the cost of Waitr.
name: Zane

text: This is one of those places where I can see other people loving it more than I did. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. I left full, which at least counts for something. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Food was good and came out fast. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text:
We came her after reading yelp this morning .
The reviews and the pictures just made us say yes we are going . So we all hopped in the car and went on Waze n went for the ride . First I couldn't find it but after I called and was navigated in a unique place. That had soooo many other places to eat this was just a adventure for us . Once we found the place it was a slight wait but after we ordered the food it was all worth the wait . Omg omg when I tell you it was the best yet . I swear we all kept saying this is the best . The other customers around us was saying the same thing . The breakfast was so fulling and enjoyable I recommend this place to anyone in Philly .
name: Keisha

text: Cool space for all types of games, friendly and fun staff and clients!  We came for a MTG night and had a great time, definitely recommend to everyone console, board and card games alike.
name: Trish

text: My wife and I had a great time when we came here for lunch during the week. We got there just when they opened, and the food was hot and fresh! We shared half of a jerk chicken and I also got a chicken patty both were very good! My wife is freshly like the fried plantains that came with the half chicken meal. The owner was very helpful and polite in our interaction with him. Great location next to the trail. I highly recommend this place!
name: Tyler

text: I had high hopes for this place since I work in the shopping center they're located in. Service was fast, food was decent. While nearing the end of my meal I noticed something that resembled cooked plastic in my yaki udon meal. Once I rinsed it off, I realized it was plastic. Since I inhaled my food, I'm not sure how much plastic I actually ate, hopefully it wasn't too much.
name: Joseph

text: The sauce carried most of the meal. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text: This place is delicious. I stopped going to gueros since they hiked up the prices and that's when I found nenes. IMO their food is just as good as gueros and bk's.
name: Denise

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. I'd maybe go back, but I'd order differently next time.
name: User

text: Wish I could give minus 1, walked in and sat at a table for 10 minutes, several bartenders and waitresses around with almost no customers but we never had a single person stop at our table. Apparently if your not "known" by they staff your not welcome.
name: Chris

text:
This was a Grubhub order so I can not speak on the actual restaurant only the food.  And it is the food I will talk about.  We ordered 2 pizzas  Italian Deluxe  
* Meatball Ricotta  
The Italian deluxe was us an instant favorite. Full of flavor from the first bite.  Warning it does have some heat to it.  The crust although a traditional thickness had a little crunch to it. We loved everything about the pizza.  The arugula , pepperoni, salami, cheeses, cherry peppers and the sauce was very flavorful and a nice compliment.
The meatball ricotta was good but not on the same level as the Italian deluxe.  This pizza used ricotta cheese and meatballs (don't think of large or round meatballs). This pizza was good but I strongly prefer the Italian
name: Thom

text: We had high expectations coming into the ruby slipper, and they exceeded them! On a busy Sunday morning, we did have to wait about 35 minutes, but they served us delicious drinks as we waited in line. The service was great and the food was the best part. Everything was fresh and scrumptious - we wish we could've tasted everything on the menu!!
name: Mackenzie

text: Let me just start by saying that "whattaburro" now known as PERCHERON changed my life! I am a Californian that came with a mindset that nothing is better than Cali food and I was wrong. Their bacon wrapped burritos are the friggin best!!! And their fries and Sonoran dogs are just the best ever. I will miss this food truck terribly I am so sad to have to move back to California but i hope this food truck stays here forever so I can make the drive to come and eat those delicious food of yours. Thank you for changing my life!!!
name: Ingrid

text: Best dinner we have had in years!!! From Eric greating us at the door through dessert perfect!!!!  Will be back!!!!
name: Just

text:
Great little place that could be overlooked.  Food is very good even for non vegans like me.  Very reasonable in price.
Jalapeno rellenos were superb.  Chop salad and cerviche were also very tasty.
No need to be a vegan to go here.
Perfect for before or after theater.
name: David

text:
Awesome happy hour choices and time 5-7 M-F and 5-6 Saturday and Sunday. The $1 oysters here are well worth the trip. The fried shrimp on the Happy Hour menu are divine! My unknown bar seats neighbor had the 'crab fingers' they look as delicious as he said they were. They also have a 'seafood fest' on Monday $25 per person with 3ish courses. The options are fairly on point. The restaurant is dark and old English/ Colonial but neat and somewhat modernized. 

A dining buddy's comments caused me to initially avoid this place. ENTER YELP! I read several reviews and it changed my mind and I'm glad it did. The Buffalo Cauliflower is not the best but I was impressed with everything else. For Buffalo Cauliflower go to Booker's 50th and Baltimore. This place has to stick to seafood!

There server was nice and the food delivered timely and hot. The Happy Hour prices are reasonable, I will definitely be back!
name: Leah

text: This was my first time eating here and I will definitely make this a place I eat regularly in the future. GOOD FOOD and the atmosphere was so warm and inviting. Albert, our server got our orders ready in no time flat, knew his specials, and accommodated our every request! Prices were beyond reasonable and they had more than just steak and burger options for people who like a little variety! Kids menu options available for little guys; I would definitely recommend to friends and family. Owner even came out and asked how we liked everything, very cool! Complimentary bread and butter, come Check it out!
name: Michelle

text: Very good food, nice decor and comparable prices. The place was so clean! The drink area and the salsa bar...hard to believe as most places have some kind of food debris lol but the ladies were constantly cleaning and it showed. I will definitely come back.
name: Nita

text:
Delicious beignets. I liked it a whole lot better than Cafe Du Monde in terms of taste, service, wait time, and cleanliness.

When we went, there were a couple tables taken and a few people in line. A completely different experience than Cafe Du Monde. The cafe was also indoors so AC was on. You basically go in line (if there is one) order, take a number, and choose a table (if available, which usually there is) then wait a few and you'll have your order. Staff were also friendly.

So again, completely different experience from Cafe Du Monde, in a VERY good way.
name: Lucy

text: Great staff and good food. Just wish happy hour was till 7 but hey no one is perfect. Definitely a cool place to grab a bite to eat or a date night.
name: Lindsey

text: Great atmosphere, food, and wait time. Good service and professionalism. I've been to both locations and experienced this.
name: Jessica

text: Great food, just hit the spot. I got there 30 minutes before closing and I did not feel rushed. Counter staff was helpful as this was my first time and very friendly. Will definitely be back with the boyfriend. Must try the king club or the smaller version for people who prefer to eat a more normal sized sandwich.
name: Sara

text: You can get any thing you want ... as long as what you want is a steaming hot cup of attitude and a 45 minute wait for a grossly overcooked breakfast sandwich.
name: Karen

text: Independence Prime is a great place to grab a quick, quality meal before or after your flight. Roseanne is a sweetheart and makes sure all guests are enjoying their meals. Definitely check this place out if your passing gate B6.
name: Sean

text:
This place was on my foodie list as a must visit.  Stopped in on the way home from a brief road trip.  There were several patron's there buying Ice Cream.  I opted for the "Chocolate God" milkshake and "Chickun" Tacos.  

The shake was cool, chocolaty, and delicious.  The tacos were flavorful (loved the mango salsa).  The mock meat was covered in a sweet and savory sauce.

I didn't see several items that I expected to see when I bookmarked this place to visit.  They changed the menu up so some items are no longer available.

The staff seemed busy, so not too much of a customer experience.  Seating and beautiful scenery await just outside of the restaurant doors.  

All in all, a pleasant visit.
name: Brittany

text: The food here is very inconsistent-I had to send a chef salad back twice.  We've had pizza raw in the middle and over cooked items several times.  We were going there two to three times a week but with a very limited menu and the food inconsistency we are spending our money elsewhere.  It's a shame as there are a couple of wonderful bar tenders who make going there fun.  We will go there to have drinks but we just can't eat there anymore
name: Terry

text:
There isn't much of a selection on their menu. I ordered wings and I thought it was overpriced for only 4 pieces. When I ordered the lady said it was going to take long. I waited ten minutes a lady came in and ordered and got her food served before me! She looked at me and said again it's going to take long because I have to deep fry. 

( only reason it's taking long is because you're microwaving frozen food!!) 

I ONLY ordered 4 wings and it took half of my lunch break!  Not only that but I heard a microwave being used twice! It's unacceptable... 

The food wasn't good and I will never go again.
name: Jessica

text: Great place for good eats and drinks! We went before the Chase Rice concert at the Pageant! Our service was outstanding! We at the tuna sliders, parm sliders, butternut squash(which is to die for!), and a chicken quesadilla!
name: Melissa

text: Overall a really good place.  Absolutely beautiful decor.  The staff was friendly, although two different servers we're wearing New York Yankees jerseys for some reason?  In South Jersey being so close to Philadelphia a lot of people can take that as a offencive.  Luckily for me neither one of them were my waiter.  I may have walked out that they were just because what they were wearing.  My survey yesterday was very Charming and wearing an Eagles jersey for some reason which is strange because it was still July.  The food is very good.  All the dinners come with soup and salad.  I was a little disappointed with my entree,  I ordered fresh sea scallops but when they came out there was only about five scallops atop a huge plate of rice.  My wife had parmesan chicken which was fantastic,  and my son had the biggest ham sake I've ever seen.  Then our dinner is also came with dessert off of a very nice dessert tray.  Overall I would definitely recommend this place although next time I am they are am going to say something to the management about the server's wearing New York colors.
name: George

text: We celebrated my daughter's 18th birthday here and we had a wonderful time.  We rented out the back room and Katherine (the event coordinator) took care of our every need.  The food was delicious (my husband is still talking about the mushroom soup!) and of course the cake was fabulous.
name: Jennifer

text:
Loved it here! First & foremost - BYOB so bring ya wines!!!

Make sure to dress a little nicer; Brian felt bad he wore flip flops. But it wasn't the end of the world! But it is more classy than what we're used to. 

Free parking, and directions are easy if you're coming off of 202 (that's where we came from). 

Service was amazing. They even brought me a bucket of ice for my white wine. (I did bring a bottle that had a screw top because I wasn't sure about the cork process & someone said they charge to uncork --- screw was not an issue and no charge though). 

A basket of bread with olive oil is served to start your night off perfect - because who doesn't love carbs? 

The menu had various options, which you can preview beforehand on their website. Let me tell you this - I really wanted a seafood pasta dish - and the server made my night when he went over the specials - I don't even know what it was called but good Lord almighty !!!! My plate was full of pasta & lumps of crab meat, scallops, shrimp, and maybe even lobster? I don't remember. I was too busy stuffing my face. The house salad I started with was amazing too. 

Limoncello shots are offered for dessert, but don't miss out on a cannoli! It was magnificent. 

I told Brian this will be our new date spot because it was great. Can't wait to go back!
name: Erika

text: The gumbo was delicious and so was the oyster pourboy.  A small place with excellent service.  Parking is a premium.  Again gumbo was very good.  In and out quickly.
name: Larry

text: Nothing was terrible, it just never really came together for me. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. The space has great original (?) woodwork with comfy seating options to make it a great place to meet up with friends or sip coffee or tea over a book, and it is very welcoming, I love the map pinpointing where customers originally came from, ranging from New Jersey to Namibia to Japan, it reflects the amazing diversity of the Upper Darby community. text:
Historically, this downtown Subway was one of those sandwich shops where you could count on consistent brand quality, convenience, and price.  Unfortunately, it has changed over the past few years, and not for the better. 

The quality of the food is unremarkable, which actually is the best thing this location has in its favor.  I mean, it's Subway.  You know what you're getting, and that is the way it should be for chain restaurants.  On occasion the flash cook oven will go out for a month or more (not exaggerating), which is an annoyance if you like your sandwich toasted, but other than that, you're getting a Subway sandwich as you expected it to be. 

Now, you may have to wait for 30+ minutes to get the sandwich made (again, not exaggerating), and that frustration will likely outweigh any enjoyment you might expect from the sandwich itself.  During the lunch rush, it is not uncommon to see only one person manning the restaurant.  And, after having visited this location many times, I can tell you that this person does not work quickly.  God help you if an ingredient runs out and needs replenishing before your sandwich is completed.  It will be another 5 to 10 minutes before the sandwich assembly process starts up again.  In the meantime, you'll check your email several times and curse to yourself as your relaxing lunch break suddenly turns into a sprint back to the office with a sandwich in a bag that you didn't have time to eat.

The lack of adequate staffing also results in a lack of cleanliness, which is something another reviewer noticed.  The seating area is generally unkempt, which, like the non-moving queue, made me want to forage elsewhere.  On top of that, during my most recent (and hopefully final) visit, the sole worker did not change gloves consistently between performing transactions and preparing sandwiches.  At that point, even though there were only two people in front of me, I decided the pizza across the street was a better option.  

Epilogue: After leaving the line, I walked across the street, ordered food, paid for food, and was walking back to my office before the person previously in front of me at Subway was even served.
name: Shannon

text:
I felt I should do an updated review based off of our visit here last night. 
We were greeted by the hostess and she stated that it was a 15-20 minute wait.  I asked if we could wait for a booth, she said "of course" and asked we wanted to be seated if a table came up sooner, we did not.  About 35 minutes went by before we were seated, this wasn't bad considering how busy they were and that we wanted a booth.
Our server, Velvet, introduced herself and offered drinks.  Since we already knew what we wanted we decided to give her our order of 
Beef á la Sichuan, Beef with Broccoli, and Kung Pao Chicken with no peanuts.  Velvet asked if this was due to a peanut allergy, to which we let her know that it was.  The food took awhile (30+ minutes) to arrive at our table, but Velvet made sure that she kept our waters full and brought the trio out to the table while we waited.  She did explain that they use different oil when there is a peanut allergy, so it would take a little more time than usual.
When the food arrived, we were a bit disappointed to see that two of the three dishes contained celery, which was not included in the description:
Kung Pao Chicken "
Spicy Sichuan chili sauce, peanuts, green onion, red chili peppers 
Beef á la Sichuan "
Flank steak strips, fiery pepper sauce, green onion, julienned veggies

While I can handle celery, my wife cannot stand the taste.
Overall the meal had much more flavor than the dishes we had the last time we were here.  While the wait times were longer than we expected, the service of Velvet made our wait bearable.

text:
Ok my rating is due to what you get for the price point. My friend wanted to go here hyping it up as the best cake. How celebrities go nuts over the cake etc. so we make our reservation and come here. 

The decor was OK. I am not sure what I was expecting but it is just white and crystals. It is pretty but the white tables under the glass tops need to be cleaned to keep that perfection atmosphere. Also some candles were burned out which was just an annoyance to me. 

I had the Gin and Tonic which was delicious and boozy. No complaints about the drink. I had the Half chicken salad and half avocado salad. The chicken salad was nothing special, the avocado salad was very good. I really don't think they were $16 good. And honestly I was not full. 

Next up is cake. There were several selections but not the mint chocolate which I guess is Oprah's favorite.  I went with the Pink Birthday Cake. So it comes and it was basically fun fetti. It was pretty. It was cute. But the taste was sort of a let down. The icing did not have the flavor that I was hoping. It was just blah. My friend had the peanut butter mousse pie which was good.  And my other friend had the chocolate cake which was also good. To me if I am gonna have a white cake make my icing great. Like Taylor's Bakery. 

So I know people love this place. It is where people get all dolled up and go. It is just not my thing. For $62 I just don't feel you get your moneys worth. You are paying for the atmosphere.

text:
We were in a mood for burgers and got a recommendation to go here from a Lyft driver that apparently worked there.  My fiancé can't eat wheat and they had gluten free buns so it sounded perfect. 

Everything seemed good going in.  The menu has a lot of options for different patties and buns.  The selection of house burger recipes was pretty good.  I ended up getting one that was on a pretzel roll with bacon, cheese, dijon and an onion ring.  

So we waited and waited.  The bartender tells us that it should be any minute, realizing that things were taking a while.  Finally after about 30 minutes the bartender informed us that there had been a screw up with the printer in the kitchen but they were now cooking our food.  

About 5-10 minutes later the food showed up and it was pretty disappointing.  The bun I had was so dry that I actually double checked to make sure i didn't get the gluten-free bun.  The bun was small to lend the appearance of having been served a large amount of food and it made the burger a giant mess to eat.  The bisson patties were way overcooked and dry.  I recognize that bison is a drier meat but if you put it on the menu you should cook it right. 

In the end they gave us 10% off of the bill for the delay without asking for it.  Overall though if I'm going to a burger place I expect the burgers to be pretty good.  Not so much.
name: Steve

text: The food came out fast, which was good because we were starving. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. I'd maybe go back, but I'd order differently next time. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish.

The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Price felt a touch high for what it was. I would definite come back again.

text: Delicious, Food was prepared nicely, bacon was thick and crispy...yum, mimosa's great. Allow for the wait time... 20-25 minutes

text: I tried the raspberry stuffed French toast! All I can say is OMG amazing! The wait was about 30 mins and staff navigated the people very well! Super friendly super organized and man oh man the food is amazing !!

text: My favorite Viet restaurant in Philly and I was born and raised in this city! Nice little spot to get a big flavorful bowl of noodles. Best Bun bo hue and bun rieu- with generous amount of meat and noodles. The boss lady is very nice and checks on her customers regularly!!! Not expensive at all, you are getting what you're paying for! Definitely recommend for anyone visiting philly for a week, a day or a month!

text: The food is ok but the last two times the family has gone one person in our group never got there meal. Everyone had gotten their meal except one and everyone finished and yet the last person still had not gotten their meal. One time it was egg plant parm and the next it was a stromboli. These are not hard meals to make, the kitchen just screwed up twice!

text:
Our favorite Date Night spot!! We absolutely love everything about this place. It has outside seating for people watching, sushi bar , high top tables, amazing food, and five star service. 

I highly recommend starting with the obon edamame. The obon sauce is so exquisite and mouthwatering. Next, I would go with the world class ramen or street noodles. If drinks are your thing, you came to the right place. The drinks here are NEVER watered-down. My wife loves the Grey Goose and Tonic. The bartender, Justin, provides award winning service. 

If you find yourself in downtown Tucson, please make sure to visit this locally owed establishment. The menu has a wide variety of savory foods that will please even the pickiest eaters. The service, alone, is the reason to make Obon a perfect spot for date nights or any social event. Just make sure to make a reservation if you plan to go on the weekend! Lastly,  make sure to say hi to Justin
name: Larry

text: Food was great. The service was fast and the waiter was friendly and didn't let my cup even go half way empty without refilling. He kept checking on us. The place overall is super clean the bathroom was spotless.  I ordered the chicken skewer and the spicy seafood ramen.  It was the right amount of spicy and the broth was delicious. The skewer went great with the Sri chia sauce I will definitely come back to try other items on the menu.
name: Denisse

text: I ordered a 3 meat fajita mix and it was horrible . The steak didn't seem seasoned at all. The chicken was was bland and dry. The pork was also extremely dry and no flavor. We were seated outside promptly but didn't receive our order until almost 40 minutes later. Maybe it was a bad day for the staff, either way I will not be returning.
name: Adrian

text: Food is decent. They have a great selection. Only giving 3 stars because the staff on this particular day couldn't have been more bothered by me asking if the salad was build your own or how you are supposed to order. I've never ordered a salad here before so I had never paid attention to the location of the menu (FYI - it's not by the rest of the menu items) I apologized to him for not knowing where the menu was and his same annoyed lack luster attitude continued as I had the audacity to order a salad that he had to make. Don't go to crushed red unless you are well apprised of where the menus are located as apparently it's quite annoying for new comers.

text: Went in at 2:30 for a carry-out Mongolian grill. Girl took my order and I paid. She then went to get my bowl and returned, saying that the cooks weren't cooking anymore Mongolian grill. Really? At 2:30 on a Sunday. Thanks Bonfire. I'm done with you.

text: Ordered takeout because I didn't feel like cooking and it held up okay. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. text: Happy hour food is great. Ordered the porchetta wheel 5 different times at 2 different locations and they were not at all the same! the first 2 were amazing, fell in love with them. text: My boyfriend and I love coming here and we do so frequently. I just wanted to share that the food was beyond exceptional today! We ordered the Smoky Mac(to share), he ordered the Bang Bang Flower tacos, and I got a Snootz Wrap. The Smoky Mac was creamy, the pasta was cooked perfectly, the sundried tomatoes provided some acidity, and the bacon tempeh took me to gastronomic heaven! I can't speak for the tacos but my boyfriend inhaled them, lol! He said they were on point. Last but not least was the Snootz Wrap; it was flavorful, filling, and the dill sauce gave it a"zing". text: Very good food and very friendly service. The owner makes you feel like part of the family. Italian wedding soup and Cesar salad were very good. Beautiful and unexpected decor for a dated strip center.

text: This place is an amazing.  I was visiting for business and was looking for something different so I stopped in. text:
First, they do Uber Eats.  Pretty dangerous but thought I'd offer up that PSA..... I love the homemade taste of everything here that I've tried like it's a special family recipe. text: It tasted fresh, just not especially memorable. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Skip the fast food and go with the fast fresh none chain with local flavor.

Not wowed...$5 burgers were small with skimpy lettuce and tomato, and lettuce was kinda wilted. Concrete had good flavor but didn't realize they used DQ style ice cream. Fries were basic but crispy.
We went on Tues at 9:30, so the line was basically just 3-4 mins per person to place an order. From order to food was much faster.
Next time we'll go to Five Guys.

text: Despite some of the bad reviews, my visit was actually pretty pleasant. We sat ourselves during lunch and a waitress came over to service our table not long after. She kindly went over the menu with me and shared which sandwiches were the most popular. I went with turkey and fig grilled cheese which also had bacon. Man it was sooooo good!  The bread was grilled to perfection with a warm buttery flavor. My friend went with the Drew Brie's (Brees)...get it?  Hahaha. It had some sort of praline sauce they drizzle atop but she got it on the side thank goodness because it would've overpowered the flavor of her sandwich which had apples, bacon, and Brie cheese on buttery grilled bread. The fries were seasoned to perfection and tasted great without ketchup. Honestly we could've shared a sandwich as they were plentiful with the fries. It was a great lunch after walking around the convention center for a few hours for the Essence Festival. Anywho, give them a try. You enter through Embassy Hotel.
name: Jennifer

text: This was a nice place to gather and catch up with friends. Service was adequate. Sadly, my food was so salty I could only eat a few bites. Out server did not even ask if it was alright even though most was left on my plate.
name: Merri

text: Went with the family today and the wait was really long- not their fault, a huge party came in before us. The younger gentleman at the host stand (Brandon) was very apologetic and assured us that they were working on getting us a table. He was very polite! Made the wait a bit easier knowing he was constantly checking in with us to make sure we were good. Really sweet kid!
name: Allison

text:
After a snafu at the host stand, which the manager made right, we finally got a table even though the restaurant had countless empty tables. 

This is our first visit to Jimmy Hulas but we had heard rave reviews! 

Started with the avocado toast which was delish! It is a whole avocado but in half, grilled with a spicy seasoning along with cotija cheese! Dip your tortillas for a tasty snackitizer! 

I ordered a pain killer which was tasty too! 

The decor and table service was top notch. 

I ordered two fish tacos which were tasty! I have another restaurant at home that I prefer for fish tacos but these were good as well. Prices were decent for the portion. 

Our only issue was with the host stand which is why I can't give them 5 stars.

text:
Tried this place for a quick lunch meeting w/my manager who raved about the food, but I was less than impressed largely in part due to the lack of service. The prime rib was devoid of any fat, and although had a good flavor, was not very interesting to eat.  Because I am such a fan of Outback and have been to many all over the country, this was such an eye opener to me.  I thought they were all supposed to have the same standards. Best place to go for ice cream!!

I get a banana split every time I go, and it's a great amount for ice cream and toppings for the price! Highly recommended!!

My father-in-law visits from time to time from WA state (lots of great Asian restaurants out there) and he can't wait to get his Peking fix.  Support your local families!  Eat local Hendersonville!

text:
Place to
Be if stuck in the east terminal. What up with 3 stars? What do you expect from a freaking airport in the middle of the mid-west? 

They have like 50 craft beers on tap and heavy pub grub. If you're gonna drink and eat heavy food in an airport full of lesser crap hit them up.
name: Pierce

text:
So. Effing. Good. 

My second time at Cheu and I wish I wasn't moving so far away bc it would become part of my regular rotation of places to go. 

Enter into what looks like a street vendor meets casual meets chic and interesting subway station. Bar seating and tables, limited seating for the size but accommodates a small-sized group to single seating. 

Twice now I've had the coconut curry ramen with fried chicken. It's a multicultural bowl of comfort food filled with noodles, crispy fried chicken strips, mint, pickled red onion, peanut sambal (they accommodate food allergies), and this to die for broth.  Both times I've tried to pace myself through eating this and it never fails I can't. Good news- you can take it home with you. 

I have to mention these perfectly pinched pockets of shumai. This isn't half assed shumai. These are legit and each must weigh a solid ounce. I take them to go because I can't walk away from the menu knowing I didn't have them. 

Other things we tried /tasted included the pastrami bing. Weird yeah, so what?  It's a good decision. 

Good beer menu, hip hop soundtrack, absolutely legit food & the people are great too.
name: Ami

text: Supposed to be open at 10:00 a. m.; it's 10:20 & the door is locked. Workers inside, no one answering the door. Thanks for wasting my lunch hour.

text: It tasted fresh, just not especially memorable. The food was good and the service was easygoing. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. text: I just moved to this area and was really excited to try this place after reading reviews.  However it was nothing more than mediocre.  I asked for "medium" spice level for my entree, and instead it was completely bland and mild.  I still gave it three stars because the naan bread was good and the owner was friendly.

text: We used to eat here all the time -- literally every day for almost two weeks at one point -- mostly because they were one of the few local places that had the Impossible Burger, but the food seems to have gone downhill the past couple of months. I used to love their side salad because it had corn in it, but apparently they stopped doing that because the last three times we ordered it didn't have corn even when we asked for it, and today I had to throw out half of the lettuce because it was super brown.
name: Steph

text:
Cute Italian dessert place. The staff is Italian, super friendly. The cannoli shells are from Italy and so are the fillings. They are willing to customize my cannoli with Nutella. There are varieties of sizes and kinds of shells, from mini to giant, from plain to chocolate covered with different toppings.  The filling can be plain or with chocolate chips.

The gelato is really good and smooth with perfect sweetness. They are imported from Italy too and definitely at the same quality as Gran Cafe Laquila. I say it is the more affordable version of it. The lady who helped me was wearing the same kind of Italian hat as those at Gran Cafe.
The Nutella and tiramisu are awesome 
The tiramisu is amazing. Definitely get this, really tasty with a lot of lady fingers soaked in espresso and perfect amount of mascarpone not whipped cream.

The sfogliatelle is greasy although the filling is very good and traditional Italian filling with a lemon flavor 

It's definitely a hidden gem
name: Retna

text: Staff and really friendly, definitely vegetarian friendly as there are many vegetarian options on the menu. The restaurant was nice and clean, easy parking, service was pretty fast and food was great and in medium to large portions compared to most dim sum restaurant !

It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Food was fresh and service was quick. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Food was good and came out fast. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed.

text: This is, without question, the greatest breakfast spot in center city. The wait staff are courteous, quick, and made us feel like family. The food went above and beyond our expectations. We are huge fans and we high recommend everyone to check it out. Our recommendation : Big Breakfast which comes with eggs, toast , pancakes, and the best potatoes your lips will ever touch. We urge you to check it out if you get a chance

text: This review is for the lunch buffet. I found nothing special here that sets it apart from other Indian buffets in the general St. Louis region. There were a few items that aren't at most buffets, but those were not worth having in my opinion. I felt the buffet was smaller than most. I enjoyed the tikka masala, korma, and gulab jamun. Naan and rice were fine, as well. Waiter refilled our waters twice. Naan took a bit to be delivered to the table. No complaints or compliments to give, really. This restaurant isn't close to me, and I don't feel the need to go back.
name: Margaret

text:
My boyfriend and I stopped through when we needed a moment to relax and have a coffee.  It was a bit weird that there only seems to be table service even though they have a café counter.  It was not very busy, so the person working at the pastry counter just let us grab a table though.

We had a couple of sweets and a coffee, and they were all good, except the frosting on the cupcake was a bit hard, which made the cupcake difficult to eat.  I would definitely come back and be open to giving them another star after trying the more standard food.
name: Jamie

text:
I've wanted to come here since they opened. They catered a lunch at my office last year which was amazing, so I couldn't wait to take my family. I was a little leery, however, because lately I noticed that there were never any cars in the parking lot - not a good sign. We went on a Saturday evening and were the only table in the restaurant. Now I know why.

My brisket was MICROWAVED, which my server didn't deny. (Nothing worse than the sound of the microwave beeping, which was undeniable in the empty restaurant.)

Ribs were obviously reheated, sides as well. Cornbread was very dry. 

The server never came back after he brought our meals, probably because he didn't want to hear us complain. 

Interesting to note...all of the good reviews are old. There are no good recent ones. 

We will NEVER be going back there.
name: Josie

text:
You can read a ton of reviews but somethings you have to experience to give a place a fair shake.

Great casual waterfront dining. The menu is seafood focused but there are options for everyone. 
 
We had the clams and wings for appetizers. Clams were perfectly prepared and will be a must have in the future. The ginger-soy wings were very flavorful. Crispy on outside, juicy on the inside. The ginger dipping sauce was something new to me. Not the worst but not my favorite either.
 I played it safe and went with the Catfish Platter. It's some of the best I've had. Opted for sweet potato fries which were perfect. 
 Huge points because the service was excellent as it was really busy.
name: Joe

text: We were excited to try this place based on the positive reviews. Our experience seemed to be the complete opposite of the 4 and 5 star reviews. When first entering the courtyard, we came upon the host stand. The hostess, looking less than enthused, brought us to a an outdoor table. No available seating inside at the time. My advice is to book a reservation in advance--they do not accept same day reservations (this is what the hostess told us). So, it's fairly warm and surprisingly nice at the moment when we were at our table. Nice ambience. Our server was ok. Not really engaging. Just there to do his job is the impression he left. Ordered some drinks and meals. For me, the food was a 1/5. As soon as some of the food arrived, several black flies wanted to join us and we were defensively  swatting away at these unexpected guests with every bite. Annoying. I understand it's part of eating outdoors sometimes and that's life but it doesn't mean I like it. I did not enjoy the wild Atlantic salmon cake. It was burned on one side, covered with the cream sauce. The inside was complete mush. Like the texture of mashed potato. The taste was bland and I was not happy about the fact that it smelled off. The Amelie mixed salad had arugula tinged with brown. Each leaf was browned. There was barely any dressing and some of the apple slices were brown as well. The greens wilted. Shrimp and grits--some of the shrimp were not deveined. Grits ok. My daughter enjoyed her chicken and andouille jambalaya pasta. I would recommend this dish if you have child with you. They seem to like pasta and if you have a picky eater, this is a good dish. There was a cream sauced pasta that was one of the specials. It was ok. Pasta was over cooked but the seasoning was there. text:

Our server was very attentive and informed us that our meals may be rather spicy (chicken curry and chicken biryani), however, they were more flavorful than spicy (as in heat). I suggested Bookers, it's close, I loved the food and ambiance, so she agreed and so there we sat, anxiously excited about partaking in the 5 course pair menu.
