Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text: If I could give a zero star review, I would. This used to be my favorite Sushi restaurant, but I will say that the last several times I have been there- it was absolutely terrible. The waitresses are always grumpy and make you feel as though you are an inconvenience. During my most recent visit ( and undoubtedly the last) the service was awful- we waited for long periods of time without being checked in on for drink refills, or to make sure our food was ok. Our order was wrong, and when we asked the waitress about it, there was no offer to help, or correct it. We would have mentioned it to her sooner had we been able to get her to come to our table before everyone at the table was completely finished. Boo. So disappointing.
name: Stevi

text: I've stopped in a couple times now, for brunch and dinner and have had great experiences. For brunch I had the biscuits and gravy along with a Bloody Mary. The place itself is really nice, one of the nicer in the neighborhood. Super clean inside with a great current decor. The brunch was really good and the staff is really friendly and welcoming. For dinner, I had the pork belly sandwich, which was nothing less than outstanding. I'm already craving it again. It's served in a really nice roll with slices of baked pear, which is a really great idea by the chef. I'd definitely recommend giving Olly a shot, if you haven't already.
name: Dave

text: What a delightful twist on pizza!  I love Indian food, but I wasn't sure how mozzarella would meld with Indian spices and flavors. Pleasantly surprised, to say the least. Absolutely delicious. The crust was amazing, and the normal icky pizza grease was nonexistent. Give 'em a try!!!
name: Becky

text: Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Food was good and came out fast. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. It looked better online than it did in person. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text:
Found this gem while visiting Reno. 
Though we were just going to a regular Mongolian place like they have everywhere. This is not the average Mongolian place. 
I could eat here 2 or 3 times a week. 
If you want spicy then use the Asian Chili
My chocolate starfish was on fire. 
Strawberry lemonade was awesome. 
Food is fresh. Food looks fresh. Food tastes fresh. Very polite staff. 
If your in Reno stop here and try it. You will not be disappointed. I can't wait to try another flavor next time. 
A little pricey for the large but very much worth it. They do offer an unlimited but I don't think you will make it to a second large bowl.  The place is very clean. They have a bar but I was too busy feeding my fat face.
name: David

text:
It took me a while to get around to writing this review, but I've decided to with only the intention of catalyzing improvement! 

Cute place, nice staff, and great tea! Prices are reasonable for this type of food (organically vegan with a hint vegetarianism, you know the type, free range lettuce, no chickpeas were harmed in making these tacos). They even let me bring my friends dog and brought out a bowl of water for her! 

This place unfortunately receives a three star review (for now, as I hope to try it again one day, if consideration towards this review is made) due to the fact that the food was extremely bland. After one bite, you are consumed by an underwhelming flavor. The chickpea tacos and avocado toast are chickpea tacos and avocados toast by technicality, but they taste closer to something you'd eat at an airport than a 'boutique' restaurant like this. 

I implore the owners/ staff to eat at other restaurants who produce a similar genre of food as theirs (these types of restaurants are a dime a dozen, so it shouldn't be hard to find a few), take notes, and adopt a similar culinary technique in the kitchen! 

I wish you all the best of luck and look forward to seeing the improvements I this cute place!
name: Thomas

text: I have been going here when Chris and her husband ran SANGWICH. New owners now- food is ridiculously priced, small servings.  The Italian sub I would order when Chris owned the place was delicious.  Now, the same sandwich is two dollars more at $8.95.  Ridiculous.  As one reviewer here mentioned the place is pricey, that is an understatement.  I live down the street on 85 th Ave, pass this place a few times each day.  The parking lot is seldom full, not like when it was SANGWICH, Chris has a gold mine here at lunch time.  She is missed.  This doesn't seem to be busy, esp in the afternoon and evenings.  I wonder how much longer it will stay open ??  I won't going back.
name: J

text: Absolute favorite restaurant/meal of all time. The pork ribs, baked beans, garlic toast. Yum!!! Every time I'm in Tucson I have to go there. The staff is great! Connie has been there since the 80s! Super laid back atmosphere and perfect for any occasion. It's simple but amazing!
name: Stephanie

text: Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Nice little spot, decent portions too. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Not bad for a quick meal. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish.
name: User

text: We just left New Orleans after a 4 day stay this weekend with a group that booked 4 rooms. I hesitated between giving this a 4.5 or a four. The service at the front desk is excellent and the food and service at both the restaurant and downstairs in the lounge area is very good and has a good assortment of choices. The view from all of our rooms were overlooking the river which was wonderful.  The pool while not heated is quite refreshing. Now for the down side, on the first night  someone came to our room at 3 AM in the morning pounding on the door to be let in. This went on for a while as we called security. The same man returned the next night again pounding and screaming to be let in.  Security responded within about five minutes. We asked to have our room changed after the second incident and the hotel obliged however it's disappointing they did not offer that option after the first or second time. When we pursued the scenario they said Marriott holds no responsibility since this was not a employee of the hotel.  This is seems an odd response and has us all questioning our safety.
name: C

text:
We went to have dinner last night. We have eaten here before and is was good. The food is was great last night. The service not so much. we ordered drinks we order appetizers salads and entrees. We were eating our cheese plate  The bus boy comes buy takes my husbands plate and try's to take mine.  I tell him we are not done, as he can see i had a piece of cheese in my hand. He must of told the waitress because she comes fly out of know where and try to take  our cheese plate again. I have to say again we are not finished. She takes a big sigh and leaves the table. She comes back and says in a mad tone can I take your plate now.....
Then a different waitress come out and gives us our salad. We never saw the mad waitress ever again at out table. except when we were walking out she was standing in the back laughing it up.
Very strange service and will never go back. To many other good restaurants to support in this town that will love too be of superior customer service. Because they like their job and that's what they like doing.
name: Kelly

text: Madison Robert's Great welcoming server are you kidding me the quality and the price is amazing we did come in for happy hour which made it unbelievable when you look at the quality food in the pricing show me a better place show me a better bang for the buck. Wow. Kreg
name: Kreg

text:
The ladies running the Fish House were super friendly and when offered advice on what to get, the definitive answer was: the basa. 

I ordered the Daily Special, the Basa sandwich, which came with a choice of side and a drink. Enter cole slaw and fresh brewed unsweetened tea. 

I've got to say, this was an incredible fish sandwich. Very simple but to the point. Battered basa pieces were light, flaky, and moist. On a bun with lettuce, it was plain to see that the basa was the star. Not overly oily. I could have used a tomato slice, but it was delicious. The cool cole slaw too was light and refreshing on a Florida's summer day.

This was great eating experience to have in Florida! Definitely a spot to return to when I visit the Tampa area again. Kudos, Fish House, kudos. 

**sorry no photos...i couldn't contain myself.
name: Bobby

text: Visiting from Idaho and stopped here because we were craving crab.  Definitely didn't disappoint.  Our server was the icing on the cake!  I was having a horrible day and from the minute he introduced himself, he had us in stitches.  So knowledgeable and great up sales without being pushy... Myles "name not distance".... you made our night!  Thank you!
name: Schon

text:
There's a reason Bern's has been around so long. There's also a reason our waiter, Jamal, has been serving there for over 40 years. Bern's is, in my opinion, as great as it gets for a special night out. It's eclectic, professional, romantic, and enchanting all rolled into one!

We were a group of 5 and were treated like absolute royalty. We really wanted to experience the menu for all that it is, so we requested to order everything "family style". We dined on 2 types of carpaccio (the truffle was my favorite). wagu, striploin, ribeye and more! I also love that each entree comes with salad, soup and potatoes. It makes you feel like you're getting a bigger bang for your buck!

The wine.... oh my.... the wine!! Whatever you do, do not leave this restaurant without indulging in a bottle of magnificent wine! There are SOOOOOO many to choose from that it may seem overwhelming, but rest assured that their staff is highly qualified in helping you with your selection. You can thank me later!
name: Kristi

text:
My first impression was not overwhelmingly positive. The staff were stretched thin and it seemed like a particularly long time before we were given even water. We were so put off by the initial slow service that we decided to only order an appetizer and have dinner elsewhere. 

The appetizer, the charcuterie plate, was very good. The wine list was not as impressive considering it is Santa Barbara. However, there seemed to be several beers on tap. Definitely believe the place is still worth a second try.
name: DD

text: Terrible service! Worst ever! They aren't even busy. We've been here 40 minutes and are just getting our drinks. 3 tables sat down after us, ate and have already left. I asked for the manager and he came to the table and told us they forgot about us! What? I've worked in the service industry long enough to know that you just don't do that! On top of that they did not apologize or even acknowledge that they were fixing the problem.  DON'T EAT HERE! BEWARE!
name: Whitney

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Would absolutely visit again. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text:
Went looking for an outside venue that we could share with our four footed friend and remembered Gaspars outside bar. Although Sundays are a all you can eat buffet there were a few entree options outside. Alicia(I am deaf in that ear if I only got close!) was a dream bartender who took care of us and Gem. 
Jojo was right there to assist us when he could see that all was not spot on.
The live music on the stage today rounded off a great day in Ybor City.
name: Michael

text: Nothing was terrible, it just never really came together for me. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: The food and service here is impeccable!!! Steve Day the manager made us very welcome and was such a sweetheart! Gave us some amazing dry rub wings on the house! Georgina was also amazing too! She has such a welcoming and great personality! WE WILL BE BACK!!!!
name: Angela

text:
Have eaten here frequently before change in ownership.  I would have rated 4 out of 5 stars before but now it's all downhill.  Food is hit or miss.  Usually miss.  Service is atrocious.  Server's are clueless and honestly no cannot understand a word they say .  The fact that we were the only diners today says it all.  The worst thing however is that the credit card  number I used today which I never pull out was used to make a fraudulent transaction on a Japanese gaming website ! Lol. Some coincidence huh?

Follow up 12/5.  Just found out place was shut down by the health department lol
name: Ashley

text: Wow wow wow! I can't believe how long I waited to try this place. What an amazing experience we had on date night. Make a reservation and go, ASAP! This tiny spot is so intimate and I was amazed by what they did in this space. Glen was personable, not condescending or pretentious like some other people in the restaurant business. We surrendered control and said "feed me." This allows the lovely ppl at tzin to choose tapas for you. We told Glen "I don't like olives, he doesn't like mayonnaise based sauces, we love seafood. We're hungry." And they did the rest. This allows you to eat things that aren't even on the menu and to see their creativity flow. Highly recommend, and will be back. Thanks Glen!
name: Joanne

text: We came here for brunch on a very warm Saturday. The place was half full even there there was a large street festival happening on Broad St. when our waiter asked for our drink orders I asked if they could make a frozen drink and his only reply was "no".  He proceeded to stare at me without offering an alternative or helpful suggestion. The interior is beautiful but that is as far as it goes. The food was not but albeit a bit over priced. I am not sure what this establishment is going for but I left unimpressed. I can usually deal with over priced food that does not quite live up to its price tag but poor service is inexcusable. There are too many great brunch spots in the city with impeccable service for me to ever return. If you doubt my word check out the other yelp reviews.
name: Cameron

text: No big complaints, just a nice meal. Food was fresh and service was quick. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Will be back. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Food took a while and didn't rlly feel worth the wait. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Not bad for a quick meal. Food was good and came out fast.
name: User

text: Went in for lunch on Monday because Thai Taste is closed on Mondays  glad I stopped in for lunch.  Place is nice clean with a cozy feel to it. A bit dark with booths and tables.  There is wine and beer served. There was a lunch menu.  I had the chicken pad Thai came with a soup  coconut milk something... was quite good, makes me want to try the soup lunch portion for lunch.  It had a lemony coconut taste it was broth with a few carrots and peas in it.  Food was brought out fairly quickly, there was not a lot of customers.  Pad Thai was on point! I asked for hot I think next time I'll ask for extra hot.  Or Thai hot since hot was not hot at all. The salad was small but nicely complimented the dish and it also came with a spring roll and sauce.  Like it, too bad it was kind of cold.  Friendly helpful staff.  Would come back on Monday if I have a craving for Thai. Lunch price per person with drink was about $12
name: Claudia

text: We wanted to order take but were tired of the usual and wanted to try something different.  Checked out this new place on Patricia Ave in Dunedin.  I got some empanadas and the Cuban sandwich the owner suggested.  I love the flaky crusty empanadas out of the three versions I liked the beef best. All of them were excellent. The Cuban sandwich was extremely good a burst of flavors and the pickle inside gave it a nice crunch.  That's the best Cuban I ever had.  It came with a healthy serving of fries.  Definitely a great take out place to add to the few choices we have around here.
name: Derrick

text: It tasted fresh, just not especially memorable. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. It was decent, just a little uneven. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Nice little spot, decent portions too.
name: User

text:
I love local businesses and supporting them. I took a date to King Dough Indy on 11/6/19 and left...confused. I LOVE great pizza shops, and Im not sure what KD is or wants to be.

1st, the pizza we ordered was delivered as promised and it was hot. It was delicious and filling. The price was acceptable. Where we got confused was the mandatory olives on the pizza that we didn't want. We were told that we could pick them off or do a custom pie...but the option for a custom pie were confusing so we just opted to pick off the unwanted olives.

The sodas and mixed drinks were delicious and our server was friendly and kept us topped off. Again, there was a bit of confusion about who was staff and who was not, and who had what jobs. 

In all, I give KD a positive but confused experience.
name: John

text: When we arrived at the restaurant, there were 2 tables that were occupied. The owner seated us (we were a party of 5) in a corner - however, the table cloth was dirty and felt a bit congested so we requested to be seated at a different table. The owner rudely refused saying - the other table is for a party of 6 not for 5 (while we were sitting on a table of 4). We decided to leave the restaurant and as we were leaving the bartender asked us what happened and the owner yelled in Hindi "unhe jane doh" (let them go). The restaurant owner treats his customers poorly.
name: Radcole

text:
Perfect fourth meal/ super late night stop! Stopped in after a night of live music on Frenchmen and the place was packed with customers at 2:30 a.m. 

The dogs and bacon ranch fries were absolutely delicious, however what impressed me the most about Dat Dog were the employees themselves. These guys hustle hard and are very skilled at what they do. From what I could see, there appeared to be 1 bartender, 1 server, and 2 cooks working in the restaurant on Saturday night, serving dozens and dozens of hungry (and often quite inebriated) customers.

Big shout out to the bartender (Ryan, I think!) who maintained his relaxed attitude, sense of professionalism, and tact in dealing with one really obnoxious, belligerent bro - Ryan really de-escalated a situation that could have become a bigger scene. He also made sure to work the room really well and continually check in on all the customers at the bar. Thanks for such an enjoyable, memorable food experience, Ryan, and the whole Dat Dog crew working late night this past Saturday!
name: Katryn

text:
This is the perfect late-night spot if you're craving a slice (or two) of pizza!

Interior/establishment - The atmosphere of the place is kind of divey. The moment you walk in you're greeted with dim lighting and an alternative / punk-rock playlist playing. There's an appropriate amount of seating for the place, which isn't terribly big, but each time I've gone grabbing a table was never an issue. 

Service - nothing much to say, honestly. People who work there are nice and I've never had a bad experience, nor had I had a terrible one. 

Food - don't expect this place to be the best pizza you've ever had. It's still a lot better than your fast food pizza chains, though, that's for sure. They have this deal where you can get two slices of pizza and a beer or soda for a discounted price and it's always worth it. The crust is perfect for me, personally, where it's not soft but it's also not super crunchy. I've ordered the vegan pepperoni once on accident, but I didn't really realize it was vegan until I was halfway through my slice. The cheese is my general go-to now because of that. Overall there's a well-balanced sauce/cheese/topping ratio happening on the slice, and at a really cheap price for a late night bite I always recommend it to my friends!
name: Lillian

text: I was not impressed though I don't seem to be the norm. The restaurant is visually pleasant but the room was very noisy.  It has a big happy hour crowd and the noise spills into the dining room.  I made a poor choice in my dinner.  The spicy tofu was not to my liking.  The tofu was way over fried, tasteless and leathery.  My dinner companions were much happier with their salmon and Mahi tacos.  We enjoyed an unbothered leisurely dinner which was great since we had a lot of catching up to do but I would have appreciated a refill of water.  I certainly have not written Harvest off! I'll give it another try and order something different next time.
name: Cathy

text: Love this place, people is so nice. Our waitress even remember us and what we order last time cool. Gods is delicious and prices wow. We found our diamond place for breakfast and lunch.100% recommended.
name: Guierine

text:
Looks like a small place but it's packed with goodies. There is a decent amount of seating inside for its size, but I'm sure if they are packed for lunch you might be pressed for a seat. No outdoor seating. They have some set menu items if you'd rather not make you own plate. But if you're not into what you see on the menu than this place works a lot like chipotle except more Japanese. You can have your protein in different forms like a bowl or even a burrito. They've got your standard items like salmon and spicy tuna but they also have a couple extra things like octopus. Yum!!!  After the proteins you pick your toppings and sauces and than your good to go. This place is not far from USF and is pretty fair on its prices for Poke. 
  All in all there are some yummy nom nom's to be had here. If you've never had poke before, don't be afraid to hop in here...it's easier than it looks.
name: Raymond

text: Second time trying the Soulard Gyro biggest flaw is it's nearly impossible to eat without a fork
name: Michael

text:
This place is incredible. As a NY'er new to the area, the quest for good Chinese food has been hit and miss.
Happy to say the delivery was prompt, pricing reasonable, and the food was AWESOME! Crab rangoon is hand made,
Boneless spareribs cooked perfectly, sesame chicken in point and Thai basil chicken was one of the best around.
All with good portions. Highly recommended Chinese food!
name: Jami

text: Lamb Barbacoa is the best. You can order ahead and order by half kilo three quarter kilo and kilo. You get all the fixings from homemade tortillas to cactus salad to great soup. Love this place: the story, the staff and the FOOD!
name: Thomas

text:
Quaint little roastery and coffee place!
Enjoyed my chai latte. Husband loved his black Columbian coffee - smelled amazing! 

Cool vibes, coffee roasted onsite.
Baked goods, bagel sandwiches... didn't seem to have vegan options to eat but i also didn't ask.

Vegan milks available for coffees.
name: Amber

text:
Ugh, Reno, come on buddy help me out here! I can't be the only local who had the worst food here, can I? 
I came here at the end of April with my husband for date night. We were seated right away and I didn't even need to look over the menu because I had been stalking food pictures of Zozo's online. I decided on cheese tortellini with creamy pesto and a side salad with their house dressing. The salad arrived to the table and it was swimming in dressing, so much so that I tried to move most of the lettuce off to the side and that is when I found the soggiest, old black lettuce all mixed in. I put my salad to the side, and even though the owner (the man behind the bar - I am assuming is the owner based on other reviews, pics) passed by my table several times, no one stopped to ask if there was an issue. Finally, our server came back to the table, apologized, offered me soup instead (sorry, if I wanted soup I would have ordered that), and then took my salad back to the kitchen. The food arrives and it is so so so bland. The house bread was simply hot dog buns! (I am not even kidding, I wish I had a picture to show you)
I had to order an additional side of marinara sauce to make my tortellini have any flavor at all and in the end it was just soggy, over cooked and bland.
We asked for our bill, of course we were charged full price for our meal even though we were unable to eat it, so instead of making a big deal we just paid and left. 
I hope my experience helps someone out there who has taste buds because Zozo's is definitely not the place for you! If you love bland overpriced food - maybe bring grandma with you.
name: April

text:
My friend has decided to go vegan and dragged me and my daughter along for lunch. I looked at the menu online to get an idea of exactly what I was getting myself into. I'm not extremely carnivorous, but the idea of NOT having meat as an option absolutely made me nervous. When we arrived I immediately noticed how small it was. I thought maybe it was a grab and go place, but everyone seemed to be very comfy. I appreciated the cultural references on the menu. That made me feel right at home...like among friends or family. I was hesitant to order, but my friend insisted on the V steak. You mean steak? That isn't steak? Absolutely not, I'll take a water. But after much prodding I jumped in and ordered. 

Food arrived rather quickly and I had a stare down with it for a few minutes because it LOOKED like meat. Smelled like meat. I took a bite and heard my ancestors singing. It was DELICIOUS. I ate the first half, completely forgetting this was a completely VEGAN CHEESESTEAK. My plan was to eat a few bites to be nice and throw it out when I got home. That sandwich didn't last 10 minutes. Everyone was very nice and the atmosphere was very laid back. Again, it IS small so if you're lucky to get a table, grab it and get comfy. I think it will be very nice in the summer because there's lots of seating outside. Definitely try it!
name: Brandy

text: Haven't been for years but, as a Native New Yorker, this was the best New York, walk up to shop with an open window counter "Saturday Night Fever" pizza. Real oily and good! Gotta fold the slice to eat it and stack them if you have more than one!
name: John

text: I really like Dos Gringos.  It's not authentic, but the title says it and it is good. Dos Gringos is a small, but friendly restaurant.  I'm always served chips and salsa prior to the meal, which is great because all of the good smells in this restaurant makes me hungry.   I love that they have spicy salsa options that are actually spicy.  The surf and turf burrito is my favorite. It is delicious.  This a great quick lunch spot.
name: Michelle

text: The food was good and the service was easygoing. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. For the price I expected more than this.
name: User

text: I love it when you find someplace off the beaten path and it turns out to be every bit as amazing as you would hope. Tucked away in an industrial area, this place has a casual sports bar feel, but it maintains its hip brewery feel with local art on the wall and great beers on tap (if you like spice try the chili beer!). It's kid-friendly too, offering a kids menu and evidenced by many families dining with children young and old. We had the snake bite appteizers, which were good. However what really blew me away was my cubano sandwich. Soft and crunchy bread. The perfect mix of salty ham, zingy mustard, and creamy swiss. 10/10 would order again. Oh and the potato salad! Everyone was really happy with their meal, and all the food looked and tasted fresh and homemade. Service was great, too. I would highly recommend.
name: Krista

text: This place is fantastic. My wife and I were in Florida last week visiting her grandma and going to the beach. And we decided to have a little bit of Mexican foods or we all went to Tijuana Flats. It is like a fast food establishment almost because you go through have a drive-thru and you can go up to the counter and order but they bring it to you certain not really a waiter or waitress but I do bring you your food and they will occasionally fill up your drinks if they see it but a lot of the times you walk up to the cash register and ask them for another refill which can get a little annoying but that's okay. Because the food absolutely makes up for it. I got a giant burrito and it had rice and beans and cheese and sour cream and all that good fattening stuff in it. It comes with a little thing of chips on the side scoop up the stuff that falls out which is a plus. My daughter got two tacos she ate one took one home I ate it later that night and my wife got these little fried chimichanga things which were fantastic as well I think overall for the four of us to eat and drinks it was around $32 which is not that bad really at all. I wish we had one in Louisville because I  would love to go to it. I would highly recommend and we will be back the next time we are in Florida.
name: Jeremy

text: The mocha is reasonably priced even with an extra shot.   The chocolate is real and the War Pig breakfast sandwich was just right.  Oh and everyone working there is great.  I will definitely be back.
name: David

text: The worst service I e ever received!!!!!!! Do not order from this place! They sent me the wrong order and when I called told me I was wrong!!! I ordered 3 pizzas one Chicken ranch and a pecan salad I'll show you the pics of what I received and they didn't do anything to fix my order.

text:
I went to this Burger King last night because I didn't feel like leaving base, but it's worth the drive next time. I pulled into the drive thru and the little boy that was working there burped first thing into his headset then asked what I would like. Then I pulled up to the window and the little boy gave me a bag of freezing cold fries.. I told him there is no way these are fresh. He asked me "oh you wanted them fresh?" 

Nooo! Please give me your oldest batch of fries. Please and thank you. 

Possibly needs new employees. I went nov 2 @ 6-7pm if that helps narrow down who to get rid of.

text:
Great pizza and salad 

Frirndly staff. 

A gem in Tucson. 

I got the deepdish

 I thinks this place was Diners Drive in and drives

text: My boyfriend and I went back again. We both tried the south philly sandwich. It tasted similar to some nice cuts of pork roast. The cashew sauce on top was amazing, it tasted even better than real cheese. One con to the sandwich is that the bread wasn't very fresh as it could be. However we still loved it, can't wait to come back!

text:
My five star review is being given as to the service that we received, not the food.
Our Server's name is Zoe and what a stroke of luck we had when we got him to wait on us. We had 11 people and it was for a Sweet 16 Birthday dinner and he was about the best we've ever had.  What a personality!! Awesome guy and won us over from the get go.  This Server never missed a beat, drinks always filled on time, appetizers brought on time and the food arrived perfectly on time. This Server made our visit to Grill smith a complete and total joy!!  Thank you so much Zoe!
name: Nancy

text: Came in for a late night dinner since it was close by and glad we stopped in. We were seated immediately and handed menus. Our waiter poured us water asking if we wanted an appetizer. We ordered pokara and then looked at the main menu. We ended up getting the butter chicken and side of naan to split. Our food was ready around 15 minuets and the steam was coming off it. The chicken portion was nice but we could have used a bit more rice. It tasted great though I wish we got it a little spicy just for a kick. While we were eating the waiter advised us the kitchen would be closing soon so if we wanted to order more we could do so then. We told him no thank you and finished what we had. Total we only spent $25-$30 which wasn't bad in the slightest. Would definitely eat here again if I'm in the area.
name: Sam

text: We enjoyed lunch today in the patio. Our waitress was fab, drinks were good, loved the ambiance. Left slightly disappointed when waitress came back after we paid our bill and left a tip, and asked to re run our card because she gave us the wrong bill initially.  They cancelled our transaction and we paid our bill which was a bit higher. Just a bit of a pain when taking clients out to dinner. We will be back for another try.
name: Stacy

text: I wanted to give this place a 5 star rating BUT the service is super slow and we found hair in our food not the end of the word until the staff tried to play it off like it was a thyme stem. I may try them again but I'm not sure yet
name: Marc

text: Had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. You can tell they care about customer experience here. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Food was fresh and service was quick. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. A very pleasant experience. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text: From the lunch special, the food was okay. It comes with an app, soup, rice, and your choice/style of meat. I got the lemongrass chicken and the lemongrass was lacking. The other compenents of the meal, like my spring roll and soup, were fine.
name: Lila

text: This place is very good. I have to highlight the amazing service we have received on two separate occasions. The manager left the restaurant open to service us on a lunch break right before their midday close. The food is exceptional, timely and always fresh! Such a great treat for a quick work trip to Philly.
name: Liz

text: yummy is a great place to eat breakfast.  They close at 3 so get there early to enjoy!!
name: Adraine

text: We ordered the pulled chicken to go. Pretty darn tasty. Chicken was moist and tender. Was just a little less smoky than I like but so goes it with smoked chicken. I've had this happen when smoking at home as well sometimes. Could just be a batch thing. Still very good. Love the white sauce! Delicious! Sweet tea was excellent too! I'll definitely be back next time I'm in town.
name: Tim

text: The spicy beef soup with potatoe noodles and eggs was spicy and tasty! So was the Korean pancakes and their special dipping sauce. Not only that, but their customer service was PHENOMENAL!!!
name: Angelica

text: Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Not bad for a quick meal. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Food was good and came out fast. Food was fresh and service was quick.
name: User

text: My family and I made reservations over a week ago for a birthday. We were planning on taking family photos at the river. When we arrived they only had the bar area high tops, which would not seat the handicapped. That is clearly not a reservation table. They should have had someone call me. This is the 2nd bad experience I've had. The 1st was a year or so ago when staff quit and we had to wait over an hour and half for food, they also didn't  say anything until the people started to get up and leave. It's great here when they have everything organized but not if you treat regulars/locals with poor service and communication.
name: Angela

text: My review is based on the pick up to go order I placed. The online app gave me a specific time to pick up my order and when I got there it wasn't ready until an hour later! I totally understand that sometimes they can be behind or super busy. BUT the website should not give you a 20 min window to pick up your dinner and you get there on time and wait an hour. I could have done something else with my time. And they also forgot my butter & bread. Why suggest bread added if they not going to read the order correctly. Super annoyed . I'm not saying I will never eat there but I def will NEVER order food to go again.
name: Jarah

text:
I ordered here through a food delivery service on a Friday night about an hour or so before they were closing. I ordered the shrimp and scallop Alfredo with a whole lobster tail. The sauce was perfect, the pasta was a little mushy, and the seafood tasted very fresh. I was disappointed with the lobster, as it  was over done to the point where I could barely take the meat out. 

The meal included a little complimentary salad that was very fresh also! So fresh...that I'm pretty sure it was not washed. Little grains of sand were found on more than one lettuce wedge. Disappointed.
name: Fantasia

text: Went with family on a Sunday and it was louder than I expected. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Food was good and came out fast.
name: User

text: I had the pleasure of booking and hosting an event at Atmology. I'm from Southern California on a nation wide tour and this was the 5th stop and the best one yet. Heather was amazing to work with along with her whole team, they were extremely accommodating with all of our needs... plus their food, coffee, and other drinks are out of this world! I recommend this venue to anyone in need of a welcoming space to get your message across. Carrot spread is DAAAAAAAAAAANK.
name: Craig

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Would return. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: Food was fresh and service was quick. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text:
Overall, I had a great experience here.

At first, I was a little disappointed because Pipo's was out of the first and second dishes I wanted to order. Finally, on the third try, I went with a freshly fried Cuban steak option. I got sweet plantains as my side.

The staff were incredibly friendly and helpful. The food came out quickly and it was SO delicious! 

The atmosphere is definitely laid back. Sneakers and a low key outfit are certainly appropriate here. I will visit again!
name: Ashley

text: Best Lunch menu in Tucson!  The cuisine, the staff and the ambiance combines to make this our favorite.  We arrived without a reservation on our anniversary and they rolled out the red carpet for us, giving us a memorable dining celebration.
name: Christopher

text: Celebrated our one year wedding anniversary here and it was wonderful! We sat outside with our dog on their spacious and gorgeous patio and were greeted with a toast of champagne and a personalized postcard. The tapas were awesome but the seafood paella was perfection, and the service was warm and friendly.
name: Katie

text: Fantastic service, thanks to Angela at the bar.  Fish and Chips were good too!  Cheers
name: Brian

text: Great food every time. The service is really good as well. We eat here about one a week and have had numerous menu items.
name: Jim

text: Ok Frank's you are known for a muffalata.  But why why do you have to make yourself a tourist trap with no pricing on kids meals and not informing guests that you charge an outrageous 4 dollars and 50 cents for Really really bad French fries.    68 dollars for a shrimp poboy and a half muff and a kids meal with no alcohol.  Sneak in Auto Gratuity for 3 and  You should be ashamed...   Table by us ordered crawfish at over 7 dollars a pound late in the season too.    The famous Crawfish Town USA is way less than that robbery.
name: Jared

text: Came in tonight and I have to say we will not be back again. Our waitress was rude and argumentative about what was ordered. I'm sorry but I'm a business owner myself and I would never treat my customers the way our waitress did tonight.
name: Kristin

text: One of the public Marigny's finest places it's casual it's dressy it's fine it's yummy it's delicious drinks it's great just go
name: Kathleen

text:
Ok.. I'm not sure why this place has 4 stars, but the food was very salty and came out Luke warm. 

-Seafood Gumbo lacked seafood and wasn't anything special.  
-Chicken gumbo was the better of the two but lacked flavor. 
-Shrimp creole was very thick and also didn't have good flavors. 
-Crawfish etouffee barely had crawfish and lacked flavors as well. 
+The best thing we got was a daily special of the gator sausage.  It had a sweet mustard.

The server was nice and was attentive.

Not worth the wait and we also had outdoor seating.
name: Jimmy

text: Campo has been one of our favorite restaurants in Reno, the choice for multiple birthday celebrations. Our visit last evening left us wondering if we will return. First off with the exception of the hostess who seated us, service seemed discombobulated. Our table server explained that he was being called to a team meeting and had several tables he was trying to juggle. We were there for an early dinner about 5:15pm. A team meeting at dinner time ? The D.R.O.P.P. salad which is usually inventive and wonderful consisted of sliced tomatoes, goat cheese, lettuce and cherry tomatoes - in this season of varied and abundant produce ! What happened ? An issue with their suppliers ? We didn't order it, since as our server said it was mostly tomatoes, opting for the local greens salad which was just okay. The fritto misto, another favorite, had only calamari rings - no tentacles and unremarkable vegetables.  It's great that they offer a variety of local beers on tap and sitting on the patio by the river is wonderful, maybe the next visit will be for a drink.
name: Michelle

text:
Seems like a decent place. So I was very optimistic. Perhaps I ordered the wrong meal. Please don't let this post deter you, it is a little piece of advice: Stay away from anything (everything) boiled. I am not sure if it is a NOLA thing, but the shrimp and grits tasted like it was boiled in a public pool. 

The wait staff was great though and the bread was on point. Since I was disappointed with the meal, I didn't stay for desert. 

There were other instances throughout the city where a $15+ cocktail was ruined by ice made from local tap water. Filtration isn't that expensive ...
name: Brent

text: So I never do reviews, but my experience with Green Mint was horrible - the absolute worst customer service I have EVER experienced. My husband and I went inside to order dinner to go, I asked the girl who took our order if everything was cooked separately because my husband has a shellfish allergy- she said yes everything is done separate and not to worry. I got the chicken teriyaki bowl and he got the chicken sandwich. Well, apparently the chicken sandwich is served with fried shrimp chips that was never mentioned and was put in the box and got all over his sandwich - he even took a bite of one, not knowing what it was and immediately spit it out! He ended up getting an allergic reaction on his lip! I called green mint to tell them what had happened, really surprised that they had not taken this situation more serious, considering this could be life threatening! Instead, the "manager" that I spoke with was very rude and basically told me that it was our fault because we ordered the sandwich - I was speechless! Of course I asked for a refund considering he could not eat any of his meal, the woman argued with me for 15 minutes about why they should give us a refund! She then finally said that I could come in tomorrow to get a $5 refund for the sandwich only but "to clearly state my name because she doesn't want to make another mistake" in a snarky attitude. I will not be going back for my refund, nor will I EVER eat there again which sucks because I do enjoy their food.
name: Lex

text: A friend recommended me Nan Zhou Hand Drawn Noodle House as a place to visit when in Philly. I decided to check it out since I was in Chinatown, and I am not disappointed. We were seated immediately and the waitress we had was very friendly. She even asked us which food we would like to come first (very attentive). The texture of the noodle ( Jiajiang Mian) was really good. I would come back here again to try the other noodles.
name: Ying

text:
I was visiting from out of town and boyyyy was I I got a treat!! Never had I experienced such southern hospitality like Monell's. I didn't realize it was family style at first so when the staff named all the starters, I was already mind blown wondering how we were gonna get to the main course. Thankfully others started showing up and joining our table. A true family style meal. We passed baskets of food which felt never ending so you best come hungry!!!

Everything was spectacular. Truly nothing negative to say at all. 
- Fried chicken
- Fried catfish
- BBQ ribs
- Stuffed shells
- Corn pudding
- Mashed potatoes
- Green beans
- Collard greens
- White beans
- Hush puppies
- Fried okra
- Cole slaw
- Biscuit and gravy
- Cucumber salad
- Banana pudding
- Sweet tea
- Lemonade

Take your pick ya'll. Stuff your face, make some new friends and be merry!
name: Jeanne

text: great place to hang out with friends and family food is great not expensive people are friendly and easy going would recommend to anyone and everyone
name: Jose

text: Very good food with a very nice atmosphere. Very good service and have ordered from here many times. Only criticism is some order confusion from time to time but other than that, wonderful.
name: Jennifer

text:
Obviously, a great breakfast/brunch place needs to have great food but you need great coffee to go with your meal if you're a coffee drinker like me. Half & Half does, indeed, have great coffee (our waitress told me that it is specially roasted for Half & Half).

As for the food, I recommend the blueberry pancakes (fabulous), oven-baked oatmeal (hot and filling and loaded with tastiness), or veggie hash (also fabulous). Service is excellent so please tip generously.
name: Mary

text:
My cousin and I stopped here for lunch. The bar/restaurant is an open concept allowing the view of the Gulf.  The bartender Mike was friendly, very accommodating and attentive. I ordered the $2 beer special, eggnog.  Sounds strange but it was quite tasty. Sea Dog drafts are $5 which is very reasonable for a small brewery. Happy hour lowers the price by $1.00. Mike explained that vodka is also made in house. The gentleman seated near us ordered a dirty martini which was tempting. We ordered the fish and chips and asked the order to be split. We each had two pieces of fish, French fries and coleslaw.  The food was middle of the road and pricey, $17, but with us splitting the meal and the generous serving we were ok with that. 

I will definitely stop in again to taste other beers and to enjoy the view. Parking is tight but it is free.
name: Kathleen

text: Location was awesome! The wait staff was attentive  and the food was delicious! Loved the clam chowder! Wasnt full of filler veggies. You can taste the clams... yummm! Super fresh seafood! The shrimp on the cold platter was super flavorful and tender. Honestly some of the best shrimp I have ever had!
name: Cassandra

text:
We weren't sure if we wanted to eat at Match but we saw the brunch menu and it was ending in 15 minutes so we decided to try it out. Having tried the location downtown and not leaving impressed, I was hoping for a much better experience and it was.

At first our hostess showed us a long table and high seats but we asked if we could sit at a table for 4 or a large booth and she said the booth would be good. It was a very comfortable and spacious. There are TVs around showing golf, hockey, and I think curling.

The brunch menu starts at 10am until 2pm on weekends. The skillet hash and frittata appealed to me the most and I went with the hash. The server let us know that the food was taking a bit of time but she asked the kitchen to rush it. It didn't seem too long of a wait.

The skillet was hot and it came with 2 eggs cooked to my liking, chunks of potatoes with lots of cheese, mushrooms, red peppers, corn beef, and I think onions too. The skillet was pretty oily but the food wasn't too heavy and greasy. I didn't eat all the cheese though. The portion size was not huge but enough food for me for a late brunch. 

Our server was friendly and attentive. The service is way better than the downtown location. They have daily specials and I would come back for taco Tuesday, pasta Wednesday, or wing Thursday. It was a comfortable dining experience and not too loud and crowded too!
name: Violet

text: Great place always went to growing up.  Ordering from somewhere else though as you need to put prices on your online menus.  Thanks
name: cameron

text: YUM! Our office ordered food from Oscar's last week for a lunch celebration. I had the veggie nachos for the second time in two weeks. They were loaded and fabulous - just a note here though that they come with shredded cheese rather than queso. Everyone else was very pleased with their food as well. We will order from their again soon!
name: Donna

text: Had a fabulous breakfast here last week! My two scrambled eggs seemed more like three, and the hash browns were delicious.
name: Siobhan

text: My husband and I both ordered the fish and chips and loved it!  The panko breading is just right, the cod meaty and the fries hand cut!  The outdoor seating is especially inviting and the wait staff were great!  Our first time but won't be our last!
name: Barbara

text: What can I say that everybody else has not already said. The food here is fresh. I enjoyed the zucchini vegetarian Taco the most. The tamales are just okay; the Masa is dense and the amount of filling is disappointing. There are plenty of tables and seats. Unfortunately, the decor is lacking, but that will not stop me from eating here.   FYI: tacoson is closed on Sunday and only open until 9 p.m. even on Friday and Saturday.
name: Jenny

text:
The beer selection was dope. Happy hour was well worth it and the Althea pizza was so freakin good. Oh and the hot cauliflower......oh so good. 
A+++
name: Todd

text:
Nice joint!

The food here is fresh and tasty. The restaurant is a storefront with floor-to-ceiling windows, so there is lots of light. It seems slightly overpriced, but considering the quality and freshness of the food, it's justified.  They serve alcoholic drinks, too. I didn't try any, but the drink menu did look tasty. Overall, this place is worth visiting, and for me it is also definitely on my repeat list.
name: Brad

text: Food took forever but ended up being better than I expected. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Maybe better dine-in than delivery, hard to tell. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh.
name: User

text: The adobada tacos are amazing, service was great. The pozole was flavorful. I will definitely come back again. If you're looking for authentic Mexican food you will not be disappointed.
name: Wendy

text: I have returned after a year once again for my birthday. There was no one in the place when I arrived. I ordered the most expensive item on the menu, carne asada which was prepared with a red sauce. Upon request  the cook makes it with a chimichuri sauce which could be whipped up in seconds.  The waitress never bothered to tell me he could not make this as they did not have it made or we're out of ingredients. So... here comes our food on salad plates overflowing and very unappetizing. I had no room to cut my meat which was also over cooked . I ended up having it boxed up to take home. I noticed all the other patrons arriving after me got their dinners on plates and not little salad plates. They would also benefit from a cheap water filter. Never again!
name: Cynthia

text: After a long day of shopping, we asked where there was a good mexican food restaurant was.  This place was recommended.  Glad we went! Would have given 5 stars, but our waiter forgot about us. I think he was going home. Otherwise, we will go back!!
name: Martha

text: Iv tried this place for the second time. First time I got a burrito and the second time I got the fish tacos a plantains. The only thing I felt was made well were the plantains. Iv made plantains before there isn't much to them. Though they could have over cooked them but they were just right. The taco and burrito were just average. I wouldn't get them again. The tortillas are not as fresh as I prefer. The place is a bit cold and service was ok. My boyfriend got the side order of fries- they came out cold and even if they were hot I'm not sure how tasty they would have been. Not a fan of this place.
name: Brittani

text:
If you are visiting NOLA don't forget to stop at least once in Li'l Dizzy's Cafe. The fist time I visited NOLA with a friend was during Mardi Gras (so veeery busy), and the guy from our AirBnB recommended this spot, but the line outside the door initially discouraged us. Line is actually moving pretty fast and the service is very good. We went for the lunch buffet (it's around 15$) and everything was so good, better than in the 5* TripAdvisor restaurant we visited the day before. 
I visited Lil'l Dizzy's Cafe again last February (again Mardi Gras) and again everything was excellent. I love their fried chicken and mac and cheese, although I would never eat both of them enywere else. 
Remember to not stuff yourself too much and keep some space for the bread pudding that is literally heaven.
name: Linda

text: Fantastic food and great family-friendly service. By far the best Mexican food in the area.
name: Alexios

text:
We went to check this out since it changed from the old 86th Street Pub. It seems it doesn't quite know what kind of establishment it wants to be. They are advertising as a Jazz club and they have white linen on the table. Are they trying to be upscale? The food is stanard pub food and comes in plastic baskets - nothing wrong with that, but the menu doesn't match the decor. They also advertise VIP seats and bottle service...are they trying to be a night club too? It was very confusing. We just had a few drinks so we didn't try the food. However, a few guests around us had some and the portions looked great. Only thing that was a little off putting was the metal detector wand on the host stand. Who is coming in??
There was nothing wrong about the bar, but there just wasn't anything right.
name: Laura

text:
We were in town  for business, we wanted Mexican, we asked 4 people they all said the ONLY Mexican you want to eat in the area is Three Brothers Grill.
 It's a small unassuming place in a little strip mall, 6 or 7 tables, open kitchen,  you can see them preparing your meal.
  We were quickly greated and sat, the server made a couple suggestions and went to nv st our drinks and chips and salsa.. salsa was incredible, not hot at all, they ma6have a hot version, we didn't ask.. incredible flavors, very very nice.
  We got the wet shrimp burrito and the beef enchiladas... the shrimp burrito was freakin  huge! Stuffed with shrimp, rice, beans quac,  cheese.. it was insane! The enchiladas we stuffed as well, they came with a side of refried beans and rice.
  We look for places like this as we travel the country, and Three Bothers was probably in the top 2 Mexican restaurants we have been to in the last 2 years.  Extremely friendly staff, h8ge portions, great flavor..
   Keep an eye out for this place when you are in the area, it's well worth your time!
name: Just_me

text: This was a happening place.  The food and drinks were great.  It was very busy and they were very attentive.  Great place to go before going to the Superdome to watch sports, play games, socialize, and enjoy.  Parking costs were extreme.
name: Rashaka

text:
"Five stars for Chick-fil-A...really?"

CHYEAH! You better believe it.

This Chick-fil-A has been my trusty friend on those long days where cooking isn't an option and waffle fries are calling my name. Their service is quick and friendly! And if they mess up your order, they make it right...and then some. 

My roomie and I picked up dinner here (via the drive-thru) a few weeks ago. When we got home (we live less than a mile away) we realized that they left out one of our orders of fries. We drove back through and told them that they left out a medium fry. They apologized and when we got to the window they gave us a large fry and a coupon for a free entree during our next visit!

Now on to the food - it's always served hot and fresh! Each visit I've had here has been consistently excellent. As far as what to order, well, everyone has their preference at Chick-fil-A. But if you ask me, get a Chick-Fil-A chicken sandwich, fries, Chick-fil-A sauce, ranch, and if you've thrown calorie counting out the window, an Oreo milkshake...and feel no regrets. But if you are counting calories and are looking for something semi-guilt-free (is that even a real thing??), I love their chicken cool-wraps with balsamic vinaigrette and a small fry on the side (because how could I not?), so yummy!
name: Amie

text: The food came out fast, which was good because we were starving. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. It was decent, just a little uneven. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Would probably stop in again if nearby.
name: User

text: The atmosphere in the Tap Room is amazing. The food was well above board. I had the Lumberjack Dip and my wife had the Turkey Pesto wrap. An order of fried pickles was the appetizer. 20 brews on tap and you can have a taste of any. Andy was our bartender and was very engaging and personable. We will definitely come back before our weekend get away is over. Thank you
name: Mark

text: Decided to try this place for lunch. The salsa given with the chips has the perfect amount of heat. Very good. I decided to have the #20 Quesadilla Chicken Fajitas - it's 1 big fajita with grilled veggies, cheese, guacamole, sour cream and tomatoes. It was so good I couldn't stop eating it. Service was fast and attentive. I will come back here when I return to this area. Two thumbs up!
name: Carrie

text: Every time I eat here I am never disappointed! It is always delicious. I have never had a bad pizza from Rosario's. They are friendly, kind, and always helpful. This is my favorite pizza place in the area.
name: Michelle

text: Ended up here pretty late, maybe around 9:30, because everything else nearby had a wait. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Would absolutely visit again. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. For the price I expected more than this. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text: Had a great experience here on a previous visit, so decided to have our special occasion dinner with the family at this restaurant. Food is absolutely awesome. One of the top one or two steak that I have ever ate . All of my family agreed. Great service and atmosphere.
name: G.

text: Great little Italian spot. The spaghetti dish is a generous side with giant meat balls that are stuffed with cheese. Low lighting and pleasant music makes it the ideal place for a romantic date or a pleasant night out with friends!
name: Dex

text: The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Worth checking out. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The leftovers held up okay the next day..
name: User

text:
Arrived for 1st time visit. Comfortable seating. I had the Cuban Sandwich madero order. Sampled the loaded nachos which were excellent. The place had excellent service for lunch meals came out quickly I was in a group of  5 co- workers.
Look forward to returning.
name: Robert

text: I used to love coming to Catelli. I have been coming for a few years and the food was always awesome but recently the food has gone downhill. I used to love the crispy calamari now it's not crispy and very bland. They also changed the menu for entrees and took of all the items that I used to love. Sad to say I won't be returning after my last dining experience. I ordered the short rib and it was very chewy. It was served over risotto which was like glue. I've ordered this in the past and it was always delicious but the food has completely gone down hill. They must have a new owner or a new kitchen staff. It also took forever to receive the entrees. Will not be back sadly.
name: Erika

text: Great place for sushi and Korean BBQ! Beautiful atmosphere, super friendly staff, and clean restrooms. Worth a try!
name: Fanboy911

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: I'm really happy the Philly location finally open up!! The food is just as good as the New Jersey location!! Price is good for what you get!!
name: Kenny

text: PJs is our go to place for after work outings. We usually go with over 10 ppl and are easily accommodated. The place is pretty big and easily located. I enjoy the wings as they have many options. They have a large selection of entrees and drinks. Everyone is very nice and attentive. This is a nice place for family outings or if you just want to get a quick drink.
name: Tati

text: Ordered takeout online and food was ready in the promised 30 minutes. It was possibly the best Thai food we've ever had. Everything was fresh and flavorful. Especially recommend the chicken satay, Massaman curry, and sesame chicken. The restaurant itself looks charming for dining in. We'll definitely be back.
name: Kristen

text: A great cozy place to meet friends. the pizza menu is vast and the ovens make it taste better.. our pizza was a bit burnt so I took one star off.. but other than that the service et al was good.. not too expensive ..next timeI am trying the nutella calzone
name: Mitali

text:
Great stuff.

We ate here 3 days in a row when visiting Santa Barbara.

We made the mistake of eating at La Ma Tou, and had to come here afterwards as we were unsatisfied and still hungry.

Their lamb kebabs are excellent.  In fact, everything was great.
name: Sirhc

text:
First time ordering the other night, picked up a Large Margarita and fried mozz. $27 total
I though was pretty good and the food was delicious. Pie was coming out of the oven when I arrived and they were picking basil right off the plant to put on it. I could smell it from the counter. We live in the neighborhood and we'll definitely be back.

text: First visit and last visit.   Our family of four did not expect white table service or food quality but this was very disappointing.  The service was below average, the food was way below average, and the entire place was in need of a good cleaning.  The server became much friendlier and much more eager to please as it became closer to time for us to get our check and pay .... tip time.  Will not be back and would not recommend.

text: Always order from here it is a great place to eat from always on time and even earlier I will never change this place always order the shrimp fried rice with 8 chicken wings until shrimp roll

text:

Cook was angry

We all know now your true feelings.

text: Just in town for a meeting and wanted to eat a good breakfast. This place was great! The atmosphere was super relaxing and the staff was very friendly. When I come back to Indianapolis next year I will definitely be coming back. The food was super delicious and the coffee was great. Everything was super fresh and that's something that you can't over look
name: Beau

text: I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Not bad for a quick meal.
name: User

text:
Service 5/5
Christian was excellent. He gave great advice and as a result we both tried a newer menu item - cauliflower crust pizza. 

Food 5/5
The cauliflower personal pizza includes crust, cheese sauce and one vegetable topping.
Dear friend and I ordered our own personal pizzas. She chose a red pizza topped with mozzarella, arugula and prosciutto. I chose a Margarita- Style plus mushrooms. 

We both enjoyed the food and our drinks. Friend ordered a wit beer I'm not sure if it was blue moon or hoegaarden I'd the Prosecco- both options were wonderful.

I've to admit that I asked what the actual ingredients in the crust are and no one could answer me. Though the first bite definitely  had pronounced notes of "caulifunk" after that I neither smelled or tasted cauliflower and the pizza was crunchy and thin crusted. I've to warn you, if your body isn't used to cauliflower crust you may experience an unexpected and unwanted "cleanse"
name: Elisa

text:
Overall was excellent other than the price. The atmosphere is very nice, more of a fine dining experience. I would rather pay $10-$12 and get Caribbean food elsewhere. I understand the location is in Hyde Park so likely the rent is pricey so food has to be pricey, but it would be wise to get a place else where and lower prices. 

Jerk chicken was so good spicy and the way it should be!
name: Blake

text: First time here. Great food and huge portions. Home style potatoes were amazing. Crisp bacon, eggs fried just right and fluffy pancakes. Our server was very efficient and friendly. The manager even came over to ask if we enjoyed our first time there. We will return.
name: Sarah

text: Price felt a touch high for what it was. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. You can tell they care about customer experience here. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Not bad for a quick meal. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: Loved the nasi lemak and mee kompliat. Horrible parking situation, but worth the extra effort.
name: David

text:
got the graham central station ice cream, it was absolutely delicious. however, it was incredibly sweet, a bit too much for me. i could feel the sugar on teeth degrading my enamel. 

i understand why it's popular though, as it was a a blazing hot summer day and the line was still a good 10 people long when i got there. just a tad too sweet for my taste.
name: Erick

text: We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Pretty happy with it overall. Nice little spot, decent portions too. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. It looked better online than it did in person. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really.
name: User

text: This is our favorite spot for our Al pastor burrito. No matter how busy these guys are there always super friendly. Be prepared to order an item that will fill you up and most likely you will have leftovers. Again we only come here for the AL Pastore burrito!
name: Janel

text: Honestly I think I ordered the wrong thing. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: The fries were probably the best part of the meal, honestly. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. The music was louder than it needed to be. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. For the price I expected more than this. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text:
No star would have been my evaluation. Waited well over time. Drive thru at 5:08 pm and got food at 5:35 pm. Was told to wait 5 minutes for shrimp and fish. They gave me two extra pieces of fish,like that was going to work.  Laziness runs this place. Joke is that they have a 97% satisfaction?  Never again!!!!!!
Didn't get the extra fish. It was two extra chicken tenders. I had also ordered 8 chicken tenders.
name: Amalis

text: How do I put drool in my review? This place was amazing. The service was great from both the bartender before dinner and our waitress Karen throughout. The food was incredible and we took our time and everything we ordered was spaced appropriately. We started with the duck wings which I thought were to die for- the sauce was incredible and the wings cooked just right, my boyfriend preferred the short ribs (also amazing).  We then tried the Italian meatballs which I thought were pretty basic but my boyfriend really enjoys.  In the spirit of ordering too much food we then tried the wild boar ribs which literally pulled right off the bone, and the Gouda Mac and cheese. Suffice it to say we took a lot home with us that night. Everything was amazing and reasonably prices, highly recommend! Can't wait to come back with more people and try the trough!
name: Liz

text: I used to frequent this place 2.5 years ago when I lived in Philly. I came back to visit and bought 2 quart containers of the tofu hua dessert with peanuts. I brought it home for my family to eat and the tofu is slimy! Did they change the recipe or did I get sold a bad batch? It tasted and smelled fine but it looks like snot and no one wanted it anymore.
name: Yingbo

text: Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. The staff seemed tired but still polite. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: Started our day here For Sunday brunch and it was the worst experience. Such a trendy place but the service was the worst service I've ever received. The server spilt orange juice all over my friend and laughed it off. Our order was messed up and sent out twice incorrectly again with over 20 minutes in between each time. Never got the salad and a manager never came over and no apologizes were given. This was honestly embarrassing to sit through with us all being in the restaurant industry.
name: Mia

text:
We really like this little joint off College, in the corner with some outside tables, some inside tables, and some tables that are in between inside and out - stop by you'll see what I mean.

Breakfast, brunch, lunch menu. Great big omelettes. Outstanding mushroom soup. We've been here a half dozen times and always found something new, interesting, and tasty. 

Recommended!
name: Tim

text:
I thought all Poké places were by and large the same but I was wrong. The selection here is less than other places in STL but that wasn't the main concern. 

As I was glancing over the options the Salmon didn't look good at all but with few other options I decided to get it anyway. It didn't look good, it didn't smell good and it tasted so bad I stopped eating and threw away my food because I was convinced I would get food poisoning if I ate any more.
name: Victor

text: Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The staff seemed tired but still polite. By the time the food came out I was already annoyed. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Wouldn't really choose this place again. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text: I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Definitely coming back. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text: It was crowded but still moved along. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Will be back. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text: The fries were probably the best part of the meal, honestly. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. The music was louder than it needed to be. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The staff seemed tired but still polite. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
