text: An authentic Italian cusine with a cool environment. They bring you a special bread, parmesan cheese and olive oil as a welcome meal ( they sometimes run out of it tho!!) and the waiters are nice and welcoming
name: Behnoush

text: We came here for lunch on a lark...looked up lunch places on Yelp and this place had good reviews and 4+ stars...OMG! SO GOOD! We aren't doing carbs do we ordered the "O.M.G. Burger" has garlic aioli...they put it on a bed of lettuce since we wanted no bun...very friendly staff, sports on the TVs, and reggae on the speakers...very fun place, we will be back to this gem!! 5
name: Dusti

text:
Charbroiled oysters were amazing !!! 
But that's it , my salmon was overcooked , and is served with lots of argulla ,which is more lime a garnish Not a salad , they put so much in your plate that looks like a salad portion , ridiculous .
The Maine lobster was dry and cold and chewy.
The only good thing I had was their charbroiled oysters.
name: Rocio

text:
We love Oceanaire and still think it's one of (if not THE) best place for seafood in the city. 

It has a great location just off the circle (so afterwards we walked over and got chocolates for dessert) with street parking- and if that's not available there are garages everywhere. 

The inside is beautiful and the servers are always super friendly and really on top of things. But what really matters- the food - and the quality here is through the roof. I've never had anything here and been dissatisfied with the taste or portion size. 

Cocktails are pricey for Indy ($14) but very well crafted. I had the limoncello basil gimlet and it was incredible. One of the most refreshing cocktails I've had in awhile. This time we visited on a Sunday- and they have a special if you sit in the bar area- $1 oysters! And this deal is TOTALLY worth it. They are cheap but more importantly, you know they're fresh.
name: Sara

text: The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Worth checking out. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The service was off and the meal kinda followed that energy. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text: I came here with my family.  Really good margaritas, really great traditional Tex-Mex.  HOWEVER... Service was just ok.  We were out on the quiet patio just kicking it and our server was turtle slow to bring our pitcher of margaritas and food. My cousin had a plane to catch, so I had to go to the hostess stand to locate our server to bring us the check. It would have been a 5 star visit if we'd had better service.  Casa Molina needs to figure that part out.
name: Danielle

text:
Alligator v. Boudin - Boudin wins (Alligator was tough, too much sauce)
Sweet tea is perfect, not too sweet
Yeast dinner rolls are top 5 - just like my mother in law used to make.
Cochon with peach and cabbage - definitely, huge portion, enough to share.
Mixed greens had to be the perfect balance of sweet, vinegar and smokey bacon goodness - you are missing out if you don't get this
Pork ribs huge flavor, but a bit over-sauced.   Service is good (but average) 
We had a reservation but probably could have walked in, place is huge.
name: Jas

text: From beginning to end this is a great meal.  The Thai soup is out of this world and the chocolate cake is the best.  All the food tastes amazing.
name: Jen

text: This is one of the best cheesesteak places I've eaten at in a very long time. Quality definitely comes to mind when I think of Franks Streaks....

text:
My expectations were very high but unfortunately I was extremely let down.  I've actually never left a review on yelp but for some reason the lack of flavor in my Delmonico compelled me to leave my opinion.  I went with a large group 8+ and we had amazing service, great ambiance, and it was definitely an enjoyable time.  Unfortunately, the steak could not have been worse.  I ordered the Delmonico steak medium rare and it was impossible to cut and had absolutely no flavor.  I was seriously confused with what I was eating.  Maybe I ordered the wrong cut or something went wrong with the cooking process but it was honestly terrible.  On a high note, the desert room was amazing.  Their version of the Irish coffee was amazing and the vibe up top was so cool.

 I didn't have the heart to tell the rest of the group how I felt because everyone else seemed to enjoy it - which is why I ended up on yelp.
name: Dustin

text: Lets start with amazing!    The food here is ssssoooooo good i almost slapped my date!   17 out of 5 stars.  Also, elaine is a very sweet server!      Food was orgasmically good!

text: Great customer service, food was delicious. I got a small chicken platter, it was very filling. The white sauce is really good. Kinda like a low fat ranch sauce. Be careful on the hot sauce. It's really hot. They usually add just a little, unless you specify otherwise.
name: Tyneka

text: This pizza is my favorite in the area! Its a little pricier but much better quality than a typical pizza joint. Plenty of unique topping combos and good beer on tap. Going here is always a treat! And therea good gluten free crust for my husband.
name: Dana

text: The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. It just never really recovered once things started off weird. Just not for me. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Food was good and came out fast. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Would probably stop in again if nearby.
name: User

text:
Outstanding service, first of all. What a humble, yet knowledgeable and subtly suggestive waiter ( I unfortunately forgot his name since its been a while, but he had a huge beard). Ive had some of the best food in St. Louis here at the clover & the bee. I had the corzetti pasta with mortadella, pistachio, and brown butter. The rich browned butter and earthy nutty sauce hit the spot. The pastas were perfectly cooked and amazing. My friend had the sweet corn and cheese tortellini and he loved it. The server suggested the tiramisu and i was skeptical because I am picky about tiramisu. But he said it was the best so I had to try. It was definitely new and nothing like what I expected. The biscuit is quite dense and much like a shortbread cookie. There wasn't a lot of coffee flavor but enough to keep my roommate up for an extra few hours. 

I heard they are rated the best brunch place in St Louis so I'm definitely coming back for brunch.. I cant wait!
name: Chie

text:
The donuts are great. A little more toppings than necessary, but I'm sure that many people will like that. We ordered a 1/2 dozen, and tried several different types. I was disappointed that they were out of the banana cream pie donut, and they were also out of several other types. 
Overall, good value, great donuts, excellent variety, but expect them to be out of a few of the favorites that might be mentioned in other reviews.
name: Brian

text: Great place. Fun time. Loft is awesome food is really good.   Donna great bartender!  Great place to visit in Terrie Verde
name: Mary

text:
This is an old reliable choice that has all of the comfort foods you could want. The prices are reasonable. The remodel looks nice but the building shows its age. 

What makes me laugh? The candy rack at the cash register. This used to be a standard feature of family diners but is RARE nowadays.
name: J

text:
I true gem of Reno. The staff is ALWAYS amazing staff and the eats are INCREDIBLE.

I'm partial to the Sierra St. locale.
name: Bradley

text: Terrible slow service my god how is it you have a happy hour and one waitress? We have been sitting at a table for 20 minutes. It was like this the last time we came here.
name: Amie

text: For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Food was fresh and service was quick. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Would return. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text: First off, please understand that we did not have the following exchange with any employees of Mama Carolla's.  This evening (8/1/19) four of my former students, three African-American young women and one Caucasian young woman (and this will matter soon enough) and I, a Latina, went to Mama Carolla's for dinner, were seated quickly and served fairly quickly. What transpired afterwards was quite disturbing. In one of their smaller dining rooms that accommodates four tables, the five of us sat alone for about an hour. Thereafter, a group of two older Caucasian couples were seated directly behind us. Soon I clearly overheard one man snicker, "Oh, she has on a Purdue T-shirt on." This young lady is African-American. This gentleman went on to discuss his political beliefs, quite audibly, sharing his views on "people" who take advantage and who "just abuse the system." Finally, after the five of us had enjoyed our meal, we requested our bills which is when I clearly heard, "Don't worry. They're getting their checks. They'll be gone soon." At this point, I turned around, interrupted their conversation and politely asked the gentlemen to have more respect for us and keep their comments to themselves. Of course, I was dismissed. Their behavior upset me terribly. What upset me more is during an opportunity to wish my former students good luck as they get ready to tackle their sophomore year as undergraduate students (at Purdue, IUPUI and Alabama State University) I had to bear witness to bigotry and ignorance. I mentioned this encounter with the general manager and expressed that it was a tremendous disappointment to have shared a meal with four of my favorite people among patrons whose views are so limited. Theirs is not indicative of all patrons of Mama Carolla's, just some this evening.
name: M

text: This place makes you feel like you are in the true old South. Homey fell menu is just what your Southern Grandma would make. They even have fried green tomatoes. Staff was lovely
name: Nancy

text: Fortunately I've been here on more than one occasion. On this most recent occasion I had the pasta on the Bayou which fell a little short in terms of flavor in my opinion. It could've used a little more chachere's. However, the Bow Wow (I think that's the name of the drink), is good and strong. The chargrilled oysters were big and buttery and well seasoned. The bread to go with it was a perfect accompaniment to sop everything up! Our server was nice even though I did get a sense she has a knack for flipping tables quickly. In sum, I'll just strike the pasta on the bayou from the things I'll get cause of course I'll be back.
name: Keisha

text: The food is bland. I don't think there are any spices or seasoning in the restaurant! The food is way over priced. I highly doubt I'll be returning.... I can make these dishes at home!
name: Chris

text: The photos made it look a little better than it actually was. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. It was crowded but still moved along. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: Sushi Ushi is always welcoming whenever i come in with my family. The sushi is great and the hospitality is awesome. It is a higher price point type restaurant but it personally doesn't bother me. I love coming here with my family whenever we get the chance to go! definitely would recommend to friends and family!
name: Olivia

text: I like this location and always sit at the bar for food and drinks. They have a seasonal menu and last time I had the Potato Crusted Cod which cost $20.49 so expensive for fish n chips tho it was pretty awesome so can't complain. I have never been disappointed with any meal there, service is always great so their only fault is they need more beer choices :o)
name: David

text:
They have bottomless brunch option on weekend. 
$25 drink only option, adding $10 you get a brunch entree. Good deal.
name: E

text: The food here is pretty decent. It has changed chef's a few times and their menu has also changed slightly. I love their orange chicken and crab puffs. Their Vegas roll is also really good. I would definitely recommend if you are craving sushi or Chinese.
name: Erin

text: The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. The music was louder than it needed to be. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Definitely coming back. It looked better online than it did in person. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly.
name: User

text:
This establishment is great, made a reservation and they had our table ready. We were met by our great server Brian, who had personality, as well as great recommendations for food. I had the lobster tail which was fried and slightly over cooked, but I really enjoyed the salads that came with the meal, and my boyfriends steak was cooked to perfection. This restaurant has taken pride in training their staff. Everyone was very professional, attentive without being too disruptive.

Would love to come back here again!
name: Christine

text: I picked up a chicken pad Thai with medium spice last night. The portion size definitely wasn't the largest I've gotten in the area but it was delicious!! The tamarind sauce was fantastic without being any bit oily. The noodles weren't overcooked or stuck together at all which I've come to appreciate. One of my favorite things about it were the raw, fresh crunchy bean sprouts! The texture difference is awesome! SO many places cook the bean sprouts all the way down so it's nearly the same texture as the noodles.  There really wasn't much chicken but I love rice noodles so much that it didn't bother me, but it probably would disappoint others. With the smaller sized portion and little protein $14 seems high to me. But taste trumps all so I'll definitely be back. Like soon.
name: Madeline

text: This place was so adorable. Couldn't help starring at how cute it was and also the service was great. Including picture of what we ordered. My oatmeal bowl with syrup was delish and lasted for breakfast the next day.
name: Vidhi

text:
My intentions in heading to Old Webster this morning were not to have breakfast at The Clover & the Bee, but I am so glad that my original plans fell through because I may have just found my new favorite brunch spot.  

The ambiance of The Clover & the Bee is insta-worthy and all around beautiful. Our server was a little awkward but very attentive and we never sat with an empty drink. 

The food all had a twist on the usual breakfast items. I went with biscuits and gravy for my main (served in some kind of biscuit log that was so unique and so yummy) for sides I ordered the breakfast potatoes (YUM) and the grits (). Also just as a side note- I pretty exclusively drink cold brew coffee at home and it's difficult to find at most places but this place has it on tap and it's not the worst coffee I have ever had. 

Overall, I can't wait to come back. I've already forgotten the name of the other breakfast place down the street that used to be my favorite
name: Emilie

text: Went here to watch the game with some friends . The wings I ordered were overcooked and dry. The loaded nachos I had were stale and tasted awful.
name: Jason

text: Another great lunch at Chadwyck's. Menu has been updated. More vegetarian items for me. And hubs loved the new fish section- pick the fish, choose the style of cooking and choose the sauce. Everything was wonderful.
name: Ritamary

text: After placing my order I was told their credit card machine was down so I had to pay cash. I didn't have enough cash so I told them to cancel my order. He said the hotel I was staying at had an ATM machine and he would add a free dessert for the trouble so I agreed. I was told 45 mins. An hour and 15 mins later the food arrives without the promised dessert and all the food was room temperature. The wings were boneless and were more like chicken nuggets with BBQ sauce. The appetizer cheese bread is just a small cheese pizza. Very disappointed and wished I had looked up their reviews before I ordered. I could have eaten at the hotel restaurant for cheaper, faster, and fresher food.
name: Kristy

text: We went to Opa on Friday evening and sat at the indoor bar. We got a saganaki appetizer and it was AWESOME!!! I also ordered a cider beer which was AMAZING, I only wish I remembered what it was called!
name: Lorraine

text:
Coming from the Midwest, I've had the very fortunate opportunity to go to some of the coolest bars in Chicago that overlook the city skyline. 

This bar reminded just of that. With New Orleans being a significantly smaller city than Chicago, I had very low expectations for the view of this bar, but if perfectly imitates the experience you'd find in a larger city. While drinks are a bit pricier, the view and overall experience of the bar is 100% worth it. 

*DISCLAIMER* If you go during a busy time, there is a wait to enter the bar, but I experienced no cover. There's a nice ground level bar that had live music to snag a drink at with the Hotel to wait at.
name: Spenser

text: One of those meals where nothing is exactly wrong but you're not excited either. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text: First time sampling Ugandan food.  I can't comment on its authenticity but it was tasty.  Lunch buffet had selection of meat based and vegetarian curry.  I recommend the fish curry

text: Very friendly service. The food was fresh and portions were plenty. Very good experience
name: Shannan

text: I stayed at a local home and was craving a home feel breakfast and found this place within 5 min walking distance. Service was great and food was delicious.
name: Andrea

text: Came in Sunday night 12/2 at 6:30 and was promptly sat downstairs by the bar. The restaurant was less than half full but over 10 minutes later no server ever approached my table.  Thanks Gullifty's- I'll take my business elsewhere.

text:
I've been a huge fan of the Raven since I was in my early 20s. Friendly bartenders, great food, and a swimming pool.

I'm sad to report that The Raven has closed, effective 10/14/2019.

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Price felt a touch high for what it was. A very pleasant experience. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: Amazing, accidental find!!! After a few hours of shopping, my friend and I happened upon this little slice of heaven ...a hidden gem replicating the beach atmosphere in the middle of downtown St Pete! This little spot is behind tall shrubs, but this bar is totally outside under a roof. There are tables and chairs surrounding the bar area. The food is limited and partially self-serve. You walk over to a little shack and place your order, and then they deliver to your table or bar area. The bartenders made crafted cocktails that were so different and refreshing! The service was excellent, and the food was good and reasonably priced. The best part of this experience was the unexpected entertainment. As the sun went down, a man with a guitar emerged and started singing all different genres. We stayed for hours and didn't want to leave! I would definitely recommend for a relaxing evening and will definitely return.
name: Rhoda

text: Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Food was fresh and service was quick. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: This is a great fish shack right on the water. The grouper sandwich was delicious! I would highly recommend it.
name: Jenny

text:
All of the bartenders are so nice and helpful! The pretzels are SO FLUFFY. The pizzas are delicious. 
Also tons of seating and super great windows
name: Lilly

text: Friendly staff. Great customer service. Joe is very delightful to talk to. Server was kind enough to reshape my food because I wasn't satisfied with the small pieces of oxtail (if you're from the Caribbean you know no one wants small oxtail lol). Very pleased with the service and portion sizes for the price
name: Moya

text: The food was delicious and hearty! The Five & Dime was rich with a kick; the BAM & Yo Yo's waffle was light and fluffy and the chicken was flavorful; the hash brown cake was really rich but tasty; and the sweet potato fries were thick, soft and scrumptious. The only reason the place is not getting a five is because of the service. The guy taking the order made us wait unnecessarily before taking the order and was not the most hospitable.
name: Milly

text: This place is great.   I travel a lot and know good Italian food.  This place is just great.
name: Tigran

text: Not sure why this place has such split reviews, but my experience was mostly fine. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Not a bad stop, just not one I'm rushing to repeat. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really.
name: User

text: Stopped by after work because I was nearby and hungry. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Food was fresh and service was quick. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. A very pleasant experience. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: I don't really get some of the harsh reviews on here. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. I had a better visit than I expected to. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. It was crowded but still moved along. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Pretty happy with it overall. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really.
name: User

text: They have a great atmosphere and really nice outdoor dining right on the river. Their pizza is amazing!

text: I love Clean Eatz. I started using their meal plan (which is SO affordable) by the time you figure eating out cost and all the calories consumed with that! They always switch up the meals week to week so you don't get bored. Even my picky husband enjoys their meals! Perfectly filling and the flavor is great on most meals! Only a few I don't care for but that's to be expected with different tastes! Do yourself a favor and checkout their prepped meals (they have a freezer there where you can just try a few)  You won't be disappointed.

text:
This is easily one of my favorite work lunch spots. My coworkers and I have literally been eating here once a week. Not good for my supposed to be budget but whatever! 

The food is amazing! I always spring for the drunken noodles and get the dinner portion because that's how I am lol. A variation of shrimp and beef is the perfect combination. I really love the mussel appetizer but it's super small and not work the the price tag. That being said the broth is amazing and you might end up drinking it like soup lol. 

The atmosphere is chill. Servers are friendly. Perfect for this spring weather when the staff open the doors and let the outside air in.

text: Fantastic food. Great service. Ask for David. Seared scallops on mashed sweet potatoes was amazing. We will definitely be back.

text: The more then enough giant sandwhich. Yes my selected size. Able feed 3 kids and they still save some.  For me I enjoy half and thank you for my lunch the following day. Great subs especially the philly Mike's!

text: The homemade meat balls were wonderful!  And the cheesecake- get outta here! So delectable!

text: I've been to Sushi Kingdom a few times and the quality of food and service are always consistent. Salmon sashimis are always fresh, fatty, and soft -- never frozen. Beef satay, tempura, and veggie tempura are really good as well. They never ran out of anything that I ordered and my water glass never hits 50% empty. Definitely the best all-you-can-eat sushi place in Philadelphia/South Jersey area!

I wanted a hot black tea but they didn't have any hot tea available which was a little weird but that's okay. Worth trying!

text: First of all, the atmosphere is nice for a place with TVs everywhere. The fajitas were great.The burger was perfect. They have baked potatoes and I got a loaded one. I recommend this. It's not as loud as some other places with TVs.

Wife got the wings and loved them. Great beer selection and the waitress was super nice and attentive. The only reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 is because you can still smoke inside but the smell of the food overpowers it so it's not that bad.

text:
I've been meaning to stop in here for years and finally did this past weekend after having had brunch another place nearby that was less than stellar. After I'd read this menu and had tasted my friend's waffle, I'd wished we'd eaten here instead. Our server was very pleasant and attentive. We sat the end of the long communal table and enjoyed our time there. I'm not sure about the other tables, but this particular table has charging stations, which is pretty cool! 

I'm always a tea drinker, but I sampled my other friend's Belgian coffee (or something like that) and it was good! I wound up sharing it with her. We will definitely return for brunch another day.

text: I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Food was fresh and service was quick. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Food was good and came out fast. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Not bad for a quick meal. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Food was good and came out fast. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: I recommend ordering directly from the Mellow Mushroom website if you wish to order online. I used Grubhub, and the order didn't come through correctly to the restaurant. The staff at MM did their best to quickly make things right. Pizza crust (and the entire pizza) was awesome and friends really enjoyed the pretzel bites. Luckily I ordered pick-up, things would not have been so easily fixed if I had ordered delivery.
name: Cheryl

text: This very casual Vietnamese restaurant offered a brief respite from the overhyped and overpriced restaurants in the French Quarter.  In a small restaurant like this, the staff has to be efficient and get diners their food quickly to turn the tables.. and the staff at 9 Roses did not disappoint whatsoever and served our food quickly as we had ordered.  My vermicelli bowl with grilled pork was terrific -- the pork was well spiced and had a nice crusty texture.  My dining companion's grilled chicken was very tasty.   A terrific option for something out of the ordinary.
name: Rich

text:
Me and hubby were browsing through yelp looking for a new place to try while out in Nashville on our day off. We decided on Metro Diner because the menu sounded amazing. They had chicken and waffles with some strawberry jam butter, a shrimp and grits dish that looked right up my alley, and $2 mimosas. 

The inside of this place was super cute. I loved the daily special written in the middle of the room on a large chalk board. The kitchen was open so you could see that the chefs weren't contaminating your food with their bodily fluids. There were plenty of seating options for singles, to large parties. It looked very promising. 

It didn't take long for us to be greeted, so we thought. When initially sat by the hostess, another young lady brought us our silverware quickly after. About 4 minutes later (which is long af when you're hungry and have questions) our server Tracy finally came to the rescue. She was really energetic and seemed eager to please. However, she had no answers to any of our questions and took a very long time to come back with them. I was thinking she must've been new, not realizing the place was still in its honeymoon stage. The third time she left to gather information, she came back and delivered the same information about the cheese option on the broccoli. So I never found out if the shrimp and grits were spicy. After I settled to try the beef tips and gravy (because Tracy said the shrimp and grits weren't actually that great) my better half settled on the hard to screw up chicken tenders. 

After we ordered our meals, I had decided I wanted to indulge in a day drink. After realizing that Tracy wasn't coming back any time soon to see how we were doing, I made my way to the bar myself. I didn't get the bartenders name but he was nice and seemed like he could've been bar tending at a classier place. The diner didn't offer a full bar but they had the basics to satisfy my day drink selection. 

Hennessy! 

It was strong too. Thanks bartender. 

Once the food finally arrived at our booth, we both were very skeptical. My beef tips look like they came straight out of a banquet TV dinner box. The mashed potatoes were a solid 7 and probably the best thing on my plate. It mixed good with the gravy from the prepackaged beef. Hubbys chicken tenders looked like they were prepared in a nursing home for an elderly with a low sodium diet. There was absolutely no taste to them. All he ate was the fries. When Tracy asked us how our food was, and we politely gave her our feedback, she advised us that we were better off getting the shrimp and grits or chicken and waffles because those were ALSO best sellers ....

Tracy was a liar at this point lol 

Tracy went on to retrieve our bill with no visit from the manager. She advised us that she and the bartender both had rung in my day drink and offered my the option of paying either her or him for my drink. I payed him separately. Upon exiting we coincidentally ran into the manager. We told him our experience. He apologized seeming genuinely and gave us a coupon for our next visit. ‍
name: Mercedes

text: Super yum!! My niece graduated from grad school this weekend, so I'm lucky she could find a bit of time to have breakfast despite so many other friends and family coming to visit and celebrate her. She picked Two Chicks, and it was very sweet. Good coffee, great food and excellent service. They told us 15-20 minutes to sit, but it was more like 5. If I lived in Reno, or nearby, I'd definitely return. Maybe I'll have to make another trip up to my niece for an excuse to do so!
name: C

text: Food is good and inexpensive. Nothing fancy here, but I like that it's close. Staff is friendly and not a long wait between ordering and the food coming out.
name: Andrew

text: One of my favorite restaurants.  Amazing food and great 5 star quality from the staff. The sangria is the best I've had from coast to coast also. Thanks to this place for always being great.
name: Hector

text: Buttkickin' good BBQ. Traditional Southern baked beans, potato salad. Smoked beef was trophy-Class good! Ribs were horrible, had a chemical taste, were almost meatless and tough, sauce was awesome! Delivery was ultra-fast. This might be the best eating within 50 miles if you avoid the ribs!
name: Steven

text: Speechless. Ordered the Debris Po'Boy and was blown away! I'm from the Midwest and we get the pleasures of meat sandwiches from the famous Portillo's, originally of Chicago. But this sandwich, with it's masterful blend of the flavorful, tender beef, paired with the crunch of the shredded cabbage, along with the subtle tangy taste of the pickles, all stuffed into a soft and generous cut of delicious French bread and then served in a pool of palate pleasing au jus sauce, has exceeding my standards for the ultimate beef sandwich! Next up, I'll see if it can compete with another iconic beef sandwich, Geno's of Philly!
name: Kous

text: Worst restaurant experience I can recall!  Bartender finally came to take a drink order after 20 minutes, never brought the drinks.  The Hostess was so rude and simply looked miserable and annoyed to be there.  Customer service at its worst!  We will not go back and I am cancelling a large team event I had scheduled there as there are plenty of other good restaurants in the area with great customer service!
name: Steve

text: Went in to pickup food not even sit down and had to wait even tho I showed up past the order time. Then I stood there for ten minutes before someone told me I was in the wrong spot, then I waited in another spot and no one spoke to me until I stopped someone. I was then told my food would be right out. However the biscuit machine was broke. I didn't even order biscuits or want any and had to wait until I said something again to her and told her I didn't want biscuits I just want my food. The food then came right out. Almost a half hour for food that was already ready.
name: Natalie

text:
Let me start by saying...
Disregard every bad review about this restaurant. Yes, the wait was a little long, but this restaurant is VERY busy. There were large families walking in every 5-10 minutes! 

I am SO HAPPY I gave it a shot even after ready every bad review on here. This restaurant did not deserve any of that. I am Puertorican and the food and atmosphere made me feel like I was right back home eating at my grandmas kitchen table. 

Everything was absolutely delicious. The staff were all From the island which made it so much more authentic and reassuring because then I definitely knew I was going to receive a delicious homemade puertorican meal! 

I got the Assorted Fritters on the appetizer menu and the rice with chicken because I wanted to try a little bit of everything. It was all seasoned so well and very well cooked. I also got the Tres Leches cake for dessert. You can't leave a Spanish restaurant without desert! 

I will most definitely be coming back here when in need of a true authentic puertorican meal. The service was wonderful. Everyone was very welcoming and sweet, food was outstanding, there was live music and a very homey fun atmosphere. 

Disregard all of the bad reviews and take the chance !
name: Yenesis

text: Service was nice, kitchen was just moving kind of slow. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. For the price I expected more than this. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: Had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Not sure though.
name: User

text: Open, cheap drafts, happy, affordable, friendly, good food, lots GF options! flexible for a couple of large parties, five fine TVs and a juke Box, across from Fitler pool great stop after some sun.  Ice cold taps and fast service.  Thank God!  Not like the two other local snarky slow service spots.

text:
A great community restaurant. With great staff and a awesome wine selection!!

Ok back for more and check out the very Private Patio.  Only 24 seats  but what a great no noise ambiance loving the tunes and the Grenache!  Kept it light with the Tapas and Chris you were correct!   This will be a sought after spot with lineups to get in.   Thank you for this great addition to neighbourhood dinning.

text: ordered three orders of spaghetti and meatballs.  bruchetta and cannolis.  the spaghetti was tasteless.. I had to add salt and I dont use salt. .still didnt help. the meatballs were also tasteless.. the bruchetta .. the cheese was a cold clump on top and the tomatoes were ok .. in a container. my friends ate the cannolis..and actually tossed them stating they didnt taste like any cannolis they have ever had. I did order the italian wedding soup. Havent tried it yet. two of us actually tossed our dinners out.. kind of sad since it was $55 .. no delivery charge.  a lot of my neighbors have gotten food there and raved about it.. guess you dont order spaghetti and meatballs from an italian place that sells pizza.. I wont be ordering from there again. too pricey and no taste.

text: Great wine selection and great food! Romantic atmosphere! Staff is great with giving suggestions and recommendations.
name: Jessica

text: Excellent ribs & brisket  fried Okra & Cole slaw was good too. Best Smoked meat so far that we have tried
name: Steve

text:
My husband and I visited this spot prior to leaving for a tour. We arrived ill prepared and both ordered eggs and a biscuit. Eggs were okay, biscuits were great. 

As we were leaving we ordered a baked ham po boy as our tour required us to byo lunch. Later that afternoon we opened the sandwich and my thoughts on Mother's was drastically changed. This fairly basic ham and slaw sandwich was probably one of the best things we ate in NOLA. The ham in this sandwich is just outstanding. My husband, a notorious picky eater, was in awe of how good this thing was and we couldn't stop taking about it. 

As for the restaurant it reminds me of a deli. Order at the counter and grab a seat where you can.  Food arrives quickly and the staff were all very nice. 

If you are visiting NOLA do yourself a favor and stop in. Try and pick an off time of day or grab and go.
name: Amanda

text: Vegan soul food was absolutely incredible.  Sure to satisfy your hunger. Highly recommend.
name: Michele

text:
Funnel cakes shaped like donuts. The donuts are good, but not REALLY like donuts. They are more of funnel cakes shaped like donuts. They're cute and the toppings are fine, bur it was not at all what I expected when I purchased 'donuts'. 
Additionally, the chocolate milk they serve is a weird brand- which tasted like a chocolate chemical in water. Just not what we expected from a pricey donut shop.

text: The food came out fast, which was good because we were starving. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. It looked better online than it did in person. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text: It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable.
name: User

text: We had a very enjoyable meal here after a reception at the nearby Michener Art Museum on a Friday night. The place, which is not especially large, was full and that unfortunately meant that at times we could barely hear ourselves think let alone talk. Since each item is cooked to order it took a while for our orders to appear. They were worth the wait.  The food was excellent, and although the portions were modest, I didn't leave hungry by any means. I had the chicken paillarde which came with a saffron risotto, and a side of haricots vert which were perfectly cooked. My dining companion had the saucisson and a side of scalloped potatoes. Everything was delicious. The wine prices are absurd so we opted for beers of which there was a good selection at reasonable prices. The big highlight of the evening was the dessert. We had profiteroles, stuffed with the most amazing ice creams we've ever had. The restaurant makes their own ice creams and they are outstanding. Our server was a delight--pleasant, well informed, and attentive.
name: Joe

text: I understand why there was no wait to be seated. We are seated and had to wait almost 20 minutes before our order was taken. Anytime we needed refills on drinks we had to find someone other than our waiter. You would think that being in Nashville, one of the most popular tourist spots the service would be better. Nope not here.
name: Timothy

text: I have a coupon for $2 off a two meat meal. Ordered a three meat meal for more money and they said sorry, can't use the coupon. What?  Okay, change the order. Food was average at best so I guess they did me a favor... less to throw away.

text: Came to celebrate birthday of two friends.  Everyone is nice but rushed.  The food is  typical beach fare. Expensive, small portions and overdone. Ordered the clams for $9 -- all breading and impossible to chew.  My friend ordered the burger which had to be a frozen patty -- bread was stale and the burger tasteless.  The band, Both Worlds, is the only reason I would venture here again

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. You can tell they care about customer experience here. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Food was fresh and service was quick. Would absolutely visit again. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. For the price I expected more than this. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: Lovely brunch with just terrific service... had the pecan waffles, omelette and eggs with croissant. Had to have beignets - of course! Solid food - brunch is hard to miss on but the friendly staff and attentive service took the 3 star food to a 4 star experience- will be back

text:

Starting from approximately 45 minutes waiting, we were advised by the lady who looks to be the wife of the owner, that our ordering was forgot.( understanding they were very busy and look like very short on staff, this one in some way is not my real issue/ concern/ problem).

I include a picture of my sandwich plate where I found a baking sheet ....

text:
My hubby has been asking for us to get Arby's for so long bc the last experience here for me like 2 years ago was so bad that my answer has always been "no way". 

Today, I said ok when he mentioned picking up takeout thru the drive thru.  I know he was shocked, lol. 

So, he ordered 2 beef n cheddars for him and a medium roast beef for me, plus he bought an extra medium sandwich just in case my son or daughter wanted it for later as my daughter was eating Taco Bell and my son was eating Wendy's. 

My hubby rarely complains and just goes with the flow so he ate his sandwiches but I saw how mushy they were, plus wrappers covered in cheese. Unacceptable!!

My sandwich, I went to open it and the 1st unwrap....OMG, there was bbq sauce all over the inside flaps.  We didn't order anything with bbq sauce!!!

Right there, I was schkeeved out!!!  How dirty the hands were on the person that wrapped my sandwich was all I could think !! 

YUCK!!!!

Gave it to my daughter who unwrapped the rest and didn't mind as long as the sandwich was plain. 

Cleanliness is obviously a problem if u can't wrap a sandwich with clean gloves or hands. 

2 stars only bc my daughter did eat the sandwich. 

Never again for me Arby's!!!  I was right the 1st time!!!!!
name: Dina

text:
This was my first time and I loved it. The place has such a cool vibe. The interior is spacious and very open. There are plenty of tables and seats. I also appreciate the trendy wall art they have there. 

The bourbon vanilla was my drink choice of the morning. I loved the combination because it was unique and the flavors were great. I didn't order anything to eat because I was crunched on time. However, from what I saw at the other tables, I was pretty bummed I didn't order anything to-go. The biscuit sandwich looked really good. 

Highly recommend. If you're looking for a place to grab breakfast and some good coffee...check this place out!
name: Melyn

text: Checking in is horrible!!!!!!!! The line is always so long each time we come here! They need more agents at the front desk. I'm in line with 30 people!!!!!
name: Farmmee

text:
What.The...
This place is so delicious.  I slammed on my breaks and turned around because it had all the signs of a hidden (to me) gem.  There's also a second location on Nolensville that I go to at least 2xs a week.  This blew that location away and it's closer to my house... so, I'm basically going to eat here every day for the rest of my life.  
And I am picky about my Mexican food because I'm from California.  If that means anything to you... do what you will.
name: Kat

text:
This cafe has had us coming back 3 times in a row during our beach stay! This family run business is everything you want in a family business! 

Fresh baked Parisian pastries daily, the father making crepes that you can view, the son taking orders and the mom running around behind the counter helping. They are friendly and helpful! 

The chocolate croissant and turnovers (Vegan!) are perfect to enjoy with your coffee as they make your crepes! You walk up to the counter to order and pick out your pastries, pick a seat and they give you a number and deliver your food to your table. 

If you like lemon... lemon crepes! If you like savory- the honey and goat cheese  
We haven't had anything of unsatisfactory standards.

Ps there's typically an a accordion player on the front outdoor patio. All the French feels.
name: Kasandra

text: Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Food was fresh and service was quick. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. Worth checking out. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced.
name: User

text: Holy crepe!  This place is amazing with it's huge savory crepe selection as well as their fruit and dessert crepes.  On a recent trip to Clayton my family brunched at City Coffee three days in a row.  Sitting outside on a beautiful morning in Clayton reminded us of our favorite crepes in Paris.
name: Ryan

text: Three stars for the good sunset views. I stopped writing reviews but I can't pass this one out. It was so BAD! Go there for a view, not the food please. Each one of us ordered couple different drinks they were all awful. Their 'special ' watermelon cocktail tastes like watermelon water, not juice, water! Then the very berry mojito or martini isn't any better, I doubt there's even any alcohol in it.20bucks for a super small and sad plain gulf grouper. Only slightly better dish is the appetizer snails(bcz they don't have oysters) Maybe I just had bad luck had a bad bartender, friends ordered lamb and red snapper and grouper dinner. Overpriced! The management here is bad. Simply bad. Slow service, issues with cleanliness. JA A. said it well, this location pales in comparison to other Paneras.

The carnitas was excellent.

With California Taco To Go closed, we were concerned we would not find great fried fish tacos . Thank goodness for Azul. Their fish taco was pretty close to on par with CTTG.

text: The food was okay! Just what I needed and wanted from a brunch style place, an omelet, and a mimosa. But the poor waiter was the only guy running the whole place and they were pretty busy. He was great but they should def have more staff for a lunch rush
name: Samantha

text: The soup was better than the sandwich, which I wasn't expecting. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Food was fresh and service was quick. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..

It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: Would probably stop in again if nearby. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Food was good and came out fast. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text:
We ended up going to a couple Ruby Slipper's while in NOLA.

This location had fairly good food and service. When we headed out they ended up offering the honey a coffee to-go, with a fresh cup to take with him.

I wasn't a fan (thus the one star loss) that it was really cold in the restaurant. Our other Ruby Slipper location didn't have the same problem, so it seems that it was only an issue with this location - it was cold outside as well, so I don't really understand why the meat locker vibe.

All in all, probably not my first choice to go back, but if you don't mind the cold - definitely an A-Ok location to be sure.
name: Meg

text: This trendy restaurant has a lot of charm and the food is sublime! Try the crispy cobia collar. You won't regret it! Other standouts are the pork belly and the fried quail. The service is excellent!
name: Nichole

text: Love this place! Everything is good!  The quality is fantastic and consistent.  I try to get different things whenever I go.  This time we got the ribeye taco, lengua taco, chicken chipotle sope, vegetarian taco, vegetarian quesadilla.  The meat was plentiful, tender and delicious for the meat tacos. It comes out with a side of grilled onions which is nice.  Green sauce is mild spicy. Red sauce is medium spicy. The vegetarian quesadilla is only cheese inside, all the veggies are on the side.  Even when it's crowded, there's never a long wait.  Food prep time on average gets ready in about 5 minute or less.  Inside is small but comfortable.  There is limited seating, only 5 tables, but the turnover is relatively quick.  It's not a fancy place but doesn't need to be.  The food is why you need to come here. There's a reason why this place is #1 in tampa when you look up Mexican on yelp.
name: Tony

text:
Why 3 stars? Because the Pepito was solid... the arepa, not so much.

   ---   ---   ---

We live nearby and visited this lot before when there used to be a Thai food truck here. Fast-forward a year or so later and this has become somewhat of a full-on food truck park.

I opted for Lenos because it had the best reviews out of the trucks here. Plus, I love arepas.

Unfortunately, I just didn't love my arepa. At this point, I may just be spoiled from experiencing some of the best arepas in all of Tampa Bay, but this one was just a bit of a let-down. The meat looked and tasted like it was a cheaper cut than I'm used to seeing and it kind of threw the whole thing off.

But we also ordered a pepito and that was something I'd order again. It was the exact same kind of meat (steak) as the arepa, but I think the cheese, heavier bread and sauces masked it a bit. It was like a latin version of a philly cheesesteak.

Lastly, I ordered a mango juice, which was fine. If you're expecting a sugary drink, I'd lower those sweet expectations a tad. This is essentially the juice squeezed out of a mango and into your cup. That's it. I was fine with it, but just giving a warning to those who might be hoping for something with more sugar.

Lenos is close to my house and very fairly priced ($24 for those three things) but I can't say that I'll be rushing back. On occasion, when I'm craving something like a pepito, I will check them out again.
name: Brett

text: Fantastic food options that are interesting but the menu doesn't alienate picky eaters either, excellent beer list and also a great place for brunch.
name: David

text: BEST DONUTS EVER. Went here last weekend and got the Boston cream donut and the blueberry fritter donut. So delicious. Not too dense or too sweet. Cream filling in the Boston cream donut was the best I've ever had. Can't wait to go back!
name: Milan

text: Nothing was terrible, it just never really came together for me. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The music was louder than it needed to be. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. I left full, which at least counts for something. Food was fresh and service was quick. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text:
My mom has always wanted to try Pia's and tonight we happened to be nearby and decided to visit last minute. It's snowbird season so the restaurant was packed. So happy they could accommodate us at the last minute. 

We were seated quickly and at a very nice little table for two in "the wine room" against the wall - so cozy perfect for a date with my mama.

Started off our dinner with the Caprese salad and Italian bread. Not gonna lie, I was slightly surprised they charge for bread being an upscale Italian restaurant. No big deal though it was worth every penny. 

Mom ordered the pasta primavera with grilled chicken and I ordered chicken Milanese with arugula salad. So delicious though Mom wasn't overly impressed and described her pasta dish as bland. 

My only complaint is that they seemed very understaffed and the overall service somewhat weak. Thing is I feel guilty pointing this out because you could tell they were short staffed and maybe it was just an off night - I think I saw a party of like 20 heading toward an outdoor table.

It took nearly an hour to receive our bread and fresh mozz. Our waiter said they forgot to bring it out. A random server brought our dishes without offering up grated cheese or fresh pepper. Luckily we found our server who hooked us up once he was able to locate some. 

I'm sure we'll give them another chance once the season ends, do


Note:
Scored 10 percent off a glass of wine with our check in which was pretty cool.
name: Ally

text: Good music and great service from DJ. Came back twice in the same day cause there was a different band and good service.
name: Dave

text:
Without question, our favorite newer place visited on this trip to New Orleans. This wasn't just a successful meal. It was a slam dunk. It would seem impossible that it could have been better. Starting with the heavenly biscuits served with two types of butter to the Banana Zeppole dessert stuffed with Nutella waiting to be bathed in the warm caramel, each bite was flawless.

We started with the Conch Fritters that featured a tinge of heat with a creamy dipping Remoulade. The Cobia appetizer was combined with grapefruit and passionfruit to form a fiery crudo-type delight. Curried Goat is perfect when well made, but who would think of presenting it with sweet potato gnocchi? My companion fully enjoyed her Snapper. 

I have been trying to think of more adjectives to use to express our admiration for this place. Suffice to say, if you're reading this, go eat here! 'Nuf said! Oh, great server, too!!
name: Jeff

text: This is my FAVORITE pizza venue in Nashville. The food is always good. The ambiance is so 90s hip hop and R&B. Oh, and the cinnamon rolls are soooo good. I'm so happy they opened up on this side of town!
name: Ashley

text: Stopped in for the Saturday lunch and was not disappointed. The restaurant was so cozy, the staff was welcoming and the food was phenomenal. It came out at a great pace and I loved being able to choose three plates from any course so you really get the meal you want. Worth the price. The cream of garlic soup (a staple on the menu) was even better than I imagined it would be. 100% great lunch spot!

text: Great food and drinks... I like to get the gnocchi and chicken and waffles washed down with a fancy drink... followed by a 12 hour nap. It's a great reason to call off work, or spend a Sunday.

text: This place was amazing! I was referred by a friend otherwise I would've never heard about the place. I had to wait a little while for the food but it was well worth the wait! We had shrimp tacos and the supreme burrito. Like I mentioned, I was extremely surprised on how authentic and good the food was. I will definitely be back!

text:
I have been here three times now, each time the food is fresh and delicious. Food is prepared as you order. Service is pretty quick.
The portions are big enough to last for 2 meals. 
This is definitely a take-out place. I think there may be one table to eat at?

text: Be sure to go in with a sweet tooth as most all menu items are on the sweet side with a waffle component ... and be ready for some fantastic coffee! The cashier was very sweet and hospitable, but between dishes being piled up beyond reasonable amounts at the service station (and in clear view of customers), and tables not being wiped down ... text: Very consistent, creative, and has the wherewithal to not use soybean products  in absolutely everything.  That's an admirable trait for a restaurant.  I love the service, even when it's busy.  You know what you are going to get after stepping into the door of Southwest Diner.  You'll be greeted warmly, served by a loving staff, and taken care by some hardworking cooks/chefs.

text: Best wings in Indianapolis!  Big! Meaty! Tasty! And very fairly priced! Everything we've had has been very good... onion rings, shrimp tacos, and burgers... all very tasty and very decently priced. If you order the wings, be prepared for a wait but know that it's worth it!

text:
This was our first time here and we really enjoyed our evening. We sat outside and listened to music while enjoying wine and our dinner. Everyone was very friendly and accommodating to all
Of our simple requests. The atmosphere was nice yet relaxed. We ordered tuna tar tar which was dynamite! Tried their newest pizza and it was a success. Also shared the pork tenderloin with orzo. We really enjoyed it as well.

text:
What a GIANT disappointment. We walked 3/4 mile on a Friday night to try out this well rated establishment. 
There was no greeting, the sign said seat yourselves. We sat at a table in the bar. There were two other tables with customers and a few people seated along the bar. Waitress passed our table three different times and never once acknowledged us. Finally, the bartender came over with menus and set down a couple of waters and told us to let her know if we wanted anything else and walked off???? WTH??? Should we shout our drink order to you or wave you down? 
We waited ten minutes and finally gave up and left. Walked to Johnny Sanchez and the service was completely opposite. 
Sorry I can't tell you how the food was at this spot, but apparently they never wanted us to have the opportunity to try it. Bummer. Last night in NOLA, hoped to end here...but, nope. Hard pass.
name: Melanie

text: It looked better online than it did in person. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Food was fresh and service was quick. Not bad for a quick meal. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Food was good and came out fast.

text: Had a simple turkey wrap but it was very tasty.  I didn't specify a sauce but whichever one they ended up using was very good.
name: Paul

text: Let me preface this by saying that we have had excellent pizza from Luigi's in the past.  Closest thing to NY style in our area (delco co). But.....this was the worst single pizzeria experience I've had in my 45 years of life.  I had worked at 3 different pizzeria's in my teens and early 20's, so I know the business, both product(s) and service.  Let me be brief:  45 min after ordering my wings and lg pie well done, I show up.  Wings were on the oven, pizza not even made yet.  The employees looked at me like they hadn't a clue.  So I said fine, I'll wait, as I want the pie made right, and well done.  10 minutes go by (people coming and going and getting their food).  Finally I talk to another guy.  He looks into it, and tries to give me a pie with extra sauce.  The delivery driver whispers to him, that's my pie for delivery, he ignores as he's trying to get rid of me at this point.  I decline the wrong pie and wait.  Finally, the pie and hour+ old wings are put on my table (I'm sitting and waiting at), without a word.  I'm livid at this point.  The only thing that could be worse is if they gave me ranch dressing instead of BC with my wings (as he asked on the phone and I said "BC please, I hate ranch").  I get home, ranch. Let me say, I never write reviews, but this was so bad, real bad- I had to. There are things I've left out, that's how bad this was.  The poorest job of customer service I've ever experienced.  The owner will be hearing from me.  He should really understand what's happening at his business, on a busy Fri night.  I'm just disgusted.
name: Four

text: Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. It was crowded but still moved along. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Pretty happy with it overall. The service was off and the meal kinda followed that energy. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text: I love this Coffee Shop! I totally slept on this spot for almost a year. Really quaint, no frills spot with healthy vibes, great food and WiFi. Their ' Immunity Shake' is Everything! I'm addicted! The egg and avocado sandwich was light, fluffy and delicious! Most of all,they have GlutenFree menu items!   Five hearts from me! The 5th heart is for the excellent melodic music/ playlist.

text: My husband and I were super excited to officially have made it to the "barbecue country" part of our road trip when we arrived in St. Louis. We were impressed by the menu upon arriving at Dalie's (and also appreciated the nice, dog friendly patio area). We ordered a lot of food--sampling the brisket, ribs, pulled pork, burnt ends, fried pickles, sweet potato fries, Mac & cheese, coleslaw, and baked beans. Our favorites were the burnt ends, ribs, and sweet potato fries. The brisket was very thinly sliced which is not a style that I'm used to, and it was kind of dry. We enjoyed the meal but were not extremely impressed by it in comparison to other barbecue joints we've tried.
name: Michelle

text: Disappointing meal. Tasteless quiche of the day and salad drowned in dressing. Waitress didn't seem to care so I didn't bother to complain. She didn't blink when I told her she could take the salad after taking only a bite. For a place that serves $17 pasta dishes you would think they might care a little more.
name: Mandy

text: Came here for a break from the French Quarter on  a trip to NOLA and am glad I did!  The views were very nice and they offer a variety of relaxing seating options.  We arrived around 4 pm after a late brunch and caught a few cocktails and a warm breeze.  I had the frozen drink of the day which seemed like a concoction of something citrus with hints of pineapple maybe?  Nevertheless it was really good.  The waitress was friendly and very attentive, the crowd was mixed and they had a high turnover so we had the chance to do a lot of people watching.  On one side we saw a game of heads up and on the other side a group of girls celebrating a 21st birthday.  No one was rowdy but the vibe was definitely lively. My only regret was coming too full from brunch to try the birthday cake dessert!
name: Yesenia

text: Would probably stop in again if nearby. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Food was fresh and service was quick. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text:
Junk food heaven for anyone who loves a quick, delicious meal. My arteries are probably getting clogged as I finish my meal and write this review but you can't say no to junk food, can you? 

I ordered a chicken dog, some fries for the table and a coffee fair milkshake. I didn't really care much for the chicken dog. It was way too basic, probably more so because I expected a lot from my first visit to shake shack. The fries are crisp and the milkshakes are delicious. The shroom burger seems to be a crowd favorite. My friend ordered this and loved it. There's a lot to choose from - flat top dogs, burgers, shakes and frozen custard. They have a limited menu for your four legged friend as well. 

My body won't be too happy but I'll  definitely be back for more.
name: Ritesh

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. It was decent, just a little uneven. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: Went with family on a Sunday and it was louder than I expected. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Not a bad stop, just not one I'm rushing to repeat. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text:
Um....Yes, please! This place deserves more than 5 stars! I'd seen it on yelp many times but it had not need the chosen destination until this morning. Boy have I been missing out!

The place itself is small but has giant personality in every detail down to the handmade ceramic boxes they keep the tea bag selections in. Both my fiancé and I ordered an Avocado toast with an egg to go. Because when it comes to Avocado toast we aren't great at sharing. He also ordered a cold brew, a staple of his.

We took our boxes to the car and when we opened them it was like BOOM! So. Much. Food. We definitely could have shared one! When we travel it's hit or miss on how much you're getting for the cost. We paid 12.50 for each toast. I thought well that's about right to get a decent piece of avocado toast. There was nothing "decent" about this amazing smorgasbord of goodness!

They also use only compostable products, including their straws! As we were leaving I also noticed they had some non-alcoholic local brews in cans. We snagged a couple to take to a friend as she raved about how great they were. 

Now that we are both overstuffed and happy I have to tell you to GO HERE. I can't wait to go back to St. Louis to try all the other toasts!
name: Brandi

text: Probably one of the best happy hours in the city if you're venturing out by Logan Square and the Franklin Institute. It's one of the few places that has bone marrow on it's menu at a very affordable $6 happy hour price. Nothing quite as decadent as spreading rich bone marrow from a half-cut bone on some thick toasted bread. Have also gotten the parker rolls in the past which were good as well. The highlights of this place though are the incredible happy hour cocktail selections and the legit giant block of crystal clear ice behind the bar that they chip off ice from for their drinks. Extremely friendly service at the bar with deftly mixed drinks and elegant presentation. If I didn't live further away from this place I would be here all the time.
name: Jason

text: For a higher end restaurant, everything needs to be on-point from the food to the service. It was how they handled a very easy to resolve situation that really disappointed me. My girlfriend ordered the charbroiled oysters (6 count) and the first 3 were okay, the 4th had a small piece of shell in it, and the 5th was just full of shell pieces. She didn't even want to eat the last one. If you eat oysters, you know you only get shells when the oysters aren't shucked/washed properly - something that shouldn't happen at a restaurant like this. When we informed our waitress of the issue, she said all she could do is have more made. When I tried to explain to her that her solution wasn't really a good one since their shucking process is obviously flawed and there is a good chance the new batch would also have shells in them, she was quick to tell us that they can't take it off the bill because she ate most of them. The thing is, we NEVER ASKED for it to be taken off our bill, we just wanted to make them aware of the situation. I would think as a kind gesture they would offer to take half off the item since it was not up to par - or at the VERY LEAST apologize. That didn't happen. The manager, Andre, couldn't be bothered to even speak to us. It is obvious they don't care about the quality of the food they prepare. They honestly made us feel very uncomfortable. Unless they want to make things right, we won't be back.
name: Adam

text: Probably the worst food I have had ever! We wanted to the go to the Thai place right across and it was closed for lunch. Someone on the street recommended mcsheas and it was a bad decision. Worst burger ever, bad service ..I mean I was there with a friend who was nice enough to still pay for the crappy food. I wanted to leave after the 1st bite. I am not a stickler for food but this is as low as it gets. Save your money
name: Foodie

text: I come here for the dosa and the vegetarian thali (lunch combo), both of which are satisfying and and taste like my family's home cooking. Not shabby at $9 apiece, and the thali is a massive amount of food. (Soo...many...delicious...carbs.) Staff isn't friendly but I ain't here to make friends, I'm hear to get my dalbhat (lentils+rice) jones taken care of. I'm personally not a huge fan of the desserts here, and the "standard" Indian curries (tikka masala, etc.) will taste different from what you may be accustomed to. And friendly staff? Nah. But you can get a quick, yummy lunch that costs half as much as some of the local buffets and is probably healthier too. (Note: I've found the restaurant to be fairly clean. Bathroom door is kinda gross but the bathroom itself gets it done.)
name: Akash

text: Stopped by after work because I was nearby and hungry. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. You can tell they care about customer experience here. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Would return. For the price I expected more than this. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text: I am never disappointed when I go here, honestly everything is so good. Sometimes they're a little busy but it's worth the wait in my opinion.
name: Jessica

text: If prison served Mexican food, this is what it would taste like. The food was so gross, my tacos came with avocado and you could tell the cooks placed the avocado face down on purpose because when I flipped it over it was all brown and looks like it had been sitting out forever. So gross I wouldn't recommend at all lol.
name: Victoria

text: Does it get any better? Amazing place that has a new twist of fun every time I visit. Beer menu was expansive, food was cooked perfectly and servers were on top of it. Never had a bad experience. Will visit every time im in town.
name: Gregg

text: Yum! Yum! Yum! I have thoroughly enjoyed my visits to this lovely bakery. The cakes are light and moist and not overly sweet. If you get there early enough, you can buy a slice of 5 or 6 flavors like doberge, lemon chantilly, butter pecan, coconutor chocolate strawberry chantilly. I haven't tried all of them but so far lemon is my favorite. The croissants are buttery and flakey and the coffee is good. Next time I will have to try the savory options.
name: Shawne

text: Wow! I thought this place was gonna be a gimmick. Best gluten free bread ever. The pickle was crisp and flavorful. Everything was home made from a scratch. What a difference. I ate my egg-avocado sandwich and wanted at least 2 more. So tasty. Great kids menu too! Friendly owner. Treat yourself!
name: Dana

text: Visited New Orleans for a company trip on 4-11 and we were all so excited to try this place on the first night we arrived. First off the seating was horrible. You're all so squished, if I need to get up to go to the restroom 2 people had to stand up to let me through, super uncomfortable. The balsamic blue cheese salad was very good. The bread and butter was super bland. The crab and corn bisque was delish, I've never had anything like it. Probably the only reason I gave this place 2 stars! THEN we see a giant cockroach on the wall climbing up behind my boyfriend next to me, I am terrified of bugs but tried not to make a scene since it wasn't bothering us! THEN it jumped down on my boyfriends shoulder while he was eating, right next to me! It was disgusting! I jumped up screaming (couldn't help it) we obviously were done eating. And the waiter just said oh a roach, the bartender lady said at least it wasn't flying! They weren't surprised and we all were. I could just imagine what the kitchen looks like! I have ate in many places and have not ever seen a cockroach in the restaurant, not even when I eat at a flea market lol! We figured the waiter or someone would've offered some kind of discount for this horrible inconvenience at least to the person it fell on. But no instead they gave us a slice of tiramisu for the 8 people we had!
name: Jasmine

text: Stop in here for a couple of drinks with my friends. Ambience was nice and loved the decor inside and out. The outside has a beautiful garden like atmosphere. Unfortunately, I was unable to try anything off the menu. However, my sangria was delightful.
name: Jena
