text:
Special occasions need a special place to celebrate.  I didn't want to go to any of the usual places that I go for dinner and so I turned to yelp to find a place that seemed very highly rated with food that I was interested in yet I hadn't tried.  I can't believe I've never heard of Byrsa Bistro before because I drive past it every night on the way home from work.  It's in an old house type building next to a historic train station in a sparse residential area off the beaten path, so unless you are looking for it, I feel like its very easy to miss LIKE I HAD EVERY NIGHT. 

We figured we would stop by, see if they could take a table of two and if they couldn't then we would go someplace else.   Fortunately, they were able to seat us in the downstairs store area at the high top table.  This place is so cool because the area we were dining in was a store that catered to outdoor clothing.  It was very much like dining in a LL Bean but it completely works as the atmosphere, its pretty amazing.   

It appears that they change the menu throughout the year, so you may not see some of the items if you go in a few weeks, and everything is perfectly seasonal.   We got the Mediterranean sampler to start, which was delicious, we both got the lobster ravioli with my dining partner getting the butternut squash soup which was DELICIOUS.  I got the beet and almond salad which was very tasty.  The only thing I wasn't crazy about was the espresso creme brulee that I ordered for dessert, but that just means it wasn't for me and I'm sure someone else would love it.   

The staff was extremely nice and the owner came around and greeted everyone, including us, as if we were old friends which was so expected and kind.  Great service, great food and all around great experience.  I look forward to going back!
name: Lisa

text:
Cute spot for happy hour on magazine street! I visited with a friend for happy hour on a weekday afternoon and we sat at the bar. The happy hour deal is $5 glasses of wine and $5 small bites. My friend and I also decided to order the beignet bites and the garlic and herb bites. For those of you who don't know (and we didn't) garlic and herb bites are the savory version of beignet bites... fried balls of dough with garlic and herb on top. Since each order is $5 for happy hour both orders of beignet bites were HUGE! We were only able to eat about 1 serving before we were completely stuffed. The garlic and herb bites were definitely the crowd favorite, as we finished almost all of those and barely any of the beignet bites, but that is probably just a personal preference for what you want at 5:00 with some wine. 

The atmosphere is cute, the waitress was friendly, and the wine and snacks are affordable during happy hour - all wins in my book! My only problem is that the happy hour menu only has 3 options for food (beignet bites, garlic and herb bites, and fries) so there isn't much variety.

I can tell you that I have enjoyed WAY too many tiki drinks across the country.  Many better than others.  Latitude 29 is in the top 1%.  If you enjoy wonderful tropical drinks in an environment that takes you away from your normal, mundane life...this is the place.  Great decor, great drinks, spectacular staff (hostess and bartender).  

This place is the REAL DEAL.  Get there today...or the next time you are in NOLA.  You will not regret a minute of your time drinking or eating here.  The food was even better than the drinks...you have NO excuse but to come here.  Forget about the usual NOLA garbage.  Get your drink on here!!! text:
Wow! Another culinary excursion somewhere under the rainbow (if you saw my check in photo taken just outside the entrance to Zoe's Kitchen). 

Have passed by this place many many times after shopping at a nearby hardware store. Never had the inclination to drop in until today.

Stepping inside,  I was pleased with the number of food options, but especially pleased that the estimated calorie count was posted. I realize that not everyone counts calories, but I track virtually all of my nutrition every day for health reasons. Zoe's posting was a big help.

I asked about the California bowl, wanting to limit carbs today, and was happy to hear that the "rice" was actually riced cauliflower. Not only was I please to hear that... I was more than pleased to eat it! A very healthy helping of wonderfully spiced riced cauliflower with feta cheese, dill,  taziki, & green harissa All topped off with a moist and nicely grilled and seasoned chicken breast.

My wife had a lamb kebab that was more than filling for her. The lamb also was spice nicely and cooked to the right doneness for both us - slightly under medium. Another winner-winner lamb's for dinner. 

I don't know if it's corporate policy or local but one more perk for this location was that I was offered a veterans' discount plus was thanked for my service to our country. 

It's been my honor!

5 Nov 2018 ***

text:
I have been here a few times and I really like this place. I had the beef and salmon at a recent party and it was really, really good. The bar area is beautiful and recently remodeled but the other dining areas are a bit dated.
I also had the Sunday brunch last week and it was a mixed review. There were some really great choices and some others that were just ok. I loved the omelette station, it was so nice to choose your own fillings and place them in a cup to give to the chef. I don't think I have seen this concept before ( if I have it's been a long time) but I really liked it. They had smoked salmon and it was really top quality and delicious. They also had salmon which was really great ( as usual ) but the shrimp were just alright, not cooked properly as the shells were tough to peel. They were still good but I have had much better. Their wasn't enough space and I couldn't even reach the salads , I think there was Caesar and two other choices.
The eggs Benedict weren't very good , mushy muffins and the bernaise sauce was just ok. 
The star of the show was the prime rib which was not as good as it looked. It was pretty tough but tasty. 
I did have some stomach issues later in the day from the buffet so I probably won't be going back for the Sunday Brunch but look forward to visiting again for lunch or dinner.
name: Mike

text:
My wife and I took my sister and her two children last night.  My wife and I have been to many Korean BBQ's restaurants in Guam, Hawaii, Korea, New York etc. Unfkrtunately, I believe this created a bias when we arrived.
My sister and her children are somewhat picky eaters, but they enjoyed the experienced or at least she was being polite.  
Upon ordering the waitress departed to the back.  The "Sister" returned to take our order again and immediately rolled her eyes at me then looked to my wife.  My wife is Thai, maybe she hoped my wife spoke Korean. My wife couldn't help her.  From then on it was confusion.  
I realized that a special party was being setup behind us and we were not their focus. The bus boy helped out with drinks and extra rice.  The original waitress help us out with dessert.  
The food was brought out and I realized that this restaurant only has one dipping sauce, but their sides were great.  The marinated chicken and beef bulgogi were good.  The pork did not have any flavor.  The kalbi was definately not short ribs , the bus boy seemed confused when I asked for confirmation.  I realized at this point any more questions would only cause either more confusion or would just seen disrespectful.  I was not about to he disrespectful like the "Sister" who rolled her eyes at me.
We received the bill and our bill fold with credit card remained for 20 minutes before I just went to the front to pay.  The bus boy took the bill food, then 3 more staff members including the "Sister" asked if I needed help.  The bus boy returned with my receipt and credit card, but I had no where to sign the receipt.  I still left a tip, since congress supports waitresses and waiters having lower minimum wage if they receive tips.  However, I simply just wasn't satisfied.  My wife immediately let the local Thai community in the Indianapolis know our experience and I definitely let all my family and friends know in the area.  
Everyone who really likes this place either has no way to compare to other Korean BBQ restaurants or I just went in on a bad night or time.  Saturday at 5:00pm.  Regardless, you lost my service and our family and friends.
name: Andrew

text: This place never disappoints. I had an Asian chicken salad. It was delicious! Our waitress was very good & knowledgeable. She gave us a few suggestions. We took home a slice of carrot cake cheesecake. It was unbelievably yummy! If you're in the vicinity you have to check it out.

text:
I like to eat here with friends. Food is amazing but small portions. Lobster bisque is worth mentioning.  Reviewing now as I decided to do takeout. Received less than half a portion for the lobster bisque. I wrote to restaurant to let them know I was disappointed. They assured me that 8oz was "the standard pour". This was 4-5 oz MAYBE. 
I want to express that the food and service are good but felt slightly dismissed and disappointed by the take out soup.

text: I love joeys. Great food and pizza! Can't go wrong with a pie or la Nona. As for pastas.. my fav is Chicken Adrianna. Once you take a bite you just can't stop.

text:
Stopped in for lunch on a hot sticky Sunday and was pleasantly surprised !  The building is simply breathtaking ! Outfitted in dark wood paneling from floor to ceiling , beautifully decorated and nice size dining and bar area that opens to the street with outdoor seating available as well.

text:

I'm glad I asked for it to be toasted otherwise it would have been a raw bagel.  Barely cooked and terrible texture.   Calling it an everything bagel would be a stretch by far.  It barely had anything on the outside.  Maybe everything fell off before I got it.   Also it's a microwaved egg which never complements a breakfast sandwich. You know the texture I'm talking about. text:
Adele's had a lot of hype, so our expectations were probably too high. It was on every food bloggers list, Airbnb's restaurant recommendations, and in our Airbnb hosts book of suggestions.

The cauliflower salad was awesome and unique. The Brussels sprouts were phenomenal. The best I've ever had. The potatoes were absolutely nothing special, even a little overly cooked/too crispy. The chicken was tender and yummy, but nothing I haven't tasted before. 

There's so much better in Nashville. I think the name and buzz attracts people but I'd bet most don't go back for  second visit.

text:
Yelping No. 2000!!!

Rare Ethnic Food # 50. Russian and Ukrainian cuisine. 

This little restaurant just opens no long ago. I already like it very much. It is one of the kind in Tampa Bay Area. You have to experience it for it wonderful cuisine. The restaurant locates near USF which make sense for many Russian students study there. The day we have visited, not many customers. It need great word of mouth to spread a good news. 

The menu is simple and delicious. The display in the restaurant is nice with Russian doll. They have the bakery good next to the counter. The only thing I would complain is the chair is too tight. 

What is meaning of "Babushka". It mean triangular folded kerchief for head or it also mean grandmother. Many Russian doll has kerchief over it is part of long tradition. It also can mean your grandma kitchen. Take your pick. 

Our first dish we have order is the Borscht. This is a famous soup with meat, sautéed veggies and beet root. The beet make the entire soup red color. The soup is great during winter. It top with the rosemary. The second dish is Blinchiki. This is a tradition wheat crepe wrap the meat inside. Very unique in many way. 

Our third dish is the Russian dumplings. They have three different fillings inside the dumplings. The Lamb, Beef and Pork. We mixed the pork and beef with the soup base. I like the most is the pork. I would suggest order with soup options. The fourth dish is the Syrniki. This is a pancake made from cheese and wrap with meat options. I like this one too. 

Our fifth and final dish is the Kotlety. It is three minced meat croquettes with a side. We have chose Russian brown rice

Overall our experience have exceed our expectations. It was marvelous meal we have at the dinner. It deserves a 5 stars attention. I would said you may need to change your taste bud when you come to this place. Many items is less sodium. But the taste still there. Russian like to use the sour cream. But I don't.
name: Boon

text: I've been here twice, and been pretty happy both times. Once for brunch and once for dinner. I absolutely loved my dinner, including the appetizer, but liked my breakfast a little less. Great bloody Mary's, though!

text:

Oh and the bread was warm and was served with a yummy oil to dip. 

I would definitely come back when I am in town again.

text: Been here about five times since it opened. Always good service and good Blizzards! The drive thru always goes quick. Thanks!
name: Olivia

text: This place make Legit sandwiches. Looks like a house that was turned into a bar but there's a restaurant upstairs. Apparently the frozen coffee is to die for but I'm not a coffee guy even if it did have booze in it. Definitely worth a visit if you want some killer sandwiches. Heads up parking sucks street parking only, but it's free.
name: Casey

text: I'm a fan! I'm glad this place took over for a chain, and enjoy the food. Wish the wait wasn't so intense, but NoWait can be your savior for this. I love the avocado toast. It's one of the best I've had! the sprinkle of feta makes it even better. Also love places with fresh squeezed orange juice. I will be back but hope that the wait on weekends dies down sometime soon.
name: Sarah

text: We loved the fired chicken here. It came two side dishes of mashed potato, green veggies plus 3 pieces of deviled eggs, some pickles and 2 pieces biscuits with a half order chicken. The chicken skin was so crispy outside, the meat was so juicy and tender, LOVE IT! The mashed potatoes was so good and I finished it although I am not a fan for mashed potatoes.
name: Meichelle

text:
Cat yoga is an excellent way to spend a Sunday morning! The class was relaxing and light-hearted, with adorable kitties doing their kitty things all aliens the room. Our instructor was great and guided us through a nice hour-long practice with a few catlike poses :)
Afterwards we were allowed to play with the cats for about 30 minutes.
name: S.

text: Small but excellent restaurant right in the heart of Main Street in Speedway! Melt in your mouth catfish, excellent appetizer specials for late night dining, decent bourbon selection and a good rotation of local and regional craft beer. Great pulled pork and pulled chicken! Not a bad thing on the menu!
name: Sable

text: I reviewed the west side location back in 2012 and completely forgot to review the one that opened near me a few years back! I had been going to the 10th street location for at least 4 years and was thrilled when they opened one just 10 minutes away from my house. This location is smaller than the west side one and is located in a strip mall rather than a stand-alone building. As such, there is little room to wait if you arrive during rush hour. I've only ever ordered off the all-you-can-eat sushi menu, so for me, food quality and service is the same as the OG location, and I am still loving the fresh sushi, sashimi, and all other appetizers that come out of the kitchen! The only difference I've spotted in terms of the menu (besides 1 or 2 specialty rolls) is that this location doesn't serve chicken tempura - I prefer the shrimp tempura, but this is something my husband and his family sigh about whenever we eat at this location. I still highly recommend this place to everyone looking for fresh sushi in Indianapolis at a great price if you have hungry appetites!
name: Megan

text: Very long wait, 40 min after initially being told 20. Pizzas look something worse than you get in the freezer, and freezer pizza tasted better!! EXTREMELY overprised, 27 bucks for 1 pizza???  All it was, was a pepperoni!!!   Location offers no parking, had to park in a muddy dirt lot across the street.  Never again!!
name: K.

text:
We are so excited to have discovered this new local gem! We first attempted to go on a Friday but seeing the crowd waiting outside, we knew our appetites couldn't wait that long. So we tried again Saturday afternoon for lunch. It was perfect! 

We ordered the Fried Green Tomatoes for an appetizer and they were deliciously dressed and tender. My husband ordered the Wicked Chowda and loved it. It was very hearty with the gnocchi and jalapeno bread that came with it. I ordered the Chicken Cordon Who and it was dreamy. The Pork Belly on top of the chicken was a great twist on the traditional. I opted for the Mac and Cheese as my side and it was well worth the upcharge. 

Matching the delicious food was the super attentive and friendly staff. Our waitress gave us lots of great insight about items on the menu and kept our drinks filled. The GM even came to our table not once, but twice! The first time was to welcome us to the restaurant because she heard we hadn't dined there before and the second was to check on how we enjoyed our food. She then gave us a card for a free appetizer on our next visit. 

Everything about the experience (including the decor) was awesome and we cannot wait to go back! If you're looking for a casual, friendly environment with great decor and creative dishes that isn't a chain, this place is for you!
name: Sara

text: This is my Favorite fast food restaurant. I'm a frequent visitor when on the run. I love that they use real chicken breast for all menu items.
name: Dana

text:
This place was pretty awesome. Great great customer service.

Fried oysters were cooked perfectly, Beautiful, haha. Oyster soup was nice, wish it was a little thicker though.

BBQ shrimp was great, their recipe is different. Heavy garlic. They don't serve the shrimp with head on though, can't suck that sweet head juice out, hehe.

The bread is really damn good here, like a light and fluffy Italian loaf. I could eat loafs of eat, it's dangerous.

Will come back to try other dishes when I visit again NO again.
name: Joseph

text: This is the amazing pizza place and great for eating then watching a movie. We added a lot of toppings and it was perfect surprisingly.
name: Dillon

text: Amazing baked oyster!  Bbq shrimp and grits I highly suggest. Also try the Po Boy Shrimp sandwich. I gotta say that I really enjoyed the wait staff as well,  I asked for suggestions on the menu and he nailed it! The waiters name is Mark!  He was training a new waiter.  The new guy will definitely learn a lot from him
name: Ragina

text: This was my first time at Colton's. They were pretty busy. The food was good, not better than Texas Roadhouse, but that's understandable. The service was okay -- kind of slow but like i said they were busy. You don't get your rolls until you get your salad. We were also suppose to get peanuts, but my father had to get up and get them himself. We also ordered the onion blossom as an appetizer. We were sharing it between 5 people and didn't get any plates. To top it off, as we were eating the rolls, we found a hair in the butter. All in all -- I would probably come back, but the first impression was not that great.
name: Ryleigh

text:
Good vibes, good drinks, good people, good prices. 

Drinks are not too sweet. None of that sugary shit. Attracts a diverse crowd. We love it.
name: Sarah Beth

text: For starters, the service is impeccable, which, in my opinion, is unheard of for a new restaurant. Everyone was extremely kind and helpful. Whenever we needed something, we were helped immediately. Whenever a plate was finished or a napkin dirtied,someone would come assist us immediately. With that said, you still don't feel rushed. The food is spectacular. They have a large menu that even the pickiest of eaters can probably find something. Between my husband and I, we've had the brisket nachos, Southwest ranch rolls, el borracho burger, statler chicken plate, fried pickles, and Circle 7 Ranch wrap and all were delicious. Overall, if you're looking for a great place to eat, look no further. I will be definitely return.
name: Alexa

text:
I didn't realize my rolls were gonna be wrapped with cucumber. It was the naruto roll I believe. Very cucumbery taste. It's ok though because everything else was really good.

BYOB?? No problem. Brought my bottle of H E N N E S S Y and they provided us with Japanese style shot cups. Bill came out to less than $50 between me and the person I was with so that's always a win. Service was extraordinary and greatly appreciated.

Most people already know if you're familiar with the area, parking can be a pain. For the Saturday night I came I got lucky and found a spot within a block but something tells me everyone won't always be this lucky.
name: Nate

text: Omg the food here is so good. I've been filling in at the Haddonfield office and ordering lunch here. The first time I ordered I got a BLT panini with fries and it was absolutely delicious. Everything was fresh from top to bottom. It was a lunch special so it was fairly priced and it arrived very quickly. The second time I ordered I got the onion rings and cheese, mushroom and sauce turnover. The onion rings were extremely crispy and the turnover was HUGE. This past Friday I ordered the chicken caprese salad. This is my new favorite salad. I added an egg which made it that much better. Every ingredient down to the lettuce was fresh. Today I ordered the rodeo burger. It was cooked to perfection. If you are looking for a place to try I highly recommend this establishment.
name: Cynthia

text: It looked better online than it did in person. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Just not for me. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. For the price I expected more than this.
name: User

text: Will do in a pinch. All dishes could be bumped up but they seem more interested in being fast than flavorful. Not sure why it's just General's Chicken or Crab Cheese Puff... Would go again.
name: Saro

text: Probably the best brunch that I've had in Philly. Everything from the service to the quality of food was outstanding. The breakfast stack was the perfect balance of savory to sweet, and their pancakes are fluffy and filled with delicious ricotta. Outdoor seating is available. Will be back for another brunch or dinner service.
name: Abraham

text: Was ok. Service was not that good. Ordered a coffee that never came. It was on my bill and I had to ask to get it taken off. Beans are gross. Potato salad was food. Chicken and dumplings had very little chicken in it. There are better places to eat.
name: Sarah

text: Great food and atmosphere.  Our sever was awesome.  Although she had several tables, we felt like she was our own personal waitress.  When I and another of our party asked for substitution she was so gracious. She didn't know if the kitchen could provide what we asked but she would advocate.  We were able to obtain the substitute with an issue.  Great experience.
name: Constance

text: Was supposed to be the best of some bbq category, but as a first time, this will also be the only time. Pulled pork had no flavor. Brussel sprouts over cooked. Staff rude.
name: Teri

text:
OK, I moved to Tennessee eight years ago and I lived in Huntington Beach.  That town is close to a town named Garden Grove.  Within Garden Grove is a large Vietnamese community and it is called Little Saigon.  It is packed with many, many Vietnamese restaurants and we frequented many of them.  Little Saigon, its restaurants and Vietnamese markets are the only things I miss about California.
I have tried various Vietnamese restaurants here in the Nashville area and had only one favorite.  That changed yesterday when a friend and I visited VN Pho & Deli for the first time.  
As soon as we walked in we were greeted by a friendly server and shown to a nice, clean table.  The menu is quite extensive and offered a lot of variety from Pho, rice dishes, noodle dishes, spring rolls, and even Vietnamese sandwiches (Banh Mi......yum).  
We were in the mood for Pho so both of us ordered some.  I ordered the shrimp Pho and my buddy ordered beef Pho.  I also ordered spring rolls (one shrimp and one pork).  Throughout the menu process our server was super friendly, attentive to our needs and efficient.
Our food arrived shortly thereafter and we were pleasantly surprised.  The Pho looked amazing, smelled great and tasted fantastic.  Plenty of flavor enhanced by fresh herbs and onion.  I was blown away.  It was better than ANY other Pho I have ever had the pleasure of tasting, including any Little Saigon bistro.  VN knocked it out of the park!  The spring rolls were delicious also and the accompanying sauce was yummy.  I could not wait to get home and shout Eureka!  My wife was totally excited when I told her about VN and I am looking forward to taking her there.  I know she will love it too.  
If it's really flavorful Vietnamese food you seek, you need to go to this little spot.  The food, the service, everything is top grade.
name: Rick

text: Had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Food was good and came out fast. It looked better online than it did in person. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced.
name: User

text: We just had a great meal at the Malvern Chipotle. The portions were plentiful, the food tasty with just the right amount of spice, and the employees friendly. Great work, Malvern Chipotle! We will be back!
name: Lisa

text: Great spot .. Hoagies are great but their burgers are the Best .. Owner is a nice guy .. If they have the ingredients they will make you anything you want .. They also have huge breakfast sandwiches ..
name: John

text: Quick and friendly service. Location has a cafe and bar vibe. I ordered the avocado egg wrap and chai tea which were delicious.
name: Claribel

text: The chile rellenos are light,  and full of flavor,  tomales are traditional,  and full of filling. The fish tacos were light,  no batter,  and delicious. Big portions,  much better than Cafe Rio. More choices,  better food,  and Daniel gives toy personal service that you never get at Cafe Rio. You will not regret choosing this place
name: Bill

text: Stopped in for a quick bite,  was gooooooood! Had chicken tikka masala (medium) and my tongue's still burning. Good size portion,  plus naan and a drink. Very clean,  very attentive. Definitely go again.
name: Angie

text: I'm on a mission to try all the different shots they have here. It's going to take a while, but I'm willing to come back as many times as needed. They have deals on beer and well mixed drinks as well if you're not into trying crazy shots. I've been on a Wednesday night for tricycle races, and since it was summer there wasn't much competition. Its free to enter, and at the very least you get one free beer during the race. My group ended up having the first and second place girls and the third place guy. We pooled the winning tokens and got a round of free drinks for everyone.
name: Grace

text: I think Maxine is one of the best chicken places in Indianapolis. Even if it is connected with a gas station.
name: Kellie

text: Watermelon sangria wasn't that great! And very small amount for $9. But of corse the nachos and wings were absolutely awesome
name: T

text: The food here is really good and the waitress was able to give me a great recommendation on beer. The hot chicken on the Mac and cheese was awesome. Would of enjoyed a little more sauce since it was a bit dry.
name: Alex

text: The food came out fast, which was good because we were starving. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. The music was louder than it needed to be. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text: I love this place! Everything from the welcoming service to the best oysters around is great! I took my friend here after she flew in from CA. She loved it. I will take all my friends from out of state here when they come to New Orleans for the first time! Thanks for making a good impression with good service and great food!
name: Heidi

text: This is a really great neighborhood place, with some class and a great playlist. The bar and bar areas is very comfortable, usually not packed to where you have to stand or wait for a drink, and you get a real drink not a partial drink in a little half glass like across the street. You can relax and have a nice cocktail and food right in the bar area. The brick walls and open windows in warm weather make it feel a little like being on vacation right in your own backyard. Great drinks and a nice selection of wines by glass, not over the top, and great to have it just a few short blocks away. Sitting outside tonight was particularly pleasant. The burgers are really good here, on a nice brioche bun, and I am pretty picky on burgers. Came out for one tonight because I liked it so much the last time. Pierogies are great too.
name: Lori

text:
I do not understand why this place got such a high rating.  Unfortunately, it was very disappointing to me.   

The food is extremely salty, basically inedible. I could not eat any of the 8 dishes we ordered.

But the service was good, and the food quality was good although I could not eat it due to the extreme salt.

If you like extremely salty food, this can be a good place for you.
name: Eatty

text:
Oh yeah, I can definitely see why there's such a big hype about this place. Food was DELICIOUS. A little pricier than I would like. Almost anywhere in Nashville you'll find an amazing and buttery biscuit. However my little hipster/foodie- slash whatever pretentious buzzword one wants to use, heart wanted to this place that had rave reviews of its food. 

It met expectation! Food was super tasty! The biscuit was soft, fluffy, slightly crisp and FRESH. We got the chicken biscuit and wow, was that a tender piece of chicken. We had the blueberry bonuts(?) as a starter to split. I've a diehard fan of BoBiscuits from Bojangles. This put them to shame. I'm gonna be dreaming about that creamy filling. Really great food, and I mean it! 

Wait time was like thirty minutes on a Tuesday afternoon. The staff were super sweet and you can tell they were trying to herd us along politely but efficiently. Again, the place is a little crowded but in terms of food, you're gonna eat good!
name: Mic

text: This place was louder than I expected and that sort of shaped the whole meal. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Maybe better dine-in than delivery, hard to tell. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text:
Went for lunch on a Thursday and Ashely took care of us she was really great and food came out fast and perfect! She is also the reason for the five stars!
But when we left and we where jumping in the car (we where parked out front) an employee was gonna park next to us and I was putting in my daughter in the car so the car door was open and I see her cursing and making faces towards us as we are being a pain in the butt to her! First at all an employee should never park up front!
name: Regina

text:
This is my second time visiting this buffet. The dinner price for the buffet will cost around $17 and that's with drinking water. I went around 8pm. One of the perks to going to their dinner buffet is the fact that they have crab legs on their menu. That's specifically what I went for. 

However, every time I visited the steam table their were barely any left....I guess I have to move quicker. That was the same for the other half empty dishes on their steam tables. I can also say that they didn't have a huge variety of food other buffets similar to this one. 

The customer service wasn't the best. When I requested to have a water with lemon. I was brought back a water with lime. When I questioned my waitress if they had lemons she said "no,only lime". I would have been fine without the lime. Slightly, aggressive with removing our plates. She would somewhat stalk our table and if she thought we were finished eating she would automatically go reaching for our plates... 

Overall, the food was decent however I don't think that it was worth the price.
name: Alesha

text:
Food is always very good but our server, Nico was absolutely terrible. Was too interested in his friends at the bar, and was too troubled to simply split a check stating, "I don't know what you had to eat". We left an appropriate tip for the poor service... it's just that, a tip. Nico then pops his head out from the second story balcony and yells at us on State Street in a very unprofessional and sarcastic tone, "thanks a lot, I will remember you guys", threatening us! Such a shame, this place has great views/location, really good food but Nico was a terrible. Because of him I will not be returning. Unless you want to be threatened by a server, I recommend you don't go either. 

*update*

The manager contacted me and completely apologize and offered a gift certificate. Very thoughtful. I was informed the problem server we had is no longer working there. I'll be back, The food is just too good.
name: E.

text: No big complaints, just a nice meal. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. For the price I expected more than this. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: AMAZING does not even begin to describe the meal I had while here.  The biscuits are out of this world, the food is all homemade and the service was exceptional!  I would give this cafe 100 stars if I could.  Thankfully, I live states away or I would be in trouble  FYI you might have a long wait to get in but let me just say it's well worth it!  They have little stores you can visit and shop while you wait to make the time go by.  I'm wanting some biscuits now as I'm writing this....lol.  Enjoy everyone, you won't be disappointed I promise.
name: Krista

text: They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Will be back. No big complaints, just a nice meal. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text: Love the outside patio! Such an adorable setting.  Servers were great, but I waited 30+ minutes for two eggs, fruit and bacon.  Willing to go back but it was insane how long it took for two people. For that I give a thumbs down.
name: Ashey

text: Honestly I think I ordered the wrong thing. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text: The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Will be back. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text: I wanted to like this more than I actually did. Anyway, it looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Idk, my pasta was decent and not overcooked, which i appreciated because that happens a lot. Also, i got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. not sure I'd order the same thing again.
name: User

text:
My first time in the Big Easy. I stopped for a quick lunch and the waiter was very friendly and helpful. Now normality I eat oysters on the half shell raw. But he convinced me that their specialty is roasted oysters. You can actually watch them shuck and roast them with a big flame. I tried half a dozen and boy they are good !!
You can taste the Smokey flavor of in the oyster and of course the butter and cheese can be sopped up with a nice bread that comes with it.
name: Donald

text: I ate at this location about 2months ago in October to be exact and this place is a dump! Dirty plates, dirty cups and silverware. I was so shocked. I remember when this red lobster was the place to go for some nice seafood and caesar salad and the infamous cheddar biscuits. The food was good no one got sick thank goodness. I won't be going back because of the appearance of the place. They need a good deep clean.
name: Brianna

text:
This place has brunch perfected. They literally do brunch all day. The place is small but so nicely decorated. It has a cool mediterranean feel. There is also outdoor seating when it's nice out. The menu has Lebanese and French spins on classic brunch favorites. The coffee and espresso are excellent. The service also cannot be better. 

I came here with my fiancé and sister this Sunday. The place was packed. A very nice man, who appeared to be the owner, told us the wait was 40 minutes, but we were seated in 30, which was a pleasant surprise. We were seated outside, and the service could not have been more awesome. Our server was nice, attentive, personable and very knowledgeable about the menu. I ordered a latte with a double espresso. It was literally the best latte I've had in Philly. For an appetizer, we ordered the grilled cheese sandwich. It was out of this world. The baguette was fresh and amazing, and the halloum cheese made the sandwich divine. For my entree I got the brunch style Cordon Bleu. Our food came out in a flash, and it was so tasty. The flavors were complex in the best way possible. Everyone really enjoyed their meals. I could describe each dish but the photos speak for themselves. You have to come here to experience Philly brunch at its best.
name: Gus

text: I've been going to this Buffalo Wild Wings for years now and it never fails to impress me. The staff are very quick, kind & overall helpful. It was a short notice dinner since it was Valentine's day and every other place was packed but it was definitely worth it and I highly recommend the loaded tots
name: Aileen

text: Get a baby changing table... great food! Pizza is the best on the strip. Better than the rest!
name: Jordan

text: For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Pretty happy with it overall.
name: User

text: What a shame. This is the second chain I have gone to. One in CA. And here ID and both do not honor senior citizens and the one in ID does not have sprouts. I guess I won't be going to these chain any More.
name: L

text: The food here is very good and the customer service is great. I had the Pad Thai with combination shrimp, calamari and cod and it was absolutely delicious. The portion size was too big for me however I was offered a take away for the remainder, which made another lovely meal. I highly recommend Senae Thai Bistro
name: Francesca

text:
Daytime hotspot for a seamless sandwich experience. Adriana, herself, takes each order to the kitchen for preparation. Expect a decent wait time, with people often spilling out into the street.

Ben's Special - add Giardiniera Peppers - well worth the wait in line. Sesame seed bread soft, but texturized. Great pushback. All the sandwiches seem to possess a uniformity, staying in place. Just when you think it's tasting sort of dry, the next bite towards the middle quenches perfectly.

***Friendly neighborhood lunch game. Hours of operation are slim, so get there while the doors open! This place has been here many years, for good reason***
name: Andy

text: I've been eating at this specific location for years, usually Order on their drive thru. The staff is always nice and the orders are always right. I am a big fan of their Eegee's, specially the strawberry and piña colada(mixed) but just recently discovered a new favorite mix Watermelon and lemon, im sold.
name: Ana

text: Wow this place is amazing. I was warned that the menu offered multiple things that I would be interested in, which was very true. Our waitress was absolutely phenomenal and checked on us several times. We sat on the partially covered patio, which I definitely recommend. I ordered the Veggie Wrap and we also had the pretzels with beer cheese. The fact that just about everything on the menu is $5.99 is just something you cannot beat. I loved this place, the friendly and quick (not to mention cute) service was incredible. I'm lucky I don't live close by because I'd probably go every single day.
name: Dan

text: Sake Cafe has the best sushi I have ever eaten in kenner. The volcano roll is so good and fresh. We had amazing service that was very attentive. The mood and atmosphere is perfect for date night or even just to hang out with your friends. There was also happy hour happening at the time i went which was a pleasant surprise. Some sushi rolls were 2.99 and perfect for fillers in between big rolls. The only thing I regret trying was the Heart attack roll lol. As a person who doesnt like creamy sushi. The cream cheese (or mayo(?) )that was in it was a little too much for me. My friend however liked it so i guess it just really comes down to preference.
name: Cree

text: This is the best hand made gelato store on the West Coast - maybe you can include the East Coast too. All the gelato is handmade in the back of the store not in some industrial plant and they use ingredients from our local farmer's market. They make the waffle cones in the front of the store. Try the strawberry chocolate chip, coconut or lavendar.
name: Shaun

text: Excellent menu with some good ole favorites, I tried Blackened Alligator and charbroiled oysters were delicious. I liked the jambalaya
name: Thomas

text: Finally made it to Zahav and went for the lamb shoulder tasting menu and wine pairing. So glad we splurged for the $60 menu- totally worth it!! Everything was amazing, I don't even know what my favorite was. The duck hearts and lamb tartare where amazing. The lamb shoulder was out of this world. The hummus was the best I've ever had.  I left super full and still had leftover lamb. Unfortunately I was too full to really eat dessert. The Turkish coffee was great. Can't think of anything negative about this place. Met Chef Michael Solomonov and he was cool- seemed like a guy you could grab a beer with. Speaking of which.. the Israeli lager was delicious.
name: Nicole

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text: I had a pretty good experience on my first visit this past Sunday 9/1. It was very busy and there was a wait for a table but once we gotta seated (we did have to ask for menus after about 5 minutes of waiting) things were great. There were multiple servers going around checking on each table and even though it was busy there was not an insane wait for food. Of course the best part of it was the several vegan options that were just AMAZING! I definitely will be back!
name: Tenika

text: Absolutely delicious authentic tacos. I highly recommend the carne asada and chorizo tacos. So much flavor and generous portions, plus she her homemade salsas (red one is my favorite) are to die for. On top of great food Lorena's has a lovely covered seating area with lots of room for all her customers. Not to mention Lorena herself is one of the sweetest hard working people I've ever met.
name: Michelle

text: For the price I expected a little more care. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Kind of landed in the middle for me. The food was good and the service was easygoing. For the price I expected more than this. Not sure though.
name: User

text: This place is a keeper!  Food was made fresh. The croissants are to die for and FRESH squeezed orange juice!  Baked good made fresh in house and they taste amazing. I little eclectic in the vibes but a great place to hang   Oh did I mention the food is really good too?  Try it. You'll like it
name: Judy

text:
Gus' chicken is NOT playing. They are packed with a punch of flavor and wooww...They are above-average juicy! So be prepared for some good old comfort food!!

Potato salad and Cole slaw are on the sweeter side. I would skip these two sides. However, beans, mac n cheese, and their okra are the bomb! It is casual dining and street parking! Customer service is very welcoming!
name: Phyllis

text: I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Food was fresh and service was quick. The whole meal felt kind of uneven.
name: User

text: A great selection of food, beer, and music. We came here for an event, and really enjoyed the band, and the sandwiches. The spicy fried pickles were awesome, and it was nice to try some of the local beer while listening to live country music. The band played all kinds of country from new to classic, which was great! If I had to recommend something it would be to put spicy, fried pickles in the sandwiches. It's a little trick I learned.  The service was super nice, and everyone was really cool. The location is great too.
name: Hector

text:
Gre8t escape
Ive been a few times food is good my fav is. Chicken buffalo fries and its good to go to an establishment where the peep thts serving ur food are friendly as well!!
name: Keisha

text: I really like vPho. The food is excellent, with several vegetarian and vegan options. The only thing that could improve is the speed of their service, but the friendliness of their staff makes up for it. The workers are always really sweet and helpful, but it does take longer than most other restaurants to get drinks, food, and the bill. Otherwise, vPho is a the best choice for pho in Delaware.
name: Adam

text: Best pizza and garlic knots around. Traffic on US 19 can be a bit of a hassle, but always plenty of parking (same strip mall as Outback), and delivery a quick option. Great stretchy cheese, sauce not too sweet or too salty. Good quality ingredients, fair price, and a tempting counter of dessert options. These guys could hold their own in NYC or on LI, and being a family from there (like us), whether a new or old customer, you'll feel at home with a "Hey - how ah ya?" welcome when you walk in! Forget the cheap chains. When you're gonna eat the calories make it worth it: Support a local family biz and savor the real thing!
name: Jenni

text:
Love the revamped location!  Tons of space now and a menu that looks amazing (I have yet to get a meal here--but I'm v excited about the vegetarian options!  Seitan Tenderloin say what?!) 

The other thing I love about this location (compared to the Carmel location) is that it has a much cozier vibe. Definitely somewhere you can come with friends and stay a while--especially on Sunday when pints are only $3!
name: Karley

text: This place is right around the corner from the straybridge hotel so decided to give it a try. I love japanese/korean bbq and this place did not dissapoint. from the minute you walk in you are greeted in japanese and the staff is super nice. Tuyet was our waitress and she was super helpful in going over the menu with us and did a really good job. I highly recommend requesting her on your next visit :) We ended up ordering the 70 dollar combo deal for 2 persons and it was enough for both of us to get full. Overall a great place and i would recommend checking it out.
name: Miguel

text: Wonderful location right on the water. Excellent fun entertainment on a Friday night. The menu had so many interesting and creative choices that it was hard to decide. Everything we ate was delicious! We had the scallop appetizer, steamed shrimp and calamari. The calamari was perfectly crisp, the scallops were cooked perfectly and the steamed shrimp was flavorful . And I enjoyed my Margarita so much I had a second one! I will definitely return.
name: Catherine

text: Had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Not bad for a quick meal. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: I just had a grilled chicken sandwich that I paid six dollars for, and that was I. Got! Expensive, I hate to think how much fries and coke would be. I don't see why people line up for.
name: Celia

text: Wow. Just wow. I have had Thai food straight from Thailand and some of the best Thai food the US has to offer. Their Pad Thai, basil fried rice, gyoza, and Thai in general are all incredible and keep up with even the best.
name: Gabriela

text: Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Not bad for a quick meal. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The whole meal felt kinda uneven. Food took a while and didn't rlly feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: On arrival the hostess seemed a bit irritated that she had to actually do her job by taking us to the table, not a good way to start the visit. Our waitress was very friendly and did a good job. Our food was pretty good. One other thing that was noted that in the area we were dining there were 5 tables, 2 long and 3 square, that were dirty when we arrived and still dirty after we left an hour later.
name: Mike

text: The only reason it's not 5 stars is because the service is so bad. The food is beyond amazing...literally 10 stars, which makes suffering from dealing with the rudest, angriest, most depressed waitstaff I've encountered worth the trip. Went for dinner, sooo good!!! Our server just shrugged when we asked about some of the menu items, sighed and then once 1 of 3 questions before walking off. We thought damn maybe this girl is having a bad week, life, or millennia, but the food was so good we called in an order the next day for take out (problem solved right?) Wrong! Walked into the bar area to get the food 4 servers and the bartender hanging out.. 4 just stared at us as I said Hi there how are all of you!!! I said wow is it that bad as they started stomping off, one girl smiled and I said Yayy someone friendly, it can't be that bad guys!! She laughed and the bartender grunted. Damnnnn it was that bad. Ok so note* food awesome!!! and definitely worth the bad service, but be warned.
name: Tammi

text: Such great service! We came in close to closing but they made us feel so welcome! Aaron was a great waiter! Food was amazing! Highly recommend!
name: Maya

text: Great food; I loved the spicy, orange (habanero?) salsa and the guacamole! Everything is a little too pricey for me to come here too often, especially the tacos, I've had better tacos at cheaper prices!
name: Eden

text:
If you are craving some authentic, savory, Chinese comfort foods - this is your spot! We came on a cold, rainy morning - and hot noodle wonton soup was exactly what we needed. The portions are super generous, noodles super stretchy, wontons super packed, and bbq pork super smoked. I don't think I took one bad bite, everything just tasted excellent all together! 
It appeared that some of the staff did not speak great English, but don't let that deter you from coming in - bc you can simply point and gesture to receive quality service. 
They open super early, so come early and grab breakfast - it gave us a strong start to our day!
name: Grace Mao

text: Every time I come here I am always welcomed with amazing service and a great atmosphere. The staff seems to connect really well with each other and made me feel really welcomed. I've come in during the day when it's super relaxing but at night it is something else. We've gotten a table a couple of times and every time our hostess, Kimi, has hooked us up with a ton of champagne and deals!
name: Nick

text: I am becoming a regular of Edgewild. The $5 burger deal on Tuesdays is unbeatable and the service is great. The burger is huge and the fries are seasoned well. The dry rub smoked wings are a must try. The bartenders make you feel like family, and that's what keeps me coming back. The beer selection is incredible and they are very knowledgeable. I will be trying their brunch soon, my roommate is a big fan. Easily my new favorite restaurant in the area.
name: Barry

text: The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Will be back. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. For the price I expected more than this.
name: User

text:
This is the third LouVino I have visited (also been to Fishers and Louisville), and I am STILL impressed.

The service was fantastic, we were warmly welcomed and our server was very attentive and helpful. We sat in a U-shaped booth and had a great view of the beautiful bar. 

The menu was slightly different than the other two we have visited, but of course we still got the signature brussels sprouts. Which were delicious. We also ordered the fish and a salad, and those were also very tasty as well. I very much enjoy the fact that LouVino changes their menu so often, it allows you to always be trying new things that you may ordinarily not get to if you have a "favorite" menu item.

While we did not order any drinks, as you can see from the bar picture there were plenty of options had we wanted one. 

Overall, we enjoyed innovative and fresh food combined with some stellar service. We will be back!
name: Alex

text: We went on Saturday night during their grand opening. The place was full but we were seated within 5 minutes. Our waitress was very attentive despite how busy they were. Drinks were refilled often (not an easy task with my family). The salsa is awesome! Some of the best I've ever had. Chips were hot and fresh. All of the food we ordered was very tasty (veggie burrito, cheese enchilada, taco, cheese quesadilla, chicken taquitos, rice and beans). Decor is nice, love the light fixtures! We will definitely be back!
name: Denise

text: For the price I expected a little more care. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. The music was louder than it needed to be. Not bad for a quick meal. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable.
name: User

text: Who is training these kids at these fast food restaurants?! The rudeness and inexperience is beyond reprehensible! For this to be a new restaurant the service is very poor. Not impressed.
name: Valencia

text: Amazing. Googled the name as I drove by and immediately turned around after seeing their menu to place my first order! I was sold. Went there 2 days in a row and both times my taste buds were extremely satisfied! Fish sausage is a little spicy but even if you don't like spice you'll love the lil kick it has.
name: LaShae

text: This place is really good- tuna melted in my mouth! Caterpillar Roll was the truth, and that Spicy Eel roll was dank. Would go again 10/10 holler at yr boi
name: Jimmy

text: Place was much better when it first open a few years ago... they seem to have lost their way....
name: Bob

text: Can't believe i havent been here before now. took myself to happy hour, enjoyed a few glasses of wine (just what I needed) and a plate of oven baked wings for $23. yes please, thank you very much. so much of the other stuff on the menu sounded good too. i am a little confused by the identity of the joint since it is called Pasta Vino but I was there for half price sushi wednesday, i certainly wouldnt have expected that. I saw people next to me with pizzas that looked amazing too. oh well i dont care, ill be back.
name: Rachel

text: BYOB... btw. Thank you previous yelp reviews! You were spot on. Husband had sushi and loved it. I had specialty snow bowl roll which was unexpectedly fried but was amazing. Miso good, seaweed salad good. 1st time there, Saturday night, sat at bar by choice. Really great service. Will be back in Oaks, PA next year and will re-visit for sure!
name: P

text:
Cozy, yet spacious French/American restaurant - delicious food! 

Atmosphere: Quite dim (need a flashlight to see the menu clearly), and mostly lit by candelight. A LOT of space for dinner time around 7pm on a weekday. Interesting music choice - some sounded French, while others were country songs. Friendly service.

Food: Drinks were incredible - loved The Other One (hints of lime, ginger) particularly. Brussel sprouts paired with bacon was amazing - I'm going to consider this combo in my own meals moving forward! Raw oyster was very fresh. Generally, portion sizes were a bit on the smaller side, and a bit pricey, but the quality was high. Braised beef was incredibly tender, paired very well with creamy sauce, though the kapers definitely give it a spicy kick. Chocolate was not what I was expecting - just a slab of creamier chocolate, and personally think the visual aesthetics could be improved there.

Recommended must-try: All dishes were high quality, but none stood out to me as a WOW I need to come back and eat this. Beef was very tender though.

Overall: 4.5/5 for high quality food and pleasant atmosphere; would come back to try other dishes, but probably not my go-to nice dining restaurant
name: Annie

text: Went tonight to find the place closed  - looks like for good. Everything was gone but tables and chairs. Sad - it became our go to Italian place.
name: Ingrid

text: I was very please with the custome servive we recieved. Micheal our server had a lot of patience with us and most of all the foid was amazing. Can't wait to go back.
name: Misses

text: Oh my gosh. So much deliciousness. We got several different kinds of tacos and all were fantastic. Nachos are a HUGE portion. Could easily be a meal in themselves. Perfect pair for rum drinks!
name: Megan

text: Loved the food, the drinks, outdoor patio games and the cool concept of converting church to a bar!
name: Sabi

text:
Pretty good place!

I arrived here with a group of 5 at 12pm on a saturday night. We were given menus from the bar and sat down. There is ample seating and we sat down and picked our drinks. There was a good selection of local beers and 6 cocktail options. 
We each ordered a different cocktail, and enjoyed our drinks after a short wait at the bar.
The music is played low which is great, so we can hear each other talk, and the lighting is bright in some areas and dimmed in others. 
Not a place for loud music and dancing, but great for decent drinks and a social.
name: Ben

text: No big complaints, just a nice meal. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Not bad for a quick meal. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Not bad for a quick meal. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: First time in and this looks like a very nice place. I stopped in for the lunch buffet. Definitely one of the better Asian buffet spreads I've been too in recent months. They have all of the standards (fried rice, green beans, General Tso...) but the sushi selection won the day. For just $7.95 you get the full spread and Taichi has about 8 different rolls to choose from. Freshly made and good too! If you're near downtown or IUPUI and looking for a good Chinese buffet, this is the place!
name: Jason

text:
Used to LOVE this place in 2015 for their lamb sliders and my partner loved their pepper something burger. When we moved back to the city it was first on our list to frequent. We were so disappointed to see all of our favorite meals were no longer on the menu. I substituted with a salmon meal and was sorely disappointed - for $20 I got a piece of salmon that was MAYBE 4"x4". 

Needless to say, was preeeeetty disappointed. We had even brought family with us to brag about the place. Definitely won't be back. Too many other restaurants who keep their menu consistent(ly good) and don't short you on portions.
name: Danielle

text: This is the best pizza place in the Greater Philadelphia area. We've ordered pizzas from here multiple times and it's been consistently great. Yes it's pricey, but it's worth it. I've never lived in a city with such terrible pizza, this place is the only bright spot in a pizza wasteland.
name: Angie

text: Giving this restaurant one star is being exceptionally generous. This was the worst experience! The waitress was clearly on some kind of hallucinogenic alternating between aloof and manic. She dropped a bowl of ketchup on my husbands hand and did not apologize nor clean up the mess on the floor. The food was INEDIBLE. Seriously disgusting and barely cooked. What topped it off was the mouse that scattered under our table. When pointing this out to the staff they replied "there are many". Maybe because of the pile of ketchup left on the ground?? We couldn't get out of there fast enough and recommend a visit from the department of health.
name: Jill

text:
My daughters like this place so I take them there for dinner sometimes. 
The food is decent but the prices are a bit mercenary for what you receive.
name: Brett

text:
I've been coming to Gullifty's since the 90's when I still lived in Philadelphia and a Berwyn native introduced me to it. 

Gullifty's is most of all solid. It's good, homemade bar/pub food typically served by well-trained college students. Great place for a burger, a sandwich, killer onion rings, salads, pizzas (try the bacon/apple/blue cheese for a nice change of pace). The dressings are homemade, the desserts are homemade (the cheesecake is stellar).

Is it a 5-star restaurant? Well...no. But it is a great neighborhood spot and I appreciate consistency. And it's nice to be in a restaurant that's NOT a chain. Thanks to the Gullifty's family for all the years of great service to our community!
name: Pamela

text: The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. The food was good and the service was easygoing. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. Worth checking out. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text:
So I normally love this place but the last time we ordered from them the pizza was a total disaster! We've been disappointed only once before and this is honestly the worst I've ever had from here. The cheese literally would not stay on the pizza regardless of the temperature. When we opened the box cheese was literally everywhere. The pizza must have been wet or something because it was impossible to eat. I'm extremely disappointed and when we called to complain the lady blamed it on us and the pizza temperature! It was NOT our fault that the pizza went into the box looking like a hot mess. I honestly am second guessing coming back here again if they're going to treat us like this. The service has declined sharply from when I was younger. The staff is getting more and more rude as the years go by and the quality of the food is going down as well. It's a shame, it really is. 


Oh to add to that, the second time we ordered from there, the delivery driver called my BLACK fiancé A N*GGER!!!!!!! GET NEW STAFF!!!!!!!!! I wasn't able to get his name but I am still extremely fucking angry about it.
name: Beau

text: Had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. I can see why people like it, even if I wasn't fully sold. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Food was fresh and service was quick.
name: User

text:
We had a great lunch at Chili's! The service that we received was top notch! It's always nice to have an attentive waitress. The food was cooked to order. It all tasted delicious. I do wish they would not put diced tomatoes in the house salad, but I can pick them out. 

If you have little ones, check Chilli's for deals. They often offer great meal deals for the youngsters. 

Of the chain restaurants that are out there, you can't go wrong with Chilli's. They have been good for a long time and their reputation shows it.
name: Ed

text: not sure why this place has such split reviews, but my experience was mostly fine. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Not a bad stop, just not one I'm rushing to repeat. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text: Dessert saved this a little. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. It was crowded but still moved along. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. I'd maybe go back, but I'd order differently next time. The food was good and the service was easygoing. For the price I expected more than this. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: God, thank you for giving us The Wharf. Please bless all those folks within driving distance of this place and help them find a way to frequent it weekly. For I am not so fortunate to do so and only find myself here once a year or so. The wings are tremendous, tacos superb, conch fritters outstanding...even the kids like the place!  Oh, and the drinks are really good too.

text: My friend liked it more than I did. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. It was crowded but still moved along. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.

text: For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. For a busy night they handled it okay. The music was louder than it needed to be. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Pretty happy with it overall. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: Best cheesteak in the city. There I said it. Cheese wiz is "the good kind" if you're a geese fry person you know what I mean. Small place but enough seating usually. The parking lot is tough but not bad enough to stop you from coming back.
name: Kaitlyn

text: This place is an amazing sushi place. And now they even do half off sushi. Best sushi in town
name: Julianne

text: I went in for the food and customer service I usually recieve. They made a mistake on my order and when I brought it to the cashiers attention, he rudely dumped out my drink. Mind you prices are a bit high, I expect quality and customer service. We drove from ventura to SB and were dissapointed. Not sure if their success and busyness has affected their customer service or if they're cashier is burnt out. Either way UNACCEPTABLE!!
name: Joey

text:
There are plenty of Cajun creole style restaurants in the French quarter and some are over the top with hype! With that being said, I didn't care which one I ate at, I just didn't want to wait an hour in line. So the "other" place across the street had 45 min wait, and no wait here. DONE! The hostesses were very friendly and walked us to the bar upstairs. The restaurant has a large dining room and an upstairs bar with additional dining tables. Also, if you can request this do it, there is a bourbon street facing patio, to sit and watch all the crazy shenanigans. 
The food was fantastic! 
I tried blackened alligator! It was interesting, has the texture of pork but leaner. Washed it down with an Abita. Next up was the bayou platter. A trio of southern soup-ish hearty dishes. The red beans and rice were crazy good! 
I absolutely loved eating here and complexly understand all the hype. Worth the dollars and the small wait time. 
Check it out!
name: Ada

text:
If you want genuine German street food they are the place to go to. Their Döner is as good as in Germany and better than anywhere in the Tampa Bay Area. Ingredients are extremely fresh. They have two sauces but the Tzatziki is what's served in Germany rather then the original. 

The Leberkäse is excellent, yet a bit thin. Make sure you order it with the gravy on the side.

The Meter Sausage tastes excellent.

All in all a great place to eat with fair prices
name: Dominic

text:
Mozzarella cheese sticks? No. 

Spinach Lasagna? Oh dear god yes.

So good...

Pizza? Oh yeah, absolutely!

The sauce, oh my, the sauce is yes!
name: E

text: Great flavors, the chicken is seasoned well, and very juicy. Have to warn you that it has some kick to it. It's not that spicy. The baked beans are perfectly sweet and the fried okras were just fried the perfect way. I wasn't a big fan of the bread. Maybe if it was a Texas toast or the white bread was toasted with butter would have been perfect. The bread feels like an after thought. Overall great chicken.
name: Thomson Bryan

text: Excellent Donuts, Coffee, Breakfast Sandwiches, Muffins and Pastries! All made on premises fresh everyday. The service is friendly and fast. The fools across the street at Dunkin' are wasting their money on frozen crap. Shop LOCAL!
name: Martin

text:
We've been coming here at least twice a month for a while now and don't plan on stopping anytime soon! The service is amazing -- Tracy always recognizes us when we come in and remembers our order. The food is always so yummy and never disappoints! Highly recommend coming here and giving it a try! 

Edit: they have a bunch of new teas on their menu. I tried the hibiscus strawberry tea with boba and it was SO good!
name: Gina

text: Wow, what an *awful* experience. I had a 6:00 reservation to celebrate an important anniversary with my husband. We usually love Butcher Bar. I will say -- no matter what whenever we come the host (no matter which time we come) always seems annoyed and like it is a huge inconvenience to seat people. Tonight was no exception. We checked-in for our reservation and the girl seemed immediately annoyed that we asked to sit on their back patio. My husband made it clear that if it wasn't available that it was totally fine. The hostess says it is open and that she has to set the table. We wait up front for quite a while. The hostess finally brings us to our table (patio def full of people and very much open) and the table is against a banquet....the banquet was COVERED in bird poop...we point this out and she just shrugged her shoulder. No apology, no "let me get someone to wipe that." No offer to move us. Very rude and VERY off putting. I dragged a chair over so I could sit on it. We then wait 12 minutes for a server....no server ever came. A manager was at a table nearby running food, she looked over and made eye contact with me. I figured she'd at least offer to get us water and say that a server would be over very soon...this doesn't happen. The manager looks right at us -- empty water glasses and menus on the table and just walks away. At this point my husband and I decided that we are clearly not wanted here nor does this place deserve our money. We walk out and the same rude hostess yells "Have a great night." You know what? We did have a great night -- across the street at El Rey where we were welcomed with open arms. I was really looking forward to celebrating this important anniversary at Butcher Bar and I am beyond disappointed in the overall experience. From the rude hostess, to no server ever coming by, to the manager clearly ignoring us. What a shame.
name: L.

text: Stopped by after work because I was nearby and hungry. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. It was crowded but still moved along. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Price felt a touch high for what it was. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again.
name: User

text:
My girlfriend and I visited for brunch today.  I have to say that every single thing about our experience here was nothing short of fantastic. 
We took advantage of the complimentary valet, so parking wasn't an issue. Of course we tipped upon departure (which is appropriate, folks - just a friendly reminder, folks). 
We were greeted upon entry by some friendly hostesses who promptly seated us.  
Our server was attentive and helped make some suggestions on the menu. I got the brunch fried rice, which was wonderful. My girlfriend ordered the chicken sandwich, which may not sound like anything special but I'd challenge anyone to find a better chicken sandwich. 
In short, everything was delicious!
We will definitely be back, likely for dinner next time. 
Thanks!!
name: Mike

text: Sit at the bar, get the Tiki bucket, order the seafood boil platter and gator legs, ask for Tater (the bomb ass waiter/bartender). You'll regret nothing, thank me later
