text: Stopped by after work because I was nearby and hungry. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. I can see why people like it, even if I wasn't fully sold. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text: Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. Price felt a touch high for what it was. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. Pretty happy with it overall. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text:
I think the reason this place gets such high marks is that it is so different from other places nearby. The hostess had an attitude and they don't really seem to interact with the hotel they are attached to, despite the ads in the rooms. I called down from my room and asked for a full menu and was told I would need to come down and get one myself despite the in room partial menu saying they could deliver a full one to my room. So thanks. 
When my friends and I finally got in on the last sitting, we were really pleased with the food and cocktails. I did the curried goat and sweet potato gnocchi. It was delicious. The ingredients were fresh and packed with flavor. The waitress we had was lovely and I'm glad I got to check this place out, I just feel like a lot of the attention and praise it gets is because it offers a different cuisine. I just wasn't as wowed by the food as I'd hoped to be after hearing all the accolades this place has. 
Also, make some time to sit at the bar, get a copper bunny and chat to the lovely bartender staff.
name: Heather

text: Wow!  When I hear Gaetanos (In NJ) I think yum yum!  I have driven by this place a million times until today.  Nice inside for a pizza place. You can sit and be served, order over the phone or takeout. The staff is as friendly and there were lots of people either dining or waiting for food they had ordered. We were really hungry so I said let's get a meatball and cheesesteak!  It's going to be delicious!   Well...wrong!   I can't see how they are still in business and how there are so many people in this place.  I should have known something was wrong...the food didn't smell good in the car. The meatballs looked old. The sauce looked like it was straight out of a can.  I took a fork and tasted it...yuck. No seasoning, just meat and the sandwich was not hot!  The steak was just...big. I took a fork and tasted the meat...flavorless. Not even hot!  I'm not sure what type of operation they are running, but I do not recommend the food here at all
name: T

text: First time visit after Yelp event. I had been wanting to try with Indian co-workers. We had take out for 6 of us. The yogurt mango drink was awesome. All the food was very good. We all agreed that it was excellent Indian food and we woukd visit again. Parking is tricky from Vassar. Turn left on S.Virginia then next right to get to back parking lot.
name: Barbara

text: I think Philly has a selection of great and incredibly affordable food trucks, and Lyn's is one that serves food which, while not the most innovative, delivers exactly what they say in a quick and tasty fashion at stupid-low prices. You can go here and get a stuffed sandwich starting at $3($2 if it's a breakfast sandwich), and they are very satisfying. The eggplant parm sandwich(or pita if you so choose), is a standby and a faux meal in and of itself; 2 meals if you get the large sandwich(which'll only cost you a flat $5). Lines can be long, but moves quickly. And Lyn is super nice. Frankly, it's hard to walk by and not get something.
name: Phil

text: Their brunch is AMAZING.  Everything on the menu is fresh, well prepared and tastes amazing.  Big portions that leave you full.  The roasted carrots are delicious.  Every time we've been in, and tried to order drinks they were always "out of something" I've never been able to order a drink and actually get what I ordered on the first try.  They always offered good substitutions for what they didn't have, but I would rather have a menu that is updated.  They don't serve liquor, just beer and wine? (can't remember about the wine) so if you want a bloody mary with vodka you're out of luck. Great mimosas, and a large selection of Kombucha. On 2 separate occasions we had waiters that didn't seem like they wanted to be at work.  Very blah. The popcorn appetizer is crazy good and very flavorful
name: Kimberly

text: Excellent breakfast with an attentive bartender who by the way reminds me of George Clooney!
name: Linda

text: Super small location. Friendly staff that'll get you in and out! Always smiling and waiting to take your order. When I come to this DD it's always between 6 and 7 am and there may never anymore than 4/5 people inside. I definitely recommend this location if you're in the area.
name: Harold

text: This was our third time giving this location a chance. It has been open for several months now so the kinks should be worked out. The seating seems to always be an issue. The wait time quoted is much lower than the actual time that it takes to be seated. We were quoted about 28 minutes, but the wait was about 45 minutes. We ordered as soon as we were seated. Shortly after ordering the waiter came to tell us that there was a back up in the kitchen. Shortly after that, the people next to us complained to the waiter that they had been waiting for their food for an hour. We waited for our food for approximately an hour. When our food came out, it was not prepared as ordered. My husband ordered poached eggs that came out over hard. My son ordered eggs over easy that came out over hard. He did not eat anything. I feel bad for the wait staff because none of these issues are in their control. Once we were done eating, the waiter gave us the check and informed us that you pay at the front cashier. To add to the horrible experience, it was a 15 minute wait to pay!!!!!!  Three strikes and unfortunately this restaurant is OUT!  I cannot recommend more fervently that you go anywhere else. They do not seem capable of getting it together.
name: J

text: First cheesesteak I've had since moving to the area 4 years ago that I thought was actually good!  Would have given 5 stars but the people working there were miserable and not friendly
name: Misty

text: Bouncers are terrible and not very bright. Took way to long to get a drink. I will never go back.
name: Kelly

text:
UPDATE
Dinner better food than brunch but I would recommend.

Brunch one star for Cold hard as a rock waffle. Flat over cooked chicken. Sweet cream ice cream is delicious.
name: Cali

text: The philly spring rolls are not good. They are not a spring roll or egg roll for that matter. They are a fried flour tortilla.  The wait staff was no attentive. The queso was good and the blackened chicken tacos were decent but messy and too wet from pico.
name: Leann

text: Mediocre food for the price. Service is ok. The bread they serve before dinner is not great. It's honestly just very overpriced for what it is.
name: E

text: Went for Mother's Day for me and my daughter. We were seated quickly and the appetizers came out quickly but it seemed to take a bit of time for our entree's. When they came out the dishes were hotter than the food. The food was tasty as always but...  just a little disappointed since it was my daughters first Mother's Day and my granddaughter was sitting for a bit too long!!
name: Maria

text: Top shelf bbq joint. We had a half slab and brisket. Everything from the sauce to the cornbread and the beans were excellent. I'd give one more star if they had reusable tableware.
name: Jim

text: It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Food was good and came out fast. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text: The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Pretty happy with it overall. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Not bad for a quick meal.
name: User

text: Fourth time here and not going to count anymore.   Went light for new treats with my companion, marinara pizza and  broccolini.  Best thing, didn't taste like a vegetable!!! Was awesome.  Laura treated us like royalty.
name: Bob

text: One of those meals where nothing is exactly wrong but you're not excited either. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text: I had a chance to stop by when this store just recently open. The food selection is great. Try the Phillies roll if you like the combination of crab lump meat and shrimp tempura. This establishment has more varieties of Sake selection compares to the other tenants nearby. I would recommend to try the Junmai Sake selection.
name: Sean

text:
This is my second time visiting the Liter House. The first was a side-trip off the Monon Trail for dinner and beers. There is just something about ordering beer by the liter or half liter that makes a place different and fun. Today was a stop for lunch. 

Waiters and waitresses were fabulous on both visits. The brewmaster is super fun and entertaining. The beer was great. Today we split the Frikadellen Hamburger with fries and it was plenty for two people. I'm not always a fan of pretzel buns but I absolutely love this burger on a pretzel bun. I'm also always a big fan of farm to table. I haven't taken my teens there yet but it will be one of our upcoming outings. My daughter will be happy to see a vegetarian burger on the menu.

If you are looking for another outdoor patio venue Liter House is working feverishly on theirs. Can't wait for it to be finished because it will become a favorite spot I'm sure. Cheers!
name: Mindy

text: People are being a little dramatic in these comments honestly. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. I had a better visit than I expected to. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text: Heard lots of great reviews from friends so we decided to give a try tonight.  We sat at the bar and had the best service!  Bar tender did a great job explaining how the dishes are prepared, how the food is sourced (fresh and never frozen). Gave great recommendations.  We loved it!  Will be back to try their weeks brunch specials!
name: L

text: A bit hard to find, but worth the trouble. The food, although simple, was well presented. The facility is clean, staff friendly though not overly efficient. Breakfast seems to be the specialty and is served all day long. Em J's is a nice change of pace from the franchise and chain businesses. Would return.
name: Chuck

text: Food was fresh and service was quick. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. Glad we tried it. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Nice little spot, decent portions too.
name: User

text: Great place to visit in the area. Food and bevy's were fantastic. Sat outside and got out to the water. Weather was epic. The wait staff was great. Look forward to getting back out there soon !!!!
name: Jim

text: The photos made it look a little better than it actually was. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Anyway, dessert was weirdly the highlight, which i wasn't expecting at all. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. not sure I'd order the same thing again.
name: User

text:
My friends and I have been wanting to go here since it opened, and one fortuitous day, we were able to! Thankfully, the lines we had seen when it first opened had abated. We were the only three in the store, which made for a comfortable, personalized experience.

There were two staff, who greeted us immediately and warmly. I almost didn't realize, because I was drawn to the amazing cooler full of to-go cookie dough and cheesecakes.

I took forever to order. I just couldn't decide! I had three samples, and the staff kept encouraging me to try more if I wasn't sure what I wanted. I didn't want to frustrate them, but I wanted to make sure I picked the best flavors!

In the end, I went with a small cup (really all you need of this rich dessert before you start to hate yourself, life, and especially your pants) with one scoop of sugar cookie and one of DOUBLE CHOCOLATE OREO. Excuse me, I got excited. It was sooooooo good!

The interior is a bit sparse, and I wish it were more visually welcoming. It looks as though it were designed for you to get in, get dough, and get out. As far as olfactorily, the appeal is 10/10. It smelled like fresh baked cookies (which they also have!!!) and dreams.
name: Kristi

text: Excellent food and service, huge portions. I had jalapeño Mac and cheese meatloaf for days.
name: Nick

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Kind of landed in the middle for me. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: This used to be our number one pizza place in all of philly, but recently the prices have gone up ($17 for 12 mediocre wings)  and the quality has gone down. Since the change will try elsewhere.
name: Jeffrey

text: For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. You can tell they care about customer experience here. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Food was fresh and service was quick. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Overall, a strong experience. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text:
Really disappointing. Was looking forward to eating breakfast here for weeks, was referred by a friend in Vegas (where we're from). We all go to order, they only serve breakfast until 11, which we wanted some of the appetizers, like the fried green tomatoes, since we don't really get that in Vegas. Asked the waitress about it and she said she would definitely check for us, never came back and told us anything, and never got them. She then took our orders, and never came back.  Food came out in a timely manner other than my one friend who literally didn't get her food until my dad physically went up to the kitchen line asking for it. Every egg we had on all of our orders was over cooked and cold. We were all about 3/4 way done when my friend finally got her food and her whole "skillet" came out cold. She still hadn't come and apologized or anything. 

I ordered the brisket skillet and I would give it a 2/5, brisket was dry. Would've been better if my egg was actually runny and I was able to mix it in! 

My other friends grits also were so cold they felt like they came straight out of the fridge! 

Being from Vegas and in the restaurant industry this was extremely disappointing. 80% because of the service and failure to make any effort to apologize or resolve the situation. 20% because if you're known for your breakfast you should know how to cook eggs! 

Our servers name was Lauren. She wasn't mean or rude, she just needs retraining. And im really surprised that no manager came by either! 

Not giving a 1/5 because of referral from friend and I truly think they can do a better job.
name: Sindy

text: The tacos were amazing!!! I had the beef brisket and the carnitas tacos! They were delicious!  Very quick service too! We waited less than 10 minutes and the restaurant was slightly full. The owner even brought over free guac for my friend and I since it was my first time at the restaurant! Delicious, affordable food and great prices!
name: Shelbi

text: Trash, garbage, dirty. Classless bartender. You know, like a cool, smart guy, that's fill in puffery. Zero long term vision, zero classiness. Trash is what our motto is. LMAO and kinda, sorta sad
name: Petro

text: I feel like they need to hire all new people. The ones they have are rude (not all, but most!) and don't seem to care. I have worked in a restaurant for the last 16 years and I know the kind of hustle you need on a Friday/Saturday/Sunday and these people don't have it. First of all, when all you sell is burgers, on a Saturday during dinner hours, there should be extra burgers cooking. You aren't going to waste them. That's all you sell and you can see a line forming inside and out. So to have to wait for 30+ minutes in the drive thru line last weekend just to get to the order screen is ridiculous. Then to have to wait another 20+ minutes to get the food from there is even worse! I understand they are cooked fresh when ordered but burgers don't take that long to cook. If extras were down it would take even less time. Maybe you throw a few out at the end of the rush (or feed employees) but isn't that better than losing so many potential repeat customers right from the start? I'm certainly not interested in going back. I wonder how much they pay their employees??
name: Kim

text: Visited this restaurant last Saturday evening.  5 star service from start to finish!  The wait was about 20 minutes.  The staff was professional and courteous. Our server, Allison, was awesome. She was very attentive and made sure we were completely satisfied with everything.  The manager was chatting with customers and pitching to help the wait staff.  When we were first seated, he came right over and took our drink and appetizer order to get things rolling.  Our food came out in a timely manner and was delicious!  This restaurant was ran like a well-oiled machine which was nice to experience.  Kudos to all the staff at this LongHorn!
name: Vicky

text:
Great burgers and drinks in a dive bar setting. Our plan was to go for lunch. My brother showed up early and grabbed a table while we were on the way. By the time we got there he was already welll lubricated ;) 

The interior is dark and crowded, the service harried and busy. The menu is very limited. Steak. Steak and Steak. And Burger. In fact that's why we went. Oh yeah, we like a good burger!

Their burger is basic - but that's ok, because basic is also CLASSIC. It comes out cooked to order. Mine was juicy and just right. The fixings are on the side, so you can build it to suit. You also get a baked potato. I admit it - I was skeptical, but the potato worked. Esp w/ bacon bits, chives and sour cream. 

For my drink I went with the Port of Call. It was good. I had a second. Things started to get a bit hazy. It involved rum, and fruit juice. I'd have it again. 

We wandered out into the blazing sunlight, at least 2 sheets to the wind, half blinded, but satiated and happy. Looking for more adventure. I think I love NOLA.
name: Chris

text: The Mud House is my #1 favorite coffee shop in the city. The coffee is perfection. Honestly. The pour overs are ace, and the bottomless drip coffee is perfect for the hours I spend there on my laptop (when they're not busy). And they do get busy. I don't even try to have brunch there. Ever. The line is out the door, and my hangry tendencies are notorious. But the food is really great. Fresh, local, lots of healthy options. The patio is shady and super pleasant. Woohoo!
name: Johanna

text:
One of our FAVORITE restaurants.  Being a die-hard Hattie B's fan, how do you say no to hot chicken without the 2 hour line out the door and the additional hour-hour and a half commute when you don't have to be down town?!  Exactly, you don't. You go to Bishop's!  And enjoy Hattie B's hot chicken with even better side options! I don't think I've ever waited more than 15 minutes and half the time I just call ahead and pick it up 20 minutes later. Super friendly staff! Great ambiance! Great location!  Only negative is the dining room gets a little crowded but that's a good problem to have. 

Now to the important matter: their hot chicken is AMAZING. I have tried most every hot chicken joint in Nashville, as well as dozens of other restaurants who are smart enough to include it on their menu. I enjoy it in the upper 20% hotness ranking :) While many of the hot chicken establishments have their own unique spin and flavor, may taste similar. 
 But Hattie B's and Bishops have a totally different flavor than the others. 
 It's almost a sweetness..before the heat slaps you in the face. My husband and I both get it xtra hot, either the leg quarter or tenders.  The mac n cheese and carrot souffle- O-M-G. You haven't lived until you eat their carrot souffle.
name: Courtney

text: Made a special trip to stop at Hattie Bs on the way from South Carolina to St. Louis. Ordered online because we had 16 hours total of driving and stops needed to be quick. Grabbed our food and sat down at a table to quickly gobble down our food. An employee comes out and berates us because we are sitting AT A TABLE instead of at the BAR because we ordered to go. (Evidently there is a sign that we didn't see) Turns out, not all paying customers are treated equal. If he had politely explained the policy and asked us to move, we would be giving a 5 star review, but instead, he basically kicked us out of our seats and embarrassed us needlessly.  Message delivery is much more impactful than the message itself. Very disappointing customer service.
name: Becca

text: When we walked in, there were more staff than visitors in the restaurant. They seated us immediately and told us our server would be right with us. We sat and watched all the servers wandering around visiting with each other for about 15 minutes without a single one of them coming over to even offer a drink. We finally got up and left.
name: Amy

text: Amazing food and incredible bang for your buck. No wonder the line is out the door. Prepare to overeat and feel gross in all the right ways.
name: Brian

text:
I love Arpeggio, their food is delicious! So it makes me sad when I receive a disappointing meal from them.  

Ordered a gluten free pizza for take out only to discover they used a frozen crust anyone could get from the grocery store. And not a very good one at that. Dominos does a better gluten free pizza sad to say. Waste of $16.00.
name: Isabelle

text: Delicious!  Really hit the spot.  We should all be born Greek or Italian.  Greek fried cheese in pita for appetizer.  Super yummy!  My favorite!  I also had pasta with Italian sausage.  Tasty, good amount of sauce, and slightly spicy.  Great service with the exception of assuming I done ant dessert.  Parking is a little tough too.
name: Constance

text: Still have never heard from the bakery over a year later except for a Facebook post telling me to call them. Uhm no you call me. I did my due diligence by calling for over a month. I feel like it is your responsibility now to reach out to me but I doubt that will ever happen. I still would never recommend this bakery to anymore not even my worst enemy. Shady business dealing that's for sure!!!!
name: Tiffany

text:
Wandering around Reno late at night at not wanting fast food but also not wanting to go near the casinos I found just down the street from a firehouse this rustic and somehow still modern bar. Although I'm not a huge sandwich fan I was delighted to find that they had pizza. 
They call me the "pizza monster" at my house, and this place did not disappoint
name: Jose

text: Last night we went for their $5.00 burger night.  We walked up,said we would like table for eight and what we were there for.  While waiting an employee walked up to the specials board and taped up a sign that said, "Specials run from 1:00 to 5:00". We asked what was going on?" No answer!  We walked away and will not be back.i
name: Daniel

text: We've been here a few times and very consistently half the food on our table is great and the other half is terrible. Oh, and their wallpaper is upside down.
name: Chris

text: Had the beef sandwich, was very dry. Service was extremely nice and they were genuinely concerned about what we thought. Chicken wings were ok, pork rolls were also decent. Was hoping for more
name: Allan

text: These cheesesteaks are the biggest I've ever saw or have eaten! Three people can split a large and they will all be stuffed! The service is fast and the cook is entertaining. And the steaks are delicious and you definitely get your monies worth! Just one thing....Go hungry! It will be the only meal you'll be able to eat in one day.
name: Bonnie

text: Went here twice during our vacation to Nashville. The first time we had a fantastic experience. We had the Thursday special- it was a Chorizo and Wagu burger topped with black bean queso and Fritos. It was delicious! Their special sauce is out of this world. I like the vibe and the beats  we came a second time last night. They forgot to put our order through so we waited 40 minutes for a burger. Service was not as attentive. Left pretty disappointed and felt like we shouldn't have come back a second time.
name: Hannah

text:
The view is breathtaking

The servers are wonderful

We had the crab cakes and cioppino

Both good. Not the best we ever had. Crab cakes had too much filler, breadcrumbs. Not enough crab. The cioppino  broth  was a bit bland but generous seafood, scallops clams, shrimp, fish, mussels, crab leg,.  

They brought the starter and main course at same time. It would have been better if they brought the starter first, let us eat that. Then bring the main dish. The crab cakes were not hot, so I'm sure they sat there until the cippinio was ready.

We biked along the coast then walked all over the Douglas  preserve.  After lunch we walked and walked along the ocean right at the beach from this restaurant. It went on for ever. Amazing.
name: Nancy

text: You can't go wrong with Lees Spicy Breaded family deal great prices and they give you more for your money than any of the Fried Chicken competitors. Best sides of all of them. Never had bad service here in all the years I've came.
name: Juan

text: Found this big rock in our clams dish, ~2" size. I complained to the manager, both their server and manager said it was normal for them, no compensation. "Clams live with rocks", thats what he said. Seriously? At a big casino like Atlantis, I cant believe they said that. So its normal for them to have a worm in a salad dish? ? Worms are with vegetables all time! Its ridiculous. This was at Bistro Napa
name: Thea

text: Okay  food but lacking in spices (garlic,basil,oregano,for example). The seafood lasagna was scare with the seafood and almost gluey. Will try other Italian places in the area & hopefully find a true winner. I'm originally from Brooklyn & grew up eating great Italian. This restaurant would not last there, sorry to say. Not 4 stars for sure.
name: Vincent

text: There's basic and then there's super basic. If the food was as good as the entertaining and humorous descriptions on the menu, this place would be great.  Ate here with my family and they were sold out of wings at about 6:00 PM, our waitress, although friendly and seemingly efficient, totally forgot our appetizer order and offered us a free desert.  Sauces were bland and maybe we should have stuck to pizza but we ventured into entrees and it was a disappointment.
name: Brian

text: I wish I'd seen this before ordering on Skip the Dishes. It took four hours to get my order ( the delivery guy said he only got the call fifteen minutes before delivering). The food was cold and missing the dumplings I ordered and was charged for. And the food was almost tasteless. Ugh!  I will NEVER order from them again. Don't waste your money
name: Fay

text: Great take on the Poke craze. Fresh, clean, delicious! Favorite sauce was the truffle shoyu. Great place worth a visit!
name: Jason

text:
After perusing various brunch hotspots, we ended up choosing and visiting this restaurant to start our day strong.
Turned out to be the best decision ever, the scene and vibe was unique, the service was great as well and the food...... uhh the food, was just absolutely delicious and excellent.

One of my friends had their eggs Benedict (I don't remember the exact name of what it's called on the menu). But I ended up tasting it and it was excellent.

My other friend tried the Boer Farmer's Omelette meal; which is frigging huge by the way. Tasted that as well, and man-O-man! It resonated well with my tastebuds; something just connected.

I personally had the Boer Country Breakfast, that was pretty delicious as well. I'm definitely coming back to try more of their meals!

Happy dining and visit De Dutch to try something unique and different.
name: Zoejaiwah

text:
This was my least favorite Italian restaurant in the Tampa Bay Area. I don't know why anyone gave them good reviews. But truth is they are slightly better than Olive Garden. The gnocchi was dry, the pasta was wayyy over cooked and just about everything we ordered was cooked incorrectly. 

Instead should have went to pan Rustica , Eddie V's , or Donatello's which all are superior to this restaurant.
name: George

text: The photos made it look a little better than it actually was. The wait wasnt awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text:
"Come hungry."  "Food was very good." "Attentive wait staff." "Definitely a repeat." Those were a few of the comments from my family about our first visit to the Epicurean Garage. 

The Salmon BLT was soooo yummy and fresh. The blueberry coulis on top of the chicken quesadilla was unexpected, but delightful and not too sweet - just the right touch. The golden raisin cole slaw was great and the tartar sauce topped off the fish & chips perfectly.
name: Sharon

text: Zesto has become a solid delivery option for me. Usually pretty fast and the food is hot. Everything I have had from here has been good! 4 Star delivery spot that I will continue to get!
name: TJ

text: The best, most tasty pizza in town. Awesome service and people. Have a 25 inch pizza that is to die for
name: Ronald

text:
We had stopped coming here because the food was typically crusty and stuff wasn't clean, but two of the last three times we came to give it another shot, there were no tomatoes on the salad bar. Who wants an iceberg lettuce, cucumber, and crouton salad??? Last time, we found out the cheap bastardos were hiding the tomatoes behind the counter ("upon request")...and this time, they told me they had no tomatoes; when I asked why, they said they had been keeping them behind the counter, so nobody was eating them, so they stopped ordering them. How's that for logic? Then we realized they also had no olives, and since the olives and tomatoes were pretty much all my toddler would normally eat, it was pretty annoying. 

One would think they saved enough money by having guests start cleaning off their own tables to buy a few salad necessities for what they call a salad bar.

We will not be coming back until they quit being cheapskates - penny wise and pound foolish - regardless of whether this is a corporate mandate or a local decision.
name: Bart

text:
Excited to try the spicy orange chicken. The servers are very nice and helpful. Seems like a great place. I will let you know more when we are done.

text: This review is only for the process of booking an event there which resulted in an unfavorable experience. We were planning a private birthday dinner and really was looking forward to the quaint location, the separate room and the food. Unfortunately we got stalled at the point where I was ready to provide my credit card number to reserve the date and book the event as the manager would only accept the card in person or over email. Over the phone was not possible. I found that very strange given I was not comfortable putting my credit card details in an unencrypted email, nor could I be there in person. This resulted in us not being able to have our dinner party here and left me with sadly an unfavorable impression of managements rigid requirements. A shame really.

text: Food was great!! My husband had the rotisserie chicken which came boneless with spinach and I had the prime rib eye which was mouthwatering! We also had the Greek salad which was tasty. The wine selection was short but great! I had a glass of the Syrah which paired well with my steak. The only drawback was the ambience. Didn't feel very welcoming and the seats (I sat at one of the walls) was not super comfy. But other than that, service was impeccable, and food was delicious!

text: Shelby is an extremely helpful person when it comes down to ordering here! She made this experience a very memorable one! Love the way she helps her customers with so much enthusiasm and positivity!

text: this is a place for great service and good food.  come join in with family and friends

text:
This was my first time visiting Max Brenner with my fiance, my friend, and her boyfriend. 

We were not sure if we wanted to come here or to Buddakan. Since we were not sure and chose Max Brenner about an hour before arriving, we did not make a reservation. 

We arrive and ask the hostess how long the wait will be, and she says THREE. HOURS. We decide to look at the chocolate shop for a bit. 

The bar area that they have in the back does not require reservations, and that is kind of like a "first come/first serve" scenario. Luckily, my friend and I decided to check out the bar, saw some open space, and waved over our men to sit down. There were four of us, but only three stools. We originally asked a waitress if we could grab one of stools at a nearby table since no one was sitting there, but she said no. 

We were really sad and were about to leave, but we decided to ask the bartender if we were able to snag the seat and she said yes, so we took it. 

Our bartender/waitress at the bar was AMAZING. I don't remember her name, but she had glasses and gave us AWESOME recommendations, as well as remembering our ENTIRE order PERFECTLY, was really friendly and sweet, was kind enough to split the bill for us when we asked, and gave us to-go bags with forks!! 

I had the Hazelnut Chocolate milkshake, my fiance had the Oreo hot chocolate made with dark chocolate, my friend had the Mexican hot chocolate and her boyfriend also had the hazelnut chocolate milk shake. ALL THE DRINKS WERE DELICIOUS. Sooo rich. Divine. 

My fiance ordered the waffle fries with cheese and bacon as an appetizer and they were so incredibly delicious. 11/10!!

My fiance ordered the mac and cheese burger, my friend and I both ordered the mac and cheese and added crispy chicken, and her boyfriend ordered chicken Alfredo. So delicious!! We were all considering getting dessert, but were wayyy too full. The portions are VERY generous for the price. I only ate 1/4 of my food and boxed the rest up and split it again with my fiance the next day!! 

This place is awesome, but DEFINITELY reserve a table!! I'll be coming back again with my fiance and his brother next month! :)
name: Casey

text:
Went out to Maypop with family for lunch.  It has a lovely ambiance: quiet, spacious, and well-decorated.  The food was elegantly plated as well, very pleasant and makes you feel like you're at a fancy dinner.  We were also brought little surprises, savory beignets before we received our bread service and caramel cubes after we'd had dessert.

On the whole, my experience at Maypop was quite satisfying and even relaxing.  Aside from the uncomfortable chairs and unholy amount of ice in their drinks, my only real complaint is that the flavors were somewhat lacking in intensity all across the board.  Maybe a little more seasoning?
name: Not

text: Favorite jalapeño burger!! Cooked just right amount- waiters are super friendly except at the bar. They don't even offer water and ignore you if you're here for takeout! The green Chile fries are a must have and the jalapeño burger is the best in Tucson!!
name: Ashita

text: I had the Spicy Thai Chicken and Rice Noodles and, as you can see from the bowl, I liked it.   My dinner partner had the Mediterranean Salad. She said "The falafel was the best ever."  This is the place to go for healthy affordable fast food.
name: Eric

text: This restaurant far exceeded my expectations. My boyfriend told me we were getting Asian food and I didn't have time to check Yelp (gasp!) So I imagined a hole-in-the-wall Chinese take-out joint to pop into before we hit the road homeward bound. I was instead surprised with a trendy Asian fusion restaurant and bar that serves spectacular food! We opted for the chef's tasting menu, which was served family style as each of our seven selections was ready. The timing was well done. Never did we find ourselves wanting for food nor wondering where to stack plates of food around the table. The sweet and sour shrimp and fillet were so yummy and seasoned/spiced just right. We were very happy with the mushroom satay and all of our other choices. The meal was topped off with miniature ice cream cones (orange creamsicle and lemon chocolate) for us to savor. I highly recommend this gem of a restaurant that's just a short walk from the convention center. The service is great and the food is even better.
name: Amy

text:
I went for my very first time Saturday morning because I had a little time before a scheduled pedicure.

First things first- slooooowwwwwww drive thru! I waited 10-15 minutes for one bagel. I am not sure if going in is faster but I will try that next time. I recommend giving yourself plenty of time for this pit stop.

Second- I tried to get the name of the guy working the drive-thru but he wasn't wearing a name tag. He seemed rushed but nice enough over the intercom until I changed my cream cheese flavor. Like I said, it was my first time, I got a cinnamon sugar bagel with plain shmear but then another flavor caught my eye and I said oh wait, can I actually have the honey pecan? and he actually "ugh'd" through the intercom which caught me off guard and was very rude. It's not like I just asked you for a kidney, geez.

Lastly- the bagel. YUM!!! So delicious. Toasted perfectly with the perfect amount of shmear. I want to eat one everyday now but I work in Sparks where we don't have an Einsten Bros. This will be a stop anytime I am on that side of town from now on!
name: Natasha

text: Burgers are delicious, by far some of the best food you can find at an airport in the United States. Staff can be overwhelmed at times with the crowds but Vanessa is terrific!

text: Went in to check the place out & was not disappointed! Sat at the sushi bar and Donovan hooked it up with some amazing rolls and service. Everyone was so welcoming & the food was absolutely amazing. Also had some hot sake to top off the great night! 10/10 will go back.

text: 3:45 on 11/8. Rude girl asked for order, sounded like work was misery. After 15 minutes we finally got a burnt pretzel and refrigerator cold cheese. Terrible.

text:
UPDATE:
Downgrading to 1 star. Three months later we stupidly decided to give it another shot. Terrible. Inside was closed at 9:30, only 2 cars in front of us - just getting ice cream -  and it took 25 minutes. Over 20 minutes for two basic desserts, with a crappy attitude thrown in for good measure.

text:
Update (Dec 17, 2019): Picked up some Wingstop again to see if things had improved and I'm happy to say they have. Before I left the store this time I had them open the boxes to check how well things had been sauced and they were well covered with a small amount of extra sauce dropping off. There is also something about their ranch that we really enjoy, to the point that whenever we throw a party we usually pick up a large ranch from here instead of the grocery store.

While I won't forget what happened that prompted my original review (which I will leave intact below), I am happy things have improved and will be back soon enough I'm sure.

Original Review (Nov 2019):
My wife and I have been coming to this Wingstop for many years now, but our most recent experience has us considering other options. It was a simple order, 20 boneless wings with Hawaiian sauce for pickup. What we received was was 20 mostly dry wings with very little sauce. I promptly reached out to Wingstop on Twitter and left negative feedback through their after-order survey, and I was reached out to by their manager. I was told that the chef was new and was offered a gift card for my troubles. It's been 10 days now with no sign of said gift card, but even then, we've been noticing that over the last roughly year the amount of sauce on the wings has been slowly diminishing. They are usually still covered in at least a thin layer of sauce, but this time things had gone too far. If/when I do get the gift card I will update my review to reflect that, and again the next time we order from them, but as it stands right now we have no plans to return here anytime soon.

Update (Dec 11, 2109): After posting my review, the manager Carlos reached out to me again about the gift card and I ended up going there in person to get it. I've bumped my review from 2 to 3 stars for the customer service, and will update my review fully the next time we go.
name: Devin

text: I have never been disappointed in a dish from Pad Thai. Quick and friendly service, and a wonderful selection.
name: Amy

text: I cannot comment on the food as the service was so bad that we left before our entrees arrived. We arrived for a reservation. We sat down for probably 15-29 minutes before the waitress came over for water and take our order. She took our orders and we did not see her again for probably an hour. No one came by our table to check on us. No food came. Finally, after we pointed out that we have been waiting for over 40 minutes for our apps that someone said our salads (that came with the entrees) will be coming. Another 20 minutes later, our apps finally arrive. No one cleared the dirty dishes off the table. After our apps, we just waited. Nothing. None entrees, no water refill. We finally gave up and asked for the check after no food came. We sat at the place for two hours and only ate a side salad (that was obviously tossed together very quickly) and our very small portioned appetizers. The manager tried to get us to stay but couldn't tell us how much longer we had to wait, admitted they lost our order (yet never asked us in the entire 2 hours we sat there what we ordered to remedy the problem). The food may be amazing but I will never know. Never going back there again.
name: Jane

text:
Have you ever had someone say the words, "have a nice day", but their tone, facial expression, and body language really says, "go eff yourself"? Well, that was the last time I tried to tolerate Del Taco.   
I know what you're thinking, I should know better. It's gross food. Granted it was the holidays, and I just wanted a breakfast burrito to eat on the fly while running errands. The 10 minute wait in the drive thru should have been a red flag, but I was stubborn.
The Ranchero Burrito was an abomination.  It has some oily mystery meat clumped up into one end, and some green slime that may or may not have been a gauc clone glopped into the other.  The tortilla was stale, dry and cracked, like it had been left out uncovered, and promptly spewed the contents out onto my coat while I was driving.  Grrrr!
Sometimes you just want a quick guilty pleasure fast food item on the go.  Sometimes you just want to spread Christmas cheer to a grumpy cashier. Sometimes, you strike out on all of it, have to throw the nasty burrito out and maybe saved yourself a whole day of the bubble guts.  Either way, Del Taco, you win.  I'm OUT.
name: Kathe

text: In town for marching band Grand Nationals, we went out for breakfast.  There was a bit of a wait on a Friday morning at 8:30, but it was less than 15 minutes.  Cute concept, but strange.  Nice that they have different coffee options, but the self serve is weird in a wait staff restaurant setting.   The food was good, but it seems everything is served with arugula, which basically looks like weeds from your yard.  The prices seemed a little high, but not terrible for a downtown restaurant.  Not sure if we'd return, but maybe.

Other members of the party had the flat iron steak.  Bland.  The bread pudding also a dud.  Service was really off as it was hard to get refills and the place was only about 3/4 full.  Many other places to choose from.

text: This place deserves your business and all of your money! Don't miss the chance to try it. I was lucky to stumble upon it while in the area for work. You know a restaurant is worth a try if they can close at 2 PM in the afternoon! I had the "five" which appears to be their most popular, classic biscuit. The biscuit was tender and delicious, topped with a beautifully seasoned and perfectly fried chicken breast. The bacon and cheese were perfect additions and then the sausage gravy...awesome! Not gloopy and gelatinous like some other places. I was greeted warmly 3x by the loveliest man who must've been the owner and after being asked how everything was, I replied "this is so damn good!" I literally couldn't stop eating and felt so guilty about it later. I also had the hash brown stack which is awesome! With an apple mimosa, I totaled $23 which was fair and well spent. Without alcohol, my (very large and satisfying) breakfast would've been $17 and only $10 if I wasn't gluttonous and wanted to try everything! Long story short. Eat here.
name: Lémar

text: New Garden Chinese has the best American Chinese food I have ever had in Boise and it's very affordable.  The restaurant is nothing fancy and there are hardly ever customers there; for this reason I stayed away for a couple of months.  It's right by my house so I finally talked the hub's into taking me there and I am so glad I did!  The portions are very generous, the food is fresh and tasty, and the restaurant is clean.  My husband is a vegetarian and they have several vegetarian options.  We ordered 4 vegetarian egg rolls (yum! hot mustard and sweet/sour sauce!), orange chicken with pork fried rice, and general tso's tofu with white rice.  The bill was only $28 and we had leftovers for days.  Keep in mind this is a typical American style Chinese restaurant so the food is fried, they use tons of cornstarch to thicken the soup, and the sauces are not homemade.  BUT if you know that going in and you don't mind that I think you will like this place. For this price, I highly recommend.

text:

We walked here from Bourbon St so it was about a 20 min walk. Not bad if you're trying to sober up. We had it with mayo, lettuce, and added pickles. My bf and I split it because it was HUGE. I don't think I'd be able to finish a whole poboy myself - it's great for sharing. text:
THIS IS A REVIEW FOR THE SINEMA SUNDAY BRUNCH. We have long been fans of Sinema - the gorgeous art deco space, charming homage to it's roots with vintage films on the walls, the swanky Old Hollywood vibe, and (at dinner) the exceptional cocktails and food. At brunch? You've still got the decor. You've still got the movies. You've still got the chic. But you also have a very basic and unchallenging buffet that gives visitors no glimpse of what the restaurant offers during the rest of the week. You are a slapdash Bloody Mary bar with a few garnish options (but no cocktail skewers) and hot sauce. You have scrambled eggs, bacon, sausage, biscuits, gravy - the usual suspects. But that's not what makes Sinema a destination. I wish they would up the game just a tad...an interesting scramble. A cool veggie option with the turkey and BBQ panini? Something besides the basic breakfast potato? And - most important - staff that isn't frazzled to the point of guests craning their necks looking for service because they don't know who or what they can expect.

Listening, I really like Sinema. But the brunch leaves something to desire. For all of the staff frenzy, they should be producing a top notch weekend fun-day experience. Instead it's middle-notch all around.
name: Charlotte

text: Great food and awesome staff! Ordered delivery catering for a family get together and we were very happy with the delicious food and friendly staff that delivered and set up our food order!

I love how they continuously come up with specials because it makes you want to come back to try them. Compared to NYC the prices are dirt cheap. I go out of my way to make sure I stop here when I travel to Philly.

text: I usually love ordering from this place. Have spent a ton of money on food from them. Last night we ordered wings and some stuff for my kids. Not only was the person who took my order rude as hell and talked to me like I was stupid (which should have been a red flag) I continued to order. This place nickel and dimes you for LITERALLY everything. When you order wings, all places generally give you Blue Cheese / Ranch and celery. Not a crazy amount, but usually for every 12 wings a cup. NOPE, NOT HERE APPARENTLY! when I asked about how many they came with, instead of giving me a straight answer, I was asked "What menu do you even have?!" Moving right along. Tried to take advantage of the 36 wings for 24 price. But apparently because i was less than $3 off from the "additional $20 requirement" that wasnt possible. Now I only had ONE specification for my order, Well Done Crispy. That's it. Almost an hour and $45 bucks later I finally get my food. Low and behold.. soggy nasty wings. ARE YOU KIDDING ME?! For $45 bucks you clowns couldnt even get me Well Done wings?! I called in to see if the place would rectify the situation. I wasn't rude or nasty, THEN the "Owner" goes on the defensive. Then proceeds to give me a science lesson on the physics of making crispy wings and how the sauce makes em soggy. Really?! Thanks Bill Nye The Science Guy. What am I a novice?! I know how when one orders wings, the inner workings of travel and the effect it has on said food. Funny thing is, I order from other places all the time, La Bella, Pronto, Little Shop Of Pizza, and these places ALL seem to know how to make wings. And you could CLEARLY tell that they WERE NOT WELL DONE. Instead of doing what you can and even acknowledging the problem and owning up.. it's my fault. Ylu tried to place blame on me. "You were clear you wanted sauce on the wings." Ok?! And?! You're a place that sells wings. You should know how wings work and the difference between nasty ass soggy wings and Well Done. Couldnt even make it right for a long time customer. That's cool.. I wont be coming back. I will NOT be promoting you guys on my radio show again and I'll be bringing all my business with me. Thanks for nothing. If I could award you less than a star.. I would.

text: This restaurant isn't your typical hibachi. You just order it from the menu and they bring it to your table, instead of it being cook right in front of you. So our table used the Yelp check in offer to get a free app. We chose the Gyoza, and it was pretty good. We also ordered the sushi Caterpillar roll and the Spider roll. The shrimp were over cooked, and the yummy sauce wasn't that flavorful. Management was very kind. Overall I will return just for the sushi.

text: What a great find! All of the previous reviews are dead on. The food is fabulous, service terrific and prices very reasonable. We had chorizo and carnitas sopes, blackened grouper taco, poblano pepper tamales, barbacoa and carnitas tacos. The tortillas are soft corn and home made. The margaritas are made with agave wine instead of tequila and are very unique and delicious.  The owner was very helpful with my gluten sensitivity and made great recommendations for me. Oh, and the churros were to die for.  Highly recommend!  We are from out of town but will be back either this trip or next time down here.
name: Kathryn

text:
We wanted to get a Philly cheese steak while in town. So we decided to buy one from Geno's and one from Pat's across the street to compare. 

Verdict: Geno's fell short compared to Pat's based on taste and customer service 

The line was long but moved quickly. We waited a little bit longer to get our sandwhich compared to Pat's. Plus they don't cut the sandwich in half unless you tell them too (unlike Pat's). The employees were rude...they barked at me when I tried to order a Coke and told me I had to place the order at the next window further down...which doesn't make sense why there's a separate line for food versus drinks. We ordered a Philly cheese steak with onions and cheese whiz which tasted ok but the kicker was the cherry peppers were way too spicy for our liking. The cherry peppers at Pat's were the perfect amount of spice and vinegar tangy-ness.
name: Crystal

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. A very pleasant experience. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh.

text: We had a catering order for a wine maker dinner. We shared the wines and the chef did the rest. We had pastrami salmon and Chile chicken with an assortment of roast vegetables and finger foods. name: Ned

text: The 1st two times I tried this place it's was amazing. Then I tried it for a 3rd time a couple of weeks later and they started using that nasty precooked chicken. The fried chicken they put on salads is the precooked kind that is like bread. Think: Banquet frozen precooked chicken. After that I tried the grilled chicken... and it tasted like Tyson precooked grilled chicken. I love to support black owned business, but this is the one thing I hate that we do...we try to cut corners
name: Tamela

text: This is a fantastic sushi restaurant. The size of the sushi rolls were definitely above average as well as being delicious. One of my favorite rolls was the baked salmon roll; it was a good price for such a large amount of food. The service was also very good, the waitresses were constantly checking in on the customers. Sushi is definitely the specialty of this restaurant.
name: Savannah

text: The best BBQ I have had in along time, especially in Tucson! The food is delicious. Try the pulled pork (some of the best I've had) and the brisket. They will not disappoint. For sides, the mac n cheese, bacon chipotle coleslaw, and beans are spot on. Haven't tried the others yet. A variety of bbq sauces to choose from as well. Very nice atmosphere, friendly service, and delicious. You won't be disappointed!
name: JM

text:
In the past, I have had great experiences with this restaurant. My family often comes here during the holiday season prior to the shows at Hilbert. Unfortunately, recently I attended a work function at this restaurant wherein a three course meal was served and it did not go as planned. I ordered the filet (which was delicious) and had a side of the blue crab topping (that usually is on the chicken). There were two curly wire grill brush bristles in my meal. Both found in separate bites out of shear luck. It could have been significantly worse had I swallowed them and they punctured my throat. I notified the server and he had a very nonchalant response. 

Please be cautious consuming foods here, as it might result in hospitalization. 

A necessary side note: this could happen anywhere.
name: Alexandria

text: Yum food! Definitely will be coming back! The lady who was our server from Poland very friendly and charming has good knowledge of Turkish cuisine! She helped to pick some dishes like yogurt soup, we was not disappointed, never had any thing like that in my mouth- it's sort of spicy acidic dish, but at the same time you actually believe or not you are able to eat, and it's intriguing...  ( so,if you're ok with yogurt spreads and food like that)
name: Olya

text:
The great reviews at why I came for the chicken and waffles. I order at the bar and within 5-10 minutes my order is out. I'm surprised/impressed as they state that it typically takes about 20 minutes for fried chicken. Unfortunately there was a reason for the quick turn around. The food that I received was lukewarm/cold. 

Waffle was cool. Eggs had cheese sprinkled onto them and not scrambled into the eggs and The waffle was cold.  Being that I was in a rush I did not send it back. Hopefully this is not the norm for this place but it was a complete turnoff.
name: Raymond

text: Came in for breakfast with my family.  Our server was very friendly and offered us the specials of the day which sounded fantastic, but I ended up getting the Wyatt Earp Benedict, which was amazing.  My wife got the classic Heuvos Rancheros which was also delicious.  Our server couldn't have been nicer or more attentive, our coffees were always topped off.  Everything was reasonably priced, too!
name: Brian

text: Only do carry out. I've order from here a few times now. Never been less than a 1.5 hour wait for delivery.
name: David

text: My date and I went to Rocca on Friday night . We had a reservation for 8:30. The place was quite busy. The overall atmosphere is fun and well lit. Love the interior of the restaurant. We were sat around 8:45 .. we started off with two espresso martinis which were phenomenal. We order 3 appetizers.. the cauliflower, crudo, and meatballs. The crudo was by far the best. The meatballs and cauliflower were mediocre. We ordered the raviolini del plin for our pasta dish . It was good but nothing amazing . We ordered the cobia and lamb for our entrees. The cobia was mediocre as well. The lamb was delicious. Portions are small and meant for sharing . The dinner took about 2 hours overall .. each plate is brought out one by one . Had a great time and enjoyed my evening .. I would order different things next time around . Bill was around 200 dollars after food and a couple drinks .
name: Samantha

text:
I didn't think I liked this restaurant but I actually love it! I had the thousand dollar chicken ($18) and it was delicious!! It's within walking distance and I think I'll be visiting more often! The wine I had was great too!

Update : the recipe for the $1000 chicken has changed and unfortunately its not as good.
name: Sarah

text: If I could give zero stars I would....... my husband ordered a cheesesteak, pizza and chicken Caesar salad for us. They screwed up the cheesesteak and had mushrooms on it when it was supposed to be plain he had to go back and get a new one the steak tasted like dog food and hard to chew I don't know if they didn't care because it was getting close to closing. Then the salads had hard to chew chicken in it croutons were stale then to top it off since when does Caesar salads have black olives in it never. The food was horrible and when I got home from work at 10pm there was no one there lights were out already so I couldn't call and complain. All I can say it WAS A WASTE OF DAMN MONEY FOR SOME SHITTY ASS FOOD. THANKS ALOT CROYDON PIZZA FOR TAKING MY MONEY FOR FOOD THAT I COULDNT EVEN ENJOY
name: Krystal

text:
Not being from the area, we were looking for someone to cater a pool party lunch at the Circle Bar B a year ago and Henry at the ranch referred us to Jeff at Woodstock's. As we drove up from LA, we called over the phone and ordered 10 pizzas, a party size salad and some cinnabreads and scheduled for delivery the next afternoon. 

Because we were getting married that weekend we were pretty occupied with other happenings so we placed our order and hoped for the best, and we couldn't be happier with how seamless everything was. Not only was Jeff nice despite me calling him on his cellphone, the girl who took our order over the phone at the restaurant was super helpful and patient, and everything was delivered without a hitch. There were place settings and plates, our pizzas were cut double as directed and our order was complete and accurate. And the food was really good! Winner! Jeff even texted the day after to follow-up to make sure we were taken care of.

We couldn't enjoy it as much as our guests did given our circumstances, so we're actually driving up to have lunch there this weekend for our one-year anniversary just to tie it all together. Can't wait to see you, Woodstock's!
name: Sophie

text:
This place is expensive, and it used to be affordable. Not anymore!
Expect a long wait, and bar hoppers in the other room where people are waiting to be seated during prime hours. 
They used to be on Delmar by 170, but now they are in Brentwood and do not have the same menu. If you order off the Chinese menu, remember they are Vietnamese, so you will be given cheap things because you've basically insulted them. 

This place is solid, but used to be cheaper and better. Prepare to pay more for whatever you order.
I recommend the Pho because its truly worth paying for, and the spring rolls with peanut sauce are pretty nice.
name: Dave

text: People are being a little dramatic in these comments honestly. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. For the price I expected more than this. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text:
Consistently good. Been here once in person and once had an order delivered with GH. The order was estimated to arrive around 835-845, but I ended up getting it at 830 by a bike delivery person. It was prepped quick!

Food is good and spicy. My GF from china loves the spicy dumplings in chili oil and chengdu style hot and sour glass noodles. I can eat spicy, but with a change of clothes and a towel. The peppercorn hot oil makes my mouth numb and head hot. That being said, I loved the noodles and am a fan of the Beijing Noodles as well as the Double Cooked Pork Belly. The pork belly was nice and fatty. It wasn't over cooked and dry like you might experience else where and the flavor was delicious. There was just enough spice to make your mouth tingle.

All in all, it's one of the top picks for my gf who i would consider an expert in chinese food. If it's good enough for her, who am I to argue?

text: Such a let down. I use to love the truffle cheese fries and burgers here but today was one of the worst restaurants experience of my life. It wasn't super busy and nobody even looked at us for a good 20 minutes after we sat down. The truffle cheese fries were nothing like I remembered, fries were over cooked, the sauce is bland and there's only some poorly chopped green onions and plastic-like cheese on top. I had to ask for ketchup and didn't even get it until I asked 2 different waiters. Then the true nightmare came... the steak salad was beyond gross. The fried onions on top were dripping oil, the steak was so over cooked it's hard to chew and bland, and the vinaigrette was so sour that the salad tasted like nothing but pure vinegar. The only thing good about that dinner was my boyfriend's burger which is just decent. Rly disappointed, wish the old quality of eureka comes back.

text: Looking for a place to watch a game that wasn't very popular. Waitress at one "sports bar" wouldn't even try to change a TV to get our game. We left and went across the street to the Sporting Club. Wow - many booths with their own TV plus an open area with bean bags and lawn chairs in front of a huge TV. Lots of fun activities going on - like axe throwing! Manager was Enormously helpful in helping us to find our game. Recommend this place for a fun afternoon.

text: Nothing was terrible, it just never really came together for me. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. It was decent, just a little uneven.

text: We had lunch and decided to eat after a morning at the museum. We decided to share the pick three meats (pulled pork, sausage & brisket) meal, with the brussel sprouts and mac & cheese. All of it was delicious! Their BBQ sauces are all very good, with my wife and I liking the Carolina sause being a sweet heat and vinegary. A must place to go to for your craving for BBQ.

text: I heard Dat the cornbread was dry AF..... other then that the rest of the food was fire.

text: Great atmosphere and it looks like a lot of fun with a group of friends. Limited bar type menu but a huge selection of beers. Philly Cheesesteak was great as well as the grilled cheese sandwich.

text:
As vegetarians it was important to us to have choices on the menu from which we could choose. The restaurant didn't disappoint us, as practically every style of cuisine had a vegetarian choice for protein. We started with two cups of the Tom Kha soup, which was rich and flavorful. It's a staple for us at Thai restaurants, and we typically judge the menu based on how good the soup was. Out opinion was that this was the best Tom Kha soup we've had in the region.


We followed that with the summer rolls, which were cut into individual bite-sized pieces and plated with a dish of delicious peanut sauce. They were very light and tasty.

For entrees we shared the Drunken Noodles with mock duck and also had the Massaman Curry with tofu. Both were prepared very well and delicious.


The service was attentive and helpful, and we left feel very satisfied with our meal. A bit far for us but definitely a place we would come back to for another enjoyable meal.
name: David

text:
Ordered this on Postmates and it's a definite yes for me. 

#1 on my takeout list from now on. 

I'll add more later but don't want to stop stuffing my face.

text: Told about this wonderful place recently by an uber driver... it was a bit out of the way but man totally worth it. Thought I was a kook to get wings in New Orleans but this woman's wing sauce was incredible. Picnic tables outside and a very small dining room all in view of the superdome. Lots of offerings: fish, chicken, meat and some great cooking.

text:

You could tell we had some new staff, but she did great. Lamb shank was really nice.  They have a big wine selection which is unique.

Otherwise nice, will pop by for the tapas Tuesday.

text: Always good food and service. Clean and fresh inside. Staff is friendly and professional. We've visited the Reno and Roseville location and are always satisfied
name: Irene

text: Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Pretty happy with it overall. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Food was fresh and service was quick.

Great Urban Steakhouse sandwich and Shrimpkabob
Very reasonably priced - friendly service
name: Anthony

text:
Here's what makes a great restaurant for me: delicious food with quality (preferably local) ingredients, dishes I can't easily make at home, with good service and ambiance at a reasonable price. French and New American tend to be my favorite cuisines, so this place really seemed to fit the bill perfectly for my birthday dinner this year. 

We had the tasting menu, which at $45/person for 4 courses is a great deal. We were thoroughly delighted by every course! 

First course was 3 dishes to share: bay scallops (very tasty if a bit simple); beet salad with long hot dressing (so delicious, I'm stealing that dressing idea); house made duck country pate with cranberry mostarda (off-menu item that was BOMB); plus the house baked bread and cultured butter which was fantastic. 

Second course was a fresh cavateppi pasta with lamb pancetta, fresh peas, and a light Parmesan sauce, served with a house-baked ciabatta. This was off-menu as well and was absolutely delicious. 

Third course was a seafood stew with monkfish and a lobster bisque sauce that was just perfection. So comforting and a tremendous depth of flavour. 

Fourth course was a caramel apple crostada and a sorbet duo of grapefruit and pear. I'm not wild about sorbet in general, and also not wild about pears, so I passed this off to my husband and he devoured it. The technique on the sorbet was very good, but I had my eye on the pie. Goddamn it was so good. 

We would 100% come back for another meal in the future. My only criticism is that the meal went a little too quickly and I would have preferred a more leisurely pace - it wasn't a crowded night. I commend them on the quality of what they're doing; everything is scratch made and thoroughly well executed. Service was good and it wasn't too loud. It's a very cute little place and I think it represents what Philly does so well with food. Small, chef-driven, with a seasonal menu and ambition. It deserves the #1 spot in Philly Mag!
name: Abby

text: We were beyond thrilled with our dining experience! Our visit started on a high note, as the chef noticed our daughter at the table and walked over with mashed potatoes and proceeded to serve them to her and sit and chat with us.It's not often we feel so welcomed in high end restaurant with our 14 month old in tow. Then our food began to come, and every bite was exquisite. The scallops were delightfully tender, the crab Mac the perfect amount of rich and tangy, the mushrooms were excellent. Our meal concluded with the decadent perfect savory and sweet foie gras bread pudding. We can't wait to visit this neighborhood gem again.
name: Whitney

text: My review is strictly based on my experience ordering lunch to go. I was in the area and in need of lunch so searched Yelp and found this place. Average of 4 stars...it must be good, but I have to unfortunately disagree. I ordered a lunch special, which included 1 appetizer (I chose the mussels), 1 long roll (snow mountain), 1 order nigiri (salmon) and miso soup. The mussels were so over cooked and rubbery I could hardly eat it. The snow mountain roll was just ok...a little bland, but nothing that couldn't be fixed with a dip in soy sauce. The salmon nigiri tasted fresh, but again bland without soy sauce. The miso soup was nice and hot and tasty. The service  when calling in my order and picking up my order was good. All in all everything was just ok.
name: Mary Jane

text: Love the birthday piñata and all the freshly squeezed liiiiimes! Aaron is a great bartender. Everything was delicious. Tortillas, salsa and guac were the best we've ever had. The fajitas were amazing. Never once had to ask for more chips throughout our entire dinner. Patio was fabulous. Everything was shockingly fabulous. I worked in the industry for several years at both corporate and private full bar restaurants and also worked in catering for weddings and corporate events. I typically have low-to-average expectations for food at chain restaurants, so Julio's was a shockingly fabulous experience. We talked about the tortillas for several days afterward lol. Can't wait to go back.
name: Faith

text: Gambling first.What did ya expect.Getting a little dated.Food is ok.Drinking ok.Good retro live acts.
name: Steve

text: This place is delicious!! Just wish it wasn't as pricey and I would be there daily! I got the chicken salad which was amazing. The shop also carries Gooey Butter cookies which are to die for and broad ripple chips which went amazing with my sandwich. The gentlemen who took my order at the deli was very helpful, if only the cashier was as polite, it would've been a five star! No worries though, the food will have me coming back.
name: Brooke

text:
When you just want some great Mexican food without the hype of most downtown restaurants, La Parada is your place! I am still dreaming about their California enchiladas with fresh pico! I mean chicken enchiladas covered in queso!! Does it get any better?! 

The staff at La Parada is so kind and the decor is adorably chaotic. 

My only complaint is that the house margarita was too sweet. I'll either pay up for the top shelf margarita or stick with a beer next time.
name: Stephanie

text:
I had high expectations for Crispy Bird and had been trying to get there for about six months. Unfortunately my expectations were not met. I started with the biscuits with butter and syrup. They were good but not great. To go with my entre of fried chicken I got small plates of Mac n cheese and potato with morels. The potatoes were nicely done and the morels were nice as well. The Mac n Cheese which I added truffles to, was burnt and I couldn't taste the truffles. The fried chicken was ok and had a nice spice, but did not meet expectations.

The service was slow and unimpressive. I would say the staff spent more time changing the records and checking on music than they did checking in on our table.

Still trying to decide if I'll go back for a second visit.
name: Joseph

text: Tried to order from Wings on Fire yesterday, unable to get ahold of anyone to place a pick-up/ to-go order. We called multiple times, from different numbers between 4pm and 6pm Sunday. Very disappointing. As well, they do not have an answering machine letting you know you reached their restaurant -- might try again in a few months if they can get it together.
name: Austin

text: Ybor City has definitely been coming up on the food map in the SouthTampa area so I was excited that they had another Asian restaurant. I would definitely avoid going around the area at night but during the day time, it's nice to walk around and enjoy all the shops they had around. My boyfriend and I got the curry noodles (khoi soi) and pad see ew. The food came out super fast which was a plus. The curry noodles wasn't super flavorful and had an overwhelming peanut flavor and the noodles were too think to really absorb the broth while my pad see ew was supposed to have fried calamari on top but they were soggy and rubbery. I was surprised at how high the ratings were for this place because it's not that great.

text: The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Food was fresh and service was quick. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh.

text: The WORST shrimp fried rice i have EVER had!!!!! The rice was hard ass hell. The shrimp was even harder on the outside and rubber on the inside. The rice was yellow not brown. I thought I was eating Chinese food not Spanish food. The spring rolls were under cooked. Just horrible food. The customer service "SUCKS". NEVER EVER EAT AT THIS SO CALLED RESTAURANT!!!!!

text:
Lol - I'm only laughing cause this place was awesome.  It's gritty, has a shit-ton of history and the service was edgy but fun!  The food was excellent - pure and simple.  Those damn halibut chunks were amazingly addictive.  Haven't had an iceberg salad since the 90s and let me tell you, it rocked.  I forgot how good that little crunchy worthless lettuce was!!! ;). Anyway, it's a classic gem that's been here in Boise (as I understand it) for a long long time.  My customer who was up there in years told me his grandfather use to have "power lunches" there many years back.  The place was packed and then as the clock struck 1 - crickets. ;). It's definitely book marked.  Hope to get to get to go there again soon next time I'm here.  Memorable - period.  


Enjoy Boise.
name: Dunkin

text:
I come here sometimes on the way home from the gym and I typically get the same thing... Chicken Noodle soup in a bread bowl.  I love the bread bowl.  Not healthy but I don't care!  It's so good!

Now, my last visit was sad...they ran out of bread bowls.  Uhhhh WHAT?!?!  :(
That's ok, they made it ok by adding a couple extra pieces of french bread in the bag.  :)  That made my night!

I have been here plenty of times.  For coffee and somethings sweet, a bagel, a salad but you can get those things practically anywhere.  Typically I'm getting the soup in a bread bowl!!

text: I LOVE this place. Every meal I have takes me back to a fresh home made meal in DR. You get a lot of food for affordable prices. The girls that work there are always so sweet and patient. They will definitely continue to get my business
name: Sasha

text: Waited 2 hours for food and had to deal with the rudest bartender ever, calling his patron a 12 year old when she ordered a non alcoholic drink. Frankly, I'm disgusted. First time in my life I haven't tipped.
