text: It was busy by 9 AM today but we only had to wait about 30 minutes for a table for two. It was worth it. The sourdough French toast was SO GOOD! I want some more! Sausage egg and cheese biscuit was also yummy. Quick service.
name: Hannah

text: I ate at shells about 2weeks ago and everything was really good today a different outcome the shrimp tasted so fishy I couldn't eat it they must be frying all seafood in the same oil it even stunk up my car the toss salad was large chunks of iceberg and a pile of tomatoes total disappointment
name: Dorene

text: Went with family on a Sunday and it was louder than I expected. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Food was fresh and service was quick. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. You can tell they care about customer experience here. Overall, a strong experience. Food was good and came out fast.
name: User

text: I went here last week with a large group with no reservation. They still seated us within 5 minutes. I had their fuku wings. Very very good! I ended up ordering a second round and so did everyone else. I had the OBON ramen as my main course. The broth was very good. Nice and spicy. I would definitely order it again. I tasted the pork belly steamed buns. That was very good as well. I would definitely recommend this spot to anyone visiting Tucson.
name: Lavel

text: So this place was probably the best surprise of our trip! We had no lunch plans and our tour guide suggested we check out this $20.18 lunch. Oh my was this delicious. Started with oyesters which I'm not a super fan of but where very tasty, particularly dipping bread into the sauce. I had a Drum Armandine for my meal and my boyfriend had a filet - both where fantastic. Bread pudding dessert was also so perfect. $.25 drinks weren't too bad too! Servers where so nice and attentive - offered to give us a tour of restaurant and some history but we had to run to make the parade but definitely first on our list to return to when we go back to NOLA.
name: Jess

text: Really nicer experience. Servers were knowledgable and attentive. Service was exceptional. The food components blew me away.  Very unique and great favors.  We were served very quickly.
name: Brandi

text: I love the concept of the table top BBQ. We ordered combo B for 90 bucks. Seemed expensive but I thought it would be fun. The small bowls of rice and veggies just weren't enough and I got funny looks when I asked for more bean sprouts. One slice of onion, one slice of carrot. For the price can I get a few more veggies? Not very good customer service. The meats were ok but not real lean. The 90 buck combo wasn't enough food for 4 people. You'll have to get the 120. combo I guess but that is so much money.
name: Debra

text:
I LOVE the tea and coffee selection here. Plus, the staff is super friendly, the bathroom is always clean, and the WiFi is fast and reliable (better than any other local coffee shop I've been to). I don't order food very often, but when I have, Ive enjoyed the sandwiches. 

Another good thing is that you can buy the teas to take home and brew yourself. I love the peaches / mango herbal tea
name: Matthew

text: Omg!!! This place is a must visit. The donuts were amazing! I also got the smoked campfire cappuccino which came with a super cool presentation. The people working in the store were so friendly and welcoming. There's an adorable little patio area. I can't say enough good things about this place.
name: Emily

text: Best texmex in Nashville! Super cool joint and the food is incredible! You've gotta get the chips and quest too! So good!
name: Brandon

text:
$10 minimum on card. The bakery is right next to the Big 8 Supermarket. Had to check out this spot because people have been talking up the tofu banh mi. 

Yes, it is as delicious as others made it out to be. The bread comes out piping hot, crunchy, and delicious. Tofu has a delicious tangy sauce sauce on it and the veggies are all really crispy and fresh. Will be back to try the BBQ pork. This is straight up one of the best places to get banh mi here in Philly. Not the greatest milk tea though; the tapioca pearls were stale. 

Fun decor. Appreciated the random elliptical next to the drinks display case lol. Store could use a thorough cleaning... there were crumbs everywhere, and reused baskets for meals. Owners were really nice and offered to answer any questions we had about any of the other items floating around the storefront.
name: Abraham

text: We ordered chicken puff pastry, curry chicken and chicken muhkani. The puff pastry was decent but not worth the $2.95. The main dishes were good. The spice level was authentic. Don't order spicy unless you want a hole in your stomach!  My husband however loved it. He described it as "hurt so good". It hurt going down it hurt coming out. The bonus is any leftover sauce is great with pizza the next day.
name: Samantha

text: Blaze has quickly become a staple for my boyfriend and I. They are extremely helpful when it comes to dairy allergies, offering vegan cheese and changing their gloves. The pizza always tastes great, and the staff is friendly. Be sure to download their app to get rewards and coupons!
name: Aubrey

text: This is hands down the best Italian restaurant in St Louis. The atmosphere, service and food are impeccable. They could be located in a better area than a strip mall next to Goodwill for sure. The outside and parking lot area makes you doubt but once you step in, everything changes. I have been there over 10 times and I have never been disappointed. It is pricey but worth every penny.
name: M

text:
I decided to give Roe another chance after 2 years! It's Thursday evening around 8pm. The restaurant is fairly empty. The menu is basically the same. 
Surprisingly the service and timing of food were very good. I ordered the stir fry rice with chicken. Since I just returned from Thailand I feel I have a trained palate on this cuisine. I would have to give this dish an A for presentation and taste. 

Bottom line. Roe is very nice now. I may have to try again on a weekend.
name: Ray

text: Good fresh food and friendly staff at this Panda. Tried the new shrimp stir fry and it was yummy. The Beijing beef is always a good choice. Overall a great experience at this Panda.
name: Marco

text: Okay so I love the pizza and would highly recommend it. It is a little pricey for the area but worth it. They even have decent deals Monday and Tuesday. Unfortunately, at least half of the time we order something gets mixed up or delivery takes so long it's cold and not nearly as tasty. On the plus side, if you call they always are willing to fix it however you might not get to eat your dinner until much later.
name: Ashley

text:
Get the Porker! Meat on meat! You won't regret it!
I recommend splitting it, unless you are super hungry. They smoke meats onsite! Absolutely delicious!!

Love the outdoor space. We came here on a hot summer evening, with the fans and the misters we were completely comfortable sitting outside.

They have a drink happy hour Monday through Friday from open to 7 PM. Domestic beer, wine and liquor. 

Our server was really good! Knowledgeable and passionate about the food.
name: Sabine

text: I've enjoyed many lunches here, have tried many menu items, and have NEVER been disappointed! Excellent flavor, great service, and the prices are perfect! They make the best Tom Yum soup in town; you've got to try it.
name: John

text: Al's has always had great sandwiches. I come here every once in a while. I have just recently visited and nothing has changed. The food is still just as good and the place is kept clean and tidy. Everything is organized. The staff is friendly and there is always ample parking. I would recommend Al's to anybody. Great Stop
name: Lorence

text:
I have to eat gluten-free and I've never had an issue with their shrimp in lobster sauce. it tastes great and comes with a lot of very large shrimp.  Great quality!

They honored my special requests for the Singapore Mei Fun as well.  

They also have a very delicious looking Thai Iced Tea that I can't wait to try one day when I have more time!
name: Mila

text: Great happy hour and ambiance. Solid mix of bar and restaurant vibe. Irish music on Monday
name: M

text:
First timer and I'm pleased as pie!

I ordered the chicken salad salad, it's amazing. Also, it's huge so I'll have some for later.

The place is clean and doesn't have loud music playing which is nice for focusing. I work remotely and have had to leave lots of cafes bc the music is pretty overpowering. 

The guy at the counter was also nice as hell, great customer service. I'll be back next week for sure!
name: Lindsay

text: The best period...tacos or hotdogs it's my favorite spot when driving through or have to come work in Tucson.
name: Mike

text:
I like the atmosphere and the service.
The quality of the food is pretty good and I like the drinks.
I had an Old Fashioned and Our group shared a giant Moscow Mule which was pretty good too.
I had millionaire cut steak with a glass of Pinot noir.
I enjoyed pretty much everything and I like the level of customer service.
The parking for this specific location may be challenging since it's in downtown area so planning ahead would be wise!
Also during the week it has a more relaxed atmosphere compare to Friday nights and Saturday nights.
It may change your experience completely if you go for a nice quite place on a Friday night and pick this place.
I personally enjoy both so it really doesn't bother me.
Based on my experiences cactus club has been always on top of my list.
name: Shahab

text: So delicious!! Everything and everyone was awesome. Mariah was our amazing server and introduced us to the weird and wonderful cocktail of lemonade and espresso. Seems weird but is incredibly delightful.
name: Liz

text: This little stop off the Monon is not only adorable but has far more options than you could expect! They serve lunch there...I didn't have that but I'd give it a try! If you're going in the evening expect to wait in a line and for it to be warm in the house but honestly...welcome to any ice cream shop in the summer! It has a homey feel and customer service was great!
name: Erica

text:
This was a great breakfast place.  I will be back to try other items, for sure.  I was really surprised that this place existed but happy I got to eat their food.  Their onion rings look super yummy, a guilty pleasure of mine. 

The restaurant brought me back to a Long Island Diner I used to go to when I was a kid.  If you like Diner type foods and atmosphere, come here!!

The service was quick and friendly and we weren't rushed like Olive Garden.  It was laid back, friendly, clean and not too crowded.  

I look forward to coming back.  Thank you.
name: Brian

text:
Pass by this place daily on my way to work so I've been wanting to try. Finally went here today with my coworkers. It wasn't busy at all when we arrived at 11:30am. The inside is very country like -- wooden tables, country music playing and tv on the wall. Plenty of seating available. Drinks are self serve. Upon entering the staff greeted us and welcomed us to Hanks.  You order at the counter and they bring the food to the table. 

I ordered the pulled pork sandwich with collard greens-- the sandwiches come with 1 side for $8. It took a little bit of time for the order to arrive at the table. The pork was dry even after I added BBQ sauce to it. BBQ is on the table FYI. So I placed some on my plate for dipping as well. The bun was fresh and soft. Eventually I just ended up eating the pork off the bun and dipping in the sauce. The collards were good but lacked something. They were too juicy and you don't get very much on the plate.  My coworker had the quarter chicken--the chicken was HUGE! And very juicy. It fell off the bone and sort of melted in your mouth. But the flavor was not great. 

The visit was nothing upon average so this won't be on my frequent dining list.
name: Brigitte

text: Neidhammer Coffee Company has got it goin' on. Listen to all of this goodness--great coffee, a shared area with Ash & Elm, PLUS co-working/event space. A truly awesome idea. Neidhammer is basically Indianapolis's version of the hipster coffee shop you see in all the movies and TV shows. The coffee is bold and fresh. The tables are nicely spaced apart with adequate outlets which makes for the perfect, quiet, and bright work space. Parking is actually pretty good. There is a small parking lot behind the building, in addition to a parking lot across the street and street parking. As a new resident of Indianapolis's East Side, I will definitely be a frequent visitor of Neidhammer Coffee Company!
name: Emily

text: I was looking for steak on a Sunday afternoon and saw legacy kitchen in gretna.  Looked on Yelp and most reviews we good so in I go. Greeter and waitstaff were welding and prompt.  Nicole made helpful suggestions.  My steak and asparagus were very good.  I didn't add any seasoning to anything.  I added a lettuce wedge that was really one of the best I have had.  Yes the meal cost a bit more but I have spent twice as much at Rith Chris and left unsatisfied and hungry. Thanks for making my travel day very satisfying. I will be back.
name: Georgia

text:
3.5 stars for Bloom. Like another reviewer, I was also conflicted about how to rate Bloom. I really love their mission, the open and bright space, and the friendly employees. 

However, the food is okay and it can take some time to prep. I got a Blooming Platter, which has 2 breakfast cups made of a meat (I did 1 ham and 1 turkey) on the outside and an egg inside, topped with cheese. It was a filling meal, but nothing really stood out. 

They have a room that is available for booking a small gathering. It looks like it seats 15-20 people and can be closed off for privacy. 

Overall, I enjoy coming here for work meetings. It's usually fairly quiet in the mornings, and I like the calming and bright space. The food is just okay, but it supports a great organization!
name: Christine

text: Not the Longhorn I remember!  I ordered a drink with 2 shots of vodka and based on taste it had less than a shot.  Just two us, place not crowded but it took just short of an hour for a steak and salmon salad.  Food tasted OK but nothing great.  They drowned both salads in dressing, they hardly put any steak in my wife's salad and my salmon tasted very fishy.  Oh, then the bill comes and it's $72 without tip.  Wow, when did crappy food get so expensive!  Server was friendly so there's that...

text:
Meh? I liked it, but I like other restaurants like Nada better. I stopped by before a show at the Murat and I definitely recommend reservations. They were on a 1.5 hour wait on a Thursday night.

I've had the tacos a couples times but never wowed by them. I was thinking it was because I had them to go. But even the fresh fish tacos I had were good, but not great. I really had to add some sauce to them.

text: I couldn't say enough nice things about this place. The staff are all super friendly. When the employees enjoy being at work, you can bet that the atmosphere is laid back and fun. Bruce, Geoff and Oliver are really fun guys. Paradise is a Santa Barbara institution. A staple place that should always be on your go-to list when the inevitable question of "where do you want to eat" becomes an issue if indecisiveness. Choose Paradise. Great drinks. Simple yet delicious food. I love their black bean soup. The happy hour is also pretty awesome. Over all, this place is a big win in my book. I've been eating there for 30 years, and I'll continue to eat here as long as it's around.

text: Went to Fresh Kitchen for the first time this Tuesday. The food was amazing, the staff was kind, and the place was clean. Not only was the food appealing but the decor was just as visually appealing. My husband and I will be back.
name: Taylor

text:
Who doesn't love a good hot dog?

Yeah, the shape is unfortunate, but any concerns in that regard are mitigated by the taste.

When it's coated in a thick layer of superfluous vegetables, it's like a full-course meal you can eat all at once. You don't even have to sit down if you don't want to.

I don't know why I hadn't stopped by Mike's Hot Dogs before, except that the one I had was $6, which is a bit rich for my blood.

I could get a whole pack of hot dogs for $6! I wouldn't enjoy them as much, because I don't like preparing food, but think of how many of them I'd have. I'd be set for days.

I guess there's also the toppings. At home, I'd never put tomatoes and what have you on a hot dog, but there's a lot of things I do at home that I wouldn't do in a restaurant. (Putting my foot on the table, for example.)

I went with the Chicago-style dog, which is the first thing on the menu. There was a lot of tempting options, but I wasn't trying to spend the amount of time it would take to decide. I needed to eat right away, for emotional purposes.

Sometimes Chicago-style hot dogs come with a relish that's a bright green color that can't, and shouldn't, be found in nature. I was kinda disappointed to see that this one didn't, but what are you gonna do.

Also, I wasn't capable of identifying all of the vegetables on my dog, though that may have been the fault of the public education system. Thanks a lot, Parkway!

There were definitely tomatoes, a dill pickle spear, diced onion and some sort of pepper that had more kick than I expected. It woke me right TF up, and probably would have disturbed a child. If I had a kid, I'd force him to try one, for the lulz.

The dog comes with everything you'd need on it. The only things on the table were napkins and salt and pepper shakers. If I'd been thinking, I would have asked for ketchup. Some of the more obnoxious Chicago hot dog places are very adamant about not putting ketchup on a hot dog (which is delicious).

The Chicago dog comes with so many toppings that you can't see the dog itself. Initially, I was concerned, especially given what my parents were spending. But it was a pretty decent-sized hot dog, more or less the same length as the bun and slightly girthier than average. Ahem.

Overall, it struck a nice balance between mystery meat, nitrates, vegetables and bread--though I'm not sure if I needed any vegetables at all. If and when I come back, I might try one of the many other hot dog options or maybe a burger.

I also got fries, which were just regular old fries but with some sort of seasoning salt on them that I enjoyed. They were reasonably priced compared to the dog, like maybe Mike (if he's an actual guy) felt guilty about charging money out the ass for things that don't even go on a hot dog.
name: Byron

Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Food was good and came out fast.
name: User

text:
This is probably the worst pizza I've ever had. 

The crust had the taste of flour. . The vegetables were all canned. 

The cheese was barely cooked. 

I would have never thought that there could be pizza worse than Papa Johns. 

But if you need to eat after most other places are closed and don't have a car then your choices are limited. 

I should have made my Cup of Noodles.
name: Bill

text:
This is my go-to Mexican restaurant.  They are always busy and have great food and drinks.

It does not matter if you are just going for $1 Tacos on Tuesday or if you are looking for quesadillas; they have you covered. The chips and salsa are fresh and happily refilled if you happen to eat them all.

The staff is very pleasant and fast at taking orders and delivering the food. They will also recommend an entree if you get stumped with the menu.

 Vallarta's is solid. They consistently produce good food, with good service, and a fun, lively atmosphere. If you pass them up, don't. Turn the car around and go back. You will be happy you did!!
name: Steve

text:
This was going to start out as a one star review, however the management took care of my problem so friendly and so nice, that I bumped it up to stars.

I went through the drive-through earlier and checked in. I got a Chalupa supreme and a double wrap crunch supreme. I drove off after spending almost $10 on two items. I took a bite of the Chalupa and it seemed extremely short on meat. So I decided to check the double crunch wrap and sure enough as you could see in the picture, there is almost no meat in it.

No I drove back to Taco Bell through the Reno air races traffic, that was bad on its own. And when I brought the food in and showed it to the lady she explained to me that there's one scoop of meat in the meal, and I showed her what was inside. Mostly sauce almost no meat. And she was very friendly and offered to remake it or to give my money back. She apologized about 34 times. Was very polite and did not have any negative attitude at all.

If this is standard fare, Taco Bell needs to consider actually putting some meat in a item that cost five dollars. For almost $10, you would expect more than just a couple of tablespoons of ground hamburger meat.

I will give them another try, as I've had good success at this place as well as I do like the flavors of their menu items.
name: Tommy

text: This is one of my favorite burger spots. Today I switched it up and tried the Classic Crispy Chicken sandwich. The chicken was prepared fresh and was very crispy, however it could use a some seasoning. They serve real chicken breast. I didn't add any condiments because I wanted the full experience of the chicken.  Added condiments many enhance the overall taste of the sandwich. The fries were good as usual.

text: I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. text: One of our family favorite go-to's! The food is out of this world! So much love and talent goes into each plate. It's not your ordinary assembly line type of food, where everything is just as "normal" as the next place. The savory flavors and authentic spices are what makes this eatery an absolute favorite. I have introduced Chef Vargas to several friends and family and they, too, have boasted how delicious the food is. Compliments to the staff for having friendly personalities and happy-to-help kind of attitude. Tucked into a large condominium complex, it's location is a hidden gem. Relaxing and comfortable environment with trendy decor. We will continue to be a regular patron and support a prideful business. We love Chef Vargas!

text:
I love this place and despite what I am going to write about what I hate, we continue to go back a few times a year.  I was just there a few days ago with a party of six.  Here are a few of my observations.  

My cook Glenn, has also been my cook Joe.  Take notice to the names, they just grab a name tag. I've also seen Elvis be Joe, but like seriously Glenn?  I tried to make conversation.  They pretend they don't know English, but they've been working there for 10 years.  

The "Show" is stale and they work through it with no passion and don't even make it fun for new people anymore. I could care less.  I like my food fresh or i'd just go sit in the other room.

silly americans.  here take my money anyway i guess.

text:
The new ancient grains chicken salad is  a swindle.  1 cup of arugula?   That is not enough base.  It's also drenched in dressing so if your order it to go by the time you get it home it's a soggy mess.  1 cup of arugula, aa sprinkle of grains (maybe a spoonful at most) 4 thin slices of chicken, 2 grapes, and a few slices of apple.... how does that add up to a $10 salad?  I was still starving after I finished it and had to make me something else.

I will say the manager Robert was very nice when I called to... voice my concern that I thought someone made me a half salad instead of a full.  As well as being helpful locating my "not so rapid pickup" in the store, in their defense they had additional questions.  Robert is also the best manager I've seen at that store, helpful, friendly, and he seemed generally concerned (he even smiled and greeted people, which for this store is insane!).  

However I'm still very dissatisfied- this salad is just an overall soggy overly sweet bad design.

text:
Good Chinese food for Tampa. I have not found a better Chinese food option in this city. With that said the food is good, but not exceptional. 

In the past I have ordered the Spicy Chicken, Kung Pao Chicken, Sesame Chicken, and Curry Chicken. The Sesame Chicken, is fried nicely and prepared without too much sauce, in contrast to the fried dishes, the wok style dishes are too saucy. The best aspects of Chinese food cooked on a wok are the slightly burnt wok flavors. Because they use so much sauce the wok flavors are lost. 

Also some of the sauces are bland. For instance the Chicken Curry exudes a coconut flavor only, no spice, or depth of flavors. Lastly, in my opinion, none of the dishes here are spicy at all. Of course this is personal preference, but I wish they would implement that option and make Szechuan inspired dishes.

text:
A very enthusiastic recommendation on 'Where NOLA Eats' lead me to Live Oak Cafe this past Monday. Easy to get to, take the St. Charles streetcar to Oak Street (6th street past the bend) then just walk one block to the left.
I arrived about 10:30 and they weren't very busy, so while you are asked to wait to be seated by the sign when you enter, I was quickly told to sit anywhere I wished. I was quickly greeted, placed my drink order of coffee and water, and was given some recommendations off of the days menu.
I went with the suggested Sweet Potato Bacon Benedict with a biscuit on the side. I was informed that a fresh batch of biscuits just went into the oven and they would take 20 minutes, but if I wanted, there was one left from a previous batch. This honesty impressed me and I agreed to wait for the next batch.
The wait went pretty quickly thanks to the two person Brazilian Jazz band playing. Apparently they have live music most days, not just on weekend brunches. Nice comforting touch in my book.
On a side note, the coffee cups are a little on the small side but the attentive staff never let me see the bottom of the cup despite my best efforts. Also, they serve French Truck Coffee if you were wondering.
The food arrived and was visually impressive right away. Not a necessity for me, but a nice touch when the extra effort is made. First lets address the biscuits. Amazing! If that was all I ordered, the 20 minute wait would have been worth it. I've always been a person to just put some butter on the biscuits and dig in, but these came with a house made blueberry preserve that the waiter had high praise for, so I got adventurous. Life changed. It's as if these two items were created to go together.
On to the main item, the dish consists of two sweet potato medallions topped with marinated tomatoes, a slice of bacon, poached egg, and a basil & herb hollandaise sauce. While it was possible to note all the individual flavors, they all complemented each other and merged into something very special.
My intent this year was to try new restaurants every time I go out to eat but the overall experience here plus how many other things that were on the menu that day will make it hard not to make this my go to spot for breakfast. Also note that there is not a set menu , so some dishes might not be available on certain days. 
The dining area isn't large so the place will fill up quick during busier times of the day so plan accordingly so you don't miss this gem.
name: Kevin

text:
You know that Flawless song by Beyoncé where she goes "God damn, God damn", that was my exact reaction to every dish I had at The Lark. From the complimentary popcorn (cinnamon + Sage --are you kidding me? Best flavor combo) to the Grilled Spanish Octopus dish, everything we ordered that night was amazing right after the other. So many unique flavors yet they somehow all work. This place specializes in family style dining which is great if you have a group of friends celebrating a special occasion & want to try everything on the menu. 

Service was impeccable. Migs (our server) came through that night with all the best suggestions for our first time having dinner at the Lark. He never steered us wrong bc we loved all the dishes. Everyone who works there was so nice and helpful! The Lark definitely knows how to treat their customers & make sure they have an enjoyable experience. From the tiny details like having a birthday postcard for us to  having fleece blankets if you need them while sitting outside. 

Love the ambience, love the interior & exterior of the restaurant, the staff, open kitchen, and of course  the free validation on parking. One of the best dinners I've had in awhile where everything went right. Thank you Lark! 

Here are the dishes we ordered that night if you're interested knowing. Heads up, they do have seasonal menus so it might not be there when you go.

West Coast oysters
Hanger steak tartare--comes with a Budweiser which is so extra but I love it
Brussel sprouts
Juniper smoked duck breast--comes with a croissant 
Grilled Spanish octopus--MY FAVORITE DISH from the night! Stellar! One of the best octopus meal I've had in my life--so tender and flavorful!
name: Elisa

text: I had to go to the bar to get my own drink, the food was MICROWAVED, the Gyro tacos were stiff, dry, and the meat was crunchy! A few of my fellow diners had acceptable chicken wings or salads, but the rest was simply deep-fried bar food. If you have a favorite restaurant or bar that serves terrific bar food, please consider going there instead! Why take a chance on eating sub-par food when there is so many better choices out there, especially in Edwardsville. The waitress was nice, but at times we couldn't get her attention, even when she was standing at the bar about 15 feet away. Go to an eatery where they create dishes, not where they heat up food in a microwave!

text:
Came here after work with some of my resident colleagues to celebrate a friend's birthday. The location made it easy for us to trickle in as we got off work and it was easy to be seated. 

The ambience reminds me of my go-to college bar which is fitting since its in UC. I'd say less "sports bar" though since it is generally well-lit and the big screens are playing things like Harry Potter (!!) and Iron Man... not just the latest basketball or football game.

They have HH Monday-Friday 5-7pm which again makes it a great pick for after work. The specials aren't crazy ($1 off drinks, $7 appetizers) but the menu prices are very affordable regardless. The chicken quesadillas (which are on special) were a favorite and very filling. The nachos were pretty sophisticated  -- they were arranged nicely and there was diced red onion on it (not something I see that often on nachos). They had a good selection of drafts (nobody in the group had any complaints) and our server, Matt was very helpful especially with a big group with people trickling in.

All in all, I've definitely bookmarked this place for the next time I want to go someplace right after work in UC.

text:
We had a fabulous dinner at Tre Lune. Booked our table through Open Table and only got outdoor seating. First I thought it could be too cold but it turned out so beautiful & nice under the heater outside plus we were able to carry on a conversation because it was not loud at all. 
The server was very nice & friendly and so was the guy who brought the bread first thing to the table after sitting down. The variety of bread with the pesto dip was already a great start to a wonderful meal. 
We shared the grilled octopus as our appetizer. Hubby had the parpadelle ragu & I had the veal scaloppini with the lemon caper sauce & a half order of the pasta Alfredo. It was delicious! 
The prices seem fair too in comparison to all the overpriced surrounding restaurants. 
I would go back to this restaurant when back in the area.

The side was generous and it came with a scoop of white rice. It definitely had mild but good flavor and consistency.

text:
An awesome very authentic brazillian style steak house! Located in center city in a very nice area. There is valet parking and it is easy to find. If you are looking to try something a little different from your average steak house, this is the place!

When you enter, you will go through a revolving door. The staff are ready to take you and you are seated very quickly in a large seating area. 

The asthenic here is very beautiful. There are many decorations such as a wine bottle wall and many cool chandeliers that fit the place perfectly. The layour of the resturant is nice too, as it is easy to move around and get to the buffet area. 

When you first receive your menu, ghere are a lot of great looking options. You can choose to go basic and order a single dish from the menu such as a filet or chicken dish, however there is a better option. There is an all you can eat option that allows you to eat the the buffet as well as eat as much meat, bread, and garlic mashed potatoes as you please. 

The buffet has a variety of different fruits, vegetables, and cheeses. You can get salad and many other common starter folds like caprese salad. There were also heart of palm, which is an interesting food. It is basically the inside of a type of plant that is very tasty and sweet. 

Although you can gorge yourself with tons of stuff from the buffet bar, I would highly recommend eating less of that and gorging yourself on the many meats that are being brought around. 

The style of steakhouse sees a number of waiters who's job is to bring around different types of meats. This includes filet, bacon covered chicken, various cuts of steaks, sausages, and many more. All you need to do is flip your card from red to green and the food will start coming. 

The meats re presented on long swords and cut to perfection by the waiter right onto your plate! The different meats can also be cooked at different temperatures such as well done or medium based on where the waiter cuts the meat. 


The service is very quick and your plate will be cleared or full depending on what you want. There will be unlimited garlic mashed potatoes as well as cheese bread and the other starters that are on the menu. 

For dessert there is a large selection of different goodies. All delicious and a good sized portion. I personally ordered a creme bread which was fantastic and de definitely a great dessert. 

This restaurant gives you a really cool and very unique eating experience that is typically only found in brazil. It is really awesome and all of the food here is exceptionally good. I would highly recommend it to anyone who loves steak and a full stomach with plenty more on the plate!
name: Andrew

text: This was our first visit, but we will definitely be back! The food here is excellent...and so is the service! We had a reservation and were seated promptly upon arrival. The head waiter was very helpful making entree recommendations to a couple of members of our party. We were told that prime rib is a specialty at the restaurant and we understand why. It was cooked to perfection and the meat was very flavorful. We were pleasantly surprised when our waiter even replaced our initial au jus with fresh, piping hot au jus halfway through our meal! We will be ordering prime rib again, for sure! The NY strip steak, rotisserie chicken and sushi were also outstanding. My husband said the the strip steak is better than any he has ever had at the streak house in Radnor. My adult son doesn't care to go out to eat and rarely says he wants to go back to a restaurant, but he said he would love to eat here again. text:
First time customer at Blaze I was at the Richmond Heights location.  I've eaten at Pieology twice (love it), so I knew the drill of ordering a customized pizza.  The 1st thing I noticed was that they had large shareable pizzas but these were online orders only & they could be delivered.  There were two guys working the line and I chatted them up about the delivery area.  They explained that a delivery service was used so the area was probably very extensive, very friendly guys.  

So I finally got down to ordering my pizza and the 2nd thing I noticed was that the line was a mess, sloppiness of ingredients.  However I didn't let that deter me ( I figured it might just be the nature of the beast) I loaded up my ingredients. All good in that department.   

The gal who cashed me out was also the oven chef she was also very friendly.  I sat in the dining area to wait for my pie to be cooked; this area was pristine.  An employee was getting a drink & I chatted her up about the many choices of fresca's they had.  It turned out that she was the manager on duty and again she was friendly and knowledgeable.  

Saw that my pie was coming out so I went over to pick it up for takeout.  I had asked the oven chef to make my pizza "kind of" well done.  This ended up being a mistake for a thin crust pizza as the crust was definitely burnt.  I mentioned that it was way more well done than I expected but was not offered a replacement.  Oh well my bad, lesson learned so I took it as it was cause I knew I would be able to eat it despite being overdone.  

Overall I had a wonderful experience the staff was personable, the service fast and the pizza was very good.  I ate the entire thing in one sitting when I got home!  It would have been excellent if I had ordered the thicker crust & not asked for well done!  Will know this for next time and I will surely be back for a next time.  Kathy
name: Kathy

text:
Vista Peru had a table at an event and it's been on my radar since. Although, I probably walked by it's second street location many times without realizing I passed it.

We popped in for an early dinner on Presidents Day, and had a mostly private experience. It was filling up by the time we left. Atmosphere was standard Old City; long dining room with cramped tables. The look was pleasant and fresh, but this isn't a spot for atmosphere.

Being there early, we were able to enjoy happy hour at the table, which includes the array of pesco sours. Frothy egg drinks tend to freak me out, but they were well done and tasty.

We shared the causas pollo from the happy hour menu. This appetizer left a little to be desired. The avocado was on the side and the potato was a little dry. There was a creamy chicken inside as well. It could've been authentic, but just wasn't my thing.

My main dish is what will keep me absolutely raving and returning. The lomo saltadowas phenomenal. The beef was cooked medium and some of the most tender, well seasoned meats I've had in a while. The risotto complimented it well.

Taking leftovers and saving some room for dessert, we split the lucuma ice cream to get the local, Peruvian flavor. It was creamy and sweet. The perfect closeout.

A nice experience with some very memorable meat.
name: Michelle

Great across the board, from the location and decor, to the menu and food quality, to the friendly accommodating service--and don't forget the horseshoe pit and outdoor tables in the back. My new favorite place in town!
name: Jenna

text:
This is our go to place. Friendly staff good bar food
Big fan of the pear rosemary mule
name: Marcia

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed.
name: User

text: Always excellent service, amazing food and great draft selection. Decor is welcoming and cozy, ample bar seating with split interior and exterior sections. Has a large outdoor patio dining area as well. They also stay open till 11:00 pm on weekdays which is later than most likewise dining options in the area.
name: Jordan

text: I hate leaving bad reviews but if it means to save someone then let it be. I'll start with our server, she was great and very nice. My sweet tea was amazing! Icy cold and delicious, would go back ONLY for the sweet tea. The food however, didn't really meet the price standard. I ordered the Ahi Tuna and was disappointed, while it did look amazing on pictures and my own plate, the tuna texture was off putting, it almost felt like it was frozen before just kind of dry. Ahi Tuna is a plate I order at every restaurant I visit and offers it. I payed $23 ($3 was added scallops) for the seafood Sampler: Haddock breaded filet, 6 breaded scallops, handful of breaded clams, 2 pieces of garlic bread and the two sides. $20 without the scallops, it's not worth it unless you really like breaded seafood. I do not particularly like breading and the menu did say made your way but was never offered by the server.  My partners food came last after everyone was halfway done with theirs. Overall I feel it was too expensive and would not go back. Sorry.
name: Alberto J

text: For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Will be back. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: I was so excited to tryFabios place in Tampa. I couldn't believe how terrible it was. Everything from start to finish. We ordered a salad which took over 45 minutes. It was a chopped salad. When it came it had fried chickpeas which were so stale they were days old. The entrees came much later. The short rib was flavorless. The polenta was barely warm. The broccolini was not even broccolini. It was broccoli and it was so hard it was not edible. The pasta was over cooked and the sauce was so thin it tasted so bland. It was almost like they ran out of salt in the kitchen. The manager was very nice and saw we didn't eat anything but I expected a better culinary experience. Fabio obviously used his name and there is no control over what goes out to the guests. I was very disappointed. Even the warm bread is served with cold marinara that tastes like it came out of a jar. If it was room temp I could understand but it should not be cold. They focused too much on decor and missed the boat. The service and food were way off.
name: Mike

text: I am not sure where to start. We've been here a few days and a little tired of southern food and partying. Popped in here for casual atmosphere, a drink and a bite.  They did not disappoint!!! Service was awesome and OMG the food was amazing!! In a place where everything is dirty and deep fried and you just want to have a beverage and a bite this place will not disappoint!!!
name: Alicia

text:
This is by far my favorite restaurant in town, and part of the reason why I fell in love with Santa Barbara and decided to take my job offer here. The tapas are really creative (never thought I would eat raw beef but it was so delicious). The cocktails are fancy and tasty. 

I was most impressed by their service, because I dropped my fork in the middle of the meal, and one waiter immediately came by to pick it up, followed by another waiter putting a new fork on my table, all within 30 seconds.

My only small knock for it is that it can get quite loud in there, especially on Saturday nights. But other than that, be prepared to open your wallet and treat yourself to an amazing night there!
name: Jiaxin

text:
I have one for you.. 

I am home with my 11 year old, who is sick. I call Grubhub and they never picked up our food from La Casa Di Lucia. So I call and speak to the owner, nice guy (Joe). I get the scoop and cancel the order with Grubhub and then... I call back Joe. I apologise for not calling them direct and asking about delivery. Joe, the owner, on a snowy night, offers to bring the order to me.

I have to tell you, a lousy experience turned into a prime example of customer service. Without a doubt, they have my business going forward.

By the way, the food was still good after the longer than anticipated wait. 

Call these folks with confidence, they are good!
name: Thomas

text: Ended up here pretty late, maybe around 9:30, because everything else nearby had a wait. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text: Fresh toppings, chewy crust, spicy marinara at an unbeatable price with the app. Chef "leader" Jon adding to that value with the extra helping of olives and basil. Thank you, my dude. I needed those olives. Get that hot honey or fig baslamic. Yum.
name: Robin

text: Really beautiful interior. Has an old school kinda bar feel with lots of booth seating in the back. Service is a little lacking. Seems the servers avoid eye contact especially when you want a refill or the check. At one point we went to the kiosk by the bar to get our server since she didn't check in with us. The alcohol is all sourced from the local distilleries and the food, especially the aps, are great. The gumbo is my fav!
name: Jenna

text: Bern's is a staple. Come for the steak, stay for the french onion soup.
name: Grethel

text: This is a beautiful restaurant, elegant, yet you can be Tucson casual.  Went for lunch and it was delicious, service was outstanding.  As far as the onion/cilantro free appetizer, not amazing but a free appetizer and it is part of their culture
name: Pat

text: I love chipotle, but my god who runs out of guacamole? I get it's the end of the night, but then close at 9 if you're going to give me a COLD burrito. I ended up throwing it out and going to Panera instead, which is next door. Unbelievable. What a waste of 10 dollars.
name: Megan

text: Cute little place and good shrimp tacos and the waitresses were very nice but PLEASE don't call yourself a Mexican restaurant because that you are not! You might serve Mexican style food but it's not authentic Mexican food. But I will return for drinks and to see the waitresses again.
name: Juanita

text: I come here all the time and love it!!! The atmosphere is great nice people and coffee is amazing. I'm a college student and come here to study it's the perfect little coffee shop :)
name: Danielle

text: I had to change my review from our first visit. As we sat here for an hour waiting for our order, we watched 5 seperate customers enraged as their orders were wrong multiple times after lengthy waits. We watched people who came in after us receive their good and leave before we ever got ours. I really wanted to like this place, but we'll never be back.
name: Mandy

text: The first thing I noticed was that the staff there was pretty friendly and helpful.  At first I thought I was special, but every customer got the same bright greeting and excellent service. I had two scoops of the coconut explosion. The Ice cream was good, nothing special. I did not have any of the coffee, but looking at some of the coffee that other got while I was there, I wish I had. This place, like most in the area are dog friendly. Friendliness and great service go a long way with me and this place has definitely mastered both. If I am back in the area, I will definitely stop back by.
name: Tank

text: Excellent meal, very professional service. Atmosphere is extremely  cozy considering the tight seating.  Low lighting.  Very enjoyable experience overall.
name: Kathy

text:
Dalessandro's Steaks and Hoagies was a destination I was told by my girlfriend that we WERE paying a visit to when we arrived in Philadelphia. She used to live in Philly and Dalessandro's was the Philly place she took all her visiting friends to.  You know what?  This place is a great place to grab a sandwich!

We paid Dalessandro's a  visited on a Saturday night and dang....the line was not only out the door, but it was standing room only inside!  There is parking at Dalessandro's, but good luck getting a spot in front of the shop. There is street parking lining the road here though.  We found a spot that was probably a 2 minute walk away.

We ended up getting the cheese steak ($9) and a couple of Birch Beers (didn't catch the prices).  Expect a wait after you place your order, depending on the line.  We waited about a half hour but the sandwich was worth it!  

There's no being stingy with the meat when it comes to the cheese steaks here.  The meat is finely chopped and fills up the bread.  Cheese and caramelized onions fill out the cheese steak.  That first bite is ridiculous and i'm almost sad I had to share half of this thing!  You'll definitely want your own.  

Cash only at this (and seemingly many philly cheese steak spots), but if you don't have cash, no worries!  There's an ATM inside Dalessandro's.

At the end of the day, if you want a cheese steak from Philly and you're in the area, you really need to take the time to pay Dalessandro's a visit.  The only reason I didn't give Dalessandro's 5 stars was because without the cheese whiz it was slightly drier than with the whiz. The next time I'm back I'll change that, and likely bump up my review. 

Worth every bite!
name: Jamarcus

text:
Coquette is a small restaurant and the elaborate, speakeasy-esque bar takes up almost half of the small space. For a party of larger than two you most definitely would need a reservation, just because of the limited seating (not sure how the bar seating works but that would also be a cool place to sit.) This was my favorite restaurant that we went to for conversation and good food. The space was more welcoming, quiet, and cozy than any restaurant we went to. We had a sweet waitress and were able to sit for a while, talk, and just enjoy ourselves, something I think that can be harder to facilitate in some restaurant spaces. 

As a party of five we were seated towards the back at a round table that was not at all crowded despite the small space. The only complaint was that the large and old-fashioned windows made the place drafty and a little bit chilly--that being said we had particularly chilly weather for New Orleans, so this would not typically be an issue. The menu is meant for sharing, perfect to come with a family because you can try a little bit of everything. 

We ordered 3 small plates and 4 large plates for the 5 of us, given we are not huge eaters, it was more than enough. 

The favorite of the small plates was the butter beans. The were served with mushrooms and were incredibly rich but without the use of cream or too much butter. For main courses I really enjoyed the chicken schnitzel, which was thin, crispy, but not too heavy. The main courses are not really served with sides designed to be a full meal, I thought it was definably better to share. 

Overall a really nice experience--would recommend for the good food, and conversation.
name: Kate

text: Stopped by after work because I was nearby and hungry. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text: Lured in by the $2 drafts on Sunday. I thought how fun to have a quick beer in one of my favorite places. So, apparently it's really $2.50. Ok, no big deal. I order a Boddingtons. The kind of surly bartender doesn't know how to pour it, so I'm getting a glass full of foam. She works with pouring it into two other glasses until there is just enough beer to overfill a glass, which spills down the sides- which she thoughtfully wipes down with her fingers. She sets it down in front of me as it is still overflowing. I ask for a napkin, to which I am treated to a disgusted look and finally I get a couple of paper napkins to clean up her sloppy technique. I'm unsure how to proceed, but I think I will leave this note and pay in cash.
name: J

text: The victorious cheese steak rivals any one you will find in philly.  The mushroom meatloaf poutine was on point.  The jerky plate was great.  As far as the beer.  Well the 4 or 8 I had were great.
name: Joe

text: Called in order at 11:23, told them we would be having 10 people. Said we would be there at 1:15. The place was 60 degrees. We arrived at 12:45 and asked them to start the pizza. Let them know there would be 7 children. While we were waiting for our pizza, a young lady came over and said the tables we were at were reserved and could we move. We did. Then when my husband went up to get the pizza it wasn't cut like he asked. She was kinda short with him. This is the second time we've had problems with them at that location. Will not go back.
name: Rebecca

text: I had the falafel with harissa sauce and the shawarma fries. The Israel cabbage with the falafel was extremely well balanced. I highly recommend it.
name: Pete

text:
I had been walking around sightseeing for a few hours and I was really hungry, which is my only explanation for what I did next.

I bought the Trifecta, and I ate the whole thing.  By myself.  In one sitting. 

I regret nothing.

The Trifecta is a gigantic bar with a brownie layer, a chocolate chip cookie layer, and a chocolate covered rice cereal layer on top.  It is probably meant for at least two people to share.  Did this stop me?  No.  No, it did not.  

Did I mention that this was two months ago now, and I'm still thinking about that bar?

It's probably good for my waistline that I'm not local, or there would be more Trifecta bars in my future.  I might even consider sharing them.
name: Amanda

text: Portion size looked small at first but it was actually enough. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Anyway, it looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Anyway, the food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text: Food was ok but it took forever to get it!! Arrived at 9:45 pm and ordered immediately. Received appetizers at 10:30. Pulled pork nachos. Not difficult to make but super slow. Received food at 11:15. SUPER SUPER SUPER SLOW.
name: Caroline

text:
When we first arrived at the Beachcomber Resort on St Pete Beach, FL, the person at the front desk was great to work with and was very helpful with all of our needs.  After a few hours of being out and about we returned to our room at around 10pm to the strong smell of sewage inside our room.  We went to the front desk and requested the manager on site.  The manager came forward whose name is Donna, and offered a fraction off the room.  We explained to her that the sewage smell was unlivable conditions and she kept offering me $50 off the $271 room.  I told her to walk to the room and check it out for herself, but she kept on with the small discount.  After she refused  a full refund  multiple times , I told her that I'm getting our belongings within 10 minutes and we will have to leave if something isn't taken care of.  We returned to our room to gather our things, and within 5 minutes Donna knocked at the door along with two maintenance workers who had a turbo fan and spray chemicals.  After I opened the door, they didn't ask to come in, but they did.  They immediately set up the turbo fan and sprayed the entire room with chemicals, which made it much worse.  I turned to Donna and told her that this is not acceptable, and that is when she started threatening me that she will call the sheriff. The whole time we dealt with everyone at the Beachcomber Resort, we never raised our voices, never used profanity, and never made threats whatsoever.  They didn't have a replacement room due to 100% capacity.  It was at this time that Donna was making it very clear that we are not welcome there and was basically asking us to leave. We paid $271 for a room that smelled like sewage, which later on was sprayed with unknown chemicals, and an extremely loud turbo fan set up in the middle of the room, and Donna, the hotel manager expected us to stay there. I have video of this as well.  After threats of calling the sheriff, we left the premises, as we were doing anyways, not needing threats of police presence.  We then UBER'd home, as we are locals to the area. We got home right at midnight of the new year without being able to use what we paid for.  We were treated with extreme disrespect.  We were expected to put up with unsanitary and health risk conditions.  We were threatened multiple times for no reason, and not a single apology or decent solution was offered.  It was very apparent that Donna was using her power of the hotel manager position to get us off the property asap in order to avoid accepting fault, and to save face.  

     As locals to Saint Petersburg, we've been to just about every place in the area, and have never been treated as poorly as we were the night of 12/31/2018.  I'll be sure to pass on the experience we had to all my friends and family, along with all my social media forums and sites that I make reviews on.  If management wishes to discuss that evening, they will have my contact info via BBB.
name: Joseph

text: Had a blast here the one time we came. Would love to go back, but being so far away it rarely occurs to us to venture out there. I loved the modern twists on Asian classics. Lighting is crazy dark, but it obviously works for the venue's ambiance. Good drinks, cheap, and overall great value.
name: Keith

text: Outback used to be our go to steakhouse. Sadly the quality has diminished at all that I've eaten at. This one my nephew's rare steak came out well done, my medium rare steak came out med well and my sisters steak was cold but cooked properly. My niece got Alice springs chicken and had no complaints. We returned the overcooked rare steak but dealt with the rest...we just didn't feel like waiting for the replacements. Food was good but inconsistent in terms of doneness. Not my favorite place anymore.
name: Megan

text: Simple you want the Best you go to the Best Pat's King of Steaks! Now they have delivery all over United States!! I was the first to order in the USA! Hey Philly Michigan says Hello
name: Buck

text: I like their mission but honestly their BBQ wasn't anything I'd go out of my way to have. Cornbread was wet and soft, which I don't like. Their sandwiches and sides weren't all that comparable to what I can get at Arby's or KFC's but cheaper.
name: Jenny

text:
If you have been following me, then you know, I have been on a hunt for the best-tasting pit beef sandwich. We came here tonight for the first time hoping to find one. I'm sad to report, we did not find what we were looking for. However, the food was absolutely amazing! I walked in and told the guys behind the counter what I was looking for, they offered suggestions and chatted with us about back East foods LOL. They were very friendly and very helpful. They seemed to know exactly what I was after, and told me their brisket sandwich would be the closest thing, but not quite it. They gave us a free sample to try before we purchased. I got the beef brisket sandwich with fries, and my husband got the ribs and potato salad. The food came out quickly to us, and honestly tasted pretty darn good. 

The restaurant is small and can easily be missed unless you have it pulled up on your maps. They have two televisions going for your viewing pleasure. The staff was pretty casual and super friendly. They made sure that you felt right at home. The pricing wasn't bad and the portion size was good too.  If you're looking for some really amazing BBQ, I suggest you get your booty over and check this place out! We cannot wait to return so we can try out some of their other dishes!
name: Dj

text: Food great! Service not there. I have always always enjoyed the cooking . I never felt a warm welcome .
name: Phyllis

text:
I ordered oysters and twin fish tacos with a sangria without sugar added. You would be surprised how many restaurants can't seem to get a simple order like that done, and it be good. 

Well. they excelled on both points! I like the casual atmosphere and prices. Plus they have specials most weekdays. i look forward to coming back again!
name: B

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Maybe better dine-in than delivery, hard to tell. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text:
If I could give Figs no stars I would.

****Future patrons I suggest you avoid this establishment unless you wish to also be disappointed and racially profiled.

I came to Figs from out of town excited to try  there tea, coffee and dessert.As soon as we arrived to the nearly empty establishment and asked for a table for four we informed the server and (I'm guessing the owner) that we were here for dessert and coffee. She took back the menus and said that it was dinner only. However the menu posted outside did not specify. 

It was clear that we were basically denied service based on the abundance of Melanin of our group Minority's are clearly not welcome in the Mediterranean establishment.  I am sad to post negative reviews for what could have been a very delightful evening.
name: Jessica

text: For this to be creole/Caribbean restaurant the food was mediocre. The hostess had to go ask if we could be sitted after finding out we didn't have a reservation, even the the place was maybe 1/6 full. Weird, right. We went on a Friday night and got there doing the last 45 mins of happy hour. We started by ordering the cigar cubanos, jerk wings, and the crab empanadas.  The cigar cubanos were tasteless, the jerk wings needed salt and were not spicy, and the crab empanadas were fishy tasting instead of crab.  For dinner we ordered the beef tenderloin which had fat and a piece of gristle on it(wth is that about), the shrimp and grits which my daughter thought was good, and the tuna which was unflavored. The mashed potatoes were just that, mashed. The cup of gumbo I got was the best thing I tasted while there besides the drinks. All in all, I wouldn't recommend this place unless you never cook at home and never had authentic creole or Caribbean food.
name: Bianca

text: Awesome Cuban sandwich and amazing service! Nice separate coffee bar with great lattes. Highly recommend this for both breakfast & lunch!
name: Abby

text: Crowded and unwelcoming crowd of college kids. I used to go to Rowan and went up to visit some friends. The bouncers were rude, and stared at my ID for a solid two minutes to determine if it was fake. Walking inside, I felt like I was ice skating - the ground was covered in spilled drinks and soaked napkins. At 10pm on a Friday night, you couldn't get anywhere near the bar in this place. It took 15 minutes to get one drink, and after that I wound up leaving because I didn't feel like waiting for another.
name: Allie

text: If you are craving authentic fresh gelato, then look no further you've found the right place. The owner, Ria, was wonderful to speak with. She let us try the gelato prior to ordering. I ordered the Nutella Crepe and Strawberry gelato. It was freshly made and a perfect combination. The gelato is made in-house with zero preservatives, artificial flavors, artificial colors etc. They make small batches and use whole fruits too. I had the strawberry gelato which had bananas blended in and it made the flavor so much better. I was here visiting NOLA for Jazz fest and craved Crepes with gelato, so I decided to give this place a try. I've tried tons of places since I work and grew up in NYC. Trust me you won't be disappointed.
name: Anthony

text: This restaurant is super nice! The inside looked modern and semi-fancy. Went in on a Sunday night for an early dinner and had great quick service. I ordered a glass of white wine, the salmon and toffee molten cake for dessert. Every item tasted great. The salmon tasted fresh and crispy. It was a little too much buttery for my liking, but still all in all was good. The dessert had a good amount of sweetness. Portion sizes of all the dishes are on the smaller size, but don't let that fool you. The food is rich in flavor, and won't leave you hungry!
name: Subhadra

text: Impeccable service & excellent food! Love this place. The ambiance is wonderful. Best red ever!
name: I

text: Reading some of these complaints now feels a little overblown. The food was good and the service was easygoing. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. I had a better visit than I expected to. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. For the price I expected more than this.
name: User

text:
I bought the mushroom steak with cheese wiz. This cheese steak was good but I think I would've opted for the provolone next time. The bread was soft but not too soft. The steak wasn't seasoned, which is why the 4 stars. I would've liked a little more flavor in the steak, but overall good. 
I didn't have a long wait at all, I went in a Friday right when they opened and i was one of the first customers. The staff was very friendly and helpful seeing as though I was a first timer.
name: Candice

text:
My first time at the eagle was a success! We had a reso at a different place but figured we'd check the wait here as we have heard good things. We were seated about 25 minutes after putting our names in so not bad for a Saturday night. 

The menu definitely had some good options. Everything is a la carte. My girlfriend got the chopped salad that was pretty good (nothing on Portillos chopped) and I had to try the chicken sandwich which was also very good. We split a sweet potato skillet as well as kind of a dessert as it was very sweet. 

Prices were very reasonable as well for portion size. I will recommend this place for sure!
name: Sam

text:
I love the food. but for God's sake, spread out my ingredients!!!
I love having one slice all bacon, then all mushroom on the other side. a pile of sea salt in one spot, and a mound of oregano in the other area...
name: Alex

text:
The best oysters we have ever had! My boyfriend and I stopped at Res Fish Grille on our recent trip to New Orleans after having it recommended to us by a couple of locals. We absolutely loved our experience. The wait staff was very attentive, and every plate we were served tasted amazing. So flavorful and authentic to New Orleans cuisine.
We will definitely be back to Red Fish Grille on our next trip to NOLA!
name: Carolina

text:
Things I love: if you have an Italian family, or grew up in an Italian neighborhood, you'll adore the wait staff. It's like being at Tia's or Nonna's. 

That said, we have a few differences of opinion about the pasta. It's  fresh and delightful... so the controversy is more around the filled pastas - the ravioli,  and the cannelloni. The cheese ravioli is absolutely decent,  but definitely not special. Neither is the diablo sauce. The cannelloni florentine with ground veal is delicious, but again, the shell is underwhelming.

Something an old school Italian (we're all italian, but the patriarch) loved is the veal parm. Literally ate every scrap and raved. So that's apparently a must-have. He's very trustworthy!

We find ourselves here fairly often with friends, and we try new things every time, just to be sure. The chianti is fantastic! And again, we love the servers. So take all of this then decide for yourself. But remember,  recommendations have been made!
name: Peace

text:
During our visit to Nashville, we sought out Five Points Pizza based on all the glowing Yelp reviews.  My husband and I are definitely​  pizza snobs after spending a lot of time in New York.  Five Points is very close to NY pizza.  Our slices were flavorful, thin, and just the right crisp to the crust.  

We had the 2 slice pizza & drink lunch ($9).  The slices were huge an the price was very fair.  We both had the Meat slices.  We are so glad we went to this little gem and it easily satisfied our NY pizza craving with the flavors and crust.
name: Monica

text:
Very busy on Sunday. No greeting at door. Went to counter where there were a few hot plates of food. Only soup and pork and rice. Still no greeting. Finally , after we initiated, we were spoken to. Chose to sit at table. 
She (I) said :" Baby can we leave. They are taking to long to come to table, and I am hungry and not in mood for this noise and chaos."

He said" I actually like this place"( he had eaten there in past.
Well, the waitress came shortly thereafter- orders came to table within 10 minutes. ( Yes, I was submissive?! Lol) Loads of food. Pechuga de pollo ( grilled chicken breast with onions, rice , beans, fried yuca and fried potato, and plantains). Well worth $12. I ate food for 3 meals. Plenty of meat! Rice and pork he liked. Fresh juices were nice to quench our thirst ( so hot this week!)


About 10 or less tables. Not fancy. Great food! Service good once they got started.
name: Chelle

text: I hate to write this review because I love the idea of a healthy place within walking distance. Both Burlington and Mercer counties have so little healthy places that I really didn't want to write a bad one. However, the place is very pricey for what you get and the food takes forever. I've waited for over twenty minutes only to be told they actually didn't have all the ingredients. It shouldn't take that long to figure it out. The smoothies are really good so I do recommend them. However, I don't think anything else is really that impressive.
name: Stephen

text:
I found this place while searching for lunch. The reviews and food pics looked great. I was not disappointed. I got the crispy skinned pork belly over of rice and beans. The food was out of of this world. The pork was crispy but still juicy and the rice was very flavorful. 

The hardest part about this meal is the restaurant is definitely more geared towards Spanish speaking clientele. I do not speak a lick of Spanish and was thrown off by the lack of menu. I had to kind of just point and ask what stuff was. The young woman working the cash register was a sweet heart and did speak some English. I wish I knew more what my choices were but was happy with what I had. I will definitely be visiting this place again.
name: Christopher

text: I love the Berry's crepe and I would love to come back and try more of other sweet types of crepe. it's fresh and soft. Egg Benedicto was just OK, I don't really like the smoked pork or ham inside of it, too salty to me and, I don't like the kind of the raw fat flavor.

text:
I really debated the rating on this, and decided to go with four stars because of the GREAT beers they serve here, the comfortable ambiance, and the friendly service.

I have been here a few times - once for one of Paul S' fabulous beer club events, and twice for a meal. The beer choices are wonderful from the light blondes and ales to the burly porters and stouts. They also have a great mix of local craft brews and authentic imported European beers. All are served in the appropriate glass ware for the style.

The space itself is comfortable with brick and dark wood and Bavarian decorative touches. Nice mash-up of new and old world. It is also bright and open with the large windows across the entire front of the space.

The service has always been friendly and they do a good job of monitoring when you might need a refill or when service items need to be whisked away. On our last visit, the sausage sandwich I ordered was just not to my liking. It looked undercooked and the taste was a little off. I let our server know when she came to check on us and offered something different. I decided to just feast on the delicious fries and grilled onions and peppers that came with the dish. When our bill came, my meal was completely taken off including my beer. It was not really expected, but greatly appreciated.

As mentioned above, the food was just OK. My husband had the Chicken Cordon Bleu sandwich which was good, but not outstanding. The fries, however are fantastic. These are some of the best I have ever had in Reno. 

I would definitely come back again. Their Happy Hour prices are very good and having a beer and an app would be the way to go.

text:
Our extended family stopped in at Slow Burn this evening. We are from Chicago and new to NHC. I'm so thrilled that we did. In summary, the food is fantastic, but even better is the family that owns this wonderful gem. It is a rare treat to sit and dine with owners who are passionate about what they do and so welcoming and caring of their patrons that I left full of joy and looking forward to returning. Thank you Jasmine, Joyce, your husband and the whole crew!

Now, onto the food. 

Chicken breasts, wings and more all cooked to perfection. The sides from the gouda mac n cheese to the okra to the sweet tea were fantastic.

Most of our party landed at the middle of the scale with Singe. A couple of us grabbed Southern Spicy for a lite burn but more flavor. Despite multiple warnings, I opted for an extra, single wing, done with The End.

After fully enjoying my Southern Spicy, my kids grabbed a glass of milk to prepare for my consumption of The End. How hot could it be? Jasmine the cashier already told me don't do it. Joyce, the owner, comically asked me if I was having a bad day and that she would get milk ready. And the kind gentleman brining out our food paid the wing a healthy respect. I think he may have even been wearing gloves.

Armed with my wing prepared with The End, a glass of milk, a glass of sweet tea, a fork and a knife, I cut into the wing while our party of 9 looked on in anticipation.

The flavor was fantastic. Rich, smokey and full of spice. I chewed for roughly 30 seconds, taking it in, enjoying the flavor and then delightfully downing the savory bite.

And then it hit me.

Never in my life have I experienced the heat of a pepper like this. We've all seen the YouTube videos. We've all wondered how it is it really? It was hot. It was almost frighteningly hot. My eyes began to weep involuntarily, my cheeks were flush and my mouth and throat were on fire. I let it linger as long as I could and then began the sips of milk and sweet tea. For a solid 15 minutes my world was rocked and I got to experience the spiciest pepper I've ever had in my life. And it was fantastic. And the flavor of the chicken still came through. But every warning was correct. The End is serious heat and commands a ton of respect. 

So if you are looking for fantastic NHC, come support this phenomenal family business and get your hot on. But when Jasmine at the register looks at you and questions your choice, maybe heed her advice.
name: Kevin

text:
The PALM Integrated healthcare was a treat for me (after a car accident). 

They have various membership levels including (drum roll please) a 1-day membership!  So, I spent the day and paid $75 for the one day mermbership which gives one treatment and I chose the "meditation treatment in the salt room".

TIP:
The PALM Integrative Health does accept (some) insurance and host classes regarding various aspects of healthcare. Nurses are on staff. Certified therapists also. Exercise and Nutritional classes as well. Reminds me of the TV show private practice.

This POWERFUL salt room meditation is instructor Lead. She guides you into a 45-minute meditation practice while breathing in the purifying salt with touch and taste engagements.

I enjoyed myself immensely. 

I started my day of membership off, by ordering lunch (not included in the membership). I enjoyed the advocado with egg on toast! It took me a while to learn how to eat it (hands or fork & knife?). I tried both. It was messy so, I went with fork & knife. The brunch crowd was starting to get thick and I didn't want anyone speaking negatively of my eating habits. SMILE

After lunch, I visited the steam room and infrared sauna. It was very comfortable and much needed.

See the pictures. There is a hyperbaric chamber, cryotherapy, meditation room and much more.

Definitely visit! Take a family member or someone you know with ailments. HECK, just go to relax.

Don't forget to visit the restroom...it has the Asian toilet with seat warmer, bidet, etc. Ahhhhhh

text:
Everything I ate here was DELICIOUS! We went here on a Frisay night and had not trouble being seated quickly. The restaurant is very long so if you are walking up the side alley to get in you will see all the happy people eating.

My friend and I got a few things to split, here is the breakdown:

Scallop Ceviche: This came with a side of hot sauce that just made it when poured over. It was cool and refreshing with a nice crunch, it was also super tasty.

Beet & Melon Salad: This was definitely different from salads I have eaten before but it was refresshing and a unique twist.

Huarache de maiz azul: This was basically some toast with a variety of charred vegetables on top. With this one don't stop at the first bite when trying, it gets better with each consecutive taste!

Chocolate Pastel: Basically a light chocolate oil cake, they add on a berry sauce which made it a nice light dessert.

Flan de Queso: This was basically a flan with cream cheese and oh my god it was amazing! My mouth was in flan heaven and watering with each bite! Pretty sure I will dream about that flan.

The one thing that was a bit off was our server. He was very nice and friendly but didn't seem as well informed on the menu and had to being other staff members multiple times to describe what things were. This could have been because he was new, not sure.

Overall amazing and can't wait to go back!
