text: This store gets more stars because of the friendly lady at the drive through window. She is always very friendly and has a nice smile. In the past I have had no major problems with this location, however today was different. I ordered a whopper with no tomatoes and no onions. It tasted like it contained onions, and upon inspection it was clear that tomato seeds were in the sandwich. The staff had just taken the tomatoes and onions off of a pre-made sandwich. On the positive side, my sandwich was ready in record time! Although my order was technically correct, this is no way to run a business. Now we know why it's always so easy to find a parking spot here.
name: Andy

text:
Pound is pound there is no better breakfast in the city of New Orleans and YES Algiers Point counts as the city is New Orleans, moat of the places thst you hear about are HONESTLY just overrated tourist trash that are waaaaaaaaaaaaay more hype than substance *Mothers, Oceana and Ruby Slipper I am talking to YOU!

The service is straight forward and personal, by the second time they meet you they already know that your name and have a feel forgotten what you might want, they are FAST, humble, clean and personable, not to mention the the food is DELICIOUS and second to NONE, if you want breakfast in New Orleans and if this place aint your first pick, then i apologize for your ignorance but guess what?!? 

You know better now!!!! So do better with the places that you dine and support REAL people that cook with heart passion and love, and your taste buds will thank you for it. Oh and before i forget its cash only, but they have a ATM on site so its all to the wholesome goodness like wonder bread.
name: Sunday

text: Just get the grilled oysters w herb butter and relax in the roof top patio. Slow service but the view and food are incredible. In the French Quarter near lots of cool shopping in the French Market.
name: Kimberly

text: The fries were probably the best part of the meal, honestly. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Kind of landed in the middle for me.
name: User

text:
No really!! Needs more improvement!!
Hmm ..need more dedication to learn about a great great hamburger..I don't mind about the price..y love quality!!
name: Esteban

text: Food took forever but ended up being better than I expected. The music was louder than it needed to be. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated bc we didn't have a reservation. I left full, which at least counts for something. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed.
name: User

text: First visit, decided to give it a try while in the area and found it had good reviews on yelp.  Was disapointed with my meal, had the bananas foster french toast and found it on the dry side.  My husband had the breakfast burger and he enjoyed it immensely.  I found the prices on the high side and it had a "chain" feel to the place.  The server was ok but a little too friendly, except when it was time to leave, I had to ask for the bill. Probably won't be back for a second time.
name: Chrissy

text: Good Ma &Pa style sandwich shop. Never disappointed here. Well worth ordering for a lunch or dinner. The owners are very friendly and welcome you with a smile.
name: Anthony

text: Me & my husband chose Brasserie for our anniversary dinner in memory of our honeymoon in France. The restaurant does online reservations which was super easy. When we arrived we discovered that they have a happy hour from 5-7 with $4 house wines and other drinks and apps. We joked that those wine prices were just like being back in France. Our waiter was very nice and attentive and made the dinner an enjoyable experience. We order the chicken and escargot that was recommended, along with the French onion soup and a side of frites. Everything was delicious. The escargot did not have the way-too-rich taste that I get from most American restaurants and the aioli with the fries was amazing. We finished with ice cream, which I believe is made at the restaurant. I recommend this restaurant for special occasions or just a happy hour drink.
name: Jade

text:
Most Chinatown restaurants are quick with their service, but one rarely gets a greeting or a smile from the staff.  Indeed, there are restaurants that I go often, that they remember my orders, and that I tips decently (20%) - and I still see frown faces.

So, this is a nice change in this restaurant - which the waitress was friendly and with a smile when taking order.  And also inquiring whether I want water or tea.

The beef noodle is good - with quite a bit of beef, brisket and meatball.  The beef is tender, and the meatball is al dente.  The broth and noodle are decent though not wow.

They do takeout, and like most if not all Chinatown noodle shop- they will separate the soup and noodle if requested (keeping the noodle al dente)

Overall, it is a 3.5 but given that they were willing to accept $11 for a $11.34 bill - as they didn't realize that I have change.  That gives them a 4 star.

One thing that they may want to consider is to provide ice water versus lukewarm water.
name: A

text: The best place ever. I cannot stop eating. If anyone is looking for a place to eat many good food it should be slacks hoagie shack. I have a huge variety of things on their menu and the cheesesteaks at the absolute greatest. They even have great deals for the whole week. That means that for me at least once a week I can be able to have a decent meal.
name: Emily

text: My husband and i went on a Friday afternoon and really enjoyed our dinner. He has the oysters and a Nashville Philly sandwich and I had French Onion and Shrimp and Grits. The service was good too. No complaints. We went back the next night did dessert and coffee.
name: Christy

text:
This was our first time at an authentic Japanese Hibachi restaurant, and the experience was amazing!

The servers were gracious, the food was first rate and the company was delightful. We arrived at the restaurant and were seated promptly. The family next to us (Tim, Meghan, and their daughters) explained the process to us, and chatted with us like they had known us for years. Hurray for regulars.

The food was prepared right in front of us by a talented and entertaining chef. Our steak was cooked perfectly .. the rice was amazing ... and the vegetables were gone in no time. I could not have asked for better.

Best of all, the prices were reasonable considering the added entertainment!

We can't wait to come back!
name: Steve

text: We have been multiple times hoping for a good experience, but each time was worse than the previous. Terrible customer service, terrible management, and terrible food if it actually does come out correctly. We will not be back unless they come under new ownership.
name: Sean

text: This is one of those places where I can see other people loving it more than I did. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Idk, the sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something i'm still thinking about two days later. Also, the food came out looking rlly good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. so yeah kind of mixed on it.
name: User

text: Food was great on a busy Sunday farm fresh food will return for dinner. Chicken was great
name: Patria

text: Came here for a light meal today after the lunch time crowd.  Small cozy Mediterranean pizza place. My favorite was the octopus which was soft perfectly grilled and exquisitely presented with droplets of a sweet squid ink and light olive oil.  Unfortunately they were out of the popular Turkish dumplings.
name: Jason

text: This place has been around for over 70 years! And it is still excellent! The food is outstanding. I had the sampler, and all 3 were fantastic. They have amazing char grilled oysters, maybe the best I ever had. It' located right off Bourbon St, so it's busy and lots of tourists.
name: Peter

text:
We found Elliston Place Soda Shop by accident one morning while we were trying to get breakfast at another local restaurant.  When the wait was too long there, we decided to walk down the street and saw this cute little place.

As others have said, when you step inside, it is like going back in time.  The place is cute--once upon a time, I worked at a soda shop.  The dessert menu looked so good--but for me, it was the wrong time of day for ice cream sundaes and milkshakes,

It was pretty empty when we walked in (it was about 7:30am on a weekday) and we were obviously the only non-regulars there.  There was a very nice server who came by with fresh, hot coffee and greeted us.  I ordered my usual omelet with potatoes and this time, the fiance ordered pancakes.  

I made the very big mistake of reading other Yelp reviews while I waited for my food.  In all fairness, the restaurant is old.  So things are not going to be shiny and new.  Yes, there is a slight funky smell when you walk in like an old house.  But I can see what others meant when they said the restaurant was not the cleanest.  Yes, there was a good amount of grime covering the juke box in our booth.  The booth seat itself had a lot of crumbs and gunk in the crevices.  Egads.  Unlike other Yelp reviewers, I did NOT see any roaches.  But just the thought of it, turned my stomach.

The food arrived and it was hot and it was good.  I thought the omelet was better than the potatoes.  I have the bad luck of getting room temp fries and potatoes whenever I go out to a restaurant.  My omelet came with two biscuits and they were delicious.  

While we were there, the restaurant started to fill up and it was just the one server.  Then her boss/manager walked in and kept her away from her tables by talking with her about other stuff.  We were trying to get our check, but he was holding her up.  She was very patient but my patience was getting a little thin.  

I would like to go back to Elliston Place Soda Shop.  I just wish they would close the restaurant down for a day or two, bring in bright lights and just scrub the place from top to bottom.
name: Angela

text: My family and I have been going to Pesto for years. The food has always been excellent, as well as the service. We recently had our engagement dinner there and it was better than ever. We had 17 people and everyone raved about the food. The appetizers are out of this world- the fried calamari are simply the best. I highly recommended and make sure to bring your appetite!
name: Maureen

text: Nothing fancy, but darn delicious. I love hush puppies and this place offers great ones. I love fried cod, and the fried fish here makes my cut. My wife had the cheese burger and it took her back East to White Castle. However, she thought it needed those burppy steamed onions to live down to the WC tradition. The house-made tartar sauce really works well. Try some with those hush puppies. The place isn't fancy, but it's spacious and comfortable. Best of all, the prices: two meals with drinks for ten bucks. We'll be back to try more things as Kade develops this off-the-wall and off-the-charts new restaurant.
name: Kenneth

text: Their food is fine, but I had a terrible experience today when trying to order my lunch. I ordered online and immediately got a confirmation email stating my delivery would be around 1:15. About an hour wait, not great, but worth it. By 2:40, I still didn't have my lunch. I called the restaurant and asked about my food.  I was informed that it was my responsibility, when ordering online, to then call the restaurant and confirm my order. This is ridiculous. Regardless, I was told that my pizza and breads were out for delivery. By 4:30, four hours after I ordered my lunch, my workday was over and it was time to go home.  Never did get my food, or a call or an email or a text or an apology of any kind. I formerly loved this place, but will never give them another dime.  Poor customer service.
name: Andrea

text: Had the sliders the other night.  Pretty good.  I've been in before but didn't eat, however the smell was so captivating I had to go back and try some.  Great place that not everyone knows about, so you can typically find space.
name: Chad

text: The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Worth checking out. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. For the price I expected more than this. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text:
Discovered this gem after it popped up on the Best of Philly list this year. It definitely lives up to its title! 
I have never been disappointed with anything I order here. My first time here, we ordered the waffle and Schnitzel club. The waffle was perfection- great texture and the dulce de leche tasted amazing. I love that the sweet dishes come with a side of eggs so you automatically get sweet and savory in one order, plus this place serves some of the best scrambled eggs I've had at any breakfast place. 
Next time around we ordered the raspberry crepe and the Croque Monsieur and again was perfectly satisfied with every element of the meal. 
You can't go wrong with ordering one of the giant macarons for dessert. I haven't strayed from the pistachio flavored one yet because it's just that good. I tried the fruit tart as well which looks prettier than it tastes, but the macaron helped to compensate for that experience. 
Hope this place doesn't blow up too much since I love being able to walk in with a minimal wait time, it's one of my favorite brunch spots in the city.
name: Bianca

text: I ordered for the first time today got delivery. Food was great,  hot, order was correct. Service was wonderful. Prices reasonable. Love this place will definitely be a regular customer
name: Jessa

text: They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: Tried this place for the first time. We arrived at 8pm and dinner rush was over. Place was very clean. Waiter courteous and very friendly. Explained the different names on menu. Since we are vegetarian, he helped us choose menu and also willing to accommodate our choices. I ordered pad Thai and it was delicious . Great lil place. Would definitely eat here again
name: Rita

text: Price felt a touch high for what it was. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The music was louder than it needed to be. Pretty happy with it overall. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable.
name: User

text: About a year ago, I had a gastric bypass. Thankfully I haven't lost my love for sushi. After a bad experience at a buffet on MacDade Blvd, I decided to try this place again. I have a card from my surgeon, asking that I be charged a kids price or senior citizen price. I showed the manager my ID and he charged me the kids price.
name: Heather

text: This is my new favorite spot for poke in the Reno/Sparks area. The wait staff were awesome and the fish was fresh. They apparently do all-you-can-eat sushi as well (that I will have to do next time). I definitely left there satisfied with my poke bowl. This is a must try place for those looking for sushi, poke or a sushi burrito!
name: Bo

text: The only time I could ever see myself enjoying this type of food is if I was stranded in the zombie apocalypse..The beans looked like they came out of a ten year expired can...The sauce was super watered down Ketchup..Super gross..I will never do it again...
name: Danny

text: Best pub food in the city.  Wings, pizza, short rib sandwich are all excellent.  Chef Ricky is knocking it out of the park!  Beer is excellent.  $5 pints!  Every beer I've tried so far is very good.  It's becoming a regular stop.
name: Jason

text:
Taziki's is hands down my new favorite place to stop for lunch in Eagle! Not only is the food just darn right GOOD, but the customer service was superb.
I stopped through the other day between errands, as I had seen it a few times in passing. They were busy, but my order went out so fast! The gal that took my order was bubbly and sweet, and genuinely brightened my day. I sat down to wait for my to-go order, and it was brought out right to me!
I ordered the Greek salad gyro with chips and pasta salad. And OH MY WORD. I've actually been craving it ever since! This place really knows what they're doing. I'm excited to have them in Eagle for when I'm passing through, although I would definitely make the 20 minute drive from where I'm at in Boise just for this!
Yum, yum yum.
name: Shiloe

text: Really well crafted donuts with interesting flavors. The hot donuts are made fresh and are great
name: T

text:
This place is definitely going on our list of favs. The food is delicious, fast and reasonably priced. We had the Whole Shebang to try a bit of everything (pulled pork, smoked chicken, ribs and sausage) with Mac and cheese and fries. It was all fantastic and perfect for 2 people. I also had an adult soda (which is a cool idea) and we split a bacon chocolate chip cookie. 
Everyone there was friendly and attentive. The owner(s?) even made a point to ask what we had ordered and how we liked it. 
This is an awesome addition to Bellevue, but I would drive a ways to go here. 
Great job Honeyfire!
name: Mary

text:
Had the gyro for lunch .   It was pretty good.  Wasn't amazing but really good.   

Came for dinner.. the pita and the dips were really good.  I thought the kebobs sucked.  Like really disappointed.   The beef was bland and wasn't cooked enough.  The chicken was tasteless. 

Had the chocolate mouse for dessert. That was average.
name: Alex

text: Authentic af. Have eaten at many restaurants in Oaxaca, Playa Del Carmen, CDMX and Tulum and this place brings the legit cuisine. Friendly service. Wallet-friendly as well.
name: Christian

text: Wish I knew about this place sooner! It's tucked away in a corner so even after living in the neighborhood over a year, my hubby and I just tried it recently for the first time. It was SO GOOD! My shrimp tacos were fresh and flavorful and my husband's enchiladas were delicious! Totally authentic and tasty. This is definitely going to be one of our regular spots.
name: megan

text: Well 2 weeks ago the bagels were fine but now they taste tough nasty and unreal. I guess they're feeding people plastic now. Ridiculous and no need to order the turkey egg and cheese anymore since the bagels are now fake. What makes them think that people wouldn't notice the difference in taste and texture. This was at two nearby locations.
name: Madiy

text: I was visiting my family in SB and was in a massive hurry to get to a wedding but needed some breakfast for myself and my kids. Being vegan it's always hard to find a good breakfast spot so I was stoked on this place. Everyone was super friendly but unfortunately that's the only good thing I have to say. The messed up orders, long wait times, and disappointing food was enough to make me decide not to give it another try.
name: Olivia

text: My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The music was louder than it needed to be. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Will be back. Food was good and came out fast. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Would probably stop in again if nearby. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: I love diners. And this one is my favorite. It runs so efficiently. The food is always fast, hot, and tasty. And the service is outstanding. It says a lot about a business when their employees are great and stay for years and years. Boise wouldn't be Boise without the Capri.
name: Randy

text:
Recently gave this place another try after a long time and I absolutely loved it! The food was delicious for all at my table and the service was the best I've had in a while. The server made sure we were enjoying our breakfast out and kept the coffee refills coming. 
Honestly wish I didn't wait so long to try it again.
name: Alyson

text: Visiting this area for the first time and we hit the jackpot here at Yats!  The food is delicious, portions and generous and the staff friendly!  Would definitely come back!
name: Amy

text:
Great experience; reasonable prices. This is my second time. Parking was free and available. The venue is crowded yet had room for all. We like the many choice of seating. Makes you wonder if this was by design, nonetheless it was welcomed...
My children, 18, 16 and 10, love the many options. After staking a table; amazingly we all were able to order and sit down at right around the same time. It was nice having with each person having their own choice and being able to eat  as a family.
name: Tony

text: Great place for friends to watch a game and have a great Meal. Make sure you chat with Ashley. She is awesome. Also stop in to welcome the new kid Makayla.
name: Michael

text: I'm definitely a fan of authentic Mexican food. My first visit was yesterday during dirty hour. AMAZING FOOD! Everything is super fresh.
name: Hayden

text: Food was excellent and service was very impressive! Friendly, attentive staff and great location. Space is quite limited inside so make sure to get there a little earlier if you wanna sit inside or if outdoor seating isn't available. It's the perfect spot in Maplewood to get to on a Sunday morning for brunch with a friend.
name: Daniel

text: Dessert saved this a little. Honestly, the service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. It looked better online than it did in person. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. maybe I just came on an off day. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: Just tried Thai Chili Pepper after checking Yelp reviews and I can't believe I haven't tried it before. If you like Thai food it's a must visit. I had the spring rolls and Tom Kha Shrimp soup with thai ice tea and it was absolutely delicious. They gave me a tray of four different types of spices so I could turn up the heat in my soup. So if you like it spicy you are in for a treat. I will be coming back soo and often.
name: Bradley

text: I asked a local where the best BBQ was and he recommend Peg Leg.  As any good BBQ joint goes you get your food at the counter and grab a table.  The dry rub was amazing, the service was wonderful.  I can't believe I ate the whole thing.
name: Karen

text: The food was delicious and our waitress was spot on! The ambiance was romantic and highly recommend for special occasion dinners
name: Hansah

text: I come here 4 days a week to work with my students. Edwin the owner is awesome!!  I do job training with students with special needs. We eat our lunch here everyday. I call it eating around the menu. They have a great menu with a large variety. I have enjoyed everything I have eaten. Their homemade chips and dip is awesome!!  My waistline wasn't handling it so well so I am now  choosing healthier options. They have several salads that are very good. My new favorite is the fish sandwich minus the bun and sauce. And in place of the yummy chips I get a squash and carrot mix. They are cooked in olive oil, NOT butter. So weather you are in the mood for a burger, cheesesteak, pizza (make sure the pizza cook is in) or entree this is your place to come!!  Super friendly staff and the place is clean . I definitely recommend this restaurant!!!
name: Georgianna

text:
Who would rate Berns anything but 5 stars... this place isn't just dinner it's an experience. From the service, to the dinner, to the kitchen and cellar tour, and then ending the night at the dessert room you will not be disappointed. 

We got the oysters, very fresh and meaty! I'm a huge oyster fan and these were very good. The filet mignon was perfectly cooked and very flavorful with the garlic butter. And of course save room for dessert. We got what the server recommended: banana cheese cream pie. AMAZING
name: Emily

text: My favorite café food of all time. They have great salads, sandwiches, soups, pizzas, bakery items, etc. It's similar to bread co and similarly priced, but the food is so much better and has so much more flavor. I get the daily double (which is similar to the bread co you-pick-two), and I always get the Sonoma chicken sandwich with the Meatless Tango salad. So much good food to choose from, and it doesn't feel greasy or unhealthy!
name: Mary

text:
The renovation and reinvigorated Bistro on Bridge should be a welcome addition to the Phoenixville scene. The first floor is open and inviting and the former "night club" space upstairs has been turned into a open air roof top beer garden. The design elements are very well done and attract a much more upscale crowd than the previous incarnation.

The food was full of imaginative takes of bar food with its like Duck Nachos, a delicious rib dish and beer battered french fries.

The service was fairly solid, but our server was overwhelmed by the sheer volume of trips she would need to make to handle drinks for about 16 people. Clearing was an issue as our table became a sea of empty glasses at the end of the evening. But, she worked really hard, was very pleasant and should have had a fellow server help her to clear the debris field we had created which was her only miss-step.

I would have given 5 stars but for the exception of the clearing and one last issue... As we had a large party, the food was all covered along with a sparkling toast with Prosecco. The host had elected to have everyone on the own for bar tabs other than the above, which is completely fine and understandable. Where the restaurant errored in my opinion was automatically adding a service charge to all the individual tabs. I can understand the desire to protect the server from being stiffed by groups but this was a tad beyond the pale especially because they had the opportunity to work out covering the server ahead of our arrival as the event had been planned as well as charging service on the large food and sparkling toast tab and in addition I gave the server $50 cash during the night to mitigate against having any shortfalls for her as she was working really hard. To which, by the way, I had service charged in addition on my tab for one... It was a mistake in my opinion by the management, not a huge deal, but it was certainly a factor in our our overall experience and those two issues kept this from being a five star experience. So, go there and have a great time! It's worth it.
name: Hudson

text: Ordered a ham, potato, egg and cheese breakfast burrito... it was EXTREMELY salty due to the over abundance of large cubes (gross) ham. The potatoes were mushy and greasy... I threw it away... not good... bummer! I picked a bit of the ham out and the dog didn't even want it!
name: Jennie

text: I've been eating Philly soft pretzels for as long as I can remember. They are a staple at any family gathering. However, I can't believe how expensive it is to get a pretzel. I walked in and couldn't believe my eyes when I saw the pretzel prices. It's a crime when pretzels are so cheap to make. I can remember when you could walk in and get one for .50! The staff were friendly but they charge you extra for sauces on top of the pretzels. They still taste great but are expensive compared to what they used to be. Inside looks like it needs a deep cleaning too!
name: Paige

text:
November 24, 2019 Sunday - 2 PM for a dinner
8 Adults

Atmosphere - 4 stars
Food - 4 stars
Service - 5 stars

Background - Invited to a birthday lunch.

Atmosphere - Located within the Atlantis Casino.  I did not even know this place existed.  The restaurant is located in the southwest corner of the casino.   I think I missed this place as I am always focused on going up the escalator to get to the other side of Virginia Street. This is an old school casino diner. 

Food
  Drink - Just water today.

  Lunch - You said bacon jam, sold!  They have a burger with bacon jam spread as an option.  The caramelized onions and jam, took the burger to the sweeter side of savory.  I had the burger cooked to medium and they were close to it. The brioche bun they used just seemed off to me, I cannot put my finger on it.  This one messy juicy burger that I enjoyed.

Service - Eight people and a birthday, they did a great job.

Future - I could come here again.
name: Paul

text: The photos made it look a little better than it actually was. Anyway, the food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Kind of landed in the middle for me.
name: User

text:
Really nice little place.  Lovely staff.  Well worth a visit for a very tasty sandwich. The sides are great too.  Indoor and outdoor seating, tucked away in a quiet neighborhood.  We will be returning.  Great Value!   
They are selling DongPhong King cakes at the mo too!
name: Cam

text: Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. Food was fresh and service was quick. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Will be back. Would probably stop in again if nearby. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced.
name: User

text: Get the charbroiled oysters.  They are life-changing.   This place was on my New Orleans bucket list, and I checked it off.   I'm thinking I will be back!
name: Jt

text: Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. For a busy night they handled it okay. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text: I love this quiet spot in Donelson. The baristas are so friendly, and are very eager to answer any questions you may have. The best part about this place is that they have macadamia nut milk as an option for lattes, cappuccinos, etc., which is a much tastier and healthier option than soy milk, and has a better consistency than almond milk. Also, though their pastry case may look a little barren on occasion, their scones are actually really tasty, and they're the perfect size.
name: Deena

text: stopped by after work because I was nearby and hungry. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. text:
Super Tortas opened in 2008 around the Indy motor speedway and quickly became a favorite for their hefty torta combinations and great food. But they quietly vanished breaking our hearts, and like an ex reappeared a few years later, but in a bigger, more beautiful and bright building that embodies their true persona. 

Wrought iron benches and wooden tables with mini piñatas and paper fans hanging from the ceiling. There's a small "memory lane" corner full of precious antiques. On the outside, an insanely intricate and gorgeous mural with picnic tables and string lantern lights overlooking you.

They have over 20 designed combinations with ingredients for everyone, but you can pretty much DIY and craft your torta to your liking. Pro-tip take advantage of the useful (and cute!) 3 different salsas caddy and definitely try those pickled jalapeños. Don't be afraid to dress it up!

I am bias to the Tortas, however, because their potato tacos dorados (fried rolled tacos) are my true love and I deviate towards them every time. They have a massive torta and there's a challenge with a reward for anyone out there who is brave enough to tackle that.

So much love for this thriving Indy business. Everyone is always friendly and so inviting. Definite local favorite that truly lives up to its name!
name: Soraya

text: Ha Long Bay opened up in the old Ivory Chinese Restaurant location. Upon noticing this, I decided to go try this place out. I had decent expectations for this place because the Ha Long Bay in Pinellas Park was rather good, especially the dim sum choices. Upon entering, I noticed that the renovations were rather significant. Gone was the old cramped and slightly claustrophobia inducing dining room. Instead, the renovations opened up the space and made it much more modern, with nice tile floors and modern wall paint. Some old dividing walls were removed which further enhanced the open feel. But while I was impressed by the renovations, I was less impressed with the food. It was rather discouraging to find that they were using the old Ivory menus without even removing the old restaurant name. The dim sum choices were limited and were at least a full $1 more expensive than most other dim sum places in Tampa and St. Pete. The salted fish and eggplant clay pot, while of a decent portion size, was definitely on the saltier side. Based on my first impressions, although I was somewhat disappointed with the food, I do also believe that this place has lots of potential. I will give this place the benefit of the doubt that because they just opened, they have some issues to iron out still. But my hope is that given time, if and when I do come back, I'm expecting much better the 2nd time around.
name: Matthew

text:

text:
I have been here a few times. The sushi is alright but sometimes the fish looks like it has been sitting out too long. Depending who rolls it, some fish may not be completely cut (so when you pick up a piece of sushi the fish that is placed on top comes off of a second sushi- then you get the very fun task of cutting the fish with your chopsticks). They do have a decent selection of rolls to choose from. They are priced at a pretty standard rate. I have been here a few times where the sushi was better than I had this particular time- which is why I gave 3 stars.

DO NOT ORDER THEIR RAMEN. I love ramen and any type of soup like it. You will be sadly disappointed if you order it. I ordered it for the first time and was shocked when it came out. It looked (and felt- as the bowl itself was super hot) as if they microwaved the bowl with its contents in it; not fresh. I have never had ramen served with a hard boiled egg cut in half (that looked store bought, precooked and sliced). Usually they arrive with a whole soft boiled egg, that is never fully cooked. The meat they gave was hard instead of tender and dry due to microwaving. The bowl was mostly noodles. The broth was the best part but there was not much in it due to the high volume of noodles which were absorbing the broth. 

They have an offer right now that if you spend $20 you get a California roll for free. Well, I decided I would order the ramen and a sushi roll. I told the waitress that since my order was above $20 I would like the free roll with it. When I got the bill I was charged for both rolls and the ramen. She said I would get the free roll next time. My bill was over $20 with the one roll and soup so I was not pleased. If the free roll was for next time then I should have been notified when I asked for the free roll. 

Overall, it wasn't the best experience but I may potentially give it another chance- especially because I have the free roll coupon thing, that I hopefully do not lose, to use next time. I did like that I could sit outside (but you cannot order alcohol out there, which the wait staff did inform me of before seating me out there). It is a bit louder of an area due to high traffic but Ill take patio seating over indoor any time when its nice out!

text: I regularly go to this store but I believe I will no longer go. I had a coupon for a sundae and I orderd it with salted carmel and went through the drive through. When I got to the window they said "oh its a survey [coupon]"...and "that's a small". I thought to myself....no problem. A small is fine. Then they took my coupon, stuffed it through a tiny slot in the cash register, and handed me a plain custard (ice cream) with no topping! When I reminded them that I ordered salted carmel topping, the reply was "that's extra"....really!?!? by mere definition a sundae includes a topping. I should have spit in it or dumped it on the ground so they couldn't re-sell it, however I handed it back and drove away. I don't need that kind of treatment in my life. What has happened to customer service? They can try to make it better, if they don't I won't be back...maybe not to any Culvers. 'One bad apple......'

text:
Booked our wedding block and rehearsal dinner at the hotel. Overall a great experience.

Lee Segal did a great job of putting together our room block, scheduling our shuttle to and from the venue, as well as answering any questions we had when booking and keeping us updated the days leading up to our wedding.

I worked with Robin Keefe and Celeste Linskey for our rehearsal dinner. Robin did a great job in helping us determining our menu choice and venue. She was very friendly and made the whole process super easy for us. Celeste did a fantastic job of putting together the final head count and ensuring everything was ready for our rehearsal dinner. There was a minor mix up but Celeste did a great job of updating the information and accommodating our requests.

During the rehearsal dinner the staff was very friendly and assisted in making sure my disabled father got to and from the dinner. 

The hotel staff was great too. They were ensured we had rooms close to one another as well as assisted in distributing gift bags we had for our out of town guests. 

The housekeeping staff also contributed to our great experience. I had left behind some valuable items and they were very honest in returning them to us after we had already checked out.

Highly recommend this venue to anyone looking to book a wedding block and rehearsal dinner for weddings.
name: Sean

text:
Stop. Read This. The staff is very friendly and I have gone to all the top restaurants in Collingswood - we even went here years ago when it opened. This time for Valentines. The prices went higher than a 5 star in center city Philadelphia - maybe the price changed for the holiday. They have an appetizer section called "small plates" and each item is $19.99.....ok....no problem....I will pay that all day long if it is good....it was not. We got stuffed Shishito Peppers and a Lobster Hot Pocket....I know...random. They were small portions - unseasoned - and presentation lacking. We then had Sea Bass which was the smallest portion I have seen in a long time compared to Capital Grille, Aldo Lamberti, and other and price led higher. My wife had "sushi grade" tuna and the portion was accurate, but not the cook or the grade.

Listen - I am picky since I eat out a lot at high end restaurants that charge this $$ and it was not up to par.  I truly want them to succeed and obviously they are for the people that keep coming back, but not sure why anyone would.

Happy dining!

text: Went with family on a Sunday and it was louder than I expected. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. You can tell they care about customer experience here. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Food was fresh and service was quick. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. A very pleasant experience. Would probably stop in again if nearby. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..

text:
I live fairly close to Hokka Hokka and each time I got I'm pleasantly surprised by something they've added to their menu. I'm an avid sushi lover, but am a bit particular as I am always on the lookout for fresh, cost friendly sushi. HH fits both of these criteria.

The menu at HH is expansive, including many typical delicious foods:  Sushi, speciality rolls, udon, teriyaki, etc. Their No Name roll is awesome. Spicy, fresh, and beautifully crafted.

The hidden gem of HH is their speciality cocktail menu. They have a handful of carefully crafted delicious cocktails. I'm a fan of their saketini. It's delicious.

The staff at HH is friendly, atmosphere nice, and (most importantly) they have great Happy Hour specials!
name: Mike

text: Thai food is my favorite, so I was very disappointed coming here. I love Tom Kha soup usually, but the one here tasted so sweet in the most artificial way. It seriously tasted like someone put a bunch of jolly ranchers in the soup. I also got the green curry which would've been mediocre if it also didn't have an artificial taste.
name: Felicity

text: Such a great restaurant the food is amazing and super creative I had the summer peach pizza w and fattoush so amazing and not expensive
name: Sofia

text: Cute little spot with good options food and drink options. Food was ok. The tortilla broke so my tacos couldn't hold together. The food was a bit cold. The sides were just ok. Might give it another try. Service was helpful and nice.

text: Excellent, quick service. Food was delicious, especially the pepper-jack mac-n-cheese. Just the right amount of heat in the Tennessee Hot chicken!
name: Kim

text:
Let me just start by saying that I am a huge critic of restaurants anymore in this area. I've vacationed in the area for 15 years and know my places, so when I try something new, I'm hard to please. 

With that said, this is my new favorite restaurant anywhere in the world. I ordered the stuffed butternut squash and it was honestly the most flavor packed meal I've eaten in awhile! It digested well too. It's 100% vegan and tastes like something a professional celebrity chef would create. Best of all it's served in a beautiful local restaurant. I love their story and their vibe. I also had a fantastic server named Danny. He checked on us repeatedly and even asked the kitchen repeatedly for multiple allergy questions we had. Best server ever (no joke) Everything from the service to the food to the restaurant was amazing. If you're in the area, this place is an absolute must!!
name: Hunter

text: Absolutely delicious, presentation was perfect and everything was incredibly fresh! Will be back for sure!
name: Audrey

text:
I stopped by Panda Express for a quick lunch using their drive thru. 

I ordered the two entrée bowl with veggie fried rice and Sweet Fire chicken breast for under $7. My meal was hot, even after driving to my next stop. Their bowls are served in a sturdy to go container so you don't have to worry about a mess once you get to your destination. 
The young man working the drive thru was very nice. Thanked me and actually said "have a good day", not super common anymore.  Everything I needed was in my bag without asking (soy sauce, fork/spoon and a fortune cookie). 
Sweet Fire chicken is advertised to be hot. In my opinion it wasn't hot. Spicy, yes but not hot. Fried rice was good and not overly salted like most Chinese restaurants. 
I always forget about this place because its semi tucked back off the road but after this experience I'll definitely be returning.
name: Crystal

text: Sooo nice burger! And fast deliveryReally love the potato with the burger, sweet and salty.
name: Leila

text: My wife and I ate here before the Saints® playoff game with the Eagles and it did NOT disappoint. We started with wine and an IPA, a local brew. Large servings and no watered down beer here! I then ordered their version of my favorite drink, Old Fashioned' it was amazing, and potent, just what the doctor ordered for a Saints football game. They served us fresh baguettes with whipped butter and we then split a BLT wedge salad with house made blue cheese dressing. I ordered the shrimp platter and my wife got the shrimp poy boy. Giant, juicy shrimp, cooked perfectly, with hand cut fries. I included pics of our desserts, King Cake puff pastry and Apple Pie cheesecake. Overall the experience was amazing and we will definitely return. So many other selections for food and drink, that we will have to be back. Our servers were Jeremy and Michelle, both were very friendly and extremely prompt and professional. Next time you're in 'Nawlins make sure to stop by!
name: Brandon

text: This bakery offers amazing versatility anything from getting one donut all the way up to wedding cakes and then many more things, as well. We have been going to this place for many many years when I worked with adults with disabilities we did the birthday club and celebrated everyone's birthday for that month all throughout the year. I worked for that company just under 10 years and JB Bakery. was always very giving to us and gave us a discount on our cakes and desserts. We are very thankful for this neighborhood bakery but on the larger scale they did our cakes for our wedding as well as the dessert table for my shower and also my mother's 60th birthday which our family still talks about the cake to this day this place has staff that works in harmony so you never know who the head baker or head decorator is, but you can tell the sense of family and camaraderie between the staff even if they are older or younger it is really nice and they also offer homemade pierogies which are delicious this is definitely one of the top five in our area to go to my mother raves over there sweet cheese buns and even though I am diabetic, it is nice to See that they even have something for me and my husband who need sugar free we Really love JB bakery I have something for every generation
name: Monica

text: Great restaurant, they had a good margarita special when we came. Good price texmex style food with a good mix of locals and tourists. The appetizers are all very large in size. Parking can be an issue and a lot of seating are is outdoors.

text: I have been to Bern's several times.  The food is delicious and the upstairs dessert room is a special treat.

text: Nothing was terrible, it just never really came together for me. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..

text:
I love Urban Village as a No Lib spot. 

The beer is pretty good. I would give most in the 4.25-4.75/5 range on Untappd. I am mainly into IPA's though and I believe the last one was more of that oaky piney flavor palette that isn't for everyone.

The pizza is super unique, fun and delicious too! The last pizza I got was named after someone and it was a normal pizza with pepperoni, ricotta on top of the normal mozzerella, and this pesto sauce that looked super fun on it. The flavor was all over the place in the best way possible. The spiciness of the pepperoni, with the creaminess of the ricotta and pesto and the cheesiness. The chef knows what he is doing with these flavors complimenting each other. Plus, the dough was just so fluffy and filling! The fries and beer cheese is delicious as well.

In the warmer months, the outside opens up and that is a fun spot to hang out, grab a few beers, some pizza, and relax with friends and/or family!

text: Awful. Sausage undercooked--pink inside.  Gravy tasted like the burned bottom of the pan had been scraped and then covered in salt. Please save yourself a horrible meal experience and do not go here. The eggs were good but could not redeem the rest of the plate.

text:
Saint Germain was on my list for a while, so was glad to have snagged a 6pm Friday reservation recently. 

Most of the food was VERY GOOD to exquisite! Dessert was a big miss, and we had a slightly snarky blue haired server, so that left a bad taste in my mouth more than the dessert. The other server was lovely and the chef came out to say hi and the drinks were awesome. I left a little bit hungry, though, but, I do have a wooden leg when it comes to food, tbh.

Interestingly, the "dining room" where you need reservations only ever had one couple in there so even for the limited availability for online reservations, there were 3 or so empty tables the entire 2.5 hours we were there.
name: Sarena

text: Ooh, I like it. Sidecar has been on my list of places to check out for awhile and a friend and I recently decided: it's been a long week--a cocktail is much needed. :-) I had the "Prohibition" which was really light and refreshing--delicious, really. I don't find myself saying cocktails are particularly delicious very often, but that's truly what it was. So tasty. The space is small but I think we lucked out by coming at a time when it wasn't so packed, even better. Definitely recommend if you're in the area--I think it has elevated itself to one of my fav spots to grab a drink in town!

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. text:
I love this place... for a lot reasons, starting with the people.
I can't remember our waiters name, and he's a sailor so out to sea possibly when you go, but he's the best.
Here's another reason:  bowl of boiled potatoes with a nice kick comes to every table. (Like a bread basket, but better)

BBQ shrimp tacos fantastic. (Side note:  menu says they come with vegetable side but mine came with fries, which are unusually good here so all the better)
Husband had the shrimp and catfish basket and we took a soft shell crab Po-boy home to the daughter. (They put the all-dressed on the sides so no soggy bread: awesome). The basket had enough leftovers that they ate it again later.

That's three quality meals plus leftovers and a cocktail for $70.

text: Decided to give this place a try with my family. Reading the good reviews and being so hungry we decided to stop by. The pepperoni was a bit spicy but I didn't mind since I love hot food . The mozzarella sticks were nice and crunchy. The Caesar salad was okay, I didn't really like the dressing. text:
The team behind biscuit love had knocked it out of the park with their BRAND new wood-fired pizza spot in Hillsboro Village. Every single thing we ate was absolute perfection. Bonus: they also have the Italian beer Moretti on tap.

It's a tiny spot that features communal seating. All pizzas are served in to-go boxes where you can carry out or spend some time on their long picnic style seating.

We started with the Ricotta Dip with Honey and Wood-Fired Pizza Dough. This was absolutely delicious. We also got a side of their homemade pesto to dip the dough sticks in and it absolutely blew my mind. I plan on stopping in from time to time just to get gallons of this pesto to-go. 

We tried a variety of pizzas but hands down my personal favorite was THAT HIPSTER PLACE IN BROOKLYN ($14). This pie was red sauce and topped with sopressata, mozzarella and the condiment of 2019, HOT HONEY. Their hot honey is homemade and amazing. 

Another highlight was their dessert THE VINCENZO ($6). Tiramisu whip topped with caramel crunch. This was absolutely perfect after a carb heavy meal as it was actually super light yet packed with so much flavor.

Can NOT wait to be back to this amazing addition to Nashville!
name: Carly

text: This is one of my favorite spots in STL.  They prepare all their foods in the spirit of BBQ and they have some pretty good drinks.  Highly recommend the loaded fries, burnt ends, wedge salad, mac n cheese and meatloaf.

text: My husband and I just happened to be walking past the store and wandered inside to see a crowd of people. Everyone was pulling items off the shelves, the line was long. None of the other stores we entered were nearly as crowded. We had to find out why. We heard several people exclaim how great the class was. Puzzled, we wanted to know more about "this class." An employee in the store filled us in, said the crowd has just participated in a NOLA cooking demonstration. He said they offered two classes, a demonstration or a hands on class. He said the next class would begin in about two hours. We were sold, we signed up for the class. We were the last two to get in the class. Chef Gumbo Marie prepared the food, which consisted of chicken etoufee, gumbo and pralines. She was very knowledgeable and gave background history of New Orlean's food history, spices, culture  and techniques of preparing creole food. She spoke of her personal heritage and her family's connection to New Orleans. She was upbeat and kept us engaged. She answered all of our questions. The gumbo was absolutely delicious! The chicken etouffee was good, just needed a little more seasonings. Chef Marie directed us to the center of the table. She wanted us to try the various seasonings located in the lazy Susan. I added some cajun power garlic sauce and a little hot sauce. That really added additional flavor to the dish. The pralines were very good and appeared to be quite easy to make. After class, we purchased a gift set, which included a cookbook with three additional seasonings. I also purchased the crab, shrimp and crawfish bowl sauce, the dehydrated garlic chips and the cajun power garlic sauce. I hope to use these spices when I return home to make an authentic NOLA meal for my family. I am so happy we stumbled into this store, it was the highlight of our vacation. I strongly encourage all to stop in and either take the hands on class or sit in and watch the demonstration, you will not be disappointed.
name: Annette

text:
Yummy Korean short ribs [Reno NV]

Stopped by here for lunch during one of Reno's special events this weekend, the Street Vibrations - Spring Rally. It was just a short distance from the new Reno Arch (5 min walk). N Virginia Street was closed to automobiles and so it was convenient and safe walking along the wide street. There were plenty of street food vendors during the event but we decided to try out this place. 

I ordered the Korean Short Ribs plate [$9.95]... love me some Kalbi. Husband chose Mongolian Beef. We were the only customers at the time (noontime) but it took awhile to get our food served. The restaurant started to fill up and still waiting for our food... luckily, we weren't in a super hurry, we were just enjoying our Saturday. The meal presentation was appetizing and the serving plentiful and as far as taste the meat was tender and delicious. Husband enjoyed his meal, I guess, because by the time I looked at his plate he had scarfed down his food LoL!

Other than the slow service in getting our food our first dining experience here was good. The restaurant was spacious and clean with lots of seating. Customers pay at the counter and if you pay by card there is a $1 charge for the debit/credit transaction. The restaurant seems to be family-run. We were provided our menus and glasses of water by grandma, son served our food and daughter took care of our check when we paid at the counter.

Review #1386
name: May

text:
I HAVE SAVED THIS FOUR TIMES AND EVERY TIME I DO IT CHANGES MY RATING FROM A FOUR TO A THREE!!!!

Pros:

Cons:

~ The home brew drinks were overwhelmingly strong. The Limeade was SERIOUSLY a Margarita without the tequila. I mean, I  a good Margarita (and at least halfway  a mediocre one...) but a Margarita without the liquor is just kinda . 
~ *SPEAKS IN ASIDE SO TABLE MATES CANNOT HEAR* 
I MIGHT have seen a small roach run across the table. 

As a good Texan girl I have done serious research projects on Tacos and these definitely hit the mark. Nice job Tennessee!
name: Carla

text: If you value safety or sleep, then you should choose a different hotel. After checking in at 7pm, I  notified the front desk that the door to the adjoining room, leading directly into my room, wouldn't lock & someone would easily be able to access my room from the other side.  Maintenance tried to fix it but was unsuccessful. The hotel staff assured me that no one would be placed in the room next to me, since this was a safety issue. At 12:20am, I awoke to the sound of a group of men talking loudly in the adjoining room that I was promised "no one would stay in." I called the front desk and asked why a group of men were in the room adjourned to mine and asked for them to be moved because I didn't feel safe if someone could walk into my room at any time. I was told that they couldn't be moved  because that was the only double bed left in the hotel, but I didn't need to worry about my safety because they were "in a rock band!" I told the night manager that I didn't care who they were, I only cared that they could walk into my room without me knowing. By this point it was 12:45am and I could still hear the men speaking loudly and I asked him to move the band to different rooms because this was not my mistake and explained that I had already unpacked my belongings since I'd been at the hotel for hours and had a training at 8am the next morning.  The night manager did not seem to care and I was told that I could either pack my things and move or not to worry because they were in a rock band. Obviously I chose to move and when I got the key from him I not so nicely told him I would never stay here again. He again tried to tell me that since the guys were in a band, they could be trusted. I said "I don't ------- care if they're in a band. I care about my safety and think it's ridiculous that I gave to move in the middle of the night due to the hotels mistake!" He turned his back, walked away from me, and could be heard talking negatively about me as he walked to the elevator.
name: Holly

text:
Been here so many times. This is the one in the Reading Terminal Market. Sandwiches are always fantastic. Always my go to place in there. 
You might see big lines but these guys are quick. You won't wait long.
Always get the roast pork sandwiches with provolone and broccoli rabe. So good!
name: Jeff

text: So disappointed in Penang, usually my favorite go to spot. But July 3rd evening was a bad idea. We got seated quickly. Waiter came over placed our plates and chopsticks and water on the table. However, we didn't get our menu until 15 mins later. Tried to get their attention and no one came. When we were ready to order, it took another 20 mins before a waiter came to take our order. I usually order the Beef Rendang Rice (it's usually good, my favorite), however when it came out it lack that curry sauce, the meat was dried and hard crust found on the beef. My order came out quick, but we waited 30 mins for our other order, Spare Ribs. But we found out that order never went through even though the waiter took it down. They never even started working on that order. I spoke to the waitress and she did not apologize at all. And we had different waiters and waitresses throughout the night. Most horrible experience here ever, I had water spilled on me before here by a waiter, but this beats it all. The two of us shared my food and left. No discounts or an apology. I left a tip still, never coming back again!!!
name: Michael

text:
LU MONTELEONE = AMAZING!

Ok, so my wife and I have the two most extraordinary experiences we have ever had at a resort, and then we head to the Manor Bar at the Rosewood Miramar to soak up some wood paneling in a totally new distinct setting.  As my wife admires the architecture, I become absorbed with one of their books they have out called the Big Book of the Hamptons.  Both of us absorbed in our pursuits, out comes this incredibly gracious and beautiful gal named Lu to greet us by asking how she could serve us.  It was as she was in the wood paneling and saw us.  We talked for 15 minutes about the resort and why she loved it so much at the Miramar.  By the way, her full name is Lu Monetleone.  This gal is a masterpiece who will change your life forever.  She was so well informed about the resort along with completely immersed in making sure we were totally satisfied with out visit.  Whatever you do go see Lu in the Manor Bar.  She treats the bar as if it were her home.  Once again Rick Caruso, and the Rosewood have gone the extra mile and found a gem by hiring Lu to mirror what this resort is all about, and that is being extraordinary!
name: Richard

text: Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Not bad for a quick meal. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text: What a wonderful place! People are friendly, the bar upstarts is wonderful. The setting is beautiful if you like to overlook the beach. The bartenders are knowledgeable and kind. The hostesses are on their game. The manager is right there working along with the team. Waiters are helpful and efficient. Food is fresh and delicious!The white sea bass is wonderful. The seafood pasta is amazing, octopus appetizer along with spicy edamame were fantastic. And, they even have organic and local sides to accompany their delicious entrees. We have been there several times and every time has been a fabulous experience. Highly recommended!

text: My Girl and I stopped in for brunch at this cute spot. The food was delicious!! She got a fried chicken po boy and I got country style breakfast, both items were absolutely delicious!! Our server Marina was so pleasant and sweet! I would recommend it if you're ever in New Orleans!!

text: This place just opened but I already plan on coming back here a lot. Everything we ate was completely delicious, we especially liked the burrito and the cheese dip. The restaurant has a lot of charm too with crazy colorful chairs and decorations.  Such an awesome new addition to the Wayne restaurant scene I seeiously can't wait to come back to try the rest of their menu.

text: Ate at the bar. The bartender was kind, thoughtful, and efficient. Food was incredibly good and we loved the dessert. I don't always review restaurants we love but I just so enjoyed this dinner.

text:
ATMOSPHERE = 2 stars (I've experienced better)
Common areas need to be cleaned and several tables need to be bussed.

SERVICE = 2 stars (I've experienced better)
Our two burritos were poorly wrapped. I only ask Chipotle for two things:
*PLEASE wrap the burritos so they do NOT fall apart as soon as you tear off a bit of foil to eat it.
*PLEASE try to spread the fillings along the length of the burrito.  It's not a great dining experience to eat your burrito and have nothing but rice & beans, then the meat & salsa, and end w/ guac & cheese.

FOOD= 3 stars (A-OK)
Chipotle is Chipotle.  All the components were as expected, although the Chorizo was lukewarm. Our order was for 1 Carnitas Burrito and 1 Chorizo Burrito.

OVERALL = 2 stars (I've had much better Chipotle experiences)
NOTE: this store was NOT serving lettuce on anything that day.  I have no problem with this, but you'd think it would make the burritos EASIER to wrap. No such luck.

Out the door for two burritos: $16.16.

For chains, the comparisons are to other in the same chain or similar ones.

text:
After looking around the St. Louis area for yummy vegan cupcakes- I think I have finally found my place!  I have been to SweetArt before, and enjoyed the coffee and ambience, but now that I've started to eat plant-based, it is great to find a place that so thoroughly caters to my cravings.  I didn't have a huge appetite, so I only orders a side of vegan mac'n'cheese and a birthday cupcake.

Pros:

1.  As mentioned before, great cupcakes!  The birthday cake cupcake I had was delicious, moist, sweet, beautiful, and did not make me immediately think "this is good, but it is definitely vegan". They also offer omnivore and gf cupcakes.  Additionally, there are some other sweet treats that are not cupcakes. A lot of variety.  Only reason I didn't buy a dozen is I would be afraid I would eat them in the car on the way home.

2.  Love the lay out, and I think it's changed around in the last year or so since I've visited.  The wooden tables, brightly colored art, and modern high ceilings make it friendly, playful, and inviting.  Great place for a lunch, casual date, meeting with friends, or just sit at one of the bar/high top tables by oneself and read/relax with coffee and sweet.  

3.  Would bring a non-vegan here, and I know they would find something they want, even if it turned out to be vegan!  

4.  Parking is on the street, but it is a quiet neighborhood area so I have never had any problem finding a place to park.

Cons:

1.  I don't understand why there isn't iced tea.  It's summer, I don't want hot tea!  They have a sign that warns you that all they have is hot tea, but I think I was in denial and asked for it anyway.  Alas, no iced tea.

2.  I wish the cupcakes were a little more accessible. They offer brownie delivery, and I noticed that they are affiliated with uber eats, but I think they are good enough that they should be in local stores/farmers' markets. Truly, these are the best vegan cupcakes I've had, must be in more locations!
name: Katy

text: My dad liked his meal (mahi mahi).  However My steak tasted frozen and was burnt. The worst part is that we ordered drinks, which came out with the food. Also did not have a good server. She couldn't remember the special and seemed very aloof. Almost like she was on something .. seriously. I also wish the meals came with sides but that's a personal preference . Also, the tables were so close together that we could hear every conversation around us. There were three of us at a four person table and there was no room. This restaurant came recommended by two people so I was so disappointed that we didn't enjoy much of anything about our experience.

text:
Such a cute brunch place with delicious healthful in mind foods. Wanted to try someplace in Indiana that we do not have back home (Arizona) and this place was awesome! My friends and I were just in Indiana for training and I had stumbled upon this place on yelp while looking for a brunch plac3. The Punch Bowl Social is definitely the place to hang and be social as they also have games like bowling or darts for you to play. 

I ordered the knockoff burger with no sauce or onions (just wanted a cheeseburger basically) and it was great! The rosemary fries were delightful and my friends even enjoyed their burgers as well. Glad we found this spot!
name: Teresa

text:
I have fond memories of dinners at Effies during college, but a visit back with a large party last Friday night left a bit to be desired.

Effies has a fabulous atmosphere. Located in an old house with mantles and family photos on the walls, it definitely has a simple, homey feel. It's a family business Greek cooks, servers, etc. On previous visits, I've enjoyed dinner in a private covered dining room on the back patio and live music.

On this visit, we were seated upstairs. They have lots of long tables for large groups upstairs, but it was also pretty stuffy, which improved when I opened all the windows. I was unimpressed pretty quickly when I noticed lipstick on one of the wineglasses on our table. 

Unfortunately, part of our party had an unexpected issue and arrived very late. Although we ordered plenty of appetizers and the restaurant was fairly empty, our waiter made it clear that he was unhappy about the delay and actually gave us a deadline to place an order by! We also ended up being there quite a long time catching up, and were rushed and told it was time to leave by the staff, putting another damper on the evening.

That said, the food is actually very good. We loved the Thessaloniki platter (lots of fresh, delicious pita and dips), the stuffed peppers, and the Effie's chicken. Also very reasonably priced.

Overall, good food, reasonably priced, cute byob for large groups. However, a little more attention to cleanliness and service would have made this a better experience for our group. Don't forget it's cash only!
name: Elise

text: This was my 82nd time gracing the drive through. Unfortunately they forgot to grab my bbq sauce and ranch that we asked for when we ordered. I'm actually at a loss for words... text:
I thought Au Cheval was the only burger I could eat twice in 24 hours (minus some minor gluttony discomfort), but I was wrong. Ok, full disclosure, I only ate one, but my boyfriend may have had 3. In 24 hours. 

The story went like this. 

Once upon a time, we were wandering from somewhere, fairly certain it was a bar, and were going to hit up Willa Jean. As we walked up, we noticed that WJ closed about 15 minutes later so instead of being those assholes, we moseyed next door to the warehouse district location of Company Burger. Ordering is a little confusing while intoxicated because of the set up inside the restaurant but we figured it out and I went Lamb, boo went double chee. We got onion rings and rinds with pimento. HOT DAMN. 

The lamb burger was SO GOOD. Thinner patties so it had a little char but it was so juicy. That basil mayo was like crack, so naturally I waltzed right over to the mayo bar (YES. THEY HAVE A MAYO BAR) and got some to dip my rings in. And then stuck my face in it. Maybe. 

My boo had his double chee, sat for a minute and said, "Huh. THANK YOU SIR MAY I HAVE ANOTHER"...or something like that, and he had another. Obviously he liked it. 

But wait, there's more. The next day after a crawl at our favorites - Urban South, NOLA, Courtyard - a friend invited us to meet her at Tchoup Yard and who was serving food? COMPANY BURGER. The 3rd burger was then ordered. 

And everyone was happy. 
THE END.
name: Jackie

text: Delicious food and very nice and friendly waitstaff and bar tender. I stumbled upon this find looking for a place for a late lunch. I thought I'd check out Printer's Alley, and there it was, downstairs and tucked away. Food and UFO beer so delicious, I returned the next day with my daughter. Fish and chips and burgers were yummy.

text:
Hands down one of the best meals I have ever had!! My boyfriend and I both love food and love to cook, so when a local friend of a friend offered to bring us here we were thrilled! 

Our waiter explained the dishes on the menu in detail, and it was immediately obvious that everything is cooked to order - which is so rare these days!! I ordered the broiled gulf fish, which was seasoned amazingly and served with the best lemon butter sauce I have ever tasted. My boyfriend ordered the crawfish etouffee, which was AMAZING (and I am NOT a shellfish person!) 

For dessert we had the bread pudding with whiskey sauce, which was amazing as well. 

I can't say enough good things about this beautiful little restaurant! The service was outstanding, the owner even came by to check on us, and the food was by far the best I had during my week long visit to NOLA. 

This restaurant is a little spendy, and it's not a place for a quick meal as everything is cooked to order, but it is somewhere you need to visit if you're a food lover! Come here with friends who also enjoy food, or on a date, and enjoy a leisurely, delicious evening!
