name: Shaw

text: We visited for lunch today and we were very impressed. Our server, Julie, was a delight. We both opted for a small Kale & Spinich salad. Everything about it was superb -- the freshness of the greens, the tart lemon vinaigrette and the flavors and textures of the toppings. We then each ordered a half sandwich: The Julie's Special, which is a yummy triple grilled cheese with rare roast beef and horseradish mayo, and the Fig, Brie and Bacon sandwich, which is self-explanatory and definitely the star of our lunch table today.
name: Dan

text: Have to be some of the best Asian Fusion food around Tampa Area. This place is just mind blowing the flavors that the food has with the meat and sauces and veggies. The combination are just perfect and rich. I couldn't give this place a single complain at all.
name: Fernando

text:
This chicken advertises 'Best Fried Chicken' by Food Network with a sign prominent above the stand.  Sadly it turned out to be false advertising, or an old review at best. As others have noted, Popeyes has better chicken. 

As I was waiting to order a side of wings (my friend and I were experiencing the market small plates style), I noticed the chicken didn't looked seasoned at all (no pepper or seasoning flecks). After 15 mins of a very slow moving line, with only one person serving. Still I anticipated it should be pretty decent. When I finally got to taste it and it was a let down, fried but no depth, no flavor. I'm glad we just decided to get a small order as anything more would have felt like a waste.
name: Niky

text:
Crepes are very thick. I noticed other people's crepes at the tables near by before I ordered so I specifically asked them to make ours thin. I wasn't really expecting them to honor my request that's why I asked one more time after we paid. And we still received thick crepes. 
Maybe they have good intentions but they don't know to make a thin crepe.
name: Olga

text:
Directly from bloody bar at Boundary to Mac's.   Come for the burgers but don't sleep on the naked pig pork sandwich or, the damn cheesecake!   

Sunday brunching!
name: Bob

text:
Been to The Goat a few times and have continuously had an overall wonderful experience. I had a waitress named Piper serve use a few of the times I have visited and she was nothing short of excellent. Even though our party was huge (and drunk), she kept calm and was on her game no matter what was thrown at her. 

ALSO, the tots are amazing. I would 10/10 recommend this place!
name: Paxton

text: Best Qdoba ever. John was super friendly at the line, as well as the manager who appeared to be taking great Leadership. Clean restaurant, awesome atmosphere, and really fun green drinks at the bar
name: Carter

text: If you never had a Aussie pie - check out Canes Cafe and Corner Store - it's the real deal! American's don't know what they are missing if they don't give it a try! Cozy and quaint atmosphere - friendly owners - nice variety of pies and they also have sausage rolls. Extensive coffee menu and smoothies as well. Check it out some time!
name: Lynn

text: The atmosphere was nice but laid back. We didn't have to wait at 7 on a tues. The food was okay. It may be what we ordered, the quinoa burger was mushy, I do not suggest it.  The oysters were undercooked but seemed fresh. Fast service but could have been more personable.
name: Emily

text:
Fireside is always consistent and never disappoints! Most nights when I come here it's crazy busy, luckily we were seated in a few mins this time.

We ordered mozz sticks and garlic wings for an appetizer. Both came out really hot and really delicious. 

The chicken parm dinner is HUGE and came with a choice of soup or salad, we opted for the salad. The chicken parm cutlet was crunchy and topped with generous amounts of sauce and cheese. It literally looked like an entire box of pasta was on the plate. About 1/4 of this was eaten in the restaurant and the rest was brought home for leftovers.

We also ordered prime rib, the end cut specifically. This was another huge serving of food which came with a baked potato and apple sauce. I'm told it was delicious and cooked perfectly... I'm going to guess that's accurate because the plate was empty at the end!

I ordered the buffalo chicken wrap. I opted to add lettuce and red onion on a spinach wrap and choose the hot sauce. I personally didn't think the hot sauce was super spicy or hot. But it was really tasty! It came with fries and I asked for a side of cheese. The cheese on the side was only disappointing thing I received. It's fake cheese whiz and taste like it's been sitting out for a month. I would have expected this restaurant to use real deal stuff or just make their own homemade sauce. 

They also supply your table with these tiny dense dinner rolls and butter. Rolls were pipping hot when they were served.
name: Tara

text: Beers were pretty solid.   Food was alright.  It's a fun place with both inside and outside seating.   There's also a second floor ( however we didn't go up there).  Not sure about parking since we took public transportation into the city and Ubered.   But I think it's definitely a place to try.   cheers
name: Kathleen

text: I was really excited about this place because we don't have too many good spots out east. My first visit let me down there were gnats flying around and one got into my wine and due to rude service I didn't bother asking for a fresh glass. Months pass and I decided to give it a go again. Not impressed same mediocre service and okay pizza.
name: Esmeralda

text: Let me start off by saying one word: RUDE. It started at the front door. They were not even busy and the hostess had no idea what she was doing, however invited us to sit at the bar while she talked with her manager about where to sit us in an empty restaurant. Once we got to the bar it really started. The main bartender seemed annoyed by our mere presence. My father wanted to ask some questions as he had never been in a restaurant like this before and although he answered his questions he was completely irked by the fact he even asked the questions. Also he skipped over 2 people in our group (which was only 4) for their drink order. He finally made the 2 drinks he did take down, and then just completely ignored us. We had to loudly ask him for his assistance. This place seems like it would have wonderful food but the service seemed like it was solely based off of the appearance of the guest and the atmosphere was detestable and completely offensive.
name: Brittany

text:
Some friends and I stayed in an ABNB two doors away and two of us walked down here one morning for coffee but once we were in there we couldn't help but bring back the goods. Avocado toast with the poached eggs and apple brie toast were both great, I preferred the apple brie ($11 for 2 large slices of bread). The americano was also good but less memorable than the apple brie. We also tried to order the goat cheese toast and the blt toast but they were out of goat cheese and bacon (by 9am?). :(
The 4 or 5 staff worked generally in silence with each other and spoke only (quietly) to customers. It appeared they were trying to maintain an environment that was serene and calming. The clientele seemed to mimic their leads. No children were seen inside, but generally couples or singles sitting quietly at tables. Staff were polite but it did take about 15 minutes for our entire order to be ready. Luckily I wasn't in a hurry but this might limit my order due to the time investment on a workday.
name: Lindsay

text: This was a great experience the staff were extremely polite when I went to pick up my uber eats order also the bagels are really good so is the coffee I would highly recommend someone to stop by here and grab a bite from here great job guys definitely deserves 10 stars if you ask me
name: Timothy

text:
At first I thought Yelp had finally let me down. Five stars.. We will see about that. 
Sabrina's started of ruff. The waitress was forgetful and uninterested. It took longer than it should have to get menus. Waters took far too long.. I was ready to be super pissed off at the service and at Yelp. Then.... the FOOD arrived. It was fricken awesome. Got the bean soup and Cuban sandwich... it was so good.. it saved the review. Little upset that it is cash only. When I asked about it the answer made me appreciate why they don't have it posted anywhere.. "we are in the middle of downtown" "sometimes we have to cover the atm" ohhhHhh got it.
Overall would definitely come again.. the food is the star.
name: Artur

text:
Best taco spot in the area. 

The chips and guacamole queso is the best!

Treat yo self!
name: Alexander

text:
This place was GREAT!! 

Stopped in over here for dinner while on vacation in Clearwater Beach. It is located right down the street from the hotel I was staying in, so it was super convenient. 

It was Friday night at about 5:30-6pm. Pretty busy, but we were able to get a table right away. We sat outside at a table with a big umbrella. It was perfect! 

The three of us started with the grouper eggrolls, and by recommendation from our server, the garlic crab fries. They were both incredible! The egg rolls were so good.. I could have made a meal of them! Definitely recommend! 

I had the Grouper Oscar as my main dish. It was grouper topped with crab meat and Hollandaise sauce, with asparagus. Hello! It tasted even better than it sounds. SO YUMMY. 

Overall I was very happy with this place! Service was great and the food was even better!! 10/10 recommend!
name: Ari

text:
Great music and atmosphere.  The serving staff were very attentive and accommodating. The red beans and rice was tasty. 

Quaint, cozy atmosphere.  Good acoustics. Individual seats with small candlelit tables in front for ordering beverages.  15 seat bar on side. Small tables in rear in groupings of 2 to 8. NICE PLACE!
name: Alena

text: Amazing food every time we go service is very good and courteous never go wrong with their Alfredo and the vodka sauce is perfectly done with a nice little side kick of heat.
name: Mark

text: I wanted to like this more than I actually did. Idk, solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated bc that happens a lot. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Not sure though.
name: User

text: We had two chicken tacos and carne asada burrito with chips and salsa. Food was good, But I still like my local taqueria better.  Guac didn't have a lot of flavor.  Outside dining was nice.
name: Jake

text: Broadway and camino seco is their new location.  They closed the other one on Broadway and Rosemont.  This location was formerly BZ's pizza.  We ordered several wings, fries, salads, and beers.  They offer boneless, bone in, and shrimp seasoned with all their available flavors.  I have always liked their wings from the previous location and they have the same great taste.  The draft beer selection is awesome.  My favorites are the noche dulce and the white chocolate ale. Our server forgot some items on our order, but I will forgive them.  The servers were friendly but they were short handed.  I will give them some more time to get their customer service up to speed.  Cheers!
name: Johnny

text: I almost skipped this place because of the ratings and that would've been unfair. Food was fresh and service was quick. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. I had a better visit than I expected to. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really.
name: User

text:
We were very disappointed with the jambalaya pasta. The chicken was cold and lacked flavor. The sauce just didn't taste any different from regular tomato sauce. 

For appetizer, we had the YA YA Shrimp. Six good sized succulent shrimps in a creamy cheesy sauce. The dish came with 4 slices of toast. The shrimp and sauce was really good with slight spicy kick. But the toast had butter or oil on it and didn't need the extra oil since the sauce was already rich. 

We also ordered the Bayou Platter ($17) which included red beans n rice, crawfish etouffee, chicken and sausage gumbo. The red beans and rice was delicious! The crawfish etouffee was excellent as well and was my favorite of the three. 

We came in around 3pm and the restaurant was not busy so we were seated right away. Service was good. The restaurant faces a busy road and we sat by the window with a nice view. 

It was our first time in New Orleans. Creole House's food is okay but nothing memorable. There are so many classic Louisiana cuisine places in the area and we chose this one randomly.
name: Thao

text: The wait wasnt awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Food was good and came out fast.
name: User

text: I've been here a few times, been pretty good each time, slight variations on quality. I'm definitely a big fan of their burgers and fries (love the B2C2 burger!). As a mac n cheese lover, I substituted mac for fries as a side this last time... large regrets. It wasn't bad, per se, but incredibly average. Just noodles with some cheese melted on top, no creamy, cheesy goodness(I skipped the Cheetos as a topper - they definitely couldn't have saved this, but in hindsight might have been nice to nibble on instead). Just stick with the fries or their seasoned chips, both of those are tasty options.
name: Jessica

text: We go to Candicci's  frequently and it seems like the food has really improved lately. Apparently they have a new chef, and the specials are amazing! The house salads are really good, and the wine is always a good pour. Homemade bread is served with a dipping sauce or butter, really good. Service is always excellent. I would say they have something on the menu for everyone.
name: Kate

text: We had been going to this restaurant for a few years now and haven't been disappointed ever. Its walking distance from our house, so we usually end up eating here frequently and all their dishes are very well balanced. Love the flavorful food and what we like the best is that you get all the flavors not so hot(spicy) food. Tamarind Wings and Burrito Maya are my fav here.
name: Fredrick

text: Terrible customer service.  Treated rudely. The staff does not care about their customers.  I will never patron this restaurant ever again.
name: Lori Lea

text: Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Food was fresh and service was quick. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Definitely coming back. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Would probably stop in again if nearby. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: For the price I expected more than this. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. The wait felt longer than it should have. Wouldn't really choose this place again. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. For the price I expected more than this. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: So I'm a little skewed in my review as a Seattle transplant. Over there options and quality of sushi is vast and fantastic. Compared to that this place is passable, but certainly the best place in the area for sushi. Our waitress was absolutely lovely, the food was pretty good, but the cost was a bit much. I certainly wish the food quality was a bit higher, but that's asking for the world for my unrealistic Seattle standards. If you haven't been tainted by premium quality sushi, I highly recommend this place.
name: Reyna

text: This is one of my favorite places. I wish I could post about various dishes but I'm stuck on the delicious steak tacos with special hot sauce on the side.  Super quick service and friendly staff.
name: Marci

text:
I enjoyed lunch here on a Monday with my husband and the food was great. We ordered the alligator bites and the crab claws for an appetizer. Both were delicious. I never had alligator before, but in my honest opinion, it tastes like fish. My husband said it tasted like shrimp... idk. It was tasty though and seasoned well. 
For the entree, I had the shrimp platter and he had a fish po boy. Both were yummy and we'd return for the alligator bites if we are ever in the area again.
name: Tija

text: My favorite place in Clearwater. I love their stuffed mahi, but have had about everything on menu, and I have no complaints. I take all our out of town guests here. Yummy!!!
name: Alissa

text: My intention was to go to Chipotle for dinner and there was no parking in that lot. So I drove around to an area that appeared to be unmarked in McDonalds empty parking lot with my two young children. We were in chipotle for 15 minutes. In that time, my car was towed. Unbelievable. Empty parking lot at McDonald's for a reason. Your entire franchise just lost my business.
name: Katie

text: Stopped by at 11:00 am and appears to be closed, doors locked.   Very run down had to go to a different spot
name: Amanda

text: For the price I expected a little more care. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I prob wouldn't get again.
name: User

text:
Just stay away.....
Don't ask why, 
Just stay away I get better service at the one downtown at 2 in. The morning.... compared to being the only car in the drive-thru having to speak up 5 mins after they told me they be right back with me....
JUST STAY AWAY
name: William

text: I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Worth checking out. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable.
name: User

text:
Good Fortune was good! My favorite part about the experience was that during a snow storm, they delivered to the locals for free! 

Ordered a variety of items, and enjoyed the cashew chicken and beef and broccoli most. The portions were not super large, but enough to fill me up, and the quality of the food is high! The price was also just right, ranging from $5 for sides and apps and $10 for entries. My friend loved the bias and wished she had ordered more. Will be back!
name: Anna

text: Table of 6.  Hate to be a downer, but no one was very impressed with the food unfortunately.  Had such high hopes and anticipation.  Paella and Cuban sandwich were total disappointments.  Almost everything was too salty -- Heart of palm salad, paella, tapas, ropa vieja.  Paella was missing the usual aroma and taste of saffron, but maybe it was just overwhelmed by the salt.  Rice crossed line of moistness into sogginess.  The kicker was waiters ignorant, yet snooty response to my question about the missing socarrat, the prized crispy bottom of a well made paella.   He acted appalled by my question and said "oh no, we don't do that.  We don't want to do that.  That's when you mess up and burn the paella."  No sir.  I didn't bother correcting him though.  Cuban was just a dry, nonevent and I hate to say, but the worst I've ever had. Tapas was ok.  Best item -  mojito pitcher was made fresh at table.   Of course the facility is beautiful, but I'd prefer a dive if there's great food.
name: Kim

text: I will NEVER go back to this place ever again based solely on the customer service of a curly haired woman behind the bar. I have been going to Coops since the late 90's, and thoroughly enjoyed it, however tonight was the end. After waiting outside for about 30 minutes (definitely a first) I went into inquire about one of the approximately 12 open seats at the bar and was promptly greeted with an exceptionally terse reply.  Several of the patrons at the bar cringed at her reply as well. I am at a loss for words to express my discontent with this establishment.
name: Scott

text: In Boise, this is the best Thai food I have found. I ordered the pad Thai and fresh spring rolls and the flavor was spot on. 4 stars because it was a to-go order and it took 25 mins longer than what was expected. I would have given 4.5 stars if they had it they were nice about it. I will be back to try the soup pad see ew and curry next.
name: AK

text: I probably won't go back here because of a principal issue. I have never ever been charged for a roll for my soup anywhere. That was bizaar. A warm or toasted roll with a meal is common. They lose a customer over .79 cents. It is something you never forget.
name: Robert

text: The place is a neighborhood secret. The guacamole was tasty but a little salty for my taste. The chicken torta was delicious and huge for one sitting took half home for later. The beef tacos were tasty and salsa was excellent!!  Will definitely come back
name: Martha-Mo

text: My favorite about this place is while you wait for your order they bring you fried chickpeas. The food is always good, good quality. They have Happy hour! I like the outdoor patio and bar, perfect spot during the winter months because they have patio heaters and roll down windows for the weather. Live music some times too.
name: Amanda

text: Love this place. Best spanish food in town. Very nice people great customer service. Everything js always fresh
name: Max

text:
My mom lives down the street and we were excited to see that something new was opening up close to her house. Since she moved to Collingswood, we've been searching for a new place to make our take-out staple. We stopped in for lunch this past weekend to try it out. We were impressed by the prices and the quality of the food. 

For the two of us, we ordered two lunch entrees from the Chinese portion of the menu and the two sushi roll lunch special to share. We also had complimentary hot tea and miso soup that came with the sushi. The whole bill (with lunch prices) was just a little over $20!

The sushi was served to us first. We ordered a Spicy Tuna roll (a favorite) and the Spicy Harry roll (something new). We were happily surprised with how good the sushi was. The Spicy Tuna roll held up to our expectations and the Spicy Harry roll may be our new favorite. The crab meat with a hint of spice was a delicious combo. 

After we finished the sushi, the entrees came out. I had the General Tso Chicken. Although the rice was a bit cold on my plate, the chicken came out hot and perfectly crispy. My mom had no complaints about the Lo Mein either. We were left with plenty of leftovers to take home and enjoy later. 

The staff was very attentive and friendly throughout our meal. I was also surprised to see the number of people dining in with us at 3pm. We definitely want to try again soon!
name: Megan

text:
Ok, so the lack of stars has nothing to do with flavor.  The flavor is spot on.  I was here with 12 people, and being the friendly person I am, I tried many of the dishes (for science and all, you know?)  Everything I has was pretty good, but the standout was the meatballs...they were fantastic when combined with those melty cheese curds that come with them.

The issue I have with this place is value.  Value is the reason I cannot bring myself to give a full 5 stars.  The fact that 5 meatballs cost $18, and that a flank (one of the worst cuts) steak and fries costs $48 is beyond absurd.  As a matter of fact, the best value item on the menu is the burger, and that is $17.

If you have a ton of disposable income, or money is no object...this place is for you, as value doesn't matter to you.  But if you want bang for your buck, avoid this place as you can get amazing food for half the price downtown.
name: Ron

text: The restaurant was beautiful and the staff were wonderful.   I had the venison and was delicious.  I would definitely come back again soon
name: Jennifer

text: Fantastic service, delicious food, and tasty drinks. We loved our server,  Misti. :) :)
name: Jennifer

text: The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. A couple small things kept adding up. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Nice little spot, decent portions too. For the price I expected more than this. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Not bad for a quick meal. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text:
The place was a total mess (dirty tables and bar had not been wiped down) the employee's were just standing around talking very loud.   Not sure who the manager on duty was, but was not doing there job.  I changed my order to go.   I ended up throwing the food in the trash.

Would not recommend this place to even have a cup of coffee.  Worst coffee I have ever had.
name: Jimmy

text:
Had a wonderful experience here!
This is a gem in the St. Charles area. Just three minutes away from i-10. Has two bars and valet!! It's like, too good to be true. A NOLA treasure at best. 

I really enjoyed Al's chicken fajita, fried chicken and corn on cob. The ambiance is beautiful and happy hours are nice.
name: Lynn

text: Dayum, happy to have stumbled on this neighborhood joint (thanks, Yelpers!).  Very cool vibe, small yet deliciously unique menu of drinks, appetizers and entrees.  The service was outstanding and the food/drinks did not disappoint.  I shall be back.  Oh yes, I shall be back.
name: Jim

text: Go for the happy hour drinks but don't stay for the food.  The bacon wrapped shrimp was good but the rest- not so much. The toughest, least-flavorful veal piccata I've ever had. I had to ask for a lemon wedge and a steak knife! Everything, including the bread, needed salt.  The other dish was Tortelloni Carbonara.  It had sausage.  Sausage?  And the peas were undercooked.  And too much Romano cheese.  Im Italian and this was just not good.
name: Christina

text: For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. The music was louder than it needed to be. Worth checking out. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Food was good and came out fast. Would probably stop in again if nearby.
name: User

text: Great service, good food, overall a good experience. Will definitely be back, much cleaner than Valencia Rd & Star Pass Rd Waffle House.
name: Anna

text: This place is awesome! 50% off for Vet until Nov 13. The only thing I don't like is no free refills.
name: Michael

text: It looked better online than it did in person. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. A couple small things kept adding up. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text:
I have always been happy with Texas Roadhouse in the past. But this time my experience was not so nice. Upon registering my name on the waiting list with the hostess, I received this pager to be alerted and we were informed that the wait time was about 15 minutes. After waiting for over 45 minutes and many shifts of patrons who came after us got seated, my wife asked the hostess for the approximate wait time. As it turned out my name was never entered on the wait list, which makes me wonder if my pager was only for the look? 

Upon realizing the mistake, she offered us the next available table. Then 8 parties and 15 minutes later, we have our seats. I finally mentioned to her jokingly that my party was probably forgotten, she replied mechanically 'sorry about the wait' while continuing her spotty wait list entries without raising her head and looking at me.

Well, after all that 45 minutes worth of peanuts, the food just didn't taste as good. The server failed 40% of my requests; needless to say it's my worst experience in TR. It will probably take a lot to convince me to go back any time soon.
name: Jack

text: I don't really get some of the harsh reviews on here. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Not saying it's the best place ever, but it was totally fine. Food was fresh and service was quick. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Nice little spot, decent portions too.
name: User

text: Found this great spot for a Saturday afternoon. Free parking on street. Located in an area with some shops and a wedding venue right past Carpinteria. You order at the front counter then find a seat outside. It's a big space next to the ocean. Family and kid friendly but there's also an adult only section. The Amtrak also passes by. The food was great. We ordered the regular Prime burger, Cali club and trio fries with beer. We enjoyed everything we ate while sitting looking out to the ocean. Will definitely come back.
name: lisette

text: Love the atmosphere and old school classic new orleans style. Unfortunately the rest of or experience wasn't great. The host at the door was rude which set the night off poorly. The food was nothing special we tried maybe 8 or 9 different dishes but nothing was impressive, special or flavorful. It felt like old people food in the style of plating from decades ago.
name: Luca

text: I had a party of 5 and was able to immediately get a table. The service was fantatistic. I did not get the waitress's name but she was amazing. She stayed on top of everything and was not a robot. The food was good and the portions are huge. I will definitely be back to this restraunt.
name: Amy

text: Drive thru, more like park and wait til we're thru making your food. Not sure why this one has a third window have to pull up to, to wait for your food.
name: John

text:
My first meal in New Orleans and Royal House did not disappoint! The shrimp were fresh and fried perfectly. Becky (my server) was attentive, friendly and checked on me often.


Bonus points for being located on a corner where you can people watch unnoticed.
name: Tricia

text: On two separate occasions within the past month, i have found dead fly in my to go orders.
name: Kara

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text: This place is amazing! I've been there 3 times now and have been blown away each time with everything I tasted. Their biscuit flight is delicious, and I love their avocado toast. It's a great atmosphere and a good value for how delicious it is. It will be my go-to spot for brunch and for taking friends from out of town out to eat to impress them with St Louis.
name: Lacy

text: OMG....WOW.....I must be back in Mexicali MX.....this is not your typical American/Mexican Restaurant....this is what you call a restaurant for those who miss their restaurants south of the border...now they have a few dishes that we all recognize like enchiladas, burritos, and chimichangas.....but come here for their grilled meats and made in house flour tortillas....for you gringos & gringas this might be a place too "hot" for your tastebuds, but if you like some "heat" and amazingly grilled meet and veggies this is a must stop....don't forget to grab a one or more house made popsicles with real fresh fruit in them.

text:
How do you purchase a beloved family owned and run casino and make loads of changes the right way? 
Do you renovate the whole thing and assume that no one will have any sentimental attachment to the place? 
Do you leave it stale to placate the local types that would still have The Mapes sitting downtown rotting from the insides out. 
Do you make it unrecognizable in both design and welcoming attitude like the MGM Grand to the GSR? 

Tough to say. however, I have been going to The JA Nugget since I was a kid and hoped that they would not rob us of the feel of the Nugget and go ahead with a modernized face lift. To me the feel was always the appeal of The Nugget. It doesn't feel like a money vacuum designed to suck to wallet out of your pocket the moment you come in. It feels like you are there to enjoy, run into old friends, bump into the people that have been working there 20 plus years and recognize you. 

I understand business and staying relevant in a highly competitive market. Not just locally with the likes of the modernized Atlantis, Peppermill, and GSR, but with the CA Casinos like Thunder Valley. Also, the ultra modern and seemingly unlimited budgets of the Las Vegas casinos. So change is inevitable. 

What I miss: The big aquarium & Trader Dick's. John greeting regulars in the restaurants. 

What I don't: Mustang Ranch Red Decor, seedy bingo hall, the arcade room as a first impression, the slots and tables stuffed in every square inch of the smokey gaming floor.   

There will be bumps along the way like Tilly's and closing Orozco, but I am liking some of the most recent changes. Did you notice that in the first time in years they have entertainers that are actually famous? Leno, Lopez, Ice Tea. The casino looks and smells fresher. 

Keep your eye on The Nugget, they are doing good things.
name: J

text: I saw a friend post about Philippine Smoked BBQ and Grill and immediately wanted to eat their food. I live in Philadelphia and always wondered why we don't have Filipino restaurants here. It only takes about 30 minutes from center city Philly to Wilmington, DE so it's very doable. Their store front is very unassuming, and inside looks like any old deli/pizzeria style place. However, just wait until the food comes out, I was so happy! By the way, this place was voted in 50 best BBQ joints in America! More than their BBQ I wanted to try their breakfast so I ordered their garlic rice, Tocino (sweet pork), and fried eggs, and my husband ordered "The LaLa" - pulled pork sandwich. We also ordered turon to share. I loved my breakfast! It was so filling I didn't become hungry until early evening! Garlic rice was not too garlicky, but had nice subtle flavour of garlic. Tocino was mildly sweet and loved the flavour and the texture. I tried my husband's LaLa sandwich; it was subtly sweet and had nice BBQ flavour (they must add other spices because it didn't taste like typical American pulled pork). I actually had some of this pulled pork with the garlic rice and it was really good. Turons had nice balanced flavour and texture of jackfruit and plantain. It was not overly sweet and not too greasy (because they do deep fry them). I wish this place was in Philly, but I will definitely go back again to try their Halo-Halo!

text:
I absolutely loved dining at Valanni as part of my 1 year wedding anniversary celebration weekend.  Our weekend was packed with plans including seeing Aladdin on our actual anniversary (which oddly enough was my birthday gift from the spring).   We were staying at a local center city hotel and wanted a walkable restaurant so we could then just walk straight to our show.  After searching though some reviews of different food establishments in the area we decided that Valanni would be the best spot for food and timing.

Although they are known for their delish cocktails I got something very plain only because I didn't want to be tipsy for the show.  If I get a chance to go back I will definitely give a more interesting cocktail a whirl!  Instead of separate entrees we decided to share a few small plates.  As always we make the mistake of getting 5 to share instead of 3 but none the less we enjoyed stuffing ourselves with every last bite.  Some recommendations to eat at Valanni:

-LOBSTER & CRAB MAC & CHEESE
-WHITE MUSSELS
-LAMB SLIDERS
-CRISPY BRUSSEL SPROUTS
-FLATBREAD -ours was with tomato, pesto, and mozzarella

If I could only try 3 I would go for the lobster/crab mac & cheese, the lamb sliders, and the brussel sprouts.  Delish!  They were very large in size when considering they are suppose to be small/sharable plates. 
 Cannot wait to go back and try some more of their offerings and enjoying some of their drinks!

text:
Better than Athenas that's for sure. What I also like about it,
   You can get personal size. I usually get margarita personal size. This place might be better than pepper mills, I don't want to exagerate

text:
Pretty Bird Coffee has a wonderful laid back vibe and friendly staff. For those who don't care about the feel of a coffee place, their homemade roasts are delicious. Pretty Bird is one of the few coffee places around that makes homemade flavored syrups, making their caramel macchiato, hot or iced, an absolute must. 

Their food offerings are unique takes on coffee house staples, like a blueberry sage brownie or a "Cruffin"(croissant and muffin combine into a wonderful cinnamon bun-like treat). They offer sandwiches and ice cream drinks, as well as breakfast biscuits and cups (a mix of eggs, meat, veggies, grits and cheese into, well, a cup). 

Everything Pretty Bird offers is well prepared and fresh. This place is a favorite of mine in Yardley, and a must try, whether you want to set up shop for the day or grab a freshly made doughnut and coffee. You won't be disappointed.
name: Justin

text:
So I was headed to the gym around the corner and 10 Miles later we ended up at the Tamale Place. Have you ever heard of it? Well, google and go...this place is golden. I seriously feel we hit tamale jackpot! This is the truth. 

So Lyn, with two snaps, is amazing!! She make us feel totally at home and explained everything we asked. Well, we asked for food and she gave us the run down of how amazing it was. It is. It really is amazing. Lyn with two snaps is a truth teller. The tamale place is for tamale beginners to tamale aficionados. It's for families. It's for everyone. 

The spicy chicken has the perfect blend of flavor...bonus, they were not dry.

The chicken in the banana leaf was my fave. This was reminiscent of all that was missing from my life. It sealed the deal. It was the million dollar answer on who wants to be a tamale-naire. 

I can't tell you to go here, but as Phil Collins plays on the radio, I can feel these tamales in the air of the night. Oh lord!! I've been waiting for this moment for all my life!! 

You're welcome in advance!

text:

text:
You can't do much better than the Classic Diner for breakfast. Or lunch for that matter. Although we have some solid breakfast and lunch options within 5 minutes of our house, we happily drive the 15 minutes to Classic because it's worth it. The waits are long during peak hours, especially on the weekends. Again - worth it. Would love if they had more space to wait inside during the colder months. Breakfast - the fruit bowl, omelettes, French toast and egg sandwiches - so fresh and consistently perfect. Lunch - bountiful, bright salads and generously-sized sandwiches. Amazing chicken fingers made with real whole white meat breasts. The fries? To die for. 
I would give it 5 stars but the waiting area is non- existent and the seats are hard and uncomfortable. Always cold. If you're not there in the summer, plan on being cold, or bringing an extra layer of clothing. The food makes all of this worth it though!

text: I was looking up some locations to grab a bite while in the area and I stumbled upon this place. I love seafood so I thought I would give it a try. The restaurant is eclectic and has a good atmosphere. The bar staff was friendly and attentive. I ordered the voodoo shrimp as an appetizer. It was actually enough for two people. I also ordered the Clam chowder which was pretty tasty. I also ordered the filet. I am not a regular beef eater but rarely pass up a good filet. If I am ever in the area I would visit again.

text:
Finally a super cool place to hang out in tiny Wilmington!  We have been here 4 times and tried more than half of the menu.   Deciding where to start is the hardest part.   So here it goes: sprouts, shishito peppers , sirloin sliders, Kobe sliders, all of their salads, spiced drunken nuts, lobster grilled cheese squares, philly brats.   These are all superb excellent and totally awesome.

Charcuterie board, duck wings deviled eggs are very good.

Pile of fries (need to be cooked better) , bacon strips (pass) duo dips (ehhh) blue crab melt (for that price someone should feed it to me)

The bartenders and craft cocktails are exceptional at every level and the management is on the ball and attentive.  The bar is also staffed very well and I would say it is the best in the city

2- I am fine with the dress code but turning away hard working well employed doctors and nurses after their shift.  (Cmon man that's just dumb where the common sense?)

text:
I really like this place and would have given it 5 stars if I would have written this review a few weeks ago. The restaurant lost 1 star due to service. 

Like other reviews there is only 1 server taking orders. Today was the busiest I have seen it at lunch time. There was a large group celebrating someone's birthday and there was 1 server for the whole restaurant. There was another girl there at least taking drink orders and bringing out chips and salsa. 

Everything I have ordered here has been great. I normally come here with my family for breakfast and it is very good. Today the service kind of turned me off and I will probably stick to breakfast from now on. 

If you're looking for a decent Mexican restaurant in Oro Valley this place is worth checking out.

text: I've been wanting to go here for a while since it recently opened, and I finally came here tonight with my boyfriend. We took a while to decide what we wanted, so the waiter gave us water without us asking. Also, he served us a complimentary tostadas with pico de gallo, black bean dip, and green salsa. text:
I thought this place was okay, nothing special.

Service:2/5
I was very disappointed in the service I received while dining here. I heard some pretty good things about Dos Rosas Taqueria but was let down by the service. When I ordered the waitress informed we they were out of the brisket. It wasn't the end of the world and I completely understand (even though it was 7PM on a Friday night). When we ordered she said that was too much food. I didn't think 1 burrito, 1 enchilada, and 2 orders of tacos (2 each) was for 2 people. She stopped us from ordering a 3rd order of tacos. We disagreed but she said we can decide later when we're done, I asked if we could hang onto a menu, she just looked at us and still took them. When we finished all the food, she didn't ask how it was, she just mentioned if we wanted another order. We made another order and 20 minutes later 2 more tacos came.

Atmosphere:5/5
I thought it was a nicely set up restaurant where it was screaming out that it would be a great date spot. The food wasn't that expensive, it was quiet, and nicely lit.

Food:3.5/5
The food was pretty good however I would recommend steering clear of the chorizo tacos, the texture was more of a paste.

The food was alright but I think what left a bad taste in my mouth was the service and I don't think I will be returning anytime soon.

text:
I like this place. Admittedly, I only come for brunch because there are not vegetarian dinner options.

text:
Came here for tacos one night with friends who make this a regular place. Guac was delicious - friends ordered it and I think I ate most of it. Chips were endless and nice and salty. Tacos were pretty darn tasty too. 
Atmosphere was a little loud. It's a fairly open area with long tables, and if you're wanting to sit and chat with a group, probably not the best place to go.
name: Jon

text: Went here for the first time expecting to be wowed due to all of the amazing reviews.The wine and food were great. However, my friend and I were sitting near the server's station when all of a sudden I felt a splash on my back: red wine was spilled all down the back of my shirt. I was polite in saying "it's ok, it's fine" but after going to the restroom to see the damage, it was not fine. My shirt is ruined. The manager offered reimbursement for my dry cleaning bill. No food/wine comped, nothing. My bill was $75 so it wasn't like I was there to not have a good time but not only was my shirt ruined, so was my night by terrible customer service. If one of your servers RUINS a patron's shirt, it is the responsibility of the restaurant to make it right. Reimbursement for a dry cleaning bill, for a red wine stain that we all know won't come out, isn't "making it right". I'm mostly disappointed because everyone asked if I was ok yet nothing was actually done to make it ok. I went for wine and a fun time and left with a ruined shirt. Also, for the record I'm a white wine drinker so I didn't do this. Pretty disappointed all around.
name: Maddie

text:
I came here for the second time a few weeks ago and really enjoyed the food. Their sides are sooo delish and I loved the fish I got for an entree. For an app we got the calamari but it was legit like eating little tiny raw octopuses because they didn't fry it so it was chewy and rubbery in my opinion. I wasn't such a fan. But I get the concept they're going for with the unique take on normal calamari & I can appreciate that. On the flip side the sauce it came in made up for it and was awesome. 

The service was pretty good and as usual I always love the ambiance that this place has to offer. Very cool new Mexican vibe within the decor selections. We came on a Saturday night (they were busy) and were pleased to be seated immediately! 

Price range is a little higher but with an upper scale mexican restaurant, I'd say that's to be expected. They do have some reasonably priced dishes though. I had the margarita and my date had the sangria both of which were very tasty in my opinion. I think I liked the marg a little better but then again I'm 100% a margarita girl. The cocktails range from around $8-$11ish they're good tho and i was pleasantly surprised with the size of my margarita. 

With that being said, All in all a very good experience!

text: Wonderful place.  Great food and service!  We had a Cheeseburger and Huevos Ranchero.  Excellent~  Great menu.  Can not wait to return~

text:

The BBQ chicken drumsticks were actually pretty good. Flabby skin but the sauce was tasty and the meat was tender. 

The Fried Chicken pieces were dry and also lacked flavor.

The kid at checkout was pleasant though.

name: Trevor

text:
Only good vibes for this place! Its nestled near the Millcreek ravine so it's close to a lot of trails; it'd be a good place to get a coffee then go for a nice walk. Once you walk in, you're greeted by friendly faces. There's Transcend Coffee on the right, a little meat market at the far center and Biera (brewery/bar/lounge) on the left. Cute wooden tables and bar like seating scattered throughout the middle.

I got the London Fog milkshake which was so delectable especially if you're a fan of London Fog tea. It wasn't too rich and they use Pinocchio ice cream which was a nice local touch. My friend highly recommends the coffee milkshake, best she's ever had and it comes with two espresso shots! 

I'll definitely be trying the brewery and meat market when I'm in the neighbourhood again! Also would be a fun day date on a lazy Sunday afternoon.
name: Nicole

text: For the price I expected more than this. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. By the time the food came out I was already annoyed. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. It looked better online than it did in person. The food was good and the service was easygoing. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Not bad for a quick meal.
name: User

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot.
name: User

text: First time there and it was an awful experience. We walked in and ordered the cashier was not personable at all, rude even. We still tipped her 20% cause we are in the industry. Ordered and payed and the the kitchen cook comes out and they are arguing about how they have only 1 biscuit left, no problem we subbed for toast on one of ours. We go to sit down and the tables are filthy. Left over food on every table. The place is dirty. The cook comes out again and says they don't have anymore toast either. So at this point it's comical cause there's clearly no communication on either ends and they are in the middle of the store basically yelling at each other. We decided to get our "food" to go because they made the place so uncomfortable. Got home and the food was slapped together and tasted awful. Was really bummed cause this looked great but to whoever owns this shop, get a better staff that's gives a shit. Won't be coming back and will not be recommending this to anyone.
name: Kaitlyn

text:
The cocktails are amazing. I was with 6 other people and 4 were very happy with their food like the bbq  and  the squid ink on rice. 
I and other friend ordered the Tuna TarTar and we both couldn't eat it. It tasted like gobs of Mayo over slimy avocado and tiny bits of tuna. Sorry C & T but that was yucky. I expected simple pieces of Raw tuna with perhaps a drizzling of some kind of sauce. Not a mayo pattie. I know there is no mayo in it (waitress told me) it just tasted like it.
name: Donita

text:
So awesome best Brunch on the beach. Service is outstanding and great all around feeling. 
The happy hour and bar is very inviting like cheers.
name: Lisa

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. Price felt a touch high for what it was. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Not a bad stop, just not one I'm rushing to repeat. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text:
The review I give this place is factual and on my own experiences. 1. Food is good, no lie
2. The worst part is there horrible customer service. I hope they read this bc man you have the recipe for success but I don't have to come to your business if you don't even attempt to make me feel welcomed or that you even appreciate our business. 
...no smile, no telephone etiquette. It's not hard to say "Thank you for calling Flavs BBQ, how can I help you? Would you like to hear about our specials?" Not hard to do. I want to continue to support this business but not if all I get is a nasty attitude and consistently out of stuff and no apologies at all about it. Will give one more try, but not now.
name: Anthony

text: Wow - this establishment has amazing pizza and friendly staff. I will be returning when I come back to NOLA.
name: Joey

text:
Yesterday my family and I visited Bertucci's after the homecoming game at Villanova. And it was packed with a 45 min wait for a party of 7. Everyone was starving so we decided to wait the time and make the best of it. 
Once seated the waitress was pleasant but seemed overwhelmed by the amount of tables she had and she even told us that the day had been crazy and apologized before hand for the wait. 
After we ordered our  drinks and apps it took 35 mins for us to get our appetizers. Insane . At this point the waitress had not taken our dinner orders. A manager was going around to all of the tables apologizing for the long waits and I even saw her grabbing extra drinks and food to accommodate people's tables. 

Once she made her way to our table.. I believe her name was Celine she had a huge smile and didn't even seem jolted by the mayhem that was going on in the restaurant at the time. We expressed to her that we had not put our dinner orders in and we had been waiting 35 mins just for our appetizers. She apologized and immediately returned with more bread and said that our apps would be our in 5 mins, she then took our dinner orders and had our waitress grab us all more drinks. 

She apologized again before disappearing and moving on to her manager duties. 
Celine made up for our undesirable experience at this Bertucci's, we've been going to Bertucci's for years and stopped for a while and was happy to come across one but disappointed by the service until the manager stepped in. She made small conversation with us so it didn't seem like she was just trying to keep us from posting a nasty review by checking in, she seemed to really care about our experience and what would make it better. I will definitely be back to this Bertucci's maybe not during homecoming but this is a place for good quality food and they have a great chocolate cake  that I have had anywhere else.
name: Clarissa

text: Stopped by for lunch.  Our server, Wayne, was great. Food was amazing. My colleague said it was the best salad he has had in a long time. A new favorite!.
name: Alexandra

text: Just had Valentines dinner here with the wife and was amazed at the quality of the food and the superb staff! Our compliments to @chef_nicole333 for a job well done!! For the appetizer the tamale was the best I've ever had. No joke! Followed that up with a Sea Bass in a bed of Risotto with some other yummy goodness I won't even try to describe. Then there was the dessert! The wife had a sangria poached pear dish that she said was exquisite with a great blend of flavors and I had the pleasure of enjoying a sugar cookie and some outstanding chocolate bars with pistachios embedded in them. Will stop in here when visiting Tucson in the future.
name: Charles

text: Ended up here pretty late, maybe around 9:30, because everything else nearby had a wait. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again.
name: User

text:
I just rediscovered the FisHouse since a friend started working there. I had completely forgotten about this spot with so many choices in that area to pick from. Let me tell you, Happy Hour there is fantastic! Great prices and a large appetizer menu.  My husband had the Ceviche and the Clam Chowder. He said they were great! I had the Burger and it is a solid choice if you are not craving fish. Only $9 and it comes with fries!

Next time you are in the Funk Zone, stop by for a drink and some food and say hi to my Friend Chris! He will greet you with a smile and brighten your day!
name: Anne

text: This is probably the worst Indian food there! Very slow service! Low on staff, and the food isn't that great!! The place is very dirty and unpleasant!!! Won't come back. The owner Hasn wasn't nice and when we complained about the quality of the food he ignored us and didn't understand what we were talking about.
name: Dave

text: This is a simple, no frills, big city diner. It's very busy and very small but the service is great and the food is quality. I had an egg and bacon bagel and it was fantastic. Love this little place. If you want a feel and taste of the city, check it out.
name: Dana

text: Went with family on a Sunday and it was louder than I expected. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. No big complaints, just a nice meal. For the price I expected more than this. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text: Had a burger and fries there yesterday. Everything was very fresh-- my second visit and the menu seemed much more limited than last time. Burger was juicy and quite good even though it was over cooked -- ordered medium rare -- got medium well. Fries were pretty good , too. Service was friendly and prompt. Burger was very reasonably priced for the quality. $5 . Nice clean facility. Would probably return if I were in the area.
name: Todd

text: Not good.  Had an overpriced "burger" that was not cooked right.  This place is essentially fast food with pre cooked burgers that they put pre cooked toppings on.
name: Andrew

text:
I get the same thing most times. Clam chowder and or the blackened chicken pasta. 

The clam chowder is rich and packed with clams. Soooooo good! I'm not usually a fan of clam chowder but I'm glad my husband had me try it one day. 

The pasta is rich with pretty good flavor. I get mine with extra sauce. The portion is also pretty big with a lot of chicken. It's great comfort food. 

I have also tried their seafood dip. It's pretty darn good. 

This place is pretty inexpensive and happy hour always seems to be going on.
name: Teri

text:
I came here mid day on Sunday and this place was empty. This gave me pause upon entering but so much as to leave. It seems setup to be a bubble tea cafe with a small row of tables but a long counter with bubble tea powders and containers of jelly. A bubble tea setup always makes me nervous in a restaurant because I'm worried that it's the prime business and the food is secondary, but thankfully that doesn't appear to be the case here.

The menu is varied with a set of Malaysian dishes and a mix of other Asian favorites. The menu also has 2 or 3 pages of vegan dishes too. 
I enjoy vegan food, but today (as recommended), I ordered rendang chicken which is slow cooked and stewed with coconut milk and coconut flakes. This was VERY rich and I was glad to have some rice and a little salad to have with it. I wish I came with more people so I could have tried more of the menu, but this was enough for me to give this a good rating.

I also had some dumplings which are one of my bellwether foods at many restaurants. These were fairly mediocre and I probably wouldn't order them again.

One of the best parts of the place is the service. Perhaps it's because I was their only customer when I arrived, but I have to say that it was very friendly and helpful. It was attentive, but not too much so.

All in all this restaurant deserves more business. I will definitely be back.
name: Derek

text:
One of my favorite beaches, that although not close to me, is worth the drive! Super relaxing and peaceful whether day or night. Some of the prettiest sunsets are found here. 

Next to a nice quiet town, with shops, restaurants and places to stay. Sometimes they have streets blocked off for craft fairs and vendors and it's fun to bring your fur baby's and walk along to check out everything. 

Very clean area also. Never see much pollution or littering. Not a party beach but more of a romantic beach. Love this area just to get away for a staycation or date night!
name: Emily

text: So a lot of the places I visit when I'm in Santa Barbara have some pretty amazing people watching.  Because of this restaurant's location on State Street, if you sit outside, you're going to see a little of everything.  Bonus - the food and drinks are outstanding!  They have an impressive selection of civiche.  Two of my favorites are the Ahi Tuna Ceviche, which has, among other ingredients, pomegranate and corn, and the Ceviche Verde, which has citrus marinated halibut with apple, cucumber, pineapple, jicama, cilantro and basil sauce.  Super creative and delicious.  The salmon tacos and crispy tacos are outstanding.  I can't wait to come here again.
name: Cindi

text: We've been wanting to try this place for a while now.   Finally had an out-of-the-blue kidless evening and ventured in.   Being new we asked for a minute to decide among the many house drinks.   My wife decided on the gimlet special, which the waitress proceeded to make 3 different excuses as to why they couldn't, including being out of a liquor that wasn't even in the recipe.   Pretty sure she just didn't know how to make it.  According to one patron (among 2 that tried to help us and the table next to us get served) the owner was sitting at the bar BS'ing with a regular and doing birthday shots, and she later checked on the table next to us but didn't even throw us a glance.   It didn't take us long to decide against ordering food and doing a one-and-done drink visit to get food elsewhere.   Temper your expectations.....especially with a business who can't even get their hours right on their Yelp page....(what pub closes at 1 pm on Friday and Saturday).
name: Justin

text: First sit in Whitney's section. She was very attentive and has a great personality. We were warmly welcomed as we entered and were seated. We were even welcomed for coming in. The food wasdelicious. Great poboys! Finally the atmosphere is warm and welcome with a little but of a kick. Great place!!!
name: Brian

text: Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Worth checking out. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really.
name: User

text: The food was well cooked and tasted pretty good. However, the server was kind of rude. She had an aggravated tone while serving us because she had to make small changes. Otherwise, I enjoyed my lunch.

text: The food was good and the service was easygoing. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..

I really said "just hear for lunch?" Sat me down and the server was nice enough.  Miscommunication on my order but they corrected it.

text: Over priced mediocre food. Good view though. But if you want better taste if food for half the price go to any other bar in town.

text: Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. A very pleasant experience. The food was good and the service was easygoing. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..

I got the eggs benedict and it was one of the best I've had in Philadelphia. They ran out of chocolate syrup to make chocolate milk and they had one of their workers run out and grab some just for us!!! Great experience.

text: Exceptional experience, service, food, and drinks, thanks Zea's!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

text: Very nice place.  Had the seafood appetizer and long bone ribeye.  Only complaint was that they over cooked the steak.  Was with a large group so maybe that had something to do with it.  Flavor was great though.  Would recommend.
name: Sam

text:
Very disappointed experience yesterday. Usually really great sandwiches. Ordered a Turkey Diablo with provolone, LTO. As a wrap. If I wanted a resentment-filled bread sandwich with added passive-aggressive mayo, I could have simply asked my boyfriend to make a wrap for me.

We are not overpaying for two sandwiches again from this place. By the way, once I scrapped off all the gooey mayo mess off of my sandwich, removed most of the bread on the top to flip the sandwich upside down to eat it without the bottom bread, it was great. I could do without the sandwich gymnastics.

I worked in the service industry too in the past, and I didn't care how you wanted your sandwich, because you were paying for it.

Don't mess with food that someone else is paying too much for in the first place.
name: Jenn

text:
Who doesn't love this place? Sure sometimes it's cars galore at the drive thru but that's because it's AMAZING. We went Friday evening around 5 and there were no cars in the drive thru and only a handful of people inside. Gave our order, got it in less than 5 minutes. The taste oooohweee...my first time having the chick fil a deluxe (with lettuce tomato and cheese) and it's now my new favorite. Wife had the spicy chicken tenders and she said they were spicy and delicious. 
They take pride in their business and their food and it shows. The employees seem happy and like they love their job. Smiles all around.
name: LaNoya

text: This place is costy, but it is well worth it. Great food and service.
name: LoadStar

text: Being a nursing momma away from my baby while out of town, Hard Rock stepped up. I called ahead to see if they had somewhere I could pump while our group was at lunch. When I got there they allowed me to use their office without any hesitation and were so polite about it. Amazing!
name: Kristin

text:
Great location, great drinks, awesome food and friendly staff. 

Their drinks were delicious and affordable. It was a fun beach bar atmosphere, and the staff was friendly and attentive. 

It's right on the beach so it's amazing. Upstairs seating is hot, but the view is worth is. 

They also sell little tubes of sunscreen! It saved me when mine exploded in the car! I was so grateful!

The only thing keeping it from getting five stars was the bathroom. They say it's going to be updated, but it wasn't comfortable or very clean.
name: Tasha

text: We tried this place for the first time a few months ago and were surprised to find a lot of cars waiting outside for it to open for dinner. As soon as that door opened, people were piling out of their cars to get in and seated. I thought that it probably meant good things, so we went in with high expectations. We've now eaten here three times and have enjoyed it every time. We prefer the regular dining section rather than hibachi. My husband has ordered the Kyoto bento box twice and I opt for the tonkotsu ramen. It's not the best ramen I've ever had (though I have been spoiled because it was in Japan). I will say it is the closest to the ramen I like in Japan that I have found in the Indianapolis area so far. I do wish it had bean sprouts, but it's still good. The thing that keeps me coming back, though, is that ginger dressing they serve on the salads. That sesame flavor just takes what is already a good dressing to the next level. I wish I could buy it by the bottle lol!
name: Skylar

text:
This restaurant isn't open that much but when it is the food is great at a good price. Especially like the croissant bacon and egg sandwiches. They're only $3 a piece and they are good very good. The French toast is to die for and it's only 895. Hopefully you won't die. 

Please be advised that restaurant open is closed on Saturday and open on Sunday from 8 to 1 p.m. they are not opened all day don't get confused. Come eat some good food in a clean place at a good price!
name: Arlene

text: I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Price felt a touch high for what it was. You can tell they care about customer experience here. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Would absolutely visit again. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. For the price I expected more than this. Would probably stop in again if nearby.

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which prob says everything.. It was decent, just a little uneven.
name: User

text: In Clearwater for work and pleasure.  Found this place near the condo.  Great thin crust NY style pizza.  Orbered several while on our trip.

text: If you want to get a good breakfast seat, get here early! I arrived right after opening, and was seated at the bar immediately, but while there, I watched the entire place quickly fill up. I had the Banana Foster French Toast, and it was delicious. The portion was huge, and was well worth the price. It had sweetness to it, but it was a balanced sweetness, and it never got to the point where I felt like my teeth were hurting. Definitely a great place to get your day going!
name: Kara

text: Went in to treat my kids to pi day of course. I ended up getting the smoked chicken caesar. The portion was great, the dressing and salad greens were fine. The chicken is where I had the most issues. If you've ever experienced over brined chicken, you know what I mean. The chicken was cooked. I'm assuming the flavor was good, but it  was wet , very wet in the inside. It also had a slight crunch when chewing chewed. It had a very strange texture that almost made me question if it was thoroughly cooked. I'm not a fan thus far. I may be back to try other things, but $10 bucks for questionable chicken is too much.
name: Krystal

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Idk, ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.

text: Had dinner at Felinis a few nights ago and the food was excellent. The manager greeted us in Italian and made us feel at home. I will definitely be going back!
name: Patty

text:
We tried 2 times and the service was terrible both times.  We just aren't going to waste our time again.  I wanted to share to prevent you from wasting your time.

First trip.  

We waited 25 minutes before one of the many servers who walked past decided we needed served.  One we ordered, everything arrived at the same time.  Appetizers, salads, food.

Second trip.

We waited but not as long.  We purposely only ordered drinks and Appetizers.  Then, once appetizers arrived, we ordered food.  Salads came out after entrees and the free Birthday dessert never arrived.  We just left.  

If you do go, good luck.

This is what I wanted it to be.  Tasted fresh and good variety.  Enjoyed dinner here again with daughter and granddaughter.  Great food, nice atmosphere and good service.  Try it again if you have not been here for awhile.

text: Honestly I think I ordered the wrong thing. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Food was fresh and service was quick. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really.
