text: I found this restaurant on yelp and read the positive reviews so I decided to explore the menu. I went to the restaurant's website and was interested in the secret menu. It advertised for two people: two filets, shrimp jonghe (shrimp baked with garlic and olive oil beneath bread crumbs), house made linguini with garlic and olive oil, wedge salad, bread and chef's choice of dessert. The cost was $79. My wife and I are teachers and thought we would splurge to celebrate the end of school year. So we went. Upon arrival we were immediately sat but were struck by the strong smell of stale cigarettes. It was really strong, as if the place had previously been a smokey bar. We opened the menu and to our dismay, the menu had changed. For $89 two people would get two filets, scallops, cheese ravioli, veggie,side salad, bread and chef's choice of dessert. I asked the waitress if the advertised menu could be ordered from and she said no and that she has no idea how often the website is updated and walked away. We ordered it on the faith that this chef was so respected that it had to be good. We were wrong. The salad was a plate of lettuce with a thick dollop of mayonnaise-like dressing (their creamy garlic upcharge, btw) the two scallops were dry with no seasoning, and the cheese ravioli sitting in a pool of sweet jarred sauce was thick and chewy and clearly previously frozen, not house made as the waitress assured us. The steaks and bread were good but that's it. Even the dessert, cannoli, was stale and didn't get eaten. We left disgusted and hungry. I wish we had the time to stay and tell the owner about our experience, but we had tickets to a show and had to leave. Sadly, our waitress didn't seem to care or notice that most of our meal went uneaten, and were obviously dissatisfied. We will not be back!
name: Tracy

text: The pizza was absolutely amazing!  Our server Angel was awesome!  The manager came by and asked about our experience and gave us a free dessert for being first time diners.  The oreo cheesecake was fantastic, by the way!  Everything was perfect!
name: Kim

text: Happened upon this place after all our other dinner plans kept getting mucked up, and it turned out to be a great end of the night. Sat at a hightop and watched the game while eating some killer dan dan noodles. The cocktails are delicious, too, and the bar space is pretty big, so if you're in the area for a drink this could be a good starting spot.
name: Sara

text: Not saying it's perfect, but some reviews make it sound way worse than it is. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The staff seemed tired but still polite. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Not saying it's the best place ever, but it was totally fine. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text:
Wow, good to see a new BBQ place in center city. Ever since Percy street closed it has been a real problem to find quality Brisket in center city. 
This place has the stuff, ribs were great, brisket was certainly better than average! Beans were not good, and the fries were average, so hopefully that was just a fluke, but when I am in the area I will be back!
name: Joshua

text:
By far the worst management on the face of the Earth. Ordered grilled chicken salad no onions. Twice they brought it out with onions. Manager doesn't know what an onion looks like or smells like. 

Then laughed.
name: Steve

text: Food was fresh and service was quick. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Overall, a strong experience. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly.
name: User

text: Mary was the rudest host I was worried my whole first experience was going to go south. The bartender rolled her eyes at my friend as a response to my friends "thank you". Then my lovely waitress saved the day. Thanks missy for making this a great lunch for my friends and I.
name: Rebecca

text: Disrespectful people who work there. Don't ever go to this location. This McDonald's don't know how to treat people with care. Half of the people who work there act like they don't care for the job. This place is disrespectful
name: I'm

text: Love coming to Cesar's Place!! Can't go wrong with anything on the menu, especially the Aguachiles...they are the best!!
name: danielle

text:
So I really enjoy this place.  

My go to is the Four bowl.

2 bases * 1 veggie * 1 protein * 1 sauce
Kale Slaw & Sweet Potato Noodles (new obsession) 
Buffalo cauliflower (ah-mazing, I have started making them at home)
Tuna poke 
Typically no sauce, but if I am feeling saucy then I will have the Holy Kale on the side

Do yourself a favor and get this in your belly! 

Also, they have Pressed Juices.  Slimberry gives me joy.
name: Ee'Cart

text: Just a heads up to make sure you check any food ordered from Fiesta as I was eating a salad and felt something unusual reached in and pulled out a piece of glass.  Things happen I understand that but when I called to speak to the owner about it so that he was aware he told me it was bullshit and I was lying (yes I have pictures) wasnt looking for anything but maybe an apology would have been nice.  Just a PSA be aware of what's in your food.  I have heard alot about other issues there.  Bugs in food.  Wrong food given to people and I could go on.  All I can say is DON'T GO THERE.
name: Jann

text:
The Bellwether is yet another testament to just how awesome the Saint Louis food scene is. I do not know if this place knows how to make food that does not taste good.
The menu here changes frequently so I will avoid talking about some of my favorite meals here and just say that if something on the menu sounds good, order it. Two things that I do not think will ever go off their menu is the Bellwether Burger and the Octopus. Both of these meals should make anyone happy. I do not typically enjoy mushrooms but the Bellwether burger has opened my eyes!!
The bar program here is fantastic as well. I highly recommend Gravity's Rainbow. It is made with russel henry hawaiian ginger gin, giffard creme de banana, sena pod gastrique, e. harlow magnolia bitters, lemon juice. Truth be told I do not know what everything listed in the drink is, but I do know that it tastes fantastic.
I give very few 5 star reviews but The Bellwether deserves all 5 of these stars!
name: Stephen

text: Cool people.. Funny as hell workers. And great food. It's not fancy and that's a good thing. It's simply good seafood that doesn't tax your wallet. Watch out for the corn though.. Soaking in all that goodness makes it super spicy.
name: Michelle

text: Despite empty seats, took us 20 minutes to be seated. The overwhelmed waitstaff was slow to take our order, get drink refills & bring our check. The menu has been vastly scaled back and doesn't include old favs like French Dip etc. It is hands down the loudest restaurant I have ever been to as well. Food quality is decent but nothing to rave about (besides the pretzels).
name: Scott

text: Prep & Pastry is a phenomenal place to go for brunch. I went for the first time on Valentines Day and their special brunch choices were absolutely delicious. I tried their red velvet pancakes and they absolutely blew me away. I have also had the Salmon Benedict and it was absolutely perfect. If you are looking for a great place to go for brunch, Prep & Pastry is a must. Make sure you get in early if you can, so they don't run out of their delicious array of pastries.
name: Meagan

text:
Several experiences at Burger Me.l add up to this being a good burger.

Now I'm fairly particular when it comes to burgers. I like a solid medium rare cook, leaving a juicy burger with a great beefy flavor. That party has gotta be on a sturdy bun that can absorb all that flavor without falling apart. Condiments need to compliment each other and not compete, and this one is totally subjective. 

Last but not least, I like my fries extra crispy. Not burned, but not floppy.

Now Burger Me offers some delicious combos and uses high quality meats for their burgers, delivering a great flavor profile. I just can't seem to ever get mine cooked the way I want it. 

Since I live so close, Burger Me should be my go to burger joint, and as a locally owned business I want to shout it's praises, but after a few overcooked experiences I can't. I'm super specific when I order to avoid issues, and it seems no matter what my burger is medium to medium well. I've certainly let staff know when I'm dining in, who have been happy to redo it, but in a restaurant with only a handful of guests I expect it to come out correctly. On takeout I do expect the burger to be cooked a little past my order due to hot conditions in the box and travel time, but even then the burger is more medium well when I get home.

The burger is still tasty, so dine with confidence if you dig  medium or beyond temps. But if you're like me, dine in and be prepared to check.
name: Michael

text: I've been here a couple times and wasn't blown away. Walked in and hostess left us standing there awkwardly waiting on her. First time there, an older Asian gentleman served us and he was great. Second time, the service wasn't as memorable. Both visits the sushi was light and fresh. We got the upside down roll, squid steak, bluefin tuna, ocean salad, and truffle salmon sashimi.
name: Anawin

text: Well appointed and delicious European style brunch spot! Our waiter, Chris B., was awesome. Chris was super attentive and pleasant. We started with Pain au chocolat. Fantastic starter with coffee. For the main event, I had the Bayonne ham Benedict and my husband has the croque Madame with truffle fries and a side of sausage. Everything was outstanding and full of flavor!
name: Adrienne

text: INCREDIBLE food! Never have been disappointed here. Service can be iffy though. Usually the service is top notch as well but the most recent visit and a handful of others the server has disappeared and not come back until we needed our checks. No checking on us to see if our food was good or seeing if we need refills on drinks. Other than that, super friendly staff and a fun menu. Tasty drinks. Reasonably priced!
name: Abby

text: Portion size looked small at first but it was actually enough. For a busy night they handled it okay. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Maybe better dine-in than delivery, hard to tell. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. For the price I expected more than this. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text: I waited a day before posting this specifically so that there is less emotion and more fact when I post. I eat here, be it via delivery or in the restaurant, about 2x a month. Its mostly convenience and the rewards program that keeps me coming back. When I order delivery, many times the order is wrong or it just doesn't deliver as well as eating at the restaurant. So...when I designated Carrabba's as my caterer for my Graduation, I expected something to be off which is why I made it a point to ensure everything was perfectly planned. Well, after spending $410 on food, it was given to us without warmers, no plastic wear or dinnerware and we didn't know until we arrived home (and had lots of ppl waiting and ready to party). The food got cold, we had to put it in the oven ourselves. Someone had to run out and buy dinnerware. And the bruschetta was in some odd combination, soggy but hard bread. The amount of food for the money was just not right. Needless to say, it made my party less enjoyable and I definitely did not get my money's worth. I'm extremely disappointed in this restaurant and they have lost a customer in me. I advise that this not be your choice for catering needs.
name: Ornella

text: My server nene told me to make a review to share my experience and that exactly what I'm doing. Everything was fabulous from the food to the service. Nene talked me and my girls into bottomless and she kept them coming as promised! I got the soup, legs and eggs, and finished with the bread pudding ! This is a lot of food three courses but everything was delicious!! Thank you Sobou for the amazing experience and service will be back very soon !!
name: Michelle

text:
The food here is always amazing. Plenty of healthy salad options and delicious paninis. They also have plenty of smoothie options. 
I recommend the
 Apple salad: spinach, feta, Fuji apples, chicken, craisins, pecans and a raspberry vinaigrette.
Energy booster smoothie: strawberry, blueberry, banana, spinach, almond milk, and chia seeds. 

It is a very tight space and crowded around 12:00. Prepare for a long wait during this time or order online!!
name: Marissa

text: Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. Pretty happy with it overall. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text: The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. By the time the food came out I was already annoyed. Probably not coming back. Not bad for a quick meal. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: Is smoking on the expo line a health code violation?!?! I watched employee after employee light up and blow cigarette and vape smoke on every order in the bar. Management.....have your employees smoke outside. It's DISGUSTING to watch the staff blow smoke into my food.
name: Stacey

text:
Anytime this place came up in conversation, I knew I had to go!! My boyfriend and I got there during peak time (7pm on a Saturday evening) and expected a wait time. We waited briefly to put our name on the list which was projected to be two hours. We found a spot at the bar and helped ourselves to a few drinks that were recommended by our bar tender and they were awesome! While browsing the menu we devoured the Mac n cheese spring rolls and a each of us had a entree. The food was good "bar food".  
Exactly two hours later our bay was ready for us and we thoroughly enjoyed ourselves! Our server was extremely attentive to us and even jokingly got me on a joke (he was so funny). You could easily see in the way he worked, he liked his job!! This is unexpected as it's unfortunately not the norm. I loved the company and atmosphere. 
If you not a golfer (like my self...talking zero experience) it was still so much fun. After playing golf, we made our way to the third level and enjoyed the DJ and bar games such as giant jenga, connect four and corn hole. This place was a fun night out and should definitely be a date night or group adventure!
name: Tara

text: Authentic Thai food and atmosphere. Friendly service.  The shrimp & chicken pad thai were just the perfect heat & sweet.  I would for sure go back.
name: Annette

text: Went for dinner with my husband on a Saturday night. The restaurant is very small and intimate. I don't recommend going without a reservation. We came 10 minutes early for our reservation and had to wait until exactly 8pm to be seated. Service overall was great. For food, I ordered the spaghetti with lobster and my husband ordered the tagliatelle. Both were amazing. They have so many great options on the menu, it was hard to decide on just one dish. This place deserves a 5 star review in every way. Upscale service and food without being pretentious. We will definitely be back.
name: Ashley

text: Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Pretty happy w it overall. Food was fresh and service was quick. For the price I expected more than this. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. It just never really recovered once things started off weird. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Maybe other people have better luck here. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. For the price I expected more than this. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text:
Think of the classiest, upscale, most French diner with decor you can think of, and that would be Parc. We loved coming to this restaurant for a weekend brunch in Philly.

I ordered the Quiche Lorraine. I was a little worried that the portion wouldn't fill me up, but it did. It comes as a nice slice along with a dressed salad. The crust was super nice and buttery and flakely - I think it was the butter they made the quiche with that made it so filling. Inside are pieces of ham and green onion. Nonetheless it was yummy and made for a delicious brunch! Would definitely come here again.

See my hungrier half's review from @AsianCoupleEats from David N (davidngo.yelp.com)!
name: Joyce

text: BELIEVE the hype.  This is one amazing new place right on our underutilized waterfront.  It is so well designed and laid out with many great options.  The space is also versatile in that it can work for families, dog owners, dates, parties, brunch, business dinners, etc.  I just can't rave about how much we enjoyed our visit last weekend.
name: Charlie

text:
This is my favorite breakfast spot in Sparks, NV! This is my second time coming here and even though there's always a wait, it's never longer then 15 min for 2 people. Well that's been my case both times lol. Right now there's construction going on next to the parking lot so know that some of the entrances into the parking lot are blocked. Now let's gets down to the food. 

Carne Asada- This is my go to here at this spot. It comes with steak, beans, your choice of either corn or flour tortilla, sour cream, guacamole, has brown and 2 eggs to order. It's a huge amount of food for a great price. The steak was seasoned well and everything came out perfectly. The corn tortillas were piping hot which I enjoy my tortillas to be hot and it went perfectly with the meal. 

If you're in the area be sure to stop by this breakfast and lunch spot! You won't be disappointed, trust me...
name: Travis

text: Stopped here on our way through Santa Barbara and the food was delicious! Portions were very large and prices reasonable. I was longing for La Super-Rica, which I haven't been to in ages, but it is Labor Day and no one answered the phone when I tried to verify if it was open. No regrets, because the grill-blackened poblano and onion tacos and homemade tortillas were every bit as good at Rudy's. My husband had the Chile rellano and it was great - the Chile was subtly spicy and flavorful, not bland, as is so often the case. Their chips are really good, too.
name: Amy

text:
HEALTH CODE VIOLATION 
To start with the good Tey and Ruby helped me pick out what to get because it was my first time but it is my last. Don't get me wrong, food is really good and MOST of the service is absolutely great. But unfortunately first and last time going there. I got my food sat down and started enjoying it, I didn't have much to do so I was watching the people In the kitchen when I saw something that was so disgusting I immediately threw my food away. A girl in the Togo side of things reached into a bag with bare hands took out a handful of fries and took a bite out and then put the rest of the fries back in while some of her coworkers laughed. If that isn't the biggest health code violation I've ever seen I don't know what is. I told the manager and he didn't even ask who it was and thankfully one of the employees was nice enough to get me her name when I pointed her out and asked (again most of the service is great). Will be Contacting corporate because a talking to that ended with the manager yelling "watch out guys" really doesn't cut it.
name: Makayla

text:
Their fried chicken is one of the best fried chicken I have ever eaten. It's a bit strange to order fried chicken in a Chinese restaurant, but boy do they do it right and trust me, I have eaten fried chicken more than a regular person should be eating. 

I absolutely love their dumplings. You can tell that their dumplings are handmade (and the dough as well) because each fold on the dumpling isn't always perfect. My family makes dumplings from scratch and their dumplings are probably the most authentic version I have eaten. 

Honestly, you can order what's on the menu, but if you want authentic Asian cooking, I am sure they'll accomodate for you. Everything on their menu is "Americanized", but that sells. The owners know how to cook real, Asian food and if you are willing, I would just simply ask them to not "Americanize" whatever you're ordering. 

Price wise, this place is extremely cheap. It doesn't get any better than this and I wish they would open a place near my town. Take the time to eat here.
name: Brittany

text: Fisrt off, it is understandable that on a Friday night most places are busy, but to seat two people and then leave them seated for more then 10 mins without a waiter coming by and even getting some water to the table is unacceptable. Apparently the service is the weakest point of this place since we have been here once before and tried their food, which is good, but not worth embarrassing yourself and sitting at a table for minutes.
name: Edwin

text: The food was fantastic. The atmosphere was awesome. The service was fabulous. Because of all this, the wait was ridiculous. The wait is the only reason this is not a 5 star. This business is really awesome, how about expanding & including the ability to make reservations for parties smaller than 5? I'm just not into waiting an hour to be seated, not even for a really awesome meal in a city where there are a LOT of places that offer awesome meals. It's off my bucket list at least! Try it!
name: Ginger

text:
This place is fairly new so I guess not many people know about it just yet. I love trying out all the hot and new spots. Got right in on a Friday nite, it wasnt busy at all. Even though they did have some patio seatings we went for the booth seating inside so we can enjoy our meal with no bugs. The place itself is really nice with plenty of room.

For starters we got the crab stuffed mushrooms and was not disappointed. The menu offered a wide variety of things from small plates to entrees. Everything sounded so good we couldn't decide what we wanted. I went with the surf and turf pasta and was so glad I did. It was so good and creamy and a good portion as well. My bf got the Seabass and he really enjoyed it as well. Service and food was great we will def come back to try other entrees or alot of the small plates.

Came back for the happy hour and we was so pleased. With the price and the options on the menu. This is def a must come back place. Everything we had so far was good and the price you just cant beat it for the amount of food you get!!
name: Lyna

text:
I've been on the fence on whether this establishment deserved three or four stars.  I'm going with four based on there really wasn't anything bad about my experience. 

You order from the counter and your food is brought to you at the table.  I liked that the drink station was clean and there were all the necessary condiments to include soy and chili sauce. 

I chose the general tsao's chicken with a bit of spice.  The main dish was just ok.  I enjoyed the chicken but not the rice or veggies.  Just seemed cheap quality.  With that being said I really liked the hot and sour soup and cream cheese wontons.  The wontons tasted a bit crabby but I would still order again.  For a quick lunch I do think this is a decent option.
name: Tasha

text: Fantastic!  Terrific staff- friendly, professional and very efficient.  Don't be put off if there's a line.  They move quick!  The store is spotless.  And the pretzels- they are truly delicious.  I've been there several times now and everything I've tried has been tasty.  I would highly recommend the jalapeno cheese sauce for the pretzels.  Eat here and you will be rewarded for buying local.
name: Kevin

text: Today was my first time trying this place for lunch. I was pleasantly surprised based on the mix reviews on Yelp. I ordered chicken pad thai to go. The price is different from the menu: it's $7.50 for lunch instead of $6.95. I didn't ask for any spice so the pad Thai tasted very peanut-y. It didn't taste too greasy. I wish it had a little bit more chicken. Otherwise than that, I was happy with the food for the value. It tastes better than the other Thai restuarants in the area. I feel it's better than Thai Siam on East Bay, in the shopping plaza with LA Fitness and Publix.
name: Crystal

text: sweetgreen is the bomb.com.  Healthy and delicious food.  Good portion sizes.  They mix up the ingredients every season so it keeps you on your toes.  Although I miss the curry cauliflower when it's gone.  I always make a custom salad and I'm never disappointed.  Excellent customer service.  Definitey superior to the competition.
name: Brian

text: This is one of those places where I can see other people loving it more than I did. For a busy night they handled it okay. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. so yeah kind of mixed on it. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text: The atmosphere in this place is very inviting. We loved our server. She was friendly and personable. Everything we ordered for lunch was spot on and delicious. A welcome establishment in downtown Meridian.
name: Jesse

text: One of my favorite restaurants! Love the kaaragi chicken bowl. Everything is always fresh and amazing! We highly recommend
name: Lesley

text: Reading some of these complaints now feels a little overblown. Food was fresh and service was quick. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Maybe expectations are just off for some people. Not bad for a quick meal. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text:
Another first time dining location.
We went for lunch my wife and I both had the Thai curries I the red and she had the yellow with chicken she says hers was very good very tender on the other hand my beef was a bit overcooked and a bit leathery but the spice of the curry was very good.
 For an appetizer we shared a plate of ahi tuna spring rolls which were excellent.
name: Andre Carlo

text: Love Blaze Pizza!!  They have fresh gluten free pizza dough and now are trying a cauliflower crust.  If they can do fresh gluten-free pizza crust, why do all other pizzerias only serve frozen crust??
name: Paula

text: Terrible service. Had a reservation. Wasn't seated at our table until 30 mins late. Didn't get appetizers for another hour. Still waiting for our food. Getting ready to leave without our food. Ridiculous
name: Keith

text: If you want to eat and drink at a daycare center this is the place for you....very family friendly
name: Vernon

text: Great tacos!! Definitely authentic and a must have!! We only had tacos this time but we'll be back soon to try their famous tortas. This is a takeout place only but they do have a small table outside, so if you're there early you can sit outside to eat. Next time we will simply take it home.
name: Nancy

text: I love this place! My boyfriend and I visit multiple times a month. We really enjoy how cold and fresh the sushi is when it hits our tables. Our servers are always attentive to our needs, especially BLUE! She's our absolute favorite. She's so personable and takes her job seriously. We really enjoy this place and the atmosphere. See you guys soon!
name: Alyssa

text: Great little place with nice cocktails. Menu is small but delicious. Most days I believe they do a crawfish boil, and I would recommend. Parking is a bit limited, but manageable. Great if you want to get out of the Quarter.
name: Kimberly

text: This part of Pennsylvania has no shortage of places to get great food at a fair plaice. Add Maryanne's to the list of places to stop. Tucked into an older shopping center, the interior is country-ish with a Coca Cola theme. You will find out shortly why this place is so popular with the locals. Lots of breakfast and lunch choices. My breakfast (and my friends) was filling and good. The waitress was attentive but not too much making sure my coffee cup was never empty. Considering the quantity and quality this place is a bargain. Mark down Maryanne's the next time you are in the area.
name: Steve

text: We are regulars here, and like the food, but today's experience was ridiculous. The only positive was Liam, the only experienced employee. Poor fellow, he was trying to train a new cashier (who was completely clueless) and a new cook. We had a small order that we had to ask about after sitting for 20 minutes. THEN they started preparing it. A lady from the drive through had to come in for her order. I was so hot and ready to ask for my money back, but hubby calmed me down. We won't be back until we see a new cashier at the very least, and maybe not then.
name: Susan

text: Very disappointed at this location. We waited 40 minutes to get our food while in the drive thru. We then got to the window and they asked us to park in the drive thru parking and they would be right out within two minutes. After 10 minutes, my husband went inside to see that our bag was just sitting there because they had forgot to bring it out to us. This is terrible service and won't be coming back. Very poor time management and customer service.
name: Paulina

text: What a great find.  Amazing food, amazing margaritas and friendly service.  It's worth a try!
name: Michele

text:
Yikes.... what a sad experience.  Plainly, the service was average/acceptable for most of the meal.  The end of the evening was a bit of a train wreck, because they are using a payment system from 1974.  With that being said, it's easy enough to pay your bill and move on with your night. 

The food was mediocre at its best--some of the desserts were 6/10s.  The two small plates I had (including the beef short rib and gnocchi dishes) were lacking in inspiration and flavor.  I would give the short rib 2/5-The horseradish was somewhat redeeming, but otherwise this was nothing to write home about.  The gnocchi were so extremely disappointing I almost sent them back.  There was no flavor profile to this dish at all. Don't be fooled by the dish's description (including preserved lemon)--sneak in something (anything) from your spice rack to doctor this dish. 

This is definitely not a Michelin restaurant.  For the love of everything in this world, I'm not sure how it could win any awards in NOLA. There are better places out there--why settle for less?
name: Geoff

text:
Amazing Hawaiian food is always welcome! Especially in air conditioned comfort. This place is incredible! It's a beautiful dining room ready for ordering! Complete with Hawaiian art on the walls. 

Hulu-huli chicken! Macaroni salad! Chicken Katsu! Rice! Hot sauce! Spam! 

Life is good!
name: Dave

text:
I have a problem. 

And it involves Strange Donuts. Before Strange Donuts I rarely would have a donut, and often times I would turn them down when offered. Now I see donut shops everywhere, and I can't help but wonder if they are Strange.

They aren't. You can only get this shit here. I love trying something new every time I come in for a taste of sweet sweet diabetes. Surge donut! Yes! Imos donut? Yes NOW!

MAKE THE DAMN PRONUTS A DAILY AND I WOULD HAVE AN EXCUSE TO EAT DONUTS POST WORKOUT LIKE A REAL BRO!

Every now and then my petite little wife even wants a gluten free donut, which she eats over the course of 4 days because she keeps her carbs low and she is the grand master of self control.

I AM NOT. And I like to eat Strange Donuts two at a time and feel the sweet taste of regret when I'm burping Strange Donuts while lifting heavy ass weights on a Saturday morning. Should've eaten the donuts after the workout but who could resist?
name: Denny

text: I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Definitely coming back. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed.
name: User

text:
Walked in around 2 p.m. on a Monday. No one is at the front counter, about a minute later someone swings out of the back asking if I've been helped, then seats me. No worries - people are busy. 

Three tables are in use in the entire place. A few people at the bar, which the bartender is helping. 

The table near me has their waitress come by. She looks over at me, sees me seeing her, then decides to move away. I think "maybe she's letting my waitress know I'm ready."

Apparently not. 20 minutes after being seated, I have had zero people check on me. Not even a glass of water on the table. 

I have seen two waitresses (or a waitress and a hostess) have time to chat behind the register, though. 

It was nice of the restaurant to give me a place to sit for a bit, but I would've enjoyed some food on my lunch break. Instead I got to go back to work hungry and spend the rest of the day angry at the place that considers three tables too busy to serve other people.

text:
Solid breakfast/diner food.

I enjoy diner food. A greasy heaping of eggs, potatoes, and meat is all I really need in life and the cheaper the better. Skyway Café definitely fulfills my requirements. 

I heard this place can get really busy, but at 11:30 a.m. on a Tuesday there were still plenty of tables available. There were people in shorts and t-shirts and people in business casual clothes - there's really no dress code. 

I went with the Vegetable Skillet with a biscuit. Next time I think I'll try the cornbread. The biscuit was fluffy, whereas I enjoy my biscuits a little more flakey and dense. The Vegetable Skillet was a great portion of potatoes, eggs, and vegetables. It was a hearty meal and I ended up with some to take home! My friend got pancakes with blueberries and bananas and they looked huge and so fluffy! I had food envy looking at it. If you're a pancake person, you should definitely try it here. 

They bring you your check but you take it to the counter to pay. Our server was great - my water glass was never empty. 

Overall, I like this place and will come here to get my breakfast food fix!
name: Christina

text:
When I first heard about Mimi Blue Meatballs' first location in downtown Indy, I wasn't sold. Uhh...I'm not going to pay $11 for 4 bites of food, no thank you. And for years, I never cared to check it out, even when they opened up a Carmel location around the corner from my house. 

Well, I finally got coaxed into coming here tonight, and all my pre-conceived notions flew out the window. My husband and I split the chopped romaine salad as an appetizer, which was perfection. It had brussel sprouts, sprinkles of candied pecans, and the right amount of dressing to give it a balanced flavor. I was pleased with the portion size. Heck, I think it'd be great as an entree! 

The meatballs were considerably larger than what I had envisioned, and they were also surprisingly filling (though I guess that's expected when your entree is all protein). And as first timers, our server automatically brought us sauce samples, which was helpful. The bourbon bbq sauce was like no other - you can REALLY taste the whiskey, so this should only be consumed by Jack Daniels fans. The spicy cilantro was another great pick and loved the unique flavor as a sauce. The honey sriracha wasn't overly spicy or sweet - it struck a nice balance of the two flavors without competing one with the other. 

The service was phenomenal, and not only was our meal delicious, but it was reasonably priced. The only disappointment was the chocolate cake. I only got it because of the Yelp reviews, and it was...a-ok. Not bad, but nothing memorable. I wouldn't get it again, but perhaps tonight's batch was a fluke. 

Weird final comment: I *think* the tables were sufficiently spaced apart, but for some odd reason, I felt like we were sitting VERY close to our neighboring customers. Not a dealbreaker by any means, but I felt like I had to keep my voice down so as not to be bothersome to the other tables. 

By the way, we came with our 5 month old. We were the only ones there with kids, but the staff made us feel welcomed. So for those of you looking for (nicer) places to bring little ones, this is one of them! 

Mimi, I was SO wrong about your restaurant all this time. You have won my family over, and we will definitely return!
name: Kelly

text: Haven't been to EM in years. We decided to do the Devour Indy Menu. I looked at the menu on the Devour Indy website. When I first looked the 7oz filet didn't list an up charge of 8$. I will get back to that. Service was very lack luster, maybe our server was spread to thinly between too many tables. Maybe it been too long since we've been at a super casual dining establishment. It just seemed that the timing between courses was very long. Flemmings , Sullivans or Ruth's Chris don't take 2 hours to do dinner. Two of us ordered 4oz filet Oscar and one ordered the 7oz filet ( 8$ up charge ). When entrees came there were three 4oz filet Oscar's and my husband doesn't eat seafood so that's a problem. They made it right and even offered him the first steak to nibble on while the right one cooked. But since he doesn't eat seafood he passed. They could have split it between the two that actually ordered the Oscar style but they didn't and I didnt think of it sooner. So his steak comes out right size right cooking temp. With the Devour Indy we all got dessert, but with the order mess up they gave him another dessert free. Here's where I swing back to the 8$ the peanutbutter cup dessert he got free was $8.95 on the menu. Since we were already getting dessert why not knock off the 8$ up charge. I thought the decor was cold and dated and the fake flower arrangements have seen better days. Steak was good ( not as good as Flemmings ) Creme Brulee was wonderful. The vanilla vodka in my hot drink made the night much more pleasing and it easier to ignore the small child on his parents cell phone playing a game or watching videos. text:
apricot stone is quickly becoming one of my favorite restaurants. I've been here several times within the last month and have brought friends and family with me who have also loved it. 

They offer a good selection of foods that happen to be vegetarian and vegan incase you or your dining partners are into that. They were also able to provide my father who is gluten-free a plate of vegetables to eat with the dips, rather than the pita chips they serve. Beware that some dips are not gluten-free, so you will definitely want to make note to your serve ahead of time. 

I am half Armenian and this food reminds me of the delicious dinners my grandparents would make. I've had several dips, the hummus, babaganoush and mujamara which were all great. Even the hummus was exceptional-- I'm always hesitant ordering hummus at a restaurant, but their house made version was delicious. 

The cheese boreg and spanakopita are deliciously cheesy, hot, and fantastic. They are rather small, so order one per person. The dolmas are also fantastic. 

As for entrees, I've had the lamb kebab which features large, succulent chunks of grilled lamb. The kefte kebab is also amazing- it's an onion-y beef and lamb mixture. I've also tried the chicken shawarma which was not my favorite, but would be a good choice for diners who aren't into red meat. They do sandwiches or plates- the plates come with a salad, a dip, and a choice of meat (or three if you choose the tasting platter). The only salad I've had that I don't recommend is the greek salad- it's a bit basic and underwhelming. 

My vegetarian friend ordered the grilled vegetable hummus wrap which he inhaled before I could get a bite. 

As far as desserts, the walnut baklava and baklava with cheese are delicious. Neither were overly sweet, and the baklava with cheese was deliciously creamy and custardy. 

Final notes, they are BYOB, so knock yourself out! I'd probably recommend making a reservation if you come on a fri-sat-sun. I've also heard they have Wednesday night specials... so to be continued :)
name: Jodie

text: Coming from a place that had great examples of Cajun food, this one scratched my itch in the perfect way! I had the shrimp & grits dish, it was close to perfect. Remember me a little of Peter Luger in NYC! Being from NY if your place brings me back to the city I was born in term of food quality than you won my heart!!!

text:
We have lived less than a mile away for 14 years, but have never been here. Today, however, we got in our car to go fill the slow leak in our tire, and the car wouldn't start. Pop-a-lock came and charged it in record time (this is a review for Bourrée, don't worry, I'm getting there), and we drove to AutoZone where we discovered that the designers of our car (rhymes with "Schmord Schmocus") are money-grubbing cockroaches who placed the battery in such a way that a layperson can't change it. So we drove around for an hour hoping that the battery would hold the charge. We tried to run two more fruitless errands in the meantime, and returned home, crossing our fingers that the battery would hold the charge. 

It didn't. 

Mad and ravenous, we decided to walk the .8 miles to our favorite Mexican restaurant on Carrollton. 

Closed for a week.

Hangry and murderous, we kept walking and found ourselves at Bourrée. We expected the prices to be out of our range, since we are already on a lockdown budget plus are now looking at money for a new battery AND a licensed mechanic, but we're shocked at how reasonable the prices are. 

We sat and ate our FLIPPING FANTASTIC barbecue and sides in a courtyard that was lit by strings of pretty cobalt blue lights while a three piece jazz combo played pleasant and expertly executed old standards. We had the barbecue ribs with cornbread, mac and cheese, and potato salad, and it was absolutely phenomenal. Every bit of it was exceptional, but the mac and cheese was damned near a religious experience. 

All of which is to say that we were having an absolutely craptastic day that was completely turned around by a lovely evening with good music and excellent food at Bourrée.
name: Joanna

text: Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Food was fresh and service was quick. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Not bad for a quick meal. Would probably stop in again if nearby. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Food was good and came out fast. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..

Super simple menu, I think there was only three items and you could add more meat, eggs and veggies. I got the Super Saiyan bowl (LOVE the Dragon Ball names) with an extra egg. The eggs were cooked over medium, I like over easy, but it was fine. Perfect amount of gochujang for someone that likes their food a little spicy.

text:
Well they have finished the remodel and it looks terrific.  Just like the new one in Pigeon Forge actually and the Pf one is an entirely new building so that is impressive in itself.  It is open, modern and elegant.

After a day of shopping we decided to finish with a splurge so hubby went with his old staple the Ribeye and I, fancying a wee bit of surf with the turf this time, went with the filet and lobster.  

The Ribeye was perfect as usual and my lobster was unbelievable.  It melted in my mouth and was perfectly prepared with no chewy rubbery-ness that sadly happens more often than not in a Steakhouse.  However my filet was severely overdone, instead of being Med-rare, it was Med-well.  When our super friendly waitress came by to check, she saw it and said she would put another on the grill right away.  Being in the Christmas spirit, I told her not to worry, I would muddle through. She  sent the manager to our table who also saw it and was determined to fix it immediately.  

I cannot tell you how impressed we were with the service and the way this issue was handled.  The best steakhouses can overdo a steak, it is a common thing but what is uncommon is the friendly professional way the steak was not only taken care of but the entire situation was handled.  Five stars and 2 thumbs up!   

Thank you Wesley Chapel Outback- you are truly a cut above!
name: Powder

text:
I decided that for my birthday this year, I wanted to go to Nashville. It's a place I hadn't been to as an adult. I just wanted to get away from Atlanta with some good friends and food in a new city. I wanted to eat at a really nice place for dinner, as a birthday treat to myself, and Skull's Rainbow Room fit the bill. Plus--and this was a big draw for me--they have burlesque shows here. 

We made a reservation for a group of 8 for 7pm. Some of my friends were a little late, but they were very accommodating to us despite that. We asked the server what drinks she recommended, and she said that the Black Poodle was one of her favorites (Tempranillo, Stiegl Radler, Carpane Antica, Crème de Violette), but I opted for the Mrs. Deadrick (Cielo, Blackberry, Dry Curaco, Lemon, Lavender), and it was sooo good. Exactly what you'd expect from a fancy cocktail: delicious, well-balanced flavors made with fresh ingredients. I did try the Black Poodle from one of my friends, and it was pretty darn good as well. I kind of wished I'd ordered one myself! A friend also bought me the The Skull, which consisted of Havana Club, Coco Lopez, Pineapple, Grenadine, and Ginger, all in a beautiful clear glass skull cup with pretty floral decorations. 

As for the food, we started with the charcuterie plate, which was surprisingly large. At many places for $17, you'd get a small sampling size, but our whole table was able to sample a little bit of their cheese plate here. We also got the Tuna Tartare, Duck Empanadas, and Foie Gras. Everything we tried was absolutely delicious. As for my entrée, I chose the Bouef en Croute, which is "Ribeye braised in red wine, shallots and mushroom, wrapped in Brie cheese and puff pastry." It. Was. Fucking. Incredible. Seriously! So rich, flavorful, perfectly seasoned, with beef that was tender and meltingly delicious; the perfect complement to the crispy, Brie crust. One of my biggest regrets from that trip was that I accidently left my leftovers. I was genuinely devastated, because it was just so tasty. 

So now onto the burlesque show! It started at 11pm, and we let our waitress know that we planned on staying long enough to see that. So when it rolled around to that time, we were all seated together at a prime location for viewing. I've seen a few burlesque shows by now, but this was the first professional one and it was such a fun experience, especially for my birthday surrounded by my friends. The hostess was wonderful, oozing charisma and excitement, with a warm, confidential tone she adopted. Each of the girls was amazing in their own way, too. Graceful, with beautiful costumes and "bits" that they had with the beat of the dance. I'd say the show was shorter than I anticipated, but honestly that wasn't such a big deal since it was included in the night's general festivities and didn't require any additional money for us to watch it. 

PROS:
-The food and drinks here are incredible! Well-seasoned, fresh ingredients. 
-The waitress who served us was fantastic, and wonderfully accommodating of our party.
-The burlesque show was fun, and since we ate dinner, we were able to view it for free.

CONS:
None that I can recall.

text:
I have never called for delivery from this location and have only used carryout, but I must say that I have always had consistent service here. All the workers here have been friendly and courteous as well. One of the guys even knows me by name and always has a smile on his face whenever I show up.

Compared to other pizza places, this location has been the best I been to. I alway order from here.

text:
Things we loved: free fried pickles for checking in on Yelp, Bloody Mary bar (but don't use the Texas red hot Bloody Mary mix--it has no flavor and it's way too hot), a delicious mimosa including pineapple juice, long tables good for big groups, delicious grits--order the cheddar ones, the meals looked small but were incredibly filling, heaters next to the tables, you can call ahead and they add you to the list. 

Things we didn't love: Bloody Mary bar didn't have bacon, bathrooms were pretty gross. I can't speak for all of the toilets but the first stall was full of trash and the bin was overflowing only an hour after they opened which means they did not clean it last night. 

Comical story: When my friend ordered her breakfast the server asked "do you want grits or hash brown casserole with it?" and she replied "grits" to which he (joked?) "fries? Okay". We all thought he was kidding but then when the food came out much to her dismay it had fries and no grits. Even more hilarious/disappointing was there was a dollar up charge. To his defense we thought he was joking so we didn't clarify and the fries ended up being delicious so we didn't complain. 

Overall recommendations: have brunch here, call ahead especially if you have a big party, speak very clearly when you are ordering, and lastly, if you think your server is joking with you make sure you clarify that.
name: Laura

text: AMAZING fried chicken sandwich. Just the thought of it makes my mouth water. Very cool location and decor. Love it!

text: I returned to SB and Fish House for the first time in almost 5 years and was not disappointed. Maybe the freshest prawn salad I was ever served. The clam chowder was great also. My favorite (I ended up going there 4 times in 7 days) was the sole. It was cooked perfectly, the sauce was creative and really outstanding, plus the little potatoes and spinach were perfect to go with it.

I used to frequent here when it was under the name Fodder & Shine, and preferred the menu back then, but it is really the cocktails and bartenders who bring me back. Although I didn't have their clam chowder, I heard the couple next to as tell the waitress it was the best clam chowder they ever had.   The other seafood on the menu is also really good.   Last time we were there Carrie D was our server (02/26/19).   Service is really good and friendly.  Don't forget to get a pound of Peal N Eat shrimp to go!   :-)

text: Great food. Will definitely be back. Our server, Jermaine, made great suggestions! Chicken Parmesan sandwich was great. As was the pub cheese!
name: SS

text: Ordered here twice this week. Had the pastrami sandwich which is very rich and moist but ask for the dressing and slaw on side if for takeout.  Also had the 3 salad special platter. Very good amount of  salad. Price of sandwich -$12 is a little high without a giveaway bag of chips or bev.
name: Alma

text:
I think I like Caliber in my head more than I actually like it in real life, but I'd need to try it a few more times to decide for sure. 

The first time I went was pretty close to a 5/5. I don't like sweet drinks and I don't like lattes, but I had to get the Butterbeer latte with soy milk (I think I got soy, it's been a minute). As a Harry Potter fan, how do you not? I wasn't mad at it. I'd probably even get it again. It wasn't nearly as sweet as I expected either. Phew. Cute latte art too. That's always got to make you smile. I also got the hummus platter and it was amazing. Kind of a weird combination to have hummus & a latte, but it wasn't my first rodeo and probably won't be my last. Although I don't see it on their online menu anymore *tear*, so it may be my last there. Maybe it's seasonal? Is there a hummus season?

The next time I have no idea what I got, but it was super weak and, obviously, forgettable. Boo. My Mom ordered a sandwich to-go and we must have stood around for over half an hour waiting on it. For a cold sandwich. That was kind of odd. The first time they were super fast, so hopefully it was just an off day. This was more of a 2.5/5, unfortunately. 

They still make me smile. Love their pay it forward wall even though I'd probably never use it. Love their mural. Love their always changing sign out front. Love the shoe drop off. The whole place just has such a positive vibe. It would be cool if they had some more vegan-friendly food options.
name: Meredith

text: We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Will be back. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Food was fresh and service was quick. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..

Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. I can see why people like it, even if I wasn't fully sold. It looked better online than it did in person. Food was fresh and service was quick.

text: Word to the wise... Don't say "the service sucks" out loud at Crab Daddy's! Unless you want to get beaten up by the manager and two other guys, and then trespassed, after you call 911 to report the abuse and the Deputy sides with the bar. (because nobody saw anything) That's exactly what happened to my husband last night! He was paying our tab for a few beers, and said "we're leaving because the service sucks here". The manager, Steve, pulled my husband off his chair and punched him in the chest! He and two other guys had him down on the ground under them. He wasn't combative, just vocal. And Steve never asked him to leave, just attacked him from behind! And we were already leaving. This abuse was totally uncalled for and unnecessary!

text:
We had a blast at The Maison. We visited during the day and the jazz band was awesome! 

We had a few drinks (I felt bold so I ordered a bloody mary only to remember why I hate them lol) and shared a few appetizers. We ended up spending the rest of our time in NOLA here before our flight home. It was a relaxing end to our trip!
name: Rachel

text:
I came in on a Thursday evening around 5 and they had only one very inexperienced server for the entire restaurant. She was doing her best, but she had at least ten tables so the entire restaurant was understandably covered in dirty dishes. Unfortunately, this is one of the Chili's that still does "buy one get one" beers which means most of their drafts are served in 10oz mugs and taste significantly more watery than other Chili's locations who've stopped with that nonsense. Our table shared food and Chili's now always neatly splits the food for you and serves it on separate plates. Here we had to ask for an extra plate and divide it ourselves. As with most Nashville Chill's our order was about 80% correct, but what was right tasted good. It seems that all Nashville Chili's locations are stuck in the nineties and aren't going with the updated policies Chili's has implemented in other parts of the country. That's a shame because the extra effort really does make for a better experience and helps justify the prices. I may try a few more locations, but it's looking like Chili's in Nashville is going to need to be plan C for dinner.  

Free parking in an underground lot beside the restaurant. It's very dark and there are signs to inform you that Chili's don't care if your car is broken into so I wouldn't leave anything that even looks valuable behind.
name: Richard

text: Spent several evenings there playing beach games and listening to great live music. The food was really great. Benny was a great server!!!
name: C

text: While the food is delicious can't say the two Red headed gentleman working are very impressive. One was more interested with his little wooden ball on a string. The other was definitely amazed by the others trick with said toy. Neither one had a sense of humor. The fries I odered came out a full 3 to 4 minutes before the sandwich. Don't think I'll be back if this is the kind of service I can expect.

text: My favorite meal on planet Earth is served at Sazon.  Follow this simple plan next time you're on the hunt for savory & healthy breakfast/brunch and you will be assured satisfaction.  Order the fish[/potato/plantain/tomato/magic] omelette with hearts of palm in the salad, the tostones appetizer with 3 sauces, a big Colombian coffee and a housemade Negrita (or "Smurf"/blueberry) dark chocolate truffle.  I've ordered this at least 30 times in my life and it always comes out of owner Judy's kitchen the same way.  Meticulously ingredient-fresh and perfectly executed.  Lots of adjectives here - all merited.  One of Philadelphia's finest gems.
name: Scott

text: Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Food was fresh and service was quick. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Not bad for a quick meal. No big complaints, just a nice meal. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.

text:
Hubby surprised me by taking me here for breakfast on Valentine's Day! He had been here before and knew that the portion size for what we wanted to get is enormous. When we told our server that we'd like to split it, he was not surprised. He said it was one of his favorite dishes here. The "it" that we ordered? Margie's Famous Crab Cake Benedict (all blue crab with fresh spinach, sliced tomatoes and two over easy eggs topped with chili cream and asparagus spears, served on a split biscuit with mashed potatoes - $18.99). 

Even knowing in advance about the portion size did not prepare me for what was actually served! The presentation was pretty impressive (see photo) and it was almost too much to split. Even though the mashed potatoes were a little cold, it tasted fairly good overall. And, with a server that was one of the best we've had recently - very friendly, happy, welcoming, and attentive - we had a great start to our Valentine's Day.

text: It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. text: Sooooo delicious! Highly recommend. I ordered the veggie burger with lettuce instead of a bun and I didnt miss the bun or the meat! This was my first time eating here and my husband and I will definitely be back!

text:
Loved it!
When in St. Louis... eat ribs (and bbq).  We did. 

The Sugarfire gets it. This establishment was high on our "want to go to" list. It did not disappoint. Everyone was happy with their meals. The ribs, sausage, brisket, coleslaw, beans, and apple pie dessert were all on. 

There were a variety of places to sit with a variety of sauces to slather your food with. 

After dinner we popped over to the blues band next door. We did attempt to eat our food while listening to the music, however all the tables were taken.

The band was a true St. Louis blues jam band. They were fantastic. Afterwords we got chatting with a couple of members of the band about our favorite burdens and drinks.

The overall experience at the Sugarfire was great. 

We will be back.

text:

text: This is a very cozy restaurant in the Nations with a great cocktail menu a modestly sized food menu that is broken down into 2 categories, I am just a little hungry and I am very hungry. The menu is not necessarily innovative with crazy new combinations of foods and flavors, but the food is done very well. The service is also very good. I can't wait for the weather to be good again to take advantage of the small dog park they have outside! I can easily see this becoming a frequent spot for my wife and I.

text: Just ate here and will not be returning. Ordered a grouper sandwich and I began eating it and realized half was still raw - completely pink. Pointed it out to the server and management was not able to comp anything, not even a cent. There are so many other options on Gulf blvd, go anywhere else for better food and customer service. text:
Good Stock has become one of my favourite vegan spots in Edmonton. I've been here quite a few times now and I've never been disappointed. In fact, since they've opened, they've only gotten better. They now offer great options for catering and to-go. You can buy an entire lasagna or casserole for a really reasonable price. Great for those nights you really don't feel like cooking.

My favourite menu item by far is the buffalo chickpea wrap. I love that they choose to use more natural ingredients for their food rather than opting for processed fake meats. This wrap is spicy and hearty and it comes with your choice of side. I don't think I've ever finished my meal in one sitting. The portions are very generous.

My second favourite would have to be the loaded taco bowl. If you're looking for a healthier, gluten-free option, this is it! It is a taco salad on a bed of kale and basmati rice. The ground "meat" (made from walnuts) and their cashew sour cream are SO close to the real thing.

Another awesome thing about Good Stock is that they make their own vegan cheese. I always end up taking a one of them to-go (the truffle one is my fave).
name: Laurel

text: Okay, I am not a vegan, and I love gluten. This place has amazing pastries, and I can't stress this enough ~ they don't taste vegan and gluten free ~ though they are! She started by answering my emails in the beginning. Then as I had further questions, she vanished and began ignoring me emails. I was so upset I even had to call the restaurant to talk to her. She wouldn't even answer until I left a voicemail! She denied getting of my emails ( although she could date when I sent them). I was really upset by the way she was treating me. The shower was in two days and I had no choice but to follow up with her. She was rude and  unpersonable.  When I arrived, I met Jess the manager. text: I've been excited to give Mod Pizza a try but we did not have a good experience. Mod is a place where you specify the type of pizza you want and they assemble it in front of you. While it was busy the line wasn't out the door or anything crazy like that. I thought I'd be clever and order through the smartphone app to skip the line.  But when I finished creating my order it said that it would take 22 minutes. I've been to pizza concepts like this before and was convinced the line ahead of me wouldn't take long.  The best decision seemed to be to grab a table while I stood in line. Not 10 minutes into my time in line a worker walked over to the table and asked if they were going to be eating to get them to move.  I couldn't believe it when I later heard that. I never would have guessed that from when I got in line until I paid it would be 40 minutes (not exaggerating). After I paid it was probably less than 10 minutes before the pizzas were ready. If you love toppings this place was made for you because you pay the same price no matter how many you put on your pizza. That seemed like a very good bargain. It's nice that they also have a tiny 6 inch pizza for people who can't finish a regular 11 inch sized one. The regular red sauce was a little spicy, which surprised us. Overall the pizza was all right but not something I would stand in line 40 minutes for. The restaurant was also freezing. They need to turn on the heat when it's cold outside.

text:
Right when you walk in on the left is the stage where a local band was playing country music songs and taking requests from the audience. The bar is just past the stage, and on the right side a slew of onlookers. The layout is weird. You're immediately in the way as you walk in.

Upstairs, they were playing today's hit music, including rap, hip-hop, and top 40, which was strange. Being a minority myself, it felt nice to see diversity on the top floor, but it felt a bit self-segregated based on music interests. I'm glad the bar at least caters to all music types. It is music city after all!
name: Rumit

text: Dinner here Friday night.  Server brought chips and a very flavorful salsa to the table to start.  In addition, brought a complimentary order of ceviche (some of the best I have ever had).  Entrees are wonderfully-sized portions and extremely good.  One of our party got a shrimp dinner and the shrimp were definitely JUMBO.  Good service, good price and great food...I will be back.
name: Rebecca

text: Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. For a busy night they handled it okay. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Probably not coming back. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Nice little spot, decent portions too. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: We had a welcome dinner there for our out of town wedding guests - they were great in accomodating us and making room.  Service was great, food was awesome!  Highly recommend this if your ever in the St. Augustine area!  I always come by here for a bite when I'm in town.
name: Oscar

text: I absolutely love, love, and love The Cake Bake Shop! So, I didn't find anything about the wonderful place until late 2017 from one of my Instagram followers that tagged The Cake Bake Shop in her story. I began to look at The Cake Bake Shop Instagram page as well as menu. First, time I went there was for my niece birthday weekend on January 20th at night since morning and afternoon was too full. I went with my cousin along with my niece we had the best freaking seats that night where we were able to watch the bakers bake. I had the delicious, chocolatey, pepperment, and creamy hot chocolate, and I had the popular Gwendolyn's Famous Earl's Court Chocolate Cake. That cake is OH MY GOODNESS SO YUMMY! It was a chocolate lover dream, and when I ate it I felt warm and fuzzy inside. Also, the atmosphere is beyond awesome to me, very decorative, warm, happy, and to me Indy best bakery. Then, I went back to The Cake Bake Shop during their summer month of June 23rd, 2018 when I saw the cookies and cream post that's when I knew I needed to go! I had a slice of the Cookies and Cream cake, my friend had the Red Velvet. I loved my cake, I was very full trying to finish my cake. I did have two of their wines which I forgotten the names. The drinks were very pretty with the edible flowers inside. Also, the drinks were definitely good, and it had good quality. I highly recommend everyone in Indy to checkout Cake Bake Shop. When, I last visited The Cake Bake Shop on June 23rd I sat outside on their patio. As, I was eating my cake, drinking, and talking I noticed the owner Gwendolyn walk by saying hi to people with a very warm smile, and big personality.
name: Ashley

text: The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. For a busy night they handled it okay. For the price I expected more than this. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Food was good and came out fast. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text:
Great food and ice creams!!! The staff are extremely friendly and on point.
I have been stopping in here for about 2 years now and always leave a satisfied customer!!
I highly recommend this sweet little hotspot!!
name: Staci

text: For the price I expected more than this. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. The wait felt longer than it should have. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Food was good and came out fast. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text: After having the opportunity to leave a review about my last experience at Northside Social, management was genuinely concerned about the comments I left and they contacted me in a professional and timely manner. The fact that they took my comments seriously was a grand gesture in my eyes. It was never my intent to take advantage of the situation, only to point out something that could use improvement. I was not prompted by Northside Social to update my Yelp review. I am doing so of my own free will.
name: Holly

text: Nice little spot, decent portions too. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Food was good and came out fast. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed.
name: User

text: Love this place and the happy hour deals can't be beat! Beautiful space and amazing service. Hidden gem in Brentwood.
name: Janet

text: Food was great!  Has the feast charcuterie and pork schnitzel!  Service was just as good!
name: ToniLynn

text:
Three stars for some aspects. But overall 0 stars for the workers. This place is so convenient to grab a drink and maybe a rice ball or two. I have tried a few flavors here but none are great. I usually just stick to my tried and true: passion fruit slush, and their taro is good too.  But don't expect good customer service-- the girls here always seem to be having a bad day. No smiles, no how are you, or what can I get you. If you want service, I would go else where. They're pretty cheap on their boba... depends on who makes your drink is how much or how little you'll get. 

I come here because 1. They're open late in case I need a quick bite and 2. Because their pearls are my favorite and 3. They're nearby. 

*They raise their credit card minimum to $10 now, from $5... which is obnoxious. 99% of the time their machine won't scan their app... so your best bet is to have cash. *
name: Vannie

text: The first few bites were promising and then it kind of leveled out. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Food was fresh and service was quick.
name: User

text:
So glad to have more coffee shops in east Nashville and on this side. It'll be great for Dickerson to grow some steam so the appeal of what's down Gallatin and Dickerson can be avenues of where people want to eat and hang out. 

This little establishment is quaint and next to a cool wood shop. Their staff is nice and the setup is pretty standard but there's ample seating if you want to do some work or hang out with friends. They have the usual espresso drinks and pour overs but they have their specialty lattes if that tickles your fancy as well. I love the old school feel to the place and the tones of the spot. The place gets plenty of light as well so it makes the cafe feel very open. I wish they were open a little later, at least til 8 and open at 6 so I can stop by on my way to work or after work but the hours make sense for its location and for what they do.
name: Mike

text: I would have given it a better score except that it was freezing cold. I had to eat fast in order to enjoy the food hot. The food was great. The price was right. The waitress was pretty good.
name: Pamela

text: People are being a little dramatic in these comments honestly. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Not bad for a quick meal. It looked better online than it did in person. Would probably stop in again if nearby.
name: User

text: Wow...just wow.  Love Chinese food and am always ready to try a new place.  I was visiting my daughter in Boise and we were on errands.  We saw in the complex we were in at the time a Chinese buffet called The Great Wall.  What an amazing find!!  Everything they had was absolutely delicious.   There was a wide variety of dishes and the food was fresh.   The breading on certain meats was so flavorful, and the meats inside them were tender and seasoned well.   Even the sauces had more flavor than most Chinese restaurants.  The service was top notch as well. Definitely think if you're in their area and have a craving for good basic Chinese food you should stop and give them a try.
name: Phyllis

text:
This was my first time coming to Acapulco and the food was absolutely amazing! 

I ordered 3 different tacos and a pineapple drink. I paid for my food up front and was asked would I like to dine in, instead. I said sure, and was told to find a seat and they would coordinate the number on the table with my order. I received my food and it was EXCELLENT.

But, upon finishing, I cleaned up my area and left. Before I knew it, one of the brothers came running after me, asking if I had paid for my order. I stated yes, I paid at the front and CHOICE to dine in instead.

I believe the waiter (who I also told that I had already ordered my food) OR the couple (who came in after me) that sat next to me, accused me stealing and notified one of the brothers. 

I believe in paying for what you eat. It was $10 worth of food. And I've never dined and dashed (nor ever will) in my entire life. 

That was the major negative during my first experience.
name: Ricka

text: Really great catfish filets. Mac and cheese was ok. Mashed potatoes were good.  Loved the lemonade,  but they should offer at least one free refill since they charge $2.50 for a glass. Service could have been a little more attentive.
name: Sarah

text: Better than expected. This is an excellent spot of char boiled oystered. Probably the best we had in New Orleans. For it to be a spot on Bourbon it was amazing.
name: Maryam

text: Loved getting a delicious beer on the patio with my little 3 month old nephew. Great fast and efficient service! Yummy pretzels and beer!

text: I love this restaurant. The owners are the nicest family. The food is delicious!!. My favorite is bacon pizza. I love that there is a play room for my kids to play while we wait for our food.

text: Honestly I think I ordered the wrong thing. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. For the price I expected more than this.
name: User

text:
Decided to try someplace new.   Crowded parking lot made us stop here 
Bigger on the inside than it looks from the street. About 2 bars and 4 dining areas.  
Good service - very friendly.  
Ate outside in the shade (they have both shade and sun). 
Ordered the $3.00 18 oz margaritas.   Hmmm. Ya' get what you pay for.  Look at the pictures.  One was really weak, the other strong.  BUT
neither was tasty at all.  Would not order them again while there. 
Split a fried grouper sandwich  which was very good but, I have had better.  My taster was off since my sister thought her half was really tasty. I loved the fried coating on the fish.   Will try that one again!
Shall return; shall get a beer next time but would order the sandwich again.  Good menu with lots of offerings.  
A good feel in the place.   Yep.  I will go back


4/29/18
Went back to Seabreeze.  The food was so very good; however, the service actually was horrid.  If it's a beautiful day and you have nothing else to do, then this is the place.  Don't go there hungry since you'll have to wait to be fed.  Also, when I see the Staff and not one if them is smiling (even when smiled to) I then know something is not right with the morale at the place.  But, food was good!

text: Had a great experience here where our server Alyssa met my customary interrogation with good-natured banter.  Our party of four enjoyed pizza, cheese steaks and chicken parm and sausage sandwiches.  We left fully sated with "doggie" bags in hand.  Not surprised to learn they are expanding.

text: Amazing time Doug the bartender and Charles the historian was very informational!  The food was yummy and highly recommend this tour.
