text: Great little barbecue place, good selection of beers and locally bottled sodas, seating is very limited so get there earlier on the weekends. Portions were good for the prices especially for a restaurant featured on Food Network.
name: Nolan

text: I love it here the food is good and you don't really wait for longtime to get your food, the only downside sometimes is the wait time, so make sure you have reservation if you're staving, but overall every time I always have a good experience there.
name: Meidy

text:
Hattie B's chicken.  First time. Sides are great. 6 levels of heat.  I should have got the Southern no heat, mild and medium.  Instead I got Medium, hot, and damn hot.  I wasn't brave enough for shut the cluck up.
   Now I like spicey food.  Haven't found a Mexican restaurant to spicy for me.  Some Indian food yes called vindilue and the hottest of hot at Zaxbys.
    All I can say is, start off low on the scale and work your way up.  They use hot oil not pepper sauce.  It ain't no Louisiana, Tabasco or Texas Pete.  Just so you know.
name: David

text: This place has THE BEST Tatar Tots and a very extensive beer menu. What makes the tots great? There is onion and garlic plus other spices blended inside and they are clearly handmade and not your typical frozen fare. Other than that it's just pretty average. I ordered the local Carrollwood Toe Crusher which was a great light IPA. Anyone that knows me knows I judge a restaurant by its French dip and eggs Benedict. Since it was dinner time I opted for the prime rib dip which was mediocre at best. I will say our server, MJ, was awesome and answered all our questions and was quick to refill our drinks as needed. Overall this is a great spot for drinks but would recommend grabbing dinner somewhere else before hand.
name: Jen

text:
The pizza was just okay, but I think it makes up for itself in the size and the price. It's basically getting a quarter of a large pizza for $5. I just got cheese because I wanted to eat sooner than later and toppings never reheat very well. I ended up eating it on the go, but in those short moments of intense hunger, I thought the pizza wasn't half bad. As it started getting colder, and I'm sure that if you get a "big slice" it will get cold on you, the blemishes of the pizza started to surface. The sauce was mediocre, the cheese could have been better, but at least the crust has a nice garlicky glaze that encouraged me to eat my slice kinda like a harmonica.

I can't say I'd ever go out of my way to eat hear, but if I found myself in a similar situation, I probably would come back for a little slice.
name: Jada

text: Harvest house is amazing they have changed my life and made me whole again  and have given me purpose what a amazing program and Ricky amazing staff member and goes above and beyond for clients great staff member and Linda is the best case manager that any one could ask for and the minor family is truly a blessing to Sarasota and there director of the program Jim is truly special and has touched so many people with his compassion and good heart he saves life's and there property manager Mr Tucker is more then a blessing he is a god send all I can say is this program and church embody would God meant by being good to others truly amazing and truly a blessing
name: John

text: I was extremely disappointed in my pad thai To go order. It was extremely burnt and not edible. This place did not live up to their reviews and it sucks they would serve this to someone
name: Lauren

text: Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The staff seemed tired but still polite. For a busy night they handled it okay. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Food was fresh and service was quick. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text:
My new favorite sushi place in Philly! The place is super tiny, so get there earlier especially if you have more than 2 people. The sushi bar takes up most of the restaurant, and Joe (head chef) is a gem. 

Sushi was amazing, flavorful and fresh. Will definitely be coming back for the omakase. Don't forget that they are BYOB! 

Favorites:
- crispy rice (spicy tuna on top of (fried?) crispy rice squares) 
- chu-toro (1/2 fatty tuna) 
- veggie tempura app (has kobucha Japanese squash, enoki mushrooms, korean sweet potato)

Super excited for a down to earth and high quality sushi place in Philly that is well priced.
name: Jung

text:
I must give this restaurant five stars for going above and beyond tonight to make me a dinner!  It was late, and two
of us needed to eat.  They were out of a lot of items so I elected to pass on eating as a they did not have what I wanted.  My son got his and was enjoying his meal and I was just sitting there talking away.  Out of know where one of their team showed up with what I had asked for.  She had made it special and gave it to me free.  That was wonderful and a gesture that will certainly bring us back many a time.  Thanks for offering great customer service.  May it pay you back ten fold!
name: E

text:
Our office brings in Food Truck Vendors on a weekly basis, and El Guaco Loco was universally adored by our team.  

Some vendors have been disorganized.
Some vendors are unfriendly.
Some vendors showed up late.
Some vendors have sold average tasting food.

El Guaco Loco was none of those things. They arrived onsite 2 hours early to freshly prepare their food.  Within a very short time they served well over 100 meals.  They were friendly, and helpful, and accepted all major credit cards.

I ate a chicken burrito bowl and it was super flavorful, shredded chicken, beans and rice were topped with fresh cilantro, and it was perfect.  I opted to not have cheese or cream on mine, but had some salsa verde added, and created just the right balance of tangy/savory/spicy.  

The menu was vast, with many options from which to choose.

I've had several co-workers already comment that they hope El Guaco Loco returns.  I agree!  (And next time, I want to try the guacamole!)
name: Lori

text: This place only opened a few days ago but it already is an Old City staple in our eyes. My fiancé and I went for lunch - She had the vegan burger, which was made in-house and so fresh, and I had the classic cheese burger, which was a picture perfect burger (but I didn't take a picture because I ate it too fast). We also had the truffle parmesan fries which were crispy and as amazing as they sound, and the cookies and cream milk shake. Even after all that food we both agreed we didn't feel "gross" as you might after eating so much, because it was such high quality guilty pleasure food!. :) The owners are super cool, friendly and really care about supporting other local business owners. They also renovated the inside themselves, and it has a great vibe. If you are deciding between here and anywhere else in old city, choose Oh Brother! We will probably see you there.
name: Andy

text:
Taziki's is one of my favorite lunch spots in The Gulch. You really can't go wrong with anything on their menu. Here are some of my absolute favorites.
*Greek Lemon Chicken Soup* OMG this stuff is amazing. I have tried to replicate at him, but can't seem to get it right. It's fine. I will keep buying it here. Taziki's take my $$$$
*Grilled Veggie Plate*  Mixed veggies served on a bed of basmati rice. Absolutely delicious, always perfectly cooked, and flavorful. Very filling for a non-meat option
*Lamb & Skordalia Gyro* Look, I have no idea what Skordalia is, but damn its good! Always served with a side, I get pasta salad. It is honestly hard to finish on my own. 


This location is always sparkling clean. You can tell the owners/managers take pride in this restaurant. I come here fairly frequently, and have been met with nothing but kindness from every employee I have encountered.
name: Julia

text: Amazing sea food. We tried a couple of vej and non vej dishes. Must try: crab cakes and their cake as dessert
name: Swathi

text: I ordered at 9:20 on a Saturday, a grinder and fries.  They said 20 minutes.  I got there at 9:45 and it wasn't ready.  Then I noticed the mad scramble because the fries were ready but nobody made the grinder.  10 minutes later I walked out with a grinder and cold, soggy fries.  I'm really disappointed, this used to be a great place but the service and quality have decreased significantly over the past year.  I think all the promotion they've done may have made them busier than the staff can handle.  That's really sad, it used to be the only decent place in the neighborhood and I recommended it to everyone.  Lately I hesitate to order from there.
name: Thom

text:
This place has the best Jamaican food in west philly... their prices are good: $6 for mini, $8 for small & $10 for large (depending on what you get ox tails are more). They serve many other dishes such as stewed fish w peppers & onions
The staff is friendly and quick. A must for Sunday dinner
name: Phillip

text: We've lived here for over 4 years, and like in the proverbial search for the best cup of coffee. We've tried many places that claim they're a Diner...but Joe's puts them all to shame! Great food, efficient and friendly waitress and owners. 5 stars all around!
name: Rick

text:
When we sat down we were informed that if you want a Chicago style deep dish pizza that it would take an hour to cook. 
Since this is supposedly their signature menu item we decided to order the deep dish pizza. I've seen a few pictures of their deep dish pizzas and ours although one of the more expensive combinations did not look as good as any of the pictures. We ordered a steak, onions, peppers, mushrooms, 2 types of cheese(?)...
Surprisingly even though we waited an hour the pizza was not completely cooked thru and still tasted a bit on the doughy raw side. There wasn't much cheese or steak or mushrooms. The flavor of the pizza was ok, mostly sauce...
If we knew how the toppings or lack of were going to be prepared we definitely would have ordered just a basic pizza and maybe stayed away from the deep dish pizza altogether...although even a regular pizza we were informed took longer than you would expect...
My wife is a red wine drinker and unless you're a bota box drinker or something you can buy at the wine store for about $6 a bottle you're probably not going to be happy with their red wine selection. 
Plenty of beer choices and lots of whiskey choices. 
I can't really say the service is bad but overall this is way to long to wait for less than memorable pizza.
We did observe a family come in with one young child and quickly learn how long the pizza would take to cook and they almost immediately left the restaurant.
name: Ian

text: The soup was better than the sandwich, which I wasn't expecting. So yeah, i kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Honestly, food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. maybe I just came on an off day.
name: User

text: I'm so upset!!  We order from here often and normally have no complaints.  Recently we ordered our dinner and it was delivered in a timely manner.  I usually eat off my meal for 2 days.  Well, today is day #2 for my Orange Chicken and found a piece of plastic in my broccoli.  Very upset!!  Couldn't finish eating it.
name: Ashleigh

text: The service and food are fantastic! Very welcoming as soon as we walked in, prompt service, waitstaff were friendly and attentive. Food was delicious and they had a promotional drink of coconut milk eggnog with or without rum and it was omg soooo good! I will definitely be coming back here!
name: Vicky

text: Amazing food and great portions. Drinks were delicious and the hookah was some of the best I've ever had
name: Anna

text: Fun vibe! We were there on a Friday late afternoon and they had great service and a great band. Eat the chicken. You'll thank me if you do.
name: Brian

text: Second time here, love the outdoor seating . They play music outside which is a nice touch. Nothing better then sitting in a sun with a beer mid day. Lunch was really good we also tried the blackened chicken tacos with fruit yummy. They have an extensive beer menu, something for everyone.
name: Lisa

text: This place was amazing!!! We sat at the bar, and the bartender was very helpful. We got the crawfish, mac and cheese balls, and cheese fries. Everything was flavorful and amazing. The staff was just the best, and he even gave more recommendations of must do's in the city. I will definitely return if I am ever back in the city, and it will be one of my top recommendations for my friends visiting bourbon street :)
name: Laura

text:
This place was recommended to my mentor and me by the hotel staff, and we enjoyed it. It was very crowded, but we quickly understood the line. They line moved very quickly, and you received your food immediately.
The meats were well seasoned, tender, and delicious. The sides were very good (I recommend the vegetables and the potatoes). I also suggest getting the cornbread. The staff was friendly and very helpful. It was definitely good barbecue, and I will come back the next time I'm in STL.
name: Stephanie

text: The menu doesn't have pics not a good sign. The waitress is awkwardly nice and pesky. The only thing I like are the battered fries  and they're never an accurate size!!! The food is NEVER HOT usually luke warm and it's always empty so why the fuck is the food lukewarm??
name: S

text: Unfortunately I went today and the fruit cups had watermelon & melon that had gone bad & smelled terrible. I don't know if their fridge isnt strong enough or the fruit was just old but I didnt notice because the melon & watermelon make up HALF of the fruit cup & are at the bottom. Its a hit or a miss & for the price it should always be a hit.
name: Bradley

text: Disappointed with today's visit.  Firebirds became our go to restaurant over the last year and we have been there at least a dozen times and have even taken business groups there.  I visited with my wife today and was VERY disappointed.  It was the slow period and the restaurant was empty except for us and a couple others so maybe the A-team from the kitchen were not in.  The food (ribeye and fries) were so salty I could not eat it,  loads of salt should not be used to try to add taste and flavor - a good ribeye should not be desecrated in such a way.  It will be a really long time, if at all, before I return.
name: Byron

text: I had the Chilean sea bass and it was as if it melted in your mouth like butter. The staff was amazing. Definitely order fish if you go here.
name: Sarah

text:
This was our first time here.  The environment is great,  with very friendly staff.  Our server,  Sharaya, was fantastic.  After explaining that my husband is hard of hearing,  she kindly moved to his side of the table, bent down a bit and asked if he could hear her ok.  I've told many servers at many restaurants the same thing, and they always address me and wait for me to talk to him.  So when she did this,  I wanted to hug her!  

My husband forgot his hat at the table, and when we went back, Sharaya had taken it to the host station.  When she saw us walking downstairs,  she came right over to let us know where his hat is. 

We also spoke with a young lady in the gift shop.  I forgot to get her name,  but she's from Greenbrier. When she found out we were looking at Tennessee to relocate,  she was very helpful in telling us the good of all the areas we were looking at.  She even told us about some areas we had bypassed as an option. 

I can't wait to be able to come back.  The meatloaf we had was scrumptious.  The custom cocktails we ordered were very good.  The servings are large, so go very hungry!
name: Crane

text:
Farm-to-table. Done well. 

Cozy, warm, welcoming interior. 

Friendly and helpful staff. 

Great, diverse, always-changing menu. 

Nice location. 

There's a reason for the high ratings for this place. Give it a shot, you won't be disappointed!
name: Brady

text: While we were excited to taste the food at this well reviewed restaurant, aside from the very fine servers, we were completely underwhelmed. The food was bland and poorly seasoned. We ate a variety of dishes and without exception they were tasteless.
name: Merle

text:
This is a delivery review so this is a food only review
We place an order for delivery Saturday night via Eat24. Delivery took about an hour and 15 minutes. A bit longer then the original estimate of 40-50 minutes. Food arrived hot so i have no complaints with the extended delivery wait time. 
On the menu tonight was a maggianos and chopped salad. Portion size was great especially for the price i thought the salad was larger then i expected. The fried mozzarella still had stringyness to it when we got to it as our second course. Great breading and the marinara sauce was great as well. For dinner we had the manicotti and the chicken and shrimp tuscan pasta. The manicotti was great. The chicken and shrimp i would of enjoyed better had it been in a Alfredo or marinara sauce. I didn't care for the tuscan sauce that they served with the dish. 
For the price i think it was on the higher end for what we got. But will probably order again as the dishes were better then what you would get from your local pizza shop.
name: Ross

text: Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Food was fresh and service was quick. You can tell they care about customer experience here. No big complaints, just a nice meal. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really.
name: User

text: Great food. For a long time; I had been looking for some options for Indian food around the area. I tried their Lunch Thali and it was awesome. Very impressed. Tad spicy though. I would rate this restaurant as one of the best in the area.
name: Bhaumik

text:
Two failed attempts at ordering dinner from this restaurant. I ordered delivery in June and they delivered something I didn't order in (tried to order the Dragon ball.) What I did receive was old and smelled and I was afraid I would get sick, so I ate 3 pieces and then threw the rest away. Two entire orders of sushi wasted because they were bad.

I decided to give them a second chance and ordered the SAME item I really wanted to try last time (Dragon Ball) and once again they failed to deliver the dragon ball, the spider roll was disgusting (the shrimp was hard as a rock and tasted like rubber) and the salad was nothing but iceberg lettuce. 

If this just happened once. I would give them the benefit of the doubt. But TWICE I have ordered the same item and it's not delivered. Apparently they just make whatever they feel like making. For an item that is $7.95, I was given a roll of rice, cucumber and old avocado on top. Yes, it was brown and expired and I threw it away. Stop advertising items you don't make. 

I can see reviews from people who have dined in and they claim the sushi is good. EIther they serve different sushi in the restaurant or people have never had good sushi.
name: Karen

text: 1st time @ Teddy's & the buttermilk fried chicken is delicious. It comes with green beans & mashed potatoes.. both where very good as well. I recommend Teddy's.
name: John

text: The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. You can tell they care about customer experience here. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Food was good and came out fast. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text: This establishment has a great menu, great food and great happy hour specials. The food is fresh, tasty and has nice serving sizes. I have visited twice. I enjoyed the salmon salad and spicy shrimp appetizer. My husband enjoyed the kobe beef sliders, flatbread pizza and fish tacos. Service was outstanding at both visits. The ambiance is relaxing and inviting. We enjoyed the patio too! We will be returning!
name: Bridget

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The food was good and the service was easygoing. You can tell they care about customer experience here. Overall, a strong experience. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text:
Nested into a cluster of busy neighborhoods, Dos Reyes makes for a perfect weeknight getaway. The outdoor pavilion seating feels quaint and relaxing, offering street side views.

Complimentary Chips & Salsa, standard, throughout the meal. YES PLEASE. Delicate, thin style chips; my preference for a more tomato-based salsa. Marg's come in neat little mason jars, straying from those stupid spherical glasses.

Street Corn tasted so awesome, providing an edge of spiciness, and served on a REAL corn husk! Nachos Supreme was also a heap of greatness, and avoided the sloppy problem often encountered towards the bottom of the pile.

***Fast-paced, in & out establishment. Service is great, and the chips/salsa replenishment timing does its service. Chalk-up Dos Reyes for an eventual visit***
name: Andy

text:
This review is written after my third visit at Phoevermore. In my opinion they have tasty broth, fresh ingredients, and the food is consistently good. 
I like the house special pho P#1 with variety of beef cuts. The veggie pho add on tofu is real good also. The broth is tasty, the veggies look fresh. The tofu spring rolls are must have, their peanut sauce is super yummy and they are generous with the sauce serving. However, the rolls often come out inconsistently, like one bigger than the other, feel like 2 persons make it. 
Our next table have the vermicelli noodles and rice plate which look really colorful and delicious. I will try those next time. 
The service can be off when it picks up. The waitress seems nice but she looks like chicken with head cut off sometimes. The price is quite stiff for a self service business. They do partner with SB Menu and also have their own catering service. Overall I think this place is good for Santa Barbara-Carpinteria clientele 
I would come back for sure.
name: Lola

text: Ordered a large pizza and lava cakes. When I got back to the hotel I realized the lava cakes were completely burnt at the bottom and crunchy. The crust around the pizza was very uneven just terrible. Asked them to send out the delivery to replace it and they wouldn't despite the commercials saying they would. Also asked for a refund and have pictures to prove it yet that was a negative. Horrible customer service wouldn't recommend at all!! Terrible thing to do to a traveling family!!!
name: Abby

text:
Worth the uber ride to see this award winning chef that treats you like family! Warm, loving restaurant!  Try the homemade pastas. The crab cake and eggplant appetizer is crazy good and the bread pudding will knock your socks off. Stop by the bar where the local talent is diverse and amazing we danced the night away.
Followed the waiter's recommendations, was not disappointed! Andrea the chef/owner came out and greeted everyone and even had a drink with us at the bar after the restaurant closed!  We'll be back!
name: Janine

text: Had the burger with the horseradish cheddar 4 years ago. Amazing. Had it again today. Just as amazing. Beer selection is on point. Do yourself a favor and give this place a go. Top notch dive bar.
name: Ben

text: It was ok. Hot salsa hot, and ok.  Fajita allows for three proteins.  The chorizo was excellent, steak ok, and chicken dry and flavorless.  Margaritas not anything to go for, not even top shelf.  Bartenders had to serve the entire bar area, make drinks for the rest of the restautant and take to go orders.... Just a bit much to handle, and expect good customer service.  They did as best as they could to keep up.  I wanted to love this place since it is so much closer than Casa Fiesta, however it seems that we will keep driving to the Casa.
name: Stephanie

text: Nick is the bomb as a bartender. He is attentive  and always smiling. I look forward to the same service when I return.
name: Matthew

text:
Really liked this place.  The people that worked there were so nice and you could tell that they cared about their customer's. Loved the sausage, crab legs, and potatoes!!! Loved that they offer gloves and aprons!  Definitely will be going back!
Don't let the looks of the outside fool you.  It is worth going in!
name: Angie

text: We tried Taichi for the first time last night.  The interior is very nice and we were seated promptly.  We decided on a hot pot with teriyaki beef, potatoes, cauliflower, broccoli, and mushrooms.  We also ordered fried dumplings.  We enjoyed the variety of sauces available.  We liked being able to cook the meat and vegetables to our preference.  The beef was fresh and had a good flavor.  The pieces were cut nicely for a consistent cook throughout.  We felt you got a lot of vegetables for the price.  We also really liked cooking the potatoes in the pot for a bit then crisping up the outside on the grill for a minute or two.  The meat in the dumplings was excellent.  I would definitely go back and try other dishes as well as get a hot pot again.
name: H.

text: Free parking in West Chester!?! PRAISE! Love Kaitlin and the chill atmosphere at Local Yoga. One my favorite places to meet with friends!
name: Lily

text:
I'd make a point of having their cran mac and cheee if I were you.

They have  good soups and fish and ribs and rice. There are better places to have seafood.  It's a fun vibe outside feels like a party.

For me? It's about crab Mac and cheese
name: Greg

text: This place is great! The employees are sweet and funny, and seem like they have a great time working there, the drinks are very good and so is the food, and the employees are very helpful, especially Lindsay. The over all vibe of the cafe is very chill and relaxed.
name: Malachi

text:
The best Indian place in the area. I work in New York and this is even on par with some of the Indian food in the city. 

The owner and his brother are very nice people. I've never dined in but the place is BYOB. 

Would definitely recommend...
name: Jon

text:
I've been coming here for about 20 years. My family's favorite beach is in Tarpon Springs and we ALWAYS make a stop at Costa's. 

They have one of the best octopus dishes in the area. TIP: Ask for less oil. They drench most things in a ton of oil, and I'm not a huge fan of that. I also love their Horiatiki Salad and Saganaki. 

I will say, I found that their service has slowed down over the years. When I went last week, the waitress forgot parts of our order and was slow to take our order and to bring us the bill. 

This place still holds a special place in my heart as I've been coming for so many years and think the traditional greek food hold up.
name: Saphir

text: Dj was the most attentive server I've had in a long time. The grouper parmesan was amazing
name: Daniel

text: We have gone for years and we were just in recently. LOVE the new decorating. Apparently we have been away several months and did not realize there is new ownership. Food and Service were delicious. We recommend !
name: Joan

text: Incredible meal with amazing service. The hummus was the best I have ever had. Lots of flavor, fresh herbs and choices.
name: Jody

text:
Wow! First time here and our meal was incredible. Pork torta was amazing and just might be the tastiest thing I've eaten since moving to Tucson 3 years ago. The lady have the huevos which she enjoyed throughly. 

Their coffee is the best I've ever had. Smoothest cup of black coffee, roasted in house. Jerry Seinfeld should bring someone here!
name: Patrick

text: Went for supper here .Had scallops as an appetizer very good would be nice to have three for the price.Had bison for main course.Well if you want the taste of stew meat it's for you .Would not recommend it ,For $42 I expect something better .Take it off the menu. Desert was very good and the hostess was excellent.
name: Phil

text: Went here on a recommendation, especially for the "adult" milkshakes.  Burgers were average.  The shakes were the only part I'd consider excellent.  All of it overpriced.  Thankfully our waiter was very attentive because the kitchen and bar messed up repeatedly.  Our server insisted they remake my milkshake as soon as he saw it because it didn't meet standards (in his words "too watery").  He also noticed immediately that the kitchen messed up my son's burger by leaving key ingredients off of it, and had it corrected.  The onion rings as our appetizer were burnt, my guess is they need to change the grease in the fryer.  If the rest of the staff was on par with our waiter, I'd give it 4 starts (too overpriced for 5 stars), but sadly they are not so only a 2 star review.
name: Rob

text: Picked up 1/2 tray pizza tonight.  Was just supposedly prepared when I walked in the restaurant.  Pizza was cold and the crust was totally burnt... how does that happen.  Think we got ripped off.
name: Jim

text: Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Nice little spot, decent portions too. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Food was fresh and service was quick. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text:
Cute and quaint... very welcoming atmosphere. There is one main long table in the middle and then some eclectic  wooden stools along the window side. Over priced but this is doylestown people, comon.

Anyway, I ate the beet and Brussels sprout bowl and it was absolutely to die. I added grilled chicken which you could just tell was fresh.

I think my favorite part about this little nook had to have been the local honey provided for customers to use. I added some to my delicious black tea and went about my day.

Will definitely be back.
name: Samantha

text: For the price I expected more than this. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Would probably stop in again if nearby. The food was good and the service was easygoing. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Not bad for a quick meal. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text: My girlfriends and I had a great experience! The service was great, awesome waitress! The food was good! I had the steak and it was cooked perfectly and seasoned well. The beer suggestions were good! Everyone left happy and full! Beer cheese was awesome! And truffle fries were amazing. The only "complaint" that I had was the online menu wasn't updated so we were unable to get the items we originally wanted. Prices were fair. Very pleased with our visit!
name: Samantha

text: The server we usually get is top notch. We have a Yorkie so we sit outside. My wife is vegan and the server is always helpful.  The food itself is delicious. I'm always getting a salad and some kind of wrap and it's enough to fill me up and tastes fresh. The red sangria is pretty good too!
name: Jessie

text:
If your looking for a pub on Whyte ave that will treat you like family, have a cold beer on tap and homemade food this is your place. All the sporting events are on tv, You can actually have a conversation without music killing your head. 

Whether its a meeting or just a pint give this place a shot.
name: Micheal

text: First time at this restaurant for my family traveling through town, we ordered a few items. The bottled root beer was raved about by the teens. Service: service was the highlight of our experience here. The place wasn't crowded and pretty much all the wait staff interacted with us and were very attentive. 

Price: So so high for the quality of food we received. I visited Dick and Jenny's per a local's tip and we were prepared to pay the price for an authentic Cajun experience and unfortunately that's not really what we got. We paid $52 for 1 entree and 1 side of truffle fries. 

Food: really just wasn't that impressed with quality or portions. My partner and I ordered truffle fries and the pan seared tuna. The side of fries was $9 and much smaller than we expected and seemed to be lack a lot of the usual truffle-esque seasonings and toppings. Additionally, I really think there was a freezer burn taste to be fries. The tuna had a similar experience. It didn't taste fresh and rather like a frozen fillet. For the price I paid, I wasn't pleased. The tuna did come with a scoop of crab meat which I suppose is a perk. 

I did order a drink- I don't recall the name but it included gin and honey. It was really delicious and I do suggest the cocktail. 

Atmosphere: it's a cute atmosphere- small and quaint with hometown style decor.

TL:DR; I suggest spending your $50+ at another restaurant if you're visiting

text:
I just can't get enough. I just can't get enough!

La Chiquita just keeps me coming back over and over again. The meat is so fresh, clearly cut by well trained hands, and the marinades are so delicious. 

La Chiquita is my favorite place to visit when I want to feed a big group of people. I recently discovered the lomo adobada, marinaded pork tenderloin sliced extremely thin into what can only be described sheets of pork! They cook up so quickly and the meat always gets a nice char and it's great for tacos or just a mixed grill. 

I still haven't found a mild salsa here. I'm not really complaining because I like the heat, but some friends were definitely caught off guard! I love the salsa casera, verde and the Roja.

The carnitas on the weekend are also not to be missed! The whole pig is in the case and you can pick your part!

Monday rolled around and my wife took the leftovers to work, and I was planning to eat them for lunch! 

Sad day for me, but it doesn't have to be for you! Go now and thank me later!

text:
After having so many wonderful meals in NOLA we were exceptionally disappointed with what was supposed to be the most memorable meal. We ordered:

1. Fried alligator: a bit overcooked and smothered with way too much aioli. 

2. Rabbit and Dumplings: way over seasoned and the rabbit seemed like an afterthought with just a few small pieces. The dumplings were good but as a whole the dish was nothing to write home about. 

3. Grilled oysters: These were good but again, nothing special. We had similar oysters in two other restaurants for less money. 

4. Smoked pork ribs: these were cooked really well, but the smoke was so overpowering you could not tell these were pork ribs.

5. Fennel appetizer which was completely inedible. However, they did remove it from our bill. 

All in all, we would not return, as there are sooo many other wonderful places to eat in NOLA.

text:
This is a great restaurant in Old City if you're looking for something approachable and good for a group. It's not so great if you're looking for something more upscale or intimate. I went with my parents and my boyfriend last Friday, the last night of Restaurant Week, and it worked very well for our purposes. The decor is attractive and the atmosphere feels busy but not overwhelming. My parents both ordered the fish filet and were very happy with it. My boyfriend had the pork chop, which was enormous, and I had the mushroom risotto croquettes, which were much smaller but just the amount of food I was looking for. We also all enjoyed our various appetizers and desserts, though I don't think any of us would go so far as to claim anything we had there was the best thing we've ever eaten. The service was friendly and prompt, which increased the pleasantness of our experience. 

Perhaps my favorite thing about Farmicia is that it has a bar but also allows BYO. The cocktail list is creative, and since we arrived before happy hour ended at 7 p.m., we were able to enjoy half price cocktails and beer before we opened the wine we brought along to enjoy with our meal. I wouldn't recommend this as a foodie place, but I'd certainly bring a group here again.

text:
Probably one of the best meals I have ever had in a restaurant! 

At Daughter's you have the experience of being welcomed into the family and served in someone's home. The venue is the downstairs of a house, and actual family photos adorn the walls. From where I was sitting I could see into the kitchen, and watched them carefully plate each fresh, homemade item. Not only did I appreciate the thoughtfulness that went into the process, but the resulting food was truly delicious! I have been to some other places that seem to have a lot of consciousness and thought, but that miss the mark when it comes down to the flavor. Not the case here! We went for brunch, and there were only 3 options to choose from. I got the "brunch", which was french toast with an egg fried in the middle. It came with super flavorful sausages and potatoes, that were served in buttermilk(something I had never heard of before, but was absolutely amazing), some kind of fresh baked coffee cake, fresh fruit, sauteed vegetables, and shishito peppers(there may have been something else but I forget, I am writing this review a few weeks later, but you can tell I remember the details because they were memorable).

I am surprised by some of the negative reviews, because I thought this place was amazing. But I will admit it is unique and you need to come ready for an experience and have the patience for an old school, 'slow food' type of situation, but it is well worth the wait and the quality is so much better than conventional restaurants!
name: Setphanie

text: Meat, meat, and more meat. This is the essence of Rodizio. For those unfamiliar with this Brazilian steakhouse, you pay a fixed charge depending on how many are in your party, get seated, and are given the all-powerful green and red ended wooden dumbbell (don't know what it's actually called). This dumbbell acts as the equalizer. The green end, when placed upwards, represents the go ahead for a multitude of servers and their knives and selections of meat (ranging from chicken to steaks of various degrees) to come to your table for your appetite. This is the perfect spot if you don't know what you want to eat and just want to try multiple things. Rodizio brings the choices to you rather than you picking from a menu. If you like what you see, pick up your personal tongs and grab you a slice or piece. If not, that's cool too! You have the choice even when you didn't even choose (if that makes sense). As you can probably guess, the red end of the dumbbell when placed upwards means the servers will stop serving you and gives you time to digest or show that you've had your fill. Of course you can flip to either side whenever you like so don't think once you flip to red once you're done. All in all, you really get your money's worth as everything and I mean everything is exceptional, especially if you're a meat lover like me. They didn't offer any vegetarian options besides the optional salad bar which is pretty good. Depending on the time you go there for, brunch is also available in the same area as the salad bar for you to pick and choose what you like in a buffet-style. I 100% recommend coming here for any occasion, and I don't say that often.

text:
I've been a fan of Public Greens for quite some time so when this location opened within walking distance from my home, I was pumped! 

The staff so seriously the best. Someone is always present to greet guests at the door and explain any new menu options and answer questions. They are very accommodating for dietary restrictions as well, which I feel are usually passed by at other establishments. 

I recently had brunch on a Sunday and was pleasantly surprised that it was not crowded. I ordered the Breakfast scramble and it was delicious. I wanted this without cheese and again, very accommodating and zero questions asked about my request.  Public Greens offer a menu of coffee, espresso drinks, and alcoholic beverages; all at affordable prices.
name: Amy

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Overall, a strong experience. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh.
name: User

text:
Summary: Slightly above average pizza with slightly below average service.

What we got for 6 people:
- 14" Prochutto and arugula 
- 14" Gluten-free tre porcelinni
- 10" bianco verde

Cons:

- When we asked the employee who poured our water for a ginger soda, he said "ask your server", then walked away.

text: This was a cool place. I am 25 and felt like I was maybe getting too old for the crowd that went there. Me and my friends got a Coppertail Free Dive IPA which was pretty sweet. I got the skinny marg which was really good! Def recommend. We split the trio dips; guacamole, queso and verde salsa. It came quick and was you're standard trio. The tacos were awesome. I only needed two and was perfectly full. Overall - good atmosphere for people in their 20s, great food and good drinks.
name: Lauren

text: Dessert saved this a little. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. so yeah kind of mixed on it. Not bad for a quick meal. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text:
The Shop always has something new and incredible on the menu! I've been so impressed how they have brought the wait to order and get food down over the past season. When I need something quick, I'll always get one of the salads or if it's breakfast the yogi (yogurt parfait). There is something about their french fries where I want them even at breakfast (multiple of my friends have done just that). 

Honestly, can't think of anything I wouldn't be over the moon to eat here! We even had them cater our wedding and we received so many compliments!
name: Veronica

text: The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Pretty happy with it overall. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. For the price I expected more than this. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text: What a terrible first time experience! I would never recommend anyone come here based on the customer service alone!  After moving downtown and finding this coffee house in walking distance to my residence, I decided to hold a business meeting here. My business partner was very late so I decided to work from my laptop until they came with the intention of ordering when they arrived: instead of approaching me and asking or expressing any concerns, the employees behind the counter decided to gossip and loudly whisper about my being there and judged my not having had ordered by saying "this is not a library". What a terrible encounter. I would never return and can't help but imagine that in a majority Caucasian atmosphere that my not ordering as quick as they would have liked combined with my skin color had something to do with their assumptions and gossip whispering. Just skip this place and go to Tea's Me Cafe.
name: Brittany

text: Food was pretty good! I enjoyed myself . I ordered the fresh pasta Alfredo with peas and mushrooms! Salads were fresh and the employees and waiter was really nice ! You may wanna order extra sauce for your pasta. And bathrooms were clean !
name: Raven

text: My friend liked it more than I did. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really.

text: Truly the best Ahi Tuna I have ever eaten.  Order the Tuna Tataki and you shall not be disappointed!  Came back a second time this week to get it again.  Wonderful.  The Kiso Japanese Noodles with chicken was very good and the Sushi Combo was terrific.    Highly recommend this location for lunch or dinner!

text: Great burgers and wings. Drink specials are always good. Great place for food or a drink. Entire staff is very friendly and helpful! Overall great time.

y'all really skimped out on my rice.. EVERY CHIPOTLE GIVES WAY TOO MUCH RICE BUT YOU DIDNT GIVE ME MUCH. you also didn't give me a real amount of steak.. plus it was burnt.
