text: Amazing, authentic Cajun food. Incredible owners and chef. Such a pleasure every time and a treat to Hendersonville.
name: August

text: Was so excited to eat the most popular burger they had but turns out they had bacon so I couldn't eat it so I took the burger with the donuts as buns and we also got the tacos. The tacos were pretty good but the rice was hard. The burger was just a regular burger and had to take out the donut buns because they're too big and didn't really go well with the burger. The truffle fries were so amazing and the Mac and cheese was okay.
name: Mayar

text: Great food great service, I took 1 star away because it's not really stroller friendly but other than that totally awesome!!!
name: Tiffany

text: Best deli in south Philly and that's a fact... I love this place. I moved from north jersey (the Mecca of delis) and this was the only place I go to. The bread is great and their homemade olive tapenade goes great on any sandwich. Fridge is stocked with San pelligrino and that is a must. The one guy was a JETS fan (hopefully you don't get fired). But I love going here and will continue to do so. MAKE SURE YOU TELL THEM SEEDED BREAD.
name: Kyle

text:
I really enjoyed this me menu! The dining experience was very good. It was baby friendly. 
I had biscuits and gravy and brussel sprouts. Very good and I had some go take home. 
I would go back for that specific meal, but currently choosing more unique dining breakfast menus before I circle back around.
name: Brianna

text: The waiters are slow and inexperienced. For price I'd expect more. The place is too loud for a conversation. So plan to eat but don't expect to hold a conversation. The bathrooms look it could be at a truck stop. The bathroom smell, tile is chipped, the floor is dirty  and a shabby skin. The food is the only good thing about the place.  The prices are high, for the experience it's just not worth it.
name: Karen

text: I went to Jolibee waited for 2 hours in line with Staff taking orders with ordering Restrictions in place only allowed to spend $60 dollars max then not to mention the Buckets of Chicken are expensive... I like Spicy Chicken but I would never buy Original Chicken again or buy the Filipino Spaghetti too Sweet however I would buy Mango peach pies they Delicious.
name: Randall

text:
Walked over from our hotel , decent enough from the outside ...then things went downhill fast .
Hardly anyone in the place and were out of bacon first thing in the morning , cappuccinos were terrible and service was crap, brought out a grilled cheese to replace the bacon and tomato sandwich and it was garbage !!  Stay away !!
name: Rob

text: Nice dive restaurant. Very little space inside, but lots of outdoor seating. Flies were out the day I was there, but that's kinda part of summer outside. I had the Lobster Corn Dog. It's a full lobster tails made into a corn dog. Very tasty. I noticed a lot of people getting take-out while I was there & I think that's probably the best way to go. Would certainly eat there again.
name: Thomas

text: So good! I have had the California Burrito twice. I am from Northern California and can be pretty picky about my burritos, and Crazy Burrito definitely comes through as the best burrito in Tampa! They also have great customer service. I ordered on Uber Eats tonight, and the owner called to make sure to clarify the order and ensure we would be satisfied with our purchase. Definitely a must-try!!!!
name: Kelly

text: It's excellent, real, Chicago style Hot Dogs. They also have snacks, drinks. and Ice Cream for a nice stroll down beautiful Main St. It's also in a great location (Right at the beginning of Main St. so you can stop there, eat, and go.
name: Connor

text: Incredibly fresh and absolutely delicious.  Wonderful ambiance on the patio.  Must try while in SB!!!
name: Courtney

text: It was Great! Fast and friendly service and me and my wife both loved what we ordered, can't wait till Santa Maria Chick fil a opening
name: Jerry

text:
My husband and I decided to stop by on a Sunday evening.  The restaurant was a little on the quiet side even with a couple of tables, including one large party, already dining.  We were immediately seated and received excellent service throughout our meal.

We started with Som Tum (papaya salad), which was definitely the best part of our meal.  The flavors--sweet, acidic, spicy--were just right.

I ordered a bowl of Tum Yum soup and upgraded to include shrimp.  It was pleasant though I would have preferred a bit more lime flavor.

I also ordered pad kee mao with chicken at a level 3 out of 5.  It was a very large portion--big enough to share.  However, it wasn't the typical flavor profile I'm used to.  I didn't see any basil mixed in with the noodles, onion, carrot, and bell pepper.  I asked for prik nam pla because I didn't find the level 3 to be all that spicy...should've ordered a 4 or 5.

My husband ordered his absolute favorite Thai curry, massaman curry, with beef.  We're used to crushed peanuts with the curry, but this version had what I assume was boiled peanuts...different size and texture than I was expecting.  We were also disappointed that the beef was thin, tough strips of beef as opposed to fall apart chunks.

Overall, our dinner was fine, but if we return I would try some other dishes.
name: A

text:
Every once in a while you just don't want to cook, you don't want pizza, and you just crave some noodles. When honey and I feel this way (usually on a Friday night or rainy Saturday) we will order from this restaurant. There are quite a few options for Chinese food in our area but we always go for China Taste. In my experience it taste the best. Also my favorite thing is the Singapore noodles and they just so happen to make them the way I like them! There are no frills about this place. If you decide to eat in or pick up your food you will find only 2 tables in the restaurant and a counter to order from. Sometimes a really cute little boy will be taking your order, I think he might be the son of the owner. He is very well spoken and just the cutest thing. 

In regards to the delivery we have not experienced any messed up orders and the portions are a decent amount. Pricing is what one would expect for Chinese food. Delivery is approximately the average 45 mins wait time for this area, sometimes even sooner. If you are ordering Chinese go with China Taste- you will not regret it- and I suspect it will become your favorite new Chinese take out place.
name: Bianli

text: Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. It looked better online than it did in person. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: I thought Coney Island was in New York. Detroit isn't near New York so call me very confused! Still, the service and food we had were fun and flavorful! Hotdogs and chili and life is good!
name: Dave

text: Got a California Flaming burrito with guacamole.  Very tasty and fresh.  I would recommend the burrito and bowls.
name: Wilton

text: My friend and I were looking for a quick dinner and stopped by. This was her first time here and now my second and needless to say, they were still great. They have a lot of different options for their custom pizzas, which is what we both got. Plus, they seem to have a lot of quality ingredients that you can put on top of your pizza and even their salads and grains bowls which are also offered. Their service is also excellent, with our server not hesitating to answer our questions. She would even change gloves after handling my friend's pie since she got meat and I did not, without me asking which was a nice touch. I have been to both Blaze Pizza and &Pizza, and this place is better than both in my opinion. The only reason that I knocked a star off was that when we went, it smelled a bit like smoke in the place and we both left smelling like pizza, and not in a good way.
name: Kris

text:
Impromptu date night. Craving sushi so decided on Ciccios. We thought they would be packed but they weren't so bad tonight. We called ahead and they said about 25 minute wait but I guess we got lucky and we were seated as soon as we arrived. (Everyone must be our shopping) food was amazing as usual. We finished every bite. I got the citrus salmon roll. It was a really good. Also ordered the garlic lime edamame. Full of flavor. 

Robert got the hot and crunch tuna bowl. He said when he used to go with coworkers one of them always ordered it with extra tuna. But it already comes with a lot of tuna. So he doesn't get it. 

Our waitress was very attentive. I think her name was Steph. There were 2 of them who came over. She even asked if we had any allergies which I don't remember them asking us that before. I like it.

Edit: looking at the receipt now it says the waitress's name is Jesseca D
name: Tiffany

text: Finally tried this little place and have to say I was pleasantly surprised at their Gluten Free options. Just about everything on the menu can be made gluten free and it was a real treat to get the Creme Brûlée pancakes. I will definitely be back.
name: Frank

text: Ordered takeout because I didn't feel like cooking and it held up okay. Honestly, the tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than i pictured from the photos. Idk, nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Anyway, i got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Idk, service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up.
name: User

text:
Overall, from the beginning to the end -  5 Star..
Table of 7 on a Saturday night at 730P and our table was waiting for us for my cousins birthday, I had got the reservation on Opentable.com and they called and hour, or so, later to ask about the party and to assure me that the table would be ready.. and it was.. the place was busy with families and trendys so it is good for everyone -  we had two young children and they enjoyed themselves(They are probably Yelping now) :) I will say it is a fusion between Southern and Italian which usually do not fuse, if you will...
Moderate cicchetti/tapas style dining, pricing were reasonable but the food was perfect - everyone enjoyed everything..
We had Tish as a server and she was very professional and attentive..
Great job...
name: Louis

text: What a terrific find!  Just a couple of little outside tables and a small trailer and AMAZING food!  Loved their sauce...the ribs were so meaty!  Best potato salad and baked beans I've had in a really long time!  Nice people and nice service too.   I wish I lived closer so I could go more!
name: Jessica

text: Really one of the best Vietnamese restaurants I have ever been in.  Soft shell crab.  Well spiced cooked perfectly.  Scallop Pho was even better. I highly recommend the kind and talented folk at Pho Lee.
name: John

text: We came for a private party where they had tables set up behind the bar. Very nice brewery. Everyone was friendly and service was great. They have some live music which was nice. The food was catered from their south location and was delicious. Didn't drink any beer though.
name: Dana

text: It tasted fresh, just not especially memorable. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. I'd maybe go back, but I'd order differently next time. It looked better online than it did in person. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text:
Fantastic food. Had the Steak Guerrero. Highly recommend. Strawberry icecream is the best.
 We all agreed that we'll be back.
name: Drew

text:
We waited way too long to indulge this spot! I haven't been to this restaurant since it was the previous restaurant and Pelago did a pop up. Cute smaller restaurant but still enough room between tables where you won't be in peoples conversations.... unless you really tried to be. Could not stop looking at the mural closer to the entrance with the different Cry Baby Logos. Okay okay enough of the decor.. onto the food.

Ordered the garlic butter on toast because why wouldn't you have garlic bread at the table to dip into the sauce of your pasta. Charred just enough to not be burnt and that's just how I like it.

Entrees: I ordered the Ricotta Cavatelli and my bf ordered the Rigatoni. Beautiful presentation, portions were just right where we were full but not falling asleep at the table from getting the itis. Satisfied and finished every little crumb. We will be back!
name: Antoinette

text: Love Rafferty's!!! The Jackson Hole Filet is delicious. House salad is always great. Their ribs are so good! Also try the fried pickles, fried mushrooms, and chicken tenders. The French fries are freshly cut everyday and cooked to perfection. I can't wait to go back!
name: Jennifer

text: Awesome appetizers, wine and entrees - we had friends in and it was my first time to The Hill - great experience!
name: James

text:
Fantastic atmosphere delicious food had a wonderful time with my husband. 
Atmosphere was great nice menu they know how to cook a steak green beans with them just right up the mess potatoes
name: Carolyn

text:
I was excited to hear Ho Choi was closing and hearing an "extension" of Pin Wei was going to take it's place.  I saw the grand opening sign and came in.  I also just found out Pin Wei in KOP is closed, so I asked the staff if this was just the new Pin Wei location.  I was told they are completely separate owners and no relations...  

I ordered pork fried rice for myself and some General Tso's for a co-worker.  I tried some of his meal and the food tasted really good and had a really nice kick of spice to it.  The pork fried rice was pretty good and probably something I would get through their lunch specials.  

There is no seating inside, much to the dismay of the customer arriving after I did.  Additionally, he inquired if they were connected to the KOP location too.  Most of the time for Chinese, I want a place where a few of us can get out of the office for a bit, but I'll still add Pin Wei into the rotation.
name: Matt

text: Great Beer selection, and the Happy Hour is terrific. $4 for a nice selection of drafts and $5 apps. Wish they would have the Crunchy Shrimp App year round. Cheers !
name: K

text:
The price was ok but the food was barely ok. Our prime ribs were very dry. The cola which I'm not sure what Knock off brand they use tasted horrible. 
What was good was the staff. Definitely friendly and happy and willing. 
Never going back to eat there again, but then again probably not coming back to Reno for a long time
name: Mo

text: Don't understand all the great reviews for this place.  The food was not that good and portions very small and overpriced.  Crowded, noisy, no ambiance (almost sterile atmosphere) - a large cafeteria with tight tables and chairs.  Decided to eat at the bar.  No real bartender - waiters and waitresses going back and forth behind the bar. Usually sitting at the bar, service is quicker and bartender attentive.  Not so here.  Left hungry and feeling cheated.  Mid-town St Louis has much, much better restaurant options. Needless to say, won't go back here.  Definitely not worth the time or expense.
name: Anne

text: Most things are vegan, and dishes are creative, delicious, and affordable. Lovely wine selection too. I would go here every day if I could and just work my way through the menu. Love the white interior with the colorful pillows, well designed and cozy. They use stainless steel straws, so cool! And they have veg chicken. Hope I am back in this city soon.
name: Leanne

text: Amazing find and use the check in offer for a free oyster as they are amazing and all the condiments and fresh options are spot on!
name: Chandra

text: This place use to have really good food but over the years they have declined. I'm told new owners joined and thats when it all changed. Extremely over priced and wait staff seem to want to rush you through service. In the past I loved the Shrimp Fra Diaolvo with jumbo shrimp and a nice sauce with good amount of heat from the chili peppers. Last time I ordered it I was surprised , no shocked, to find the canned mini shrimp (used in shrimp macaroni salad) along with a few jumbo shrimp and the heat in the sauce was so over bearing almost like they added hot sauce to it.  Bread basket had a few measly pieces that were on the stale side and a meager plate of roasted peppers. Calamari was chewy and can tell it was not fresh.
name: Jennifer

text: This place is a hidden gem. We stopped by to grab a quick bite and I was pleasantly surprised by the appearance and atmosphere once we walked in. They had a live mariachi band playing and it's very spacious and clean inside. I ordered a 28 oz house margarita and it was good, but not as good as I was expecting. The service was a bit slow despite our early arrival and it took a long time for us to be able to place the order and the food to come out. However, the food was delicious and authentic Mexican flavors. I had a chicken enchilada along with tamales, rice and beans. Overall, we had a great experience. My suggestion is to have designated serves for the restaurant seating only while others handle the bar area, not both. I will certainly go back. Great for accommodating big parties also.
name: Selma

text:
We stopped in this awesome place to try a few donuts and ended up hanging out for a while!! The owner was THE best and the donuts were amazing!! I highly recommend this sweet spot. We will definitely be back!! 

Thanks Todd
name: LaTaveya

text: Came for a business dinner with a set menu selection. Ordered the salmon with rice and Brussel sprouts. The salmon was amazing! Super juicy and cooked a little under which made it tender. Loved it! The brussel sprouts complimented the salmon well but the rice felt undercooked. Was not good at all. Everything about this place was nice from the atmosphere to the servers. Definitely recommend coming here to try it at least once.
name: Sarah

text: This was my first time going here. The staff was very nice. I bought the Jumpback Jack burger but substituted the beef with chicken with the natural cut fries which were delicious and seasoned well. I ordered it to go and it took no longer then 10 minutes. I am definitely going back and will bring friends. This is s good place to have a drink at the bar and watch sports or bring family and friends for a even dinner.
name: Ebony

text: Overpriced, understaffed and not worth the wait on a Saturday morning. Dry pastries that seem to be reused from the day before. Been here multiple times but won't be returning. Don't waste your time.
name: Brent

text:
This place was nothing short of AMAZING. My friends and I came here from up north and amongst craving some southern fried chicken, we saw this place highly rated online and decided to give it a try. When we first got there and got seated, we were immediately given all the "fix-ins" (Cole slaw, pickles and onions, beans, and hushpuppies). Apparently no matter what you order you get UNLIMITED fix-ins!! By the way, the Cole slaw was some of the best we've ever had... 

I got the fried catfish and fried chicken combo which comes with fries and a DELICIOUS biscuit. We were literally salivating at the table. GO HERE
name: Sara

text: I wanted to like this place better than we did.  Nice options on the menu.  Like the promotion of STL.  I had the Famous Barr french onion soup.  It was decent.  Shared a chicken club sandwich with my wife.... that was pretty good and a good value.  The sweet potato fries were really good.  My son had the pork steak sandwich, which ended up being like a pulled pork, so he was thrown a little bit of a curve.  I tasted it and thought it was good.  3 of the 4 of us didn't like the Mac n Cheese.  The teriyaki wings were cooked nice and crispy, but the sauce tasted a lot like straight teriyaki sauce out of a bottle, like soy sauce, instead of using teriyaki as a base to make a better wing sauce.  I'd go back, but am not running back.
name: Scott

text: Honestly this place is repulsive. Yes there is games and food  for your kids and yourself but when everyone you go with gets food poisoning that's a different story. The group of both kids an adults I went with all left with there stomachs hurting and later  lead to everyone puking other than myself. When we ordered our pizza and wings all the slices where different sizes as if it where a Frankenstein project because of that I just got a salad and guess what everyone who had the pizza or wings left sick. I will not ever go here again nor will I let my children.
name: Bryson

text: Great customer service. We were greeted as soon as we walked in. Food came out quickly. Every single thing we ate was amazing and reasonably priced. I would highly recommend this place!
name: Bri

text:
Got a quick bite to eat here while I was in the area. I got 2 rolls for $10 and a side salad for the lunch deal which was fantastic! The salad had a delicious tangy, gingery flavor to it, and the rolls were extremely fresh and flavorful. 

The food was so good that I decided to order some Gyoza to snack on later in the day and they were hands down, the most delicious Gyoza I have ever tried. I got the vegetarian ones and they were full of amazing flavors. They had edamame in them which was a great surprise. 

Between the ambiance, service, and food, this place deserves 5/5 stars.
name: Cristina

text: Carrillo is my favorite dining common from the other three on UCSB's campus. They always have a great variety of veggies, options, side dishes, main dishes, soups, and desserts. The staff are friendly and welcoming. The atmosphere has an outside patio, booths, tables, and bar-like tables. I miss going here for meals everyday.
name: Lianna

text: Great food especially their Ceasar pizza and Philly Cheese Steak. You can even set a time to have your food delivered. I've never been disappointed. The employees are nice and even the sit in restaurant is clean and nice to eat in. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone.
name: Destiny

text: My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Would probably stop in again if nearby. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable.
name: User

text: This is my second review and things have not improved. My husband and I went in for Happy Hour and ordered drinks. He ordered a beer which came right away. I made the mistake of ordering a cocktail off of the drink menu on the table. After 15 minutes and several apologies by our waitress I never got my drink. We finally gave up and left. We noticed that a number of other patrons were having the same problem with the bartenders not filling drink orders. Management needs to address this problem quickly or they won't be in business long.
name: Renee

text: This is by far one of the best steak houses in the city of New Orleans I have eaten at this place many times and each time I go I still am Impressed by the staff and the quality of food this is without a doubt a fantastic place for a good service and good food
name: Dub

text: Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text: I love this cafe, it's warm, cozy, and relaxing. It's not as congested as most cafes in the city and the staff is pretty is nice. I'm a Tea person and I love the variety of teas they have, and, I don't see many Cafes that offer Ginger Tea which is one of my favorite teas. Their Lattes and Chai is pretty good as well. Their food options are delicious as well, I highly recommend this place.
name: Kareem

text: This place was great overall,  from the quick service to the ribs and amazing rabbit and dumplings.   I will come back here again the next time I am in town.
name: Paul

text: The food tastes about average, some of the items here are good. The decor here is nice. Good place to take friends and family. Decent selection of north and south India items. This is the only place that I have ever been to that serves Lobster dosa. I liked it.
name: Robbie

text:
A nice quaint restaurant on a small street... I came here for lunch... The service was good, especially considering that I dined here when there was a large party... I saw several items on the menu that I wanted to try but in the interest of time I ordered the Gorgonzola Salad and added chicken; it was good. I'll definitely come back as I would like to try more dishes. Also, the food is reasonably priced.

I almost forgot to note that I really enjoyed the laid back atmosphere and the soft Italian music that played - very nice touch!
name: Nyja

text: The service was horrible as my wife waited at least 25 minutes for her take out and the person was so rude to her when my wife inquired about her order.   She did not even offer to give her a fresh hot sandwiches!!!   Totally unacceptable especially for a Chick Gil-A restaurant!!!   Won't go back to this location !!!!  So bad for customers!!!!
name: Brad

text: Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. Glad we tried it. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Food was fresh and service was quick. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed.
name: User

text: If you're looking for a place to have some great chowder and sit to take in the amazing view then this is the place to go!  Great service, quick and helpful if you have questions about their menu. Only caution is the pigeons and pelicans around but there are plenty of signs to remind everyone not to feed the birds.
name: Judy

text: I got carry out pizza. It was SUPER greasy and bland. I was expecting better quality since it was highly rated.
name: Alexandra

text: Ate here with my husband for dinner tonight. It was great! The wait wasn't too long (about 20 minutes on Thursday night at 8p). I had a cup of turtle soup and my husband had a cup of crawfish etouffee. I'd never had turtle soup before and it was pretty good, but the crawfish etouffee was GREAT! Would definitely go back just for that. We shared 6 lbs of boiled crawfish with corn, potatoes, and sausage for our main meal. We're from Houston so we were excited to try crawfish in LA. The price was great ($4.75 per pound), and 6 lbs was plenty for both of us. The crawfish were spicy but not too spicy. The corn and potatoes were really good too. To top it all off, the atmosphere was super chill (which we were ready for after a day in the French Quarter), and our waiter was fantastic (really attentive and nice). I recommend the unsweetened ice tea too. We will definitely visit this restaurant if we're in this area again!
name: Brianna

text: Stopped by here while in town for work. It's solid but not the best BBQ by any stretch. Service is friendly and the prices are fair. You could worse but can definitely do better as well.
name: Izzat

text: Would probably stop in again if nearby. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: This is a nice little place to relax, have a few cocktails & enjoy a dinner .. the crab cakes, I felt, had a little to much filler ... but coming from Baltimore, I guess I shouldn't complain !  The steak Oscar was very good, but the filet itself was very small, not much crabmeat on top, very small portion .. I will try it again since it has been voted the best !
name: Donna

text: I don't know what it is about food being sandwiched by doughnuts that makes my heart so happy. I definitely enjoyed the food here and I'm not a fan of beef so I think that's on account of the doughnuts being soooo damn good! I wish you could customize your meal to make the beef patty a little less intimidating but that wasn't an option according to our waitress, so I ended up taking out one of the two already huge patties. Sandwiches are also good. Bf enjoyed the homemade chips.
name: Syddie

text:
5/26/19 - Just heard that Alexa has left this location. She will be missed. She was excellent at her job. Gabe was there today and he is very good 

2/15/19 - A very nice experience today. Even though we came in after 20:30 am they still had my favorite quiche available. Lacy was extremely friendly Once again problems. They consider this a four cheese grilled cheese sandwich. What??? This and a small bowl of soup was close to $10!!! You've got to be kidding me. 

A grilled cheese sandwich is not made by putting a handful of shredded cheese on two pieces of flat bre
Took it back to the manager and he said that's the way they make them. REALLY???

He did however bring me a half sandwich of another type.
name: Doreen

text: Great family place to eat.  Mac and cheese pizza and taco pizza are the best.  Good beer to.  Love watching Preds and Titans there.
name: Paul

text:
The restaurant is huge so I don't think there should ever be a problem with getting a table. They had live jazz music when I came here on a Tuesday night. I forgot to get our waitress' name but she was so attentive and friendly. When it comes to the food I wasn't impressed. I do want to say that I've never tried fried crawfish or jambalaya so it could be that I just did not like those dishes. My friend however liked the crawfish and his seafood platter. He said it was well seasoned.

They bring out all of their desserts on a silver platter to entice you into wanting more. I chose the pecan pie and I was obsessed! The pie is not made in house though.
name: Emily

text:
Charbroiled oysters are so delicious!! We get them every time we are in town. Fried fish, shrimp and Abita on tap makes this place worth the (standard but brief) wait. Have tried the oysters raw but not sure worth the health risks any more. Cooked are great anyhow.

If they could eliminate the sewer smell waffing in from outdoors and clean up more they would be 5 starsl Like many NOLA spots cleaning is not a priority.
name: Jason

text: I almost skipped this place because of the ratings and that would've been unfair. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Maybe expectations are just off for some people. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Not bad for a quick meal. Food was good and came out fast. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: Hands down, the most authentic Cuban I've had in the area. I will be definitely be dining here more often since my sister just moved up the road and she also loves it! The empanadas are huge & fresh, croquetas are delish, moro rice is TO DIE for, ropa vieja is mouth watering and yuca is perfect with everything. Gracias, Latino's!
name: Gina

text: Lighting in bar was far too bright for my liking.  Dim those lights and hide some of my wife's wrinkles, please.  Also, beer selection limited... don't expect any craft beer options here.  Menu was quite large but sandwich was just okay.  Lastly, all the patrons that night were clearly present to watch a sporting event, yet employees/management insisted on blasting horrible music instead of playing the games commentary.... know your customer!!!
name: Scott

text: Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. For a busy night they handled it okay. It was crowded but still moved along. Definitely coming back. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable.
name: User

text: Visited this restaurant for the first time, immediately my server was at my table taking my drink order.  The menu had a very good selection of food.  I ordered the honey hot wings which was very tasty, an order of fries which came out fresh and hot with their special cheese sauce and I really enjoyed the meal. I would definitely be back!
name: Toylonda

text: My partner and I were frequent customers to E Mei (it was our go-to schezuan restaurant) and it was our first time back since their renovation. We expected it to be busy since they had recently reopened, and so we also expected a wait time for a table. We were quoted a 10min wait, but it ended up being 45 min, which would have been fine if that was our expectation to begin with. We then placed our order relatively quickly (we ordered our usual). We also expected our order to take longer than usual since they were still getting used to the new space and it was busy. We kept an eye on other tables around us that ordered before and after us, just to gauge when our food was going to come out. It wasn't until the table next to us (who were seated after us) had received their food, that we immediately got someone's attention to inquire about our order. By this time, we had waited 45 min since our order was placed. Our waiter then came back to us (had never checked in on us during the whole 45 min of waiting for our order) and let us know that he didn't put in our order. That was it for us. We just got up and left. Before leaving, I asked to speak to the manager. This is the first time I've ever left a review for anything in my life, which shows how angry I am. My partner and I are very non confrontational, so it takes a lot to make us angry. The manager just told us again that the waiter forgot to put in our order. She did say sorry for what that counts. I understand that you can't turn back time, but perhaps take a dish off our bill for their mistake? Nothing. I'm very disappointed because as I said initially, this used to be our go to restaurant in Chinatown.
name: Cassandra

text: We've eaten here several times since its recent opening. The menu and food are outstanding. We highly recommend the prosciutto pasta dish - I usually don't eat meat, but I couldn't help myself from trying a bite off my husband's plate. Divine!  Our only suggestion for the restaurant is to install noise abatement panels.  It's super loud on the weekends, which is a bummer when you have to strain to hear your waitress and dining companions.  Can't wait for our next visit!
name: Deanna

text: Turkey and the Wolf is the best lunch spot in NOLA. It has received a lot of national recognition, so be sure to arrive early to beat the line. It is known for its quirky decor and menu. The collard green melt is my favorite sandwich and is a vegetarian version of a reuben. Their wedge salad is striking and quite large so it should be shared or eaten as a meal. No visit to T&W would be complete without their famous deviled eggs with fried chicken skins. Turkey and the Wolf makes for an excellent and extremely filling lunch. No visit to NOLA would be complete without stopping by.
name: Rowan

text: Best sushi/japanese in the Riverview area. The restaurant is clean, the service is prompt, the food is great and comes out fast, it's extremely inexpensive, and the atmosphere is really chill. I will continue to come back!
name: Shelby

text: AMAZING!!! The best Italian food I've had in so long. Big portions and reasonable prices. A must in NOLA
name: Shelby

text: Went to Eleven14 with the new "Mrs." for date night. Unfortunately not the evening I was hoping for :( The restaurant was pretty busy as we were there during happy hour. We ordered the pretzel, bacon burger and pep pizza. Also had 3 beers (extra was for me). The restaurant is pretty new and I probably should have given it a few more weeks, but I had seen the positive reviews so we gave it a go. Food was average on taste and presentation. Pretzel was the best, but pizza was undercooked and burger was overcooked. They were close!  I didn't complain as they were both edible but it is frustrating when you are close yet so far. Our server was a 6.5. She was a college student who was not super engaged and did not seem to have a friendly enough attitude to be a successful server.  I will (as I usually do) go back in 2-3 months and am hoping for a better experience.
name: James

text: This is my first time coming back to ocean Prime in years. The food was delicious but be prepared to dig deep into your pockets on the menu. I ordered their iconic Bubbles and Berry's drink, my boyfriend ordered an old fashioned(which brought him back to his college years in VA) he loved it so much that he ordered two. And we are a couple that doesn't really indulge much but he truly enjoyed the bartenders old fashions. My entree was the sea bass which was good but very tiny portion for the price we paid. Our server was great and very knowledgeable about the menu and they surprised me with a chocolate cake at the end for my birthday
name: Tracy

text: I love the location in Newtown Square so I was thrilled when they opened in Exton, unfortunately I got food poisoning at this location. When I tried to call and tell someone about my experience they put me on hold for 15 minutes and never answered. I'm really sad, I wanted to love this place. I think with a busy kitchen, and they are BUSY, corners are cut and cross contamination is inevitable. They need to work on customer service and cleanliness. It seems their main focus is funneling as many people through the restaurant as possible in the shortest amount of time. The regional manager was nice enough to reach out, but I'm still underwhelmed with this location compared to others.
name: Ashley

text: Very cute. Food was good and so was service! We had the catfish nuggets and a chicken caesar salad. Both came out fast and tasted fresh. Would recommend.
name: Mary

text:
The Embassy suites is a decent hotel. Needs to be updated though. The room was clean and very spacious. The staff was very helpful. The best part is the breakfast. I recommend the French toast...very good. 

Pros: helpful friendly staff. Great hot fresh breakfast that offers everything and then some.

Cons: older looking rooms. Needs to be updated.
name: Juan

text:
Not the biggest fan in Reno.  I went here for lunch with a couple of co-workers and we waited FOREVER.  Prices are a little steep and I'd say the menu was very minimal for people who like salads and other types of dishes.  The pictures on Yelp for burgers looked really good but all I heard was negative feedback from the people I went there with who all ordered burgers.  

When I asked the waitress if I could have chicken instead of steak in the paleo bowl, she said that wasn't possible. I'm still not sure how it wasn't possible.  I decided to order the grilled salmon on top of salad instead of a sandwich and that was surely possible.  There was way too much mayonnaise dolloped on top and my salmon was way under-cooked and VERY raw on the inside.  I had to take it with me and finish cooking it at home.

On the uppity-up-side, I will say that the sweet potato fries were addicting and some of the best I've had in the area.

Any-hoo, I give Fat Cat the stink eye when I drive by because of my unmemorable experience.
name: Tara

text: I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: Interesting place.  You can get some far out fusion types like kimchi tacos or just darn good regular tacos.  Nice folks working the counter are helpful.
name: Chris

text:
They miss-named the carne asada burrito . It should have been called the safari burrito. Then, new customers, would understand they will have to hunt for the meat. 

If $8 is ok for a rice burrito, then this is the place for you.
name: James

text: Second time here and food was good just like before! Crab legs are seasoned to perfection! Today I shared the #1 which cane with crab legs, shrimp, corn, sausage, potatoes and boiled eggs. We opted for the Cajun seasoning with extra butter sauce and it was soooo good! I pretty much ate most of it! Gotta try this place if you are in the Loop area! New location will be in Jennings !!!
name: Amanda

text:
I usually enjoy eating at this location but the food has gone drastically downhill. If you get a very standard dish, then it is sometimes passable.
My family will not even go to eat here with me anymore and until the terrible dish that was served to me tonight, I am over this place. Hit and miss became just "miss". I will say that it used to be good. Sorry but I'm going to pass on this place from now on.
name: Mark

text: Food was good and came out fast. Anyway, the food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. Anyway, the food was good and the service was easygoing. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. For the price I expected more than this. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. idk I'd try something else next time.
name: User

text: Menu is too limited.  Bar was not clean.  Would not go back.  Needs better options.  Good location with huge opportunity.
name: Debbie

text: Loved it. Nitro coffee is smooth and the Amazing French Toast really is amazing. They weren't just hyping it.
name: Brijitte

text:
First time eating here. Late lunch. Menu with a variety of app's, salads, burgers, and pizza's.
               We were greeted quickly and choose a booth. Let the waitress know we hadn't eaten here before and she went over the different sandwiches and foods and even recommended her favorite food.
             My husband got the barbecue bacon burger minus the lettuce, tomato, and onion which came with fries or coleslaw and a pickle - he went for the fries. I ordered the double mushroom and Swiss burger and also opted for the fries.
                Our waitress Kerstin did not write our order down and it was very slow inside. The food didn't take long at all, my husbands was delivered correctly but I however was given a wrong burger plate. Our waitress showed up right after our food was delivered and I pointed this out, she rushed off with the wrong food and said she would get mine entered right away. I asked how it could get so wrong and she stated she apologized and entered it in wrong. 
          After my correct burger came out it was actually really good, very big, messy & greasy but really good. The fries were fresh and tasty! My husband loved his burger and fries also. It was big portions! 
           The waitress checked in a few times and apologized again even though she never offered to take anything off the bill even though she messed up and he had to start eating without me. 
     We would give them one more chance since the food was good but if you can't remember an order write it down. 
        Prices were reasonable- $10 per sandwich.
name: J

text:
Totally a fine dining experience.
The waiter was fully engaged and aware of every detail of our party of 8. We sat on The rooftop patio under the canopy and the experience couldn't have been better. Even with our large group, all diners were hot and set down at the right position. 

I'm not going through all 8 dinners but not one peep from our group. We shared a couple deserts and had a marvelous time.
name: Greg

text:
If you like fried, you will love Sahm's.  Their fried cauliflower is spicy and tasty and their "tachos" (tater tots festooned with nacho toppings) are yummy.  Every night of the week, they over discounted drinks (selections chance by the day).  Service is friendly, but servers seem to have more tables than they can handle.  

Sahm's burgers are fantastic.  Looking for more fried food?  You can get fried mushrooms as a side with that burger- or fresh fruit, if you want something to break up all that fried food.  Actually, they offer an impressive number of side selections, and their app and main serving sizes are generous. 

Not a burger eater?  They offer the "impossible burger" for a small upcharge, and it is a very tasty alternative to meat.  They also offer a nice selection of salads and an impressive cocktail and beer list.  Sahm's is one of those sure things in life:  you will be met with a smile and get a better than average meal if you go there.  And If you like fried food, this place is the bomb!
name: Mary

text:
My boyfriend & I visited from NJ for my mom's birthday, as she has been here before. 

We arrived before my mom & her friend, so my boyfriend & I sat at a table to wait. We were greeted after waiting for 10 minutes -- "do you guys want any beer?" (In the most monotone way ever)

No "hello", nothing. Obviously we want beer... at a brew pub... 

This intro was awkward as hell & set the tone for the rest of our visit. Whoever the female was serving food/beer today, should take some Customer Service 101. She was cold & my big toe has a bigger personality than her I think, lol. 

I watched two tables arrive & leave after waiting and waiting for someone to come by and take their orders. Yikes. 

When we finally flagged someone down for our tab, we paid, and while we finished our beer, the girl who waited on us proceeded to collect her tip and walk away... Here's an idea, say "thank you!" Or maybe "have a great day", for a little razzle dazzle. We get it, you want your tip. Maybe wait a minute so we can get out. I left this place feeling like the staff couldn't care less about us. Not exactly stellar customer service....


Not a great experience & overall so-so beer. Not sure I'd come back here because of the service.
name: Caroline

text: I went for a friends birthday dinner. The ambiance was beautiful and the host and attendant was well mannered and friendly. However, my server was exceptionally rude. Had a bad attitude the whole time and didn't smile once and just ruined the experience for me. The food was good but not exceptionally. Not to mention the two train rides that startled me in the 45-1 hour I was there. Enjoyed the ambiance but don't think I'll be back.
name: Nina

text: I took my wife and parents out for the First Saturday Gallery stroll in the New Orleans Arts District and chose Emeril's for out dinner. We could not have asked for a better experience. I've eaten a Emeril's on multiple occasions and have always had a great meal, but this evening was just fantastic. We started off with a fabulous bottle of 2015 Domaine le Lang des Caillous Vacqueyras, followed by salad and entree's. I had the filet which was cooked to perfection, my wife enjoyed a perfectly prepared ribeye and my parents both ordered the smothered pork chop. The pork chop was HUGE! We then ordered a special king cake bread pudding and a bottle of 2011 Chateau du Levant Sauternes. A wonderful cap to our meal! The wait staff was fantastic, the atmosphere and ambiance excellent and the time from our seating to finish was perfect! Well done Emeril's!!
name: Scott

text: Parking was annoying and I was already in a bad mood by the time I got inside. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Kind of landed in the middle for me.
name: User

text: Had the traditional 2 egg breakfast. Potatoes are excellent. Large serving of grits - which was buttery and delightful. The avocado toast is a pleasant, refreshing choice, was ordered as a side. The Cap'n Crunch French toast - nice crisp outside, with the creamy-soaked bread inside - sweet, dense, almost brioche-like. One slice is enough, so consider ordering as a side. Great service. Offers a take-away coffee when you leave! (... if you've ordered coffee with your breakfast).
name: Janet

text: Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Honestly, the sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something i'm still thinking about two days later. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, tho the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Anyway, it looked better online than it did in person. Idk, the whole meal felt kinda uneven. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Food was fresh and service was quick.
name: User

text:
Their club med is a spectacular sandwich. Tender juicy charred chicken topped with grilled veggies. The sandwich is fairly messy to eat but so worth it! Just make sure you have lots of napkins on hand. Fozzie's changed my mind on adding squash and zucchini! 

Although I was only in St. Louis for a brief stint, I often think about this place and can't wait to come back again.
name: Conan

text: The waiters are very knowledgeable about their tequilas! They have the perfect ratio for margs and the food hits the spot. Not to mention the decor and atmosphere is always festive
name: Griffin

text: Portion size looked small at first but it was actually enough. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. For a busy night they handled it okay. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text:
l is for love this place!!!

h is for how could i ever live without this incredibly wonderful small menu, farm to table, delicious cocktail place 

k is for kill anyone who thinks this place isnt good, hahah jk but for real this place rocks and people need to recognize.
name: Layla

text: I don't leave reviews for grocery stores, but this place goes over and beyond. The deli and bakery departments are especially fantastic, as we became regulars to them and they always offered my two year old son a free cookie. Seems small, but it made grocery runs so easy. Solid meat selection, great beer selection, and customer care that seems to actually care.
name: Paul

text: Best spicy tuna around! The tuna munchkins are one of the greatest appetizers I've ever had! The family is super sweet, which is an added bonus :)
name: Christi

text: I love this Peg's location! Everyone here is sweet as pie and they each greet you with a warm smile regardless of how busy they are. This location's food is consistent with the other area Peg's. My favorite item is most definitely the Huevos Rancheros. In the fall I enjoy the pumpkin pancakes. I'm not a huge fan of the Benedict's (and yes, I've had them all). The coffee is always hot and fresh. The service is always good. And the price point is great.
name: Jeanna

text: Worst Dunkin I have ever been to. Super slow service. Employees all seem like the don't care or don't want to be there.
name: Suzanne

text:
The bar seems to be a decent place, but the owner started making a scene kicking sober people out for no reason 15 minutes before closing time.  She seemed intoxicated or on drugs and was being very rude and obnoxious. "I am the owner, get the f***out."  The wait staff and bartender seemed afraid to contradict anything.  

I would not recommend giving this person any business because of her callous attitude towards her customers.
name: Tom

text: For the price I expected a little more care. The music was louder than it needed to be. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. The staff seemed tired but still polite. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text:
Really good for a tourist! Only odd part (but beneficial because I'm sure it moves the line well) is that you have to order food and drinks before you sit. Tip: sit at the bar if you want to add on. 

Food was great, jam was a little on the less sweet side, and drinks were good.
name: Bailey

text: Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text:
Superior Seafood is my go-to place for happy hour and to show off New Orleans to my out-of-town visitors. It's a fancy schmancy white tablecloth restaurant with incredible service and great ambience. They have a live piano player as well for dinner. Happy hour is daily from 4-6:30pm. You can get a large frozen drink for the price of a small, or $3 house wine/draft beer. Their 50 cent happy hour oysters are a steal (and typically HUGE)... I usually get a dozen and a half or two to myself. 

My favorite entree so far has to be their Blackened Catfish Napoleon. It's served with crawfish étouffée, corn maque choux and whipped potatoes. The flavors mesh together very well, and the catfish is well-seasoned. The food here is not too salty, which is an issue I run into with a lot of restaurants in New Orleans. Their crawfish mac and cheese is also creamy and delicious. Overall one of my favorite dining experiences in the city, so definitely give this place a try!
name: Karen

text:
I live just around the corner from Diamond Doughnuts, and this morning was my first time visiting, and I enjoyed it! I ordered an assorted dozen and the doughnuts were delicious and fluffy! 
Great service, tasty doughnuts, and a happy customer!
name: Edgar

text: Delicious food - un-drinkable cocktails. Eat the food, avoid the cocktails - stick to water or wine.   Love the food and would recommend it to anyone.  Absolutely delicious.   The 4 of us ordered cocktails and despite knowing what we ordered, none of were sure of what we actually received.   None of them tasted anywhere close to what they were supposed to have been.  They remained untouched throughout the meal and our waitstaff although wonderful ignored the full glasses.  Perhaps she knew not to ask about them.
name: Robert

text: My son picked this restaurant for his birthday, he and my daughter ordered steak, maybe I should have followed their lead. Since fish and seafood are the specialty of this restaurant, I went with crab crusted cod with lump crab on top, green beans and scalloped potatoes. The green beans were raw, not seasoned, not even warm, the scalloped potatoes were like chunks of potatoes with some velveeta, the cod was ok but lacked seasoning, I would not call it crab crusted! I have eaten in many, many restaurants all over this city, I have yet to write a review like this, when I tried to talk to the server Hannah about the green beans, I was told that french green beans are served "crispy". That is not the right word for what I was served, inedible is, I was not offered an alternative or anything. My husband was equally dissatisfied with the fish and chips. I left feeling really pissed that I paid almost $22.00 for a meal like that, couldn't believe it!
name: Patty

text: The photos made it look a little better than it actually was. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. It was crowded but still moved along. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text: Best Fish Burrito in town. Warm atmosphere and nice staff.
name: Beverly

text: Management picked such an amazing meal for us during our visit from Chicago!  I will forever crave those shrimp and grits!!
name: Leslee

text:
Two words: SOFT SWERVE. Its a game changer. 

I love this new addition to the SOHO Juice family. The quick serve concept is part of the storefront FLY and it has a great vibe. Jill was the most helpful and amiable worker we were met with at the counter on the Sunday of opening weekend. There was a good amount of parking in the back and you can miss the entrance to the parking lot if you blink (the driveway to the parking lot is right next to Genghiz Khan)! 

My healthy eating PIC and I were there to order their amazing frozen dessert concoction known as soft swerve, their exclusive VEGAN version of soft serve ice cream. There are two flavors available AT THIS LOCATION ONLY. I am conflicted on how I feel about this, as the original South Tampa location is walking distance to my house but I actually have to drive here for this new product but I digress. 

I selected a cup of this magical dessert and added some awesome indulgences. Gluten free cookie dough? UM YES. Cashew butter cups? Yes PLEASE! I practically had to smack myself to make sure I wasn't dreaming. My reality had forever been altered by this heavenly treat. 

Jill was most helpful and offered samples of items offered so if you are wondering what something tastes like, you can ask if there are samples so you can try. After we ordered our highly anticipated desserts were up in moments, photo appropriate and ready to be devoured. Please take the fact that I did not snap a pic of my cup of magic that I was too eager to dig in. Or, it could also be the fact that I have a newborn I take care of these days. 

The seating area is nice and comfortable and there is a bar to eat at with a view of outside, bigger than their original location. There are some also very cool wings with positive affirmations on them that create a nice photo op (don't forget to hashtag). 

Overall I was quite impressed with this new location and the fact that it is part "atheleisure" clothing store is rad. You can shop while you wait. Normally the wait is not long, however, unless there are a slew of people in front of you. 

I highly recommend you check it out and judge for yourself! Everything at Soho Juice locations are gluten-free so those with celiac or gluten sensitivities need not worry to eat here. This, like all SOHO Juice Co. locations feature fresh pressed juices and cleanse programs, packaged house made granola, almond and cashew butter cups, non-garbanzo bean based hummus, kale chips, etc. Soho Juice is perfect for a healthy snack, a pick-me-up, a healthy vitamin rich meal, or an indulgence. You can choose your health potion. I was impressed by their unique hummus flavors and I saw that many are zucchini based which is awesome. I've been told they taste just like standard hummus so I will have to try for myself. They also serve kale chips and other vessels to eat with it. I's consider it a great one-stop snack destination.  

Pro tip: Join their rewards program in which you are identified with your phone number. It can be used at any location.
name: Tina

text:
Fantastic in every way.  Smelling the woodburning oven as we walked in and seeing the serpentine line of hungry customers was a treat.  

Three of us shared 3 entrees and while we each had a favorite we all loved everyone of them.  All of us are vegetarian so the plant-based meat (Impossible) was available for 4 of their entrees (we had all but the Doner).

One of those places you're upset you haven't already been 50 times.
name: Mark

text:
I should have read the reviews before we went. We decided to go on a Sunday night and even though we said we were not seeing a show at the Keswick we were given a very limited theatre menu. There wasn't even a gyro sandwich on it. We ordered the sampler appetizer platter which was very good, the only thing that was worth any stars. For entrees we had 2 gyro platters, a filet shish-kabob and the salmon. Everything was dry and quite tasteless. I hope the waitstaff was new because it would be sad if this is their standard. She was stumbling and awkward and weirdly inattentive yet rushing us. 
My $100 would have been better spent elsewhere.
name: Vivienne

text:
The first time we came here was perfection. The second time we came here was OK.

Kebabs are all great. Highly recommend the mixed grill with the grilled chicken and kefta.
Love the salad. Great prices for the portions!
I am not a big fan of their hummus. It has too much tahini for my taste and not enough lemon juice.
I would have given them 5 stars but the second time we went the rice was tasteless and not good. It's like maybe the chef was off and someone else did the rice and it came out wrong? It was bad.

Pro tip: They have AWESOME French fries! Get some kebab and French fries and that's basically all you will need to eat that day.
name: EJ

text: Exactly what this area needed. A big town feel in an otherwise small-ish town. I am trying to reach Yelp Elite.
name: Gerald

text:
A coworker told me about this spot, so I checked it out a few times while getting my oil changed down the road. The few times I went there, I enjoyed my sandwich and thought it was good value.

Small sandwich shop with a handful of tables, and prices are pretty affordable. Everything else you might want to grab is extra, like most sub shops. It's nice to have this little spot nearby and convenient.

I really enjoyed the panini I got there!
name: Will

text: Vouching solely for the purpose of the atmosphere. I grabbed a beer and sat on the roof top. The view is absolutely worth it and the entire setup is lively. My dad is a huge fan of Jason Aldean so I made sure to stop by and get a hat just for him. The staff was friendly and the music was great as well.
name: Lindsey

text:
The Rooster is a small, step-back-in-time place with a menu of deli classics. 

Note, this place used to be Rooster Soup Co., but within the last year they revamped the menu and format of the restaurant. This mostly seems to mean a greater focus on non-soup items, but the menu is by no means large. One part of the reboot is changing the restaurant from full waiter service to a quick service format where you order a the counter and they bring it to you. If you want water, you serve it yourself. I've been here before the change (twice) and after the change (once), and maybe I'm colored by my great experiences back then, but I miss the waiter service format. It's also not obvious that that's what you're supposed to do when you come in. These are small complaints, to be sure, so this isn't a big deal. 

But unfortunately, my only experience so far at The Rooster as The Rooster had a mixed record on the food. I came in starving for a late lunch and ordered a patty melt on rye with fries on the side. The fries were very good, but the patty melt was just not the quality I had expected and the meat was very dry. So that's unfortunate. In my previous experiences, I had legitimately rave-worthy meals, especially the burger. If their burger was so good before, what's going on with that patty melt, man?!

One more thought, and this isn't a complaint, but this place has terrible lighting for photos. I like the lighting and atmosphere inside actually, because it's a slightly different feel from everywhere else and contributes to the vintage style, but it seems nowadays restaurants go out of their way to make the inside and the food itself as photogenic as possible, of course because of the Instagram presence. 

I'll probably come back and try a few more things, such as the burger once again, but I was a bit disappointed at this last time at the patty melt.
name: Patrick

text: Very overpriced for what we ate. Food was subpar at best. Very dry chicken and an expensive burger
name: Amanda

text: Stumbled upon this place with a friend after checking out Christmas Village in Love park. We were excited to have some Greek food. The waitress told us that the dishes are tapas style and she suggested sharing 4-5 dishes however the way my friend and my wallet were set up we ended up just getting one dish each and sharing the fries which ended up being fine and enough food. The fries were reallyyy good, typical Greek style seasoned fries, really tasty. We both got lamb gyros which were honestly quite lacking. I've had many a good gyros and this one was unfortunately not one of them. I wasn't a fan of their lamb -- it had an interesting texture. Maybe chicken would have been better. I ordered one of their cocktails with fig in it that the waitress recommended and it's probably the best cocktail I've had in my life, soo good and the perfect sweetness, you can barely taste any alcohol. My friend ordered a drink that she wasn't too fond of and asked to get what I got instead and the waitress replaced it no problem, so definitely great service but the food or perhaps quality of meat (from what I tasted) could use a little improvement.
name: Simisola

text:
Sunset? To technologists, that term means at or past end-of-life. No more. Kaput. The signage still says Zushimaki. No, it's been sunset in order to have become "Sunset."

I have to take issue with a Yelp review left at the former Zushimaki Yelp page that describes this location as "aging...dark in a creepy way." This is an old, functional strip mall restaurant space. So what? It competes with other strip center restaurants, not Michelin stars. Style upgrades have nothing to do with service or food. Implying service or food is bad because the building space isn't new, hip, or flashy is unreasonable...unless you come to eat the architecture, which I don't (it leaves splinters in my teeth.) The space is clean and provides what is needed to serve you.

It's been months since I last drove out of the sunset to visit, yet tonight's service was great. Pad Kee Mao was delicious. Pricing was right. And I found no sushi offerings that interested me. Near as I can tell nothing has changed. There ought'a be a law! I sat there awaiting my order and Yelp had me all worked up from saying it was closed. In name only, perhaps?

So, it's not closed. It simply changed hands in place and is under different management who seem, to me, to be doing well...short of affording new signs (which can be a tad expensive) to label the new brand. The new name/logo on the menu wasn't even noticed.

A savvy business transition will often maintain a prior brand. Branding doesn't seem to matter here, today, because at 5 PM the house was nearly full. I've yet to experience anything other than a full house at this location. Luck of the draw?

Confusion say: "It might be the beer." But it's not. It's the signage.
name: David

text: The food was awesome and our server Austin was also great. Would defently love to come back.
name: Aly

text: Food was good. I got the trout with 2 sides. Very different taste. I enjoyed would return :-)
name: Susu

text: We had a GREAT time here: worth a stop on the way to/from Reno on I-80. Fun outdoor games (cornhole, horseshoes) while you wait. Two things I'd like to see: better wine list (no Pinot? Just add a basic Pinot) and some more substantial meals: how about a steak or porkchop dinner?  But we'll definitely be coming back. My son had the ribs, I had the chicken BBQ sandwich: both were excellent. Good service!
name: Brian

text:
Went for lunch. I came here a few years ago and wanted to see if it held up. Honestly it was a really good lunch. I had a lamb gyro with the lemon rice and chicken soup. The soup was great. I inhaled it. The gyro was chocked full of meat, tzatziki, tomatoes and a bunch of crispy lettuce. It filled me up. It was hearty handful of a gyro. Loved it. We had the tzatziki and pita bread appetizer. Pita was warm and delicious. Tzatziki was creamy and very fresh. 
It's a good restaurant and I recommend it. Ron Swanson.
name: Led

text: Our overall experience was great! Food was good, I ordered steak and chicken tender combo with broccoli casserole and Mac & cheese and a Caesar salad. My steak was a bit over cooked but everything else was delicious! No wait and fast service during dinner on a Tuesday. My reason for 4 stars is due to the steak and the painkiller drink (which is why I initially went there lol) it appeared the bartender may have spilled a whole lot of nutmeg on top of the drink, leaving a perfume taste... I've definitely had better drinks from other locations.

text: Really enjoy Etch. Menu is always good. I'm a fan of the chef. Great place to take out of town guests. Really nice wine menu.

text:
Don't advertise if you are not going to have all the ingredients. A combination pizza is a combination pizza. Not a pizza that you have to pay for each topping. Call it a cheese pizza. And it takes like a lunchable.

It took the food long to come out and I can understand fresh, but a salad is not long to make. My son, grown son, fries should had been given to a kid.  How do you give a grown person a combo meal with a order of small fries?

Please train your staff people skills. I can tell attitude when it is presented. Not interested in returning.

text: Great place for breakfast !!! Fun atmosphere and fabulous coffee!!! Located in cool midtown shopping center with great ships to browse
name: Madeleine

text: The only thing good about this place is the view.  We visited Caddy's today after driving 2 1/2 hours to meet some relatives, visiting from Washington.  Because I am Celiac and have other food allergies, I had researched Treasure Island restaurants and found Caddy's to be one of the few places that touted accommodating people with allergies/sensitivities.  Our server seemed very knowledgeable and agreed grilled Grouper and steamed vegies would be perfect.  NOT!  Caddy's was out of vegetables (at lunch??), and the Grouper was so over-cooked, I could hardly cut it and didn't even try to eat it.  We told our server and the manager, who flippantly replied, "Yah, that's over-cooked.  Let me buy you a drink to make up for it."  No offer to replace my meal or take it off the bill, and a drink was the last thing I needed or wanted.  By then, everyone else had finished eating, and I felt so frustrated, I just wanted to leave.  Wow...Caddy's, worst meal ever.  Even our relatives thought the food was merely OK.  Don't waste your time or money here.  There are many beach eateries with gorgeous views and much better food.
name: Madeline

text: Such a nice addition to blooming downingtown! The interior is very cute with cactus and bright colors! Definitely recommend the quest, it's warm and seasoned nicely. Their fried avocado on the salad and tacos is yummy and the brisket is great too! Worth checking out for sure there is a nice outdoor area with games for kids

text: Went there Saturday night and they only have brisket. What happen to the rest of the menu. Kind of sad.

text: Great Donuts, super fresh. Highly suggest trying them out. They always have fresh doughnuts, this is no Dunkin' Donuts!

text: Excellent service from Maley! And they had gluten free soy sauce which I appreciated.
name: Anita

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up. text: I ordered the mixed kebab with grilled veggies for delivery.  The delivery was timely and the food was delicious.  I was a little disappointed I only got one kofta because it was very good, but besides that it was good portions.  The meat and veggies came with a side of hummus and a little salad.  It's a little bit pricey but I'd say it was worth it.
name: Brian

text: Love the sushi! Tofu skin and smoked eel are really good!! The chicken teriyaki is not my style but it is fine. Highly recommend any sushi. We tried fried ice cream and it also delicious!
name: Lucille

text: The fries were probably the best part of the meal, honestly. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: This is by far the closest you'll get to having NY style AND taste pizza in this area, I've been waiting for a place like to open up. They just opened so they're extremely busy and you have to understand there will be hiccups along the way with service and timing but I will take that wait because it's worth it. Get the grandma pizza and you'll go running back!!
name: Noelle

text:
I know I am going to be in the minority on this one....
Maybe it just didn't live up to the hype. Regardless, we showed up ten minutes before they opened to be the first ones in line and by the time they opened the line was ten deep.
We ordered the boudin balls, a double pimento, a double cheeseburger and rip fries. Everything was made fresh and was hot off the grill, but the burger was not that "melt in your mouth I need it every weekend and two when I am hungover" type of burger. If you like a lot of bun this Might be your place, but I prefer a more even bun to meat ratio. The rip fries are a must, with just enough kick but not too spicy. 
Glad we went because we loved the experience but probably won't be our regular burger joint.
name: Melanie

text: I was there today for Mother's Day and it was awful. Our server was great but the food and menu were miserable. We sent our food back twice due to poor temperature and ended up leaving.
name: Aly

text: Great spot for large groups. Short wait and great service. Bison sliders and pulled pork was amazing!
name: Brad

text: Best pies in philly! Magpie you will be missed! I'm so sad that I didn't get a chance to try every pie on the menu.
name: Mansi

text: A hidden seafood spot in ybor away from all the nightlife so keep your eye out. I come here often cause I enjoy the food and vibe of the dining area. The last two times I was here I got the Florida steam pot with the crawfish bites as a appetizer. The pot is kinda small and somewhat over priced being market price of around $29 dollars and then add another snow crab cluster for $8 dollars it just doesn't seem worth it. The clusters are decent size so you do get a good bit of meat. It comes with about 15 shrimp you peel em. About 10 cuts of sausage and 2-3 ears of corn. Be warned the sauce in the boil is spicy not noted on the menu. My recent trip here compared to last weeks was a drastic change. The lady I had last week was amazing and so attentive and made sure me and my guest had everything and enjoyed everything. Then on Monday I came here to show this place to a friend and it was a complete nightmare. The waiter we had did not even bother to take drink orders after giving us a menu. There was two other small groups there but he kept going to the back so I'm not sure if he was helping cook as well. The wait time for everything was very long. After eventually bringing us our food to start with the appetizer he didn't even bother to bring plates or napkins over for the other guest. With the main corse we awaited still napkins and refills. Then at the end the waiter assumed I wanted to split the check and put the appetizer on my guest check and that's not what I wanted or ever brought up and he was not pleased. I'm just over all disappointed with my most recent trip there with how terrible the service was because this is one of my favorite restaurants in Tampa. I'll still be returning in the future but I hope the service is better and no one else has to experience that.
name: Blaise

text: I ventured back today, saw one of the best servers in the business, Alejandro, had a great meal today, Macho Shredded Beef Burrito. Everything was excellent, warm chips, hot dip, cool salsa, and EXCELLENT SERVICE! I will be back! =)
name: ThaDragonSourceRa ®

text: This is my regular Chinese food takeout/delivery spot. Food is good, not fancy. Restaurant is clean. I usually order the general tso's meal with white rice and egg roll. The crab Rangoon are decent too, but I agree with other reviewers that they're mostly cream cheese (I'm not complaining though). Is this the best Chinese food? No, but is it consistent? Yes! Plus I like the order online option through Yelp.
name: Kate

text: Great location if you're staying downtown, nice little place, good coffee and food. Very good service, we've been here a couple of times and the service and food has been consistently good!
name: Jose

text: This place offers the best bloody mary. I also enjoyed there charbroiled oysters. The service was good and friendly
name: Brandon

text: Food was fresh and service was quick. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Pretty happy with it overall. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. For the price I expected more than this. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: Avoid if at all possible. Parking is terrible, the employees are unfriendly (and often downright rude), and orders are often wrong.
