I am a regular Panera customer at other locations and usually enjoy their food and atmosphere, but this location is subpar to say the least. You would have a better experience at any of the other nearby restaurants on 21st Ave.
name: Javelyn

text:
Thursday 5/23/19 was my first time eating at Wasabi, and let's just say it will never happen again. It started off great, met a bunch of friends for dinner and drinks. Dinner went as planned, and we had a great time. Now why would I never go back again you ask? Well let my just say on Saturday 5/25 I woke up feeling nauseous.. a few hours passed and now I'm violently ill () Turns out- 10 out of 14 people from the party that went to Wasabi for dinner were sick with the same thing. At first I thought it was crazy, but after doing research, salmonella poisoning can take 12-72 hours to show signs. This has been a miserable experience and has put myself and friends out of commission for several days now. 

My hope is by writing this review I'll help another person avoid the food poisoning plague. There are plenty of other restaurants out there to try. Maybe try the ones in Tampa if you don't mind the drive.
name: Hannah

text: Decent beer selection, mediocre live music at best and a lovely bartender lady who either can't count correctly or purposely gives you incorrect change hoping you won't ask her where your missing $2 went...
name: Cody

text: Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Glad we tried it. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text: Favorite spot in Tucson. Spicy Garlic Shrimp, Calamari, every pasta dish is great. Friendly staff, great atmosphere.
name: Rob

text:
Ahh, yes.  This is a classic hometown pub. 
It's layout is open and functional  ... perhaps large enough to allow for a crowd when it's time for the big game?   It's got lots of television screens, and when we arrived there were several tuned to the various sports. 

I ordered the chicken fingers and they were tasty with two different sauces that hit the spot.  My SO had a burger and there were no complaints there. Enough to take home leftovers.  

The service was really good for a midweek visit to Round the Corner. Glad to have a spot to go to around here  ... just "around the corner" from me actually.
name: Sarah

text:
Uggh this place sucks.  My daughter's daycare is less than a mile away from this and I've stopped by Woosa Bubble Tea before and this place is right next door so I decided to try it for lunch.  The two staff workers working at the desk to process your order and payment are super slow, can't speak English, and one of the employees decided to chat with her friend while people are lined up to order. She was noticeably oblivious about the growing line while she keeps chatting and gossiping with her friend.  I can tell people were getting antsy and she was just laughing in the counter with no care in the world.  The other guy stepped in to take the order since his co-worker decided to chat instead of work,  was nice- but can't speak English very well.  They have wide range of Chinese food in their menu, but I decided to order a safe dish since I'm not sure- Kung Pao chicken. It's also good to mention that they don't have a cheaper lunch menu so you have to pay full price even during lunch time.  

My dish arrived and I was severely underwhelmed.  The dish was too wet, had too much bell peppers and peanuts and not enough chicken.    

Also, be warned that they don't serve any beverages besides lukewarm water, and few sodas in can.  No- they don't even have any tea- warm or cold. 

With the lack of parking, lackluster food, awful customer service- I definitely won't be back
name: Kirstie

text: Great service!! Excellent beer selection. Would recommend to anyone. We didn't have food but it looked awesome when it came out.
name: Karla

text: Went with family on a Sunday and it was louder than I expected. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. A very pleasant experience. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text:
GREAT service by Matt. We didn't have to wait for a table on a Friday night at 7:30 which was really nice. There were still plenty of people there. Food was on point. We had hush puppies, calamari, oysters on the half shell, and all four of us ordered different versions of the combo boil. I ordered snow crab and shrimp with no head- juicy sauce and medium hot. The only thing I'd change is that I would have done head-on the shrimp. My sister did that and the flavor was a little "juicier". 

It's affordable for being really fresh-tasting seafood in the Midwest. Also, the drinks were good and strong. Will go back regularly!
name: Lindsey

text:
Wow... very impressed. Great food, knowledgeable staff, and excellent wine! 
Oh yes..  and great food! A very pleasant surprise when you taste your pasta dish and it's made how it should be. 
Thank you Chef! 
Highly recommended!
name: John

text: Reading some of these complaints now feels a little overblown. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. I had a better visit than I expected to. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. It looked better online than it did in person. The service was off and the meal kinda followed that energy. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text: My husband and 2 kids went to the open demonstration. Our chef was entertaining and informative. Our 10-year-old picky eater was even willing to taste everything because he made it so fun. After class, the chef was kind and pointed out to our picky eater that he needed to keep trying things even if he didn't like them the first time because his taste buds were still developing. I so wanted to give him a high 5 just for that!! They have this spice called Joe's spice I believe and we bought large quantities to bring home with us. I would do this for any occasion again and again....just take my money!
name: Alysha

text: Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Food was good and came out fast. No big complaints, just a nice meal. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Not bad for a quick meal.
name: User

text: This is probably my favorite dimsum joint in town. Their dishes are always consistent and the place itself is clean. No complaints here :)
name: Vinita

text: Went in at 330pm on a weekday, had to order take out because the entire place was being mopped. Tried to create small talk with the owner while I waited (owners wear the black shirts, right?), and she was super stuck up and awkward. Empanadas are great though, expensive but really good.
name: Enrico

text: I have been here numerous times and have always enjoyed the atmosphere and food/drinks.  The food today was good.  Our waitress - Nina - was so rude, condescending, and could not wait to bad mouth other customers (we heard her talking crap about them at the register with another waitress) we actually left her a tip - I shouldn't have and wish I didn't (just was always raised to). Will probably move on to the next cool place on the beach for lunch/dinner next time.  Disappointing.
name: Katie

text: My name is bob. I ordered the goat masala and stone IPA it was bomb af. Don't order extra spicy if you can't handle extra spicy. It's really spicy, and I like spicy. Apparently it uses Thai chili peppers. Still good tho, definitely would recommend 10/10.
name: Vune

text: Based on reviews, we gave it a shot. Wish we didn't. The food was sub par at best. My husband couldn't even eat his. Save your money and go elsewhere.
name: Jamie

text: Love love love this place! I travel for work and I'm always looking for kick-a$$ vegan food. When in Philadelphia, of course you have to get a cheesesteak! It was awesome. Also ordered the root beer wings
name: Antranise

text: Went here with sweetheart and daughter for dinner.  My cosmo was super, but daughter found her cocktail (house specialty) was weak and boring.  The appetizer, peirogies and caviar, was excellent!  We ordered one starter for all of us to sample, and would have eaten a second!  Now on to the entrees....Sweetheart had the fried chicken, which I thought tasted like Popeye's chicken.  Daughter and I had the scallops.  I thought they were undercooked and lacked any crispiness or interest. We had the mixed cookie plate for dessert, which I found very boring.  Were those cookies even homemade?  I would not return to The Love.  I find most Starr restaurants quite good, but The Love does not make the cut.
name: Lynn

text: Second time to this awesome restaurant! We had such a great experience and our server Julie  was the best ever so we had to come back. Of course we asked for Julie's section when we returned! The salads and hot chicken were delicious!  The pizza looked amazing! Also the peach tea drink was delicious! You won't be disappointed!
name: Stacey

text: I get the appeal, I just don't totally share it. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. The staff seemed tired but still polite. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Maybe better dine-in than delivery, hard to tell. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced.
name: User

text: I've been to several shake shacks and maybe it's because I'm a West Coaster and didn't grow up in it (In-n-Out for me), but the burgers are average at best.  The cheese fries are delicious though.
name: Nick

text:
I wouldn't think that a lack of comfort and convenience would have negatively impacted having breakfast, but it did. During our visit, the restaurant had no heat plus something wrong with the credit card processing so cash only with no receipt.

I don't think well when I'm cold and didn't want to go through the work of "build your own hash". Instead, we picked the one pre-designed chorizo hash that was mostly large blocks of potato but barely any avocado and salsa. Designed with Mexican flair, the hash came with sides of black beans, three small corn tortillas, and sour cream sauce flavored with cumin. For a hash, the scrambled egg almost became incidental.

My palate doesn't taste much when I'm cold which could be why the egg frittata was bland. With half-dozen small chunks of potatoes, a dozen leaves of spinach, and jack cheese, the health-conscious frittata wasn't filling.  Additionally, the recipe didn't seem to have strong source of flavor and was underseasoned. On the side was a partially ripe avocado studded with seeds like pepitas.

Order at the counter. Both indoor and outdoor seating. 75 minutes of free parking across the street in the city-run lot. The popularly-written about prisoner egg muffin was not on the menu.
name: Brian

text: Great restaurant with beach view. Nice atmosphere. Our waitress was very pleasant and efficient. We both had sandwiches and we ordered some conch fritters and crab fries. The food was yummy. This was one of the only places to eat that were directly on the beach. Parking was tricky, had to pay for public parking.
name: Molly

text: Delicious food always a fun place to bring your friends. Watermelon Margarita and softshell crab are delicious.
name: Connie

text:
We were super excited for this opening- love this location! Flatbread is great so we knew the owners would likely deliver a fun new concept. The food that we had was good and we will definitely return because some of the items we wanted weren't available. No big deal. 
The reason for the 3 stars- pretty easy fixes, really. Our server showed ZERO excitement! No mention of recently opening, no name/introduction , no recommendations or even the offer to answer questions- first thing she said 'do you want anything other than water?' So boring. I mean, you JUST opened! Show your excitement to be there and your guests will feel it. 
Another thing that bothered all of us at our table... the fact that staff utilizes the garage roll up door to go between the patio and inside. There is a small wall that everyone has to liters step over and it looks so unprofessional and lazy. Maybe if the small wall at the bottom wasn't there, it wouldn't have been so obvious, but they even used this access while the tables in front of the door were seated with guests. It was so bad. All 4 of us noticed it right away and couldn't believe it. It's really the little details that make restaurants stand out. I think there are a lot of great things about this restaurant but I just feel they need fine tune the details. Especially staff! 


* I tried to email that address but it didn't work. I'm happy to try a different one, if you have one. Thanks!
name: Sara

text:
There's a rivalry between people who like Kate & Al's vs. Pete's Pizza. I can't be the judge of that feud just yet. I can't seem to eat at any other stand but this one. 

Slices are $2.25. I can tell you now, it makes much more sense to buy a pie. It's addictive and you'll be upset for not doing so. This pizza is mind blowingly simple. Tomatoe Sauce, Cheese, Crust. Why is it so good? The old square pans they use, is my thought. This is the only Sicilian style pie that's managed to have a thin buttery crust, pillowy dough, and a layer of sauce with cheese that isn't heavy. I've easily eaten a pie myself. Yes, it's that good. If you're looking to have toppings the only way to snag them is on a pie. Luckily, you can call them up and order a pie before you pick it up. 

This place does lack in service when they get busy and it's cash only.
name: Chels

text: food was amazing chef HAS SOME SKILLS and server Tim was amazing. The food was delicious and attractive not to mention the atmosphere and attention to service. we walked 20 minutes and we not disappointed at all..KEEP UP THE GREAT WORK
name: Evelyn

text: Not like the Desi Vegas in the CBD area. Came for Valentine's Day. I wish they had more entree options on their menu. The waiters were ok, a little too animated for me.
name: Samantha

text: Loved it. A very nice experience. I dont know of any place like this. Reminded me of the restaurant in good fellas. Planning on returning in the near future.
name: Jack

text: Great cafe, lots of options, pretty good coffee drinks and the cupcakes are awesome. I love their breakfast, and they have a sweet little back patio , great to sit with your dog and enjoy this beautiful beach town.
name: Alex

text: This place was louder than I expected and that sort of shaped the whole meal. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Food took a while and didn't rlly feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Anyway, the sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something i'm still thinking about two days later. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Anyway, it looked better online than it did in person. Also, for a busy night they handled it okay. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text:
Came to Pho Langs with two coworkers last month for a quick lunch while at a training downtown.

The restaurant was jam packed at lunch time - usually a pretty good sign.

We ordered salad rolls and spring rolls to share.  The salad rolls were good the spring rolls were - meh, boring and the accompanying fish sauce quite plain.  

I ordered the spicy beef satay pho.  It was standard but nothing to write home about and truly lacking the spicy part.

My counterparts had a sliced beef pho and a pork vermicelli bowl.  All parties in our group are regular Vietnamese restaurant goers and really, none of us were left wanting to come back.  There was nothing wrong with our meal but also nothing stand out.  

Compared to greasy pizza and burgers, I'd still pick this place in a heartbeat.  But given that it's just a quick 5 minute driver from 97 street Chinatown, I'd rather hop on over to Golden Bird any day of the week.

Thankfully the Vietnamese iced coffee was strong and kept us awake for the remaining of our course that day.

3 stars - "A ok."
name: Kristin

text:
I went at 8:00 am on a freezing Saturday morning.  I am pretty positive I was the only customer.  Oddly thought, not one worker spoke to me.  Maybe they were still busy getting ready, I don't know, but the one thing I like better about Good Earth is the relationship you have with the employees.

Th great part was I found everything I was looking for and more.  They have tons of oil options (I use Jojoba on my hair and its really hard to find at a decent rate and size).  There are also large selections of herbs and spices which you can fill on your own.  

They also have Paddywax candles which smell amazing!

It is pricey and with Whole Foods slashing prices because of Amazon these other stores are going to need to step it up at the community level if they want to compete with the other giants in the field.
name: Ericka

text:
Delicious!  My wife and I have ordered takeout from here three times and each was excellent.  The Chef's special vegetable platter is big and so yummy!  I've ordered both the chicken tikki masala and butter chicken.  I like the tikki masala a little better but they are both good.  My wife ordered goat korma (great) and lamb tikki masala (tender and delicious). 
 Naan and paratha are hot, fresh and the dipping sauces perfect.  

Takeout service is fast and friendly.

I hope they stay in business for a long time.
name: Miriam

text:
I come here every time I stay Atlantis Casino.
Food is great. Service superb and location very clean. Server Vanessa very corteus . Bus person Mariela also corteus. The whole staff very professional and corteus.
name: Oz

text: Loved it here! The service the food the drinks and the staff amazing! The bow wow was good and a lot for the price. I had red beans with fish soooooo good. Loved everything about it and it's black owned. Don't miss out on this place.
name: K F

text:
Instantly one of my favorite cafes. I'm on the road a lot for business which means I've been to hundreds of cafes and this was incredible all around. Friendly staff, high quality coffee, and delicious gluten-free food.

I highly recommend it.
name: Erik

text: Dina was super nice.  Good food and fun setting. Fun family environment. Good price.  Breakfast all the time.  The Bobs Big Bear Burger was the best
name: Estella

text:
I was one of the first people in there when I went. I was greeted with a smile and popcorn was brought to my table. I had the hot roast beef sandwich and it was absolutely divine. The au jus was some of the best I've ever had and I would gladly have paid twice as much for my meal.

The next time I'm in New Hope I will definitely be sure to come back.
name: Ann

text: Came in during a lull in the day. Encountered one of the rudest people on staff ever. Tall slender blonde male. Was in a blue Qdoba shirt and black hat. Regarded me like I was a huge problem and actually *flung* each item I requested into my burrito bowl. Unbelievably bad attitude. I've done food service throughout my college years. That was a decade ago, but I can tell you that having someone with such a shit demeanor dealing with customers makes NO sense. I also taught public high school for several years, so needless to say I am able to let quite a lot of ridiculous Behavior roll off my back... Even consider  reasons why someone acts out.  But on a Sunday afternoon just making a burrito bowl with someone who is being completely neutral? What the hell did I do to you? If you don't like your job, find another one. Don't take it out on customers who didn't even bat an eye at you The wrong way. The other dude working wasn't so hot, either. It's pretty loud in here between the music and the hum of the kitchen, so I had a little trouble hearing some of his questions. Excuse me... The only pleasant person on staff was the young lady with pink hair. Maybe you ought to bump her up to management and fire the other two since they don't know how to treat people.
name: Deej

text: Not good service.   Came in with a friend for some food and a drink...we both ordered food at the same time.   After ten minutes my friends food was brought out... I was told mine was coming even though the bartender never even checked with the kitchen...   Fifteen minutes later when I again inquired about my grilled cheese and fries they actually checked with the kitchen and my order was ????     asked for a refund and told again it's coming... NO Thank You..   Skip this place and you have not missed anything.
name: Keith

text: I've been looking for an authentic Thai restaurant in the area and was excited to see this one. Wasn't let down. We sampled a number of items off the menu; spring rolls, satay chicken, Thai Basil and Green Curry and all were superb. We will definitely be frequenting this place.
name: Naarah

text: This place has incredible BBQ, and the atmosphere is always great! Also, the service has been great each time I have been. If you are in Nashville and want BBQ, give it a try. You won't be sorry!
name: Kortnee

text: Me and my husband ate at Mission BBQ a few days ago for the first time. We were on vacation in Nasvhille and this place was recommended to us by a few people in the Opry Mills mall. I ordered the pulled chicken sandwich and french fries. The chicken was good, but could have been warmer. It was pretty much room temperature. I tried the bbq sauces and only one i thought was alright. The rest seemed very much a vinegar base. Which i soon found out that's how most of the bbq sauce in Nashville is made. The seasoning on the chicken was good enough though that i didn't really need much sauce at all. The fries were cold which was very disappointing. It was a chilly day and was really looking forward to a nice hot meal. I'd be willing to try this place again in the future since my husband enjoyed his salmon, fries and cornbread.
name: Heather

text: I love pizza hut and they're great this one sucks i asked for garlic sauce they gave me marinara sauce instead and i paid for it never again will i order from this location!!
name: Jen

text:
Great location, above average food, and ok service. Overall a good experience. 
Don't like how they sneak that extra 5 bucks for the glass when you order a "specialty drink". C'mon, just add it to the price of the drink, not in some small writing on the menu and then get surprised when the check comes. Tasteless practice I must say.
But, they do have some of the cooler logo shirts on Bourbon St.
name: Flemming

text: Great food and wonderful service.  My favorite dish from this place is the Hunan Spring Duck.  The meat is always cooked to perfection and the sauce is tastes great every single time.
name: J.P.

text: The crab legs were very tasty full of flavor... The fries were good... The clam chowder soup was amazing. Great atmosphere... Would give it five stars but I took the elevator up to the third-floor and when I got there somebody was working on it in the elevator locked up for about five minutes on me...
name: John

text: My friend liked it more than I did. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. I'd maybe go back, but I'd order differently next time. Nice little spot, decent portions too.
name: User

text: Literally still waiting on my 2lb lobster and king crab legs been out side now for 40 mins! No joke. Do not come here for Restuarant week.
name: Warren

text: Stopped in for a late lunch today and had an awesome experience. The food is always great, but our server Bethany was fantastic, she took wonderful care of us and towards the end she even chatted with us a bit. Best experience I've had at a restaurant in a long time.
name: Jason

text: A company was hosting a speed dating event here and my friend and I who attended the event loved this bar. Since then we've brought more friends for dinners, hookah, birthdays and much more. I would give bar more than 5 stars if it were possible!
name: Julia

text: Just like the star title says, Meh. Went to this place with a few other people who were treating my husband and I to dinner. It was okay...The view was nice, maybe that's strictly what you are paying for because the food wasn't anything special, esp for the price. I had fish that came with vegetables and the carrots weren't even cooked, fish was okay. Key lime pie was decent but if you've had Key Lime pie in Key West it doesn't stand a chance....staff were friendly but hostess def gave us an up and down look upon arrival which seemed slightly rude. Was it worth the almost $300 bill, no way.
name: S

text:
They're just really going in headfirst on the gentrification, aren't they? I openly admit that I patronize places around Boise that could be called gentrifiers. It's hard to avoid in a town with this much growth. 

But this is a little much even for Boise's standards. 

The menu is unbearably pretentious. The staff are condescending.

I ordered a small plate to sit with and read and was still disappointed. Better light options at Cloud 9 with a friendlier atmosphere just a few blocks away. Or the Modern, txikiteo's cousin location, offers better options for comparable prices. Don't ask me why they are night and day as far as attitude. 


It's unfortunate. West Downtown could use some more dining options besides fast food. I just wish this place didn't swing to the other end of the spectrum with its snobbishness.
name: Kathryn

text: The first few bites were promising and then it kind of leveled out. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text: A nice non commercialized place to have great food, drink and amazing service.  The broiled fish is very good and I highly recommend it for fish lovers.
name: Bill

text:
The epitome of horrible customer service!!! our chicken and fries were re dropped in the oil- the chicken wings were black and the fries had no potatoes in the middle! when we told the owners they said " im not changing the grease for you or obama" they refused to give us a refund also.
words were exchanged-the black owner called us bitches (disrespected black women)!!! And yelled at us in front of his customers! He told us we could not have to -go boxes for our paid for overcooked food and then proceeded to grab our food and threw it in the trash!!!!! That's when the police were called. The owners still refused to give us a refund. We had to dispute the charge with our bank!!
Please spread the word- do not spend your hard earned money at this business. This is why blacks dont support black businesses. I guarantee thier doors wont be open next year!
name: Avonda

text: I really enjoy this place. It's low key, inexpensive and the ingredients seem fresh. I liked the red and green salsa that comes gratis and their chips are good and not greasy. I had the Plato del Dia dish, el pastor - I didn't use many of the tortillas to wrap it all up because the flavors were good enough all on their own to eat up with a fork. I'll definitely be back.
name: Bridey

text: Amaretto and Pineapple  w/ Mardi Gras Mash was simply delicious . The server was helpful and even allowed us to taste samples for the best mix.
name: B

text: They put love and magic into their food.  They could halve the portions and it would still be a bargain. Lamb torta and tacodilla were crazy delish.  Right across from the Hilton but behind another business. Take the time to find this gem.
name: Sarah

text: So this is a pretty popular spot from what I can tell and it's trash. I've been to many cheesesteak places up here and this is by far the worst. I can't even express how bad this place was. Another place I'll never reconsider on my quest for the best cheesesteaks.
name: Clifford

text:
Frenchy's was rockin! Band was playing on Sunday and drinks were being served! We complimented our island drinks (felt like we were about to set sail on a cruise) with some delicious food! My personal favorite was the crab fries! You can order a small or large portion depending on your group size. For 13 of us to show up without a heads up on a Sunday afternoon, they were super accommodating and got us all to sit together, so thank you!!
My tuna poke was really good! It had grilled avocados with the ahi tuna on a bed of rice with some sweet chilly sauce. My one suggestion would be for the tuna to be cubed and freshly cut, the chunk of tuna (although had the same flavor) was a little mushy because it was all slopped together. I imagined it to be similarly cut to a tuna tartar or how I get it in my sushi roll. Other than that it was a great time for the group and myself and we will definitely be back!
name: Sarah

text:
If your in the Tampa area for Memorial Day and was trying to find a  decent bar, this is it. 

There is live music playing and during intermissions a collection of music is played from country, rock, hip hop, pop and R&B! A little bit for everyone. At 10pm if your under 21 you are not allowed in.

Me and my boyfriend was greeted by Dan, who was AWESOME. He was so attentive despite it being busy. Dan surprisingly remembered my name despite my name being very unique so I was definitely impressed! 

The scenery grounds look like a Tiki bar from outside bury inside is regular small bar. They have ample food items to choose from and the my perfect margarita was strong and tasty! The food wasn't anything to go crazy about to us but the lie music , drinks and service was great!

I will definitely stop by again when I'm in the area.
name: Sandra

text: This place was AMAZINGGGGGG. Like bitch when I tell you they exceeded my expectations...tbh I was tryna go to La Esperanza but for some reason they were closed. So we came here. That steak burrito? BOY. it was delicious. The greatest thing about some Mexican staples is that it's simple good food when done right. This burrito was exactly that. The only thing that bothered me was my boyfriend and I ordered soft drinks and they each came in different cups. That bothered me lol. But overall, great food. Will return.
name: Ashley

text: I ordered 2 slices and 1.5 Lol.... this place sucks!!! Not very good pizza either way.
name: Vincenzo

text: For a busy night they handled it okay. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Pretty happy with it overall. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. For the price I expected more than this. Food was good and came out fast. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text:
The Horn is the way to go. Nestled on Murfreesboro Pike, it is easy to miss. It is a cultural gem, with authentic African cuisines and coffee grounds.

I absolutely love this spot, there's plenty of open seating--perfect for meeting to work on a group project, study, and hang out with a group of friends. The staff are all very friendly, and love opening their doors to community members.

It's not a Frothy Monkey, there's no frills here, but that makes it even more unique. I absolutely recommend that you check out this coffee shop, the sooner the better because you are truly missing out on a great spot in Nashville!
name: Nicolette

text:
I'm really tempted to say that this is the best bakery in Nola but I'll leave that up to you to decide. There's a reason why its called "Gracious". I went here for the first time today and I had the best customer service  that I have ever experienced in a cafe setting. I ordered two pastries and when I asked if there was water, the barista offered to make a cup of ice water for me even though there weren't any "official" water cups. And when I was about to pay for the treats, she threw in an extra pastry for good measure. (All the pastries were amazing and warmed to perfection-I had the carmelized onion bread and the cinnamon cruffin.)

Also-and this is just a personal thing-their music was on point! I don't know if it was because I was the only one there or what, but their playlist had all these really great alternative tracks that were clearly stolen from my iTunes library...
name: Julia

text: My boyfriend & I went here tonight because we were starving and wanted some good jamaican food. I read through the comments and felt comfortable that it would be delicious , but the lady did sound very depressed and unamused when I called the store to order. When my boyfriend went to pick up the food he said it was so quiet, there was no music,  and no one spoke. They just handed him the food and stared. I could care less as long as our food was right. I didn't have time to take pictures because we both were starving but we ordered oxtails ( large) and jerk chicken which came with rice & beans and we ordered two side orders of mac and cheese. My boyfriend said the oxtails were delicious but the rice tasted old and the mac & cheese was horrible. I loved the jerk chicken but man was it hotter than hell. ( thanks for not giving a warning Yelp reviewers ): ) It took me two water bottles to get the spice to go away. The flavor was amazing but i think i'll keep that for my spice lovers. On to the rice, horrible. It was so crunchy,  but with the jerk sauce it was bearable. The mac and cheese I was looking so forward to was disappointing and dry. The cheese was not melted and it honestly looked like someone sprinkled some butter and cheese over some noodles and called it a day. This was just okay but i do say beware, eat at your own risk. I was opened to trying again until i woke up in the middle of the night puking. So as you can imagine... there goes the possibility of me revisiting . I recommend going to Morgan's Island grill for some real Jamaican food.
name: Damani

text: Good food, reasonable prices and I love the ambiance, quiet and spacious. Definitely one of my favorite places.
name: Gustavo

text: I was very happy with my experience at Palais De Jade. Immediately walking in the place was full, it was clean, and I was greeted and sat. I ordered the Shang Hai dinner, for $17 you get a bunch of appetizers, soup, and your entree. It was a great deal! The food was great, and the manager was very friendly. Going around and asking customers how their dinner was. I will be returning!
name: Alyssa

text: Got the chicken Parmesan.  Extremely dry, all cheese, almost no marinara.  The waitress noticed my unhappiness, and said since it was so dry did I want some sauce?  I asked, "Can I?"  She said yes.  Eventually she brought out a small saucer of marinara, which allowed me to choke down enough to no longer be hungry.  When I got the bill, however, I found they had charged me a buck for the extra sauce.  Grrr.  Never going back to THIS chain.
name: Tony

text:
Best place for live music good food and best craft beer & cocktails. Not to mention their serious collection of aged scotch/whiskeys!
When you visit head down stair for a game of pool in the parlor or a lounge cocktail in the speakeasy. Something for everyone!
name: YearoftheWood

text: I love this place- though it is smaller than the Campbell location (or it appears to be). Nonetheless the same great food. If you are a pancake lover, I highly recommend it. The specials are always tasty and the regular menu has a variety of options too.
name: Desiree

text: The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Definitely coming back. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text: Was in Santa Barbara for over a week and went to San bar on our first weekend there  and had so much fun. The cocktails were amazing. There was a big group of us and maybe a bit loud but food was great and our boy Nicholas kept the chips and salsa coming. And he was quite entertaining. He told us places to see and hiking locations. Had so much fun. Can't wait to visit again!!!
name: Marlene

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. It was crowded but still moved along. Price felt a touch high for what it was. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again.
name: User

text: Saw the reviews on my Nextdoor app.. went there just to see if they offered vegan options... and THEY DO!  One of the best vegan dogs I've had in a long time... I ordered the Italian "dog".. and it was delicious!  Great customer service and cool little spot!
name: Tammy

text: This is a great cafe that serves breakfast and lunch.     The selection of drinks and sweets makes it a great place for a short business meeting too.  They have varied seating and even a few outdoor tables.  I had an excellent salad and gluten free dessert.  The staff were friendly and attentive.  I'll definitely be going back.
name: Kirsten

text: I get the appeal, I just don't totally share it. Also, solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Also, the host got us seated quickly, which i appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Idk, i've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. idk I'd try something else next time.
name: User

text: So happy this place opened up in Metairie! It's next to Trader Joe's. It doesn't look like Camellia Grille on the outside. Inside is modern, still got the stools and big counter, but there are also some tables, too, which is nice. Food was delicious and quick. The buns are toasty and the burgers melt in your mouth.
name: Rachel

text: Location is really cute with great decorations. However, service is SUPER mediocre and the prices are just TOO HIGH. Ordered the sea bass for a small piece of fish for almost $50 with no sides. It was a good meal but not worth spending that much on. I would love to see this place become a staple in the Warehouse District but I will not be returning all long as prices are as high as they are.
name: Beja

text:
Definetly would give more than 5 if I could. The first time I ate here was 2 weeks ago and we enjoyed their all you can eat spaghetti special. Yes all you can eat is tacky sounding but they kept it classy. It was $19.99 a person and you got an appetizer, salad, and entree. The entree was pasta with fresh tomato sauce and a iron pot filled with meatballs, Italian sausage, and ribs. Seriously this was tasty. I ordered and extra pot of meat to take home it was so good.
Today we enjoyed avocado toast as an appetizer. Holy avocado goodness  THIS time I brought my family with me. We had chicken and waffles which came with cheesy Smokey grits. And I hate grits but these were perfection. I ordered a chicken parmesan sandwich with a leafy salad. Someone ordered a delicious pizza with ricotta and green stuff on it lol it was amazing! And my little one had scrambled eggs and chicken sausage.  

For drinks we enjoyed a strawberry frozen drink, a orange cream frozen drink, a Bellini with prosecco and peach nectar, and a JDubs Poolside beer. 

Try this place! I drive so far to eat here. It's sooo good.
name: Liss

text: Live music, balcony is fun, happy hour. Lots of space inside and out. Ok drinks, ok food.
name: Alex

text:
We don't often give 5 star reviews but this place deserves it. The staff was friendly, the portions generous and the food flavorful. We had the steak fajita dinner, al pastor and lengua tacos. It was miy wife's first time trying a cantaloupe drink and she enjoyed it very much. 
It was our first time here and we'll be back.
name: Luis

text: Very Underwhelming.  This was our first trip to this place so I ordered a simple single bacon cheeseburger with small fries and husband order the grilled chicken ranch.  No line, not busy and still service was slow.  Burger was as thin as a McDonald's Burger and tasted like one.  The chicken ranch husband said his food was forgettable it was dry and overcooked. He threw half of it away.  Fries where okay.  For the $20 we paid for the food we could of gotten better meal at Wendy's.  Not sure what all the hype is about this place, but was very underwhelmed by their food.  Will not be going back ever.
name: Victoria

text:
Konan BBQ is the real deal!! Home style authentic BBQ!!! Local establishment with Tampa owners! I haven't had anything there that wasn't good!!! 
All the sides and the desserts are YUMMY!!! The PineApple tea is a must!!!
name: Nicole

text: Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The music was louder than it needed to be. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Pretty happy with it overall. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: Drinks were phenomenal, sides terrific, but the bone-in filet didn't exactly seem worth it to me.
name: Jonathan

text: I came here on NYD and was out in the patio area as that was the only seating available at the time. The hostess said that the Patio will have heat on. I said ok as I was with my 5 year old son at the time and wanted to go somewhere with a kids menu on NYD. I put in my order and had a seat and waited for about 35-40 min to get food. I just had orders of wings and my son had cheeseburger sliders. I took off my jacket and was starting to feel cold and saw that the heater above us was shut off. My son was feeling the same way. Our table was in the corner next to the window so it was cooler in that area. Apparently a group who was seated after us complained about the heat so that was shut off. The waitress said because they want it shut off that we will turn it on briefly. She turned it on and it was fine and then 5 min later it shut off again because the other table complained again. I asked if we can sit somewhere else and told her that's not fair. My question is why should we move? We were there first  got our order after the other group and I had a kid to manage as the other group was a bunch of adults. I was so annoyed by the service that day. They moved us to the bar.  If you decide to come here and patio is the only option and if you get cold request an inside seat or go elsewhere.  If they are going to turn off the heaters in the winter and have people sit out there..that's not cool. The waitress didn't care about doing the right thing..she was concerned about losing her table in a transfer.
name: Manish

text: I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Glad we tried it. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text:
The food is great but it is overpriced and the service is AWFUL: go somewhere else, you'll save money and feel better! 
to elaborate, the staff is beyond rude. they barely greet you, if they do, it's as if a gun is to their back. Every interaction I've had there (it's around the corner from my place) has left me feeling like "why did I just pay to be talked down to and ignored?" The $15 sandwich is not good enough to justify the terrible service and gouged prices. 
The main person that works there gets paid and tipped to just be awful to people. I've never heard a twinkle of warmth come from her. Oh! And they have signs telling you to get the fuck out immediately after you finished. I've only ever seen those signs in center city fast food places. So anyway, I'm done giving them my money.
name: Brooke

text:
This is one of my favorite new spots close to home. It's hard to find Thai cuisine in the Exton area so I was pleased to find that while Murasaki is Asian Fusion, they do a pretty good job with Thai. Being gluten free I have mostly stuck to the Basil Fried Rice with Chicken, prepared gluten free. It's very tasty, large portion. I always ask for extra vegetables. If you don't like spice, stay away from the thin green peppers! They add the right amount of heat when cooked in the dish but are very hot when eaten! They also make an excellent and authentic Thai Iced Tea which is one of my judgments for a good Thai restaurant. 
My family really enjoys their Udon with Chicken and Drunken Noodle with Beef. We've also had a very good sushi roll. I look forward to sampling more of their dishes.
name: Lorianne

text:
For fresh, delicious Thai food on the northeast side of town - THIS IS THE PLACE TO GO!  My husband and I found this gem several months ago and we are hooked!

The food is delicious, the wait staff is friendly, the ambiance is quaint... my only worry in recommending is that the place will become so busy we will have to wait for a table when we go!

We've only gone for dinner, but have enjoyed just about everything on the menu... and with each entree you can pick the "heat" level (mild, medium, hot) which allows the diner to try all the options without concern for being overwhelmed!
name: Christine

text: Obon has good ramen, but is located downtown which means finding parking is going to suck or you're going to pay. I rarely come here because of this. Their tonkotsu is what i usually order and is as good as ikkyu. Ramen prices are fair. I also really like their non-traditional buns. The crab bun has an actual crab in it and is delicious. The buns are pretty expensive though. Their happy hour sushi isn't half bad either.
name: Apisto

text:
I called on 8/3/19 asked if there are any specials.  All i got is no. With the prices of round table and no specials you might as well go to a real pizzeria.
;To the sole proprietor,    have fun in bankruptcy. Please check out longboard pizza nearby.  Or a lot of other real pizzareas near by. When you operate a chain customer service is key.
name: Gianfranco

text: Sal & Joes is the best! It's been around forever and the food has been great forever! Classic Italian restaurant, the garlic bread is second to none. I always get the chicken francese and it never disappoints. All of the soups and salads are wonderful as well as the seafood, particularly the muscles.
name: Gracie

text: RF's was a wonderful surprise.  Who would have expected a craft cocktail / martini bar in a Holiday Inn?! I know that we are talking NOLA, but I never expected anything like this.  Wonderful live music, great happy hour and FABULOUS Artisans behind the bar.  Josh, Kat and the others behind the bar take basic and fancy drinks to a whole new stratosphere and their garnishes are fruity works of art.  I highly recommend you stop in and enjoy the relaxed atmosphere, great music and some of the most personable and talented bartenders I've met in NOLA (or anywhere else).
name: Shelly

text: Have been dining at this place a lot recently.  After searching the city for months trying to find the perfect oyster spot, I can confidently announce that this is the place! Ocean Prime has a fantastic menu with lots of drink options to back it up. This restaurant is definitely on the higher end of the price spectrum so be prepared.  I typically go during their happy hour (4-7) because of the price discounts. 1$ oysters on Thurs and Fri!  The bar area is very inviting and the staff has always been friendly and attentive.   Definitely check this place out if you are looking for a change to your normal restaurant routine.
name: Kevin

text: Healthy and yummy. We had the avocado club panini and the euro grains bowl. Both were more than enough for lunch and both were very fresh. You can watch them make your food, but it is obviously made to order. Someone was cleaning tables so there were always open spots to sit. Prices are comparable to Sauce- around $10 a dish. Good spot!
name: Treena

text:
There is a new Chinese restaurant in the Town Center Plaza that is giving it a go.  I believe it to be an independent restaurant, but has all the standard chain offerings that seem to be pretty popular in the area.  As part of a strip mall, there is plenty of free parking in the lot.  

Inside, they have done a complete makeover of the lobby and small shotgun style dining area.  Warm yellow walls, black and white flooring and wainscoting, and teal benches make for an inviting interior though it was kept rather dimly lit.

I decided to get my order to go and after placing my order and paying, grabbed one of the chairs in the lobby by the window.  I didn't see any wait staff, so I believe you are supposed to grab your own supplies from a counter where you pay if you are going to dine in.  Otherwise, you should have all the napkins, sauces, and plastic utensils inside your to go bag.

I was ordering for dinner, so I selected Egg Drop Soup (thick and yellow, but not much seasoning), crab rangoon (6 in an order and quite crisp with a sweet red sauce), and the peppered steak entree that comes with white rice.  The flavor was mild and okay, but the peppers were cut into too large of chunks to be bite sized and I wasn't supplied a plastic knife (which probably wouldn't have cut the peppers).   Fortunately, I was able to dump it out onto a plate at home and take care of it.  But if you were trying to eat directly from the little white box, you would have some challenge.  My wife sampled my dinner and thought that it was okay, but not anything special other than if you simply wanted a quick Chinese to go dinner.

I will say that the lunch specials are priced at only $5.50 and include fried rice and your choice of an egg roll or crab rangoon.   There are 25 lunch special options listed!

Anyway, the food was good, but nothing unique.  The service was efficient and easy to communicate with.  It's nice to have another option for dining in the area.

Review #2574
name: Ken

text: Went with the family last night, checked in through Yelp. Upon waiting about 30 min (which I usually expect after checking in through Yelp), we were told while walking to our outside table (not wanting to go outside being that it felt like 90 degrees and there was a live band which we couldn't hear each other) that we were checked in as first come first serve. This has never happened before when we used Yelp. Our experience there was not a good one however the food was really good.
name: Michelle

text:
I know I gave this place 1 star on my first visit, but I'm all about second chances. I've actually been back here several times and absolutely love their al pastor tacos. After trying the carne asada, I realized that there's no way I'm straying from the al pastor. It's just so rich in flavor and the pineapple bits make it excellent. You know you're getting the real deal when you get a side of the nopales, a grilled jalapeno, and an onion. I prefer the salsa verde rather than their smokier chipotle salsa, which is the spicier of the two.

It's made to order, so if there are some seats, grab yourself one and get excited. Sadly, they have raised their price and it's currently $9 for the al pastor tacos, which is on par with the area and it's still cash only. The drunk yelpers seem to like it and as someone who's eaten this only soberly, I also approve.
name: Augustina

text: Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Food was fresh and service was quick. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Would absolutely visit again. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Food was fresh and service was quick. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: Quick. Clean. A/C pumping on hot days!! Friendly staff. Great tacos, nachos look promising, I saw someone eating a burrito that made me jealous that I didn't order it. It's hard to decide which I like best... pork or beef brisket but I'm interested in the Peking Duck now that it's on the menu too. Ahhhh! The moment to decide is a bittersweet one. You know you'll get something you want and like BUT you'll miss out on the other awesome choices.
name: T.

text: Cool atmosphere, great food, and tasty cocktails! We will definitely be back to try more off the menu! Whipped feta and roasted carrots to start. The feta had a great garlic taste and it was so rich and creamy. The carrots were perfectly cooked with a glaze (balsamic reduction maybe). We had the cheeseburger and quail for dinner. The burger was second to none! The quail was cooked "Nashville Hot Chicken" style (fried with spicy sauce and seasoning)! We didn't get dessert because I overheard the guest at the table beside us mention that the pastry chef was on maternity leave, and she didn't care for what the fill in prepared.
name: Tiffany

text: Decent food but not filling at all unless you plan to spend a ton of money - we ordered family style and spent about $35 each and all left still feeling hungry. Food is delicious tho. I'd go for the experience but not for a filling meal
name: Mariam

text:
Update: one year later and this place is still in shambles. No one willing to seat you still so again seat yourself or like Uber eats just grab your food at the hostess stand and go on your merry way. Soup comes out with dinner, dinner comes out wrong, servers are no where to be found. Over priced joint that does not deserve your money and time. 

Server took salad and dressing from plate after I stuck my finger to taste dressing to see what it was since I ordered fries. I feel bad for whomever had it after me because I have been sick recently with bronchitis.
name: Christine

text: It looked better online than it did in person. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. A couple small things kept adding up. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Wouldn't really choose this place again. Not bad for a quick meal. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Nice little spot, decent portions too. The wait wasnt awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which prob says everything..
name: User

text: This was my first experience with a true Cuban sandwich. It did not disappoint! If you chose to go here, prepare for a line and limited outdoor seating. The food comes out quickly though, so it makes the line wait worth it.
name: Blake

text: This has always been a go to for me. The food is always fresh and well prepared and great. The staff is friendly and service is quick. This place is always clean. Really good and fresh food here.
name: John

text: Food is ok. There are some pretty good deals on the menu in terms of price, especially breakfast. Skip the coffee...I use to order it every time, but they switched companies and it taste terrible. Service is friendly. It's just always crazy busy in there and feels like there isn't any room to breath. The hostess did a poor job of seating us on my visit today. We came in and asked for two high chair before she ever sat us. She took us to our table and left. She put two babies out on the main aisle and then I had to go back up to the front where I found her standing around talking to other workers and had to ask her AGAIN for high chairs...and another worker took care of it. Come on front end...get your act together.
name: Leslie

text: Firstly I know it's st paddy's day weekend BUT I still paid for this. So since it's st paddy's day weekend we don't matter to you cause we are just occasional customers so therefore we get our drinks in plastic cups! Cmon Man that's low. Second we order from the special st paddy's day menu figuring that since this is an Irish bar it'll be good since that's their specialty. Well guess what,they don't give a sh-- about that either. The shepherds pie was -get this- hamburger meat in gravey over (not under) mashed potatoes! No peas, potato's, carrots anything! It was gray. Period. We sat two tables away from the door to the beer shop and every time it opened we got blasted with cold air. The people behind us were dying. I understand that places like this make their money on weekends like this, taking advantage of people that are out for an occasional holiday. BUT, this time we are two people out looking for a new and different neighborhood place to go for a drink and dinner. That's two people who won't be coming back once the special holiday crowd is gone.  Because of how you treated us I don't think that this bothers you, but I hope I can warn others that this is the attitude that exists at this place.
name: David

text: I've been going to White Dog for almost 4 years now in multiple locations, but the Philly one is definitely the best. It's in a great location, so if there's a wait (which is extremely rare) there's plenty of things to do such as shopping or just walking around. Their alcoholic beverages are great, and so are their other ones. Although it may be a strange thing to like so much, the bread that is served with the lunch & dinner menu is great and the butter is wonderful. Everything I've had on the menu is delicious, but my favorite is without a doubt the cheese plates. They're so cute and come with 3 cheeses and assorted sides (usually some kind of apple butter, a fruit and sometimes nuts.) The staff have been really nice & accommodating every time I eat here - I've never had a bad experience. There's also many different rooms to eat in, which makes it a lot more comfortable and easier to talk. It gets busy sometimes during lunch hours on the weekends, but it's really nothing too bad because of how spacious it is. The art is also really cute, and I love the way it's decorated. It feels really homey, which is great. Definitely my favorite restaurant on every level. If you're in the area looking for somewhere to eat, definitely try it out! Some of the items on the menu can be pricey, but you get what you pay for (great food!)
name: Allie

text:
This is such a cute little place! I thought the design had kind of a rustic feel and the Beer Garden is super unique & pretty. We went on a Saturday afternoon for lunch, the weather was terrible but the food was good. We joined the waitlist online or else we would have been waiting for forever. 

We ordered the chicken pesto sandwich & the pharmacy burger! The burger was delicious and had a somewhat Steak N Shake steak patty taste. Their ranch was also incredible! 

The only downfall I found to this restaurant had very little space for the parties waiting on the waitlist. Also, how loud this place can get.
name: Rachel

text: Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Definitely coming back. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text:
Moist, flavorful and generous pork sandwich. One of the best I have ever had. The coleslaw was crisp and tasty-not overly mayonnaisey ar all. There is a bbq sauce bar with several flavors-I tried sweet and hickory, both were delicious. 
I'll be back!
name: Julie

text: Went back two days in a row for hot chicken and sweet teas.  Good value and memories of Nashville.
name: Angie

text: The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Glad we tried it.
name: User

text: For the price I expected more than this. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Probably not coming back. Food took a while and didn't rlly feel worth the wait. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable.
name: User

text: Absolute abomination. The horror! of this food! The spaghetti is completely unedible I received it as long overdue room service.  This place is so bad it should be closed by the state as a matter of policy for embarassing the great state of Nevada. How this place can exist in the same state as a place like Prime at Bellagio is just a strange contrast.  The depravity of this places burnt meatballs knows no bounds.
name: Kevin

text: My brother wanted to check some new place and we spent a little bit of time trying to find it through his phone but we eventually found it with my phone.  Sounds like his phone was outdated right? Anyways we come up to CopenRoss and it's easier to find than having the map tell you where to go. Walked in and it's got a great vibe, friendly staff willing to help with all the delectable wonderful beer choices they have. Very knowledgeable staff, food is excellent! I got the a wheat beer which I don't remember the name but it's close to your old hef style beer. I also ordered a jalapeño cheese pretzel with jalapeño ranch. I ordered also the monster sandwich. The pretzel was superbly delicious! Nice crispy on the outside with the jack cheese melted on the inside. You sprinkles of cheese on top of the pretzel that gives it a nice crunch. My monster sandwich was different from any where I have been. The sandwich was made with ingredients that I can't even think of.  The bread was like focaccia, light, airy, and the choice of meats mixed with a may Dijon and a sweet chili lime flavor. Very interesting and was a really tasty sandwich. I liked the baked fries, one thing I would next time is ask not to have salt added. The fries were baked nice and crispy. Give this place a try and you might find yourself a new place to hangout.
name: Kevin

text: This is a great place.  Has a dive feel but great place to get a craft beer and hang out.  I wish I lived close to take advantage of their happy hour 1/2 off drafts.
name: John

text:
We were in town from out of State for a show at MSU and asked a worker there for a local recommendation for dinner.   And here we are...

Really enjoyed our dining experience and highly recommend this brewery. Fun, interesting decor, staff are efficient and the beer is tasty, cold & plentiful.  We made it in time for a happy hour and dug into a plate of Italian Beef sliders for $4.  Yum!!  
Our group also enjoyed the Pouteen and Pulled Pork sandwich.  The onion rings looked delicious but we found the batter too hard for our liking.  Seriously thought I could break a tooth if I ate them.  Not sure what's up with that batter but man, those are some tough rings.    

We would definitely return to Ferguson Brewing the next time we are in the area.  And super close to MSU if you're heading in that direction.
name: Olive

text: I was charged more than what I had expected, I brought it up to an employee and the employee 'Erica' which I did not see a name badge. She said that was the correct charge when she viewed my receipt but I told her it doesn't state it on the receipt nor did I order it that way.  I was given my food, when I was driving I checked my bag, I was missing 1 item.  To top it all off, when I got to  the order, the order was wrong. I didn't even get what I was charged for.  I was in a rush so I didn't go back to the restaurant because I was already 20mins away. I was picking up food for other people.  Poor service,  I am not going back to this Mcdonad's restaurant
name: H

text: Here during devour but didnt take advantage of it. it's for a serving of 2 and I was by muself. I was immediately seated, no wait. no RSVP . It's a great deal and I was tempted to take some leftovers home. Instead I got the 45 roll (my usual) and i decided to try the lettice wrap. It was very tasty.
name: Vicky

text: Food was ok but Americanized, bland. Like a PF Changs. Atmosphere inside is very nice & our service was excellent. We just prefer local food with more flavor...Lemongrass is flavorful & more authentic! I hope they improve the flavors, if so I'd give them another star!
name: Diane

text: I've spent a lot of time in Texas and have had some amazing tacos. My opinion is that barracuda is the only place that is comparable to those within the city of nola. Good tortillas, ok queso, but really good tacos including the fish, special chorizo, pork, and chicken. Margaritas are good as well. Cool atmosphere and decent price.
name: Steven

text:
It was a horrible experience, I had ordered a  iced coffee as the options I had was that, or chai tea as there is nothing else he can make l

The server was not interested in helping even when I told him the iced coffee was horrible he just took it n threw it out! My friend complained about the chai tea he had ordered and he got a look as of what is it that he must do.

So as my friend and I are in the car looking for a new place to go to, I had did a review regarding our experience and next thing the owner pulls up next to us and basically tells me why I put that review up, and we must get out of his parking lot and never come back! He continued to yell at us as if we did something wrong!  Super disappointed and upset
name: Roslyn

text: It was a long wait for Seaweed to open but since it did (many months ago) it has become a favorite of mine. I've tried a lot of different items on the menu and they are not equally successful. I don't love the bao, for example. But I have found wonderful dishes, including the fish spread, the grilled oysters with manchego cheese, and my favorite, truffle hamachi. Ok, if you won't eat raw fish, you won't like it. I usually also order a fish and have enjoyed them all, including grouper or whatever is on the menu. I sub a vegetable skewer for potatoes and it includes sublimely grilled veggies such as squash, pepper and onion. Don't go if you're in a hurry because service is relaxed.
name: B.

text:
This has got to be the slowest fast food joint going ! So disorganized and not the cleanest place Nats flying around the soda fountain garbage over flowing scraps on the floor in the dining room . People everywhere waiting for their food.  So far I've been waiting 20 mins for 2 fish sandwiches with no bun and 1 order of onion rings !
I gave one star because I couldn't continue
name: Tammy

text:
OK, a bit late.. my wife and I were here about a year and a half ago and love it!  Friendly staff, fresh food, convenient (to us) location and we felt "at home" by the warm and welcoming atmosphere there.  Loved it.
Our daughter lives in Jersey, and this was our first time visiting her.  This is the place for us to visit, time and again whenever we are in the area.

Diners are diners, plenty of them around, but THIS PLACE MAKES YOU FEEL AT HOME from the first friendly greeting, to the fresh and warm comfort food served.
name: Joe

text: Shells have been a great family seafood spot in tampa for years. They reopened a few years ago at this location and I have always enjoyed their seafood and drinks. I ordered the infamous shrimp and scalloped pasta, crab cakes,  and crab dip. My meal was so scrumptious. On another note, I didn't break the bank plus my 5 year old had to practically roll me out of the restaurant.  Oh by the way, she has a habit of collecting some of their shells on the ground outside, before we leave the parking lot. As soon as we got home she rinsed them off and dropped them in our fish tank.
name: Melissa

text: DONT COME HERE UNLESS YOU WANT HAIR IN YOUR FOOD. I love this place usually and frequent it. But...today I found a big, long , black hair in my food!!! I was outside on the phone when my food arrived and when I went to sit down, the hair was staring at me. I politely gave it back, disgusted beyond measure, and tried to order and eat something else. But it was hard. My appetite was gone. They didn't even try to comp the meal and made me pay full price for a barely touched breakfast! Then as I'm paying, the guy had the gall to blame me and say it was my own hair!!! I have short purple hair, not longer black hair. And hello...I wasn't even there or had the opportunity for it to fall on the plate! DONT COME HERE!
name: Sunni

text: Met friends here for Sunday brunch a few weeks ago and while I did not  love my meal, it was OK, but everything else was fantastic.  Starting with the friendly service and the complimentary mimosa's, it was just a great place to enjoy spending time with friends.  Next time I'll try something else and I've heard the pizza is excellent.  Will be back for sure.
name: Mary

text: Cute place! Glad to see other dessert place in Chinatown. The staff is welcoming and very nice. Would definitely come back and highly recommend!
name: Michelle

text: This was my first and last time ordering from this restaurant.  Got my order wrong, couldn't contact the manager to complain because their message service is not set up on the phone, ordered 2 shrimp PO Boys got some type of uncooked fish instead.  Added the photo so you can see the type of food I was handed.  Totally unacceptable and I'm sure whoever made it wouldn't eat it so why have my pay for it.  Terrible
name: Terrell

text: Ordered takeout because I didn't feel like cooking and it held up okay. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. So yeah, really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. So yeah, it looked better online than it did in person. Food was good and came out fast. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text:
Okay so this ramen is just okay to me. I've had a bunch of places throughout NYC and when passing Philly I saw that it had killer reviews on yelp so I decided to give it a try.

I gave them three stars because I think the different noodles and textures were great but the broth didn't do it for me.

I got the terakawa speciality ramen which is tonkatsu broth and thin noodles, as well as the miso ramen which is with a miso base broth with thick wavy noodles.

Both noodles were good, texture wise, but the soup wasn't good enough for me to want to finish. I usually drink a lot of soup when I eat ramen but this just didn't cut it for me. It didn't have a depth in flavor. 

I wouldn't say they're bad but there is definitely better out there!

Best part was the chashu and egg!!
name: Sabrina

text: Still going to 1sr Round and still get excellent service from Tia. She is such a wonderful server.
name: Wesley

text:
One of the smaller buffets I've encountered in the area for Indian food on a weekend. The area has a few places that have outdated menus and buffet info, but glad I found this shopping center! They're were so many options that I'd come back to try. 

The buffet had a soup, fried potato, a veggie side, white rice, chicken tikka masala, and lentils. Everything was rich and flavorful, and it comes with fresh naan. Naan got cold pretty quickly and wasn't too fluffy. The smaller lunch buffet isn't anything special, but can get you by if you have a craving and need something yummy!
name: Gloria

text: the sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Definitely coming back. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: Literally the worst food I've ever had out.  How do you mess up quesadillas?  Half filled and disgusting.  Cold queso from the sampler, water tastes like its from the tap or toilet, and nothing seems like it's prepped in house.  I can see why the place is EMPTY at 7 on a Saturday.  Go ANYWHERE ELSE.
name: Sarah

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Not a bad stop, just not one I'm rushing to repeat. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Food was good and came out fast. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text:
Came here today (Tuesday) for lunch not expecting much and was pleasantly surprised. I've seen and heard about El Vez many times over the years. How can you miss the unique decor when walking down the lively 13th Street? However, I never expected for this trendy place to have excellent authentic Mexican cuisine, and maybe they don't because I wasn't going to find out. Haha! I ordered the chorizo macho nachos and they were much better than I expected. This appetizer that's big enough to fill you up comes out on a lifted pizza tray and rather than being filled to the brim with an absurd amount of cheese, everything is right there baked to perfection with all ingredients in moderate proportions. Not your typical nachos but just right. And boy do they taste good. Not sure if this is only on the lunch menu or what but it's a super safe pick that you won't regret. I'm too picky to pay a lot of money for just any tacos so I veer away when in doubt.

The service was pretty good. When we arrived at about 12:15 pm they said it was a 30 minute wait and I was prepared to go across the street to Barbuzzo or Lolita's before they gave us the option to be seated immediately outside. They promptly offered us suggestions from the extensive drink menu. I would definitely come to the bar here just for drinks. I got the guava mojito, just the right amount of liquor in it. Watch out though, it might creep up on you. 

Will try an entree here sooner or later but it does seem to be a bit pricey at dinner time so we'll see if it can match the Macho Nachos.
name: Nate

text: You can never go wrong with a good happy hour plus it is black owned. Crab claws with a shot of Crown to wash it all down. Them claws got a 10/10 from me. Make sure y'all check them out!

It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Would return. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The whole meal felt kinda uneven.
