text: My friend liked it more than I did. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Price felt a touch high for what it was. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. For the price I expected more than this. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text: This is my second time going here within the ball park area, and both times have been pretty poor experiences. My first time, we were the only ones in the restaurant, with the second time being packed. Both times, service was horrible, having to wait 15+ Minutes each time to be able to grab a waitress or bartender for assistance. The sashimi and sushi combination was horrible, tasting fishy, poorly cut with tough spots and overall gross. The second time around, I fell back to a rice bowl, that was covered in way too much oil. In addition, extremely over priced. Expect to pay almost a $100 for two. Would not recommend.
name: Chad

text: We just had Breakfast here and Laxmi was such a joy to have as a waitress. She started our day the best way possible.  Thank you Laxmi
name: Allison

text: Hey, what's not to like about this place! Great made to order sandwiches and salads. Every order is a delicious surprise. And a soda fountain with real sugar cane flavors. I eat here often for lunch.
name: Matthew

text: Veggie pho is my favorite dish on the menu! Their spring rolls and fish sauce is also a must! Cool, chill atmosphere. Very modern decorations and friendly staff.
name: Paola

text: Really delicious vegan soul food! As a vegan chef I am always looking for a good place to eat out to treat myself and have a break. I had the Soulchik hot plate, which is vegan hot chikn, collards, mac n cheese, home fries, a roll and ranch. The chikn was full of amazing flavors, the Mac n cheese was creamy and yummy, and everything was well made. The owner is very friendly and it was a positive experience. I recommend this place to everyone. Bring your carnivore friends and blow their minds!
name: Anneli

text:
The Columbia is an institution. It's historic, multi-generation and, growing up in Tampa, a household name. But boy o' boy has it gone down hill. 

We did a family birthday lunch here today...
Firstly, service was incredibly slow. Over an hour for food, with little to no information from the waitress other than 'the kitchen is a mess today'. The manager came by with the same rhetoric, no reasoning just a shoulder shrug. 

My sister and I both ordered black bean soup, it was ice cold. We sent it back, they literally microwaved it (raw onions included) and brought back messy cups. The soup was still cold. 

After an hour and a half, our salads came. They come in big communal bowls and are mixed and served table side. Can you believe it took this long to make the salad in front of us? The waitress haphazardly mixed and served the salad, lettuce was everywhere. It was sloppy and unappetizing. 
The veggies weren't fresh, it felt like it was all chopped the night before. Everyone's portion and toppings were inconsistent. WAY to expensive for this non-sense. It's a $14 iceberg salad. 

All the other food was lackluster, the plantains, empanadas, sandwiches....nothing exciting to share 

We were so frustrated we didn't even have a birthday dessert for the birthday girl. 

It's really incredible how dramatically the quality has declined at the Columbia. 

This third-generation is really letting it slip and it's pretty sad the place is flooded with tourists getting a less than stellar experience on Tampa's culture and historical food.
name: Kt

text: This location isn't as popular as the main location on Woodland Avenue, but their food is just as good. Less customers here so the wait time for food is slightly longer. The portions of food are enormous!!! I love it. I love their goat platter, and also their cassava leaf. Never any complaints with their food. If you've never had African food before, certain food dishes tend to be very spicy. So make sure you have some water or something else to drink. Great restaurant
name: JC

text: The pancakes were good and so were the homemade fries. The eggs were terrible. Nice little joint, it's small so not too many people fit inside. It was a little pricey for what we ordered but overall it was okay, wouldn't come again tho.
name: Amanda

text: I ordered the kids meal during a lay over in Denver at the airport! After they got the order correct, it was a yummy filling burger with all the trimmings ( you have to ask for a child's burger) and the fries were seasoned well. Would order again!
name: Elisabeth

text: So delicious and worth every penny! I'm glad I was able to eat at this place one last time before I left Tucson. Feast is a must while in Tucson, but make sure to check out the menu online beforehand if you have allergies or you're a picky eater as they have a limited menu that's always changing. They do accommodate allergies if you ask them. Scallop tacos delicious and the moods of chicken also very good! You won't be disappointed!
name: Kayla

text: This is the best breakfast I have ever had. My girlfriend and I went on vacation to Clearwater from Fort Lauderdale and we decided to come here, hearing about them from down south. Our server, Lisa, was quick, made great recommendations and offered us seating wherever we wanted. Everybody should know about this place. I ordered the Traditional eggs scrambled and my girlfriend got the Floridian omelet. Both were fantastic
name: Mason

text: The Pad Thai is delicious every time I order, it can seem a little pricey around $10 lunch special and around $15 for a dinner portion but the lunch size was enough with soup and rangoons for me to get 2 lunches out of it  I highly recommend Pearl Cafe
name: Catlynn

text: An all time family favorite ! Love their pizza and they recently renovated the front of the restaurant. Definitely worth checking out !!
name: Nick

text: Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Food was fresh and service was quick. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text: Just as fabulous as the Datz in Tampa.  They have a brunch menu all day on Sundays.  We had the short rib Benedict which was amazing.  Also a coffee drink with a powdered donut in the drink.  Ah-may-zing.  Def a great spot for dinner before a show at jannus.
name: Cassandra

text:
Fair amount of selection is offered on a regular basis to satisfy our cravings for the succulent, brinysweet and pristine oysters every time we drop in. My favorite from OH is the kusshi, the tiny buttery choice from Canada and one that bears close similarity to the kumamoto. The service was impressively efficient and brisk,(not to be taken for granted at an oyster joint), as it's always bustling here on Saturdays. 

We were happy with the oyster choices: swan point, stormy bay, pebble beach, wellfleet and the kusshi. Scallop cerviche was balanced: low on citrus and tender but served at a temperature that emphasized the wrong things in the dish. The scallops came across ripe and fleshy, slimy and warm. Especially jarring after the oysters. Grilled Salmon salad was solid and a bit bland, as though the ingredients needed longer marinating in the Tahini dressing. Overall, a good meal, but I have to say just go for the oysters.
name: Jin

text: Love this place....drinks & food always on point!I been here a few times & I am very impressed everytime!
name: Tina

text: I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Food was fresh and service was quick. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Not bad for a quick meal. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Nice little spot, decent portions too.
name: User

text: The fries were prob the best part of the meal, honestly. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Not a bad stop, just not one I'm rushing to repeat.
name: User

text: Ordered takeout because I didn't feel like cooking and it held up okay. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. I left full, which at least counts for something. It looked better online than it did in person. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: Food is worth the wait. Not a fan of the line it creates outside which I believe it is just for show and completely unnecessary.
name: Tomas

text: The waiter gave great service and the food was good. I had the San Fran Wings and the Steak and Street Corn Tacos. Both were awesome. The accordian style window walls that open up were great features to have on such a nice day. Very impressive lunch. Thanks, will be back.
name: Roger

text:
Eat here. Do it. 

An absolutely phenomenal gluten-free Italian meal. The service is exceptional and the food is unbelievable.

I'm not kidding. Eat here. Do it.
name: Ashley

text: Hubby and I went to Culvers in Plainfield today - our first time to eat at a Culvers.  We went because of getting a BOGO for a Deluxe Double Cheeseburger (found in the Icon Hendricks County paper).  So glad we went.  The burger beat our usual favorites of Five Guys & Steak & Shake.  At $5 it is cheaper than Five Guys (just as good or maybe little better), but more costly than Steak & Shake (which also includes fries but is no comparison in flavor & size).  In our opinions, Culvers' burger had the best flavor - yummy!  (Can't compare to the other fast food places because we don't eat at those.)  We didn't get fries so we would have room for custard.  We got a Concrete Mixer with Reese's Peanut Butter & Cookie Dough - very good - much better than DQ, plus we got chocolate custard - DQ only has vanilla ice milk.  Might be cheaper than DQ, not sure - about $5 for regular size with 2 mixins - I think DQ is about $7, not sure.  Don't think Culvers' custard beats Frost Bite in Avon though - difference is at Frost Bite the peanut butter cups aren't chopped as fine, which we prefer.  We arrived about 11:30am (Tues) & no wait to order.  We ordered at the counter & our food was brought to our table.  Employees extremely friendly (but not bothersome so) & helpful with us as first-timers.  The restaurant was clean, temp comfortable, plenty of parking.  Drinks are self service - we got water which is free of course - not to be cheap, just that's all we drink.  We definitely have put Culvers on our frequent dine-out spots.
name: Julie

text: My wife and I went for lunch and enjoyed our food and service. Had the BBQ shrimp, crab cake, and steak. Loved the apps and meal and thought the service was outstanding. Looking forward to our next visit.
name: Darren

text:
An ok option for breakfast. They serve a lot of options outside of the normal pancakes and scrambled eggs. The fresh squeezed juice is AMAZING, but the food was just eh...my husband ordered eggs Benedict and it was room temp, like his dish was waiting awhile for my order to finish. I got the Mediterranean baked eggs. I had to add hot sauce for flavoring. It tasted just like stewed tomatoes and unseasoned chicken. The over-easy egg yolk saved it a bit. There were other items in the menu that sounded really good so I would give it another shot. They may have just had an off day. 

Oh....we asked for plastic cups for our water because the ones on the table were left there from the last guest that didn't use it. They were covered in some dirt and fingerprints.
name: Lauren

text: Let me just say if I could give this place 6 stars I would.!!  We live in the neighborhood and consider ourselves lucky that it's only a few minutes from our place.  The food is always amazing - fresh, authentic, and most importantly consistent.  The prices are insanely good for the quality you get and the staff is always polite and friendly.
name: Alex

text: Enjoyed an amazing dinner here at Little Kitchen a few nights ago. The had a special on Carnitas which were delicious and my girl had the fig burger which was also very tasty! The service and interaction by the staff was nice and I would highly recommend coming to Little Kitchen if you have not tried it before! Definitely one of my favorite little places in Santa Barbara!
name: Ed

text:
Tried several pies the other night, and I'd say the quality of our food was solid. Unfortunately, the quantity wasn't up to my standards for the price (~$18) per pizza, which is smaller than a typical medium pizza elsewhere.

While the flatbread style was crispy and tasty, several of the pizzas lacked enough ingredients to fill up the pies, so we thought we were getting skimped on a bit.

The actual restaurant environment seats about 35-50 people only, so try to avoid a Friday evening. They can get quite crowded and do not take reservations. So, keep that in mind if you've got a group larger than a typical table size or willing to sit at a bar.
name: Garrett

text: We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. Pretty happy with it overall. It looked better online than it did in person. The whole meal felt kind of uneven.
name: User

text:
Hathorne pleasantly floats by the new, trendy, and underwhelming restaurants in the Sea of Nashville. After going to Catbird Seat a few weeks ago and our weekend routine of trying new spots I'm on a mission to tell all about Hathorne. You can see the passion and dedication of the owner in each dish. If you're trying to decide on a spot, stop looking. Hathorne is it. 

Atmosphere A+
Food A+
Service A+
name: Ian

text: On a four day trip to NO and we have had 3 meals a day each from a different local establishment, and this was by far the best. The service was impeccable - friendly, fast and cheerful. Food was sublime. Complex flavors and proper portions at a fair price. I had the baked Drum and it was by far, the best fish dish I have ever had. Highly recommended!
name: Tyler

text: For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. For the price I expected more than this. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh.
name: User

text:
Only Chinese restaurant I'll order from! They're always nice, food is always on time and it tastes fantastic. 
Last time I ordered and forgot to take the lock off my card and I forgot to change my number on the account (online ordering), so they drove to my house just to tell me it wasn't going through! 
They really go the extra mile.
name: Andy

text: It's an okay place. The food was average, nothing fantastic, and everything is way overpriced. I had a simple egg breakfast for around $10, and it only came with a single slice of toast--and was told they'd charge me extra for an additional slice. Overall, a mediocre experience.
name: Marie

text:
My first visit on a Tuesday night for a $5 Classic pie. That's pizza for you West Coasters. I had a coupon so I had to try it.

Made in front of me, a classic cheese pizza. Wood fire cooked came out hot and delicious. It had a very traditional NY taste. I paired it with a small Cesar salad that came with garlic bread cut like small pizza slices. Nice touch.

Staff was fantastic,  friendly and explained the cooking process.

I joined the club so I earn points and coupons. It texts the info to your phone 

I will be back to try a custom pizza. Go check out My Pie.
name: Barbara

text: This is my favorite place on mass ave. Their wine is affordable and delicious. They have a red, white, and rose flight and each one is perfect. I have tried all the flights and have loved each and every wine I have tried. They also serves small plates (my favorite is the warm bread and oil) that are perfect to go with wine.
name: Danielle

text: Always a pleasure coming here. Probably will be back next week! Favorite brunch place in STL!
name: Andrea

text:
The sushi was trustworthy, the service was very friendly. 
I had the all you can eat! 
The salmon skin hand roll was tasty. Definitely a great place for large party!
name: Matthew

text: I'm still twisting! Some things are worth the fat but seriously these tiny filling morsels are very diet friendly!!  Oh these wings ! The chickens must have come direct from heaven cancel that flight to Chi-town and enjoy a new local favorite! Get one free Mozarella  stick if you mention Yelp!

text: I can see why people love it here. The place is huge. Attentive wait staff and the food was well sized portions. I ordered the catfish po boy and gumbo. Great choice and definitely order ahead for fast pick up.
name: Shanel

text: The food is amazing! Lots vegetarian/Vegan options. Seafood options are good as well. Homemade seitan is amazing!!!! Def try this place if you haven't!
name: Daniel

text: Really good wines and service. Came here with a group and we had a great time and a great server. This is a fun group activity and so close to many places in downtown for an after dinner treatment.
name: Ashlee

text: Mmmm! Love this place. Lots of pretzel choices & they are always hot & fresh. Sometimes you have to wait for items to be cooked but they never take long. Great customer service & the lemonade is the BOMB!! SO GOOD!
name: Dubbl R

text: One of those meals where nothing is exactly wrong but you're not excited either. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. It was crowded but still moved along. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: This restaurant Is a little gem and could easily be missed from the main road.  Friendly service and very clean.  I had the chicken quesadillas, lightly grilled and very good.  Also, the burritos are also very tasty.  Salsa is fresh and delicious.  Definitely will return.
name: Jane

text:
Rarely one restaurant can excel both in Japanese AND Vietnamese dishes. Hai's is one of those rare ones.  The sushi is top grade that would rival top Japanese restaurants. Certain the likes of Virago don't even come close. 

The Pho is awesome! It tastes great AND has incredible aroma!  They also offer the more rare noodle soup dish Hui Tieu. It is also delicious!

The staff is super friendly and the price is right. 

Go and have a great time with your friends or make new friends at the bar.
name: Richard

text: The place is beautiful and the staff is super nice. Food was average. Nothing special about their menu. Prices are higher than average.
name: Judith

text: I guess this place is selective in who they want to serve. Party of 10--wanted to sit and have a few drinks at 2 tables that were unoccupied (40 minutes later, still empty). Waitress told us we couldn't sit there to just have drinks, but how did they know we wouldn't have decided to order food after a few beverages?? Waitress told us to leave, it was very unprofessional. They lost out on over $100.
name: Brilyn

text: These people really know what they are doing! So far the best patisserie in USA - especially for the tiramisu, peach, red velvet etc, they ran out of macaroons which I heard were too good here, definitely going to come here often though!
name: Gauthami

text: This place was soo good, food and drinks were good, service was excellent. The prices were very good due to the amount of food they gave, I would expect to be paying more, not complaining but giving a complement. I was full for serval hours. 5 star meal! Flavorful and tasty.
name: Tay

text: It was very very good! I had some bad, pricey Mexican last night. So I had to do a redo today. Hit the spot. I had carnitas, pollo, and carne asada tacos, and the flautas. The tacos were delicious! The flautas were ok! The chicken could have used a little more flavor.  But they were good. The tacos were $3 a piece, with I thought was a good price
name: Latoya

text: The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Food was fresh and service was quick. The music was louder than it needed to be. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Worth checking out. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: The most amazing food and customer service we've had in Tampa Bay Area!! We got two platters because we couldn't decide what we most wanted to try. The mousaka, beet hummus, and daily special (crack wheat and butter beans) were our favorites, but to be honest ALL of the food was so delicious. The owner, Mouna, is so sweet and very personable. We will be coming here again!
name: Jensen

text: Just ate my turkey gobbler with the roll. Its so good with the soggy roll. Its like the best diner without going out. Sooo good.
name: Alene

text: Loved the bloody mary mix!. I had the fish tacos, while the fish wasn't very flavorful, the meal was very good. Get the beans as they are unique, with a hint of barbeque sauce. Wife had the greek salad and was impressed with the quality of the feta (melt in your mouth). Décor is classic surf theme. Server was excellent. We will be back for the burgers.
name: Dnainsb

text:
The food and cocktails definitely exceeded my expectations.

Our group ordered stuffed grape leaves, charred carrot hummus, and two orders of the croquettes. All three of these were flavorful and served beautifully. I was also quite hooked on the Cap Spartel cocktail which had a fresh carrot juice element to it. 

Space was bright and lively and you could tell people were excited to be there for the first time. My only discomfort was with a few interactions I had with the staff. It felt hit or miss which I sensed as well from other comments left here. 

When we first sat down, it was a nice touch that our first bartender shook our hands and formally introduced himself. The gentleman juicing the lemons was also great - he made conversation with our group and was super friendly. 

However after we ordered our first round, I asked whether we could hold onto a menu since there were three of us and we planned to order more food and drinks. Rather than allow it, he said he would give us a menu later on should we need it again. I'm sure there is something practical behind his response and definitely not a big deal but I've never had that happen - it made us assume they must have a shortage of menus.

Another odd interaction requires brief context. There were quite a few people behind the bar which was awesome in the sense that there was always a friendly face making sure you had everything you need. This also meant that there were multiple people asking you the same exact questions. 

I had expressed to two different people that I was fine to keep my plate/silverware because though my friends were done ordering, I had more food on the way. Then a third human I had not yet encountered started pulling my plate without a word. I was startled because the plate was so close to my arm and when I turned I really nicely smiled and explained that I had ordered more food and didn't want them to have to waste another plate on me. He then lifted his hands in the air in a surrendering way and started walking backwards with a really sarcastic face as if I had just snapped at him. 

Anyways, the food and beverages are great and I think once everything and everyone fall into place, it will be a go to spot for many.
name: Ariana

text: This place is a hidden gem! Quaint but really lovely. We went Saturday around 10 am and it was pretty busy, but we didn't wait. Ordered the cinnamon raisin French toast and it was amazing! Friendly staff, wish it wasn't so busy but I know why it is. I will be back and this time with more people!
name: Jules

text: Went for endless shrimp on a Tuesday night and When you first walk in there's an awful odor. We were seated quickly and our waiter was very nice but so slow. It took us 10 minutes to get drinks and we had to ask for bread and then another 10-15 minutes to even get our salad. The shrimp Alfredo had no flavor and the shrimp was most likely small bagged shrimp and the sesame shrimp on a stick was cold. And the fiesta shrimp is also disappointing. It was hand breaded shrimp tossed on a plate with pico de gallo and this cheese whiz thing on top. I haven't been there in 5+ years. And I don't think I would ever go back to red lobster. The quality has just gone down a lot. Very disappointing.
name: Rubi

text: Food was pretty good. Tapas were way overpriced for what they were. Service was what really disappointed us. When we walked up to the host stand there were three girls standing there chatting and it took a while for one of them to notice us. We were then seated inside with a nice view of the water. Our server, Sara, started out okay but near the end of our meal as we waited for our check she disappeared and didn't acknowledge our table for 15 minutes ( even walked by us once and didn't even look at the table to see that we were clearly finished). In my opinion not worth returning to, especially for how much we paid for a lackluster experience.
name: Paige

text:
Best breakfast in town!

We love The Brick House!! The new location is a lot bigger than where they started out, so they can accommodate the larger customer base that craves their food! 

We come here probably every Sunday for breakfast and are never disappointed! 

I normally order the western omelet. They PACK these omelets full, so you get filling in every bite! You get a choice of hash browns, home fries, or grits, and toast or a biscuit. Personally, I prefer the hash browns over the home fries. 

Coming in at a close second, is the 2 egg breakfast with corned beef hash. One of my FAVORITES!! You get the same choices listed above with that. 

They have a yummy kids menu, and the kid pancakes are shaped like Mickey! They're really yummy pancakes, too! 

My only complaint is that they have fresh fruit listed on the menu, but it isn't fresh. It's like from a jar, so don't order that. 

If you get there before crowds, you can walk in and sit where you like. Though they do have a hostess if you're not comfortable with seating yourself. 
At busy times, you need to put your name on the list so you're in line to be seated. 

They have a long bench and rocking chair inside for waiting, and also some rockers outside as well as another bench. 

They have most of the same people working there as from the old place, and they are all sweet as pie. They do get very busy, but we have never waited longer than 15 min I think.
name: Becky

text:
I love barbecue and I love sides. I'm indecisive and my appetite is a black hole. I love sauces and condiments and I also am a harsh critic when it comes to expensive, slow-cooked, smoked, barbecued meat, especially when you have to wait in line to eat it.

Martin's provides good barbecue, delicious sides, and larger plates with enough options to get a little bit of everything so you can have a taste of it all if you're with a group of overeat if you're taking on a solo meat challenge. Each of their sauces is individually worthwhile and the line moves quickly enough to keep you satisfied with your decision to stop in.

I came with a pretty large group, and we were fortunate to find a comfortable spot to sit and watch some TV while we stuffed our faces. I was satisfied with the food and the experience. It wasn't the best barbecue I've ever had, but it was a great attraction while in Nashville.
name: Joseph

text: This place is legit...We got the seafood extravaganza,  Dat Chicken Plate, and the Bourbon Street Love. All three were delicious.  The sweet tea was on time and the service was really good. We were even greeted by the kitchen staff.  I really like the ambiance of the dining room. Takes me back to 1970s New Orleans. I could hear the Seafood City Commercial song in the back of my mind. The dining room had a fresh coat of paint and was very clean. I'll definitely be back. I can't recommend this place enough for really good New Orleans food.
name: Ryan

text:
Royal India is home to the tastiest Indian food in Reno! To me, it feels like I am walking into someone's kitchen when I arrive. The staff are so friendly and welcoming and the service is awesome. As soon as we sit down someone is there to greet us. I love that! 

I typically will go with one or two others for their lunch buffet. What I love about the lunch buffet is that they are always switching out the dishes, but they also always have the same top picks for returning customers. They have the thali trays so you can try many different types of curries and sauces. The food at the buffet has been fresh and hot every time I have come in, and I have arrived at varying times of the day. 

My favorite dish they have at the buffet is the Chicken tiki masala. It is so flavorful, creamy, and the chicken is moist. The naan is served fresh and the chai tea is a perfect cap for a delicious meal. 

Thank you, Royal India! You have filled many Sunday afternoons with great memories for my family and I!
name: Ashlee

text: I ordered thw BOOM BOOM shrimp... it was just the right size for a first quick eats to start our vaca.  Husband got the chargrilled oysters and he enjoyed them as well.
name: Vicki

text:
This is seriously one of my favorite places to get pizza for several reasons. 1. BOTH of my kids can usually agree to come here without much arguing. 2. It's quick, easy and convenient. 3. You can build your own. 4. Last but not least, it's actually really good.  
My kids only like sausage and cheese on their pizzas so it's always nice to for everyone to get exactly what they like even me!
name: Sheila

text:
Ping Pong is on another level. Please don't refer to this restaurant as a "Chinese" restaurant. This is authentic Szechuan done to perfection. 

My favorite dishes are the fish dishes, hot pots, hot sauce, stewed fish, and country style. 

BYOB restaurant, so bring your favorite wine or cocktail, and enjoy the night.
name: Mike

text:
Came here on a recommendation. Gaul & Co. sits on the corner in a mostly residential neighborhood. Very typical pub atmosphere inside. Comfortable with nice upbeat music. They have about 8 beer taps, many bottles and can to choose from. There are 3 large televisions to watch our favorite Philadelphia teams. This place is small enough, mostly bar seating. 
Very good selection of food specials in addition to the regular menu. 
I chose the Italian sandwich. Consist of a breaded chicken cutlet; Includes roasted red peppers, provolone, broccoli rabe. Very nice. 
The bartender was beautiful and also very polite and pleasant. 
Glad I stopped in.
name: Ray

text: me personally, i loved it- the baked chicken was delicious, the strawberry waffle was the jawn, the yams and mac & cheese was like home- and tht butter had me like whoa!!!!  the hostess, she was on point too, she got what she deserved #nicetip-   wifey/ me & the kids said this is our place to go on weekends-  keep bangin maxines- see you soon

text: This place has the most amazing baked goodies!!! We went as a group of 4 and got a little bit of everything to share. Nothing disappointed us. text:
There are moments in time when change is long overdue ... change is necessary ... and change is good.  All three of those realities apply to this long established and perhaps worn in the tooth (Ok, I really don't know what that means but it sounds good when referring to an eating establishment.) diner on a challenging New Jersey traffic circle.

The difference is palatable as you walk in to see the new owner greeting customers with his trademark smile.  The diner is sparkling clean and inviting but it is also spacious so a busy Sunday after church crowd didn't threaten to make you feel closed in.  Glancing around you can't help but notice an "army" of diner staff in their custom shirts ... the good news at least from the young woman serving our corner circular table (Yes, I know that is a mathematical puzzle that defies logic but it's where we were seated.) proved to be friendly, engaging, and helpful.

This 24 hour a day classic Jersey diner has one of those extensive menu's one would expect everything from breakfast to items to snack on.  Can't quite say "soup to nuts" because I didn't spot any dish with cashews, walnuts, pecans nor peanuts but perhaps they are there too.

But soup ... yes the Cream of Chicken soup (Waitress highly recommended it.) was appealing visually and the older member of our group devoured it licking her lips and just saying "very good ... very good."  I will buy that the soup was very good.

Now, I am an apprehensive salad bar visitor so before choosing one of the mini-meals that offered some appealing options plus the salad bar or soup I had to check the all you can pack in element of the diner.  This is not a salad bar to write home about because it's merely a basic salad bar but its freshness was noticeable (the red onions crunched with every bite), the dressing options were appealing, and the carrot pineapple salad had everyone's phone out googling in search of an online recipe that might replicate this totally delicious salad bar bonus item.

Now, the only complaint ... our youngest diner just wanted eggs and turkey sausage.  A basic breakfast ... two eggs and sausage.  Waitress said, we serve 3 eggs same price.  One third more ... ok, so this was a bonus not a complaint.  Where other diners skimp the new Brooklawn management gives more to its customers.

All the other meals were plentiful requiring boxes.  One person plans to take what was referred to as delicious moussaka and add it to tomorrow's eggs.  Ok, so I ate the whole meal ... no box for me but this will be my one meal of the day ... it was packed with fresh red peppers (again snap to the bite), fresh onions, good tasting Italian sausage, a yummy sauce that I sopped up with my very fresh dinner roll, and ok ... pasta that could have been more el dente for my liking but still it was firm not mushy.

For under TEN BUCKS ... a salad bar or soup, a massive meal (We chose the mini-meals I can only imagine the real meal) that will serve as other meals for all but then this truly perfectly flavored and prepared rice pudding with hints of cinnamon and a huge mountain of whipped cream.  Rice pudding in my book is either worth the calories or also I leave it for the clean up crew .  On this Sunday morning all the rice pudding bowls were cleaned to the glass.

If you are on the circle and hungry but don't turn in to this classic diner the good news is you can just keep going around the circle because it will be on your right side again.  And, it is the right choice to make.  

Check to see if the owner is in ... he'll say hi and want you to leave happy.  We certainly did!

text:
-Loaded Chicken Nachos? Barely a shred of chicken on the plate. No melted cheese, no guacamole, no sour cream and no shredded lettuce. Nothing more than clumped tortilla chips with a small dish of queso cheese and a few black beans and a dice of tomato or two. Something (or perhaps someone in the kitchen) may have been loaded but it certainly was not the nachos.
-Parmesan Crusted Chicken with Mashed Potatoes and Broccoli was even worse. Nothing crusty about the chicken. It was dry yet mushy like it had been cooked ahead of time then reheated in the microwave. And here's the best part....the mashed potatoes were INSTANT mashed potatoes. Are you kidding me Friday's? Even Boston Market does better than that.
-Cheeseburger was actually tasty and cooked to perfection but fries were cold and limp. Obviously they were cooked well ahead of the burger.
How ironic they serve actual potato fries but serve INSTANT mashed potatoes. It's apparent the fries are nothing more than the frozen ones you can get at the supermarket.
Very little value for hard-earned money.

text: Where do I begin. First, I'd highly recommend reservations because this place gets busy.  Secondly, simply put this restaurant was outstanding. The staff was friendly and informative.  We had done our research before visiting so my wife and I went in knowing what we wanted to order. After asking the servers recommendations we went in slightly different directs and we couldn't have been any happier.  For our appetizers we went with the renown cauliflower and duck confit.  I was admittedly skeptical on how good could cauliflower actually be(there are only so many ways to cook). But I was wrong, it was cooked perfectly just like many other restaurants. The difference was the side sauces. Dear lord, they bring cauliflower to life like I've never had before.  The duck confit was cooked exceptional, but again the sauces knocked it out of the world.  You'll get the trend by time I'm done this review.  For my wife and I entrees we had the venison and scallops.  The venison was cooked perfectly, but again the side flavors brought into the meal through sauces were amazing. I have eaten venison more times than I can count and this was the best.  The scallops my wife had melted in your mouth.  We've ordered them right off of boats and they weren't this good, a true testament to the chefs! Lastly we had a side of the crispy potato salad. This was probably the best I have ever had. The dressing is what really made the meal. The server referred to it as crack sauce. I believe it. We were hooked after the first bite!  We closed out our meals with the pretzel chocolate moose! With our pallets satisfied and our stomachs full, we left but will most definitely be back.  This is one restaurant I think everyone should visit while in Nashville.
name: Kyle

text:
My hubby and I had our date night here last night and we were both blown away. I can't think of a meal I've enjoyed more in St. Louis. We chose toasted ravioli for an app because - The Hill - and we were told the special which I believe was a ribeye with a balsamic butter. As a huge balsamic fan, I requested some for my bread and oh my soul. That butter was AMAZING. Apparently it's their butter of the month this month (November 2019) and I'll be back more than once this month at least for that butter. The t-ravs were sooo good. They didn't look like they'd be crispy because they were not dark but they were perfectly crisp! The meat sauce served with them was amazing as well. We could have stopped there because we were already so pleased with our meal. But we like food - so we ordered entrees. My hubby ordered a burger and said it was amazing. He got a baked potato as a side and later wished he'd gotten something else. The potato was good but with the other options, he decided he made the wrong choice (but not because anything was wrong at all.) I ordered chicken parmesan and a side of potatoes with the balsamic butter and I definitely made the right choice. The chicken parm was also perfectly crisp - the breading wasn't soggy at all () and the potatoes were perfectly cooked. I just kept eating and eating. I was thrilled we were sitting with our backs to the wall because I had to unzip my skirt a little! Hahaha

We will most definitely be back many times and especially this month with that butter. 

Oh also - the service was fabulous!! Our server was Alexa and she was so personable and attentive. She smiled, made eye contact and was engaging but didn't linger forever. Perfect service! Even the other servers were so attentive as were the bussers/serving assistants. 

This will easily become a new favorite!!

text:
I have eaten multiple times at Bertha Miranda's as my work is walking distance and their food is pretty good.  Today I couldn't even stomach sitting down after being treated so poorly be staff.  We waited at the host stand and there was quite a few people waiting to be seated for lunch (expected because of Hot August Nights).  After waiting 15-20 minutes for the parties in front of us to be seated I took a phone call from a co-worker who was asking me to order something for her to-go.  However I'd never get that chance as the host skipped over our party and seated the party behind us.  When those nice people said we had been there first she stated to them, not us, she would not seat us because I was on the phone.  We told the host when she came back that she was pretty rude which she responded by saying it didn't matter because she was going to seat us now.  I pointed out that if you make customers wait 20 minutes than you can't expect them to not take a phone call with the anticipation that she "might" come back, further my lunch partner was not on the phone and had been fully interacting with her.  The host told us that there was no way we were waiting 20 minutes, which we clearly knew was accurate because we were both on a lunch break and watching the clock closely.  When we politely said that we were just going to go somewhere else she said loudly "GOOD" and turned her back and walked away.  I've been here multiple times and there is no sign or warning that if you answer your phone while in line you will be ignored and further when you point out how rude it was to ignore us while my partner was ACTIVELY talking to you, you are told that you're wrong.
It's extremely disheartening because until today I was a regular customer which will obviously have to change.  Disappointing that anyone would talk to another human in such a rude manner, let alone a customer who has been loyal for 5+ years.
name: Denise

text: I've been Ritz Carlton member for a while and I have stayed at other Ritz locations numerous of time but so far Bacara which is part of Ritz has been the worst place I have stayed. I'm very disappointed with our experience here at Bacara. It all started from our walking in to our room and smelling strong STRONG bleach smell in the air and seeing not so clean and outdated room. Especially the balcony which had smoke ashes all over  chairs, table, floor, railing and all over. We called right away and they send someone 45 minutes later and they cleaned while we were in the room.  Because of full occupancy and not having double bed room we were promised a roll away bed. And before we went to dinner I called to make sure it will be delivered and asked for extra towels too, thinking there will be turned down service like all 5 stars resorts. But when we walked to our room after dinner the bed was shoved against the balcony door, the towels were thrown on the small table and the shower/bathroom was exactly how we left. I called the operator very upset and told the how disappointed we were and instead of sleeping and resting we had to wait someone to come to put the bed together again while we were in the room. When I went to front desk next morning and told them how disappointed our stay have been and what happened they said ooo we apologize and here is $35 credit for resort fee. Even though our spa visit  (again very outdated) was very nice including treatment and dinner at Angel Oak was good but overall experience was not. I will not be coming back here. We have stayed at Teranea resort many many times and never like this happened there before. Sorry for the long review I just had to write and get this of my chest. Thank you.

text:
The two stars are for the atmosphere and our waitress, which are about the only two things that were positive on our trip to La Roca. 
My husband and I went yesterday for restaurant week. The interior is bright and colorful, with ample seating. We were sat on the second floor overlooking Main Street. Our waitress was very attentive and made sure our drinks were consistently refilled. I also had a white sangria, which was decent. 
We waited for over an hour for our food, which made no sense for what it was. I received chicken skewers, and  two pulled chicken tacos. The tacos were quite dry. My husband got a burrito (that was $16!), which was mostly rice and very bland. 
My dessert was a tres leches cake , which tasted like stale corn bread with condensed milk thrown on it. It was very dry, which the opposite of what tres leches should be. Our bill came up to over 50 dollars, with subpar food. 
Perhaps this place is good for happy hour, but I wouldn't eat there again.

text:
After a great weekend snowshoeing and hiking, a delicious Mexican lunch hit the spot.  Going with a group of 8, they were able to accommodate us with no reservations, as we went at around 3pm on Sunday.  It started to get busier in the early evening.

I ordered a classic dish of Pozole, which I can best describe as a spicy stew/soup dating back to the Aztecs.  It is characterized by shredded meat and hominy (white savory corn).   When you get your soup, they bring a platter of lettuce, radishes, onion and chiles you can add to the soup as much or as little as you want. It is so delicious. 

As an appetizer, the table ordered a Chicharrón de Queso, which is basically the single thing you need in your life.  Unless of course you are lactose intolerant, then PLEASE avoid it if you can.  Essentially, it's just fried cheese grilled on a flat grill until it's crispy.  It's heaven on earth and in your mouth.  

Huma hit the spot on a cold day and I will be back! Often!
name: Sarah

text:
Neighborhood place, cozy, friendly.  Diverse menu and interesting specials with a full bar -both wine and beer specials.

Gets crowded early, option for tables or stalking hi-chairs around the bar.

Ordered the salmon special- grilled, swapped out their veggie prep for sautéed green beans.  Good dish.  My wife enjoyed a half order of farfalali pasta with ground tri-meat mix in a plum tomato sauce. A good fias well.

text:
Large portioned, tasty room service food! We stayed at the Logan Hotel in Philly and they offered a full menu from Urban Farmer with plenty of options for both adults AND kids.

Our dinner was very delicious. I had the market fish of the day, which was cooked perfectly. Usually room service comes overcooked and dry, but this was juicy, crispy and was a large portion with mustard potatoes and greens. We also ordered the Philly cheesesteak with a side salad (huge portion) in addition to a regular salad (gigantic portion)....the salad was AMAZING! It had fennel, mustard seeds, radish, huge shavings of carrot. It was hearty, light yet still sweet/salty/crunchy. Our kids' macaroni was a big serving (enough for three toddlers) and its side of steamed carrots was enough to feed all of us. They were bi-colored buttered carrots stacked inside a cup. 

In the morning, we ordered an egg sandwich, egg dish (scrambled eggs, with 4 pieces of huge bacon and a hash brown). The portions were really large and we were able to share as a family of four. While the coffees listed were only plain lattes and cappuccinos, we wrote in mocha and vanilla and they were able to still customize our drinks! An extra plus for super friendly staff delivering food and talking to our kids on both trips.
name: Jennifer

text: I love it here!!! My favorite is the snow pea stir fry with chicken. Service is excellent, too. You know the stereotype that Asian restaurants have rude servers? Well not at SK Noodle! Keep up the great job! We'll be back!

text:

text:
This review really makes me sad.  I love the 50's and the concept of a restored diner.  The atmosphere and ambience are all great as is the decor.  Unfortunately the food does not live up to its billing.
This was the third time my daughter and I have visited the Oasis, always hopeful that the food will be worth the relatively long drive for us.
The homemade sodas are good as are the milkshakes.
The tenderloin that we got tonight, as in the second time we visited this location, was dry and over breaded.  Not juicy, not flavorful, just dry with lots of crust.  It was very large, but when something doesn't taste very good, the size ceases to matter.
I had the catfish special -- the breading tasted just like the breading on the tenderloin.  What appeared to be a large piece of fish, ended up being a relatively small piece with bread crust on either end or an inch or two.  The cole slaw was nothing special and the fries was limp and luke warm.
The waitress was extremely slow and never did check on us once the food was out.  I can't believe how long it took to get our food-honestly, I was about ready to stick my head in the kitchen to see if anyone was there when it finally came out.
I've spoken with the owner before.  He seems to be a cool guy dedicated to making this diner idea work.  We went for breakfast the first time and it was fine - but then again, the owner was there.
For me, if we're in the area and want a homemade milkshake, we'll probably stop by but otherwise, we're crossing the place off our list of places we like to go.
If you want a really good tenderloin, I suggest you try your local American Legion-that's were I've found the best ones in Central Indiana.
name: Frank

text: Cash only for delivery. ...not everyone has cash on them. Great way to loose business.

text:
The Parkway Bakery & Tavern is a bit off the beaten path. You need to take a trolley and walk 4 or 5 blocks or take an Uber to get there, but it's worth it. 

When we asked around New Orleans and looked online for the "Best Po Boy in New Orleans," many times we saw Parkway. We had to check it out. 

I have to admit, while walking there, after getting off the trolley, I didn't know what to expect. When you get there, there's an old brick & mortar bar entrance or you can enter through the courtyard/beer garden/outdoor seating. 

The gentleman taking the orders was extremely friendly. We couldn't figure out what to get and we're going to do two small Po Boys, one fried oysters and the other fried shrimp, and the guy was nice enough to offer a large half/half for less than two smalls. He asked us about where we were from and we talked for a moment while we waited for the food. 

The inside is decorated with old newspaper clippings, signs, etc. from the area - those are the type of restaurants that's tend to scream "this will be good," the restaurants with decades of history on the walls. It shows a restaurant can not only withstand the tests of time, but thrive. 

The large Po Boy was pretty darn big. It's the type of sandwich where I'm glad that I was sharing it, because while I could've certainly finished the whole thing - and been happy, I also know that I would've been stuffed. 

The bread had a nice crunch when biting in, but was also airy. It was firm enough to hold its composure despite a mountain of fried seafood, but soft enough to be the right vessel for the job. The oysters and shrimp were overflowing out of the sandwich. It was just as much a Po Boy as it was a Po Boy with a side of friend oysters and shrimp too. There's also a sauce bar in the middle of the dining room area where you can find different mayonnaise and aioli mixtures. 

There was some confusion on our side though. We asked, or that we asked, for fried pickles and we got French fries. We didn't take it back though. The fries were okay, nothing special. I wouldn't order them again, but wouldn't not eat them either. I bet the fried pickles were good though!

Do yourself a favor too and get a bottle of root beer. It's a nice drink to go with a delicious sandwich. 

I would definitely make it a point to come back anytime I'm in New Orleans. Next time I'll get my fried pickles.
name: Richard

text:
Visiting New Orleans from Portland, OR, where we take our vegan brunch VERY seriously...but Nola Vegan put my snobbery to shame. Scramble was yummy, and the grits were something I could never get in Portland, but the best was the Chick-Un and Waffles. This is the most convincing vegan fried chicken I've ever had! Next time I'm in town, I wanna get something off the main lunch menu.

As others mentioned, the space is bright and clean, and the music is good too...sad to see it so deserted on a Saturday morning, but that might have been because it was two days after Thanksgiving. Staff was quick and friendly. The cook, who I think might have been the owner, even shared an "experimental" new cookie recipe with us. Another review mentioned that there was no coffee, and that was still true when we went, but she mentioned they're in the process of choosing the best blend.

text:
I am getting into a cleaner eating lifestyle but going out and eating is always tricky. Enter Fresh Kitchen and all my worries went away! You cannot pick something that isn't healthy or good for you! Yea the bbq is probably the worst option (calorie wise!) but it's so damn good! Lol luckily the serving is just enough to not feel guilty ordering it lol! 
In the past 2 weeks I've gone 3 times and it gets better every time! 
For those just getting into healthy eating, this is a great place to experiment with veggies! I'm serious!! Cauliflower mash?! Sounds weird, but unbelievably delicious! Sweet potato noodles?! Weirdly translucent, but again delicious! Even better when they're warm! Flavor here is in the air. The chicken is moist and the veggies are all delicious. They do offer sauces but I find it almost unnecessary to add in since everything taste so good already. Plus it's probably an easy way to save a few calories too! I also really like the bowls, they are recyclable cardboard and they offer Togo tops! Easily fit into a microwave at work! Can't wait for my next trip

text: Came here on taco Tuesday and the service was very good! I got the mango margarita this time in a monster to share with friends and it was super yummy. I highly recommend the mango one over the strawberry margarita. The monster can also be shared with 4-5 people as it's pretty big and the tequila in the margarita is definitely strong. So the tacos, it's one dollar and usually comes top with cilantro and onions. The ones I usually get is the el pastor (pork) and carne Asada (steak) which I both highllly recommend getting if you love spicy (el pastor) or very savory (carne asada). I also got the tinga chicken tacos (spicy sauce chicken) which wasn't my fav as the seasoning and flavor just wasn't there for me- just quite too salty for my liking. Overall, I would recommend this place for a quick and cheap eat on Tuesdays!
name: Jessica

text:
I first came to this place in early summer, and instantly loved it. The decor stood out from the beginning - a wall made of cork, decorative air plants, a chandelier with moss, penny tile backsplash on a bright bar. They truly nailed the marriage between theme and style.

The first time I came in was for Sunday brunch earlier in the summer. I had the wagyu beef, my boyfriend had the burger. Both were fantastic. And those fries? I mean, not even fair. Outstanding. We loved that they offer bottomless mimosas and a make-your-own Bloody Mary bar - and one that includes less common pickled ingredients as well as uncommon flavors for the base of your Bloody (one was beet, I went with one that was orange in color). Service was great - our server was a young guy with a raspy voice, who was incredibly attentive throughout the meal, and in good spirits. The manager came and spoke with us for a bit as well. We left loving our experience, and excited to come back.

Finally made it back in for date night tonight. We had a few small plates and sides, as well as some drinks. I enjoyed my Brown Butter Old Fashioned, bae was thrilled about the Sonoma Pinot. The Blue Crab Pasta was definitely a standout, as were those damn French Fries. Our server was fantastic - tall bearded guy, with the world's best laugh - even if he refused to admit that they're clearly adding crack to the fries. (He swore it was dill and salt.)

This place really gets it right. Wowing us two times in a row isn't always easy, but DTB managed to do so in a way that makes it clear that this is normal for them. Cannot wait to come back.
name: Gerardo

text:
We were looking for a quick pizza. Came into here and was rewarded with a pretty good meal. My wife and I both had the meatballs. I would rate them 8.5 on a scale of 10. They were very good. You get three and with the Parmesan on the table, a good way to start the meal. 
I had the 12" pizza, which is the size of all their pizzas. I ordered sausage, onion, and mushroom pizza with red sauce and cheese. I would would give it a 8.5 for speed of service. I would give it a 6.8 for taste. Nice pie. Crust was a little fluffy. 
I'll come back for a quick meal.

text: Normally I would give PF Chang's a 5 star review because everytime I've been it's incredible. Delicious food and great service. However, my most recent visit was disappointing. Even though the food was great in the end, there were many mistakes in our orders. There seem to be a lack of communication between the kitchen and server....the manager even came by to help correct everything which was nice but still frustrating. It should not have been so hard to serve a party of 6 on a Monday night.

text:
I visited this cute spot during a short visit to Philly. I have nothing but great things to say about this family-owned restaurant. 

Atmosphere: There is a ton of space inside of the restaurant for families and groups to escape the bustle of Old City. The facilities are incredibly clean as well. There is ample seating outdoors and definitely recommend sitting outside on a sunny day!

Customer service: The cooks and staff were incredibly courteous and gave me suggestions on what to eat because honestly, there are a LOT of options for food and drink.

Food: I had the cheeseburger and wow--so good. I was surprised by how amazing the quality of ingredients were and will definitely come back for that burger. You can customize the ingredients as well! As for drinks there is a wonderful selection of beer, wine, and soft drinks. 

5 stars and will come again :)

text: With a name like theirs, you'd think this review would be about daiquiris...but you'd be wrong. I'm writing today to say how much WE LOVE the Big Easy's Bloody Mary. No lie. text:
This place has really good potential. It rubbed me the wrong way upon first arrival. After getting off the elevator there was a male employee there that was angry about something. He was cussing and complaining about the customers saying, "why come to the beach if you're afraid to get wet!" There was a slight sprinkle going on when we visited so we're thinking maybe people were complaining about the chairs being wet, we weren't sure. 

Anyway we go outside to the bar and the bartenders were nice. They have a menu section that serves Cruzan rum and the drinks were $7. Which really isn't a bad deal. We got drinks and proceeded to sit down in a tall table section that overlooked Clearwater. The view was great and the drink was "ok" but we didn't expect much for the price so we were fine with them. The biggest drawback of the whole place was that they allow smoking. There was two sets of customers that were chain smokers and once one set was finished another set would begin. It was entirely too much so it caused us to cut our stay short.

I was a little apprehensive with our seat, sitting at a long table with another party, separated by some greenery, but that did not even matter! text:
First I'll start with the property. Beautiful scenery and well maintained grounds. Rooms are nice but nothing exceptional. Mattresses are a bid firm, harder than I like. 
The service is mediocre. As a Marriotta Titanium Elite Bonvoy member, I thought I'd get a little special treatment. No rooms upgrades on a Weds/ Thursday? Hmmm. Wasn't even acknowledged. Ate breakfast at the Bistro 2 mornings. Service was slow. Had to chase down our servers both days. Cocktails took 10+ minutes to be delivered. Also ate at the bar. Waiter got my order wrong. Completely wrong item. Said we can just keep and he would bring my original item. The incorrect item was so salty it was inedible. It's very surprising how slow and inattentive the service is given the room prices and it being a Ritz. Not worth the price.

text: I love chick fil a, cane today dined in and a man named Joe walked around constantly and made sure everyone dining in was taken care of and asked if we needed anything. Sweet guy, really appreciated that.

text:
If I could give no stars I would... everything about our dinner was awful. First, we stood at the host stand for 3-4 minutes before another patron told us that she had waited 8 minutes and finally had to go to the bar to be seated. We had to do the same. We were seated and our drink order was taken. Then, after a longer wait than normal, we finally had to tell our server that we wanted to order - he wasn't prepared to take our order on his own. 

We ordered the pierogies, a cheesesteak, and a side of Mac n cheese. We were both finished with our meals before the Mac n cheese came out, and it was only brought out after we had asked our server for it twice, and finally asked another server a third time. Then, the server that brought it out didn't even apologize, simply said "I'm not sure what took so long..." 

When our waiter finally came back to our table, my husband ordered another beer, and when the beer was dropped off, our server left the table before we could even open our mouths to tell him that it was the wrong beer, he was gone. Once again, we had to ask another server for the correct beer. 

Finally, when our server stopped by our table, we asked for the check, which we waited almost 5 minutes to get - we had our cards ready and gave them to him right away, without even looking at the bill. In a span of  TWENTY minutes there were  five empty-handed trips from the server to the section we were sitting in, all without our bill. I flagged him down twice and both times he held up a finger as if to say "hold on"... only he did that twice. And after twenty minutes, he finally came back to our table.... with another bill... not our cards. At this point I was beyond upset, as it's really concerning to not know where your credit card is for 20 minutes. 

I went inside to speak to a manager, who was understanding of our concern and frustration. But when she asked the server where our bill was, as she was offering to comp the price for our excessive wait, the server said he didn't know where it was! He literally had to look all around the entire bar to find it, and found it on the edge of the pool table, near the servers station, where it had been sitting unattended for probably the entire 20 minutes that we waited. 

After all of that, we were comped for our $6 side of Mac m cheese and for our three beers, which given the fact that our dinner took over two hours and made us miss the rest of the plans we had for that evening, didn't really make up for it. 

Food was mediocre. Beer wasn't great. And the service was the worst I've ever had.
name: Melinda

text: Went with family on a Sunday and it was louder than I expected. For the price I expected more than this. So yeah, it looked better online than it did in person. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Food was fresh and service was quick.

text:
If you're like me, you love trying trendy new places. As soon as I saw No Vacancy pop up on Instagram, I had to try it. Luckily it was my friends birthday and she planned a Sunday brunch there.

I live in Tampa so it was a far drive , but I don't mind the drive if the location is worth it. We finally got there and it was pretty easy to find. The loud music kind of led us to the right spot. It was definitely much smaller than I thought it would be. It just looked a lot bigger in social media pictures. Still really cute though , and had to take a lot of pictures! 

I had my first drink , it honestly wasn't that good. It looked good but it was watered down with all of the ice in my cup. I decided to do the $20 bottomless mimosas because that would probably give me lore for my money. They fill your glass with champagne and they have a table with all different juices and fruits to put in your glass. I chose pineapple juice and strawberries. If you're a Bloody Mary fan they had a bar for that too. 

The only complaint I really have was that it was small and cramped and it was so hot! Which wasn't their fault , it's the Florida heat. I'd definitely sit inside next time. I'd probably try their fish bowls next time too! They are $60 but it's for up to 4 people. They also have half off fish bowls and appetizers on Thursday's for happy hour.


I will definitely be back to try some more drinks!!!

text:

text: We found this place after watching the Krewe des Vieux parade, and we lucky to arrive with almost no wait for food or a table.   Loved the cauliflower pizza and the delicious salads with a bottle of Montepulciano, a good buy at $20 for the bottle!  Got a couple of slices of plain pizza for the kids, a nice option Would definitely return.

text:
Though some reviews have not worked well for this establishment, my experience was very nice.  My husband and I ate at the 96th Street location for a late lunch after a day of car shopping.  My husband was not familiar with hot chicken so he was anxious to see what it was about.  I, on the other hand, had tried hot chicken many times in Nashville--known for its famous hot chicken restaurants.  
     We both ordered the three piece tenders with a side and a drink.   My side was mashed potatoes.  I was surprised the potatoes came with brown gravy instead of the traditional white chicken gravy.  It was good but I still prefer the other.  My husband  had the greens as his side.  He said they were well seasoned and quite tasty.  Our chicken tenders were excellent.  I cannot rave about them enough.  They were hot, juicy and perfectly breaded.  In fact, they were so appealing that I forgot to snap a picture until my plate was clean.  For dessert we split a banana pudding.  It was wonderful.  It was largely sized but next time I am getting my own--I don't want to share --so delicious.
     The dining room is very nicely organized.  Lots of seating on both sides.  Menu board large and many items to choose from.  Take your time because it all is tasty.
name: Andria

text: Second time in two days. Food is awesome. Bourbon listen is extensive. Cocktails are hand crafted and delicious. Highly recommend
name: Jimmy

text: Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Food was good and came out fast. It looked better online than it did in person.

text:
One of our favorite places to visit for an easy sit down dinner without a lot of fuss. We particularly like the oysters, catfish Mac and Ahi Tuna dishes.
The local beers offered are always good along with delicious cocktails. Service is good with attentive (but not hovering) servers, hostesses are always friendly and even the bus boys were accommodating. A well run restaurant (the staff shows it) with a fun atmosphere that will not disappoint!

text: I honestly can say that I will not be returning for a second time. I ordered a large and at 16 dollars I was expecting decent portions. The employee that scooped my protein was not very generous and was shocked that he even shook two cubes of salmon out of the scooper because it was too much. I understand that is where most of their money is spent but there are plenty of places in Tampa that offer much more for less money. I assumed that the toppings would at least be given generously but I was sadly mistaken again. Just not a very good experience with this place and feel that there are plenty of other places that have a much better product. Taste wise it was average but like I said at that price range you expect much more.

text: This was another bookmark we were able to mark off of our Yelp to try list.   We had some raw oysters fresh and delicious.   Catfish and greens, gumbo and hush puppies.   Everything we ordered was delicious however the hush puppies were outrageously delish crispy on the outside and lite and fluffy melt in your mouth on the inside.  A must try! I would go back for the hush puppies alone.
name: Deidra

text: I get the appeal, I just don't totally share it. Honestly, not terrible, just not something i'd want again soon. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Honestly, no big complaints, just a nice meal. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. For the price I expected more than this. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Food was good and came out fast.
name: User

text: Walked in around 8:15 on a Wednesday night to a huge line. I can't blame them, this place is usually great. I see one person on the line warming tortillas in the press and one girl assembling each one with no help. We are all waiting a pretty long time and I notice the single person being waited on is actually an employee getting his meal made. There are about 13 people in line waiting for this guy to get his monstrosity of a burrito made. This thing needed to be double wrapped and the assembly girl was having issues wrapping it with how much was shoved in there. Long story short, this dude is now enjoying his dinner while paying customers are now waiting off to the side because of how many ingredients are now not available and need to be prepared. That's not all, next up is a family where the dad has his arms reaching over the sneeze guard pointing and reaching at the ingredients for what he would like in his bowl. Way too close to the steam table line for comfort. I got out of line and left at that point, passing the dirty dining tables on my way out. I will not be visiting this location again as I am disappointed and skeeved out.

text: Good food and nice ambiance. Pretty packed for a Tuesday night! Chargrilled oysters were delicious. Got the kids pizza which the kids ate all it and it came our pretty quick. Lettuce wedge was great and the pasta bolognese! So delicious.  Needed a little parmesan and salt and pepper but was good after you added that. She didn't bring us the Parmesan originally and we had to ask for it which seems strange at an Italian restaurant. And we also had to ask for tomatoes with the lettuce wedge which was strange. Also, bread did not come out at all and I feel like that should be a staple if you're at an Italian restaurant. Server did the best she could waiting on us because I feel like it got busy SUPER quick and she was in the weeds. I want to give it 3 1/2 stars so I'll give 4 since this is a brand new restaurant and give it some time to fix the kinks. I'd definitely come back to try some more stuff on the menu. Oh and if also wasn't that expensive for an Italian place so that's good!
name: Lindsey

text:
So o wish I could give more than 5 Stars.

See first looking at the outside we thought we made a mistake but the second you step inside you are greeted warmly and enthusiastically.
The service has been beyond incredible every time we went there. Instantly treated like family. We said it was our first time there and do he brought us over dessert just to say thanks for coming in. Just really nice. 
The food is very fairly priced. I'm going to admit my ignorance to Mediterranean cuisine so I can't say how authentic it was. And their one dish is the best thing I've ever eaten. Absolutely phenomenal! 
Please if you are ever in the area and even slightly hungry.... Stop in and treat yourself!

Guac was runny (someone else had mentioned that). You're better off getting to-go or drive-thru. Staff is very nice and helpful, though.

text: The only reason I give this establishment at 3 is because they produce an excellent ribeye steak and baked potato dinner. I've had their other steak options and they are not nearly as good. The restaurant is outdated, the service is poor but friendly, and the other food items are mediocre at best. I have dined at this restaurant in numerous times and it's always the same. The appetizers are straight from the freezer section and nothing is fresh made outside of the blue cheese dressing, which is really really strong and the seasoning for the steaks. My wife and I come here strictly for the ribeye and the baked potato, outside of that, there's really nothing worth ordering on the menu. So if you're in the mood for an excellent ribeye steak, this is the place to be. Just keep in mind that that's really all you're here for. You're still going to play about $30 per plate, so be prepared.

I don't even remember what we got, but we had a very large variety and practically everything was scrumptious

text:
This pizza "joint" is absolutely horrible. I used to order from this place once a week. Now, I will NEVER, EVER order from this "joint" again. 

Normally I just request delivery, but I forgot my husband's steak sandwich. So once I caught my mistake I called back to "add on" my order. I don't even think it was fifteen minutes, even checked the phone log on my phone. The guy on the phone said I couldn't add it onto my order because it had gone out for delivery already and hung up on me.  What? You hung up on me? I call back, he didn't even answer the phone, just straight up hung up on me. I was getting furious. In the meantime, my husband came home. I asked him to watch the children while I went down to the pizza "joint" and speak to the manager about my rude experience. 

I get to the "joint" they call a pizza place. I'd driven past it, but never picked up my food. Again, I will NEVER, EVER GIVE THEM MY BUSINESS! I came in to order the additional steak and speak with the manager about my horrendous experience on the phone with the guy that answered the phone. Ironically when I approached the counter, the guy behind it was handing the delivery guy my 40+ order. But wait, it had already left to go out right? Even worse, that rude guy that answered the phone was the supposed "manager". When I asked him why he told me I couldn't add on the steak to my previous order, he again told me it had already left. I said to him, "How can that be, you JUST gave it to the delivery guy?" He turns to me and says, "It's very busy here ma'am. Are you going to hassle me or place an order for a cheesesteak?"  Are you serious? Hassle him? How was I hassling him?  I replied to him, "No hassle buddy, I'm taking my business else where!" He insolently turns around and says to me, "You need to take your business to Jenny Craig."  

Are you kidding me? Do you talk to your mother like that? I just gave birth to twins two months ago and still have baby weight on me. 

Obviously this man doesn't have an ounce of compassion or customer service skills in his body. At best their food is mediocre. Their customer service is deplorable. Save your time, money and breath and order some where else. Not only have I had a bad experience with this supposed manager, others have as well, along with the rude phone girl. 

ORDER FROM SOME WHERE ELSE!!!

TRUST ME!!!

text: Parking was annoying and I was already in a bad mood by the time I got inside. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. For a busy night they handled it okay. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up. Would probably stop in again if nearby.

text:
Made me feel at home. I just moved from CT where I had a go to small brewery right by my house and I've been looking for that feel here in PA. With the live music and friendly bartenders I'm feeling like
I'm back at home in CT. I can't wait to go
Back

text:
Wow! We were craving tacos, and boy did this place fit the bill! Our server India was amazing. She told us the house favorites and she was spot on. We tried 5 different tacos (and per her recommendation the cauliflower shocked us by being our favorite), the elote (fresh corn) was out of this world, and you have to try the chili potatoes. 

But even better that the food, when ch was a 10/10 was the service!!! Stacey and India we so nice, helpful with the menu, and just so welcoming. If your anywhere near Vanderbilt, give this place a try! We loved it.

text: I got the Triple Threat and it was great! The waffles are your typical batter, nothing fancy there BUT they make for a great combination alongside the peppered chicken breasts. I will most definitely be back again.

text: Had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. It looked better online than it did in person. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..

text: Price felt a touch high for what it was. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. The staff seemed tired but still polite. For a busy night they handled it okay. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Definitely coming back. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: Stopped by after work because I was nearby and hungry. The food was good and the service was easygoing. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Would return. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Nice little spot, decent portions too.
