text:
I grew up in South Florida eating every kind of seafood from all types of restaurants. I moved to start, then raise a family in Phoenix, Az. Last night I flew back, and landed in Tampa.

A friend that I grew up with picked me up, and we both really needed to eat. We happen to come across Aqua, in Tampa. I have to imagine the food was close if not better than any place famous chefs like Ramsey owns.

We both ate appetizers. I had the Bib salad, and my friend John had the Volcano. Both were amazing and full of flavor. My salad had pieces of asparagus and tomato. John had the most satisfied look on his face as he ate the Volcano. I don't want to guess what was in it, yet he told me the spice was perfect, and it must have a cream cheese sauce because he couldn't stop raving about it.

Then our grouper arrived. It sat on pasta, linguini I believe, which also had sliced mushrooms in it. The food server then takes a tomato water and slightly pours it on the side if the plate. The grouper was cooked amazingly. Such a perfect piece on both plates, it had the perfect spice covering it and flaked so beautifully.  I can only imagine it is was heaven would taste like if you could eat it.

 The service was as good as the food. Very Professional and friendly. I will add the pics I took. I'm bummed the one I took of the Volcano didn't come out because this chef plates food with such style and class. I will eat there every time I pass through now.
name: Michael

text: Hands down, the WORST PIZZA in Santa Barbara county. Filthy store front, terrible customer service, etc. Etc. A miracle this place is still in business. Well, Carp is pretty 'Podunk' - so maybe that's why. The campers love it. Need I say more?
name: Zelda

text: What's not to love about a great place for wings, ice cold beer and drink specials, TVs with great sports action all served by attentive servers?!!!  We typically stop in on bottomless wing night on Wednesdays. We always ask for our favorite server, Tatum because she is attentive to every drink refill and serves our order fast and piping hot. Their menu has expanded and has many great new things. Pretzel bites are heave
name: Stacy

text: We have been to many Cheesecake Factory's around the country and everyone of them have been very good all around but  this one has always been a challenge. The food is never consistent here. We have ordered many of the same things here each time we come and it is always different though usually good. Our last visit we all ordered salmon which was very good.  The server quoted a price because it was a special but when we got the bill, the price increased by $4.00.  The service is never good here which is a common theme in New Orleans. There were also other tables around us that were seated after us that received their food first.  We even got our bread long after the other tables and after asking for it several times.  I now do not blame the restaurant for bad service because it is common theme in New Orleans these days. It seems that most workers do not care anymore which is very unfortunate.
name: Ralph

text: The food was extremely delightful. We had a party of four... and everyone was quite pleased with their selection. The drinks were strong, but well mixed. The portions were perfect. Definitely, a must... try to get there before the rush as you may see a line out door waiting to get in.
name: Vanessa

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. No big complaints, just a nice meal. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Food was fresh and service was quick. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Overall, a strong experience. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text: What a cool place.... The owners Joel  and Kelsey make you feel like family.    The courtyard in the back is a great place to hang and meet people.      Woodie, the restaurant associated with the bar had awesome  crawfish boil the night I was there.  Roseann will make you want to eat there over and over
name: Robert

text: This place was very welcoming when we walked in with our huge luggage (even if the place was somewhat small). Food was fairly priced for the portion you receive and was delicious to say the least!
name: Evan

text: Went for the first time on Saturday, the burgers were great. The fries were old and cold, once we asked for new fries they were fine. The wings were also very good. Our waiter was terrible, never once came back to ask how things were. There was a waitress at another table that was very helpful. I'll probably try them again and give them another shot. Has potential to be a really good burger place. Server really didn't seem like he wanted to be working that day, if I do go back I will request someone else. I didn't want to leave a tip but the wife forced me to leave 10 percent.
name: Scott

text: I've been to this location and the other one, and both times were wonderful. Went with a group and we split the fig&squash pizza, Black garlic&artichoke pizza, and arugula reginette which was all so delicious. The arugula pasta was great with the mushrooms and they also gave us pita and hummus as a free app while we were deciding what to order. The staff was also extremely kind and funny and the drinks were great also.
name: Amber

text: It was close to our hotel which was the draw for us at the time, but it is clearly a favorite of the locals.  Down to earth, cheap and good food! Place had a real good vibe. On top of that, they don't gouge you on the price of drinks like so many places do in this part of town. I really enjoyed being here, and I definitely will be back. When in New Orleans, Jimani is worth a visit. Extensive bottled beer selection. Several TV's for other football games. Bartenders were great.  We had a blast.
name: Tonyia

text:
The market itself is well kept and very organized. It has a wide range or selections and I can't wait to explore it more!

The cafe was amazing as well! I ordered the fried squid and the pad Malaysian. The fried squid was a lot of food and delicately battered. You get a sizable portion and it's totally worth the affordable price. The Pad Malaysian was only slightly spicy which is good for me since I am not a big fan of super spicy food. If you like spicy though, you can always ask the server to crank up the heat on it and they will accommodate you!

The service was quick. Next time I will go with a better idea of what I would like. It was my first time there and I was a little overwhelmed with the choices and I am just super indecisive. A customer next to me actually was super friendly and made some suggestions. She mentioned that she had recently moved to Memphis and really missed this place so she always makes sure to come when she is in town.
name: Cheryl

text: Used the restaurant as a get together with 3 generations of old family friends. The restaurant went out of their way to make this reunion a wonderful experience. They, without being told to, set up two tables, one for the kids and one for the adults. Gave the adults time to catch up and the kids to get to know one another. Food was outstanding. Everyone found something they liked.
name: H.

text:
Chris and I stopped in Nashville in our way to Michigan and listened to the recommendation of the sales clerk in the gift shop who suggested The Stillery for dinner. "That's where we eat!"  

Perfect little bar with a knowledgeable bartender and great local brews. Our Starter of Pickle Chips are great.
name: Debbie

text: Pricey, but delicious. Scanty amount of food, given the price. Even with GPS, was difficult to find the location. Server was so nice and very accommodating.
name: Brandi

text:
Long story short - good food, even better service and fast! Several specials offered and breakfast is served all day. 

Opted for a local place over the other chains in this strip mall area. The few tables outside were empty when we arrived. When we left there was one table of two men and a dog. The dog had a water bowl which I am not sure if the people brought or the restaurant offered. Either way, dog friendly patio/sidewalk seating. 

We walked in and there was a large party of 6 or 8 waiting for a table. We were immediately greeted and told we could sit anywhere we would like. We sat at the bar area as we aren't usually table seating types of people. 

Immediately asked for our drink order and provided menus. The server was kind and efficient and good at her job. She clearly had been doing this for several years. She managed many tables at one time. 

I had the half corned beef sandwich with mustard and soup which was italian wedding. He had the special of chicken wrap. The corned beef was good, they forgot the mustard in the kitchen but the server provided it quickly. I opted for white bread as rye can be overly filling. It had an ok amount of meat on it but it certainly wasn't overfilled. The soup was good. His wrap was huge! It was grilled so the wrap was crispy. Enough for two meals. He also had the macaroni salad which was good. 

Our bill was $15 and some change. Not too bad especially since he got two meals out of his. We paid on the way out. We wished we had room for dessert because they make their own and they ALL looked delicious. 

The patrons were all (except for us and one server) over 60. This is clearly a 'regulars' kind of place. They all seemed pretty upbeat about the food and service. 

We enjoyed our time here. We would stop in again if we were looking for home cooking kind of food. The place has been there for 30+ years. Goes to their ability to keep patrons happy. It also goes to the dated atmosphere. There is a shelf of lighthouses above the bar area which are probably 15 years old. The walls are a dull off white. The carpet is dark which is probably a good thing given it looked like it was 30+ years old. I doubt they will update it anytime soon. It doesn't seem like that is their focus. So if you want sparkly new - this isn't your place. Go somewhere else. If you want good ol' home cooked food that is delivered quickly - this is it. We prefer places that have their character and charm built in due to its long standing tenure. We would rather pay for our food than the ambience. Well done Eve's. Next time breakfast is going to be had. Can't wait.
name: Suzan

text: Amazing food... we had fried rice,chicken dosa and biryani. It was really tasty and affordable... the portion was huge too definitely will be coming back for more... the pastries are to die for... for that price point and the quality of the pastries... totally unbeatable...
name: Flawlessin

text: Went there not knowing they had a vegan menu. Much to my surprise not only did they but it was amazing. Great food. Good prices loved the outdoor seating . See the Ocean watch train go by as you eat. Children can play in the sand box. Might Even see a bunny hoping around.
name: Heather

text:
The worst experience I have had, we came in on a Sunday to not have a long wait. So we went and sat in the bar, the restaurant was disgusting including several water spots and dips in the ceiling (included a picture with the ceiling caved down and a hole where the water leaks above the "clean" washed dishes- probably a sign we should have left then).  But we both used to love Benihana so we stayed, we got our drink orders and got our drinks 20 minutes later. My fiancé ordered a glass of wine which instead of pouring in a glass they gave her in the mini wine bottle (not a big deal but when you have to pay 10 for a glass of wine you expect more). We then put in our food order and a hour and a half later I noticed another employee asking our waitress who had our order (guessing someone forgot about our food), which 20 minutes later we received our food...Non surprisingly it was cold; including our steak, chicken and shrimp. I then asked for a beer mid meal and waited another 30 minutes until she remembered my drink. I would understand this type of service if, 1) you are really busy...but there was 1 other couple in the bar or 2) if your food and drinks weren't expensive(as in I got a lunch order and she got a dinner order and they were the same size, and I had 2 drinks she had 1 and it was $80). We were so annoyed after being at the restaurant for 2.5 hours that I wasn't about to complain. 
There are way too many places in Indy that appreciate your business and definitely no reasons why you have crappy service. Sorry to leave a bad review, I am just disappointed in the place, considering it used to be one of our favorites.
name: Paul

text:
Been here a few times now, and I've never been dissapointed!

First, the empenadas are awesome, but the real star here is the white garlic sauce.  FANTASTIC! 

The Cubano is my go-to.  Best I've had this side of Miami.  I also like the Hambergao.  Very unique.   Again, this is great with a drizzle of the magic garlic sauce.
name: Rob

text: No big complaints, just a nice meal. Not bad for a quick meal. Would prob stop in again if nearby. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Food was fresh and service was quick. Would probably stop in again if nearby. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: People are being a little dramatic in these comments honestly. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Maybe expectations are just off for some people. Not bad for a quick meal. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text: For the price I expected more than this. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Probably not coming back. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Food was fresh and service was quick. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text: The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Not bad for a quick meal. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. For the price I expected more than this. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really.
name: User

text:
The brisket was "ok". The service/attitude was terrible. 
Q: "Can I get lean meat?"
A: "no"
Q: "can I get fries as a side?"
A: "it's cooking"
Q: "what is polish Karbala?"
A "we don't have it"
Not a place to come back, ever.
name: Eyal

text: They have Philly best popcorn chicken. Whenever I go I order one! But, a little bit waiting time than I expected.
name: Xin

text: This place is nasty! I am sure that the oil used to cook probably gets changed every 6 months. All the dishes taste the same. The shrimp tastes like it's been in their fridge for years! All the meats and vegetables come from frozen packages. Nothing is fresh! Don't waste your time!
name: Jackie

text:
Ooooooo sunda. You gave me a lot of feelings. I came here for a birthday party on a Saturday and although some food was delicious other dishes were subpar. The service was awful because they were too packed. Our server had a party of 10 and a party of 17 and he was struggling. The whole restaurant was really frantic. 

Our food came out over the course of an hour even though we ordered at the same time. It was pretty awkward and when I asked where some items were I was rudely informed that they food comes out as it is prepared. I get that, but a few people ordered the same dish and they came out 20 minutes apart. It was really absurd and not at all reasonable. Again it took an hour to get all the food between the first dish dropped off and the last. 

The fried rice and pad thai were not good at all. No one who got anything other than sushi was pleased with their food. It was all really bad and over priced.

I will say that the sushi was delicious, even at $25 per roll I was happy. I got the lobster wagyu roll and although it was an experience I would not get it again. The red dragon roll, however, was made of dreams and I want it again ASAP. The seafood roll was also delectable. The nigiri is on point and really high quality. 

Overall I had a good time with good people. I would come back to try the sushi again on happy hour when it will hopefully be less busy.
name: Morgan

text:
Bar Louie has been around for several months, and I just got a chance to go for the first time last weekend.  As you may have noticed, Bar Louie occupies a prominent location at the intersection of Old Meridian and Main in Carmel, and from the outside it appears to be an upscale bar with ample outdoor patio seating.

Inside, the decor was trendy and hip, and dark.  There is an upstairs seating area, but we sat on the main floor in a booth.  Service was very good, although it did take a while before we were acknowledged.  But, once we were greeted by our server, the drinks and food came pretty quickly.

I had a traditional mojito, which was very nicely done.  The mint was properly muddled, and wasn't crushed to death, which is the starting point of any good mojito. 

Not much else to say - we'll be back to try some of their other food offerings.  Bottom line: Everything was great.  No complaints.  Looking forward to exploring their menu.
name: Tom

text: We went back for breakfast a second day in a row because of their marvelous menudo! I was very impressed by their menudo: it was very "clean" and well prepared. The last time I had menudo that good was more than 20 years ago, made by my sister who passed away. The whole breakfast menu is a quality menu. My husband had the chorizo with eggs and hash browns. It was flavorful and not greasy. Manuel was an attentive, polite, and responsive server. If you're looking for a great breakfast with marvelous menudo, this is the place to go. Thank you Sunshine Cafe!
name: Nancy

text: This is a very good taco/Mexican restaurant  with an excellent salsa and fixings bar. Beware of the habanero salsa. Their warning is accurate--It is very hot!  They only have beer and wine, but my wife enjoyed their wine based margarita. I loved my very authentic tacos.
name: Don

text: Really enjoyed our first time here.  I had The Reggie and my girlfriend had The McIsley.  Both were full of flavor and the biscuits themselves were amazing.  We especially enjoyed the pickles on the McIsley.  The line was intimidating when we approached but it moved quickly and we received our food very fast after ordering.  We will be back!
name: Tawnya

text:
Harp & Crown was a great find during my last trip to Philly. I went with coworkers on our first night in town.

So first off, it's really hard to find. If they have a sign, I didn't see it. You have to look for the address. We walked by a few times and couldn't find it until we called the restaurant. It's easy to see the address.

Next, make reservations. They seemed pretty busy and reservations weren't available at the time we wanted when we made it a few days in advance. We got a decent time but it looks like you need to definitely make them.

There were four of us in our group so we did small plates and shared everything. We tried so many things and everything was really good.

My coworkers said this restaurant was a good pick!
name: Jenn

text: Everything was fresh, delicious, filling, and beautifully presented. The wait staff is excellent, the manager is present, attentive and professional. Very very happy. Ask for kaden. Best server in Tampa.
name: Jade

text:
One of the best spots for pho outside of Washington Ave and Chinatown. 

The beef broth is rich, flavorful, and savory, and they don't skimp on the meat. The spring rolls are perfect - crispy on the outside but full of tasty pork/mushroom goodness on the inside. Don't sleep on the fruit smoothies, either! A perfect complement to a piping hot bowl of noodles. Lychee is my favorite flavor here. 

Really cozy place, and the servers are always sweet and friendly.  My boyfriend and I went for the first time on New Years Day of 2019 (miserably hungover, mind you - because what better for your hungover, sorry self than a bowl of pho), and have already been back many times since. 

Felt a little guilty cheating on Pho 75.... but trust me, this place is worth the infidelity. Check it out!
name: Becca

text:
We were lucky enough to eat at this fancy restaurant during Coolinary week at NOLA. 

The servers and greeters were very nice, friendly, helpful and efficient. The ambience was romantic and the adjoining carousel bar was playing some music, not too loud that it got annoying, just enough that it provided some background music. 

The food:
Appetizers:
I had - grilled octopus with petite potatoes and brown butter: octopus was cooked just right. not long enough to be chewy nor rubbery but just enough to char some of the sides and cook. Sauce was lemony herby (yes, that's the best way I can describe it). 
Husband had the pork cheeks in grits. Nice flavor, texture? not so much (glad he ordered it and not me:) 

Entree:
I had the Angus flap steak - nice and juicy, good flavor, ample serving
Husband had the Cobia and it was realllyyyy good! I had to steal some of his fish as it was so flaky, tender, fresh and clean tasting. 

Dessert:
I had the strawberries, husband had the creme brulee. Not a big fan of strawberries, once again stole some of my husband's food :) 

Overall a nice experience.
name: Mary

text: Great quality food, I'm always satisfied with the meal. EVERYTHING IS VERY FRESH. The tacos and burritos are my favorite. The service is always great everyone is friendly. Hands down best Mexican food around! I've tried every place in the area and this Is the best.
name: Jake

text:
First time eating in Philadelphia and decided to check out South Phillys own; John's Roast Pork. It was exactly as I had imagined when we pulled up, a small building with line wrapped around the side. Everybody in line was excited and Hyper focused on what they wanted to order I knew I had to get the roast pork obviously and a cheese with but I also got the onion rings because why not. 

Once inside the building the line didn't move as fast thanks to a couple of customers who are being picky about cold sandwiches... Come the fuck on your here for Philly cheese steaks and roast pork sandwiches.

Anyway got the roast pork, got the Cheesesteak and probably the best onion rings I've had to date. 

I'm not going to wax poetic about the sandwiches because they're by far some of the best meet and Bun combinations I've ever had. Absolutely worth the 2 and 1/2 Drive from Upstate New York for it. By the way the cheese steaks do contain some molten lava in there so be careful when you buy it again because onions will stick to your face and burn ever so lovingly.
name: Alresch

text: Best Pull Pork BBQ Tacos I ever had...only ones I've ever had actually, but these are probably the best taco's I've eaten period - My new fave. Went here after visiting a church down the street - came with high recommends so thought we'd give it a shot.  I'm a pulled pork connoisseur so I couldn't resist the tacos.  Layers of flavor just go on and on, seemingly without end.  Juicy enough w/o it, but adding some of there special bbq sauce added another unexpected layer of yummness - Sweet, tangy, salty? Hmm to Ymmmmm.  Can't wait to try another one of their dishes - The biggest challenge will be choosing which one.  Side note - kind, courteous, excellent service combined with an inviting, laid back Nashville attitude makes this my go-to for bbq in our new hometown.  Forgive the photo's - No pics of food, just the flag in one of their upper floor eating areas as proof we were actually there and a smiling, happy, satiated customer selfie. :)
name: Kristy

text: The staff make this place what it is. To facilitate such a large restaurant and entertainment space with quality is complex. Props to the team and their attention to detail. You pay for a quality experience in Tucson, and it is worth it if you like a high energy atmosphere with the amenities.
name: Hadrian

text:
Hot is an understatement. My mouth was on good fire. The heat was real, the sweat was rolling and my mouth was a happy. Sides are generously served with a smile. Don't worry about the line, everyone is friendly and the chatter makes it go by in the blink
If an eye.
name: Nombre

text: Hottttt Chicken! After an hour and half wait, seeing the customers sweating it out and enjoying every moment!! I loved all levels of heat, the sides... and the fun staff!  I loved my experience
name: Amy

text: Food was great. The grouper sandwich was delicious as well as the shrimp tacos. Would recommend the Brunch beer. Service was okay could have been a bit better. Our order was slightly messed up but they corrected it very quickly.
name: Brigett

text: I ordered the smothered chicken. It was OK, the chicken was really dry. The plate was really hot, so I'm not sure if it sat under a heat lamp for a while and that's why it was so dry? The potatoes and risotto were great. The bread they bring out was delicious. The server was attentive.
name: Sheller

text: The Turning Point in Blue Bell has some unique breakfast offerings but fail to execute a lot of them.  I have been here a few times and had a large party for XMAS Eve breakfast.  We got there early so it was not too crowded yet.  The service is kind of slow even when it was not real crowded and the place for breakfast is a little pricey.  I am conflicted between 2 and 3 stars because it has some things going for it.  The fresh squeezed OJ is excellent.  The Belgian waffle is really good with nice warm syrup.  The breakfast nachos are solid but a large portion.  However other things like the bacon are too salty and kind of gross.  I love bacon and couldn't eat it because it was so salty.  The avocado toast...holy salty Batman.  The salt ruins it so if you get it ask for salt on side unless you love salt.   Three people at my table ordered this and all thought it was too salty including my sister in law who eats almost everything and is not picky at all.  Overall I think they struggle with a lot of their dishes and a lot of the food comes out cold due to the aforementioned poor service.  I had rye toast which was cold so I sent it back then they burned it.  The fritatta is very average as well.  Pancakes came out cold.  Also the rye bread is just not a good rye, tasteless and bland.   As a general rule when you struggle with toast it usually is not a good sign.  Overall while they do some things well I think they struggle with too many things to get above 2 stars.  I will probably wait a while before I go back and to be honest Izzy's Deli, IHOP, and even Friendly's offer much better breakfast for better prices.  I would go elsewhere.
name: Darren

text:
Poor management. Why do I start with that, because we went for lunch/brunch and when we tried to order from the children's menu, the waiter said the new sous chef would only do the children's menu at night. There was another family sitting next to us and they had the same issue. 

The waiter was nice and explained that it made no sense. All of the necessary ingredients were in the kitchen and these are not complicated dishes (grilled cheese, chicken fingers, etc.). 

The food was eh-ok, but the poor start set the tone for the rest of the meal. The tomato soup was very salty.
name: Allan

text: Expect LOTS of spices and ingredients in this store.  My husband and I picked up cans of jackfruit and some chutneys for home.  We also ordered the pakora, which was tasty, and ate in the small room adjacent to the store.  The food did take a bit to come out, so I would not recommend ordering food if you are short on time.
name: Allison

text:
I used to eat here alot bcuz my girlfriend literally lived across the street so id just order by phone and walk over but I hadn't been here in over a decade until today. ordered a basic breakfast which consisted of a sausage egg and cheese sandwich on a long roll and an order of home fries with onions. when I arrived I was greeted by a woman who was friendly. there was a short wait but nothing to complain about. I was a little bothered by my home fries being packaged on a paper plate covered by aluminum foil as opppsed to the normal styrofoam container. I just felt it was cheap and tacky. food tasted okay but not great. seems quality has declined since my last visit. 

tates is okay on a whim but I wouldn't go out of my way to dine here.
name: Beaumont

text: Plenty of parking and clean entrance. I just grabbed a quick to go order but and the chicken souvlaki was awesome and the staff was very friendly. Definitely will be here again.
name: Ben

text: $1.95 + 0.50 for pepperoni.  I was surprised to have the slice fresh made and I received more than I bargained for.  When I opened the heavy box down the road, there was two moderate slices.  Or you could say a large slice cut in half.   They offered ranch and parmesan (+ peppers / none taken) free of charge.  It tasted great, especially the caramelized cheese that oozed on to the grill.  Overall the service was great, friendly and welcoming.
name: Jason

text:
The tomato soup was great. 
But my pizza...wow. So. Bad. It was soggy and the crust was squishy. I could have rung it out like a dish rag. So gross.
name: P

text: Come for the vegan cookie sandwich at Valhalla, but stop and actually grab lunch at any of the kiosks here! So good!
name: Brieanna

text:
We had a nice time here last Saturday evening--dined al fresco on a lovely June evening.  The service was friendly, albeit spotty. The beer(s) were memorable.  I actually had all 6 of their featured brews in a 'flight.' My wife chose the light pilsner, but didn't like it at all, so returned it (amazingly enough, they graciously allowed here to 'trade it in') for one of their amber beers, which she loved.

The food was pretty good, too.  I went with 2 appetisers (cheesesteak egg rolls and Korean wraps--the latter were messy, so get extra napkins); my wife had an entree. We enjoyed all of it. 

We both ventured inside during the evening to use the rest rooms, and were delighted NOT to have been inside.  It was a lively, happy, LOUD crowd, and normally would have been ideal, but we were relaxing after a l-o-n-g day at a kids lacrosse tournament, and welcomed the relative colm of the sidewalk cafe.

So, take your crowd and go there.  I assure you, everyone will have fun, and at reasonable prices.
name: Gary

text: Wow, just wow. I will never order from another food place when I don't want to leave the house. They have a wide variety of food from fried rice to chicken wings to burgers. The quality and quantity of food is just right. Most delivery places take anywhere from upwards 30+ minutes. Not with ClusterTruck. We got our food in 20 minutes. Fast and delicious. Not only is it fast delivery, there is no delivery charge unlike every other delivery service. Highly recommend - you won't regret it.
name: Rachel

text:
Our hotel was just down the street so we wanted to check out this joint for dinner one day. We walked in at around 6:30PM and half the restaurant was empty, but the hostess let us know that all the tables were reserved, so only bar seating was available. We were fine with that, but even by the time we left an hour later, there were still empty tables.

We ordered char-grilled oysters (how could you not in new orleans?!), and I got the fried shrimp dinner while my companion got the fried catfish. I liked how they sprinkled some bread crumbs on top of the oysters which gave it a little bit more texture and crunch. The fried shrimps from my meal were huge, but the breading lacked a bit of flavor. It came with some rice and a shrimp/crawfish maison choux that was very tasty (which I had to look up what it was), but I couldn't find any pieces of shrimp or crawfish in it. My fiance seemed to enjoy his fried catfish and creole. 

Bartender and the person shucking the oysters at the bar were very nice. Overall, the restaurant is worth a try, but might not go out of my way to eat there.
name: Patty

text:
I think this was my third time visiting and it's been great every time. It's a must in New Orleans. 

My friends and I arrived for lunch. Since it was 4th of July weekend, we figured it was super busy. Luckily, Drago's is enormous so we didn't have to wait for a table. We all ordered a dozen charbroiled oysters and fried alligator bites. Our food came out pretty quickly. The charbroiled oysters were so savory and rich. It also came with French bread - we needed to carb up before we turn up on Bourbon St. The fried alligator bites tasted like chicken, very tasty.

I'm pretty sure I've tried their other dishes before but the charbroiled oysters were always the star of the show. Highly recommend.
name: Kathy

text:
Amazing vegan comfort food in an old school diner style restaurant. You order and grab a table and they call your number when your food is ready. Self seating and self service.  
I had my first vegan Philly cheese steak with waffle fries and it was delicious. 
I was there for Sunday brunch and it was crowded. If you don't find a table they hold your food and keep it warm till you do. So, arrive early for brunch and dinner times or go at off hours.
name: Laura

text: Best Cheesesteak in Center City. Good cheeses fries as well. My go to place when downtown!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
name: Philly

text: The food today was wonderful! Thanks Hollywood for such wonderful service! We really enjoyed our visit. Great Food Great Service, Great Music. We will be back!
name: S

text:
Food was ok overall. 
This restaurant is located in the INDIANAPOLIS airport. When you walk in to the B terminal right after going through security, you see it right away. 
I was little disappointed that no chicken wings were on the menu. We had a burger, grilled cheese sandwich for our 5 year old and Champps club sandwich. Chips were served with sandwich but it was cold. I'm not sure it supposed to be that way but after trying the warm waffle fries, chips tasted even worse. 
Burger was ok. Grilled cheese was ok too. Club sandwich was my least favorite.
Service was ok. There was nothing bad about it but it wasn't excellent. 
Music choice could've been better though. At one point I felt like I was in a club. Maybe it was put on for a reason, maybe to put people in the mood for more drinking.
name: June

text: Stopped in for some grub around 11:00 on a Friday night the food was hot and fresh and everything tasted good. I had the Sesame Tuna tacos they were very flavorful the tuna was cooked nicely. I had sweet potato fries they were nice and hot. And there were a lot of them. You know sweet potato fries get cold fast I couldn't eat them all. My boyfriend had wings there were delicious as well. Nice and tangy and well fried. We'll definitely be back.
name: Brittany-Ann

text:
Such a great place with such an amazing vibe. The first night I met my partner we went here during Sunday karaoke. That night changed my life forever! The staff is always nice and welcoming and even remember friendly faces. Their drinks are great and I never have to wait too long to be served. 

The piano room is my favorite room. There are four sections, a dining section, a bar, a dance floor, and the piano room. They play live music very often and it's refreshing listening to people sing and show appreciation towards the love of music. I definitely would recommend stoping by if you're ever in the area.
name: Alyssa

text: The tortilla soup is reason enough to come here, but the street tacos and chips and salsa and great too!
name: Greg

text: This is the first restaurant I tried while visiting New Orleans for the very first time and I appreciate it that the food was by far one of the best seafood I tried. And it has already set the bar very high for rest of the restaurants. I tried house special Fish in the bag, and it truly was filled with flavors. Will be coming back to this place for some other items.
name: Wahab

text: This was the first time my kids plate wasnt messy. Love this chipotle for their awesome packing skills and super fast to go orders!
name: Ashley

text:
Disappointed is a little too harsh, but good would be too complimentary.  Three stars, too much, because it was not "A-OK".  It's a newer cafe, but they've had plenty of time to work out any kinks.

Greeted immediately upon entering by mildly pleasant, barely smiling hostess and seated one booth away from the kitchen (noisy, not a great view), early morning and not busy yet.  Server came by quickly and got coffee to us after a couple of minutes.  Took our order, but seemed strange that in answering a few questions about an item, she kept saying how much each option cost...puzzling way to explain, and confusing.  We didn't ask how much, just what choices the combos had.  

Ordered breakfast sandwich.  My bad for not paying attention and asking for a specific bread, and her bad for not asking what bread I wanted rather than assume white.  Asked for runny eggs. Hard to tell if I got one egg or two on the toasted white bread, but they were not runny.
Probably just one egg since half the sandwich had nothing on it.  Don't know about y'all but for $7 to $10, I want two eggs and some stuff on my sandwich...mayo, tomato, avocado, butter, something!!  This had nothing...dry white toast, egg, cheese, bacon.  Very blah, dry, unappealing.  Maybe my fault for not asking, but waitress should have asked me or suggested things.  Also had ordered home fries and had to ask again when sandwich was delivered without them.  The were so-so, looking ok and a large portion, but the limp slices of potato were not crisp and did not seem to have any flavor (no onion?).
Our other order was for the combo pancakes, eggs, bacon.  Bacon was terrific and done the way we like.  Eggs were eggs.  Pancakes were another matter...if the word dry makes any sense?  Just so dry that we could of used a few more portions of the little cup of butter we got.  Worse, no matter how much syrup we put on, they needed more.

In an instant poll between the two of us...no, we won't go back, and First Watch, a few miles away, will get our business since they do a better job when it comes to the service and food.
name: Steve

text: I also came here after I saw the show Someone feed Phil on Netflix. When we arrived there was a long queue until the outside however the waiting time wasn't too bad. We ordered two famous Bologna sandwiches and they did not disappoint. The service was friendly and quick. Don't go here if you're on a diet! otherwise this is a great lunch spot when in New Orleans
name: Markus

text: A great spot in Tampa for authentic Puerto Rican food. The food is delicious, I've tried a lot on their menu and never had anything I didn't like here. They are in a shopping center on Fletcher in the university area, very small and easily overlooked but I highly recommend checking it out if looking for good Latin food. Service can be a little slow but they are very friendly. They are also on Uber Eats if you want to order from home. All meals are under $10, except the mofongo, and you should definitely treat yourself to one of their fresh juices. The sides are so cheap you can try new things without feeling like you are splurging too much. The portions are large and they also offer specials and family meals.
name: Amanda

text:
Great food and ambience! Will was my server and he was amazing. Made the experience much better!
Got the duo hotpot buffet.
name: Rice

text: This place is AMAZING!!!  We stopped by on a road trip and everything we ordered was incredible. The staff was friendly and helpful and the owner came by to talk. This is what a real neighborhood restaurant is supposed to be. Stop by and be amazed.
name: Bryan

text:
Cafe seventy two consistent delivers solid food with the right price. 
I've been coming here for lunch for the last couple of years, it was recommended by someone I worked with. Since the food scene in Ewing is just hopping with choices. (Sarcasm) I have to give this place a try.
You might missed this place if you are not looking for it, it literally looks like someone's house next to a Barber shop. The parking lot is shared with an adult day care next door. 
Inside is decorated based on season. I believe they  renovated once since I've been coming here. It's clean, pretty roomy and def has the cafe feel.
I believe their star dishes are off their breakfast menu, omelette, pancakes, fresh toast and breakfast sandwiches.
Some of My favorites thus far is the grilled chicken sandwich, chicken and waffles and BBQ pulled pork sandwich. If you like spicy, add some sriracha to your grill chicken sandwich, it adds another flavor profile you won't expect. I always get their home made chips as well. 
If you don't want to wait for a table, I would recommend coming here around 11:45 or after 12:45. Since this cafe is smaller in size, you can wait up to 30-45 mins during the rush. 
I would be coming back again and again.
name: Wei

text: Amazing food. Super cute atmosphere. The Thai iced tea is to die for. I only ordered take out but the food was ready in 15 minutes and still piping hot when I got home . I got the beef pad Thai and it was amazing not spicy and plenty of flavor m. Definitely going to come back and have a sit down meal here
name: Sam

text:
After driving by many times since it opened, I decided to give this place a try. I've become a big BBQ fan since a bunch of places started opening up several years back. 

I ordered the 2 meat platter, with brisket and turkey. Chose Parmesan potatoes and green beans as sides.

The turkey was excellent. The brisket, which is what I normally order, was not as good as the brisket at some other places I've tried over the years. The sides were good, but not anything that stood out as great.

Overall, a decent option, and with as good as the turkey was, it's very possible some other stuff I didn't have could be great too. My bbq standards are pretty high, and most  of the things I had didn't meet those high standards.
name: James

text:
This is my favorite breakfast place to go to! Interior is beautiful and the food is scrumptious! Service is amazing and the food prices are unbeatable.

I love starting my day at mama's diner. It's a great spot to spend time with your family. Can't wait to go again.
name: Leslie

text: This is one of those places where I can see other people loving it more than I did. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. So yeah, nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Also, the wait wasn't awful, just longer than i expected for the time of day.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Anyway, i liked the soup more than the entree honestly.
name: User

text: Oh my.... 1st, when I walked in, I was very impressed with the atmosphere and the look of the restaurant.  2nd, Matthew, our server, was awesome and have great suggestions. 3rd, the food was phenomenal! Definitely coming back... when I'm not on a diet!
name: Breezy

text:
This place gets an "A-OK" from me. Our service was very slow, partly because my girlfriend ordered a vegetarian hot dog off the menu. It took almost 40 minutes to come out and it looked like any other hot dog. 

I had a hotdog and poutine combo. The hotdog wasn't that great. I wouldn't say it lived up to the name of a place that serves only hotdogs. Poutine was a bit better, but not that much better.

Our server was nice and she did a good job serving us. Overall though it was an underwhelming experience.
name: James

text:
My husband and I loved this place!! My first suggestion is to download the No Wait App so you can get in line while you're on your way. We did this and were seated within 5 minutes of arriving. We started out with the pitcher of Abe Famous Infused Mary. If you like a spicy Bloody Mary I highly recommend. My husband also got the light roast coffee and he said it was great. 

I got the chicken & waffles which had a honey chipotle glaze. I loved the balance of sweet and savory. The glaze also added a little heat. I'd definitely get it again! 

My husband had the smoked salmon benedict. I had a bite and WOW. Lots of flavor. My husband loved the poached egg and the smoky salmon. Our food took longer than normal to come out but he said he would've waited another hour for his food because his meal was THAT good, haha! 

Our server was super sweet and the atmosphere was very welcoming. I can't wait to bring friends here to check it out!
name: Molly

text: Get it together. New management or more training necessary. Or new employees. You guys are awful at your job. I live 1.7 miles away. It shouldn't take over an hour for a single pizza to come after dinner rush.
name: Daniel

text:
Axum has a bright, welcoming decor, really friendly owners, their own honey wine, and most important, great food that comes out really quickly. I think our group actually spent more time trying to figure out what we wanted to order than the amount of time we actually had to wait for it.  Ironically, with all the options, we found the standard combo platters to be the best option not only for our tummies but for our budget. They were very accommodating in terms of platter setup too, as for various reasons we needed the vegetables on a separate platter from the meat.  The food was nicely spiced, just right for us, and the honey wine complemented it perfectly.

They do lunch specials too, and I hope to try those as well if time permits.
name: Bill

text: I sat next to Jerrod Neimann on flight back from New Orleans lat year. And he told me this was the spot for Hot Chicken. So, we tried it out. A little too salty but definitely good. It reminds me a lot of lunch plate joints growing up in southwest Mississippi. Good chicken, good sides & a lot of love and tradition in the food. I drive by this place all the time and it's always packed. It's definitely worth adding to your hot chicken tour of Nashville.
name: Adriene

text:
Customer service is amazing! I loved our server. The food is good, I had a burrito and it was interesting and very fresh! I would need to visit again and try other things! I also ordered rasmali (I'm not sure if that's how you say it) but it's a delicious dessert! 
The ambience is very nice and inviting.
name: Jean

text: Went to Dave and busters last night with my husband and three kids. They told us the wait was going to be an hour but we waited only 45 minutes. Our waitress was awesome and the food was great.
name: Lauren

text: The drinks were delicious! 10/10 would recommend going for drinks and appetizers. However, our food was awful. I had the octopus tacos, which were so spiced you couldn't taste the octopus sadly. My friends had the prawns which were tasty but expensive and didn't come with a side. And the other had the clams which were so salty we could barely eat them. I definitely wouldn't go for dinner but the environment and drinks were great.
name: Claire

text: My husband and I happened to stumble upon this place a few years ago. Every time were in Clearwater, getting a bagel here is a must. They give New York bagels a run for their money! In fact, I'm back home in New York still thinking about their bagels and those delicious chocolate rugelachs!
name: Amber

text: I grew up in Phoenix, AZ and spent more time in Mexico than most folks I know. Mexican food is one of those foods that just never gets old. Having had it in Phoenix, Mexico (from locals), Texas, California, Guatemala, and here in Idaho. Campos Market has food that reminds me of the old Mexican market places and restaurants we used to visit when I was a kid. Down to earth good food. If you like Taco Bell, well, you probably should stick with taco bell because that is most definitely NOT Mexican food. One thing I notice about Campos is that the local hispanic community frequents their markets. That should tell you something. Now, not everyone likes real, authentic south of the border fare, and those folks eat at places like Taco Bell (Just saying the name makes me puke in my mouth a little). But Campos is the real deal. Give them a try.
name: Greg

text: This Taco Bell looks nice and new but it's service is awful! We pull into the drive through after driving 3 hours and wanted to get a little 'quick' snack... 20 minutes later we finally get our meal with everything wrong! The nacho bell grande had No sour cream or tomatoes and the ground beef soft tacos had sour cream and tomatoes! When ordering they asked what sauce I want and I told them hot. Then at the window I was asked again what sauce, I said hot... well I ended up with NO sauce! I will NEVER be coming back to this Taco Bell location!
name: Ashley

text: NO FRILLS cheap breakfast. Not a Michaels diner (Melrose/Penrose) so the food isn't garbage, pretty standard but worth the price. Servers are nice and their fruit salads are actually pretty fresh cuts of fruit. All there is to say, it's typical, classic, won't break your pocket and won't make u feel like total crap afterwards.
name: Shaun

text: Ordered for takeout here. The man (stocky build with short hair) by the register was super rude to me. When I told him I was ordering for takeout instead of dining in, he slammed the menu in front of me. And when I came up to him to order, he didn't even look at me. I had to begin to order for him to engage. Mind you, I wasn't expecting a full blown conversation. I would just like to be acknowledged as a paying customer. I felt like I was bothering him as soon as I walked through the door. I've experienced better service at a McDonald's drive-thru. Properly train your staff if you work in customer service! For this reason, I cannot support this place and no longer eat here. There's a lot of pho options in the Northeast area with better food and far better customer service, don't settle folks!
name: J

text: Hello.  Folcroft Diner is a superb diner.  It is situated in a convenient location, right on Chester Pike, which makes it easy to travel to.  My first time and it certainly will not be my last time.  My family dined there on a recent Sunday afternoon, Palm Sunday.  My mom ordered pancakes, my brother ordered turkey with stuffing and I ordered broiled scallops.  Our waitress, Amanda was the bomb!!! Every order was large portions.  My brother had to ask for a box since they gave him so much turkey with all the trimmings.  Along with my scallops, I ordered for two sides: asparagus and a baked potato with butter on the side.  I am greedy so I ate all of my food and I did not need a box.  Our food was simply divine!!!! Amanda, our server, came back several times to check on us and to make sure we were satisfied, whether we needed anything else and to make sure all was well.  My family and I will definitely be back!!!!! One of the best diners in Delaware County!!!! Whoo hoo BABY!!!!!!
name: Krystal

text: Excellent sliders. Watched the Michigan bowl game here. Fun atmosphere. Definitely some of the best sliders I've ever had. Reasonably priced for what you get. Highly recommended
name: Matt

text: We weren't expecting much since this place didn't get too many stars... But we were pleasantly surprised! The deep dish pizza was wonderful and cheesy.  The breadsticks were lacking flavor but hey, no one's perfect.
name: Sara

text:
Popped in here randomly today due to hunger. Jill was our bartender, and she was wonderful! Just attentive enough, and knowledgeable about the menu and sauces. She also packaged our to go part so nicely (Saran wrapped each sauce individually!) We shared a half order of the pulled pork cheesy fries  $6 and we'll worth it! Get these! I'm not much of a fry or pit bean girl, but I can recognize good ones when I taste them. The pork was soooo good. They have two bbq sauces: one kinda spicy Carolina mustard and one sweet. I liked the sweet, bf liked the spicy Carolina mustard. Both were so good! 
This place is so much nicer, and cleaner than it was when it was smoking inside. Love the ceiling. 
We had a drink and put in an order to go of 1/2 slab of ribs with Mac n cheese $13 and the white wall special (smoked brisket with smoked Gouda and pickled red onions). Tried them as soon as we walked in the door. I'm not a bbq girl really, but it was SoOOOOOoooo good! I will write home about it! The Mac n cheese is the usual, but I love that the seasonal veggies were asparagus and sundried tomatoes topped with goat cheese. I would suggest they mention what is in the seasonal veggies on the menu, especially mentioning the goat cheese. I looove goat cheese, but I know many who do not.
All in all the food, service, and atmosphere is amazing. Reasonable prices, too! We'll certainly be back soon!
name: Sara

text: Food is great at Waldens and so is the coffee.  My only complaint would be the prices.  Over $10 for a BLTA sandwich?
name: Patrick

text: Stopped by on our way up to NorCal for lunch. Weren't expecting much but I was blown away. Good service and great food. Didn't know when we picked the place but it was apparently #16 on yelps 2016 top 100 places to try and I would agree, it's pretty delicious.
name: Benjamin

text: Not sure why this place has such split reviews, but my experience was mostly fine. The music was louder than it needed to be. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. The staff seemed tired but still polite. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Kind of landed in the middle for me. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Not bad for a quick meal.
name: User

text:
Heard a lot of good things about Lins. We finally made it out here and think we made a mistake coming on a Saturday during lunch rush. 

The building, staff, and food would make this a solid 4 star most likely (I will return to give it another chance). We were seated fast and our table was clean. While making my first visit around to see the buffet options, I came across the cooled desert area were a kid was under the snot shield playing on his phone "cooling down" as he said. I pointed it out to a few employees that he was hanging out under there for the past 5 mins. None of them wanted to say something to him about the food safety hazard he was creating by sweating overtop the desert bar under the snot guard. I asked him to get out and he left to complain to his mom. There were also 3 or 4 kids wrestling on the floor and almost knocked an older lady over, no staff said anything.

The Chinese food assortment was great, fresh, and full. The American food assortment was plentiful enough to accommodate even the pickiest of children lol. The Mongolian grill and steak grill were very nice as well. My wife loved the sushi and seafood assortment. And the deserts looked great but after "sweat boy" hung out over them we avoided the treats. 

Now the reason I dropped it to a 3 star, the bathrooms were horrible. My wife had to clean her seat and sink before using either. The mens room was trashed and urine on seats, broken urine filled urinals, trash on the floor, and dirty sinks. Usable.....but only gas station level clean, don't touch what you don't have too and use AFTER eating. 

Keep up the great work with the building and the food, keep a better eye on your customers food safety violations (we all want to have a good eating experience). We will return soon.
name: Eric

text: I agree with everyone else.  This is a great addition to Fishtown.  The sandwiches are high quality on fantastic bread with fresh and tasty ingredients.  The owners are very nice and friendly.
name: Bernie

text: Went with family on a Sunday and it was louder than I expected. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Food was fresh and service was quick. The food was good and the service was easygoing. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Overall, a strong experience. Food was good and came out fast.
name: User

text: The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. The staff seemed tired but still polite. The wait felt longer than it should have. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Probably not coming back. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Food was fresh and service was quick.
name: User

text: For some reason we held off on going here even though it's right down the road from our house. It looks very small and kinda "eh" on the outside. HOWEVER, it is a small but beautiful setting on the inside with great service. I had the tandoori chicken kebab and I asked for it to be medium spicy. It was so good we went back the next week! (Don't pass up a little scoop from the box of mukhwas on the way out.)
name: Andrea

text:
Great dinner - we got 2 small plates of meat and that was waaay more meat we needed for the 4 of us and 3 boys. 

I really liked getting cold noodles at the end which helped settle all that food I ate. Entirely self inflicted. We ate everything on the plates and small dishes.
name: Andy

text:
Excellent food! 

We had the Black ended shrimp and crab cake appetizer - I bit into the crab cake to a small rock shell which turned me off, the shrimp was delicious. 

The fresh bread was hit or miss, the first one was so soft the second one was burning hot and very hard. Garden salad was literally lettuce a slice or tomato and onions, the dressing was kinda blah. 


Jambalaya comes as two large healing rice scoops and the crawfish penne pasta which was delicious. Serving size was generous.

While I wasn't a fan of hard shells in my food and a blah side salad the dinner was delicious, waitress was very tentative, friendly and prompt.
name: Jenni

text: The food at atmosphere of the place were great. I ordered a white pizza and it was great. The crust was soft and delicious while the sauce and cheese were delightful. My mother ordered a 4 cheese Stromboli. I would say it was above average with a somewhat sweet sauce. The waiter did confuse her dish with a 4 cheese pizza but we were given an apology and the 4 cheese pizza for free. The atmosphere was great and the bathrooms were wonderful. The restaurant was very affordable and well worth the trip. I recommend.
name: Nate

text: Very good food for relatively low prices. Bathrooms and dining area were clean and the staff was very welcoming and helpful. Gluten free options and dairy free options abound.
name: Christina

text: Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Definitely coming back. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh.
name: User

text:
We've stopped coming here. It used to be one of our favorites but they're just let us down too many times recently. The last time we came here, the manager gave us a dirty look when we came in with our three kids (who are actually really quiet and well behaved in restaurants) and huffed at us when we asked for a high chair.  
Service was less than stellar too. Nobody stopped by to give us menus for several minutes, and we had to ask for silverware after our meals finally arrived. It was just a constant series of little oversights like this from beginning to end and I never once felt welcomed.
One bad visit I could understand but it's been a pattern lately. 

We've switched to the Colonial, and they're not perfect but at least they don't treat us like we're intruding on them.
name: Ben

text: Had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. Honestly, nothing was awful but i left disappointed. Also, the ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but i still finished most of it. Also, the host got us seated quickly, which i appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Idk, it looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. not sure I'd order the same thing again.
name: User

text: Had not been there in years, since other Indian restaurants had opened. Now that some other Indian restaurants are no longer as good as they had been in the past, we decided to try Coriander again. It was wonderful. The service and the food were excellent. There were some nice "fusion" choices as well. They still have my favorite chai-masala ice cream.
name: X

text: WINGS, WINGS, WINGS!!! If you want good wings, try the DOA's (hot), Delco's (hot mixed w/ BBQ Sauce) or Sea Isle's (same as Delco but with Old Bay mixed in). I recommend getting them well done with extra blue cheese!!
name: Adam

text:
3/13/2018
Yelp Review
Half & Half
Clayton MO
Half & Half
8135 Maryland Ave, Clayton, MO 63105
(314) 725 0719

Overall Half & Half is by far my favorite breakfast spot in the St. Louis metro area. Although many attempt to compare with the whole in the wall restaurant, no breakfast spot comes close. People come from all over the area to get a taste. 

Known for its very satisfying selection of breakfast options, Half & Half also serves lunch. For breakfast I ordered the Fried Egg Sandwich for $7.00, other items ranged from $3-$15, or higher. The presentation was beyond appetizing. The Brioche Bun sat perfectly toasted a top the crispy fried and sizzling bacon, surrounding it the freshly chopped breakfast potatoes with a parsley garnish on top. Biting in to the sandwich was almost heavenly as the flavors of the egg, bacon, cheese, and brioche bun all coalesced into a wonderful taste in my mouth. I have recently changed my diet to pescatarian (which cuts out meet and replaces it with seafood). I was so very pleased to find out that they had the Salmon Hash. At first I thought it wasn't going to taste as good as my normal fried egg sandwich order, but I was happily surprised. The Salmon rests on a bed of sautéed spinach with a side of breakfast potatoes. After trying the Salmon hash, that is my new favorite on the menu. 
This location is wedged between neighborhood odds and in stores and local restaurants.  The restaurant itself gives off a quaint but lively coffee house feel. We were sat a round wooden table with glasses and the cutest coffee mugs, making even the most anti-coffee drinker want to order some type of Hot beverage. The hustle and bustle of the servers and people was quite eye catching, as being able to people watch is very fun to me. 
Upon my first visit I was welcomed with bright smiles and servers seeing if there was anything we needed.  Our server was very well mannered young man and extremely attentive to me and my family's dining needs. Once greeted we were accommodated with a table for 6 right away. With a family my size it is important to find a place where we can all enjoy and be seated quickly. After taking our order the young man was very prompt with bringing drinks out the fastest he could. Normally it takes at least 25 minutes to prepare food at most establishments but our food was hot and ready to be served in 15-20 minutes. My family was very pleased with the promptness of our foods arrival. 
If looking for an accommodating breakfast or brunch spot in the St. Louis area, look no further than Half & Half. I would rate my overall experience 5 starts. The service was impeccable, the atmosphere very satisfying, and the food unbelievable. I would definitely go out of my way to try their food. I certainly will be making a visit the next trip home. [506]
name: Saenea

text: Layla is the place to go for a great burger! The area is also super cool! Service is great and never takes too long!
name: Jacob

text: The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Not bad for a quick meal. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The food was good and the service was easygoing. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: My favorite Thai restaurant, everything is delicious. One of my favorite dishes, however, is the boneless roasted duck w/ tamarind sauce.  If you ever get a chance, definitely try it, you won't be disappointed.
name: Brandon

text: Went today and door was locked with sign saying to go's only. Didn't bother but was irritated after 45 minute drive

text: Do not eat here! I ordered Uber eats from here after trying to order from bento (which is amazing) but Uber wasn't letting me place my order. text:
I've eaten here probably 20+ times now. 

They had a very rough start and it has leveled out... some people need to CHILL on negative feedback when a place first opens... 

This is a locally owned spot by a Franklin family. And I like supporting local! I've had some amazing experiences. I've had some tougher ones (mainly early on). I've seen gradual and continual improvement... and this is what's most important to me...

Benchmark has some of the BEST burgers around!! (And they have Blackbean and Chicken Burger options too!) I like mine medium rare and it's been cooked to perfection *every time* for the past few months... *mouth watering* YUM!!! Plus the bun they use now is awesome!! Super tasty fries... 

I also enjoy coming here for Happy Hour (2-8pm M-F). Most Appetizers $9 and under are 1/2 price! And $5 Wines, $1 off Beer... 

Honestly though, my favorite Happy Hour combo is:
Sweet potato fries w/ honey mustard and an Ice Cold BUSHWACKER!! (Benchmark is KNOWN for this drink... and I've tried about 15 other "Bushwacker" drinks... all were VERY sub par to Benchmark's!!

They also have really tasty wraps and salads! Oh! And their cheese dip is home made yumminess!

The atmosphere is upscale casual. Which I dig. There does appear to be some staffing glitches from time to time. Nothing horrendous. And it's consistently improving. 

Remember, it's a sports bar and restaurant. While I've absolutely brought my kids (and they have enjoyed it), it's a place designed mainly to eat food, drink and have adult conversation. 

Recap:
Burgers: 5 Stars
Drinks: 5 Stars
Atmosphere: 5 Stars (for a Sports Bar)
Service: 3.5-4 Stars (and upward trending!)
Overall: 4.5 Stars
name: Mike

text:
Sullivan's has been our go to NYE location for past seven years when we are in town.  Went with my SO and another couple for NYE.  Arrived at about 8:20p for our 8:30 p reservation and were seated at 8:35.  We were promptly greeted by server who said water was on the way, provided drink/wine menu, shared additional items that were not listed on menu and we placed our cocktail order (the ladies had the pineapple knockout Martinis, a woodford and I had a Hendrick's martini).

The drinks were out pretty quickly and we enjoyed a toast before the server returned to take our order.

On NYE (and other holidays) they do four course menu with starter, soup or salad, main and dessert for $75.  We all opted for the shrimp cocktail starter (other options were steak tartare, crab cake, steak egg roll and for an upcharge an oyster, shrimp, crab combo).  For salad/soups we ordered three wedge salads and one lobster bisque and for the mains two New York Strips, one Ribeye and one filet.  I also ordered a bottle of wine from their extensive (if over priced) list.  

Overall the meal was nicely paced, service was good but not great.  Orders came out correct and everyone was happy with their meals.  For me the highlight was the Shrimp Cocktail (five nice sized shrimp with tasty cocktail sauce) and my ribeye that was a perfectly prepared medium rare.

Will be interesting to see what happens with the sale of Sullivan's by Del Frisco's to Romano's Macaroni Grill.
name: Aaron

text:
Right down the street from a famous Nashville landmark, the Woodbine Krispy Kreme, is the House of Kabob. Their Persian food is what we decided to have for lunch last week. After we were seated, our server, Ahmad, brought us pita bread with feta cheese and sprigs of cilantro before he took our orders. My choice was the neesk (lentil soup) and the junior lamb shank. My wife ordered the chef's appetizer and the junior lamb kabob.

My neesk was spicy, but not overbearingly so. That lentil soup was a winner. The lamb shank was huge and fall off the bone tender. My shazari salad was fresh and crisp. The green rice on my plate could  easily have been more moist.It may have been cooked too long. Something bad happened, anyway. My wife loved her lamb kabob. It came with white rice that appeared to be moist and fluffy- unlike mine.

We each ordered s baklava for dessert. Mine was flavored with a mixture of sugar (not honey) and perhaps lemon juice. The filling was composed of mixed nuts (mainly walnuts). Ii contained about a gazillion calories and I never wanted to stop eating. Color me happy.

Our server, Ahmad, gave us excellent service from start to finish. My lentil soup and lamb shank were very good and my baklava was excellent. For all that, House of Kabob deserves five stars. Unfortunately, the crispy, crunchy green rice dragged their rating down to four stars. I'll be back if only to raise their rating.
name: Oscar

At this time we just needed to sleep. When I got up I immediately went to front desk and they said they would comp one night. I guess it could be worse. I was really looking forward to staying here in the future. The Nugget Resort and Casino could do a better job.

text:
Was in New Orleans for a bachelorette party back in August and I swear, this was the only place that was open late on a Sunday night that served oysters. I decided to cheat (vegetarian) since I'm in a town known for it's seafood and their Charbroiled oyster were TO DIE FOR. I wish I could describe to you the flavor and wonderfulness of them but you have to try them to understand the euphoria experienced.

text: I almost skipped this place because of the ratings and that would've been unfair. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. It was crowded but still moved along. Maybe expectations are just off for some people. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. For the price I expected more than this. text: My husband and I heard rave reviews about this spot. With us recently moving into the neighborhood, we knew we had to check it out for ourselves. This is everything you would expect from a classic corner bar- sports on TV, local crowd, and a no frills environment- yet it still delivered on great food at a super affordable price. People who came in after me were also served before me. They told me five to seven more minutes when I went up and asked.. it took an additional 15.

text: Super good food and drinks. Love the beach view. They have really good salads, especially the seafood salad in the tortilla bowl. Wish I lived a bit closer, I would definitely come in more. Prices are fair, service is nice, music gets a bit loud but we usually sit outside.

text: There were so many options for a cheese steak in  Reading Terminal Market, so we decided to try Molly Malloys.   We ordered 2 cheesesteaks,  fries, wing and the roasted Brussels sprouts- those were my favorite!!  Roasted in a truffle oil with garlic- absolutely delish!     The cheesesteak was good...not greasy, decent flavor.   But, obviously not the traditional cheesesteak Philly is known for- which was okay, since I didn't expect to get that anyways.  I give them 4 stars, because the food was all good.   Just, nothing was outstanding besides the Brussels sprouts.  Cost was a bit in the higher side compared to other options in the Market- but again, none of it was a surprise as you can see the cost of everything before you order.

text: Nice pub setting in Brandon. We tried the 6-minute egg, mussels, and fish and chips. All of the food was great. The server was very attentive - maybe too much so at some points. The food came out fast. The portion on the mussels was great. It's definitely enough for a meal. They even give you some garlicky bread to dip in the sauce. Seems like a cool place to hang out for happy hour.

Kung Bo Shrimp w/ Fried Rice and Cho Cho = WONDERFUL!!
Kung Bo Shrimp had large shrimp and lots of veggies. Shrimp fried rice had lots of large shrimp in it. Cho Cho was full of meat and shrimp. Everything was delicious. Waitress was great and kept my iced tea full. Will be putting China Doll into my lunch rotation!!

text:
The best hot pot in the city! Huge selection of items to choose from. Friendly and attentive staff. Huge parking space and you will never leave smelling like food after. Really good! 

If there was one thing they need to work on, it's having an organized line for when it's busy and people are entering. It could get chaotic!

text: Stopped in this afternoon for lunch. Food is all fresh and made from scratch and you can tell. The steak bowl special was fantastic. The steak was cooked perfectly, not dry or chewy like you get at most places. It was served over black beans and yellow rice, with a chipotle sauce and queso fresco. Staff at the bar were talkative and attentive. Aaron thanks for the great conversation today. Overall great experience! If you haven't been here make sure to check this place out! Definitely a must if you are in the area.

text: I went to the Steak n Shake on Gravois & Germania last night to get a chocolate shake. It took the waitress 10 minutes to seat me and the restaurant wasn't busy. She then proceeded to seat me in several dirty tables and I told her that was not acceptable. She said that the day shift waitresses didn't clean and it wasn't her job to clean after them. I told her that is not an excuse, it should be everyone's responsibility to make sure the restaurant is clean for guests. This location is continually understaffed and irresponsible. I've been to this location on a Friday evening and they were closed at 7pm with a sign on the door, no employees showed up to work, so they are closed.  The chain is truly is just a verge of filing for banktruptcy. Once a restaurant has to have coupons to draw in business, its a sign they will be closing the doors soon.
name: Paula

text:
I know it may seem cheesy and I don't care who judges me for it, but I love the Olive Garden! I'm generally not very into large chain restaurants, but Olive Garden is at the top of my short list of exceptions. I find the food to be solid and it's a nice place to have a group meal. I especially love this Olive Garden location because it's consistent in the food and the service is friendly (can be slow at time, but has always been friendly). 
My undisputed favorite item at the Olive Garden is The Zuppa Toscana and I've been known to go there just to eat unlimited soup. Next on my list is the 5 Cheese Ziti, a simple yet delicious indulgence. I've tried a few more elaborate features that are quite good, such a their wine braised beef with gnocchi, but the classics are a staple. I enjoy visiting during their promotions, particularly the "buy one take one" which is a great value. As someone who loves leftovers, I appreciate that I can order an entree, but am usually so full from that I have plenty of leftovers to take home. As far as desserts go, the black tie mousse cake you can't go wrong with if you like chocolate.
It may not be the finest of Italian cuisine, but this Olive Garden is a great place for a good meal and bang for your buck.
name: Brenda

text:
Skyler was the best

text: I decided to stop in for a coffee and a quick snack. What I ordered was good, the French puff was delicious and my coffee was good, as well. The low score is for the overall experience. I walked in and the employees was walking up from the back towards the front. I was greeted with "I'll be with you in a minute" it wasn't a friendly greeting. It was spoken very rude. I can tell she was punching in an order, but I was actually still deciding what I wanted, so waiting wasn't a big deal. Once she finished the order, she asked what I wanted. I ordered a iced vanilla lattes and a French Puff. There was really no exchange of words between her and I, but there didn't need to be any word exchange, body language and her attitude said it all. I felt like I had inconvenienced her. Almost like she was really annoyed I came in and ordered something. So, she throws my puff in a bag, hands it to me and hurried to make the drink. I was then handed a half assed, haphazard drink with milk and espresso going down the side... I didn't get a thank you, come again.... nothing. The customer service sucked! I grabbed my latte and a napkin and walked out. I won't be back. Horrible customer service.
