text: Stopped by after work because I was nearby and hungry. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot.
name: User

text:
An unpretentious Italian place with high-quality ingredients. I love that I can dress casually and also enjoy some incredible Italian food. We made a reservation, as this is a new, hip spot, but you can definitely also walk in. 

The staff were all friendly and we were quickly sat. Our server was great - efficient, funny and had good recommendations for us. I went for the Chicken Parmesan with a side of pasta (could also have chosen a side of vegetables or potatoes). You can't not get pasta in an Italian restaurant! At least that's my meter on how yummy the spot is. My friend got the Parmesan pasta, as they said that's one of the most popular dishes. It looked amazing as well! 

My food was great and I scarfed it up quickly. I like that the food comes out in normal portion sizes like real Italian food should. This is not a place where you'll get a plate of pasta the size of your entire body - this is a place where quality reigns over quantity and you leave feeling full, but not like you've overdone it. 

A lot of people were enjoying Aperol Spritzs and all we needed was the Italian coastline itself. Thanks, Maialina! I'll be back for a salad and lasagna! And the salmon... and... 

Last thing I'll leave you with: Maialina means pig in Italian. Show off on your future date here with that knowledge.
name: Niki

text: While I enjoy Penn Station, I will not visit the one on Pendleton Pike again. Quality of the food is poor. Order the veggie sandwich and they got it wrong.Then told I have to drive back with the sandwich to prove they messed up! Grilled vegetables were not edible and looked like they had been cooked hours ago. Would not recommend to folks who love Penn Station. Visit another location!

text: Top-quality soft serve. A "mini" version as big as a beer can (and priced about the same as the Sierra Nevada at Radio Cafe tonight). Honestly, though, the toppings do a disservice to the underlying ice cream. Not that they aren't good, as good as a packaged marshmallow from the supermarket or name-brand chocolate syrup is going to be. They're ok. But they're not blended in to the ice cream, and they are not liquified (the marshmallows, anyway) on top of it. So what you get is ice cream. And marshmallows. And some crumbled graham crackers (and not a lot of any of these). It's called The Campfire. But if you're going for the S'mores thing, a S'more is a beautiful, unified mess. Frisson's is not. But still excellent ice cream. And that's the important thing in the end.

text:
Another good addition to the El Charro family of restaurants and another got spot in Tucson.   On Broadway just west of 6th a few steps away from it's sister restaurant of Charro Steak.        We were downtown on a Friday afternoon for an event late in the afternoon.. Unfortunately doors do not open until 4pm, so we headed down the street for a beer at Thunder Canyon, before coming back at 4 to have something before our event.  We were seated in the main dining room and not the bar area.  Unfortunately we were not given Happy hour menu or pricing, so can not comment on that.  

We opted for Artichoke al' horo, which was well prepare and loved the stuffing in the artichokes... Something different than the normal
Asparagustos, which was delicious  and 2 Brazino Veracruz, which I believe is a seabass.  Oh My Gosh, it as so well prepared, not over or under cooked and very light for a warm spring afternoon.      We had a bit of time before our event and opted to try the Champagne fried strawberries, with a whiskey cream glaze.   Very light dessert and tasted well.. I only wish we had better strawberries in Tucson, never as flavorful as the pacific northwest.

Definitely will be back.  Thank you Flores family for another hit in Tucson.

I think flamestone has been an awesome addition to the area.

text:
First visit here: one waiter, full restaurant, menus and beverage served within 15 minutes. Waiter spilled iced tea on my husband. Gave him lots of slack because it was so full and he was managing well, if a bit on the slow side.

Food was fabulous. Papaya salad, green curry w/chicken and some spicy beef dish...all great. Service was too slow at best. Waiter said that waitress was out sick.

Second visit, 2 weeks later:  Seated promptly along with a table of 4. Restaurant had about 4 other tables finishing up. One waiter and one bus person? who was comically slow...seriously, a sloth could move faster...he seemed lost and confused the entire time we were there.
We got menus after about 15 minutes, then the sloth gave us beverages about 10 min. later. Still waiting to order.

Now, a table of 2 and a single table come in. We are still sipping tea and waiting....still giving the waiter slack for being alone. Time ticks on. Single woman gets her food....The table of two decide to move to another table and two more tables of two come in. One is seated right behind us and one within my line of sight. Husband told me that the one behind was not going to be patient. Meanwhile, the original table of 2 get their order taken and the table of 4 get their order taken and we are still waiting for someone, anyone to take our order.

We arrived at 1 pm....it is now about 45 minutes later. The table of 4 that arrived with us have food delivered, the table of two that arrived after us, get their food, the table I can see, get up and leave. We still have not had order taken, we would have complained but were being considerate of an overworked waiter with a sloth for helper. 

The table behind us start to loudly complain.( called that one)..after being there for 10 minutes. They get their order taken.....(side note, if it had be us and the situation was reversed, we would have told the waiter that that other table was there before us and should have their order taken first....but that is just us..) At this point, we get up and walk out. I had wanted to walk after 30 minutes, but husband was uncomfortable ( out of character) and wanted to pay for the tea. The waiter saw us leave, tried to say he would get to us....good thing my husband spoke with him, I would not have bothered to explain or apologize. It was ridiculous. 

We got in our car exactly 1 hour after arriving in the restaurant. Never having order taken and other tables arriving long after we did, were eating and finishing their food.
BS....we will never go there again. period. Too bad too because we really liked the food.
name: Sara Sybil

text: I hate giving locally owned places bad reviews and maybe our experience was a fluke but it was not a good one. We were seated in the front, where the sun was blazing it, felt like 100 degrees, we asked to be moved elsewhere, they did. Kind of a dingy whole in the wall, which doesn't usually scare me. They weren't busy at 6 on a friday....the chips and salsa were probably the best I have ever had and I have had a lot of mexican food! It is my fav...........the young man serving us was friendly. On to the bad part: even tho not busy it took forever for the food to come out. It was ALL cold. the rice, beans, the main food. My beans were very bland. My boyfriend's fajitas came on a plate, not sizzling skillet and they were COLD! I ordered pork carnitas, which for me is chunks and flash  fried. this was shredded pork. The pork had a bone upon first bite. OK, I get it, it happens. 2nd bite, a piece of round bone, like a socket or something. Then I found another piece, while digging. Appetite gone! We asked for manager, explained the cold food, showed her all the bones. They apologized offer to get us something else, we declined. we asked for the check, she comped the bill, which I appreicate. I did leave a tip for the young man, as this was not his fault. It is a shame too b/c those chips were amazing!

text:

Until I went about a month ago, the menu change was not a great one, the chicken and waffles was my favorite item on the old menu it was sweet, savory, large portioned etc, but the new is very basic! Then the french toast has changed at well wasnt happy. Please bring back the old menu!!! The positive though, still a great atmosphere and great music.
name: Chris

text: The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Pretty happy with it overall.
name: User

text: One of my favorite restaurants of all time. Appetizers all the way to desserts are phenomenal here. Try the Oreos. Absolutely to die for. I would love to give you guys five stars since you guys are my favorite, but truthfully speaking I almost gave you guys a three. Soho sushi servers have become rude and careless. I can hear them cursing and speaking sexually about women. "I would hit that" does not allow anyone to enjoy their food.
name: Stacey

text:
Our room was fairly priced, clean, and comfortable. 
Check in staff were quite pleasant and welcoming. 

I ordered a pork soup as an appetizer for dinner. The broth was rich and and quite tasty. The crab cakes, garlic mashed potatoes and green beans entree was also quite nice. Our server seemed inexperienced but still capable of doing the task at hand. 

The complimentary breakfast was sub par. The granola was a tad stale, the coffee quite acidic, and the baked goods rather bland. 

It's a one minute walk from here to the theatre for an evening performance which makes seeing a show here doable for those of us who live hours away! So convenient!
name: Jennifer

text:
Came here for brunch with my parents. We made a reservation ahead because we heard about how crowded the place gets. When I was making the reservation two weeks ago, it was already pretty full! Make sure to make a reservation ahead of time. 

The food itself was pretty good. We got a plate with eggplant, some kebab chicken, hummus, and bread pizza. The bread pizza was really good, was perfectly flavored. The eggplant plate with pita was okay. The eggplant thing was a little similar to hummus, but it was a little bitter. The pita was baked to a really puffy shape and was delicious though. The chicken was okay. The salad and fries that came with the kebab plate were surprisingly good tho. 

This is a pretty good place to bring guests to when they visit Philly for brunch!
name: Nina

text: Good food. However, overpriced. They give you the same portion, no matter what size you order. Bad customer service. Staff was not pleasant at all. When we asked if the portion size was right, they responded very rudely. Restaurant has many flies, probably due to the messy tables that don't get cleaned. The tables were sticky and had stains on them. The floor fans, and ceiling was very dirty. The eating area needs a major update. We usually get brushfire to go. However, we will not be returning here again due to the staffs inability to at least appear like they care about customers. A simple smile and apology would have gone a long way, even if you didn't fix the portion size. I try to support locally owned businesses, but expect them to show more pride in their restaurant than a chain restaurant. Save some money and try Dickey's BBQ instead.
name: Paul

text:
Not Marriott's finest property. We stayed overnight here on a recent trip to Philadelphia, wanting to be downtown and near all the action. The first thing you'll notice if you drive in is that parking is hard to find. We ended up having to circle around several one way streets to find our way to the parking lot across the street from the hotel. When you first enter the hotel, you'll probably notice how it's massive. While many Marriott properties seem big but have personal touches, this one is just huge and somewhat impersonable. 

The rooms had everything you would expect, but were dated. Definitely past their prime and ready for a renovation. I guess the saving grace was how they had the smart tv with streaming audio and video. 

Word to the wise: avoid the pool. It did not seem clean the day we were there, with cloudy water, grime on the wall, and garbage everywhere. There is also no hot tub.
name: Mike

text: I'm here at least a couple times per week. Super chill. Unless Ed catches you with something other than a Java Station item on your table then he'll be an asshole. Rebecca is amazing. I hope she never leaves. Definitely a weird place but I love it. I bring friends here often.
name: Geoffrey

text: Really enjoyed our lunch. The food and choices were excellent. Service and price were also good and the portion sizes were good. We would return again. Added bonus was the exellent store with lots of goodies!
name: Denise

text: Best place in Nashville for country ham, eggs, biscuits, preserves.  Only wish they still had the homemade butter and a little thinner cut on the country ham.  Their lunch and dinners are fantastic as well. Meatloaf or chicken n'dumplings are both winners.  The homemade salad dressings are fabulous.
name: Megan

text: Popular restaurant. Decent food. Huge menu selection. I would make a reservation in weekends. Gets busy. They also have an outdoor sitting area with a live entertainer in weekends.
name: T

text:
Located in the heart of the bar scene of Fishtown, the Fishtown Brewpub boasts an aesthetic of Irish sports bar meets hipster gastro pub, but with slightly more upscale feel. Compared to some of the other tasting rooms in the area, it's also much quieter. It's definitely a place to check out if your sole focus is on beer tasting.

There's a nice variety in the beer selection in terms the different types and ABVs, so getting a flight is most definitely recommended. My personal favorites are the C4, Modest Monk, and the award-winning Beatrice Marie. The Modest Monk is a lower ABV Belgian ale that's packed with lots of flavor. It's got a nice medium body with a smoky after taste. The C4, though a much higher ABV IPA is very refreshing and citrusy. The Beatrice Marie is also incredibly refreshing (though it might not look it due to its dark color). It also has a bold citrus taste, but the oats and lactose make it very smooth. 

The food is about average and a little overpriced. It appears they're attempting to put a ritzier spin on traditional bar fare. The brewpub burger is okay; while I can appreciate the creativity with the everything English muffin, it's small and not quite as juicy as I'd like for a burger. Definitely not worth the $13. If you want fries, there's also an upcharge. These are $5 at happy hour and for that price, I won't complain. 


Overall impressions:
Beers: 9/10
Food: 6/10
Atmosphere: 7/10
Location: 10/10
Service: 8/10
name: Vanessa

text:
I live at this place. Great food. Fast service. What more could you ask for!!!

Regardless of when I come in here, the line is short. The fries are fresh. I'm not sure why this place has such a low rating. I'm picky about my fast food, and this place always comes through with deliciousness and Great service.
name: Arielle

text:
Renamed D D's and not good. Stinky, cancer causing vanilla glade plug-in at the door. Dirty dishes piled on the bar and nearly every table filled with dirty dishes. Only one TV on tuned to TelaNovella. There are 3 TV's.
Iced tea tasted like pool chemicals. No limes with the fish tacos. Can't smell the food for the glade plugin. No bowls for the salsa you have to squirt from bottles. Chips taste burned. 
Go to a real Mr. Baja Fish where they care about the customer. Try the new Mr. Baja Fish Express at Wetmore and First.
name: Astro

text: Great local bakery.  We are staying in Collinsville for a baseball tournament and found this place.  Good selection of doughnuts and pastries.  Glaze are like little pillows of heaven.  The people working there are really friendly and welcoming.  Definitely worth going a few miles out of your way.  Really light and fluffy.
name: Dave

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Food was fresh and service was quick. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: Best Thai food in St. Louis county.  Dine in or carry out, all awesome.  Big menu to choose from.  If you like Thai food check this place out, even if you don't like Thai food check it out.  You won't regret it.
name: Joe

text:
This place is blast!!!! Food is awesome.... we had burgers and pulled pork.... lickin our lips!!!!
Alexis was soooo cool!!!! Cant beat this place!
name: Kate

text: Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Food was good and came out fast. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: Everything was delicious. You know it's good when my one year old son devoured the homemade spaghetti (he's a picky eater). The cocktails were made well, the grilled octopus was on point, the brick oven pizza was amazing and the rosemary ricotta with bread was yummy!  Can't wait until we come here again...and they're pet friendly so my fur baby can enjoy dinner with us (always a plus).
name: Kimberly

text: I've always heard about this place and have seen all the locals go here, but this was my first time going there. Overall had a great experience, enjoyed my drink and burger!
name: Mark

text:
I highly recommend this restaurant! This restaurant is in a shopping strip and I personally think its a great location. The restaurant itself is small. I also do not think they can have more than one big party at a time. There was a big table that I saw when we first walked in that fit about 8 people. The seating it limited which is probably the downfall of this restaurant, I hope that it will expand because the employees are great and the food is even better. We were seated in minutes which I was surprised since it was a Friday night. Blue Duck is also BYOB!! So bring that beer or wine! 

We ordered: 

Blue Duck Fries ($13)- hand cut fries tossed in duck fat. Smoked Gouda Cheese sauce, shredded duck confit topped with scallions-- WOW!! I will come back just for the fries! I LOVE FRIES AND THIS IS PROBABLY NOW MY FAVORITE

Wild Boar Meatloaf ($19)- whipped in bacon, red bliss potato mash, baby heirloom carrots and herb brown gravy-- I wanted to try something different and of course this did not disappoint! There were 3 big slices of meatloaf covered in gravy and my favorite part was the bottom where the mash potato was! I LOVED THE MASH! They should def offer this as a side because I would get loads of this for myself lol  

Fried Chicken ($19)- pickled- brined, cream Swiss chard & bacon, mac and cheese with tabasco honey-- my hubby order this and he loved it there was nothing left on his plate which is strange because he usually takes some home. He said he really enjoyed his meal and he also really liked the mac and cheese. 

BLUE DUCK! thank you for existing and I will be back more friends and family! Can't wait to see what other specials they have to offer.
name: Lizabeth

text: Sauce On The Side is my new STL favorite! I was incredibly impressed with how friendly and accommodating the staff was. I can tell these guys love what they do. And the calzones were so cheesy and delicious! Thank you guys, you have gained a loyal customer!
name: Nathan

text: This place was recommended  by numerous people and did not disappoint. When having your cafeteria style atmosphere one usually is hoping for really good food, and that's what you get. I ordered the golden fried shrimp po-boy and had a side of rum cake. The amount of perfectly fried shrimp was amazingly delicious. And you can definitely taste the rum and the rum cake. So moist!  This place will be on my list for po boy every time I come back to New Orleans.
name: Al

text: Worst run city event I've seen in 30 years. Signs for cocktails but none available,  volunteers said they dont know why booze wasn't delivered.  No cold water at all, a few hydration stations but 90 degree water. Ridiculous maze, 100 miles of metal fencing with 2 ways in or out and not a single sign to tell you where. The few people that were there at 8:00 friday night had to jump multiple temporary fences to get in or out. This might have worked in Chesterfield but we expect far better than this in the city.
name: Mick

text: I ordered last minute call from out of twn from Los Angeles, with a rush order speciality cake to be delivered to my fiancé in NO. Not only did Chaya make it happen effortlessly but also sent pics of the sample of the cake to confirm order and they delivered it without problems my fiancé love the cake it was delicious it looked amazing bayou bakery is one of a kind!
name: Nicole

text: Food is AWESOME!! If you like spicy this is the spot!! My husband loves spicy and he was absolutely impressed! New favorite spot! We will be back! Prices are fine for a family of five. Portions are big too.
name: Jessica

text: I have heard about Sammy's for a while. My Roast Beef Sandwich was good. The Soup was Cream of Asparagus and it was not ok. The best thing I had was the French Fries. Roast Beef was sloppy but parts were cold. Ordered the food and it took way too long . After I ordered they got really busy. It was about that time when I realized that they obviously forgot my order because it took the 25 minutes to get it to me. The longer I waited the longer the line grew. 20 people in line, one register open. Did I mention the girl in the  black Beanie taking phone orders with the attitude? The one who acted as if she was doing me a favor by have me wait for a cold Roast Beef Po-Boy ! I guess it was me, but I was expecting more. Good Po-Boys are a dime a dozen in New Orleans. What separates the good ones from the great ones is Attitude, Bread and Service. Sammy's lacked 2 out of 3 today.

text: The wait was longer than it should've been for a pretty normal dinner service. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot.

text:
Reservation on Mother's Day, tough day, but reservation was after rush. It took 40 minutes to seat (a couple of free apps givin). With it being Mother's Day this was understandable.

-no bread offered
-slow to refill drinks, water
-one member of party did not get food until all others were done, no one really came over to check on party.
-wait staff thought the difference between tortellini and tortelloni was pronunciation when they are two separate types of pasta(close but different). When I ordered the tortelloni on the menu, it was repeated back as tortellini. At this point I asked which it was, waiter said "tomato-tamato" and was argumentative when I stated there was a difference. A St Louis waiter at an Italian restaurant should know his menu and the difference between the two.

Food was fine, equated to an expensive Macaroni Grill with snobby, undertrained staff.

Won't be back

text: I took a group of students here while in town for an event. The line was forever long and they were groaning. By the time we left they were all smiles taking about wanting to come again. The staff handled the high amount of traffic beautifully. There was something for everyone. Turnover on tables was fantastic so we had a place to sit. I, personally, had a white slice and am eggplant parmesan slice. Fantastic taste, nice, thin, foldable crust. Perfect. They live up to the 'NY Style'.
name: Jen

text: Had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. You can tell they care about customer experience here. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly.
name: User

text: We went Thursday  April 25th. Great food. I was born to in St. Pete. My parents took my brother and me maybe 60 years ago. Great dining experience sitting outside. Great food.
name: Jin

text:
This place has a very nice ambiance, and the food was nice, but nothing was particularly memorable. If you are in the neighborhood and looking for a spot to eat, this is not bad. I had the crawfish grits, and that was good, but nothing particularly special to write home about. My cousin had the BBQ shrimp, and that was similarly good. 

The thing that is worth mentioning is the dessert. We got the bread pudding and pecan pie. My cousin never had it before, and she became a fan. It had a good crust with a chewy and soft middle. Meanwhile the pecan pie had that goo to pecan ratio I am always looking for! 

So while I would not seek this place out in particular, I would not mind coming again.

text: We were so excited to go here. We went straight to the hostess desk to wait on a table.  We stood there for 15 minutes four girls stood there like they were clueless.  Finally I said to one of them we would like to eat here.  With a blank stare they didn't even say a word to us. She finally said we are on a wait.  Really the place was half empty bot ok . Then she proceeds to tell us well if you want to sit by the bar you can .  We went and did that so we sat there for 20 minutes and no one ever came over to us. Never again! We left and will never go back.

text: Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. A very pleasant experience. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text: Zero stars if possible! Terrible service and mediocre food. Walked in for a take out order, and it took 10 minutes before anyone was able to take my order. Then it took another 20 minutes to make one sandwich. To note, there was ONE table of THREE people in the entire restaurant! Waste of time and money! Go elsewhere!

text: Server was inattentive, the young lady who brought my glass of wine did not know what she brought me. Meal came out of kitchen approximately 3 minutes after our salads were served. Filet was tough and stringy, ordered medium rare and it was very rare. Vegetables were 1/3 over cooked, 1/3 perfectly cooked, and 1/3 raw. Prime rib was very nicely done. Nice ambience, and no one thing was disastrous but overall left disappointed.

text: My buddy and i each did the Karagee bowl and agreed this was an average or slightly above average meal.  Portion was small but adequate.  Large pickled radishes overpowered the other ingredients.  Next stop @ Armature i will be shopping elsewhere.
name: Scott

text: I've always had a great experience at Fulins in Mount Juliet but, tonight was exceptional!  My fiance and I got there at 8:50pm not realizing that they were going to close at 9pm.  We went in to just say hello to the bartender Christy and the owner Susan.  They insisted that we stay for a meal as my fiance was craving sushi.  Us being in the food service industry, we realize that normally employees have had a long day/evening and just want to go home....NOT THEM!  They treated us so well beyond expectations and their food menu and meal was also exceptional!  I highly recommend going to Fulins in Mount Juliet and we will be visiting them more often!  Thank you again Christi and Susan!
name: Neal

text: Purchased the XL Pack and 1 lbs of meat pack. The meat included 1 lbs of the pulled pork, brisket, and 2 lbs of ribs. We ordered mac and cheese, baked beans, slaw, and potato casserole for the sides. The positives: food was excellent 5 stars. Meat was tender and moist and the sides were excellent. The negatives: prices vs portion is 0 stars. An order of $100 spent should have included another large bag. Each person (family of 6) got a single spoonful of each side. The actual portion we received should have been $60 and not the price we paid. We will not be spending our money on this overpriced business again. Also the "potato casserole" is mashed potatoes. Too cheap to make the side portions bigger on an already cheap food to make.
name: Ashley

text:
My favorite place to get Thai food during lunch! Oh my gosh, they are so fast and courteous. I've been here a handful of times but haven't made a well deserved review yet. Also, love that it's close by my work!

Even with the lunch rush, we didn't feel rushed or ignored. We were seated promptly and handed two bowls of soup before even ordering, haha. While going through the menu, I casually looked around the room, locked eyes with a waitress, and boom, not even a minute later, she came to ask if we were ready to order. We weren't, but I was impressed! She helped answer a question my boyfriend had.

We ordered two lunch specials - mango curry and panang curry, mild, and with pork as our meat. Mmm, so, so good and so filling. The mango also tasted fresh and sweet! I was satisfied and full with my own portion. The lunch special comes with a small appetizer, salad, and rice. It adds a nice variety to your meal. 

We arrived around 12:00 pm and left at 12:30 pm. How quick is that? A great place to get an inexpensive meal that will leave you coming back for the service and taste!
name: Jennifer

text: Went for dinner tonight with a group of friends. Highly disappointed. The food and service is subpar. Will definitely not be going back to eat.
name: Pia

text:
First let me say the band playing was phenomenal!! 

The food was to die for, I got the Chicken Fried Chicken with the Mac and cheese and the creamed collards on the side. They were to die for!! The chicken was juicy and we'll seasoned, the collards were different from what I'm used to but I have never had them creamed, they had maybe bacon and carrots in them and it was surprisingly delicious!! The Mac and cheese was the only thing I was not really enthused with as it was not baked but it was good for what it was. 

My boyfriend got the chicken and rib combo as it comes. I was able to taste the ribs and they were good, fall off the bone with good flavor to them.
name: Azraelle

text: Nothing was terrible, it just never really came together for me. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. So yeah, nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. maybe I just came on an off day. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. For the price I expected more than this.
name: User

text: I ordered take out from this place twice and it was excellent. I love their veggie summer rolls! they are fresh and super flavorful. My partner had a rice dish and a vermicelli one and he was very happy about it. We were both impressed by our fresh the food was! We ordered it online and the food was already waiting for us when we got there! definitely a place worth trying.
name: Elisabetta

text: The absolute BEST! We come with our young son and are never disappointed. Not only is our family welcomed with open arms by Anna but the food is stellar. I almost don't want the public to know about this fabulous Newtown spot. It's our families favorite. The food, the ambience, and the employees make this place a top restaurant in Newtown. The only problem could be that it's not big enough. So much love. Absolutely amazing.
name: Lauren

text: Came to Nashville for a bachelorette party and this place was highly recommended. Had to wait about e0 mins to get in in the rain. Worth it! Highlight is the Nashville hot chicken and the grits. If you're a grits person you HAVE TO TRY THEM.
name: Caitlin

text: The fries were probably the best part of the meal, honestly. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. For the price I expected more than this. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Anyway, the experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. So yeah, we shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: Great place to eat and drink. You can choose from domestic beer to craft beer. They have a small liquor selection as well. The food was also great. Would be a nice place to come in and watch some sports, you can sit outside as well.
name: Anthony

text: So-I guess I can't add anything shockingly different than the other positive reviews.  But-having spent time in Italy, Coco's nails the dining experience.  Kind of disorienting to walk in and feel like you're standing in a small Italian market/deli.  But that's the way it is.  A fresh cheese/meat cooler, and lots of other food items for purchase.  The gelato was very good-some of the best I've had outside of Italy or Germany.  I used to walk from one gelato stand to another.  Yummy-my weakness.  This was truly a whipped/airy/light ice cream delight.  On to the food.  We had bruschetta as an appetizer and it was very good.  I had a margherita pizza.  It was thin and crispy and the fresh mozzarella with basil and tomato sauce was fantastic.  About 3 people from our group had the Timpano - an amazing layered/lasagna pasta baked creation with a whole boiled egg in it!  They were raving about it.  I will go back to try other awesome things on the menu.  The place is crowded as are most great places to eat.  The service was fast and efficient and the prices were reasonable (if you were wondering.)
name: Rick

text: I went for lunch today and I got the 7in deep dish supreme. The sauce was robust and the crust was not soggy and buttery. I have been to Chicago and I felt it was authentic. I really enjoyed my lunch and the service was prompt.
name: Klash

text:
I wrote a kind letter to the corporate office concerning the Non Handicap stall. They replied with a $40 coupon and hoped they would become my favorite restaurant again. REALLY Ruby Tuesdays. A gift card?
For one, was Ruby Tuesdays anyones "Favorite Restaurant" ever? I mean really.
name: Laurie

text: I wanted to like this more than I actually did. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. The staff seemed tired but still polite. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Kind of landed in the middle for me. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Food was good and came out fast. The whole meal felt kind of uneven.
name: User

text: Shout out to Wes the bartender! Super nice guy who deserves the recognition. I hate using Groupons but he was super cool about it. (Remember folks to tip on the ORIGINAL amount!) Food was decent but I would just come back to be waited on by Wes! Thanks for making my evening a good one.
name: Lindsey

text:
This was my first time and I was excited to see one of my favorite 80's movies on the big screen. Walking in, we went to the bar and had a delicious old fashioned and another shareable drink mage with ginger beer. They both were fantastic. Everyone was friendly and the atmosphere was spot on with the speak easy style. 
In the screening room, we ordered pretzel loaf with two yummy sauces and burgers. The food was amazing. I could eat a plate of the thick butcher block bacon on its own! 
The seats were way more comfortable than they looked; however, we were lucky and had no one seated near us so I was able to cross my legs and as stretch out, per se.
My only negatives are towards the end of the movie, the kitchen was very loud and you could hear dishes and talking, which was distracting.
This is a great place to watch cult movies and make you feel like you are in a friend's screening room. I love the concept of this business and will be back!
name: Alison

text: Best Vegan spot in STL. We had The Big Mak and chilli cheese fries, crack tacos and Chicken Sandwich. All were amazing. The service was fast and the staff was very friendly. Highly recommended for Vegans or anyone wanting to eat a delicious plant based option. We will be back.
name: Cherice

text: Was in the area and decided to check out Blue Sushi. The restaurant is so cool inside - great ambiance. We had miso soup and a couple of sushi rolls. The sushi was fresh and delicious.
name: Natalie

text: So happy I stumbled upon this place. The quality of food here surpasses all the other Mediterranean bowls & halal cart places that have been my previous go-tos. You can add as many toppings as you want at no extra cost, service is friendly, and the ambiance is perfect for a quick fast casual lunch! My favorite is the Naya rice bowl with half chicken shwarma and half kafta lamb kebob (yes, they let you split your protein!).
name: Ramya

text:
Decent sports overall...pool tables are nice, shuffle board, darts, a lot of big screen TVs...

That's where the good ends.  Service is the worst ever.  You can go in, sit at a table, be seen be ALL the servers/tenders and manager, and STILL get 0 service 20 minutes later.

Doubt they will be open 3 months from now.
name: Rich

text: Ahhhh there food is average at best. I would rather go to Jeans pizza! If I do go to Shef's don't get the pizza! It's freaking terrible!!!! Buffalo wings has no flavor to them just hot sauce! Counter girls are rude and nasty!! Just a horrible pizza shop! STAY AWAY!!
name: Terrell

text: Very clean and excellent service. Food is very good. I had the tamales and the were outstanding. Never have had a bad experience here
name: John

text: My husband (vegetarian), myself (vegan) and daughter (vegan) went here for brunch today based on a tip that there were vegan options! I got the Breakfast Shawarma and my husband got the Veggie Toast. We also got 2 orders of Homefries and our dishes came with a side of fruit. My daughter shared my dish, ate the fruit and homefries. Everything was so fresh and delicious!!  My husband said his was amazing and I loooved the Shawarma. My daughter has been sick and very picky with food, but she devoured everything. We will definitely be back for more!! The only reason I didn't give 5 stars is because there's meat on the menu, but am so so grateful for the vegan options! Thank you so much for bringing more variety to the area :)
name: Jackie

text:
Stopped by Helena Avenue Bakery to check out what the fuss what all about for the breakfast offerings.

I decided to have some of their fresh roasted coffee along with the Bacon, Cheddar & Egg Biscuit sandwich.  The menu doesn't do it justice: this is a gourmet sandwich, complete with a friend egg, bacon, cheddar cheese, greens, tomato, and a delicious tomato roulade that has a slight little kick in to to wake up the taste buds.  

The sandwich is so tasty, with a wonderfully baked fluffy biscuit and a portion definitely big enough beyond a breakfast bite.  

The decor is simplistic.  Rustic tables with a quiet outdoor patio, and several large shared wooden tables inside.  

I'll be back, and next time, I'll try the desserts.
name: Randy

text: Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Maybe other people have better luck here. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. For the price I expected more than this. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh.
name: User

text: The vibe is cool and the Pizza is FIRE!!! I'm vegetarian so I ordered the "Hippie"  Would definitely recommend others to try it.  This is my new pizza spot.
name: Carmen

text: No big complaints, just a nice meal. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Nice little spot, decent portions too. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Glad we tried it.
name: User

text: Tonight I went to New Orleans Hamburger & Seafood on Clearview I wanted the southern thing po boy but it wasn't on the menu they've taken it off the menu but they still serve it but I didn't know that and I told the cashier that I was looking for the Southern thing Po Boy by this time I had already order the Bayou pasta which had a cheesy Tangy sauce which was good with a sweet tea my food always tastes good but for some reason that food always bothers my stomach I very seldom visit New Orleans Hamburger & Seafood it's always that way even if I have a burger no matter what I eat there even with the southern thing but I love the something thing Po Boy but I think this is going to be my last visit I think my last visit there was about 6 or 8 months ago and I'm still having the same problem New Orleans Hamburger & Seafood you will be missed.
name: Regina

text:
Stopped here for lunch and were able to sit outside. I had the cobb salad with friend chicken! It was really good though the ranch dressing was kind of blah. Drinks were good. Prices reasonable.
It was fun people watching any way.
name: Berri

text: The food was a bit over priced but that isn't the bad part. Got fried pickles, and both me and my girlfriend got a burger. Pickles were so thin and the breading was so thick it was tasteless. It came with "white BBQ sauce" which was more like honey mustard. The burgers came our and they looked appetizing enough. They tasted ok. But we have both been feeling awful since we left. Would not go back and would not recommend
name: Dylan

text: Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Also, service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. Also, i liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. not sure I'd order the same thing again. Not bad for a quick meal. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text:
Upon entering this restaurant, my father and I received an Indian greeting "Namaste," from the owner. This is how you invite an "athidi" to your home. I Do not remember the last time an Indian owner greeted us in that manner. Then we saw the beautiful Buddha idol symbolizing the "satwik" food we will soon appreciate.
There was melodious instrumentals in the background along with television screens.
That introduction itself speaks a lot about this place.....wide variety of dishes and with vegan labels.
Everything tasted like it was homemade.
I only posted a few photos....there was a lot more there.
Come and check out the ambience and appreciate the food offered here.
name: Sarat

text: I work right down the street from Sharkeez and regularly enjoy their happy hour. El-dizzle is a great GM and is always on point. Check out their specialty cocktail list. They love making complex craft drinks and if you adjust your food order to exactly how you like it. They'll probably pick the sesame seeds off your bun if you asked. ENJOY
name: Megan

text:
Came here for breakfast with a girlfriend and we really enjoyed the healthy options here. They offer a wide variety of breakfast dishes to smoothies, milkshakes, lattes, and even frozen yogurt! We opted for the make your own omelette dish with a side of toast. Prices were reasonable, omelette was good and lattes were just right. Nothing to complain here!

Definitely would come back if I'm ever looking for breakfast in the area again!
name: Jenny

text: Gluten free bread was an added bonus to well cooked eggs, home fried potatoes and for the carnivore with me the bacon was excellent. I would prefer potatoes not deep fried but they are tasty.
name: Kathy

text: Return customers; we come here for most birthdays; as always, the service was fantastic and the food was delicious; more than we could eat so we get to enjoy leftovers tomorrow for lunch; Wayne was very entertaining as well as efficient, and our server Kevin was spot on and incredibly customer service oriented; we will be coming back again.
name: Kenneth

text: The Spicy Belly is a Korean/Fusion restaurant that has great ideas, but unfortunately, the Korean-side of the dishes have a bit to improve on. On a Friday night, luckily this place wasn't too crowded - their happy hour was from 9-10:30, and they have a plethora of beers and cocktails. My friend and I ordered the fried kimchi over white rice (happy hour), Mo-Bay Bimbap, and a Fusion Burger. We started off our meal with complimentary banchan (side dishes), which was a really nice touch - the garbanzo beans and the pickled carrots were too salty, but the potato salad was good. The Fried Kimchi over rice was also pretty good, especially since the fried kimchi was topped with some sweetness and rice was made well. Unfortunately, the kimchi itself was also a tad too salty and could've been better if it had more of the sour kimchi taste. My Mo-Bay Bimbap was okay - not too complex in flavors, but had a great medley of vegetables; I tried putting some of their gochujang sauce in there, but the sauce itself was also a bit too salty rather than with the complexity of most Asian flavors. My friend's Fusion Burger looked amazing and was big! The fries that came along with it were actually one of the best fries I had.
name: Jacqueline

text: service was friendly, just kinda slow once the room filled up. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Will be back. No big complaints, just a nice meal. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text: Absolutely amazing. One of my favorites. The service is some of the best out there and the food is mouth watering. If you have not been you need to try. 11/10 recommend. I love it here
name: Mason

text: The first few bites were promising and then it kind of leveled out. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. The music was louder than it needed to be. I'd maybe go back, but I'd order differently next time. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: I'm a bit torn on this one. In past posts I've stated that Asian Restaurants aren't getting anymore passes while I chalk it up to Culture or acceptable behavior while I spend hard earned money. That said more Stars might have been possible but dropping off food and never returning is not the way to earn them. I also had to get her attention by saying , "Excuse me". From across the Restaurant she chose to have me ask her for Hot Oil/Chili Oil. From across the Restaurant! After swinging by at the speed of sound she was gone with wind, never asking me if I needed anything else. The Pho is said to be (according to a Patron I asked in the Parking lot after leaving) is the best in the area. The Pho was good but I didn't get, "Best in the area good". In all honesty I'm having a hard time deciding if I'm going to subject myself to another round of being ignored and disappointed. The Jury is still out on this one. Reviews we're mixed with most being positive. Maybe they were having s bad morning. Perhaps this is business as usual!
name: Brian

text:
Well, this was my first time back since my last review and I thought it was fair to update my review and rating.  My 8 year old nephew had a choice of any places for dinner for his birthday and he did choose here (he loves all you can eat taco).  So suffice to say I had my hesitation due to my previous experience.  My sister has been here a few times and did reassure me things are better.
I'm happy to say that things have changed a lot!  First, our server was awesome in both service and personality, a huge change from the server I had last time here.  I don't do buffets much in this city since not an all you can eat type person, as well I don't hold buffet foods to much high standard, just as long as it's decent and good.  Nothing was mind blowing but everything I tried was better than last time.  I really did like the roast beef, nice and tender I'm the middle.  The last time it was dry and no taste.  My brother in law loved the mussels.  Overall the food was better than last time I was here.  Not sure if new management or owners but good job on the changes!  This is more a 3.5 stars (wish Yelp let you rate half stars too).
name: Wil

text: I'm really surprised at how bad this visit is. I've been here since 4:05. It's 4:52. I just got my cocktail 10 minutes ago. They rang it in twice and still forgot about it. Then they brought the food. You can tell the chicken was either over fried or was fried awhile ago and sat a little bit. And then the sauce was thrown over it. Also if you like traditional deviled eggs, don't order these. They have a salsa or some kind of red sauce on them with some cold candied bacon. Maybe the Northerners like it, but not me! Lol!! The staff is really nice and let me order a burger. I hope it turns out well! I visited once before and it was really good. But they have slipped. I won't be back! I can spend my calories elsewhere lol
name: Latoya

text: Good fresh food. Sit at the counter for conversation with others. Orders take a while, however it's good stuff. Omelettes, OJ, sausage, crepes, can't miss.
name: Edward

text: I brought my boyfriend here this morning for a Valentine's breakfast! It's a smaller cafe, definitely has more of the cozy feel! We were greeted promptly by staff upon walking in, as well as by our waiter once seated. I would definitely say the service was top notch! Checking in on us, offering more coffee, coming to get our order without having to waive the waiter down. Overall service was great! The food was certainly delicious as well. My boyfriend ordered a breakfast bowl (eggs, avocado, peppers, onion, etc.) that looked and smelled fantastic, I ordered the pancakes stuffed with french toast, banana, and Nutella. They could have gone a little more lightly with the Nutella, but still a delicious tasting sweet dish (I'm currently in a sugar coma)! I'm glad we were able to enjoy a good breakfast while celebrating our love.
name: Bridget

text: Great little diner! My parents come here a lot for breakfast. I had the day off so I joined them. I had a cheese omelette with home fries and rye toast. Everything was delicious. There was a ton of food on my plate as well. My parents enjoyed their meals as well. For all 3 of us our bill was under $30. Lots of food for little cost. Our waitress and the rest of the staff were great and attentive. Can't wait to come back to Liberty Bell!
name: Linda

text: The order taker got my address mixed up & the driver got lost 3 times & had to call me. He then called me when he got to my house said I'm outa& I was ok come bring it up to me. The food wasn't what I thought it be. I thought I'll get a decent amount of fries but I barely got a handful or two. The veggie pizza wasn't too good either the crust was like paper thin & it didn't say thin crust. I assumed it was regular crust. I'm definitely not in hurry to come back. I can go to better pizza places are better.
name: Kyle

text: Jordyn, a beautiful woman, was the perfect waitress! She let us order our "meal-for-two" just the way we wanted it. Soups came out first. Piping hot and absolutely delicious. Our appetizer, chicken lettuce wraps, WAS TO DIE FOR! If they bottled the sauce, I would buy it. Just as we were about to finish our appetizer, our main dishes arrived. Ginger chicken with broccoli and Mongolian beef are WONDERFUL!! The staff was attentive and checked on us just enough times to feel like they were there if they needed us but not so much as to be bothersome. She packed up our left-overs and brought our check without us having to ask. Amazing food and SERVICE! RHANKS JORDYN!!
name: Kelli

text:
Spotted this place from Google due to a meeting in this area. And it is really good!!! People working there are super nice and helpful with any questions.

I don't like rice and asked to replace the rice with veggie in the platter. The waitress immediately agreed. The lamb was really tender with enough spices (but still on the lightly salty way).

Will definitely recommend!
name: Yang

text: The buffalo wings...a little on the large side, but tasty. I ordered french fries and they were undercooked. Truthfully they didnt need to rush the fries. If u want something to nibble on you can stop here.
name: Naeemah

text:
An outstanding meal! Very nice surprise This place continues to get better and better. I had the mahi and it was some of the best mahi I've ever eaten in spicy cornflake  crust with curry and garlic aoli. Delicious. 
The service was also excellent; be prepared for tapas-type service. The food comes out when the food is ready to come out! But altogether a delicious dinner for eight people.
name: Joy

text: Everything we tasted was so flavorful. Our first meal after we landed we tried the gator bites half blackened half fried, first time trying gator and we are hooked so pleasantly surprised on how tender the meat is. My fiancé has the Cajun pasta and loved every bite of the shrimp. I had the taste of New Orleans we kept swapping bites and loved every minute of it. So tempted to come back for every meal on our trip to explore the rest of the menu
name: Jennifer

text: I was excited to try a lunch special because the other reviews were so good, and I was right in the neighborhood.  When I got home and saw my chicken moo goo gai pan, I didn't recognize the "chicken" - it looked like no chicken I've ever seen!  The sauce was flavor-less, except for the garlic, and had the consistency of paste.  Cannot recommend and will not go back.  The only reason I gave it 2 stars instead of 1 is because the meal (whatever it was) was cooked to order, and the staff was very friendly.
name: Donna

text: The first few bites were promising and then it kind of leveled out. The music was louder than it needed to be. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. For a busy night they handled it okay. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Food was fresh and service was quick. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text: Very fun and happening place. Great spot in the center of downtown Broadway. Go early to get a seat!
name: Leslie

text: I think I just discovered my favorite place! I would eat here for breakfast, lunch and dinner. My most recent visit, it was the most homey, cozy dining area. I love how at the tables have drawers equiped with utensils. When the food came, the presentation was absolutely amazing. I will definitely be  returning and will tell my friends. Thanks for a great experience.
name: Sohaira

text: Been there 3 times, first time was decent and I told my friends it was a good place in South Tampa for burgers. Second time I went for a take out the burger was undercooked and I didn't return it as it was late.  I ordered to go again Saturday night there was hardly anyone in there and I could see it was just my food they were cooking. I left a tip and left got home and it was just about raw!!! I ask for medium well to well done. This time I called and a waitress is yelling on the phone telling me the manager will call me back.....NOTHING it's like $11 not to much but when you take the time to travel there go home TWICE to find undercooked meat the least they can do is apologize PICTURE attached this was near the edge of the burger not just in the middle.  Will not be recommending this place to anyone.
name: Deadpool

text:
It's restaurant week in King of Prussia so we came for dinner with friends.
We had a reservation, but probably didn't need it on Monday evening.  Our waiter was attentive and the place was busy, but not so bad to make the noise level unbearable.
The clam chowder had a kick to it and one person sent it back.  The Cod Imperial and Bankers shrimp and scallops were very tasty.  You can pick different dips for the shrimp and scallops.
The fish taco's was not the best choice.
But the crispy fries made up for it.

We shall return at some point- but I have to say between the restaurant week menu they also had a special running for dinner for 2 and their regular menu and between trying to figure out the logistics of what was included on what menu, it became a little comedy routine (which wasn't wanted).  So just order off the main menu.
name: E

text: Food took forever but ended up being better than I expected. Honestly, the food came out looking rlly good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. So yeah, it looked better online than it did in person. So yeah, the sauces helped more than i thought they would.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Food was fresh and service was quick. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Food was fresh and service was quick. Would prob stop in again if nearby. Food was good and came out fast. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text: Very nice people, really comfortable vibe. And there's a drive thru! Blimpie/moxie Java
name: Keaton

text: Excellent quality sandwiches and dishes. It's a sandwich shop that has  paid attention to every detail of the items they make. So flavorful and with best ingredients to make good food. The management and staff are all in to be the best at what they do inside the shop. I'll be going back to try more items.
name: Lawrence

text: The cheers of coffee houses.  The staff knows your name, they know know your drink, sometimes they see you drive up and have your drink ready when you reach the counter!  They are nice, friendly, and even when it gets really busy, they keep their cool, helping customers as fast as they can.   It is my home away from home.  David always has a smile for you, and E is the nicest guy around.  Say hello to him when you see him sitting out back playing his guitar, or cleaning around the shop. My go to coffee shop....Java Station!
name: Yogi

text: My favorite pizza place in Nashville! Desano's has a great warm vibe and great pizza. You order at the counter and then sit down at a table to wait. They have a bar where you can buy drinks, but they allow you to bring your own wine, and will even open it for you. We accidentally brought beer once which they politely confiscated and held for us at the front. The pizza is cooked in giant woodfire ovens from Italy and truly represents an authentic Italian pizza (besides some of the toppings). The lasagna pizza is my favorite! The pizza is a bit more expensive than Domino's or another chain, but it's definitely worth it! They are also really great at accommodating groups is you call ahead. My friends and I always choose Desano's for our group gatherings. I can't say enough good things about Desano's!
name: Andrea

text: Came here to celebrate my 32nd birthday with my family and love the food and the service. We had such an amazing time. The fireplace was probably one of my favorites because it was so big and warm. Our server was amazing and did an awesome job making sure the food was good and we enjoyed ourselves!
name: Lakeya

text: Somewhat pricey but the salads are delicious. I found a second location over in the central business district so I think I would go to that one more often. However this is a great place to take a walk to on a Saturday or a weekend with friends benches outside to eat on in that ice tea is delicious. It really reminds me of the salads you see the Kardashians eating and the ice tea definitely rivals those health nut drinks they drink
name: Jasmine

text: This is one of those places where I can see other people loving it more than I did. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. idk I'd try something else next time.
name: User

text: Our group called 15 minutes before arrival, there were 18 in our party. They said they could seat the whole party outside. We were so pleasantly surprised at the hospitality, attentiveness & professional manner in which we were treated! Travis was an exceptional waiter! Everyone was delighted at their menu choices especially those that ordered the Crispy pork shank and the Swordfish! Did I mention that Travis was an exceptional waiter? Dessert was a treat all in itself... the banana one was delicious. I would definitely recommend this place.. ask for Travis as your server! Ooh Rah!
name: Sonja

text: Went with family on a Sunday and it was louder than I expected. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable.
name: User

text: Was going to eat here tonight with my family only to find them completely closed downwas our favorite
name: Libby

text: It's located in the old Rockbottom location off 86th st. Went during the week-lunch hour so it wasn't busy at all. The first thing I noticed was the smell; not sure what it was but smelled like sewage. I did inquire of it but the hostess acted as if she couldn't smell then proceeded to say a lot of people complain about it. Ordered those seafood bags with crab legs, potatoes, corn, shrimp, sausage and boiled eggs-yea a lot! You can choose diff levels of seasoning and I ordered mild but there was still a lot of flavor. We prob wouldn't go back as We usually cook crab legs at home and I prefer ours lol
name: Lillian

text:
Great food - the burgers were super juicy and flavorful and the fries were crispy and had just the right amount of salt. The pretzel and beer cheese were my favorite. It's served in a really cool way (order it and find out!)

The drinks were good too. I had the Above the Fold (a twist in a G&T) and the Witty Headline (a wheat beer with citrus notes). 

I really liked the space. It's newspaper themed, and pays homage to the Collinsville Herald, so all of the beer and drinks have newspapery names. There are type setting cases and the wooden letters adorn the bar front, which is super cool. I do wish the newspaper them had been carried a bit further, like maybe displaying more historic stories or having an old printing press or something.
name: Caitlin

text:
From the outside the place doesn't look like much.  Decided to give it a try due to the yelp reviews. WOW! Well worth it. The food is fresh  and tasty. We had the xtreme nachos and xtreme tacos. You have a choice of meat for both. We chose Carnitas for the nachos and pork for the tacos.  The plating of the nachos were well done, all layers had queso blanco,beans and pico de Gallo. The homemade chips are thick, they don't become soggy halfway Through the meal and were plenty for two people.  The tacos were just as yummo. 
Best of all was the service, we were greeted with a warmth and smiles. They were helpful in describing the menu and checked on us often.
Will definitely will be back, the hamburger sounds delicious.
name: Angela

text: The staff is amazing. They trip over themselves to greet you, and take your order. They are soooo accommodating, and they never make you feel rushed. It's the best way to start you day, or wind down after working overnight.
name: Warren

text: Food was fast and fantastic. Service was quick and efficient with pleasant staff. The new location is very nice on the inside and clean as you would expect a new diner to be. Parking is an ISSUE! They share a lot with Chickfila and they do not have enough spaces to accommodate both businesses. If you go during lunch you will not find a spot easily.
name: Justin

text: I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. For a busy night they handled it okay. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Pretty happy with it overall. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly.
name: User

text: I've gone to the original location on N. Reno for years but thank god there's one closer to home now! I love how everything is consistent across the bar with all their locations
name: Vidall

text: The sauce carried most of the meal. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Idk, the wait wasn't awful, just longer than i expected for the time of day.. So yeah, service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text: This has been one of the most horrible experiences that I've ever had.  Our group had been treated very badly by the manager & cook.  The clam chowder old & had been burned, gumbo old & had no meat nor shrimp in it (cook informed us that someone had taken out all of the shrimp), mashed potatoes old, lettuce was mostly white & bitter Yellow leaves, Fried chicken (mostly big pieces) (no baked food offered at all), (high blood pressure/diabetes) informed that we could not order ANYTHING off of the menu, when asked to purchase a slice of pie, cake etc. from the restaurant, we had been reminded that one of our guest had purchased a cake, via Sam's, for the birthday girl.  Manager came out, asked young man if she could get him anything.  He asked for three wings.  Manager: oh, They just put some out on the bar.  I can't get that, but you can. (Walked away). We we're told that we could not order off of the menu due it possibly being too many separate tickets for the cook, but we were all charged separately & even the small children under 12 had been charged a separate tip fee which had been taken out automatically.  Our waitress: Ms. Corteisha, was wonderful.  She tried her very best to accommodate us.  Thank you very much.  Thanks to Ms. Marsha Goodwicks behavior & the very bad food, We Will Not Be Visiting The Shrines Restaurant ever again.  Terrible service
name: Tonica

text:
A beautiful restaurant for sure-we had wonderful service-everyone we encountered was cheerful and polite-the food, sadly, was very ordinary- nothing special really...we liked the poutine fries and the fish and chips- our order also included the artichoke dip, pimento cheese appetizer and the chicken sandwich.

The real stand-out here is the chocolate chip cookies! Our server offered to warm them up-and they were spectacular! We agreed that if we are in this area again-we would pick these up as a take-out item!!
name: Shelley

text: Really poor experience with bad food, no silverware or napkins until asked several times . No refills on water or drinks. Our waiter was extremely hard to find / ask things for. And the quality of food was very sub par bar food. Really bummed with the experience here. Had to split our own check after waiting 45 minutes for waiter to do it. Needs a complete menu and staff renovation
name: Sammi

text: My husband and I have been looking for a place that serves true NY style pizza and we were so happy to find this place. After reading reviews of how this place can get busy on weekends we went around 4:45 pm on a Saturday. You order at the counter and they bring you your food. We received ours about 10 minutes after ordering. By 5 pm it was busy! Definitely recommend going a little earlier to beat the rush like we did. The food was great! We tried the garlic knots and a large cheese pizza. The sauce on the pizza is perfect; fresh and not too sweet! We will definitely be regulars here and look forward to trying more items.
name: Katie

text: The restaurant has a very homey feel, it is apparent that the food is authentic and great quality. I ordered the parpadelle and it was top 3 the best pastas I have ever had! My boyfriend's dish came highly recommended by the server, however it unfortunately lacked any flavor and tastiness that my dish had (the presentation was also horrible- it looked like dog chow). Although his dish was less than satisfactory, the server was very accommodating and provided us with a dessert on the House (raspberry mousse- delicious!). I would definitely come here again for delicious authentic Italian food and would order the parpadelle a thousand times over but would veer away from ordering the tagliatelle!
name: Lexine

text:
Great vegan and gluten free options. 

My go-to place for brunch in the area. Crepes are quite good and seasonal. Most sweet crepes are only offered in the summer, but if you're a fan of savory crepes then this is your new winter hot spot. The portions are decent for the price point and the atmosphere makes up for the rest. The breakfast menu is delicious, and the lunch/dinner menu is more of a curtailed typical Bailey's menu serving burgers. 

Servers are kind and helpful. And, as long as you're not coming on a Saturday or Sunday morning, you'll be seated quickly and be able to stay and chat over drinks for as long as you'd like. 

One of my favorite parts of Rooster may seem somewhat arbitrary, but they have PARKING! Everyone who spends time in tower grove knows how much of a pain it can be to park blocks down in the neighborhood, but Rooster solves this problem with a fairly large lot of their own behind the building.
name: Maggie

text: The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. By the time the food came out I was already annoyed. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Maybe other people have better luck here. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text: Not bad for a quick meal. Would probably stop in again if nearby. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. For the price I expected more than this. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: Saffron has incredible food and the best staff!  My wife and I go there on our own often and have a great experience.  Recently, we took our year and a half old.  The staff was very patient and had fun with her.  Even brought her a complimentary fruit smoothie because they thought she would like it- she loved it.  5 stars for sure...
name: Scott

text: This place makes the biggest sandwiches I have ever seen in Edmonton. They are huge. They are so very, very huge. The bread (you have a choice of what kind) is Texas big as well. You can combo your sandwich with fries or onion rings and a pop. The sandwiches are made to order with your choice of a limited selection of toppings. I had a turkey sandwich and my friend had roast beef. I have never seen anything like them. I could not take a photo that did them justice. I was frantically texting my brother during the meal to tell him about this place. I was looking at other people's plates and saw similarly enormous piles of food. There are burgers, subs, pizza, and some dinners. The staff are also very friendly. Donna's is located on the northwest edge of the city, but well worth the trip.
name: Paula

text:
This is one of my favorite vegan restaurants! The place is small, but at 8:30am on a Sunday, it was empty so we had no problem getting seats. However, we noticed a lot of people come in right after we got our food. I was pleasantly surprised that the food wasn't expensive. 
The food was fantastic! If no one told you the food was vegan, you probably couldn't tell. We ordered the Dirty Jersey, Breakfast Boost Toast, and deluxe breakfast burrito. My favorite was the burrito. It was so flavorful and filling! I wish I substituted my home fries with tater tots though; they were on the drier side and not that crispy. 
The breakfast sandwich and toast were also very good! If you're looking for a lighter meal, the toast is a good option. 
I'm not from Philly, but if I ever come back, I'm stopping by The Tasty again for sure!
name: Christine

text: It looked better online than it did in person. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Would probably stop in again if nearby. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Food was good and came out fast. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: Great place.  I had the taco salad with roasted veggies. So good.  Husband loved the overstuffed burrito.  Sat out on the patio right next to the koi pond.  So peaceful and inviting.  Wait staff was attentive and the owner stopped by and introduced herself. Great place to take out of town visitors. We will be back!
name: Teri

text: Large portions, excellent quality, plenty of space in a neighborhood away from most tourists, and full of students and lots of dining choices. Great place for after-dinner dessert.
name: Douglas

text: Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. For a busy night they handled it okay. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Pretty happy with it overall. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text:
We can get Tasty Kake products in California but they are frozen and shipped. The Tasty Kake products are from Philadelphia but you can get them fresh (not previously frozen) in New Jersey. I couldn't find anything to buy in New Jersey to take home but a proprietor suggested getting the Tasty Kakes.

I bought 12 boxes of Peanut Butter, Butterscotch, Crumble-cake, Chocolate Chip Bars and Chewy Brownie bars. I like the Peanut butter kakes, the butterscotch is super sweet on a semi-moist Kake and the crumble-cake was okay.
name: Henry

text: Love this place the food is great. I try something different every time. The food is never a disappointment. Vegan friendly
name: June

text: Food was good and came out fast. It looked better online than it did in person. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Honestly, the sauces helped more than i thought they would.. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. not sure I'd order the same thing again. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text:
We went on a Monday evening and we truly liked the ambiance. It was a light crowd so we were seated right away. We both started with the crispy spring rolls which were good. Three small crispy spring rolls with a side of sweet n sour sauce. 
We both had Pad Thai. He had Chicken Pad Thai and I had Tofu Pad Thai. He thought the Pad Thai wasn't sweet enough but the flavor was really good. My Tofu Pad Thai was very good. It wasn't too dry or too saucy. It was a nice balance. We had a Mai Thai drink that was good as well.
The waitress was very nice and made sure our meal was satisfactory. 
It was dim in the restaurant so the pic color doesn't give the meal's aesthetics much justice.
name: Steph

text:
