Okay, we have stopped at Gelson's in the past for a quick run through and thought it was pretty cool. Nothing could have prepared us for our trip to SB on New Year's Eve. Trying to find a restaurant for dinner was impossible, with restaurants closing early and others needing reservations.
We decided instead to go to Gelson's and see what we could pick up and take back to our hotel room.
We did a loop around the store and decided on the Deli, even though the carving station and soup bars were tempting.
We chose:
Spicy Thai Noodles (because others were buying them and raving over them)
Crab cakes and (Gelson's made) tartar sauce
Lasagna
Pretzel buns
And brownies.

It was the best dinner we could have gotten anywhere. Everything we bought was heavenly good. We went back the next morning and bought more -- enough to carry home in a cooler.
The brownies have to be Ruth Reichl's Art Park brownie recipe. They taste just like them.
Gelson's - thank you for a furnishing a memorable meal in a hotel room
I wish we had your market in our neighborhood. 
On second thought, perhaps it's better for us to just visit ; )
name: Annie

text: Fantastic meat pies and baked goods! The sausage rolls are just like what we got back in England but without the pricey plane ticket! The owners are super nice too. Happy to support local small business.
name: Emily

text: We have been a few times. We go back for their burgers!! But this. Is it was different and the burgers were bland. When I asked if they changed anything, they said that they changed the meat for the burgers. :( Sadly, it was a bad choice. On a positive note, the atmosphere is still fun.
name: Tawny

text: This place is legit.  Won't overdo it with a long review but got the rueben, pattymelt and chicken and gravy sandwiches.  Pattymelt and rueben were incredible, easily 10/10 and chicken was a solid 7/10.  Stay with the homemade ketchup and diss the Heinz BS.  Oh, don't forget to walk to the back. I'll just leave it at that...
name: Gregg

text: We have been coming to NOLA for about 10 years for my husband's birthday weekend and had always made this restaurant one of our stops. This will be the last time, they took the best thing off the menu - oyster club was Devine-  my son tried the crawfish etouffee which he said was bland, I had the raw oysters and hubby had a burger. The food was just mediocre, what was really bad is that about 4 hours later our son was sicker than a dog- food poisoning. We won't make this a stop anymore very disappointed
name: Kathie

text: This place would get five stars, if the wait for food sometimes wasn't so dang long, even when I call ahead. Anyway, the fried chicken is a nice and crispy, the cabbage is yummy and the fries are thin cut.  Also, all the food is very reasonably priced.
name: Tam

text: Glad to see them open again! Hammer pizza and some suicide wings (mango habanero and teriyaki mix)! Amazing!  Good to see you guys! Carl, Brian  and Mike!
name: Chris

text: Nice little spot, decent portions too. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Food was good and came out fast. Not bad for a quick meal. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Not bad for a quick meal. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text: A Decent Cuban, not like central Tampa, FL. If you want authentic go to Ybor/Central Tampa. This is just if you're passing by, & hungry! It is good though. 3/5 for me.
name: Bryan

text: The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Food was fresh and service was quick. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text: A decent sports bar located in a hotel area right off the highway and near several regional sports facilities. They are used to accommodating groups, so this makes it a good option for your teams to gather between or after tournament games. Our team stopped in for a late dinner after a day on the soccer fields. The restaurant put up a good energy-building pasta buffet to help prepare us for they next day. The facility is spacious, with a bright atmosphere and plenty of view screens to watch your favourite sports. They have a few arcade games and such for the kids to spend their time and bond together on. Service was quick and friendly. Food was decent and fresh. Recommended if you are in the area to catch a game on television or wind down after an event.
name: Joseph

text: So my husband and I stopped in for a couple of beers. The bartender was more interested in her cell phone than her customers.  No personality.  Beer prices are expensive!
name: Diane

text: Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. By the time the food came out I was already annoyed. Just not for me. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Food was good and came out fast. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: Clearly a delicious and well enjoyed dinner.  We were served quickly and given enough time to peruse the menu by starting off with a few appetizers.  We had the coconut shrimp which was heavenly and fried spring rolls which were good but unlike my dining partner, I'd prefer to have had fresh and not fried.  Both were tasty though and the dipping sauces, were sweet but worked with the flavors.  My dining partner decided to order one item for himself and urged me to order one item for myself as well.  This was unusual because I'm used to sharing dishes.  I decided to order the Panang Curry with beef and a side order of sticky rice to soak up the sauce.  I was more than delighted with my choice and ate as much as I could but still needed a doggie bag (that no dog is going to touch!).  My dining partner ordered the sizzling platter which did come to the table sizzling.  I tried a bit of the curry sauce in it and it had a great sweet curry flavor.  The service was excellent.  Always accessible, but not hovering.  The atmosphere was somewhat lacking as we were seated in a room that had little decor.  It was more of an overflow room.  But it didn't dampen my enjoyment of the restaurant.  The waiter didn't ask how hot we wanted our meal to be on the number scale and it didn't matter to me if it was hot or not but the food came out mildly hot.  The bathroom was clean but smelled like a sewer.  That's the only negative I could find.  I will certainly return as the food was excellent.  Parking can be tricky if the restaurant is busy but we managed to find a good parking spot right outside the restaurant.  Yay!  This restaurant has been here many years and I'm sure it will be here for many more years.  You've got to try it!
name: Lisa

text: Got our summer fix on fried food here today. The poppers were really good stuffed with cheddar and deserving of 5 stars. It was impossible to look past the conditions floor, the condiments  and bathroom. Dirty at best. The staff was friendly but if the proprietor could and should invest in some professional a cleaning company and ditch the table top condiments.
name: Jane

text: I have been to East Coast Wings on multiple occasions and enjoy the wings and some of the staff.  After my last two visits I have decided I will not return.  This place seems to have a policy of not giving customers all of the change that they are due.  The waiters decide to keep whatever change, meaning coins, that are due to the customer after paying.  For example, on one visit my change that I was suppose to receive was $3.98.  The waiter, a latino male with a pony tail,  brought me back $3 and kept the receipt.  The next time I visited I had a guy named Khris.  Keep in mind this is a completely different waiter.  Again I ordered, ate, and paid.  Upon receiving my change I received $3 even with no receipt.  After waiting to see him again I didn't and flagged down another employee  and asked for the general manager.  Much to my surprise Khris came to my table and said he was the acting manager on duty.  I asked him if I could have a copy and he seemed surprised.  When I looked at the receipt it said that my correct change was $3.38, so I asked him where my 38 cents was.  His response was that he didn't carry change on his person. I politely told him that i would like the 38 cents that I was due. He smirked and retrieved my correct change.  Imagine of every check they kept the cent on each order.  At the end of the day that is a significant amount of money. On the other hand, imagine that they rounded each check up in favor of the customer.  They would be short at the end of each shift and be accused of stealing by the restaurant.  The same is true in regard to the customer.  IT IS THEFT FLAT OUT!  I WILL NOT RETURN!
name: Greg

text:
Holy hell.

This was the best dinner my wife and I had in New Orleans. We went in with high expectations and it blew all of them away 3 times over. Every single thing we ate and drank was bonkers delicious. The best Indian food I have had or will have for a long long long time.

If you're a fan of Indian food in New Orleans, you'd be doing yourself a disservice to skip on this place. 15/10, just finished my dinner and already want to eat there again.
name: Michael

text: This was such an awesome find. It took me a second to realize it was inside the hotel but it was worth it. I was in somewhat of a hurry and so I found a seat at the bar, ordered right away, for brought a class of water without me having to ask (which is always nice). The food was so hot and full of goodness that I didn't mind burning my tongue. Food was excellent. Service was quick and I'm definitely headed back.
name: Austin

text:
-star!!!!!  This evening was dead at Sonny's... Only three cars in the parking lot when I arrive to pick up my order.  I called in a salad and wings.  Mike the Bartender was great took my order explained everything to me.
 I arrive 3 minutes later for my pick up. My salad was not ready nor were my wings. I waited an additional 15 minutes. By the time I got my salads and to me it was wilted and hot. The portion was half of what it would've been had I have ate in the restaurant. My wings 75% of them was left over from lunch and the 25% more fresh and hot light on the top. It was horrible I will never ever eat there again. I do not recommend this place to anyone.
name: Bonnie

text: Just updating the fact I tried the burger( half off 4-6 and 9-close) it's one of the best on Mass Ave. amazing flavor, cooked perfectly, and came on a gourmet soft and airy bun. Will be back for the burger soon.
name: Andrew

text: Not impressed, appetizer came out after the meal. My daughters order was in 2 parts and my burger was undercooked.
name: Louis

text:
We walked in without a reservation because we weren't sure we could get in. My BF didn't bring a jacket with him from CA  because we had not planned to dine at any place that would require one plus it was so hot and muggy.  We changed our mind and decided to try this place upon recommendation from a couple from the area. The host has jackets and (I suppose) if you look clean and otherwise well dressed, he gives you one to wear while dining.  I saw him turn away some folks for not meeting the dress code, but then after we'd been there 20 minutes, in walks two young  women (17-18?) one had on tight white capri leggings with a sleeveless midriff top and rubber soled sandals. I also saw another young lady wearing a romper. I suppose the host may not be able to tell it is basically a shorts jumpsuit lol. 

Once seated, it took nearly 10 minutes for someone to come to our table. A very nice young man came and brought us water and two small plates of butter. Then he mumbled under his breath that he isn't allowed to bring bread until there was silverware on the table. That made me chuckle. Why bring the butter? A few minutes later he brought the silverware and set the table but no bread plates. It was awkward eating bread and not really having a place to set it down between bites.  

Finally our waiter arrived. We each ordered an appetizer- I had the asparagus with hearts of palm salad and my BF had the seafood gumbo, both delicious. For dinner I had the shrimp au vin that was good but not a stand out. My BF had the lamb chops which were perfectly prepared. We also shared a side of creamed spinach, which was good. 

I get the feeling this place is frequented by mostly locals. Men in seersucker suits, young girls with big bows in their hair, women in conservative dresses and low-heeled pumps... It has a stuffy vibe yet it has extremely loud acoustics due to the high flat walls, narrow room, etc that makes it difficult to even carry on a quiet conversation. 

In the 4 days we were in New Orleans, we ate at two top-notch restaurants. Galatoire's  and GW Finns. In comparison, GW Finns outranked Galatoire's  in every aspect- food, drinks, service, and ambience.
name: Kim

text:
Just placed an order through DoorDash, and I was amazed by the amount of food I received! 

Monstrous ribs --- are these wild boar ribs?! (They were great; had the 'tips' and a nice bite!) The hot sausage was juicy and spicy, and the cut of cornbread was incredibly generous. I can be quite a glutton when I'm tucking in to BBQ but didn't come close to finishing this "plate". 

Also, if you're doing Keto or Paleo you can rest easy knowing that the sauce comes on the side... But you won't have to worry about your carb macros because their meat shines even without the sauce!
name: Hadley

text: Rize always has a great menu. Their food is so fresh, clean and tasty. Reason for not putting 5 stars is the waitstaff; hasn't always been the friendliest and it seems almost each time I'm there, our server tends to forget to put things in or bring the table something or just seems to be trying to rush us out. It's not bad enough to not keep coming back though! Definitely worth a try.
name: Nadia

text: Breakfast and Lunch, both delicious and reasonably priced!  You can tell they put a lot of pride into their food, and it pays off because it's great.
name: Phil

text: Tasty, inexpensive Mediterranean restaurant for lunch or dinner. Local chain restaurant with a casual vibe. Fresh ingredients. Friendly staff. Clean. Appreciate the restaurant's efforts to accommodate my friend's gluten allergy by offering the humus plate with veggies, instead of pita. In addition to the humus, I had the delicious Mediterranean salad with grilled Tilapia.
name: Michael

text:
How does this only have one review??? Literally everyone and their mama needs to eat here and review here. I live right behind this Marcos. 
Marcos is one of my favorite chain pizza places....and to be honest even tho I am a Whiteland resident I was worried when we were getting a Marcos cuz I assumed it would be mediocre. However.....we have eaten here so many times I can't even count. And not once was I disappointed. Sometimes my husband and I meet up there for lunch too cuz they have great lunch specials. It's weird because....well I don't wanna sound rude but honestly every time I go there the employees seem less than enthused to be there or anywhere for that matter and I always wonder if the food will reflect that. But it never has. Always has been fresh and perfect. I only have one complaint.....I am an avid beer drinker and have always known of the term "skunked" but never knew what it tasted like. One night I ate here with my Dad and I got a Blue moon or something and I took a swig and I was like oh my gosh what is WRONG with this beer???? I asked my dad, "Hey is this what a skunked beer is?" He sniffed it and was like oh my gosh YES. So that was my first experience of a disgusting beer.  
Other than that everything has been perfect. The only reason I didn't change my star to 4 was cuz it's a pizza place not a beer place and I feel like based off all of the other multiple experiences we have had here they deserve 5.
name: Heather

text: Reading some of these complaints now feels a little overblown. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. The service was off and the meal kinda followed that energy.
name: User

text: Fresh cut fries and upgraded to the prime rib beef burger normally found on the phillyburger. Fabulous!
name: Norma

text: Exactly what you'd expect from a pizza and wine bar - good food and inexpensive. Inside is clean and looks nice. Service is adequate and the pizza is good. Overall satisfied, although nothing extremely memorable about this place. Went here primarily due to proximity to my apartment on Drexel's campus. Would certainly go again if in the area, but there are much more compelling options in Center City if you're looking for italian food.
name: Nathan

text:
At the time of my visit, I am partaking in a complimentary birthday meal via the First Watch club.  This location has been open for a week.  Across the area there are 700+ locations and this location nestled into the Brentwood plaza complex has a full bar!  (See bar menu).

Decor

The traditional First Watch menu and a seasonal "Harvest the Season" menu placed at every table.  The decor is new country.  It's quaint with hanging country doors from the ceiling, floating window box planters, old tracker seats, and black cast iron skillet hanging as a curtain separating the dining area from the kitchen.

Meal

Oh the meals looked yummy.  Each breakfast which passed my eyes looked more and more scrumptious from the toast points with avocado, hash, breakfast potatoes, omelettes, and sandwiches.

I am a pancake lover so I had the pumpkin pancakes, switched from chicken sausage to Hardwood smoked bacon. There are a couple bacon options (Million Dollar Bacon - maple syrup, pepper, 530 calories and the Hardwood smoked bacon, 160 calories).
Scrambled eggs.

The pumpkin pancakes...so fluffy with the perfect Touch of pumpkin not over whelming, crispy golden edges. Served with warm maple syrup which had my mouth watering. Crispy bacon, and the eggs or scrambled hard like I like them. 

I met a young lady at the bar who'd been I'm 3 times that week!!  So, that is a real plus.

Staff

Friendly and upbeat.  This was their busiest day since opening a few days ago. They were a bit overwhelmed but everyone kept a smile on their face and very pleasant. a diverse staff.

See menu for pricing and to choose what you'd like to have before you get there. Once you look at the menu you'll want everything on the menu.
name: Cynthia

text: Tried the apple fritter and coffee. I was looking for a place to hang out and kill some time. The eating area is very small and I didn't feel comfortable being in there for any time longer than to just scarf down my food. The fritter and coffee tasted okay, nothing that really impressed me beyond measure. I probably won't go out of my way to eat there again.
name: Joshua

text: On a five-day trip to Tucson, I could only talk my traveling companions into Mexican food once, so we had to make it count. I was surprised that in the Southwest it was so difficult to find a highly rated Mexican spot. It wasn't busy when we showed up at La Placita Cafe. We were greeted with tasty but unspicy salsa, heavy on the oregano. I had a house Margarita--way too sweet with no lime flavor to speak of. I asked for extra lime, and that helped. And then we waited. And waited. Authentic manana attitude is in full force here. After about 20 minutes we were able to order. I ordered their chili verde. Surprisingly it's offered with beef, not pork, and only refried beans, not whole, are available. And then we waited. And waited. See manana attitude above. Food finally arrived. Nothing special. No heat. Spectacularly mediocre. At one point my husband looked around the table of five and said, "how come I don't see any smiles?"  Although no one had said anything, we were all feeling ambivalent about our meals. More manana attitude when it came time to flag down a bill. So frustrating, since this was my only shot!
name: Alisa

text: I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Food took a while and didn't rlly feel worth the wait. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text: Cake Bake is an indulgence. Me and my friends go usually for special events like birthdays or when we are feeling especially bougie. The raspberry champagne cake is my favorite, but all the cakes are rich and delicious. The only complaint I would have is the large wait times that we usually encounter on our trips there. It is a very popular spot with limited seating, especially in the colder months when they do not have seats outside. But if you get luck and are seated quickly inside with the beautiful decor, Cake Bake is a decadent dessert place.
name: Katherine

text: Great service. Pizza is excellent. Delivery driver was very courteous! Definitely my go to Pizza!
name: Jane

text:
More like 3.5 out of 5 stars. 

To be honest, traveling to reno I was only looking to eat at a buffet. I've been to almost all the ones in vegas and people of yelp were highly recommending this place.

We were staying at the Atlantic, which is the same building as this buffet.  Sadly, they don't give you a discount if you're hotel guests, you'll pay the same price as everyone else. Another thing is the different prices for the different levels of players cards. If you dont have a player card, you'll pay the same price as someone who has a card without any points on it.

As for the food, most of it was pretty good. I really wish their crab legs were cut in half so that you can get the meat easier. However, i'm really happy they had stone crab as they typically are meaty and easier to crack open. I stuck to stone crabs all night and I think I got my money's worth.
Another thing that's deserves attention is the brisket. It was really flavorful and the fat portion almost was melting in my mouth.
Another hidden star were the carnitas from the Mexican side. Super juicy and full of flavor. 

They have a Mongolian bbq and a pho section. 

However I noticed some things that didn't warrant a 4 stars.  For the dessert, some of the strawberry used for the fondue were old and they looked moldy.
The bathrooms were located outside.
Didn't get drinks when we first got seated.
The cookies and cream ice cream tasted like coconut and cookies.
name: Jeff

text: Holy cow.  Don't order food if you want it in less than. An hour!!!   I thought they forgot about it but no - they're just confused, uncoordinated and slow
name: Kenny

text:
It was very exciting to finally dine here but I was sadly left a little disappointed! Mostly with the food and the interior of the restaurant. 

Inside is very groovy with color changing lights and an open seating plan. It felt a like a cafeteria because of the layout of the restaurant and how loud it got. They had these funky table lights bolted in the center of the table that are as much a conversation piece as they are an inconvenience.

Service was very attentive and formal which is a good thing; however, it was a little hard to connect with everyone we encountered. Generally, everyone was very nice. Food was brought out quick as well. 

Four of us ended up with the most expensive sushi platter because we were told that would be enough to feed all us. It was the right call and a good sampling of different types of fish and sushi. The flavors were not rocking my world for the price though! Also tried the braised pork belly and the wagyu beef dumplings. These were not enough for four but we each had a little nibble anyway. :) the beef dumplings were very good but left me wanting more. Pork belly on a rice porridge was good but not great. 

I opted for the skirt steak medium rare and was left a little disappointed. Meat had decent flavor but very chewy. The sauce was again, good but not great. The green beans it came with were not at all good: the ends weren't snapped off and the experience eating them was not fun. The Duck Duck Duck entree was very good and filling. However, the rice was something you could easily make in your kitchen. The black cod was beautiful and tasty but my friend said it could not rival Nobu's. Finally dessert! We got the Fiery Chocolate Tart because the pyromaniac in us was intrigued. They pour lit Bacardi 151 so it's a fiery topping over a chocolate mold that melts on top of burnt miso ice cream. The bites that had the alcohol on it tasted like the liquor. :( the brownies and tiny fruit pieces with it were pretty good! 

Presentation was stunning for all dishes, of course! I wouldn't come back here. Maybe f I was a more adventurous sushi eater? Also not a great spot for groups. They can make it work but it's so loud and very pricey I might prefer elsewhere if I was part of a party larger than 4. Sorry, Mr. Morimoto. :(
name: Caroline

text: Awesome find! Great food, good vibe & fantastic service. You will not be disappointed -- sooooo good!
name: Kendra

text:
BLUF: Love the interior design of the restaurant! Found hair in my sinigang and they didn't apologize for it at all. Their 800 lb Guerrilla plate definitely saved this review.

My wife and I came here because we were starving! We found this on Yelp and decided to give it a shot. I'm Filipino and was fed Filipino food all my life; I love it! 

I really like how the place was designed! It showcases a lot of the Filipino culture, mixed with a modern-American feel. Very hipster feeling. Kinda weird that they were playing country music... lol.

Anyways, we ordered the 800 lb Guerrila and sinigang. The 800 lb Guerrilla was BOMB! Poached eggs, adobo, pork, rice hit the spot.

But when it came to the sinigang, thats where I was turned off... We found a piece of hair in the bowl. We addressed our concern to the cashier and NO ONE apologized. They just said if I wanted another bowl/ refund. We asked for another bowl anyways.

I tried the sinigang and was not impressed. My parents cook way better sinigang. It honestly just tasted like water and a LOT of salt. It was overbearing. So I went back to the other plate.

I might give this place another try in the future. Bummed that we had an below average experience for our first visit.
name: Raphy

text: FANTASTIC food. I last ate Mr. Empanada when my parents brought take out for my brother and me at the University of South Florida. I have been dreaming of a meal here for the last 7 years. Had an apple and a beef empanada (in that order), and it is as good as I remember. I recommend this place without reservation.
name: Faloolah

text:
The Gumbo was a real let down here. It looked like it had all the right ingredients but it was bland. I had to salt it and pour hot sauce over it.

But the Crawfish Etouffee and Shrimp Creole was superb!! The Jambalaya was good along with the Alligator sausage. Order the combo plate and sub the Etouffee in and you are good!

Full bar, great service and a very nice patio area you can't go wrong, even though of it's touristy atmosphere.
name: Juan

text: Nice little spot, decent portions too. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. So yeah, the staff seemed tired but still polite. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Idk, the sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something i'm still thinking about two days later. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. idk I'd try something else next time.
name: User

text:
Never been! Will go again!

Cute little place in midtown. Probably used to be a two or three bedroom house back in the day as many midtown businesses are.

Nice rustic/bbq uplifting decor and super nice staff. Prices are up there but it's to be expected for BBQ. Offerings range from port to need to brisket to bowls!! Tater salad is great, Mac n cheese was amazing. Beverage options include tea, soda and a variety of craft beer.

Just six tables and two pub tables although they do have outdoor seating. There is a sign outside that says they do sell out so get there early and enjoy!!!
name: Jennifer

text:
Visited in the lunch time ,ambience was good, but very congested seating's. After our order taken by a staff, it took almost 45 minutes to get all our food, that was little frustrating because  customers came after us was served more faster than our order even though our order was just a Thali and some masala dosas. all the dishes were good ,some of them lacking the true flavors.
Most of the down side  of the visit was inattentive staff , we have to  waved our hands in the air several times to refill the water or  some second servings even for the check :(
If the management can rectify some of these then its a good restaurant to dine especially if you are from any of these  kollu/mallu/ tamil region
name: Ren

text:
The location and the atmosphere is fantastic, but the food is a bit pricey. Even though there's pretty much nothing but outdoor seating & views that will knock your socks off, there's nowhere to smoke or vape unless you go to the parking lot or to a lone smoker chair over by the dock slips.
   I had a whiskey sour upon arrival which was mostly ice and very little drink... it was like a teaser beverage. I also had a shot of vodka and two beers, but happy hour seems to be limited so everything was kind of speedier than I'm accustomed to.
   I split conch fritters & they were delicious, but you only get 5 fritters for $10.50. I also split the mahi tacos and (while delicious), I was expecting more than two tacos for $18.50. 
   This spot is right on some water and you can swim if you like, which is cool. The table we sat in was a picnic-style spot with adirondacks. At some point the mosquitoes came out hard & our server actually had spray for us. 
    I wanted to take the spring mix that my fritters came on with me, & expressed this, but got no carry out container.
    All in all it's a cool vibe & a neat place but at the prices, I don't think it's a spot I'll be able to get to very often. I spent $50 on my two shots, 2 beers, 2.5 fitters & 1 taco. 
    The bathroom is beach side style so it's not the cleanest feel.
   Dolphin watching a plenty though! I did have fun!
name: Nicole

text: Though this place looks unassuming in a quite little shopping plaza,  its actually some of the best chinese food I've found in the area. I got tofu with a veggie medley the sauce was a little off for me but the cooking style and veggies chosen was good. My boyfriend got the mongolian beef and it was incredible, large serving portion and delicious sauce definitely recommend.
name: Rachel

text: Ended up here pretty late, maybe around 9:30, bc everything else nearby had a wait. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Food was fresh and service was quick. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: Adorable little shop! Great place to celebrate a special occasion or just to go enjoy an amazing piece of cake.
name: Kelly

text:
Another incredible CRG concept (no surprise)! This place does not disappoint and is a great addition to the Westshore/South Tampa area. Everything about this place from the coffee/tea, to the food, service, and layout is a reason worth going for. 

The coffee is a speciality blend from Bandit and is delicious. The tea is a selection from TeaBella (the best in Tampa). There is truly something on the menu for everyone, including anyone with dietary needs/restrictions, and every employee we talked to was helpful and kind. The portions are quite large and definitely worth the cost. 

I highly recommend getting the Hot & Crunchy. I just got this yesterday and am already craving it again. 

For anyone with an allergy, CRG takes it very seriously and there are plenty of options on the menu to choose from. I've never felt like I've had more GF options at a restaurant than when I go to anyone of CRG's concepts. I've also never ran into an issue with cross contamination. 

Thank you CRG for bringing another healthy, fresh, fast concept to Tampa! Y'all are the best.
name: Katy

text:
We tried Milk and Honey this past Saturday and the food was very good but the service was definitely less than mediocre.  We waited for about an hour (which is fine and completely expected in this area for a party of 4 on a Saturday morning) and were seated on the patio.  Since we had been waiting for a while we already knew what we wanted and placed our drink, appetizer, and meal orders as soon as our waitress came to the table.  We ordered the cinnamon roll, a bloody mary, a mimosa, two lattes, the breakfast burrito, 2 big kid breakfasts, and the hodgepodge hash.  The cinnamon roll came out first and it was fine.  It was cold and tasted like any other cinnamon roll I've ever tried.  We then received our food and everything was very good.  I especially liked the breakfast burrito and the hodgepodge hash.  I really liked their honey hot sauce and even bought a bottle to take home.  Here's where the minus two stars come in--during our entire meal we never received our water or any of the above mentioned drinks.  We asked three separate times and were told that the kitchen was backed up.  I completely understand that but I am uncertain what that has to do with glasses of water.  So we finished our entire meal with nothing to drink and then waited for about 30 more minutes before our waitress came back and asked if we were ready for our check.  We then informed her AGAIN that we hadn't received any of our drinks.  They finally arrived and honestly both of the iced salted caramel lattes tasted like coffee mate creamer and ice.  The mimosa and bloody mary were fine but we were pretty much over it because we had been finished eating for almost an hour at this point.  Overall we enjoyed the picturesque location and the company.  The $120 breakfast is average for the area and would have likely been higher if we had been given the opportunity to have more mimosas.  
 
If we are ever in town again on a week day I would definitely try this place again and get the breakfast burrito.

Quick breakdown: good food, cute atmosphere, $$$, bad service.  The price would not be a problem at all if the service was good.
name: Rachel

text:
Simply Thai is a must if your are out in Spanish Springs. I've been a fan since they opened. The food is excellent and service friendly and efficient. 

I usually get a curry and a few appetizers. You simply can't go wrong here all the food is delicious and lovingly prepared. 

Stop in. You'll be glad you did. I always am.
name: Shawn

text: Just had the lamb/beef gyro and falafel. It was delicious!!! The meat was perfect and tender. I'm going to be ordering again and again!!
name: Erin

text:
Had the vinaigrette greens and the fried oyster appetizer.  Both were great- the sauce accompanying the oysters was awesome.  

There was a little annoying thing which was that it took a long time for my first drink to arrive.  In fact it arrived after the greens did.  After a long day I look forward to that first drink, dammit!  
  
Not a huge deal though, I just ignored the salad for awhile while I enjoyed my drink, and the service was otherwise quick and pleasant.  

Overall the vibe was nice and the food was good.  Give it a shot.
name: M

text: We was very excited to try this place, however their organization and customer service was terrible from the beginning - we were not acknowledged for so long after being seating that we ended up having to leave so I can't speak to the quality of the food:(
name: Rachel

text: Food is great! Setting is awful. They're SCREAMING peoples names at the top of their lungs and the dining room is chaos. You have to sit with others at big cafeteria sized tables and bus your own dishes. I was done eating my food for over 15 mins before my coffee was ready so I didn't have a drink with my meal. Just kinda a mess. Probably won't go back.
name: Samantha

text: The Chicago burger is something you can't get anywhere else. The beer cheese is made with Coors Banquet, how fancy oh la la. Prince was an excellent server, ask for him next time you visit!
name: Josephina

text: Only went for beignets, to compare to cafe du monde. These are more doughy and more like a doughnut. Less crowded and had live music. Iced coffee was pre made and sitting in dispensers.
name: Zelda

text: We have been customers here for 9 months on a regular basis. We ordered boneless wings tonight through them via DoorDash. The wings arrived literally BLACK! We called the restaurant and gave our concern about the food being burnt. The lady on the phone said they couldn't do anything because we ordered through DoorDash. We couldn't understand what that had to do with anything. We didn't want any money, we just wanted our food!! We asked for the manager. The young lady never pushed the hold button, so we heard everything she said to the manager-which included how awful and dumb I was!! The manager offered no additional assistance and continued down the path that nothing could be done to remedy the situation. The DoorDash driver didn't burn them!! Needless to say my husband DROVE the burnt wings back to the restaurant. So much for tasty wings. Mike's-you just lost a regular customer who was visiting your establishment weekly! What a huge disappointment in service and food quality!
name: Angela

text: Went there on a late weekend..Food was good..lots of options for quick bites..will definitely visit more
name: Sovan

text: I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Pretty happy w it overall. Would probably stop in again if nearby. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text: The best and most romantic restaurant in Bucks County and within walking distance from my home. Who could ask for more.  The restaurant is comfortable and set within the walls of a still functioning OLD country inn.  Charm exudes from all the walls and table settings.  And to top it off, this is a BYOB restaurant.  Wait staff are professional and friendly as well as knowledgeable.  There is not one appetizer or entree that isn't worth trying.  Keep in mind that the menu is definitely County French.  On this visit we chose crab cakes remoulade and Poached leeks as our appetizers.  I seem to order the leeks every time I am there, they are just so  good!  Entrees chosen were the lamb Chops with herb crust which were perfectly cooked to temp, juicy and tender as could be ; and the Poached salmon Florent in.  OMG was it delicious.  The desserts look incredible but we stay away from sets so I can't give an honest review.  But I can day that those around us who ordered desert left clean plates. We will be back once again.
name: Alison

text: Delicious food! The staff is SO nice--they really make you feel like family. We love coming here for breakfast, but the lunch options are good and everything is priced right!
name: Meredith

text: Was in town for family zoo trip. Saw this on yelp so we tried it. For starts it was clean! We started with papaya salad and some chicken wings Laos style which was what I was craving and it was wonderful! Kids had pad Thai they really liked it. My youngest had red curry chicken and ate almost the whole thing with a little help from my wife of course! My wife Pud Woonsen and she really enjoyed as well. I had Pud Kapow without bell peppers add onions with brown rice Thai spicy and it hit the spot! Very authentic good service and a must try! Wish I stopped to take pictures but I was too hungry and there wasn't anything left
name: Matt

text: We love coming here. Good food, decent prices, excellent waitresses! Annie is our favorite. Since meeting her 4 or 5 years ago, she has always made our dinner time fun.
name: Rebecca

text: I'm not a sushi fan, but their cooked goods are awesome, especially the hibachi. Delivery is prompt and those who deliver are always polite. I order frequently and the orders are always correct. The only reason I don't give it 5 stars is sometimes there is a dip in quality(greasy or dry), but recently it has been more consistent.
name: Whitney

text: Love to come here everytime we visit Arizona. The food here is excellent! Prices are reasonable. We love the lunch combos. I highly recommend  this place if you are ever in town. The price, food, and atmosphere is great.
name: Agnes

text: Stopped by after work because I was nearby and hungry. It looked better online than it did in person. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. For a busy night they handled it okay. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Food was fresh and service was quick. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: It wasn't to bad, wasn't outstanding either. The store was nice and clean. But you could tell it used to be a coffee shop, which was strange being in a poke shop with chairs with coffee cups on them.
name: Michelle

text: Just awful. How can this place win all these rewards? My guess is the location is Pinellas Park and they don't know what even so so Italian food is at best. The sauce was very bland and had no flavor. It tasted like they just opened a jar of ragu and poured it in a pot. The pasta was way over cooked.My chicken parmigiana was very rubbery. The only highlight was the tiramisu one of the best I had. The coffee drinks were also very bland, couldn't even taste the butterscotch schnapps. Again the food was mediocre at best.  Would not recommend to any one.
name: Matt

text:
We walked and got seats right away. Lol
 The place had lots of open seats. Full bar. After seating down, and looking around, I spotted alot of very different decor.

Our waitress was great. Greeted us, brought out water, took our drink orders. I had coffee and it was good. Our friend had warm apple cider spiked. She did say it was very good. 

We order led the guacamole and plaintaichips, western omelette, shrimp ceased salad and steak and eggs. Our appetizer came out a few minutes later. Our brunch took forever to come out. By the time I got my western omelette, it was cold. Everything was cold. The toast was the only thing that came out warm and good. My friends however enjoyed their dishes.

I was really hoping to like this place. Our waitress did check up on us a few times. Once my friend mentioned my food was cold, she immediately apologized and when our bill came, she took off my omelette. It was a very nice gesture, since I barely touched my dish.

Service was great. Food was so so. Drinks were good. Metered parking outside.
name: Mimi

text: I have been here quite a few times for their sushi menu. During lunch they offer dollar+ sushi and it's usually pretty quiet and not too busy. Sushi is usually good, and they offer cocktails as well, which tend to be on the sweeter side but are tasty nonetheless. Music can be a little dance club like at times which is a little funny... but still fun. Service is ok. Not the worst but not the best. The bathroom had a really bad smell the last few times I went which was kinda gross. Overall it's pretty ok, and they have options if you're looking for a good deal on lunch for sushi.
name: Sierra

text:
This is one of the best places in Nashville if you're looking for Jamaican food.  The food selection is really good, I suggest either the oxtail or the brown stew chicken.  The service is friendly and helpful.  The pricing is very good as well!

If you're looking for Jamaican food in Nashville, you'll want to check this out in the Farmer's Market!
name: Jon

text: It's review catch up day! I went to this location two days ago it was a little disappointing but not all bad. Ordered the medium spicy chicken meal and a double whopper with cheese ( shush it was lunch and dinner for the day :p ) It was empty and took a while for anyone to come take the order; they saw me and just didn't care. I waited was given my bag and offered sauces and they walked away without handing me a cup. I stood there a moment and said excuse me a few times and was ignored and the guy waiting to order next just reached over and handed it to me. It's fast food so meh. The chicken and fries were good, the whopper I'm pretty sure they opened an old cold one and just added slices of cold cheese,and the soda machine gave me seltzer because they hadn't hooked it up to the Sprite syrup so that was poured out once home. Fast Food is usually a hit and miss but some places and locations care enough to actually work at work. It's a little sad to me when people don't realize a slump in sales usually means cutting employees and locations being closed when too many customers are alienated. Received a call from the manager wanting to rectify the experience. I try to be reasonable about these types of things and certainly appreciate an attempt at providing better service. If I visit this location again for my own meal I'd gladly change the review after a few visits as I usually have no issues with this location. If in the area again I'll at the very least stop for charities sake and give it to one of the many homeless people I see in the area from time to time because I don't usually keep cash on me but certainly don't mind helping someone else have a meal.
name: Keila

text: Awesome food and awesome service...absolutely De-lish... I've been there 3 times since they open and I can't wait to go back! The wait can be a bit long but it's worth it
name: Cordeyah

text:
Came in for a take out. I ordered chicken saffron kebab. Waited about 15-20 minutes. 

Food was delicious and not greasy. I really enjoyed it. 
However, for the price, it would be nice to have more chicken and some veggies. I don't think there were enough chicken for the amount of rice given. The few pieces of veggies that came with it were pickled and too sour for my taste, hence I could not eat them. 

The place was very clean and nice. Owners were friendly and courteous. Will definitely return to try a different dish next time.
name: Kura

text: Nice service and great location but curry was almost inedible. Meal was saved by the excellent British ales on tap.
name: Mace

text: This was such a fun experience for me and my friends! We're from out of town and wanted to stay away from the chain restaurants. We pulled onto a side street near the restaurant that is in the area of the House of Blues Studios, so during our 15-20 minute wait for a table, we were able to explore. The restaurant is a little cramped but cute with art on the walls and ceiling. It was a ton of fun cooking up our own breakfasts, experimenting with flavor combinations. Our server was a great guy, but could tell was a little overwhelmed so he often missed a thing or two we asked for, but it's a popular place so it'd be easy to do. Overall, great experience, great breakfast outside of the city for a great price.
name: Nikayla

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. You can tell they care about customer experience here. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Food was fresh and service was quick. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Would return. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Nice little spot, decent portions too. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: Love the food and great people.. eat here at least twice a week either pick up or at the bar
name: Kenny

text: The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Glad we tried it. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text:
Phenomenal!  Our family loves Italian and have hit some very good places in our travels all over the world.  This, for me definitely at the high end of the list.  And in our own backyard to boot!

I loved the the black ravioli.  It was excellent.  The fresh donut dessert finished it off with an exclamation.

Service was prompt and friendly.  Wait was short.  And atmosphere was very relaxing. 

Will definitely be back.
name: Jeff

text: The food came out fast, which was good because we were starving. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh.
name: User

text: First things first: the only reason for the lack of star is price. I feel like I almost have to compare it head to head with Tucanos because these are going to be your two options when looking for this type of experience. In summary: Tucanos is a more fun atmosphere better for big groups/party settings and is mildly more affordable. Texas de Brazil is much more romantic and all the food was of a higher quality comparatively. In addition, our waitress at Texas de Brazil was an absolute gem!! Our drinks were full and she brought my boyfriend 3 helpings of fried bananas (the last one without even having to be asked)! Heidi, you're our girl! We also got a free dessert for our anniversary. I feel like at their competition, I've always had to ask for every refill I've ever gotten. Both places are great, but if price was not an issue, I'd pick Texas de Brazil. Tip: they do have a VIP program that saves you 50% on 12 meals over 12 months which if you're going to go even semi-regularly may be worth investing in and make the choice to choose Texas de Brazil much easier!
name: Danielle

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Parking was annoying, although that's prob more about the area than the restaurant. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed.
name: User

text: We went back for weekend brunch to see how things were going. It seems they got their shit together. At least the tables were set and we were greeted. The waitress was very nice and did a good job. The food was ok. Nothing special.
name: Stacey

text: Crooks !! Our gift card had $15 on it and the cashier swiped it and charged it through but cleared it and then ended up printing us a new receipt that said it had zero on the balance after I saw her throw away the first receipt! She called her manager and asked why the computer wasn't working but it was cashier air I saw with my own eyes, but they declined and said that their system wasn't working and it's because there was nothing on the card which is not true at all. Foods good but they need cashiers who actually know what they're doing. Simple math books might help.
name: Summer

text: This is probably our favorite fancy restaurant with a view in Philly. Everyone from the person downstairs to guide you to the elevator, to the hostess, to our server Mark. Were all very nice and helpful. The food is always delicious and we love that they are always changing it up. We do only go for special occasions so how often they change it up I'm not too sure. Kudos for the complimentary champagne they gave us for our 5 year anniversary!
name: Min

text: OK as far as bar/pub fare goes, but gets extra points for the laid back dive bar atmosphere with good entertainment opportunities such as games and karaoke.  Great patio area for cooler days and/or nights.  Interesting assortment of drink machines behind the bar for chilled shots including tequila, Jagermeister among others.  Cool building,  btw.
name: Paul

text: I did as instructed, and no one ever contacted me back!  Do not patronize Sonny's.   This place is no longer a good value unless u go for a promotion I guess. They don't even follow up on customer service.
name: T

text: Stopped by after work because I was nearby and hungry. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. For a busy night they handled it okay. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Would probably stop in again if nearby. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: Being from Hong Kong, I know what authentic Chinese food tastes like. Jun Dynasty has exceeded more than my expectations and I couldn't recommend any other Chinese restaurants than this. The pork intestine that they serve is superb. 10/10 would come back.
name: Jerry

text:
Beautiful hotel with both charm, and modern conveniences. Upon arrival, valet greeted us warmly and assisted us to the front desk, where we were told we got upgrade to a suite with a balcony! Very comfortable bed with great sheets, soft towels, and comfy robes + slippers.  Having gone during December, the entire hotel was beautifully decorated in gold magnolia garland. The dimly lit bar had a great live music scene, perfect for a nightcap. 

Overall: extremely clean, newly renovated, extra points for having a pool w/ pool bar (although we didn't get a chance to use it). Great staff and even better location! Within walking distance to the French Quarter.
name: Sarah

text:
Do not go to this place. The staff is very rude.  Cool car hanging on the wall, but don't look at it or they will threaten to kick you out or handcuff you illegally.

They not only made our group feel unwelcome but we were actually scared to be there.  Terrible terrible staff.

I believe they own the Johnny Cash museum too so I would avoid that establishment also.

Sad, looked like a cool place but we were harassed and left.
name: Jeff

text: Gumbo, jambalaya, and complimentary bread were good.  I've had better and worse elsewhere.  Waiter was knowledgeable.  Quite a line the night we went but it moved quickly.  The rest of my party enjoyed it more than I did.  They aren't as familiar with New Orleans food.
name: Mark

text: Ariana the waitress is awesome! She was attentive and very efficient. I had the Salmon with veggies!!! Food was great!!! Thanks a bunch!!!!
name: Eric

text: Stop by today to get Smoked Turkey Blta and it tastes really delicious.  Awesome setting with very kind/friendly staffs...
name: Noy

text: Ordered $40 worth of hoagies, every single hoagie was delivered wrong. This was supposed to be a Turkey and cheese hoagie with lettuce and onion. My hoagie came with no cheese and barely any lettuce or onion, every sandwich had barely any toppings and most of the toppings were wrong. When calling the store, their answer was that they would take 10% off my order next time which is not nearly enough for the crap hoagies we received. Do not recommend this location at all.
name: Sarah

text:
Perfect spot for lunch and Skippack shopping! My mom and I enjoyed a lovely meal here with the world's nicest server. We started with the jumbo shrimp cocktail, which I highly recommend! The vodka-wasabi infused cocktail sauce is unlike any other I've had. It does have a serious kick to it though and will clear out your sinuses. We also split a couple plates including the lobster roll and crab scampi pizza. We loved every bite and the fries that comes with it are amazing. 

It is on the pricier side but that's normal for the area and the high quality of food. The location is prime in Skippack with a ton of parking out back.
name: Emily

text: If you are craving a quality burger..... stop what you're doing and head to Mac's. The staff was extremely friendly and helpful for our first time. I ordered a double cheeseburger and my boyfriend ordered the Louie. We tried both and they were the deliciously thin steak patties that melt in your mouth. We also split the RIP fries which is fries with red hot ripplet seasoning.... need I say more?? . There was a decent bottle and can beer selection. We enjoyed the outside patio area and the arcade garage in the back. We will definitely be heading back to Mac's soon.
name: Morgan

text: Extremely disappointed with the service here. I came here to celebrate my 21st birthday with bottomless mimosas. The hostess was extremely irritated with us just being here in the first place even though I made a reservation for 14 people.  We sit down and order bottomless mimosas around 11:45. My brother did not get his food until 21 minutes after everyone else, and his eggs and toast were cooked wrong. Then, the manager comes to over to me and says "just letting you know I have another big party coming in and you need to leave" I was SHOCKED. I was kicked out on my birthday, after not even reaching out 1.5 hour limit on mimosas. My friends and I felt extremely uncomfortable especially for over 30 dollars a check without explaining the added gratuity, we will not be returning, ever. Thanks for a very rude, short ended birthday celebration, Cask.
name: Alyssa

text: This place is fabulous! Since I live so close, I literally go there once a week! Great food, great service, great atmosphere.
name: Kayophe

text: Mediocre at best. Stopped by for lunch on Sunday afternoon and left disappointed.  Small portions and high prices. Will not go back.
name: Joanie

text: Terribly overpriced, the appetizer my friends and I shared was disgusting and barely edible, the drinks were just okay but also expensive. I don't mind paying a lot for good food, but this food just simply wasn't good.
name: Kate

text: The Chicken Parmesan was very think and a bit over cooked. The pasta was ok but the sauce was very watery, probably due to not draining the pasta correctly.  The sauce was ok but rather plain, again maybe due to being watered down.  The seafood in the other pasta dish was ok, some of it a bit over cooked and chewy.  The service was ok but got the impression the waitress wasn't loving her job as she was not friendly at all.   Overall not very impressed and most likely won't be back.
name: Sue

text: I stopped in here for the first time ever on Thursday for lunch. It was busy but not too busy and parking wasn't a problem for me. My friend recommended the black garlic tonkotsu which was very flavorful and filling as well. The service was lovely, and I'd like to go back and try some more from the menu!
name: Sierra

text: I was looking forward to coming to Acme to eat bc I've heard so many good things...   sadly I can't say this was a good place.  first you 'tip your servers' as you place your orders.   Besides setting the food down on the table they are not  servers.  The food wasn't good and  the restrooms were ... gross.  I'm sorry I normally give great reviews bc my business relies on reviews as well. I might have came on an off day.
name: Dell

text: Everything here is always good...friendly service..its very busy..but I rarely ever have to wait...neighborhood is lucky to have Paul Revere!
name: Chris

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. It looked better online than it did in person. For the price I expected more than this. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Food was fresh and service was quick. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text: In town for business and stumbled across this place.  Great selection of fresh juices and inventive blends.  Worth the stop.
name: Pamela

text: Service is sporadic. Been here numerous times. The Ortega Chile bagel and the Jalapeno bagel are great but the amount of toppings vary greatly from day to day as with all their bagels. 3 times we get onion bagels and one day you end up with onion w/ poppyseed on the bagels. One day we didn't get part of our order. Their schmears are good (I really like the jalapeno one, it's got some fire to it). Serve Caribou coffee, but never the blend I prefer (Obsidian). 2.5 stars.
name: Maxx

text: Busy spot but didn't take long to seat us. The seafood platter is definitely a 2-4 person job. Everything came out perfectly fried. Substituted the oysters for shrimp which were nice sized. Our waitress (God I wish I remembered her name) was very attentive  but didn't hover. Good overall vibe; well placed TVs for game watching. Definitely plan to visit again.
name: Jane

text: This is the 2nd time I have been to Pia's with a group (6-8).  I recommended returning the hour's drive today because the food was so good the first time.  Tonight I had the Lasagna which was excellent, as was the Spaghetti Boulognese I had the first time, both healthy portions.  I also tasted the gnocchi and Eggplant Parm. which were excellent as well and 1 in our party had the veal which was also excellent.  Unfortunately, we went early and stopped in the bar area for a glass of wine.  We ordered a carafe of the house cabernet, which turned out to be Bolla,...at $28.  In a 2 liter bottle, which retails for $12., there are 2 carafes,...thus a 466% mark-up on a lousy cheap wine.  Had I asked the brand prior to someone else in our party ordering I would not have ordered it.  Regardless, I don't mind paying for good quality if I get it,...as we did with the food, but I don't like being "ripped off" for poor quality, and that's what happened with the wine.  As well, we were seated near the side entrance in the sun when there were many spaces in more comfortable locations.  5 stars for the food and waitress service.  2 stars for the wine and seating experience.  Go,...but beware.
name: Richard

text:
Was in New Orleans with friends for my birthday and we all were craving OYSTERS. There were many places to
choose from but we decided to go to Felix's. We got there around 8 pm on a Thursday night and there was a line. The wait wasn't bad. They had us seated in about 20 minutes. Our server Paul was GREAT. So professional and so on point. Paul took great care of us. We had an order of char-grilled oysters, soft shell crab apps, shrimp and grits, blackened shrimp and seafood gumbo. The star of the show was (ding ding ding) THE OYSTERS (you don't say). We were blown away by how fresh, delicious and well prepared these suckers were. They came with bread and it was a perfect moment in foodie heaven. Paul recommended trying it with the hot sauce and O M G !!!!!! Just amazingly delicious. The seafood gumbo was also very good. Best I've had actually. Everything else was good too. The oysters were so delicious we went back the next day for more and of course it was just as delicious. If you're ever in NOLA this is it!!! Definitely worth the wait.
name: Danielle

text:
Have come here a couple of times for lunch by boat.

Perhaps we've been fortunate, but have not had trouble docking a boat, or this past time, a couple of Waverunners.  Appears most of the clientele come by car or walk.  So, it is great, to be able to pull up by boat, hop off, have good dockage and get a solid meal.

I wouldn't mind a slightly expanded/different menu, but the food is good, and the service on this past visit (Server was Whitney) was excellent.  We sat outside on the dock, overlooking the water.

The restaurant is on a no-wake area, so it is calm waters and quiet boat traffic to be enjoyed.
name: E

text: The cheesesteak Stromboli has literally 0 cheesesteak in it. $17 and I get that shit. Guy who took the order was the most unhelpful person ever. Not to mention I asked for sauce on the side multiple times and was told it was in the box at checkout. I get home and guess what there is no sauce. Used to be a great place... going downhill now
name: Peter

text: The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Not bad for a quick meal. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Food was good and came out fast. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Not bad for a quick meal. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Food was good and came out fast.
name: User

text: Got a cheesesteak and wasn't chopped up enough to hide the amount of gristle the sandwich contained
name: Jim

text: First and LAST time I will ever visit here. Walked in and sat at the bar. The blonde bartender came up, didn't say anything and just stared at me as if I was the one who start up the conversation. While sitting there, I overheard a conversation she was having with other customers about edibles. Not professional at all. Ordered the fish and chips, and it didn't even come with tater sauce. Isn't that common sense? She informed me that they would have to make some, but by then, I was so over the food and her poor attitude that I stopped eating. At one point she blamed the new cook for the issues that were happening. Also, we noticed on our receipt that she changed for three different beers, all different prices, but we only had one Angry Orchard and a couple of Budlights. The bartenders horrible attitude and customer service skills really kills the vibe of the bar. Definitely will NOT be returning and I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone.
name: Sarah

text: First off, there is no check in offer available as stated on yelp. However, the food was worth it. We arrived late while they were closing up. I ordered oxtail, brown stew chicken, and jerk chicken. All with rice and peas and cabbage. The oxtail was on point falling off the bone. Next, the jerk chicken was very good. Nicely seasoned. Lastly, the stew chicken was also good. I really enjoyed the cabbage mixture. Usually, places only give you plain cabbage but I really enjoyed the added carrots and (I think) kale. The one fault was the rice. It was on the hard side but I blame that on getting there late and having the end of the batch. I would definitely return.
name: Tracy

text: I went there yesterday for brunch with a friend. The food was delicious and the staff was very polite and accommodating. It was my first time having vegan food and they answered all my questions. Will definitely go back again!
name: Rachel

text: Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Food was good and came out fast. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Would probably stop in again if nearby. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: They had a guy singing cover songs. I'm not sure his name. He was great! We walked in and sat ourselves. The place was pretty empty. I was very surprised for a Saturday night. Our server was awesome! He was attentive and funny. The food was amazing. I ordered the appetizer shrimp, boneless wings and a salad. We also ordered some lemonade sangrias. They were pretty weak with alcohol in my opinion. I will always come back here. I love the atmosphere, food and service!
name: Kayetta

text: Very authentic taste. The meat was seasoned perfectly. I've had the lamb kebab platter, the dolmas and the gyro, all were fantastic. I've had a lot of Mediterranean food in my life, these bad reviews tell me that people around here have not ever had good authentic cuisine and it's not over seasoned or salty. I'm excited to try their breakfast!
name: Annelise

text: Fantastic food large portions great prices definitely worth visiting the fish and chicken are cooked to perfection the Philly cheesesteak is excellent I've had everything on the menu and it's all delicious
name: Chad

text:
I've gone here so many times I can't even count. It's literally right down the road from me. Perfect place for a Sunday (hungover) morning! 

I appreciate breakfast places in which I can make my side of toast pancakes! I know I sound boring but any time I go there I get the same thing-- one egg (comes with hash browns & pancakes!) All this costs me just $6 (plus tax). Being a broke college student this is the perfect meal for me. When I go with my boyfriend he likes to get the entire farm, yes that's a meal and yes it's huge! It comes with sausage gravy and I always have to steal some because it's so good!

I love Lincoln Square's service, they are always very quick and friendly.
name: Denise

text: Excellent family owned restaurant in Clearwater beach.  Went for our anniversary and was not disappointed. They sat us in a nice booth by the window. We ordered a bottle of wine, and was in for a wonderful dinner. Out server was, then word that comes to mind is "genuine." She was sweet and took her time with questions. What she didn't know she got an answer quickly from others.  The service was attentive but you are not "rushed" through dinner like other places.  The food was too notch; lamb was seasoned well and not salty as most restaurants. Wife got the cheese ravioli and it didn't disappoint. Tiramisu for dessert was delightful.  Would go back if I'm in Clearwater beach.
name: Avi

text:
Good restaurant. They have promising future. This restaurant is about 4.5 stars in my book. Not yet 5 stars. They have 5 dollar pho night. Service is good and attentive. We were here and find out many people waiting on the line try to get in. Very popular place. We were lucky to have two seat at the bar when two other just leaving. 

I read all my friend review. Many have visited them a year or two years ago. You can see the most drop of the star is due to service. During our visit, the service is perfect and you can see improvement. The reason they are four stars now is their regular price is a bit in the high side in compare to many Vietnamese restaurant. That is the main reason not round up to 5 stars. 

Food. The restaurant has good beef noodle soup. The sou is the best to my expectations in Bay Area. The papaya salad is one of the best. We also order the crispy duck and papaya tiger shrimp fresh roll. Their roll only come in one compare to many Vietnamese restaurant. But their roll is a lot bigger than other place to make up two quantities. 

My experience is good. I will visit them when they have five dollars deal.
name: Boon

text:
Absolutely no words to express how great this place is. If your looking for good handmade food this is your place. Carb overload but there hasn't been an item we have had that we didn't like. Every time you visit the food is always different. 
It isn't your normal restaurant, you pay after you eat and order food and drinks separate then pay basically on the honor system. It's also a casual place to work on homework and drink some yummy coffee.
name: Kaitlyn

text: My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Pretty happy with it overall. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text: Great spot. Wish they were open for lunch on more days than just Friday. Also upset they did away with the 33 oz mugs. Bubbas 24 doesn't have as much of a ring to it. Burgers are flame though.

text:

I called the store Texas Chicken & Burgers sharing I would be canceling the order.   They had no idea of identifying my order or who they deliver through.  I won't be going back here.

text: Excellent food, prices and service!   Tacos are very good! Clean, cute and convenient location.  We will return.
name: Julie

text: Cool atmosphere, great service, yummy food. Chips and salsa are $4 and house margaritas are $6. Both were delicious! Our waitress was very attentive and friendly. The fajitas were very good, but the portion of chicken and veggies was a small for the price in my opinion. I would return, especially for happy hour specials next time! Overall this is a cool place, but just more expensive than comparable Mexican restaurants.
name: Amanda

text: Stopped in twice for breakfast on a business trip. Great service and great food. Don't pass up this place. The outside may fool you but the food is definitely worth coming in for. Lots of food and great service. I will stop in again when in Tampa for sure.
name: Mark

text: Got my mother and wifey some boiled crabs....man, let me tell you, I got some bonus points from them. The crabs were big, hot ( temp.) and spiced just right. Cajun daiquiri has a full menu, daiquiris, propane sales and brake tags..one stop westbank shop. Highly recommended.
