text: Lunch yesterday:  If you are eating avocado toast anywhere else, you need to stop.  The schug (and if you don't know what that is, you need to get with the program!) uplifts other boring avocado toast and makes this one a sensation.  The kashkaval grilled cheese on a Jerusalem bagel is a twist on classic from mom and sorry mom, but this is the winner.  And finally, the smoked salmon on a Jerusalem bagel crushed it b/c those pickled cucumbers (not quite cucumbers, not quite pickles) add just the right umph to the sandwich.  Today:  trying pastries - which will be nearly impossible to surpass my bubbie's - and the borekas/bourekas.
name: Fawn

text: Great sandwiches at reasonable prices! Will definitely be back next time. Place was one of those hole in the wall that packs a punch. I tried a Big Joe with whiz, next time better without. Also tried the Italian Chicken Cheesesteak but I felt like it came up a little short on flavor, maybe more cheese next time? Either way, I definitely recommend this joint to tourists cuz I'm sure the locals already know it's reputation. Keep it up Joe!
name: David

text:
I was craving some Mexican food and drinks so when my friend and I were trying to decide on where to go for happy hour, I suggested Lucha Cartel. We were able to get there at about 5:30 pm on a Wednesday (happy hour runs from 4 to 7 pm) so we were lucky enough to snag a booth. Had we been there just an hour later, we would have had to find a place at the bar because they were completely packed. I guess people were rushing over at 6:30 pm right before happy hour ended!

We were quick to make our drink selections - her a sangria and I got a margarita. Our super friendly waiter gave me the option of the house margarita for $5 or a flavored margarita for $7. The flavored options were strawberry, mango, or jalapeño. When he heard me debating between the mango and jalapeño, he was nice enough to suggest getting a mix of both! Spicy mango? SOLD!

My margarita was awesome. Perfect amount of both sweet and spicy. The alcohol was also definitely present, but in a good way. I could taste it and also had a good buzz going on. 

My friend and I were both hungry so we decided to go pretty heavy with the happy hour apps. We got the chorizo sliders, chicken quesadilla, and chicken empanadas. We then also ordered some chips and guac (off of the regular menu, not a happy hour deal) because... what's a fiesta without guac?

Out of all the food selections we made, the empanadas were by far the best. The empanadas were so flavorful. Crispy on the outside, and bursting with flavor on the inside. They came two to an order. I would totally get them again! 

The quesadilla was stuffed with shredded chicken which I liked and thought was well seasoned. It came with a side of chipotle-paprika crema, which was completely flavorless though. If I hadn't read the menu before, I would have though it was just sour cream. The happy hour portion is also quite small which is something to keep in mind. Since we had ordered other items though, it was sufficient for the two of us. 

The guac was pretty boring. Kind of like something you would get at the grocery store. The chips tasted very fresh though! 

The biggest food let down was definitely the chorizo sliders. They really had no taste or flavor to them. I believe they came with some kind of sauce, but there definitely wasn't enough of it. I guess you can't expect much for $5 sliders, but I do wish I had put that money towards another drink instead!

I could see myself returning here for happy hour because they do offer some awesome drink specials (who can beat $5-$7 margs?). Perhaps I'd also get some empanadas to share with a friend as an appetizer, but I would probably head elsewhere for the rest of my meal.
name: Alisha

text: Good times. Met brother in law and wife. Had a wonderful time. Bartender had good suggestions for dinner
name: Don

text: Sitting outside with a great view of the rising moon.   Wait for a Friday night was not to long.  We were quoted 45-60 mins for a table outside.  We were seated in about 35 mins.  After being seated quickly it took it only took a couple minutes to get our drinks.  Great deal on the $3 margarita and $5 rummer runner.
name: A

text: Amazing from start to finish! Our service was exceptional and we will definitely be back! Also received a complimentary meal on the next visit as a Mother's Day gift can't beat that! They were very attentive checking on our needs! Amazing is all I can say! Well worth it!
name: Robinette

text: Had a great business dinner here with 2 colleagues. We had the mussels and french onion soup which were great - the fries are also deadly! Loved the space too!
name: Katherine

text: Absolutely terrible. Who is the manager here! (Oh I'm speaking on the restaurant, not the game section). We were in the mall and as soon as we got there our toddler told us he was hungry. So we got what we were there for and stopped in Dave and Buster's since he's been asking for chicken tenders.  Upon being walked to our table, there were napkins all over the floor by one table with smashed up french fries on the floor and some dirty tables as we were walked past them to our table. I didn't like that as it was slow. Why are your tables and floors messy with hardly anyone there? A nice bartender came over to us to get our drink orders since she said she was trying to help our waitress. She got us our drinks and we sat, and sat, and sat. A lady who I am assuming was our waitress kept walking to the table in front of us and back of us helping them. No one came to us after the bartender. We waited for some time. I even told my husband let's just wait as our son is hungry and they can't mess chicken tenders up. Well I too got tired of being helped or even greeted with a hey I'm so sorry I'll be with you in a minute. So we left. I have been there in the past. It's maybe been 3 years now since we've been to this exact location to eat and play. Never again!
name: Chantel

text:
The pastries here are FANTASTIC! Here are the ones we tried:
1. Almond croissant- croissant was perfectly baked so flakey and delicious. The creme on the inside was not overly sweet, but just sweet enough. The almonds toasted perfectly. 10/10
2. Lemon fan- I have no other words to describe this magnificent pastry other than perfection.  The lemon, the pastry all of it 10/10. 
3. Berry tart- a mix of cherries and berries in the most delicious tart cup. 8/10
4. Chocolate croissant-so flaky, buttery and delicious and evenly distributed with chocolate. 10/10

One downside, the coffee. I was not impressed. My latte tasted just like almond milk. Stick to the pastries.
name: Erica

text:
We were looking for a pizza place close to our hotel. This place popped up on the nearby options. 

We did get there in the middle of the friday rush hour. This place is primarily a delivery place. They have no real room at eat at location. They have few old metal tables outside if you want to eat there. Their bottled drinks are well over priced. The food is subpar. I do not know if that is because of the friday rush or not. I just know what happened while I was there. 

They do have military discount.
name: Michael

text: This is an awesome sushi place. This place makes the original Philly roll. The owner created the Philly roll 37 years. The ingredients and fish are super fresh. Flavor and sauce are not over powering. I don't know why it took me so long to find this place. Now I will be back often.
name: Edison

text:
What do you get when you mix Whole grain alcohol with Tito's..... you get a WOWZER slushy.

Fun stop for a walking drink in the Quarter!
name: Bob

text: This is such a fun little spot. It's quintessentially hipster from the music to the decorations and food. The donuts are rich in flavor, fancy, and rustic at the same time. Service is friendly and efficient but relaxed. Of course, it also smells amazing in here, and the open kitchen looks very clean and well-designed. I think that if you are going to have an open kitchen it should be organized and attractive, and this kitchen is all of those things.
name: Jessica

text: Nice place for a fast meal with friendly staff. Food was great. They have crayons for kids and pin their drawings on the wall if you wish.
name: Husky

text: The PokeSpot is a welcome new addition to Philly's assortment of poke restaurants, and is definitely a stand out. Similar to most poke places, you can choose a base, proteins, and toppings. What sets The PokeSpot apart from what you'll find elsewhere in the city? PokeSpot has some bases you can't find elsewhere, like zucchini noodles, if you're into that. They've also got an array of proteins marinated for additional flavor and variety (the chili salmon is AMAZING, spicy tuna was meh, not very spicy), in addition to the standard proteins. And then, of course, you get unlimited toppings (with the exception of the avocado, which is extra. Unless you really love avocado, not sure the upcharge is worth it, with the 1/8th of an avocado tiny portion you get), which is always great. They've got quite a few more toppings that you wouldn't find elsewhere, and some you would find elsewhere but definitely stand out, like the onions that are marinated for extra tastiness. If you want variety and quality, The PokeSpot is definitely worth trying!
name: Emily

text: The bartender was experienced and helpful. She kept the crowd under control. Food and drinks were reasonable and delicious
name: Susan

text: Giving them 5 stars because 10 wasn't available.  We spent more than a few hours during our stay at the Roosevelt in the Fountain Lounge and had a great time.  Jacob and Sasha both make excellent cocktails, but be sure to have a Gin Fizz.  They are worth the wait!
name: Vanessa

text: Let me start by saying that the food here is great BUT if you're looking for home cooked food that is quick this ain't the place. There is no one at the front to direct you to a table or even instructions to either wait to be seated or seat yourself. We got to there at about 1045 and didn't leave until 1200. We weren't fully ready to order after the 1 of 3 waitresses brought our drinks therefore she said she would come back. No one came back for at least 30 minutes. We watched as they ran food to tables and then were told by other customers the things they ordered that they didn't get. Finally we got up and addressed this with someone there that our order hasn't been taken. That's when 2 tables around informed us that they each had been here for 45 minutes to an hour waiting on their food. After letting the staff know we got our food maybe ~10 minutes later. It was good but not worth the wait in my opinion. They did give us free cinnamon rolls while we were checking out for the inconvenience but they shouldn't have to do that. They need to hire more staff or waitresses that know what they're doing.
name: Callie

text:
I don't know how this place has 3 stars, the atmosphere of the restaurant is bland and dusty (literally) they could really use some new decor. I was confused by there being a buffet area in a Mexican restaurant. Anyway me and my husband went to here for lunch on taco Tuesday, we both ordered tacos (chicken and beef)  we got back two plates with inedible nonsense on it. The tortillas were soggy and they looked raw, the beef tacos were so greasy I had to spit it out. The chicken was bland and had what appeared to be way over cooked peppers. The side of beans and rice my husband got tasted like baby food and on top of it they had the nerve to charge $4 for that 3rd grade art project. We paid the bill and tipped the server but that was a horrible Mexican food experience. I won't be surprised if that place is closed down in a few years. We're on our way now to loli's for some real Mexican food. 

the chips and salsa were the best thing we had there...
name: Kenza

text: Ate here for lunch and I noticed that the servers were friendly and working together. The hour I was there at least 3 different people checked on us. I was absolutely surprised at how fresh the food was and the friendly portions. I'm sure I'll be back and I will recommend this place. The only drawback Was the parking.
name: Michael

text:
I really loved this place when they were in the old location, great food, great service and a tiny little spot that was quiet cozy in the winter. It seems like the stakes have been raised with the new location and quality has definitely declined. 

I was super excited when the announced they were moving to a larger location. During the interim, when I couldn't get my Korean taco fix I told anyone who would listen about how amazing this place is. Maybe it was my excitement and anticipation that did me in, but it's just not the same!

I usually go for the japchae & Korean tacos for lunch, which don't get me wrong they are still deliciously but comparatively don't hit the same mark as the old location. 

My suggestion, try it for yourself - it's still a great spot!
name: Jasmine

text:
If you like Mexican food, La Calaca Feliz is an okay choice near the Philadelphia Museum of Art. 

I think some other tables got complementary chips and salsa, but my table wasn't offered any, and I didn't notice the other tables until I was walking out the door. We tried the nachos, which were presented carelessly, but overall acceptable. They were served with really spicy habaneros, which was excessive by any measure. 

I ordered the carnitas tacos with a side of rice and beans. It was just okay; decent flavor but not really compelling and a small portion. The prices were reasonable for downtown, but the food was far from memorable.
name: Adam

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way.
name: User

text: Absolutely love this place first time there i was skeptical because it has a really low key appearance from the parking lot but once i stepped inside it was a really nice set up. Great bar as well as dinning area. Very versatile and has a mixed crowd I always feel welcome when I come here. Its ok for all ages depending on the time of day because they do have live music at night which draws in an adult crowd. The food is really good, I have had a few of their dishes and they are always fresh and taste of good quality. My personal favorite is the firecracker shrimp. They also have some signature cocktails that i enjoyed my favorite was the tidal wave. As for service it is exceptional. The owner/ manager are always present and always making sure guest are comfortable and taken care of. I can tell this establishment is well managed and care goes into running this place. I cant wait to go back again.
name: DAnna

text: We recently had a housewarming party on May 11. We decided to order 60 wings (3 different flavors; 20 each). We haven't ordered wings for takeout in over a few years, but figured it's The Jughandle, how different will it be? We got the wings home. They were breaded (we didn't order them that way) and just plain dry (really dry!). We put them in our 3-section warming tray, and they didn't even look good when we were putting them in. Granted, people ate them...but they definitely weren't popular. We had a LOT left over...and we usually never do. Highly disappointed.
name: Lisa

text: We were visiting Tucson for the first time and found this restaurant on Yelp with good reviews. I can say we were not disappointed. Barb, our waitress was excellent. She took the time to explain the dishes and even gave us samples to try. The red chile pork enchiladas with their green chile sour cream sauce was fantastic!  I will be back again.
name: Alisa

text: Rustic little spot. Few tables, staff is fast but kind of "fake smily", it almost looks like they are making fun of you at a time. Besides that food comes fast and is delicious. The chocolate chips pancake are heaven and the coffee is really good too. Definitely affordable for breakfast. Can't give 5 because a person from the staff was kind of rude to my dad that doesn't really speak English and that bothered me to the point to don't come back.
name: Daisy

text:
Excellent Cajun food and a great value,
Especially with the $1 happy hour oysters!  We had the sampler platter. Also the creole Mary was excellent.  Service was wonderful!
name: Denise

text: Wow! And unexpectedly authentic TexMex meal. The chips and salsa were perfect. The chimichangas were flavorful and the guacamole was fresh. To top it off, the fried cheesecake was outstanding. If they do everything this well, you can't go wrong.
name: Marc

text:
I'm not vegetarian myself but was with a friend who is, so we ordered two veggie dishes to share (the mapo tofu and veggie chow fun). WOW, both were bursting with flavor and absolutely delicious. The mapo tofu was perfect - not too spicy and served with bok choy and jasmine rice. Great twist on what a traditional Chinese restaurant would serve - a little surprising with mushrooms incorporated. The noodles were great too, a tiny bit on the oily side for me but again, just beautifully done. It IS a little on the pricier side but the portions were a decent size and worth it for the food. 

Super hipster and trendy inside too, but the downside is that it's very small inside. We went around 4 PM on a weekend and it was already decently crowded, so can't imagine what dinner time would look like. 

I can't wait to come back to try some of the other dishes on the menu. This is what good food done right looks like.
name: Cindy

text: Usually a good place to get a drink and some food my wife had the worst experience tonight having to reorder her drink two times and then refusing both because of a distaste and poor quality of a drink . then to top it off. Usually Delicious coconut shrimp tgus time they were burnt. frustrated she rather not say anything just eat and go. Perhaps it was late towards closing ...
name: Dee

text: This restaurant is beautiful, has great ambiance, and has great people working here. The food is the bomb!!! Sits right on the Bayou. Swamp tour next door. You can go out on a chartered fishing trip and have your fish cleaned and cooked here. What could be better??? It's not far from the city. I will definitely be back for more!! Thanks Bryan!!
name: Joy

text: We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Food was good and came out fast. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Not sure though.
name: User

text: No wonder it's rating is so low. I worked for them 20 years ago and this brand has really ran into the shitter. There was no one in the restaurant or the bar on a Friday night, that should have been a clue to run. Slow service, terrible food, wrong order, and we left feeling like we got mugged. I can see this place closing very soon. Too bad
name: Lucy

text:
So there's always a wait at Cheesecake Factory.  But 35+ mins at 230 in the afternoon?  It took nearly an hour to get our food after we ordered.  My green salad with ranch was beyond bland.  My orange chicken with brown rice was mall Chinese caliber with some pieces not even getting sauce.  Dry and ehh.  

Wife enjoyed her salmon and mashed potatoes.  But broccoli was bland.  Daughter's antioxidant salad was enjoyed.  Water glasses were not filled very often...which sucks when you wait that long for your food.  

Staff did work to make up for it without us asking, (1 free slice of cheesecake) or this one have been a star lower.  Still charged us for coffees.
name: Sean

text: The soup was better than the sandwich, which I wasn't expecting. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Not a bad stop, just not one I'm rushing to repeat. Nice little spot, decent portions too. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text:
Very clean and appealing location, staff is great.
Pancakes, syrup and bacon are highlights.  Disappointed that scrambled eggs didn't seem made to order and arrived cold.
Fresh OJ is killer.
name: E

text: I HATE OYSTERS or so I thought. I tried a charbroiled oyster for the first time, after previously only having raw oysters in Texas and I LOVED it. It really was so much better than I expected and I definitely will travel back to have them here. I also tried the fried shrimp platter with red beans and rice along with potato salad. I loved all of it and I'm very picky. This was the best place we dined at during our stay in New Orleans and it was worth the wait. I suggest you arrive early but either way, don't be surprised by the line. This place is THAT good.
name: Maudie

text: Food not good, service not great. Will not be coming back. Still searching for a good diner in the are.
name: Liz

text: Went with family on a Sunday and it was louder than I expected. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Would return. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text: Our first time to the Chocolate Bar. Our server Ashely was so welcoming and helpful. Great suggestions. Our milk chocolate martini was perfect and the ice cream flight was too delicious for words.  We will definitely be back!
name: Becky

text: Very good as usual. Got in to Nashville late and papa johns to the rescue. Friendly staff and quick order. Garlic knots were great too!
name: Jared

text: This is my favorite brunch spot in Nashville! The food is amazing, drinks are good, and the atmosphere is so unique. There is usually art displayed on the walls that are available for purchase too. I would recommend getting the banana foster pancakes, their cinnamon roll French toast, or their seasonal specials for pancakes (the ricotta lemon pancakes are amazing!)
name: Abigail

text:
We were very disappointed today 
We sat down at 5:45 and no one stopped by for 20 mins then sat another 30 min before we got he salad and rolls my cup of soup came before the salad and rolls  and I asked for No scallions  and had them in my soup 
We had to get our own peanuts 
Two of the meals were over cooked  
When I went to the ladies room the kitchen staff had to come out to get the wiatstaffer because customer  dishes there sitting under the heat lamps 
When we went to pay the military discount was only on 1 meal and all 4 of us are prior service
 It saddens that the service was like that.  for I have eaten there several times. Maybe the management needs to look at the crew that was working tonight.
name: Amy

text: For a busy night they handled it okay. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text:
The CUSTOMER SERVICE as this location of Zea's is one word.... EXCELLENT!!! 

All of the staff from the greeters to the manager were all friendly, polite, and were quick to respond to any need my party of 8 had. (Mind you were dining during peak lunch hours) 

The decor is modern, simple, and sheik and they have a large bar area with a nice outdoor patio. 

Food was rich in flavor however I would have preferred my dish a little warmer. It was served as if it had been prepared and sat on a counter. This is the only reason for the 4 stars instead of a perfect 5! 

I'll definitely return to try some of the amazing happy hour offerings and daily drink specials! (See pictures for details!!!)
name: Angel

text:
We have been wanting to go to this restaurant for a while because of the neat concept and good reviews. First off, to the owners of the establishment, it really would make sense to put menus and pricing on your website. How are people supposed to find out what is on the menu from each individual restaurant and their prices?

We arrived at 7:30pm on a Sunday night. Daughter had the Poke bowl from Dumb Fish and she said it was really good. 

My wife and I wanted the BBQ, but they only offered wings and ribs. We were hoping for brisket or pulled pork, etc. My wife decided to get the pepperoni pizza from Upper Crust Pizza. The pizzas are visible on the counter to select from and looked like they had been sitting there all day. They took the slice of pizza and put it in the oven. We thought reheating it would make it good. Nope. Tasted just like it looked........like an old piece of pizza sitting out all day. This one slice was $5.50.

The most disappointing meal was mine. I ordered the large nachos with Chorizo from Avenue that were made with supposedly fresh fried potato chips instead of tortilla chips. I also ordered the refried beans that were $5 thinking they must be great for that price. It was close to 15 minutes before my food was delivered to our table. This surprised me because everything at this place seems set up for quick service type food like in a mall food court. The refried beans were in a bowl with exactly 6 tortilla chips and they weren't enough for the amount of beans in the bowl. It didn't matter though because the beans were terrible and we didn't finish them. Thought maybe it was just me but my wife tried them and felt the same way. The only way to maybe try and make them edible was to add salt, but there wasn't a salt or pepper shaker in the entire establishment. How is that possible? As for the nachos, they were just barely warm when they arrived to the table. After a few bites it was apparent I didn't get Chorizo as I ordered, but got Carne Asada on the nachos and there was barely any of that on there. The fried potato "chips" that made up the nachos were not good as they need to be served hot.

Went to get two of our fountain soft drinks and saw they had several interesting flavor choices. Filled our cups with the same flavor and then when we tasted them at the table realized it was only carbonated water. Apparently the soda syrup dispenser was out.   

Doubt we will be going back.
name: R

text:
Okay, if you follow me on Instagram you know that this place is my second home. Meeting? Last Hotel. Stay-cation? Last Hotel. Sunday Funday? Last Hotel. 

I'm certainly on a kick, but how could you not be? 

First off, they historically renovated the Saint Louis Shoe. Company building in a stunning way, and have pulled that story and history into the fabric of everything they do. It truly feels like they spared no cost in making it a perfect sanctuary for any occasion. 

In addition to the amazing hotel experience they provide, the place is totally a destination for locals, too. Just do yourself a favor, when you go- just take yourself straight up to the 11th floor. Rooftop pool with an amazing bar and some of the best views in the city. 

As far as food goes, the buffalo chicken sandwich was my go to, but now it's the burger. I had one on Saturday and it was so freaking good. Drinks are a little on the expensive side, but also you're paying for the scene, you know. You're on the rooftop of a luxury hotel with beautiful downtown St. Louis surrounding you and a pool! Don't get no better! 

Find me here when I need to relax, celebrate, or anything in between!
name: Max

text: GREAT service! Bet Guy was very kind! And the chicken sandwich was DELICIOUS and so filling!
name: Eva

text: We were greeted immediately and we gave gave drink and app orders. Our drinks came in a little bit but the waiter said the bar was backed up. We the sat for over an hour- no appetizers- we weren't asked if we wanted to order dinner- finally we asked our waiter to check on our appetizers- he said the manager said we already ate them. He put them in again. They came out quickly but were cold. No apologies nothing. The waiter never asked if we wanted to order anything else or checked back to see how our food was. Horrible. I will never eat there again.
name: Jane

text: The male manager had a demeanor that was not one of a manager. He made me and my fellow guests very uncomfortable and we will not being going back to this location.
name: John

text:
Went here for a birthday celebration dinner with kids in tow, and then again to try the brunch as we wanted to see what it was like in full capacity crazy mode. And we were not let down.  This has been on our hit list for a while now, and thanks to Craig LaBan's review, worth the drive out of the city, which is rare to drag my butt out of the city just for food. I also wasn't driving so there was that. 
Totally worth it either way. Be warned, no juicy buns/soup buns, but it's Cantonese not Shanghai or fusion or any confused Americanized dim sum place. Although they do have some Americanized snacks for those that get scared. Kids ate everything except for the spicy or the feet. I also did not want feet. But one person at the table took the plunge and said it was good 
Everything was ON POINT. 
You see the live fish and crustaceans swimming around just waiting to be plucked from their little tank to their firey death. At least, you know, it's fresh and all that. 
Sometimes I'm ready to be fully vegan, but to here wasn't that time.
name: Clarissa

text: Very old school Nola steakhouse.  Not much has changed since 1934 when the opened!  Beautiful wood decor, tile ceiling, old hunter fans.  Steaks are very good to excellent.  My ribeye was surprisingly tender and perfectly cooked.  Au gratin potatoes were very good. I did not care for the side of mushrooms.  Service was very good.  Place was packed on a Saturday night.  Recommended.
name: Paul

text: This place is a gem! I love the decor. It's a great place to go and escape the city and feel like you are on vacation somewhere warmer. My husband and I went here for drinks and appies. The lime margaritas are perfection. Not too sweet and just the right amount of tequila and salt. Also the mussels were giant and tastes so fresh and delicious. We can't wait to come back and try more authentic Peruvian food and also do some dancing on the weekend!
name: Angie

text: The best place where to get fresh amazing food.  There filet mignon sandwich is life changing.
name: Michael

text: This place is great! If you're not in the mood for greasy bar food. Kerri was an amazing server. She explained items on the menu. She checked on us throughout our lunch but wasn't overbearing. Merchants has a great atmosphere. The music is soothing. The food is excellent.
name: Tina

text: Wow! We've been here a few times and it has been incredible. What happened?? Our meal was cold...all of it! The ribs were overcooked. The mashed potatoes sat under a heat lamp forever because there was a film over them. So sad! Used to love this place. Probably won't t be back. The waitress was super nice!
name: Mary

text:
My favorite place in town. 
I have been going here for Sushi/Sashimi for about a year now and I have never been let down whether dining in or carrying out. Overall, it's well made food at a reasonable and fair price; furthermore, there is even plenty of options for those who prefer things cooked and crispy. The establishment is clean and comfortable for a nice diner out.
name: Kenny

text: This is the best place for breakfast. Went here on a whim before Shad Festival. So good. You wont be disappointed. We will be back
name: Elyse

text: Wow! Last time I came was with my boyfriend back in December. Back then we only ordered the 25oz Miller Lite which is only $3.50! We came back today and were pleasantly surprised at how good their food was. We originally came for the great deals on beer but we will be coming back because of how good the food is! Everything and anything we ordered was very good. Our waiter Chelsea handled a party of 9 beautifully. Thank you all for the patience and great customer service. We are for Miami, so unfortunately will have to wait a while to come back. Can't beat the quality and deals they have.
name: Abby

text: Went in to get sushi because the name on the front of the building stated sushi. Sat down, received the menu and it did not list any sushi selections. Asked the server for sushi menu and he said they really didn't have much sushi right now, whatever that means. Left.
name: Mike

text: I was online today looking for a good place to get a steak and this place stood out to me and I must say amazing steak and fries keep up the good work told my husband about this place this is my go to spot for food , don't change anything great customer service the young man who brought the food was very friendly . I will be back  and if you want something real and tasty this is the place
name: Tasha

text: I had a really great experience at Molly Malloy's! When going to Reading Terminal Market for the first time - prepare to be overwhelmed! It was a lot to take in, but then I saw Molly Malloy's and though "oh good, a place we can sit down and have a full service lunch and get acquainted with the place...and that's just what Molly's provided. We had to wait a short bit, maybe 5 or 10 minutes...that didn't matter though, because Theresa at the hostess stand was incredible. She was sort of our first impression of Philly and she set the tone so nicely! She was on the hunt for seating for us and provided us with a full detail of where all of their food is sourced - right there in the market. She gave us information like, "the meat comes from a butcher just two rows over and his food comes from Amish farmers about an hour away" and "The bread was baked on Row X and was made just today" and "the produce is from the corner produce stand just right there"...it was really cool to know that everything we were eating was coming from right within the market, fresh. It was our first couple of hours in Philly so I went ahead and dove right in with a Philly Cheesesteak and it was delicious! I added caramelized onions and mushrooms and it all seemed as fresh as it was described to us. My husband had the chicken pot pie and WOW it was good. It came out in its own skillet and tasted very homemade and fresh. To top it off we had a couple of glasses of wine and then went about exploring the market. Leave room for dessert! There are tons of dessert vendors! This was a nice experience and we owe a lot of that to Theresa!
name: Kerry

text: One of my favorite places to eat at when I visit Reno.  I've tried a few of their dishes but my favorite so far is the Sage chicken! The chicken is very juicy and just right.  I also love their bloody Mary!  So tasty and it is garnished with Bacon too! My kids love their waffles and bacon waffles.  Can't go wrong with this place!
name: Janice

text: The pizza really is ready in 3 minutes.  Have stopped here for super quick dinner on two separate occasions and haven't been disappointed.  They have a variety of pizzas to choose from (or pasta or salad) or you can build your own.  They have white, wheat and gluten free crusts.  The servers and pizza makers are quick to offer suggestions.  The only down side is that the beautifully crispy crust does not keep very well so better to eat it while it's hot!
name: Rachel

text:
Went here for lunch on 7/3 - the food and service were fantastic! The layout is a little tricky to find a table bc you order your food at the counter and then find a table.

Highly recommend the cheese tray, potato salad, BLT and muffuletta - all of it was delicious!

The reason for the 4 stars were 2 things: 1) no refills on drinks which irritates me at any restaurant in the US but particularly in NOLA in July and 2) there are far too many tables shoved in the small space which makes it difficult to enjoy your meal fully.
name: Jennifer

text:
I had my birthday dinner here with some friends & it was absolutely perfect! Our waiter was friendly and fun, and mostly importantly, knew the wine list like the back of his hand. We ordered at least half of the menu & each tapa was fantastic. The standouts were definitely the steak with truffle vinaigrette, patatas bravas, & the chickpea dish. At the end of the meal, I was surprised with a decadent molten chocolate cake. The bill was also surprisingly low considering all of the wine & tapas we ordered. 

Can't recommend this place enough!
name: Mellissa

text: Good place to get a quick cup of corn and crab bisque before your flight. My food only took about 5 minutes, although there wasn't a line when I was there. Bisque was pretty good, and the biscuit was great. I would recommend this place as it is reasonably priced for the airport and the food is pretty good.
name: Nina

text:
DONT GET THE CHICKEN MARSALA..... I GOT FOOD POISONING!!!!!! 


Typically, this restaurant is great... service and food. 
We went to dinner as a family and right off the bat it was horrible. Front desk was so extremely unprofessional and rude, not to mention one of the girls was wearing a shirt so short, we also say her butt. 
Our server was so slow and didn't seem to be present at work. It took him 15 minutes, FIFTEEN MINUTES, to bring us TWO WATERS!!!  
He was so "overwhelmed" by a table of 7, the manager had to step in and finish serving us. 
ALL of our food was cold but since we waited over an hour to get our food (when the table behind us of 10+ people got served before us) we didn't send any food back. 
Sad when you spend over $17 A PLATE and you get cold good. 

I have been sick for three days because I ate the Chicken Marsala. It was DROWNED in Marsala sauce and the fettuccine sauce from my noodles, I wouldn't have been able to tell if it was undercooked or not. 

Every time we eat at this restaurant, it gets worse and worse. Things need to change from the front desk to service to food. 

I wish I could give NO stars for this review...Won't be eating here anytime soon!
name: Kayla

text: This place is not very good. The food is very mediocre and tasteless. Their naan is good but other than that the food is not worth the price. I tried their lunch buffet with some American colleagues and they hated the food too. That usually never happens . I like their desserts and naan ..that's it
name: Aakash

text: Wow - there must be a new chef or procedures for the kitchen. Best and biggest burger ever on a nicely toasted bun. Wrapped well and fries nice and hot. Well done! Dlvy was on 30 minutes, very nice! Keep up the great work.
name: Rick

text: If you like wagyu beef burgers and craft beer, then you have to try this place out.  They have over 100 craft beers that rotate regularly.  The burgers are phenomenal!  Try the Trabue if you like an egg topped burger.  Try the Cowboy if you like bbq burgers and if you like spicy flaming hot.....be brave and go for the Shocker (jalapenos, habaneros, house made Shocker sauce and pepperjack cheese.  The sauce they give you for fries is a delicious alternative to boring ketchup.  Staff is friendly and informative on all of the craft beers.  My favorite burger place in Nashville by far.
name: Troy

text: My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Not bad for a quick meal. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: Just stopped in for some drinks. Our bartender RICHARD was so nice and told us a lot of history for the downtown bars. Enjoyed talking with him! Music was good also. It was a kid that had been on the Voice.
name: Paula

text: Johnny's Po-Boys is legit.  Wife and I split the shrimp po-boy as a mid afternoon sober up snack.  It hit the spot.  Added a little crystal to my half. I thought it made it better.  No ketchup please.
name: Adam B.

text: Food was good and came out fast. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text:
Cannot give zero so gave one. The person at reception on 02/03/18 was very unprofessional and rude. When we asked to speak to a manager, he claimed to be the manager. He could not provide us seating and was extremely rude to our group after waiting for 20+ minutes.

I would not advise to visit this place for a group of more than 4.
name: Faraazuddin

text: What a surprise find!!!  My wife & I ate dinner there tonight.   The food was great, but the real treat was the incredibly positive attitude and fantastic service!!!!  Nicole, a physical therapy student from PA who attends school here, came over to provide a personal welcome and discuss the history and mission of Mission BBQ.    The walls are covered with tasteful decorations & mementos of military, law enforcement, and fire fighters.   When the staff heard is served over 30 years in the US Navy, they brought dessert - on the house!
name: R. Tom

text: The manager of this establishment treated me like..well..that..I think mostly because of my accent, yes,my Hispanic accent. Funny thing was I was getting something to put it in a to go fast food list..that a magazine asked me to do.
name: Erika

text: Drive through is horrible during the lunch rush. Cashier working the window is always in such a rush that it's easy to forget what the customer ordered. I ordered a meal and a chocolate shake but did not realize I didn't receive a chocolate shake until I was miles away. I'm sure it's because as soon as she handed me my order, she close the window. I called back up there to see if I could be reimbursed on my debit card but I was told I had to come back up in order to be reimbursed. Now why would I come all the way back to this restaurant to be reimbursed for a  chocolate shake when I could just get another chocolate a shake? That's a mention the food was all really greasy and the wait is always always too long.Terrible customer service.
name: Julia

text:
This is Barrett for another review and I loved the Mac n cheese but I would add a little more seasoning to the pork chop with two sides altogether I would recommend to a friend.

This is Samantha (Barrett mom!). This was a great dining experience!  Most of the time Barrett doesn't eat meat (other then burgers and tacos) but today he ate EVeRYTHING!  He could have licked his plate.  I had the 4 veggie and LOVED everything I got!  Eating area and Bathrooms were clean.  Parking was a bit of a nail biter but it is all good!  Enjoy!
name: Samantha

text: Went in late on Monday night, close to closing and they were out of meatballs so we went back the next day for a late lunch.  We were treated great and the meatballs were delicious.  Thank you for the extra special experience.  Steven was our server and he took really good care of us.  Good food, Great service!
name: Craig

text: Terrible service, sever was absent, forgot food and drinks, obviously the place didn't have enough staff loud obnoxious trivia night
name: Jana

text:
Big thanks to Jonathan and David for making my sisters bachelorette lunch such a fun event - complete with the right size tees. 

As always, the Nachos are to die for and the tacos too.
name: Cheryl

text: First time going here. Staff is over the top friendly. I had a Bloody Mary to drink, it was great. I ate the chicken and waffles (it was delicious), my daughter had shrimp and grits (it was ok, wouldn't order it again) and my husband had the western omelette (he had no complaints). Will definitely come back another time and try it again.
name: Rachel

text:
Bonkers. I became immediately obsessed with this place from the first day on a recent vacation.
We were staying in the St. Claude/Bywater area just north of St. Claude and needed a grocery store nearby that was open at 9:30pm. MGZ showed up on Yelp and I went there with my brother.
First of all it's just a single door sized door on a huge building, no sliding double glass here! When you walk in there's a built-in pizzeria to your left and a deli counter to your right. Walk straight past both and the registers and the room opens up to a huge warehouse-like grocery store. There is a staircase to an open second mezzanine story that claims to have all the Mardi Gras supplies you'll ever need. To the right in the hallway of refrigeration with rows of reach-in deli coolers and open produce reach-ins going into the distance.
We bought groceries, wine, hot pizza, small cigars (for my niece and her boyfriend) and other stuff. All was reasonable.
I would go back just for the funky, righteous vibe. I went every day I was there and couldn't stop suggesting it to everyone.
name: National

text: Although they initially got our order wrong, they more than remedied the situation.  Ivan went out of his way to make sure we were satisfied by fully replacing our order.  We really appreciated the great customer service and accommodation.  Very sweet people
name: Robert

text: For a busy night they handled it okay. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. The music was louder than it needed to be. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Definitely coming back. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: Best sushi in Santa Barbara and if i'm honest als the best Restaurant in Santa Barbara now. From the moment you walk in, it is on. 17 courses. One big mind blowing event. Close your eyes, surrender yourself, let go and enjoy! Go here now.
name: Erik

text: I'm so glad that I had the chance to stop by this place on my last day in NOLA.  Followed the suggestions from the other yelpers, I got the CBB. It's delicious and satisfying. I still have the taste of it in my mouth while I'm writing this review.  Savory, creamy and spicy.  Definitely will come back again.
name: Lynn

text:
I came here for dinner with friends and there was four of us total. I think that was our main problem. This restaurant experience is more suited for two people dining out rather than a group. Once all of our food that we ordered was brought out, there was very little room at the table to move around. Two of us did the BBQ and two did the Hot Pot, even so, with 2 people doing BBQ, the grill gets a bit crowded. Which means you can only cook your meal in small batches. So you're kind of stuck nibbling in bits and pieces the whole time while you wait for the rest too cook. It also gets messy. You get a set of tongues to cook the meet with, but with a crowded table and a small grill where you're cooking your meat and vegetables on together I was constantly almost touching raw meat and cooked meat/veggies together. Also the potatoes and pumpkin I ordered came frozen so it took forever to grill, and even then they never really cooked properly. I also tried the curry chicken breast which was really good but not spicy at all. 

Maybe if I came back and was with only one person and we did 1 Hot Pot and 1 BBQ it wouldn't be as bad and there would be more room/ time to cook the food and not worry about contamination.

text:
4.5 stars. Overall, we really liked this place! Great tasting, authentic Mexican food at a reasonable price. Interior is really lacking in ambiance, but many times the best places have that strip mall, stripped down feel, so I'm not complaining. The service was friendly and fast, and the portions were generous. 

The best part was the Cadillac margarita. For some reason, Reno Mexican restaurants think serving pre-mixed margs in a huge bowl that looks like you should be buying it from a Disneyland gift shop is the way to go, but that's gross. (I'm looking at you, Miguel's.) I'd been searching for a normal sized, excellently made Cadillac, and I found it here, thank Jesus. 

The only thing I thought was strange was that the tortilla chips were already on the table when we were seated. Not sure how long they'd been sitting out, but having them served warm after we were seated would've been better. They weren't stale, I just didn't care for the cafeteria feeling having them already out evoked. The salsa was the kind we liked, more thin than chunky, and very flavorful.

Other than that minor nitpick, overall a fabulous place. Bonus points for having actual Latin people working in the restaurant. When everyone from the chefs to the servers at a Mexican place are Caucasian college kids, it feels inauthentic. (Again, I'm looking at you, Miguel's.)
name: J.T.

text: My husband and I had dinner on Sunday to celebrate his birthday. We have eaten here before on numerous occasions. I ordered the shrimp scampi and a small  salad. My husband ordered the 20 piece buffalo wings. When my salad came out there was a very small amount of dressing on it . You could hardly see it. I got the waiter 's attention and asked for more dressing. He came out carrying a little cup which was not even on a plate.   I always thought when you ordered wings the whole wing would be covered in sauce. On the plate was a pool of mild sauce then the wings were put on top making them baked wings. Again we flagged down the waiter and showed him the plate. He said he would bring out some wing sauce which we covered the top of the wings with. They were pretty good but I thought a little pricey at $19.99 for 20 wings. My scampi  arrived  next. It was hot but again where was the scampi sauce? It pooled at the bottom so I had to take a spoon and fork and keep mixing it. It was decent but I have eaten better. Very little garlic flavor to it. My husband's main entree was the beef and chicken fajitas. They were very good but considering the large platter of food he received only 2 small tortillas. He got the waiter's attention and asked him how many tortillas come with this. When he showed him the container with two small tortillas he apologized and brought a few more out. He never asked if we wanted a drink refill. It seemed like get the customer in and out. It was these small annoyances that kept me from giving a higher mark. But little things and presentation do count. I think we will not be returning anytime soon.

My wife and I took our 11 year old birthday boy to MM to celebrate his day with some delicious pizza. We didn't expect the inordinate delay and poor quality of preparation we received.

It was around 3:30pm on Saturday and only about 4-5 tables in the restaurant had guests. Once we finally received it, the appetizer was good. Unfortunately after that, it took FOREVER to get our pizza. By this I mean almost an hour. For a single pizza. In an empty restaurant. On a slow Saturday afternoon. 

When it finally did come out from the kitchen, the bottom/crust was so burned that we had to just scrape the toppings off and eat them. I do realize we could have sent it back, but we'd already been sitting in an so long to get the first one, we were starving, and honestly just didn't want to wait any longer. What's ridiculous is they charge $26... TWENTY-SIX DOLLARS... for a single, large pizza. At this exorbitant cost, we expect MUCH better.

text:
I work just down Rangeline and was introduced to Piada via their Cannoli chips (mmmmm). 

I visited this location for lunch with a former colleague. We went around noon and parking was absolutely horrendous. 

The restaurant itself had a fairly long line but I was impressed at how quickly it moved. Inside is very open and there are different types of table options to accommodate a single, a couple, or even fairly large groups. Right in the middle you get your cutlery and drinks.There are also a few tiny tables outside if you are so inclined. 

I was a little confused at their menu. There are little menus as you enter the queue, a large hanging menu and, of course, the online menu (for people like me that like to do research in advance). They didn't all have the same information (certain things were excluded like my beloved Cannoli chips) which is bad for new patrons. So I recommend you check out the online menu in advance if you're heading in and unfamiliar with the offerings (which I believe are seasonal anyway).

I have had the pepperoni and Parmesan piada sticks (I prefer the Parm). Is it just me or is the sauce that comes with it very Ranchy? Good but not what I expected. I had a meatball when I didn't want to commit to a larger meal. It was good but an almost mushy texture (not necessary bad to me but my friend wasn't a fan). I got the Carbonara which was pretty good. (Not good heated up, just FYI). I added chicken but it does have a little pancetta so at least I can pretend there's some protein with my carbs. You get quite a lot of pasta for the price (I got the regular). 

Overall it wasn't to die for but it was good enough that I will definitely be back to try some more menu options. Also, again, dare I say----Cannoli chips.

text:

As far as their entrees go, the options are endless. As a pescatarian I am biased to their shrimp dishes- I've had shrimp tacos, sea food burritos and their stuffed shrimp. Each dish was amazing in their own way- save to say that my plate is always cleaned at the end of the meal!

text:
I literally just stopped eating a bacon knackwurst in order to write this review. Rieker's Prime Meats is by far the best German shop that I've visited in the United States. The selection is incredible, the prices are incredibly accessible, and the food is perfect. 

I'm admittedly biased, having grown up with a German father, and taking frequent trips to visit his family, who owned a butcher shop in a small German town, and Rieker's was like taking a trip back in time. The minute I opened the door (parking lot is in the back), the smell took me back to Mayen. The meat counter stretches for what seems like miles, and is filled with prepared cuts (marinated meats, stuffed meats, expertly-butchered cuts), and the rest of the store features all of the German brands of sauces (Maggi), spices (Knorr), desserts (Kinder Chocolate), and more. I was basically a kid in a candy shop. 

I wanted to get my bearings before ordering meat, so I started by picking up some spicy pickles, German dumplings, Westphalia rye bread, and other treats, and browsing their extensive selection of Germany-themed flags, hats, scarves, and more. They had a wide variety of my favorite Germany mustard (Thomy), as well as frozen pretzels and fresh Amorosa rolls, sauerkraut, red cabbage, potato salad, and prepared sides like cucumber and onion salad, and incredibly flaky, sweet, and gooey apple struedel. 

Once I was ready to immerse myself in German meats, I walked over to the counter and was served immediately. They have a number system for when it's packed (and while it wasn't packed while I was there, there was a steady stream of customers the entire time), but service moves quickly. 

There were a couple of things I knew I wanted (bacon knackwurst, landjaeger), a type of ham I didn't know the name of, but knew how to describe the taste (turns out it's Westphalia ham), and then wanted to try some new things. The guy who helped me was wonderful, and he brought us several things to try, resulting in me buying the best bologna I've ever tasted, and two other cooked sausages (Rauchfleish and Pfefferfleish). 

Rieker's is a must-do for anyone who enjoys German food, but it's also great for buying super high quality meats at an affordable price point, and if I lived nearby, I would definitely go there for lunch. Es ist wunderbar!

text:
After watching the relevant Chef's Table episode and driving over from West Philadelphia, I was poised to like South Philly Barbacoa -- a lot.

We came at 1PM on a weekday and were lucky enough to find a parking space on Ellsworth not far from the barbacoa.  Amazingly, there was absolutely no line when we walked in the door.  The three of us ordered a total of eight tacos and one agua fresca.  We paid $40 in cash for our lunches.  (Credit cards are not accepted here.)

My lunch consisted of two lamb tacos, one pork taco and the agua fresca.  I live in the SF Bay Area, where the agua and taco standards are pretty high.  I thought that the cantaloupe agua fresca was A-OK but not as rich as what I can get at home.  The lamb tacos were ABSOLUTELY DELICIOUS and justified the whole experience.  My pork taco was surprising to me both in its color and its taste -- there's nothing at home that I can compare it to, and I'm not 100% sure that I liked it.

When we left (~ 1:30PM), South Philly Barbacoa had a line out the door.  The staff (who were super-friendly, by the way), were doing their best to expedite the ordering process and ensure that people could get served without much delay.

To no one's surprise, the bottom line is that I did like this place -- a lot!  I recommend South Philly Barbacoa without reservation to anyone whose interest was piqued by the Netflix program and the surrounding hype.  More generally, I recommend South Philly Barbacoa, period.  I hope to return when I next visit Philadelphia.

text:
I was recently taken out to a restaurant in Newtown Square that I didn't even know existed but have probably passed by several times.  Well now I know it exists because I had a totally tasty and enjoyable meal there.  I'm talking about Charlotte's. Charlotte's is what I would call an old-school restaurant.  It is especially known for its crab dishes including an all-you-can-eat crabfest on Tuesday nights. But the large menu has many other delectable treats as well.
 
When we walked in, right away I was struck by the Austrian crystal on display.  My friends knew it was there but didn't tell me beforehand so I could be surprised.  We then sat down to a multi-course feast.  The entire meal began with a bread course served with both olive oil and butter .... your choice.  My appetizer selection was Philly Snapper Soup.  Of course it came with sherry.  This soup is so flavorful, I could eat several bowls of it.  Friends tried a mushroom bisque which also passed muster.  A healthy salad with amazing house-made blue cheese dressing came next.  The dressing was full of blue cheese chunks and when the waitress saw how much I liked it, she gave me a little dressing to take home with me.  For my main course I ordered the now-in-season soft-shell crab on toast points with cole slaw and French fries.  Again everything was fine but I was getting pretty full by this point so I knew I would be availing myself of a doggy bag.  The other entrees of chicken piccata and rib-eye steak were also large and well-liked.  My friends ordered key lime pie for dessert which I tasted - perfect!
 
Our waitress was great .... personable and efficient!  She easily handled any requests and made sure the water and wine glasses were filled.  Of course I would go back to Charlotte's again.  It was an excellent meal!  My tip for this restaurant is:  Have a big appetite when you dine here.  And don't forget to admire the Austrian crystal!
name: Jeff

text: I didn't know there was such a thing as bland Mexican food till I ate here. That is all. Well aside from the fact 2 chicken tacos, a Dixie cup portion of rice and a drink cost me $9.00.
name: Terry

text: Went for the first time today. Suuuuuuper delicious! Had the bang bang shrimp Banh mi and was not disappointed. Spring rolls and peanut sauce are on point too! Can't wait to return and try everything else!
name: Lauren

text: Great casual spot to grab brunch or lunch! Enjoyed the outdoor seating. The avocado toast was great (and very filling with a poached egg on top!) Only downside was they didn't have too many vegetarian options available.
name: Bansri

text:
Busy Family restaurant. Wings and curly fries that I had one nice and fresh and made to order. Unfortunately the pizza. My son want it would have taken over a half an hour. My son was satisfied with sausage and cheese Pizza. Nice  two beverage cases full of bittled drinks  Nice snacks and candy choices for a treat. Also a small selection of fresh groceries. I was kind of confused on how we order when we came in there were three TV screens that were not working probably due to upgrade I was handed a paper threefold menu to pick from. Which was a quick and easy read. Unisex bathroom located. Very spacious I'm comfortable in temperature control.
Only do three stars due to obviously repair work that there doing. Looking forward to visiting again let me come back for Fall Festival.
name: Danielle

text:
Wow wow wow, I think this is the best pizza in Boise, without a doubt it's the best deep dish pizza and likely the only Detroit style in all of Idaho.

The server was extra chill which equated to him not being very attentive. I didn't really need his attention the majority of the time. If I were there with my kids the service would likely have been an issue. He was very friendly though. He recommended the pizza that I got.

There was no beer menu on the table so I ended up just getting water which had no ice. The water was cold at least.

I can't wait to bring the family here I think they'll love the pizza too.
name: Wade

text: Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. A couple small things kept adding up. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Food was good and came out fast. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text: Have been to other Two Stones and always enjoyed. Have been to this location twice, once just to grab a quick drink and do some work, and then again Saturday night for dinner. There was a minor wait for a table, but the bartenders were friendly and quick while we waited. We were seated in the large, heated and covered patio-ish area, and Amanda took exquisite care of us. The beer list was solid, and they were quick to update them when something kicked. Founders Canadian Breakfast Stout - wow! Menu was excellent, as usual, and the specials were good. The chicken nachos were delicious, and I went with the short rib confit dinner special. The short ribs were perfectly prepped, and really yummy. Next time we will stay for dessert as well. Amanda and the team were great, and all three of us had a blast. Thanks for a great time!
name: Ian

text: A fantastic beer and brat and more experience.  I had the venison brat that was very tasty.  My wife had the pork loin sliders. Real pork nicely fried.  She ate ALL her nice big chunky fries.  They had wine for her, and I enjoyed a nice house Kafir Lime IPA.  So good I'm taking home a growler.  We may come back for dinner because they have vegan brats for his girlfriend.
name: Ron

text: Why is there termites everywhere?? food came out cold..i wanted this to be great and the ball dropped
name: Kristen

text: I very much appreciated the surprise of paper plates since we are in a hotel. Delivery was fast. Delivery person was sweet. And the food was delicious! We ordered the classic deep dish: pepperoni and garlic-fennel sausage plus dry rubbed wings.
name: Ari

text: Having tried the other location in the past, i wanted to compare the two. This is definitely the better location! The server was very friendly and helpful. The sandwiches taste better here, higher quality and less greasy. A good lunch spot if u are craving a hot sandwich!
name: Kovia

text: It tasted fresh, just not especially memorable. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. For a busy night they handled it okay. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Maybe better dine-in than delivery, hard to tell. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly.
name: User

text:
It's a chain... what do you expect? 

I sat at the bar for dinner. Service was slow, but the place was packed. I order chili, it was horrible. I had a fillet ($27) with broccoli, which were decent, but the waitstaff kept screwing up my order. I asked for butter and did not get it, then asked again and did not get it, on the third try I finally got what I needed. It took 10 minutes, by which time I had eaten most of my dinner.

Will I be back? Only if I have to.
name: Joe

text:
My friend and I were lucky enough to get a reservation about two years ago and didn't enjoy the food or the atmosphere. There  was a very LA trendy air. 

My BF chose it tonight based on an Axxess deal but I didn't realize it was the same place. The host was very nice and the wait staff well trained and professional. The apps were delicious.  We had the garden lettuces and eggamuffin which were both amazing. We then ordered the Santa Maria tri tip and NY steak. They were literally inedible. They brought me a Sea Bass in exchange and it was not rare it was seared. We returned all three proteins. The sides and appetizers were amazing but their proteins were inedible.   The management was great and removed the cost but we tipped the server $100 to ensure the owners knew we weren't trying to get a free meal.
name: Jim

text: Amazing Asada Burrito. Food is good. Service is friendly. It was super cold inside. We are wearing jackets. They need to turn the heat on. Margaritas are large and good. Hit the spot.
name: Joseph

text: Stopped by after work because I was nearby and hungry. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. It was decent, just a little uneven. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text: Great place right on beach drive in st Petersburg. They have a nice large bar as well as tables in the restaurant. They have a fantastic food menu but I've only been here for happy hour. And what great happy hour specials they have, 1/2 off house wines, 1/2 off select draft beers, 1/2 off well liquors and appetizer specials. I had the blistered Edamame and shrimp chips, both were delicious. The Edamame was some of the best I have had because of the flavor around the pods. At night on the weekends they bring in a dj and it becomes a happening night time location. I love the decor, good service. I'll definitely return for dinner and they have Saturday and Sunday brunch.
name: Lara

text: We stopped by for barbecue after a movie and thoroughly enjoyed Mission BBQ. The food was great service was excellent we will definitely go back. Everything on the menu is a ala carte with what's a good beats to choose from. I had the pulled pork and they have 6 awesome BBQ sauce is on the table try them all they were all great!
name: Dave

text:
Fabulous find for a nice treat!  Upon arrival the hostess greeted us and wished my husband a happy birthday, which had been noted in our open table reservation.  We arrived 10 minutes early and were promptly shown to our table.

We ordered way too much!  We were hungry and the portions were generous.  Next time I could go without an appetizer and just enjoy the delicious warm bread that they serve with a nice spice blend to it.  However, since it was his birthday we decided to go all out and try whatever looked good to him.  Appetizers Kung Pao Calamari and Meat & Cheese Board were wonderful!  Meat & Cheese board came with several large grilled crostini, whole grain mustard, candied pancetta (delicious), burrata (mozzarella), goat cheese fritter on apple butter (my favorite)!  Entrees we had were the Crab Cakes & Snapper.  Crab cakes were very light, not too fried and large portions.  I ordered the snapper and it was phenomenal with nice spices.  We both struggled to finish the entrees as we knew they wouldn't reheat as well.  To top it off they had my husband pick any dessert for his birthday, which was complementary.  He chose the bread pudding that came with a scoop of vanilla ice cream on top.  It too was very delicious!  We will definitely return for more date nights and order less food!

They do have valet parking for $8.
name: Alice-Anne

text: The pizza is good, most of the people are friendly but they are so disorganized. It's ridiculous. Even if you order in advance they will never be on time. They tried to make me double pay this last time and never even asked to see my receipt. I was greeted as "the lady who ordered a bunch of pizza and it's not done cause it was a lot of pizza". They never have Hot n Ready anything on any day at any time. If they weren't they closest place aside from Domino's I'd never go to this location since you'll never get out in less than 30-45 mins.
name: Ashley

text:
The place was bumping and the decor was fun & chic! The food was decent... not a lot of flavor in my fajitas.  I've had chimis from here before and the meat just isn't seasoned all that well.

I do love their chips and salsa and they have my favorite prickly pear margarita.. it's the best here!

The food and service were okay but nothing to write home about.  I always take my Eastside friends here because the food is consistently decent (no great or bad days usually) and they get that 'Mexican' food vibe they're looking for so it's typically a steady choice.
name: Augustina
